The Electronics Supplier Quality Engineer will support Allegion’s America’s business units by managing their global suppliers in the electronics commodity (primarily PCBAs, motors and wire harnesses). This role will be expected to drive supplier KPIs (SPPM and on-time supplier 8D closure rate) and support both commodity management’s strategic vision and manufacturing’s ongoing production.

* Conducts On-Site Assessments, in support of new sourcing / supplier plant moves, to evaluate the capability of the supplier’s processes to produce and deliver a part that meets customer requirements.

description:
Are you a passionate engineer that likes improving processes, keeping production flowing, and preventing non-conforming parts? We are seeking a quality engineer to be Oxide’s onsite presence as a Production Quality Engineer. You’ll work directly with our contract manufacturer (CM) quality and production engineering teams, leading the front line defense of Oxide products!

While Oxide is a remote-friendly company, we’ve found that being physically present during manufacturing is essential to building a great product and strong relationships. This role requires regular on-site presence at our contract manufacturer (CM) in Rochester and Winona, Minnesota (up to 5 days per week). Relocation package is available.

**As a Quality Manager, you will:**
-----------------------------------

* Prioritize communicating “early and often” as the Oxide onsite quality presence and point of contact for production quality issues
* Take ownership over incoming material and production non-conformances, deviations, and production quality issues requiring Oxide support
* Work with incoming material suppliers to prevent recurrence of material non-conformances
* Provide clarity and advocate for Oxide’s expectations of quality attributes and requirements
* Support production application testing for part qualifications
* Work closely with our contract manufacturer’s manufacturing teams to understand manufacturing processes, identify risks, and take preventative actions
* Learn about every piece of Oxide’s hardware, from the smallest PCBA to the rack-level, including reading schematics and drawings to understand the system
* Execute resolution of 8D corrective actions for customer escapes tied to CM production processes
* Recommend hardware and equipment needed to support onsite quality needs
* Perform periodic line walks, collect feedback from CM production employees, and advocate for continuous improvement
* Review and propose improvement of contract manufacturer’s production and incoming inspection plans
* Work with Oxide and CM Quality functions to rectify underperforming first pass yields and identify root cause
* Work closely with manufacturing and test teams to develop, maintain, and sustain processes and procedural documentation

**You will thrive in this role if you:**
----------------------------------------

* Have deep experience supporting various commodities, including mechanical rack weldments, cables, PCBAs manufacturing, and other electronics relevant to server hardware (e.g. SSDs, DRAM, CPUs)
* Have experience using traditional inspection methods (calipers, multimeters) and seek out ways to integrate more advanced inspection tools (CMM, VMM)
* Can navigate mechanical and electrical manufacturing processes and tools to present solutions to our engineering teams
* Are a strong verbal and written communicator. You will be an onsite representative for Oxide and you will be expected to provide concise and respectful communications across multiple levels and functions of our contract manufacturer.
* Mastered tools and processes related to product quality and supplier quality
* Have experience working with contract manufacturers in the electronics industry focused on highly complex printed circuit board fabrication and assembly
* Enjoy digging into technical data (schematics, datasheets, drawings) to provide recommendations to engineering teams to address quality issues
* Are able to balance cost, quality, and time as the situation dictates, adjusting priorities based on risk while driving for all material to meet customer expectations.
* Have held of positions throughout design engineering, manufacturing, and quality
* Have lived as a Manufacturing Engineer. We’re looking for someone that has a technical eye for developing processes and procedures and their career has evolved into holding suppliers to account in a quality role.
* Possess ASQ or Six Sigma certifications

**Before applying for this role, you should:**
----------------------------------------------

* Learn enough about our product to understand our approach.
* Browse our public Requests for Discussion to get a flavor for how we work.
* Listen to Hiring Processes with Gergely Orosz to familiarize yourself with the Oxide hiring process.
* Listen to some of our hardware-centric episodes of *Oxide and Friends*. A few recommendations:

+ Scaling Manufacturing about our experience rapidly ramping our manufacturing and supply chain.
+ Tales from Manufacturing: Shipping Rack 1 to hear about how everything came together for our first customer shipment.
+ Raiding the Minibar about a test rig we’ve developed for our manufacturing line
+ Integrating Hardware and Software Teams on the benefits of having hardware and software engineers working together.

-----------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

**The City of San Antonio is looking to fill multiple** **positions** **Citywide. Applications from this posting may be used to fill current and future vacancies within multiple departments, including but not limited to: Aviation, Building & Equipment Services, Center City Development Office, City Attorney, Department of Human Services, Office of City Clerk, Fire and EMS, San Antonio Police Department, SA Metro Health District, Municipal Courts, Parks and Recreation, Public Works, Pre-K 4 SA, World Heritage Office, and other departments****.**

Under immediate supervision, is responsible for performing a variety of secretarial and clerical duties. Working conditions are primarily inside an office environment. May exercise supervision. Annual salary is based on working 2,080 hours. Actual compensation is based on the number of hours worked.

This advertisement will be used to fill one of the following positions:

* **Administrative Associate** (salary range: ($37,926.72- $39,458.90)
* **Administrative Assistant I** (salary range: ($40,491.62 - $47,410.22)
* **Administrative Assistant II** (salary range: ($42,375.58 - $52,106.86)
* **Senior Administrative Assistant** (salary range: ($39,350.22 - $59,025.46)

Some of the available positions are "grant-funded", therefore unclassified and have no disciplinary appeal rights to the Municipal Civil Service Commission. These positions are likewise subject to at-will employment status and can be terminated at any time for any reason.

**Work Location**

Varies based upon assigned department.

**Work Schedule**

Varies based upon assigned department.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**Administrative Associate:**

* Performs a variety of clerical duties in assigned department including maintaining personnel records and payroll, data entry, filing, distributing mail, answering telephones, and taking messages.
* Types and proofreads reports, letters, memos, flyers, and statistical charts.
* Responds to inquiries about department services and activities; assists visitors as necessary.
* May prepare payroll and associated transactions and assist in compiling and maintaining personnel records (e.g., weekly earnings, absences, supervisory reports, change of status, terminations, and personnel requisitions).
* Verifies and reviews correspondence for conformance with established policies and procedures.
* Orders and maintains inventory of office supplies.
* Prepares routine reports and correspondence.
* Orders supplies and equipment; maintains petty cash fund.
* Issues permits and collects associated fees.
* Department Specific:
+ Department of Human Services - staff at Senior Centers - Unloads and sorts food commodities from pallets; assembles food boxes and packages for distribution to Senior Center members, which requires lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

**Administrative Assistant I:**

* Assists with monitoring and reviewing expenditures; provides information to appropriate department staff for budget preparation.
* Maintains calendars and schedules activities, meetings, and various events.
* Coordinates activities with other City departments, outside agencies, and the general public.
* Assists in initiating personnel requisitions, monitors overtime and attendance records, and assists in monitoring employee payrolls.
* Department Specific:
+ Department of Human Services - staff at Senior Centers - Unloads and sorts food commodities from pallets; assembles food boxes and packages for distribution to Senior Center members, which requires lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 25 pounds.
+ Office of the City Clerk - Physical requirements include occasional lifting/carrying of up to 50 pounds, visual acuity, speech and hearing; hand and eye coordination, and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer keyboard and basic office equipment. Subject to sitting, standing, reaching, walking, twisting, and kneeling to perform the essential functions. Working conditions are both inside and outside, with exposure to temperature extremes, a warehouse environment, dust, and high-level noise.

**Administrative Assistant II:**

* Assists in providing a variety of responsible duties involved in coordinating the administrative operations of the assigned department or division.
* Assists in the formulation of policies and procedures for the assigned department; ensures compliance with current City and department rules and regulations.
* Assists in coordinating administrative personnel functions, assists in initiating personnel requisitions, monitors overtime and attendance records, and assists in preparing and monitoring employees' payroll.
* May oversee operations of a warehouse, including inventory control, purchasing materials and tools, and ensuring inventory procedures are implemented.
* May supervise clerical and administrative staff in general office operations.

U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals granted refugee or asylee status in the U.S. are considered U.S. persons. At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

We are seeking a **Senior Principal Project Engineer** for our Avionics Software Tools team based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. The Avionics Software Tools team is an Avionics software tools focused team, with responsibilities for Avionics Function tools, delivering tools that configure Avionics products and Integrated Modular Architecture systems tools that enable systems engineers to design and deploy aircraft systems I/O for aircraft platforms. This engineer will work in a team of software and systems engineers driving solutions for DO-330 qualified tools, simulation and infrastructure tools for multiple avionics teams. The team supports Collins Avionics Commercial and Military platforms. Our team builds cloud and desktop environments for use in dev ops pipelines, desktop deployments and external customers that enable configuration of Avionics products used on aircraft.

This role is for a strong technical leader that acts as a Product Chief for our team and will be expected to develop knowledge in multiple avionics software domains and lead technical approaches, trade studies, demonstrate project reporting skills, and represent our team in formal bids, product management reviews, and work closely with engineering management to drive projects to completion. An ideal candidate will have systems experience or training in addition to a software engineering background.

This is an onsite role in our facilities located in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and due to the global nature of our business and customers, applicants to this position will be expected to collaborate with teams located in multiple geographical locations beyond North America.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead design activities, bidding and execution coordination of Avionics tools in support of avionics software development and system testing
* Report on program status (schedule, budget, staffing, issues, and accomplishments) to management
* Interact and collaborate with engineering teams across Avionics and provide engineering project support to external customers when required.
* Lead design and requirements for current and next generation Avionics tools
* Provide technical leadership to the team, driving the roadmap for the group towards achieving organizational Avionics development and tool qualification needs
* Work with aircraft systems engineers and airborne software application teams to design and deliver solutions that integrate Avionics software for prototyping, implementation and testing of avionics products.
* Collaborate using project management tools and processes defined by the organization.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experience
* Project engineering experience leading medium or large sized teams
* Experience in software engineering and how it applies to system architecture development
* Experience with proposal preparation and formal bidding processes

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience with DO-330 qualified tools used in certification of Avionics software
* Experience in both software and systems engineering
* Advanced knowledge of related disciplines within work area and ability to identify links and potential impact on projects, programs or systems.
* Experience with engineering proces

description:
Meta's Infrastructure organization is seeking a Manager to lead energy analytics strategy for our global data center portfolio. As power demand grows by an order of magnitude over the coming years, energy cost and usage become increasingly material drivers of Meta's financial performance. In this role, you will lead a growing, geographically distributed team of experienced analysts responsible for developing the forecasting models and analytical frameworks that inform capacity planning, budgeting, procurement strategy, and rate design across Meta's data center infrastructure. As the portfolio continues to scale, this role carries increased ownership: setting standards across the team, developing experienced individual contributors and emerging leads, and serving as a primary energy analytics partner to Infrastructure and Finance leadership. You will also build the systems that quantify the portfolio's exposure to energy price and volume volatility across markets.

### **Manager, Energy Analytics Responsibilities:**

* Lead and grow a team of energy analysts spanning data center portfolio analytics, clean and renewable projects, cost and rate analysis, and load and generation forecasting. Own hiring, onboarding, capacity planning, and team structure as the function scales
* Develop ICs and emerging team leads
* establish career pathways, calibration practices, and succession depth so the team's analytical capability is not concentrated in any single person
* Lead with accountability, transparency, and recognition, promoting continuous improvement and learning across the team
* Serve as an expert on energy rates and energy usage for Meta's growing global portfolio of data centers
* Own development and continuous improvement of models to forecast energy usage, generation, and cost, and to analyze electric rate impacts for current and future data center sites
* Set and enforce analytical standards across the team, covering methodology review, model documentation, version control, assumption governance, and QA of outputs used in financial and capacity decisions
* Support analysis and strategy for development of new rate structures for current and future data center locations, including in new and emerging markets
* Strengthen how the team characterizes uncertainty in its forecasts, moving beyond single point estimates toward ranges and scenario views that reflect price and volume variability, historical forecast error, and concentration by market, technology, and contract type
* Help establish and scale an energy risk quantification capability within Energy Operations, building the systems that measure Meta's exposure to energy price and volume volatility and partnering with Finance to define the analytics and reporting cadence that surface material exposure shifts early
* Build standardized tooling, data pipelines, and reporting that scale with the portfolio, reducing manual effort and streamlining communication of data and impact to the broader organization and leadership team
* Consolidate fragmented energy data across utility, market, and internal backend sources into durable, queryable data products with clear ownership
* Own the data controls and escalation paths that keep utility and market data reliable as transaction volume increases
* Lead development and delivery of monthly and annual summaries of key energy metrics to the Global Energy team, Infrastructure partners, Finance, and senior leadership
* Build strong partnerships with Infrastructure stakeholders to track data center design and capacity engineering trends, improve load forecasting methodologies, and support energy efficiency efforts
* provide energy expertise to diverse internal teams and coordinate on relevant issues and requirements
* Represent energy analytics in cross-functional planning forums, translating analytical findings into clear recommendations and trade-offs for non-specialist audiences
* Refine processes, planning cycles, and reviews to support decision making, prioritization, and tracking of progress across key stakeholders
* Travel domestically and internationally as needed (up to 30%)

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant work experience with an electric utility, financial institution, energy supplier, renewable energy project developer, or energy-intensive consumer
* 4+ years of direct people management experience, including managing a team through growth and change
* Hands-on experience analyzing and interpreting energy usage data, electric tariffs, and wholesale energy market data
* Experience owning forecasting or analytical models used in budgeting, capacity, or investment decisions
* Experience building or materially scaling an analytical capability rather than inheriting an established one
* Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large data sets
* Communication and data visualization skills
* experience developing narratives and communicating effectively with multiple

description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla’s Supplier Industrialization team develops and qualifies critical components at suppliers so production can launch on time, at scale and at quality. This role is in the Exterior Lighting team and related exterior lighting commodities from advanced development through mass production. You will work with Design, Purchasing, Quality, and Manufacturing, travel to supplier plants, and make on-the-spot calls on process, tooling, and launch readiness.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead industrialization for exterior lighting commodities from advanced development through mass-production qualification
* Lead New Product Introduction at suppliers, including process design, tooling and equipment readiness, inspection planning, and packaging
* Drive DFM with Design Engineering and suppliers; close manufacturability, GD&T, and process-capability gaps before tool kickoff
* Own Tesla Qualification Process deliverables through okay-to-tool, okay-to-ship, safe launch, and exit from safe launch
* Lead containment, root cause, and corrective action when parts or processes miss spec; confirm fixes stick across lines and plants
* Improve supplier scalability, cost, and quality using process capability, SPC, and launch metrics
* Make on-the-spot technical decisions at supplier sites, and close gaps in manufacturing process, tooling, inspection, and quality systems before they reach Tesla production

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years industrializing or manufacturing automotive exterior lighting, or closely related injection-molded / PCBA / optical assemblies
* Proven launch of production parts: tooling, APQP / PPAP or equivalent, process validation, and supplier readiness
* Working knowledge of GD&T, MSA, SPC, and problem-solving (8D, Ishikawa, DOE)
* Hands-on familiarity with processes such as injection molding, coating or metallization, welding or bonding, LED/PCBA, photometric or optical validation, and end-of-line test
* Ability to deal with competing priorities, ambiguity and thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment; strong technical comprehension and oral & written communication skills; understands technical issues and able to explain them in a concise and plain manner to technical and non-technical audiences
* Able to travel domestically or internationally on short notice, possibly up to 30%

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

#### **Expected Compensation**

$132,000 - $198,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located in the Examinations Branch of the Division of Clearing and Risk (DCR). The Examinations Branch plans and conducts examinations of derivatives clearing organizations (DCOs) to evaluate compliance with the Commodity Exchange Act (Act) and Commission regulations and monitors financial, operational, and risk activities of DCOs to assess the actual and potential implications of those activities for the DCO and for financial markets generally.

Learn more about this agency

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

Applications will be accepted from any U.S. Citizen.

**Duties**
----------

If selected for this position, you will serve as an Associate Director responsible for managing and supervising a team of professional and technical experts responsible for assessing DCOs for compliance with the Act and CFTC regulations. This will include the following:

* Provide expert advice and technical guidance to the Deputy Director for Examinations in the formulation of an annual plan of examinations. Ensure the planned examinations are carried out in an efficient and effective manner.
* Prepare risk assessments that identify potential areas of risk at a DCO and assign rankings to each risk. This includes assessing business risks related to DCO’s risk management policies and procedures and the identification of potential gaps in the risk controls at a given DCO.
* Establish the scope and priorities for DCO examinations, including those focusing on financial resources, operational capabilities, and risk management activities, specializing in system operations and safeguards, with minimal guidance from the Deputy Director. Conduct meetings with other regulators regarding common registrants, including staff of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the Securities and Exchange Commission and manage these inter-agency relationships.
* Provide leadership and guidance to team members through identifying, distributing, and balancing workload and tasks among employees in accordance with established workflow, skill level, and/or occupational specialization; adjusting workload and tasks among employees.
* Supervise professional staff assigned to non-routine reviews arising from notifications filed by DCOs highlighting unexpected events or errors, as well as reviews involving complex or unusual issues arising from ongoing or ad hoc financial and operational analyses of such entities.
* Review and assess the sufficiency and accuracy of the reports prepared by staff that detail the analysis done in response to DCO notifications.
* Assist the Deputy Director in developing new examination standards and guidance for evaluating the compliance of DCOs with regulatory requirements. Review the effectiveness of these standards and guidance and update as necessary.
* Serve as an expert regarding the Examinations Branch’s internally developed software. Assist other staff in understanding the output of the software and respond to general or specific questions posed by senior DCR staff, other CFTC staff, and Commissioners and their staff related to the software.
* Represent the branch at program meetings, briefing reviews, technical assessments, training sessions and related activities for DCR senior staff and staff of other Commission offices/divisions regarding the examination program functions and activities. Answer questions from DCR and other Commission staff and the public concerning the examination program.
* Build coalitions internally and with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, nonprofit and private sector organizations, foreign governments, or international organizations to achieve common goals.
* Perform special projects, as assigned, and in support of DCR’s responsibilities in general.

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* U.S. Citizenship
* Background/Security Investigation
* Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
* May be required to serve a 1-year supervisory probationary period

Must submit all required documents by the closing date.

**You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency (knowledge, skills, abilities) in the following areas:**

* Accountability
* Customer Service
* Decisiveness
* Flexibility
* Interpersonal Skills
* Problem Solving
* Resilience

Skill in developing, planning, and coordinating examinations of DCOs for compliance with regulations;

Ability to communicate in a clear, concise and effective manner in order to prepare reports that document analysis, findings, and conclusions;

Ability to lead people toward meeting the organization’s vision, mission, and goals. Ability to provide an inclusive workplace that fosters the development of others and facilitates cooperation and teamwork;

description:
Provide financial analysis, forecasting, and business supporting the Global Supply Chain leadership team, including regular interaction with VP-level stakeholders. Reporting to the Finance Manager, Operations. This role supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis for annual material and freight spend across multiple divisions, with direct impact on margin performance and operational decision-making. The role operates in a dynamic cost environment with significant exposure to commodity and transportation market volatility, requiring both financial rigor and the ability to translate complex cost drivers into executive-ready insights.

**Leadership Scope:** Individual contributor role with matrixed influence across plant controllers, commodity managers, and logistics leaders

Success in this position requires moving beyond variance reporting to identify root causes, provide actionable insights, and influence decisions related to material costs, freight spending, inventory, and margin performance.

Business Partnership & Strategic Support

* Serve as a key finance business partner supporting Global Supply Chain leadership through planning, reporting, forecasting, and decision-support activities.
* Partner with sourcing, procurement, and logistics to provide financial analysis and recommendations supporting cost, pricing, carrier selection, and network optimization decisions.
* Monitor commodity market trends and support forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis related to steel, aluminum, fuel, and other key cost drivers.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis

* Develop detailed analyses of PPV, material usage variances, freight spending, scrap, inventory performance, and commodity impacts to identify risks and opportunities.
* Lead monthly accounting, accruals, and financial analysis for direct material purchases and freight spend.
* Prepare and manage annual budgets and forecasts for material commodities (steel, aluminum, resins, etc.) and multimodal transportation costs (truckload, LTL, intermodal, ocean, parcel).
* Provide management with clear material and freight economic reporting, including comparisons to prior periods, standards, and annual budgets.

Cost Management & Productivity

* Evaluate and quantify cost productivity initiatives through PPV analysis, trend identification, forecasting, and financial modeling.
* Coordinate and support the annual material standard cost setting process in collaboration with commodity managers, plant controllers, and finance leadership.
* Coordinate with third-party freight audit and pay providers to ensure accurate and timely freight accruals and recovery of billing errors.

Systems, Controls & Governance

* Ensure accurate financial reporting and support internal and external audit requests.
* Leverage Oracle ERP and Hyperion Essbase to enhance reporting transparency, forecast accuracy, and decision-making speed.

Support additional projects and ad hoc analyses as required.

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in manufacturing finance, cost accounting, supply chain finance, FP&A, or related analytical roles.
* Direct experience with standard cost accounting, material cost analysis, and purchase price variance (PPV).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities (complex modeling, large data sets, variance analytics).
* Proven ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders with data-backed recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred

At Williams, we’re powering a cleaner, more connected future — and that starts with you. Here, your work fuels communities, drives innovation, and helps deliver reliable energy the world depends on. Join a Fortune 500 team that invests in your growth, values your contributions, and challenges you to make a lasting impact every day.

As Business Development Director, you'll lead large projects and transactions and develop solutions to sophisticated problems using your extensive knowledge of the natural gas industry in ways that are unique or innovative. You'll demonstrate superb communication and interpersonal skills as you interact with customers and provide your expertise negotiating various agreements. Your ability to cultivate and nurture a network across functions and influence others to gain support and dedication to get results are keys to success!

**Responsibilities/Expectations:**
----------------------------------

* Develops innovative services, technologies, processes, or products that address current and future customer problems and needs
* Leads projects and programs with significant risk and complexity to achieve breakthroughs and objectives
* May lead or mentor others
* Understands all components of a deal structure
* Partners with others on sophisticated, greenfield business opportunities; uses financial and quantitative information to guide actions and performance
* Accurately forecasts financial information and makes prudent decisions regarding expenditures; identifies, monitors and estimates contributors to costs
* Considers industry and market trends when making decisions and balances strategic impact on the organization
* Develops opinions and challenges recommendations on basin, customer and competitor intelligence based off third party tools and publications
* Builds strategies for development of commercial insight and knowledge
* Other duties as assigned

**Education/Years of Experience:**
----------------------------------

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related field and a minimum of fifteen (15) years’ related experience
* Preferred: MBA

**Other Requirements:**
-----------------------

* Knowledge of upstream, midstream or downstream assets
* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of energy market fundamentals and economics including commodity pricing, basin market fundamentals and competitor strategies and actions
* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of commercial aspects of the energy industry
* Experience with asset development
* Considered a specialist regarding deal structure, contract terms, financial issues and other aspects of project development
* Demonstrates excellent organizational/interpersonal skills and safety as the utmost priority
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Application and PC skills

* Strong pay plus an annual incentive program
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage with options that fit your life, not the other way around
* 401(k) with company match and an annual company contribution
* Paid time off, including company and floating holidays
* Paid parental leave (up to six weeks per parent), plus fertility and adoption support
* Advanced AI tools and resources to help level up and work smarter
* Clear paths to grow your career, with a strong culture of promoting from within
* Tuition reimbursement and support for continuing education
* HSA and FSA options
* Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Domestic partner benefits
* Employee resource groups, wellness support, paid volunteer time, and company matching for causes you care about

*Eligibility and benefits are governed by the terms of the applicable plan or program document which can be amended or terminated at any time.*

For more information, please visit Total Rewards | Williams Companies.

---------------------------

Description:

**Signia Aerospace** is built on decades of proven performance and partnership in the aircraft systems industry. The proven brands that operate under the Signia Aerospace ecosystem lead the field in thermal management and mission-specific equipment. They are the brands of choice for pilots, maintenance directors, ground crews, and supply chain professionals worldwide, in commercial, private, and military applications. Our depth of expertise and unique pool of resources allows us to act as an integrated, nimble partner in the design, manufacture, delivery, and service of highly specialized aircraft systems and components.

**Precise Flight** is a leading designer and manufacturer of aviation safety and performance products for commercial, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. For more than 40 years, the company has developed innovative solutions including aircraft lighting systems, oxygen systems, and other aerospace components that help make flying safer and more efficient. Headquartered in Bend, Oregon, Precise Flight serves aircraft manufacturers, airlines, fleet operators, and aircraft owners around the globe.

**Our Culture**

We are a team that prides ourselves on a culture that supports shared values of empowerment, accountability, drive, integrity, and respect. Our team shares a deep commitment to safety and collaboration. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance, 401(K) plans with employer match, company provided Growth Participation Units (GPU) and so much more.

Our GPU benefit is unique to the industry and encourages all employees to think like owners and receive future financial reward for contributions to business growth. Join our team to be part of a culture that encourages growth and development and celebrates our success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Executes procurement strategies and sourcing activities for assigned commodities, suppliers, or operational categories. Manages supplier selection, contract negotiations, procurement compliance, and supplier performance activities while supporting operational continuity, cost management, and supply chain efficiency. Collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure timely procurement execution and operational support.

All roles at Signia are expected to support the company’s operating model (SOAR) and contribute to the organization’s business value drivers, Profitable New Business, Productivity, Precision M&A, and Value-Based Pricing, through operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

**Key Deliverables of the Position**

1) Effective execution of procurement strategies and sourcing activities

2) Successful supplier selection, contract negotiation, and procurement coordination

3) Reliable supplier delivery, quality, and performance management

4) Compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements

5) Improved procurement efficiency, supplier responsiveness, and cost management

6) Accurate procurement reporting and supplier performance tracking

7) Strong supplier and cross-functional stakeholder relationships

Requirements:

**Education and Experience**

* Solid working knowledge of procurement and supply chain practices
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or related discipline preferred
* Typically requires 2–4 years of procurement, sourcing, or supply chain experience
* Works under general supervision and may mentor junior staff

**Technical Competencies**

1) Procurement strategy execution

2) Supplier selection and contract negotiation

3) RFQ/RFP management and sourcing processes

4) Supplier relationship and performance management

5) Procurement compliance and policy adherence

6) Cost analysis and operational support

7) Cross-functional collaboration and communication

8) Process improvement and problem-solving

9) Proficient Computer Skills – Microsoft Office and procurement systems

10) Excellent Communication Skills – both verbal and written

**Behavioral Competencies – Demonstrates behaviors consistent with our values**

**1)** **Thinks and acts like an owner**

o Uses company resources wisely & cost-effectively

o Shows pride in the organization and a commitment to its long-term success

o Takes full responsibility for their actions

o Holds self to high standards of performance and integrity

**2)** **Demonstrates high integrity**

o Consistently acts with honestly, transparency and high ethics

o Makes decisions based on what is morally right

o Owns their actions and holds self-accountable

**3)** **Puts team above self; in it together**

o Prioritizes team and company over personal gain

o Collaborates with team members within the department and across all functions

Contributes to a positive, inclusive work environment

**4)** **Innovates and improves**

o Actively support

**Description**

**Grain Receiver**

Penn Pak, a business unit of Central Garden & Pet Company, is a leader in the bird food manufacturing industry. We are searching for a Grain Receiver for our Sidney, NE location. This position is essential in ensuring the efficient and safe operation of receiving and processing commodities and mill equipment, contributing to the production of high-quality products. The ideal candidate is safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and able to work in fast-paced environments with tight schedules and deadlines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Receive and test commodities, unload [rail cars] and trucks, and transport materials to designated bins in a timely and efficient manner.
* Operate and monitor mill machinery to clean and process incoming commodities in a safe and responsible manner.
* Perform basic mechanical troubleshooting, clear jams, and resolve obstructions in machinery when necessary.
* Safely operate forklifts, skid steers, and tractors to move materials, transfer commodities, and assist with silo clean-up.
* Perform quality control checks and tests to ensure product consistency and compliance with standards.
* Monitor and regulate commodity flow to ensure optimal product quality and continuous mill operation.
* Accurately weigh and measure ingredients, maintaining detailed records.
* Clean and maintain indoor and outdoor work areas, machinery, and commodity handling areas, adhering to all safety and sanitation regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must be able to lift up to [50-75] lbs.
* General mechanical aptitude and the ability to troubleshoot basic equipment issues with minimal supervision.
* Forklift proficiency. Ability to obtain forklift certification onsite.
* Strong attention to detail with good organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a constant state of alertness, in a team environment, and take initiative.
* Basic math skills for measuring and recording ingredient quantities.

**MINIMUM EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:**

* High school diploma, GED, or relevant work experience preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in a manufacturing, agriculture, or grain handling environment preferred.
* 1+ years of machine operation experience in a production facility preferred.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Work environment includes a non-climate-controlled warehouse production facility, with frequent proximity to moving mechanical parts, product irritants/allergens, airborne particles, and outdoor weather conditions.
* Occasionally, tasks may involve working at heights, in confined spaces, and amidst moderate noise levels.

**ALLERGY NOTICE:**

* Please be aware that we produce products containing nuts and peppers.

**BENEFITS PACKAGE & EMPLOYEE PROGRAMS:**

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Free Life and Short-Term Disability Insurance
* Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* 401k with 3% company match and annual employer discretionary contribution
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
* Employee Assistance Program
* Discounts on pet supplies, cell phones, movie tickets, gym memberships, and more!
* Education Assistance (both college degrees and professional certifications)
* Referral Program with cash bonus
* Access to thousands of free online courses
* Access to on-demand pay
* Paid parental leave

Central Garden & Pet Company (NASDAQ: CENT) (NASDAQ: CENTA) understands that home is central to life and has proudly nurtured happy and healthy homes for over 40 years. With fiscal 2023 net sales of $3.3 billion, Central is on a mission to lead the future of the Pet and Garden industries. The Company’s innovative and trusted products are dedicated to helping lawns grow greener, gardens bloom bigger, pets live healthier, and communities grow stronger. Central is home to a leading portfolio of more than 65 high-quality brands including Amdro®, Aqueon®, Cadet®, Farnam®, Ferry-Morse®, Four Paws®, Kaytee®, K&H®, Nylabone®, and Pennington®, strong manufacturing and distribution capabilities and a passionate, entrepreneurial growth culture. Central is based in Walnut Creek, California and has 6,700 employees across North America and Europe. Visit www.central.com to learn more.

**We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

Motive's GTM Intelligence & Operations team owns the systems, data, and governance behind how 2,000 sellers, managers, and marketers engage our customers worldwide. As Manager, GTM Intelligence & Operations, reporting to the Senior Director of GTM Intelligence & Operations, you'll lead a team of systems administrators and program owners responsible for our end to end GTM SaaS stack: Salesforce at the core, plus sales engagement, prospecting, enrichment, gifting, references, conversation intelligence, and the integrations that connect them. You'll own the stack's roadmap, architecture, budget, and licensing, and partner with Sales Operations, Sales leadership, Enterprise Systems, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to deliver our biggest GTM initiatives.

You're a battle tested enterprise systems leader with a business owner's mindset. You've run GTM platforms at scale, built and led admin teams, and seen enough implementations, migrations, and outages to know what good looks like. You know why every field, integration, and setting you own exists, and you use that to make better decisions, not just faster ones. You stay calm when a platform goes down and the field still needs to sell by lunch. You lead with data and translate technical and regulatory requirements into plain language that sellers and executives can act on. Above all, you grow your people into independent experts and keep the focus on the business.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of GTM systems administrators and program owners by setting clear priorities, delegating platform ownership, and developing each person into a trusted subject matter expert.
* Own the end to end GTM platform ecosystem as a connected system, with Salesforce at its center, including architecture, data model, profiles and permissions, automation, integrations, and the downstream tools that depend on it. Serve as the final escalation point for complex platform issues.
* Set the standard for Salesforce administration across the GTM org, including release management, change control, documentation, and the quoting and CPQ processes that connect pipeline to revenue, in partnership with Enterprise Systems.
* Own the strategy, budget, renewals, and license governance for the broader GTM SaaS portfolio, including our sales engagement platform, and partner with Finance and Procurement on ROI, seat forecasting, and investment decisions.
* Lead vendor evaluations and major tool migrations from requirements and diligence through build, launch, change management, and retirement of the legacy tool, so that multi-million dollar decisions are grounded in data and the voice of the user.
* Partner with Legal, Security, and Marketing to design and enforce GTM compliance and governance across markets, covering consent management, Do Not Contact, call recording, texting, and email deliverability. Provide data and audit support to Legal and leadership when needed.
* Act as the systems lead for major cross-functional initiatives such as new market launches, rebrands, and new sales motions, and partner with Enablement to deliver onboarding, training, and documentation that drive lasting adoption.
* Keep the revenue engine running when things break by leading incident response with vendors and ESYS, engineering workarounds, protecting data integrity, and keeping field and executive leaders informed.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in GTM operations, sales or revenue operations, or GTM systems within an enterprise or high-growth B2B SaaS organization, including 5+ years of direct people management experience leading systems administrators or GTM operations teams.
* Deep, hands-on Salesforce administration experience at an enterprise scale of 1,000+ users, including objects, security and sharing, profiles and permission sets, automation, reporting, and integrations. Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, CPQ Specialist, or other Salesforce certifications are a plus.
* CPQ experience is strongly preferred, ideally Salesforce CPQ or R

Babcox Media is looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial Business Development Representative who wants to build a career in sales while helping us grow an exciting new area of our business. This isn't a job where you'll spend your day waiting for leads to come to you. Energy, effort and enthusiasm are essential.

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting people, isn't afraid to pick up the phone or walk into a business and gets energized by finding the next opportunity. You'll identify and develop new customers for Babcox Media's growing portfolio of video, social media and digital marketing solutions, often introducing our capabilities to businesses that may not know us today.

You'll spend time in the market meeting potential customers, learning their businesses and showing them how great video, social and digital content can help them reach more customers and grow. You'll have the opportunity to help us take those capabilities to new customers and new markets.

* Competitive base salary plus commission and performance-based incentives.
* Increased earning potential as you grow your business.

description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Racing is where our story began.

In 1901, Henry Ford climbed into a car he built himself—"Sweepstakes"—and beat America's most famous driver. He wasn't a racer, but he had to win. He did. Ford Motor Company was born from that victory.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground—that's where we prove ourselves.

The result: one of the world's most iconic brands, legendary nameplates, and a team unmatched in the industry.

Our mantra: Race to win, engineer to lead.

If you're a competitor, innovator, or performance obsessive, Ford Racing is where you belong. Help us write the next chapter.

**In this position...**

* Ford Racing is seeking an experienced Chassis engineer with the passion to win to join our team.This position involves leading the development of high performance components such as control arms, ball joints, and bushings while working with suppliers to deliver best in class products.

**What you'll do...**

* Lead the design, release, and delivery of components for Ford Racing production vehicles
* Manage Quality, Cost, Weight, Function and Timing (QCWFT) to support program & engineering GPDS milestones
* Work with Purchasing to source commodities
* Lead program delivery through various milestones
* Work with FSS (Full Service Suppliers) to deliver on time with quality
* Assure conformance to the Ford Racing DNA all applicable Ford & regulatory requirements
* Develop innovative solutions for performance vehicles – including design, CAE analysis, and testing
* Support issue resolution and design change management during the prototype build and launch builds
* Interface and maintain collaborative relationship with Core Ford engineering
* Support current production, quality and cost optimization efforts

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / electrical / material engineering or related engineering degree or related field of study
* Experience in control arms, ball joints, and bushings
* 5+ years’ experience in Chassis Design and Release
* 5+ years’ experience in Program and/or Unit GPDS deliverables
* 5+ years’ experience in Data acquisition & analysis tools and methods
* Have a demonstrated high level of performance delivering on both required objectives and behaviors
* Excellent communication and relationship skills
* Able to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving products and needs
* Strong work ethic and ability to adapt to requested schedules
* Passion for performance vehicles / racing

**Even better, you may have...**

* Master’s degree in mechanical / electrical / material engineering or related engineering degree or related field of study
* Experience in control arms, ball joints, bushings, and dampers
* Experience in Vehicle Dynamics

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resource groups
* Paid time off for individual and team community service
* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $74,300-$124,500.

Join the Texon Team!

Texon is a leader in butane blending and energy marketing. Since 1989, we’ve pioneered blending innovations and hold patent rights worldwide. As a Savage company, we’re proud to be recognized as a Military Friendly Employer, and we welcome Military Veterans and Reservists to apply. Military experience equivalency may substitute for some requirements.

To Apply for this position, click on the "Apply" button above and complete the application.

**Reports to:** VP, Marketing

**Location:** Houston, TX or Denver, CO

**Job Summary:**
The Marketing Manager oversees customer relationships, contract execution, and commercial performance while ensuring coordination with Scheduling, Operations, Accounting, and Contracts to deliver reliable commercial outcomes across midstream operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day to day marketing and commercial activities for assigned customers, commodities, and markets
* Oversee execution of marketing transactions, including pricing support, contract performance, and deal coordination
* Lead and develop customer relationships, serving as a primary commercial point of contact
* Coordinate closely with Scheduling, Operations, and Logistics to ensure commercial commitments are executed accurately
* Partner with Accounting and Settlements to ensure accurate invoicing, reconciliation, and financial close activities
* Monitor contract and customer performance, identifying risks, issues, or optimization opportunities
* Provide guidance and oversight to marketing staff or support roles, as applicable
* Support development and improvement of commercial processes, controls, and reporting
* Ensure compliance with all safety, regulatory, and internal control requirements
* Contribute to commercial strategy, market analysis, and business development initiatives as needed

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred

**Experience:**

* 5–8 years of experience in marketing, commercial operations, or energy trading within the oil & gas or midstream sector
* Prior experience managing customers, contracts, and commercial execution required
* Previous leadership or supervisory experience preferred

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Strong working knowledge of midstream markets, contracts, and commercial workflows
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and lead commercial execution in a fast paced environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
* High level of professionalism, accountability, and business acumen
* Ability to travel if business requires

**Additional Information:**

* A complete job description is available upon request
* Savage is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains a drug-free workplace
* California Residents Job Application Privacy Notice
* You may view available jobs at www.texonmidstream.com/careers and apply using the online job posting.
* Team members may be eligible for a benefits package that is dependent on hours worked and position classification. This package may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; life, AD&D, and disability insurance; supplemental coverage options; health savings and flexible spending accounts; paid time off; profit sharing; and a 401(k) plan with company match. Benefits are subject to change. For more information visit https://savageco.com/careers/benefits-information/

**Job Description:**

Rocketdyne is currently seeking a Procurement Specialist to contribute to the success and growth of our Space business located in Mason, OH, supporting the procurement and management of machined and electronics components. The Procurement Specialist determines how to achieve objectives by applying a deep understanding of procurement principles, concepts, and practices in a DoD environment. This position requires a minimum of 6 years’ experience in defense procurement and manufacturing.

**Essential Functions:**

* Procure components and subassemblies to support various programs, including commodities such as electronic, mechanical, optical components or assemblies, capital equipment, and electronic/optical systems. The primary focus of this role will be on electronics.
* Manage Purchase Orders (POs) and other agreements for direct and indirect procurements; Includes preparation of Requests for Quotes (RFQs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs), proposal evaluation and analysis, and issuance and maintenance of POs.
* Select and recommend suppliers, negotiate pricing, delivery, quality, terms and conditions, and execute non-disclosure agreements and service agreements.
* Contribute to material cost reduction strategy. Create and issue various types of POs, including Firm-Fixed Price and Time & Material.
* Lead source selection teams; conduct formal cost/price analysis to determine price fair and reasonableness. Negotiate the lowest possible total cost for the product (balance price with optimum quality and schedule needs).
* Identify opportunities to mitigate supply chain risk.
* Administer post-award of issued POs.
* Create purchase orders files in compliance with all command media and necessary process disciplines for audits.
* Support Integrated Product Teams (IPT) through supply chain representative or as an active team member.
* Monitor and provide feedback to IPT on critical supplier performance to ensure timely delivery to manufacturing schedules; Inter and Intra departmental coordination is essential.
* Active participation in company and department initiatives such as strategic sourcing and various L3Harris improvement efforts.
* Provide training and mentorship to peers to further Inter departmental growth.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience or in lieu of a degree a minimum of 6 years of supply chain experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Strong background in strategic sourcing, planning, supplier management, and inventory optimization
* Knowledge of aerospace quality and regulatory environments including AS9100, FAA, DoD, or ITAR requirements preferred

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience using advanced Excel skills including use of pivot tables, lookup tables, etc.
* Knowledge within Deltek, Costpoint, and SAP.
* Knowledge in the procurement processes of military grade products.
* Demonstrated experience working within proposal teams, generating material estimates for bids and proposals, and providing substantiating evidence as needed is a plus.
* Willingness to learn DoD 5000.02 framework and Earned Value Management principles.
* Proven ability to direct and manage multiple projects with effective prioritization and resource allocation.
* Strong team player with excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Superior verbal and written communication abilities, along with strong organizational, negotiation, and management skills.
* Advanced computer skills, including proficiency to quicky learn ERP systems and MS Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Capability in reading and interpreting specifications, statements of work, and technical drawings.
* Extensive knowledge of FARS, DFARS, and ITAR regulations as they pertain to purchasing requirements.
* Extensive understanding of company policies and processes.
* Extensive understanding of small business government requirements.
* A strong commitment to learn continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Six Sigma tools.

* Strong math aptitude.
* Knowledge of commonly-used concepts, practices, and procedures within the field,
* Use experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals.

* High attention to detail, be highly organized and be highly efficient and effective.
* Strong problem solving/analytic skills

description:
**Buying Professional**

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

**Transform the everyday with us!**

We are looking for a **Buying Professional for our Heber Springs, Arkansas** location, a manufacturing and distribution facility primarily focused on medium-voltage overhead outdoor power distribution products and solutions. Outdoor products are essential components of medium-voltage distribution grids. Siemens' comprehensive outdoor portfolio of switching devices is designed for a wide variety of applications and climatic conditions. Type-tested reliability as well as long electrical life and mechanical robustness help to minimize operation costs while increasing resiliency of medium-voltage smart grids. Solutions for wildfire mitigation available on select products.

**Position Overview:**

Supports business in semi-complex buying strategies and activities to purchase and arrange timely deliveries of material and services; plans and expedites as needed and serves as liaison between manufacturing and vendors.

**You will make an impact by:**

* Manage the supply chain & provide a prime focal point to suppliers.
* Generates Purchase Orders (SAP) in assigned queue in accordance with required strategies based on the requisition and obtains order acknowledgement.
* Identify, report, and manage potential problems and proactively address material shortages before impacting production.
* Manages supplier On Time Delivery (OTD)
* Prepare and manage supplier key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Obtain information from suppliers in order to complete supplier setups.
* Familiarity with the various Siemens Procurement tools (SAP, NexGen, IOL, GMDM, SCMStar, etc)
* Issues POs for Capital equipment in oneSRM
* Participates in the Supplier Qualification Process for new suppliers of key major components
* Prepares and conducts negotiations as required for issuing Purchase Orders and seeks price reductions for YOY spend.
* Coordinates with Engineering, Supplier Quality and manufacturing as required
* Ensures compliance with SIEMENS buying guidelines.
* Understand Siemens T&C’s, contract and project deliverables and enact plans for meeting goals.
* Leads Supplier Non-Conformances (NCRs) with the Supplier Quality Manager and Engineering to insure no impact on production floor.
* Performs Supplier Evaluations and Supplier Development Plans for the assigned commodities, including establishing supplier score cards.
* Support resolutions of GR/IR issues and other exceptions to established rules
* Support and help define commodity strategies for assigned purchasing spend.

**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree (B. S.) in supply chain, business or technical curriculum
* A minimum of 2-5 years of experience
* Strong written and oral communication in English language
* Highly skilled with Microsoft office products (Power Point, Word and Advance Excel)
* Must be customer focused and a collaborative team player
* Ability to assess priorities, demonstrate flexibility and understand sense of urgency
* Self-motivated, demonstrate problem solving abilities, continuous improvement, and decision-making skills.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Green or Black Belt Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Experience and Knowledge of castings, fasteners, sheet metal, commodity metals and various electrical components is desired.

**About Siemens**

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce**

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

As an **Inventory Analyst**, you will support our Data Center Operations team by tracking, managing, and maintaining all company-owned and client-owned tools, equipment, and materials across the site. You will develop and maintain tool control processes, ensure calibration compliance, conduct routine audits, and coordinate purchasing activities with Procurement. This role is critical to ensuring technicians have the tools they need, when they need them, while maintaining accuracy, accountability, and compliance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintain accurate inventory of company-owned tools, PPE, ladders, carts, test equipment, and operational materials.
* Track and account for all client-owned test devices and equipment (e.g., EXFO units, OTDR testers).
* Develop, manage, and improve the tool check-in/check-out program for technicians.
* Track technician tool assignments and reconcile discrepancies promptly.
* Monitor and document calibration schedules; ensure equipment is sent out and returned on schedule.
* Conduct regular inventory audits (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and generate audit reports.
* Identify missing, damaged, or end-of-life tools and recommend corrective actions or replacements.
* Work with Procurement/Inventory teams to submit purchase requests, process orders, and reconcile incoming inventory.
* Maintain digital inventory systems and ensure all movements, updates, and disposal actions are accurately recorded.
* Support reporting needs, including inventory dashboards, utilization metrics, and audit summaries.

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**

* 2–4 years of experience in inventory management, supply chain, warehouse logistics, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Experience using inventory management software or asset tracking tools.
* Ability to understand basic technical tools and equipment used in data center, telecom, or field operations.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with technicians, leads, and leadership.
* Ability to lift/move tools and equipment in accordance with site safety standards.

**DESIRABLE CRITERIA:**

* Experience working in a data center, telecom, construction, or technical field environment.
* Previous experience developing or managing a tool control program.
* Familiarity with calibration tracking for test equipment.
* Proficiency with Google Sheets / Excel
* Experience collaborating with procurement or supply chain teams.

At EOS IT Solutions, we are committed to supporting the well-being and success of our team. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

* Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance starting the 1st of the month after your start date.
* 10 Days of Paid Time Off (PTO) annually
* Occasional overtime and bonus opportunities
* 12 Paid Holidays
* 6 Sick Days (available after 90 days of employment)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with a $2,500 company match (available after 90 days of employment)

*The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.*

We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non-merit factor.*

description:
We are a specialty vaccine company that develops, manufactures, and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs.

We have leveraged our expertise and capabilities both to commercialize three vaccines, including the world’s first and only chikungunya vaccine, and to rapidly advance a broad range of vaccine candidates into and through the clinic, including candidates against Lyme disease and Zika.

Valneva USA is focused on the marketing and distribution of vaccines for Japanese encephalitis and chikungunya.

The Senior Business Operations Manager serves as a U.S. strategic leader responsible for overseeing 3PL and end-to-end vaccine logistics operations across the market. This role drives operational excellence by optimizing distribution networks, enhancing supply reliability, and delivering sustainable cost efficiencies while ensuring full compliance with FDA, CDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

As a key member of the U.S. leadership team, this position aligns logistics and commercial operations with broader corporate strategy to support product launches, government contracting, and ongoing lifecycle management within the vaccine portfolio. The role champions cross-functional collaboration across Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, and Global Supply teams to ensure seamless execution.

With a strong focus on scalability and agility, the Senior Business Operations Manager leverages data-driven insights, process standardization, and continuous improvement methodologies to strengthen supply continuity, mitigate risk, and enable long-term growth in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment.

**Requirements**

**U.S. Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the U.S. strategic lead for business operations and vaccine logistics, aligning supply chain, finance, commercial, quality, and global teams to deliver operational excellence.
* Provide executive-level performance reporting and insights to the U.S. Head to ensure leadership alignment and data-driven decision-making.
* Lead U.S. contracting operations across government (including Military) and private market partnerships, overseeing financial analytics, compliance, and execution performance.

**Supply Chain & 3PL Oversight**

* Own end-to-end U.S. vaccine supply chain strategy and execution, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives and full compliance with GMP, FDA, and State Board of Pharmacy requirements (serving as Designated Representative nationwide).
* Oversee 3PL distribution operations, including inbound/outbound logistics, cold-chain integrity, inventory control, returns management, and sales order administration.
* Partner with global supply chain on demand planning, transfer pricing, U.S. Customs coordination, and inventory optimization to minimize expiry risk and protect supply continuity.
* Lead engagement with wholesalers and distributors, ensuring contract compliance, inventory discipline, issue resolution, and regulatory adherence.

**Pricing, Government Reporting & Contract Administration**

* Direct pricing governance and contract administration, including distributor agreements, rebate management, chargebacks, and customer compliance.
* Calculate and submit required U.S. government pricing reports (e.g., NFAMP, FCP), ensuring accuracy and regulatory adherence.
* Implement and operationalize new pricing structures, membership agreements, and commercial contracts.

**Sales & Commercial Operations Support**

* Oversee sales analytics and reporting infrastructure, managing data sources and remote analyst teams to deliver actionable insights.
* Partner with the GM and Sales Leadership on incentive compensation reporting and commercial performance tracking.

**Quality & Compliance Leadership**

* Collaborate with Quality Assurance to maintain rigorous regulatory standards across 3PL and distribution operations both for the US and alignment globally.
* Proactively identify and mitigate compliance, logistics, and operational risks.
* Embed continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, scalability, and control.

**U.S. Business Operations Management**

* Lead administrative and operational infrastructure for the U.S. entity, including HR benefits oversight, vendor and fleet management, office operations, and employee onboarding.
* Manage cost controls across operational budgets while maintaining high service levels and employee engagement.
* Support organizational effectiveness through coordination of meetings, trainings, and cross-functional initiatives.

**Benefits**

Good team spirit in a strong and highly motivated team
