description:
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.

As an **Inventory Optimization Analyst**, you will partner with Sales, Product Management, Demand Planning, and Supply Planning teams to support inventory stocking strategies across the distribution network. Leveraging data analysis and inventory planning expertise, you will help maintain optimal inventory levels, improve product availability, and support business and working capital objectives through actionable insights and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* Apply advanced statistical analysis, data insights, and business knowledge to optimize inventory parameters and improve inventory performance.
* Develop and maintain inventory assortment strategies to ensure the right products are available in the right locations.
* Establish performance standards, metrics, and reporting to monitor inventory results against business objectives.
* Work closely with Supply and Demand Planning teams to maintain and optimize key inventory parameters that drive planning and execution systems.
* Support the communication and alignment of inventory assortment, service level, and working capital objectives with cross-functional stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency, reduce excess and obsolete inventory, and optimize working capital while maintaining appropriate product availability.
* Prepare inventory analyses and provide insights to support inventory planning and business decisions

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
* At least 2 years of relevant experience; master’s degree preferred.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of inventory optimization and supply chain best practices.
* Ability to analyze large data sets and apply appropriate statistical and analytical methods.
* Understanding of how inventory decisions impact sales, working capital, costs, and inventory performance.
* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Management principles and inventory planning.
* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and continuous improvement skills.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to effectively coordinate and work within a team environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Access.
* Working knowledge of SAP ECC; experience with SAP APO or similar planning systems preferred.
* Experience with inventory optimization tools such as SO99, i2, Manugistics, or similar platforms preferred.
* Familiarity with statistical analysis tools such as SPSS, Minitab, or similar software.
* Understanding of multi-echelon inventory optimization and ability to analyze optimization results and recommend adjustments.
* Understanding of lot-size optimization models and ability to evaluate results and recommend improvements.

**DESCRIPTION:** Patricio Enterprises is searching for a Logistics Analyst to provide DoD acquisitions logistics expertise and support to Marine Corps Systems Command’s Amphibious Assault Vehicle program (AAV) Sustainment team. Support includes research, analysis and update of authoritative enterprise business information systems that influence synchronization between Force Development and Force Management Employment processes. The Government expects a significant increase in the development of change requests to authoritative business information systems hosting principle end item authorized allowances, acquisition/cost data, accurate equipment association, fielding and disposal schedules. PM AAA requirements are closely monitored and accuracy of relevant and current data is required to compensate for software interface gaps.

**Primary duties will include (but not limited to)**:

* Conduct the administrative and technical activities required to develop, review, update, and deliver logistics acquisition documentation (i.e., Life Cycle Sustainment Plans, Fielding Plans, Technical Manuals, Facilities Impact Reports, Item Unique Identification Plans, Disposal Plans, SL-3s, I-Type documents) and coordinate, host, and participate in logistics events and activities (i.e., LOG Demos, Product Support Analyses, Independent Logistics Assessments, Audits, Test Events)
* Possess active accounts for various logistics information systems (i.e., Total Force Structure Management System, Total Life Cycle Cost Tool Operational Support Tool, Global Combat Support System – Marine Corps) and review information and recommend updates as required to ensure data fields are accurate
* Coordinate, conduct, and document validation/verification events for all I-Type documents, Technical Manuals, and other logistics products
* Provide in-depth review of Product Quality Deficiency Reports and make recommendations for corrective action
* Identify, track, and report Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages issues to determine impacts to long-lead times, supply availability, and part obsolescence
* Leverage knowledge of the twelve (12) integrated product support elements to inform program logistics assessments, supply chain management, sparing levels, and reorder points
* Analyze supply and maintenance readiness data to identify readiness issues; recommend corrective actions and readiness improvements; and develop program readiness assessments
* Review and monitor the program Failure Reporting, Analysis, and Corrective Action System (FRACAS), and deliver comprehensive FRACAS reports as required

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

* Conducting research, analyses, and updates of authoritative enterprise business information systems.
* Total Force Structure Management System (TFSMS), GCSS-MC, CATALYST, Technical Data Management System (TDMS), Master Data Repository (MDR), DPAS, Tactical Imagery Production System (TIPS), EDA (to include the PIEE GFP module), and Federal Logistics Information System (FLIS).
* Documenting transactions and ensuring compliance with current and relevant business standards.
* Has built and/or revised component TAMCN associations in TFSMS and the Bill of Materials (BOM) in Catalyst.
* Analyzing implicit and explicit relationships between data items and reviewing data for completeness, conformity, consistency, accuracy, duplication, and dependencies, as well as identifying data errors, gaps in data, and outdated data in Data Quality Systems.
* Building Tables of Organization and Equipment Change Requests (TOECRs) and ensuring all TAMCNs capture accurate Equipment Attributes.
* Capturing Using Unit Responsible Issue (UURI)/Supply System Responsible Issue (SSRI) Associations, identifying and developing process recommendations to improve effectiveness and efficiency, and reviewing technical publications to ensure equipment associations are current.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE****:**

* 6 years of related professional experience **with** a bachelor's degree.

**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact**
Intel Foundry is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Analyst - Parameters and Demand to support planning operations in manufacturing, including Intel's most advanced leading-edge technologies and production readiness activities. This role partners closely with Technology Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to translate customer and business requirements into actionable supply plans that enable technology development, factory readiness, and manufacturing execution.

The successful candidate will leverage advanced analytics, business insight, and cross-functional collaboration to influence supply decisions, optimize factory performance, and drive execution against business objectives. This individual must be a strong communicator, critical thinker, and problem solver who can translate complex data into clear recommendations that drive alignment and action across stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Planning Parameters** :

* Assess planning parameter risks and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Analyze the supply impact of proposed parameter changes.
* Coordinate Intel Foundry throughput time (TPT) and yield inputs for Blue Yonder scenarios.
* Partner with Finance to evaluate the financial impact of parameter changes.
* Prepare the monthly Intel Foundry Parameter Package and present recommendations during the Intel Foundry Parameter Review.
* Prepare the monthly Intel Products Group Parameter Package and present approved changes during PRF and parameter review meetings.
* Coordinate with Model of Record (MOR) and Engineering to assess and implement mask layer changes.
* Coordinate with Global Logistics Org to assess and implement in-transit TPT changes.
* Coordinate with Strategic Capacity Planners (SCPs) to ensure approved parameter changes are accurately implemented in Supply Planning Application (SPAN).
* Collaborate with the Supply/Demand Analysis (SDA) team to review Intel Foundry parameter changes for validation of Blue Yonder inputs.
* Communicate approved parameter changes during Tactical Execution meetings following the parameter review.
* Establish Intel Foundry TPTs for new products.
* Manage and maintain customer lead time data in Planning Data Hub (PDH).
* Support On-Time-Delivery planning and performance improvement initiatives.
Support deliverables for IDM 2.0 Acceleration Office (IAO) Release 3 preparation.

**Back-end Demand Planning:**

* Understand monthly/weekly changes in customer demand.
* Use OneMPS and Compass solvers to assess customer demand.
* Prepare weekly/monthly cycle-over-cycle demand change assessment for assigned products or customers.
* Collaborate with substrate/materials teams and factories to ensure demand fulfillment.
* Collaborate with customers to ensure their demand process is successful each cycle.
Serve as a critical part of the Sales and Operations Planning (SNOP) team to address supply vs. demand reconciliations.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across teams.
* Passion for driving innovation and efficiency within supply chain operations.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

**This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Degree in one of the following options:
+ **Option 1:** Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or in a related field of study with 4+ years of hands-on experience.
+ **Option 2:** Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or in a related field of study with 3+ years of hands-on experience.
+ **Option 3:** Ph.D. in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or in a related field of study with no prior professional experience.
* 4+ years of experience in supply chain planning tools and software (Experience in BlueYonder preferred).
* 4+ years of experience with data analysis, forecasting, and inventory management.
Experience with supply chain concepts, including capacity planning and demand management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with factory planning parameter management.
* Experience with semiconductor Demand Planning.
* Experience identifying and solving complex supply chain challenges **.**

We invite you to become part of a dynamic team that values collaboration, forward-thinking solutions, and operational excellence.

**Job Type:**
-------------

Experienced Hire

**Shift:**
----------

Shift 1 (United States of America)

**Primary Location:**
---------------------

US, Arizona, Phoenix

**Additional Locations

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join Amazon Global Logistics to create and deploy EDI, API, and XML integration solutions that power the movement of inventory across the globe. As a Systems Development Engineer on the GL Integrations & Visibility team, you will architect and implement solutions that enable Amazon to exchange data with external logistics partners. As a Tech Integrations Manager, you will lead the design and implementation of technical solutions that enable Amazon to move products quickly and cost-effectively from overseas suppliers into our fulfillment network. This role combines deep technical expertise in Middleware systems with program management capabilities, offering the opportunity to reshape how global commerce operates at unprecedented scale across multiple geographies.

Key job responsibilities
Design, architect, and implement EDI/API/XML integrations that connect Amazon's logistics systems with external partners and carriers.
Automate partner integration workflows using AWS services and AI/ML tools to reduce integration lead time and build scalable systems.

Lead technical projects from conception through deployment, managing timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
Maintain and optimize mission-critical systems that form the backbone of Amazon's global logistics operations.
Collaborate with development teams to architect scalable business software solutions that meet current and future needs
Provide technical escalation management and troubleshooting for integration issues affecting operational processes
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI tools, to automate workflows and improve platform capabilities
Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into technical specifications and system designs

A day in the life
You will work at the intersection of technology and operations, partnering with software development teams, logistics operations managers, and external carrier partners. Your day involves reviewing integration performance metrics, troubleshooting data transmission issues, designing solutions for new carrier onboarding requirements, and leading technical discussions about system architecture. You will balance multiple priorities, from responding to urgent production issues to planning long-term platform enhancements. Internal stakeholders include Global Logistics operations teams, software engineers, product managers, and business intelligence analysts. Your customers are both internal teams who rely on seamless data flow and external logistics partners who integrate with Amazon's systems. You will solve problems related to data accuracy, system reliability, integration scalability, and process automation.

About the team
The Global Logistics team is driving initiatives that reshape how Amazon moves inventory worldwide. We support multiple geographies and operate in an entrepreneurial environment where innovation and customer obsession guide our decisions. Our team values technical excellence, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in ambiguous situations. We work on systems that process millions of transactions daily, connecting Amazon with carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners around the world. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and the willingness to dive deep into complex technical challenges. We balance the need for operational stability with the drive to innovate and improve our platform continuously.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 5+ years experience with ANSI X12 standards and/or EDIFACT and/or XML, including supply chain documents (214, 315, 310, 856, etc.)
* 5+ years hands-on experience with EDI communications standards and protocols (AS2, SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, API)
* 5+ years experience working with dev teams to design/architect business software solutions
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope technical requirements and prioritize tasks.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services: Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* 5+ years of coding experience in SQL, Python, Java, C++, or Perl
* Experience managing technical relationships with external partners and translating business requirements into technical solutions
* Experience with cloud-based integration platforms and microservices architectures

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

**Job Description:**

**The** **Global Sales Operations Training & Process Analyst** **is responsible for training, coaching, and supporting Global Sales Analysts to ensure consistent execution of global sales operations processes and best practices. This role supports the daily execution and continuous improvement of global sales operations by partnering with Sales, Operation, Supply Chain, Sales Enablement, and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate project execution, timely project closures, process compliance, and data integrity. The analyst also helps maintain standardized processes, supports continuous improvement initiatives, and contributes to achieving business objectives.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for someone who demonstrates:**

* Excellent communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Patience and Coaching Ability
* Excel in fast-paced high-pressure environment
* Analytical and Critical Thinking
* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement, top performance and winning
* Thoughtful, fast, disciplined execution
* Relentless customer focus
* Integrity as a core value
Interest in exploring and utilizing Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and scale processes

**Here is a glimpse of what you’ll do…**

* Train, coach, and support Global Sales Analysts on quoting and estimating systems and tools, task management, data hygiene, and project closing procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sales operations issues related to project closures, resolving operational obstacles and ensuring timely completion.
* Act as the liaison between Sales and Supply Chain to resolve planning discrepancies and operational issues affecting committed projects.
* Partner with the Sales Enablement team to ensure a standardized global onboarding process for Sales Analysts and support ongoing training initiatives.
* Maintain and update Sales Operations process documentation and work instructions.
* Participate in project handoff meetings to identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Audit and review all global handoff checklists and follow up with the team to ensure process compliance.
* Provide coverage for Sales Analyst responsibilities during vacations, absences, or workload fluctuations.
* Assist with ad hoc reporting, opportunity cleanup, and data quality initiatives.
Participate in the testing and validation of estimator enhancements and other sales tools.

**Here is some of what you’ll need (required)…**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, engineering, accounting, operations, or Master’s degree in business administration (MBA) or a related field.
* 8 + Experience in sales operations, commercial operations, customer support, or a related analytical role.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and implement effective solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across global teams.
* Strong customer focus, with a commitment to providing exceptional support to internal stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Supply Chain, and Sales Enablement.
* Working knowledge of CRM and ERP systems, such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Oracle, or similar business applications.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Ability to document processes clearly and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Here are a few of our preferred qualification…**

* Experience training, coaching, or mentoring employees in a sales operations or commercial environment.
* Experience working in both startup environments and global public companies.
* Experience developing, maintaining, and documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs), business processes, and training materials.
* Experience analyzing business processes and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

* Supporting proposal activities and pricing exercises.

* Preparing weekly reporting and invoicing.
* Performing various ad hoc financial analyses and exercises as needed.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact**
As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical role in optimizing Intel's supply chain processes by leveraging data-driven insights and analytical expertise. On a day-to-day basis, you will evaluate supply chain health metrics, forecast business needs, and design solutions to drive continuous improvements. Your contributions will directly enhance supply chain efficiency, ensuring seamless operations and strategic alignment for Intel's success.

**Business Group**
The Supply Chain Analyst position belongs to the Intel Foundry team within the Advance Packaging Planning organization. This team focuses on ensuring Intel's supply chain processes are strategically aligned to meet business objectives and deliver value across multiple programs. By applying innovative approaches and data analytics, the group contributes to Intel's broader mission of advancing cutting-edge technology solutions globally.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct supply chain health analyses, identify key dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and implement strategies to enhance tools, systems, processes, and inventory management.
* Collaborate with Intel stakeholders and external suppliers to align supply chain initiatives with business objectives.
* Perform business forecasting, constraint analysis, and benchmarking to create actionable recommendations.
* Manage and reconcile payments, warranty remedies, and credits, ensuring departmental compliance.
* Validate and present solution options to meet customer and business unit requirements while removing adoption barriers.
* Support audit activities and contribute to compliance efforts.
Provide subject matter expertise on specialized supply chain topics and serve as a resource for complex problem-solving.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills to effectively engage with stakeholders and resolve complex challenges.
* Proven ability to thrive in a matrixed, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* High initiative, creativity, and adaptability in changing conditions.
Ability to thrive in a matrixed, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

The Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position. Minimum qualifications listed below would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experience and / or schoolwork/classes/research. The preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

**This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 1+ years of experience in supply chain analytics, operations, or process improvement.
* Experience in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Access, Python, or Power BI.
* Experience in designing and implementing supply chain solutions using data-driven methodologies.
Experience with transportation, warehousing, and industry best practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or in a related field with 2+ years of industry experience.
Experience with financials, and global transportation, and logistics.

This position offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on Intel's supply chain strategy while advancing your career in an innovative and fast-paced environment. Apply now to be part of a team driving excellence across Intel's global operations.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

***Job Family Definition:***

Supports inventory control operations through data analysis, reporting, inventory investigations, and process improvement activities. Analyzes inventory data to identify trends, risks, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve inventory accuracy, operational performance, and material control processes.

Develops expertise in inventory management systems, manufacturing operations, and analytical problem-solving while supporting business objectives through data-driven recommendations.

Works under general guidance to complete assignments of limited to moderate scope. Exercises judgment within established procedures while developing the analytical and leadership capabilities required to manage increasingly complex business challenges.

***Responsibilities:***

* Supports day-to-day inventory control activities, including reviewing inventory records, material transactions, storage locations, and movement of materials.
* Learns and performs inventory-related transactions and analytical processes using SAP and other business systems.
* Develops, maintains, and communicates reports, metrics, and dashboards used to assess inventory health, operational performance, and inventory accuracy.
* Investigates inventory variances, material discrepancies, shortages, transaction errors, and process exceptions.
* Coordinates corrective actions for validated inventory-related issues with relevant stakeholders.
* Collaborates with Materials, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and other partners to resolve issues and support accurate, efficient inventory processes.
* Supports the planning, execution, reconciliation, and analysis of physical inventory and cycle count activities.
* Resolves issues related to reconciling inventory discrepancies and addresses questions escalated from employees in lower-level roles.
* Identifies opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, reporting, controls, and business processes through data analysis and stakeholder collaboration.

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, operations, analytics, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent and relevant experience.
* 0–3 years of relevant experience involving data analysis, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, or process improvement.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Experience with SAP, Power BI, SharePoint, SQL, reporting tools, or data visualization tools is beneficial but not required.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collect, organize, validate, and interpret data from multiple sources.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset and willingness to challenge existing processes through data-driven recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments and organizational levels.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied

**Job Posting Title**

Data Integrity Analyst

**Legal Entity**

GKN Drivelin Newton LLC (Delaware)

**Job Description Summary**

Dauch is looking for a Data Integrity Analyst to join our team in Newton, NC. This is a fully onsite position.

This individual is responsible for the organization's inventory integrity and master data management, which includes the creation and maintenance of item numbers, resources, routings, and bills of material and PFEP set-ups. This person will monitor and audit inventory and master data integrity. They will also analyze and troubleshoot discrepancies to the inventory integrity and master data management.

**Job Description:**

* Monitors inventory integrity, utilizing available reports and transactions to help validate daily performance. Provide root cause analysis for incorrect data.
* Performs the API process and root cause analysis of discrepancies.
* Prepares and distributes operational reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
* Audits bills of material and routings and develops action plans to implement corrective actions for non-conformances identified.
* Performs and Maintains cycle count records and provides root cause analysis for identified discrepancies.
* Tracks, maintains records, and communicates master data changes to the organization for new program launches and changes to existing programs.
* Creates item numbers, departments, resources, routings, and bills of material for new program launches and changes to existing programs including both engineering and process changes and maintains correct records for these changes to inventory and master data.
* Responsible for year-end budget process standard load.
* Responsible for month-end close process.
* Creates and maintains PFEP records.
* Follows safe practices.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills and Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 2–4+ years of relevant professional experience in manufacturing processes, particularly in an automotive environment, with hands-on involvement in new project execution and supporting business cases.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles to support and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Practical experience with automotive manufacturing processes and the ability to assist in the implementation of new technologies and systems.

**About Dauch:**

Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.

Dauch will not discriminate against any Associate or applicant for employment because of age, race, color, gender, religion, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic history or information, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, or other characteristic protected by law. Dauch will take affirmative action to ensure that applicants are employed, and that Associates are treated equally during employment, without regard to their age, race, color, gender, religion, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic history or information, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, or other characteristic protected by law. For the Disabled Job Seeker: We offer reasonable accommodations for qualified disabled individuals who are applicants for employment. To request assistance or accommodations, please e-mail TalentAcquisition@aam.com. Dauch is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

**Overview of Position**

Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.

The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.

This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.

**What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?**

**Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
* Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
* Ensure compliance with:
+ U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
+ OFAC sanctions requirements
+ U.S. Customs regulations
+ International customs laws and regulations
+ Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
* Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
* Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

**Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)**

* Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
* Ensure accurate:
+ HTS classifications
+ Country-of-origin determinations
+ Customs valuation
+ Duty assessment
* Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
+ Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
* Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.

**Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)**

* Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
* Ensure compliance with export controls.
* Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
* Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
* Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
* Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
* Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
* Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

**Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)**

* Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
* Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
* Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
* Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.

* Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
* Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

**Training and Culture (5%)**

* Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
* Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
* Maintain training records and support audit readiness.

**Number of Direct Reports**

* 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst

**Financial Responsibility**

* Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

**Experience**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
* At least 5

This position is ideal for someone who is passionate about business intelligence, market analysis, and continuous improvement. By analyzing demand patterns, economic indicators, and sales trends, you will help deliver actionable insights that support strategic planning, forecasting accuracy, and business growth.

At Emerson, our Professional Tools portfolio includes trusted brands such as RIDGID®, Greenlee®, and Klauke®, providing innovative solutions for professionals in the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing industries worldwide. Working within a dynamic global team, you will have the opportunity to influence business decisions through meaningful analysis, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Develop and deliver sales planning analyses, forecasts, and reports that identify demand patterns, market trends, and actionable insights to support business decision-making.
* Leverage business intelligence tools, including Domo, and statistical analysis techniques to evaluate business performance, monitor economic indicators, and predict future demand.
* Partner with Sales, Product Management, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to develop detailed product, market, and distributor forecasts.
* Support the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process by contributing data-driven recommendations that help deliver an aligned and accurate sales plan.
* Prepare presentations, dashboards, and reports for leadership using data visualization and storytelling techniques to communicate key insights effectively.
* Participate in planning initiatives, business improvement projects, and process optimization efforts that enhance forecasting accuracy and organizational effectiveness.
Support strategic planning and recurring business activities, including long-term sales projections, backlog analysis, intercompany sales projections, and sales plan development.

**Who You Are:**
You enjoy analyzing data to solve business challenges and uncover meaningful insights. You collaborate effectively with others to achieve shared goals and build strong working relationships across functions. You communicate clearly and confidently in a variety of settings, tailoring your message to diverse audiences and organizational levels. You learn quickly when facing new situations, balance the needs of multiple stakeholders, continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and outcomes, and follow through on commitments with accountability and integrity.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
* One (1) or more years of relevant professional experience (intern/co-op experience will be considered).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information and insights to management.
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative, work independently, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Domo, Power BI, or similar platforms.
* Master of Business Administration (MBA).
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

Guided by our core values of innovation, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion, Emerson is committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute, develop, and succeed. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and offer competitive benefits designed to support the physical, mental, financial, and social needs of employees and their families. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, an Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition programs, flexible time off, paid parental leave, vacation and holiday benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

description:
Virgin Galactic is seeking a Senior Vice President, FP&A and Investor Relations, reporting to the company’s Chief Financial Officer. This person will be responsible for leading both the company’s Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Investor Relations functions through the rapid growth phase in commercial spaceflight operations, and beyond. This is a one-of-a-kind opportunity to drive internal financial results and external investor communications at a company that is making space accessible to humans on an unprecedented scale.

The SVP of FP&A and Investor Relations will be a strategic thinker with the strong analytical, business partnering, and communication skills required to optimize key financial decisions for the company, drive consensus, and ensure follow through across multiple disciplines. The selected candidate will also be responsible for formulating corporate themes and specific messaging for all investor communications, including earnings calls. You will possess the leadership skills to continue the effective development of a diverse and high-performing team. The candidate will wear multiple hats and demonstrate a bias towards action in a low ego and collegial company culture.

Responsibilities

* Play a lead role in the company’s strategic planning process, evaluating capital needs and developing a rolling multi-year investment plan based on optimization of financial outcomes
* Lead the company’s annual and long-range financial planning process, including cash flow projection / optimization, and P&L forecast refinement
* Conduct cost/benefit analyses on investment opportunities across all corporate departments and make go/wait/no-go recommendations to leadership team
* Act as a financial business partner to top management in interpreting and using financial data to drive business results
* Drive the consolidated budgeting process across all business units, track performance to budgets, and link changes to business drivers
* Create financial presentations for Board Meetings
* Assist with development of supply chain strategies based on strategic needs, cost/benefit tradeoffs of outsourcing vs insourcing, minimum volume considerations, and other factors. Be a key stakeholder in major supply chain contract formulation and negotiations
* Develop investor messaging based on key financial themes to demonstrate progress and economic merits of the company as we rapidly grow our commercial spaceflight operations
* Drive earnings call process, including internal and external logistics and follow-ups with sell-side analysts. Manage communications with the retail investor community and institutional investors. Plan and coordinate non-deal roadshows and investor conferences
* Manage, mentor, influence, and grow a high-performance team to help drive the business

Required Skills and Experience

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or related field, 10+ years of progressive finance experience including strong FP&A foundation, and minimum 3 years in an executive leadership role. MBA or CPA desired
* Proven experience as a senior finance leader who is passionate about process improvement and driving results
* Facile with data analysis and forecasting models. Demonstrated ability to translate financial matters for all stakeholders to foster understanding and support
* Knowledge of both corporate finance and accounting, with ability to communicate seamlessly in multiple financial modes, such as free cash flow, operating expense, EBITDA, EPS, etc.
* Analytical skills that penetrate complex tradeoffs in order to drive clear and effective decision making
* Strong business acumen and partnering skills that result in the SVP being a sought-after consultant to leaders across the company for planning and decision making
* Familiarity with contract terminology and structures, and ability to recognize key contract elements for program success
* Proven ability to develop financial systems, processes, and tools to enhance transparency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial insights
* Past experience in investor relations at a public company is a plus, but most essential is the ability to communicate core investment theses to a diverse audience and to understand dynamics of a diverse investor base (i.e., heavy retail, growing institutional)
* Demonstrates the executive presence needed to instill confidence and commitment from various stakeholders and constituents. Inspires others with values-driven leadership over positional authority
* Superior communication skills, including ability to communicate clearly, timely, respectfully
* Open-mindedness to other ideas, and ability to adjust thinking and behavior as discussions evolve deep curiosity for the possibilities that are made available to humanity through space travel

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

**Job Description:**

The Specialist works in an office environment, business casual dress. He/she will evaluate inventory support material and services requirements for UPS's airline. The Technical Analyst will be working with various airline groups to determine requirements, component interchangeability, configuration requirements, sourcing options, negotiating with suppliers, and maintaining project tracking/reporting. The Technical Analyst will assist in the development of short/long range material support for the airline along with special projects as assigned.

Specialists in the Asset Management Groups will have a systematic understanding of the Planning, Purchasing, Repair, and negotiations for aircraft components and services. This knowledge will be used to successfully control the supply chain of these assets and coordinate customer requirements. Customers include Aircraft Line and Heavy Maintenance, Engineering, as well as other key support and Procurement Services functions. Interpret Engineering and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) technical documents to validate effectively and interchangeability. Analyze component repair requirements and processes. Liaison with component repair vendors.

**Required Skills:**

* Formal training in a relevant aviation field and/or extensive aerospace industry experience.
* Must understand the effects of material support on the maintenance organization.
* Ability to collect technical and cost data to identify trends.
* Must possess a technical, statistical, and analytical aptitude to interpret:
  + Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Drawings
  + Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC)
  + Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM)
  + Minimum Equipment Lists (MEL)
  + Engineering Orders (E/O)
  + Any other aviation industry technical documents and processes

**Preferred Skills:**

* Aviation Degree and/or A&P License preferred.
* Commercial expertise, negotiation, technical and financial skills to component repair and overhaul costs, alternative parts, and alternative repair authorizations.
* Ability to comfortably and confidently interface and negotiate with monopolistic suppliers and our aircraft engineering teams to standardize component specifications and ensure our cost per flight is best in class while maintaining reliability.
* MIPS, MTX, and other programs related to Aviation is a plus.
* Proficiency in all Microsoft Office Suite products.
* Understanding of Project Management.

**Interpersonal Skills:**

* Ability to work in a regulated environment with minimal supervision. Must have great attention to detail and prioritization skills. Must be able to clearly communicate with internal and external customers.
* Ability to interact and work with Administrative, Business Professionals and Management daily.
* Able to make quick decisions and adjust plans under operational pressure. Team player with proven leadership skills.

Dover Food Retail (DFR) is a leading manufacturer of Display Cases, Specialty Products, Refrigeration Systems, Power Systems and Comprehensive Services; and leading our industry by Innovating What’s Next in glass doors and intelligent merchandising technologies that keep food safe under brands such as HillPhoenix and Anthony.

DFR is part of the Refrigeration and Food Equipment segment of the Dover Corporation® (NYSE: DOV). Dover is a diversified global manufacturer with annual revenues in excess of $7 billion.

DFR is built on creativity and customer-centric innovation delivered by people invigorated by a strong sense of responsibility to help our customers win in their marketplaces. The relationships we build with our customers are as important to our success as the products we manufacture. This collaborative environment delivers FRESH THINKING, reassuring our customers that they choose the best when they choose to work with the people of Dover Food Retail.

**Job Title:** Senior Financial Analyst

**Location:** Conyers, GA

**What we’re looking for:**

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who will perform detailed reporting and analysis to support financial planning and reporting requirements. This individual will also analyze data to support leadership in decision making.

**What you’ll be responsible for in this role:**

* Preparing weekly and monthly reporting packages which include revenue analysis, labor analysis, variance analysis, and other operational performance reports.
* Prepare and take ownership of aspects of the monthly and annual forecasting processes.
* Develop and maintain financial models & templates to support Dover requirements
* Partner with the Engineering and Supply Chain functions to validate and track productivity initiatives.
* Develop relationships with department heads to improve forecasting and cost ownership of department budgets
* Help drive business intelligence automation reports and adoption
Perform ad-hoc analysis as necessary

**What are the basic qualifications?**

Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or related field and 1 – 3 years of experience of financial reporting experience.

**What are the preferred qualifications?**

* Previous role in Finance or Accounting for a manufacturing company.
* Experience in financial forecasting and financial modeling.

* Power BI, Power Query, and Hyperion experience a plus

**To be a great fit for the role:**

* Intermediate knowledge and experience with FP&A, budgeting and forecasting
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and data-mining ability
* Demonstrated ability to initiate analysis and drive positive change based upon data
* Exceptional organization skills and ability to handle multiple tasks

**How We Define Our Values and Why You Should Join Our Team:**

The backbone behind our collection of outstanding businesses is a team of dedicated employees who protect and enhance our valued reputation for quality and delivering what we promise. It’s our values that define Dover to all of our key audiences: our shareholders, customers, prospective employees and especially to ourselves.

These values must be expressed in our work and embody our actions, as they form the basis by which we do our jobs, make decisions and measure our performance. It’s our unwavering commitment to maintaining our values that defines who we are as a Company.

* Collaborative Entrepreneurial Spirit
* Winning Through Customers
* Respects and Values People
* Expectations for Results
* High Ethical Standards, Openness, and Trust

**What’s in it for you?**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 401k Retirement Plan
* Flexible Spending
* Paid Holidays

**Automotive Networking Cable Assemblies**

**BUSINESS UNIT:** Connected Mobility Solutions (CMSBU)

**SEGMENT:** Networking

**FUNCTION:** Product Management / Cost Analytics

**LOCATION:** Rochester Hills, MI

**TRAVEL:** 30-50%, Globally

**Your Job**

The **Strategic Cost Analyst** will serve as the cost modeling and profitability analytics expert for the CMSBU Networking cable assembly portfolio. This role will build a detailed understanding of product cost structures, identify the primary drivers of cost and margin, and translate complex operational and financial data into clear recommendations for business decisions.

The analyst will partner closely with Product Management, Sourcing, Plant Finance, Corporate Finance, Engineering, and Operations to strengthen cost transparency, improve estimating accuracy, and develop repeatable tools that support pricing, portfolio, sourcing, footprint, and investment decisions.

**What You Will Do**

**Product Cost Insight and Competitive Analytics**

* Partner with Plant Finance and Operations Finance to understand the manufacturing processes and associated costs of automotive networking cable assemblies, including coaxial, shielded twisted-pair, unshielded twisted-pair, and next-generation connectivity solutions.
* Translate cost data and operations knowledge into clear views of the material, conversion, process, scrap, testing, logistics, utilization, and investment drivers that influence product competitiveness
* Develop decision-oriented cost views
* Benchmark internal cost positions across products, plants, regions, sourcing options, supplier quotes, and credible external reference points to identify where the business is advantaged or disadvantaged.
* Identify and quantify the drivers behind gaps to competitor pricing and help distinguish true manufacturing cost gaps from differences in design, sourcing, footprint, scale, utilization, or commercial strategy.
* Build a repeatable fact base that Product Management can use to understand what it costs to make products and where focused action can create value.

**Quoting and Commercial Decision Support**

* Embed cost insight into customer quotations and RFQ decisions so teams understand the key cost assumptions, sensitivities, and risks behind each offer.
* Partner with Product Management, Sales, Finance, Sourcing, Engineering, and Operations to evaluate pricing alternatives and recommend quote strategies that balance competitiveness, contribution, risk, and long-term value.
* Analyze quotations at the appropriate product and part-number level to prevent portfolio averages from masking unattractive configurations or cost gaps.
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses for volume, commodity, labor, utilization, exchange rate, sourcing, footprint, and design alternatives.
* Compare quoted positions with available competitor intelligence and market evidence, clearly separating known facts, assumptions, and hypotheses that require validation.
* Support structured commercial experiments and post-quote reviews to improve future assumptions, decision quality, and win-loss learning.

**Opportunity Identification and Action Planning**

* Use cost and competitive analysis to identify opportunities in design-to-cost, value engineering, sourcing, localization, automation, process improvement, capacity utilization, and manufacturing footprint.
* Work with functional owners to convert identified cost gaps into specific questions, hypotheses, and potential actions, while leaving execution ownership with the appropriate Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, or Finance team.
* Partner with new product development teams to establish competitive cost targets, monitor emerging gaps, and elevate risks before major business commitments.
* Support make-versus-buy, regionalization, supplier, and manufacturing strategy decisions with transparent economic comparisons.
* Prioritize analytical work based on the size of the decision, the quality of available evidence, and the potential value of closing the gap.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field; or equivalent experience in product costing, cost estimating, cost analysis, operations finance, pricing, sourcing, manufacturing analytics, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in product costing, manufacturing cost estimation, operations finance, financial analysis, sourcing, pricing, or a related discipline.
* Strong financial and economic acumen, with the ability to connect operational drivers to revenue, margin, cash flow, and return outcomes.
* Advanced analytical and modeling skills, including the ability to structure complex and incomplete data into decision-ready insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with enterprise financial, manufacturing, or business intelligence systems.

description:
The Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) division integrates financial planning, spend management, third-party risk management, product management and engineering teams to support strategic decisions across the firm.

**Finance & Planning** drives business planning, budgeting, and analytics across revenue, expense, liquidity, and capital. The pillar includes divisional CFOs providing strategic finance advisory, Product Finance managing non-compensation expense governance, and Corporate Insurance & Advisory overseeing the firm's insurance needs and risk mitigation.

**Global Procurement** strategically manages third-party engagement, optimizing value and mitigating risks across the supply chain. Key functions include Strategic Sourcing, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Procure to Pay (P2P), Travel, and Sustainable Operations driving ESG initiatives.

**Product & Reporting** manages the product lifecycle for CPM technology platforms and delivers comprehensive reporting, dashboards, and analytics. * ### **Nothing Better in the Market**

We believe great people build great brands. And we know there is Nothing Better in the Market than a career at Brown-Forman. Being a part of Brown-Forman means you will grow both personally and professionally. You will have the opportunity to solve problems, seize opportunities, and generate bold ideas. You will belong to a place where teamwork matters and where you are encouraged to bring your best self to work.

* ### **Total Rewards**

At Brown-Forman, we believe in recognizing the bold ideas, ethical decisions, and winning results that make the company’s short- and long-term success possible. This recognition comes in many forms, to include your base salary, holiday bonus, and any incentives you may earn.

* ### **Learning is at the heart of our culture**

We create an environment that nurtures and prioritizes continuous learning. At Brown-Forman, you are empowered to take charge of your own development with a variety of customized, award-winning programs available for every step of your career journey.

**Meaningful Work from Day One:**

Lead complex product governance and master data activities that support new product launches and changes. Partner across brands, markets, and functions to ensure product data is accurate, compliant, and operationally ready. Drive process improvements, provide technical expertise, and guide governance activities from requirements through implementation and issue resolution.

**What You Can Expect:**

Master Data Initiation & Governance

* Own the accurate and timely initiation of SKU and component master data in SAP for new product introductions and product changes.
* Oversee critical data entry and validation activities and resolve complex master data issues.
* Own the end-to-end product governance workflow for assigned initiatives, ensuring master data readiness and timely operational handoff.
* Assess and communicate master data, compliance, execution, and launch-readiness risks and their potential business impact.

Project & Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead master data and product governance workstreams in partnership with the Product Development PMO and cross-functional teams.
* Support project scope, timing, and prioritization for new product introductions and product changes.
* Facilitate communication and information flow between product development, master data, and operational teams.
* Lead resolution of cross-functional data, ownership, and governance issues.
* Provide work direction, technical guidance, quality review, coaching, and prioritization support to analysts and cross-functional partners.

Process Improvement & Regulatory Compliance

* Identify and lead continuous improvement opportunities within master data and product governance processes.
* Serve as the functional decision-maker for product governance requirements, data readiness, and master data quality within established authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce cycle times, streamline data intake workflows, and improve operational performance.
* Lead global regulatory compliance projects from initiation through completion.

Data Analysis & Performance

* Monitor product governance and master data performance, including data accuracy, right-first-time completion, cycle time, milestone adherence, rework, exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, root causes, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare and present insights to support governance reviews, resource prioritization, process improvements, and business decisions.

Standards & Governance

* Develop, maintain, and enforce global product governance standards, decision criteria, data requirements, controls, and documentation practices.
* Maintain standard requirement templates, readiness checklists, data definitions, and governance controls.
* Ensure consistent application of governance requirements across brands, markets, product types, and manufacturing locations.
* Manage exceptions to global standards, including documenting business rationale and coordinating appropriate approvals.
* Lead product governance reviews, document decisions, and escalate unresolved risks through established governance channels.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience
* Strong understanding of product master data elements, hierarchies, and their impact across planning, procurement, production, logistics, sales, and other supply chain functions.
* Hands-on experience with SAP master data structures and functionality related to SKU and component creation.
* Ability to analyze complex product development inputs, including product specifications, packaging requirements, and geographic or market considerations, to determine master data needs.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex or ambiguous business requirements into clear, complete, and actionable master data specifications.
* Experience with data entry, validation, and maintainin

description:
**The Opportunity**

Smurfit Westrock is seeking a highly talented Finance Manager to help lead the Supply Chain Finance team working in a complex global function located in our Corporate Headquarters in Atlanta, GA. This position will report to the Senior Manager of Business Finance & Analytics and will be a key business partner to the Enterprise Logistics team. The Supply Chain Finance Manager will work closely with Freight and Logistics Leadership, Supply Chain Leadership and Mills Financial Team in the preparation and review of forecasts, budgets, ad hoc analysis, and periodic reports. In addition, the Manager will participate on project teams, periodically acting as the ‘finance lead’ on these teams. In performing these roles, the Manager will be expected to interact with numerous functional departments (both at Corporate, Mill and Box locations) and with numerous management levels within the company.

**How you will impact Smurfit Westrock**

* Lead all freight forecast/planning development and variance analytics for both Mills and Packaging businesses
* Liaison with Packaging counterparts on forecast/planning assumptions and variance analytics
* Responsible for the delivery and accuracy of daily/weekly/monthly financial analyses with related commentary.
* Prepare financial materials as required & lead any financial presentations.
* Track all relevant KPIs and provide insights on drivers of performance to Supply Chain and Mill business partners
* Validation & tracking of CTO freight project savings
* Participate in any freight/logistics-related diagnostics or project-based work
* Mentor to Financial Analysts and Interns/early career development associates

**What you need to succeed**

* Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Accounting, Business, Procurement, or Supply Chain Management is required
* 5+ years related experience in general or corporate finance, strategic finance, supply chain/logistics data analytics, and complex system configuration integration (ERP implementation and support)
* Must possess the potential and desire to advance to leadership roles
* Ability to adapt to a high-paced work environment, balancing routine responsibilities with ad hoc requests and stringent deadlines
* Advanced level proficiency in Microsoft (Excel & Access); Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) experience preferred; JD Edwards and Hyperion a plus
* Minimal to no travel required
* Occasional weekend work required (financial reporting, system cutovers, testing, etc.)

**What we offer**:

* Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence
* Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
* An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
* A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of daily work

We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

**We Are:**

Accenture’s Supply Chain & Operations practice, and we live in the details that make distribution centers run. Our clients—Fortune 500 leaders across retail, e-commerce, grocery, consumer goods, third-party logistics, and industrial manufacturing—count on us to design, configure, and stand up the systems and processes that power their warehouses. From WMS solution design and configuration through go-live and stabilization, our Warehousing & Distribution Engineering team combines deep functional expertise, hands-on operations knowledge, and Accenture’s global delivery capability to solve the problems that other firms treat as out of scope. If it touches how goods move inside four walls, we own it.

**You Are:**

A hands-on WMS functional expert and distribution center operations specialist who has spent your career in the details—configuration workbooks, fit-gap analyses, process flow diagrams, UAT scripts, and go-live war rooms. You bring deep, practical expertise in Manhattan Active® WM (or a comparable enterprise WMS platform) and you know the operations side just as well: receiving and putaway, wave planning and pick/pack/ship, labor management, slotting, cycle counting, and returns. You can walk a client’s operations floor, immediately identify what is broken or sub-optimal, and translate that observation into a WMS configuration or process change that actually fixes it. You are an effective facilitator who earns the trust of warehouse managers and IT leaders alike, and you thrive guiding client super users through design decisions that will shape how thousands of associates work every day. You are ready to be on-site where the work happens—and traveling 60 to 80 percent of the time suits you fine.

* Lead the WMS functional workstream on large distribution center implementation programs, owning requirements gathering, process design, configuration, testing, and go-live for Manhattan Active® WM and comparable enterprise WMS platforms.

* Facilitate solution design workshops with client operations, industrial engineering, and IT stakeholders; translate operational requirements into documented functional specifications, configuration decisions, and process design documents aligned with the WMS platform's capabilities and best practices.
* Own and maintain configuration workbooks, functional specifications, fit-gap analyses, process flow documentation, and requirements traceability matrices across the full implementation lifecycle, ensuring changes are version-controlled and communicated across project workstreams.
* Design and execute end-to-end WMS testing strategies—unit testing, systems integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT)—including test script development, defect logging and triage, regression testing, and go-live readiness certification in partnership with the client, SI, and automation vendors.
* Lead WMS cutover planning and execution for go-live events, including parallel processing support, cutover checklists and rehearsals, hyper-care protocols, issue escalation, and post-launch stabilization in live distribution environments.
* Design and deliver role-based end-user training programs for warehouse associates, team leads, supervisors, and system administrators across all WMS functional modules; develop training documentation, quick-reference guides, and on-floor job aids.
* Support configuration and optimization of labor management systems (LMS), engineered labor standards, slotting programs, wave optimization rules, and warehouse performance dashboar

Overview:

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

Fred Hutch Cancer Center is seeking an **Application Analyst II** to join the Enterprise Business Systems team within Information Technology, supporting the business application portfolio used by Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Research Administration, and clinical operations partners.

Responsible for supporting all aspects of the UKG Dimensions cloud application in support of business operations. Provides technical application support, troubleshooting, systems change management, and training of users. Leads design, testing, process development, and end-to-end configuration. Serves as the primary technical expert for the UKG system and leads configuration. Supports the Application Manager in preparing data for business proposals related to application functionality and changes. Provides systems support for other business applications (PeopleSoft, Concur, Censeo, Blackline etc.).

Most Fred Hutch jobs require *some* on-campus work. However, there may be flexibility for certain positions. Please check with the recruiter if you are an out-of-state applicant interested only in working outside of the Seattle area.

Responsibilities:

* Collaborate with operational end-users and project stakeholders to collect and interpret business requirements, write functional specifications, identify possible system enhancements, document needs, find alternatives and determine functionality to meet those requirements.
* Designs system configuration builds and tests system functionality, leading all testing efforts to ensure release deadlines are met and the system functions as intended.
* Responsible for developing and running test scripts related to specific areas for validating changes to the system, including the development of appropriate test conditions, and validating results.
* Provide functional services by acting as subject matter expert and providing input on best practices, options, risks, and impacts to other processes and systems.
* Manages application functionality including identifying and performing appropriate audits, supports payroll processing, and performs regular system maintenance.
* Identifies and helps to implement workarounds for gaps between business needs and system capabilities.
* Provide technical support, responding to, and resolving day to day production issues in a timely manner, troubleshoots solutions, escalating when needed to the Applications Manager and working with the vendor's technical team to resolve; serves as the technical point of contact.
* Identifies improvements to current system configuration, including determining the root causes of problems and solutions designed to eliminate manual work.
* Manages and opens tickets with vendor on technical issues.
* Responsible for all system documentation including documented requirements and configuration guides.
* Collaborates with other departments in support of the system, such as Human Resources, Facilities, Finance, Education/Learning Management (LMS), etc.
* Serves as a subject matter expert on clinic staff scheduling, maintaining an active knowledge of staff scheduling practices across the clinic.
* Manages assignments of training based on user type. Creates and updates training materials as needed.
* Provides training to end-users from all levels of the organization via self-service job aids, assigned LMS trainings, and live virtual sessions.
* Remains up to date on future UKG enhancements and opportunities for Fred Hutch to fully benefit from service offerings.
* Work in partnership with - UKG consultants and internal teams to leverage the application to maximum potential and efficiency.
