Ascent Aerospace – Inspiring the next generation of flight!

Ascent Aerospace is a world-renowned, single-source provider of production and automated assembly systems for the aerospace and defense industry. We provide high-precision advanced automated equipment as well as a full suite of both mold and assembly tooling required for the aerospace manufacturing market, including the largest Invar molds ever made— making us the largest tooling group in the industry. We work with our customers to develop their project and see it through, from process engineering to build and installation, to ensure it is an efficient and cost-effective solution. As a true, single-source integrator, we have proven tools to surpass our customer expectations. We have greater control of timing and schedules, which allows for 100% accountability, and avoids costly mark-ups, ultimately saving our customers money. The result: a group of businesses, each an industry leader within their own discipline, now acting as one truly integrated supply base.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Business Systems Analyst is the connective tissue between Ascent Aerospace's business stakeholders and the Information Technology team. This role owns the work that makes technology initiatives succeed: process documentation, requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, and change management. The analyst translates business problems into structured requirements, maps current and future state workflows, and ensures that the people affected by technology changes are informed, prepared, and supported through the transition. Working directly under the Enterprise Solutions Architect, this person is central to how IT engages the business, taking the discovery and design work off stakeholders' plates so they can show up to focused conversations rather than blank pages.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Process Analysis and Design

* Document current-state business processes across all functions including Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Engineering, and Business Development.
* Identify process gaps, manual workarounds, and improvement opportunities through structured stakeholder conversations and direct observation.
* Design future-state workflows that align with both technology capabilities and business objectives.
* Facilitate working sessions with business sponsors to validate requirements and confirm process designs before any development begins.

Requirements Management

* Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional requirements for all IT initiatives.
* Maintain a living requirements backlog and ensure clear traceability from business problem to delivered solution.
* Define acceptance criteria and success metrics for each initiative in partnership with the business sponsor.
* Assess the business impact of proposed scope changes and communicate it to stakeholders; the IT Project Manager owns change control.

Stakeholder Communication and Change Management

* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the IT delivery team across all active initiatives.
* Develop and execute change management plans for each major rollout, including training, communication, and adoption tracking.
* Prepare executive-ready updates and support steering committee reviews.
* Proactively surface risks, trade-offs, and dependencies before they become problems.

Program Support

* Support the VP of Information Technology and Enterprise Solutions Architect in roadmap planning and initiative prioritization.
* Work with external vendors and implementation contractors on requirements, functional design, and review of deliverables against business requirements, in coordination with the IT Project Manager.
* Maintain process maps and requirements documentation, and contribute to the program decision log and lessons learned.
* Flag process and business-change conflicts across workstreams to the IT Project Manager.

REQUIRED SKILLS, EDUCATION, AND EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a business analyst, systems analyst, or process improvement role.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex business problems into clear written requirements.
* Experience facilitating workshops and working sessions with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership.
* Experience working in a manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or regulated industry environment. Experience in an engineer-to-order or project-based manufacturing environment is strongly preferred.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience with SAP ECC or S/4HANA in a business analyst or super-user capacity.
* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project management methodologies.
* Experience with AI platform implementations or digital transformation programs.

This position shall be performed under the day-to-day direction, control, and supervision of WTCC

**REQUIREMENTS/SPECIFICATIONS**

**Education/Experience:**

Minimum Requirements per DOE O 426.2:

1. High School (HS) Diploma

AND

2. Must have knowledge and/or expertise consistent with the technical material to be presented.

AND

3. Must have experience as an instructor or have the ability to successfully demonstrate knowledge of instructional techniques through basic instructor training.

AND (if applicable)

4. Instructors who are responsible for instruction of subjects such as Technical Safety Requirements (TSR) must have successfully completed training on facility operating characteristics and principles, and operating limits (Safety Limits, Limiting Control Settings, and Limiting Conditions for Operation) and their bases or have had significant involvement in writing the TSRs.

**Additional Requirements:**

* At least 2 years’ experience in technical instruction.
* At least 2 years’ experience in technical training material development.

**Preferred candidates will have:**

* At least 8 years technical experience in operations, maintenance, or related technical position in Naval Nuclear, Department of Energy Nuclear, or Commercial Nuclear Operations.
* Experience with JPro Simulation Software

**MAJOR** **RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES/TASKS**

* Conduct simulator system task training for control room commissioning technicians and other control room staff.
* Operate simulator software and equipment, as necessary, to provide plant response during training evolutions
* Miscellaneous support and/or activities related to training development and implementation.
* Under the direction of a Simulator Instructor – Senior:
* Provide observation and evaluation of student performance during integrated simulator training.
* Under the direction of a qualified instructional analyst/developer:
* Develop simulator task-based training, alarm response, and drill exercise guides.
* Perform observations and assessments to ensure activities are implemented safely and effectively in accordance with approved procedures.
* Support a strong Nuclear Safety Quality Culture (NSQC) by emphasizing the values of safety and quality in the performance of work, in order to protect self, others, and the environment.

This job description is not intended to include every duty, task or instruction for which an employee is responsible. Other tasks may be assigned, based on business needs and the department supervisor's request(s).

**SUPERVISORY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* None

**PHYSICAL** **REQUIREMENTS**

(EFNM) Exposed Field Non-Manual

Performs desk work, including writing, computer workstation processes, and telephone operation. Arranges for and/or performs presentations, oral reports, planning meetings, and other formal and informal contacts, requiring long periods of sitting. Oversees field activities through inspections, testing and equipment operations, which requires walking, standing, bending, and turning along with wearing of personal protective equipment. Occasional loading, transport, and unloading of tools and/or supplies specific to an activity.

* **This position is located at the Construction Site (22 miles north of Richland) and works a 4 x 10 schedule, M-Th, 6:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.**
* **Must be authorized to work and remain in the United States without Amentum visa sponsorship now or in the future.**
* **Must be able to complete and pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check which includes verification of employment and education.**
* **Must be able to obtain a Department of Energy badge for access to the Hanford Site. (Even if teleworking, must still be able to comply with security requirements to obtain a badge.)**
* **Non-U.S. citizens from countries identified by the Department of Energy as posing heightened security concerns—including sensitive countries, state sponsors of terrorism, countries of risk, and other designated countries –are subject to additional security requirements.**

Our predecessors helped build Hoover Dam, protected fighting forces in World War II, and supported the Manhattan Project. Today, our teams clean up legacy nuclear waste around the world, manage the United Kingdom’s defense portfolio, design programs and tests for Navy submarine electronic systems, and provide integrated supply chain services needed in developing countries during the pandemic.

Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**The Role**
------------

In this role you will support package development and semiconductor manufacturing programs. Coordinate project activities, forecasts, sample builds, purchasing processes, and program tracking while partnering with engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and finance teams to ensure successful execution of key development initiatives.

**The Person**
--------------

You are an organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You bring strong analytical and communication skills, a process-focused mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working effectively with cross-functional teams across global locations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support package development programs through planning, forecasting, scheduling, and project coordination activities.
* Manage project trackers, reports, documentation, and status updates to ensure accurate program visibility.
* Coordinate package and assembly sample builds, including manufacturing requests and execution tracking.
* Prepare and manage purchase orders, supporting delivery, invoicing, and SAP posting activities.
* Partner with engineering, procurement, finance, suppliers, and manufacturing teams to drive efficient project execution.
* Capture lessons learned and maintain project knowledge for future program planning and execution.
* Track deliverables, milestones, risks, and action items to help ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience supporting program management, project coordination, engineering operations, or manufacturing initiatives.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, and forecasting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and web-based planning tools.
* Familiarity with SAP, purchase order management, invoicing, and financial tracking processes.
* Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, package development, assembly processes, or new product introduction (NPI).
* Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and collaborate across geographically distributed teams.
* Experience in a fast-paced technical or manufacturing environment is preferred.

**Education :**
---------------

Bachelors or Masters in relevant field

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

**#LI-AP1**

Qualifications:

*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

Overview:

At **Morgan Advanced Materials**, our rich history and dedication to innovation define who we are. Since our establishment in the UK in 1856, we have expanded globally, now operating across 70 sites in 18 countries. Our goal is to create a more sustainable world and enhance quality of life. We actively pursue this purpose through the development and production of advanced materials.

Within our business unit, we specialise in innovating cutting-edge carbon, graphite, and carbide products that deliver outstanding performance. We use our expertise to tackle complex challenges across many diverse industries to provide effective solutions for our valued customers.

Our products are shaping a better future; from enabling electric cars to charge faster and drive longer distances to maximising the operational efficiency of wind turbines. We are proud to help generate power for billions of people, deliver water to drought-stricken regions, improve the efficiency of industrial pumps, and protect lives both on the land and in the air.

**Key Figures:** Revenue £1,100.7m (2024), ~8,000 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

Responsibilities:

**The Continuous Improvement (CI) / Operational Excellence (OPEX) Specialist is responsible for driving operational performance and business results through the implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and data-driven improvement initiatives. This role partners with plant leadership, production teams, engineering, quality, supply chain, and support functions to identify opportunities, eliminate waste, improve processes, and optimize productivity.**

**The CI/OPEX Specialist will utilize Power BI, manufacturing KPIs, and statistical analysis to provide actionable insights, monitor plant performance, and support strategic decision-making. This position serves as a change agent, fostering a culture of continuous improvement throughout the facility.**

Essential Functions:

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

* Lead and facilitate Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives across the facility.
* Drive improvements using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, 5S, TPM, Standard Work, Visual Management, and Root Cause Analysis methodologies.
* Conduct value stream mapping and process observations to identify waste, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies.
* Facilitate Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and problem-solving sessions.
* Partner with production, maintenance, engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to implement sustainable process improvements.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, standard work instructions, and best practices.
* Monitor and measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements and report results to leadership.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement at all levels of the organization.

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools.
* Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends affecting safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Design and automate KPI reporting for plant leadership and operational teams.
* Create visualizations that provide real-time insights into plant performance.
* Utilize ERP, MES, quality, maintenance, and production systems to collect and analyze operational data.
* Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting efficiency using Microsoft Power Platform tools.
* Support strategic and operational decision-making through advanced data analysis.

Manufacturing Performance Improvement

* Support initiatives to improve:
+ OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
+ Labor productivity
+ Throughput
+ First Pass Yield
+ Scrap and rework reduction
+ Downtime reduction
+ Inventory optimization
+ On-time delivery performance
* Conduct root cause investigations utilizing methodologies such as:
+ A3 Problem Solving
+ Fishbone Diagrams
+ 5 Why Analysis
+ Pareto Analysis
+ Statistical Process Analysis
* Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to establish performance improvement targets and action plans.

Project Management

* Lead and manage improvement projects from identification through implementation and sustainability.
* Develop project charters, timelines, success metrics, and financial justifications.
* Communicate project status and results to plant leadership and stakeholders.
* Track cost savings, productivity gains, and operational benefits realized from CI initiatives.

Requirements:

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 3-7 years of experience in manufacturing operations, continuous impro

### **Description**

SKIMS is a solutions-oriented brand creating the next generation of underwear, loungewear, shapewear, and essentials. We are setting new standards by delivering technically innovative, comfort-driven products with elevated design for everybody.

At the intersection of culture, innovation, and commerce, SKIMS is a global brand redefining modern apparel. Our teams are built on creativity, collaboration, and operational excellence, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance environment where ambitious, curious, and values-driven individuals can do the best work of their careers.

As we continue to scale globally, our HQ teams play a critical role in shaping strategy, building world-class infrastructure, and driving sustainable growth across markets.

SKIMS is looking for an Operation Analyst. This position will be focused on providing analytical support and strategic insights to the Operations and Logistics team, including KPI reporting, forecasting, cost tracking, and capacity planning.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Work cross-functionally to forecast inbound and outbound volume by sales channel and fulfillment location.
* Prepare invoices, KPIs, and supporting documentation for monthly close reconciliation, and partner with Accounting and FP&A to validate MoM variances and trends.
* Track departmental costs and analyze performance to budget while focusing on opportunities for cost savings.
* Perform ad-hoc analyses to translate data into insights for Operations & Logistics in the realm of cost modeling, DC capacity planning, and trend analysis.
* Manage, analyze, and report on all DC-SLA and capacity performance and present insights by developing KPI’s for daily tracking.
* Maintain internal rate card and SOP documentation.
* Must facilitate a positive work environment and manage issues by escalating as suitable.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* 5+ consecutive years of experience in operations management, fulfillment, or supply chain management; fashion company experience is a plus
* Operational forecasting and budgeting experience is a plus
* Experience managing relationships with vendors, 3PLs, and dedicated warehouses
* Excellent leadership and motivational skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Looker, Microsoft Office Suite, NetSuite, and project management tools
* Flexibility and the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments
* Goal-oriented mindset, with the ability to measure success both quantitatively and qualitatively
* Ability to collaborate strategically with cross-functional teams to drive projects forward, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions
* Professional outlook and demeanor
* Strong analytical skills, particularly with Excel, ERP systems, and reporting tools, to develop actionable recommendation
* Bachelor’s degree
* Onsite 4 days a week

### **Job Benefits**

**Benefits and Culture**

* Up to 100% Company Paid Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
* Kind Body Fertility Benefits
* 401(k) savings plan with up to 4% match
* Unlimited PTO
* Full Access to LinkedIn learning
* Employee Discounts

**Perks (HQ Location)**

* Free weekly catered lunch at HQ – M/T/W/Th
* Dog-Friendly office on a Thursday and Friday
* Free Swag Giveaways
* Annual Holiday Party
* Annual Summer Party
* Invitations to pop-ups and other company events
* Complimentary daily office snacks and beverages

### **About SKIMS**

SKIMS is a solutions-oriented brand creating the next generation of underwear, loungewear and shapewear.

We are setting new standards by providing solutions for every body. From technically constructed shapewear that enhances your curves to underwear that stretches to twice its size, our goal is to consistently innovate on the past and advance our industry for the future.

Eaton’s Fuel and Motion Control Systems Division of Eaton’s Aerospace Group, has an opening for a Aftermarket Production Support Analyst. The position is based onsite in Jackson, MS.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $71000 - $105000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.

The Jackson facility has approximately 500 employees and is a leader in the design, development, manufacture and delivery of Aerospace hydraulic components, systems and services to the global aftermarket and OEM markets.

The Production Analyst will be responsible for Return to Service through a 14 CFR Part 145 Repair Station and for the induction process.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Perform Return to Service release through a 14 CFR Part 145 Repair Station.
* Perform customer delegated source activities such as inspection of product, paperwork, and customer portal information.
* Partner with hourly and salary team members to achieve team, function, and plant goals.
* Monitor production processes and methods to assure maintenance of in-process quality levels and to prevent quality problems.
* Investigate and resolve product quality problems caused by processes, material or worker error.
* Review rejected hardware to determine cause and corrective action.
* Maintain accurate records to comply with Company policy towards record retention.
* Receivie customer returned hardware and verfy product and paperwork match.
* Reviews customer PO’s and determine work scope for unit.
* Determine if Eaton Jackson has capabilities.
* Enter customer information into repair database to create a work order.
* Coordinates with customer service team.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required Basic Qualifications:**

* Associate’s Degree from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of one (1) year of experience in a manufacturing or quality environment.
* This position requires use of information or access to hardware which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident.
* No relocation is offered for this position. All candidates must currently reside within 50 miles of (Jackson, MS) to be considered. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in business, supply chain management, engineering or related discipline.
* Either a Mechanics (Airframe or Powerplant) or Repairman Certificate per 14 CFR Part 65.
* Previous experience working in a maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) environment.

**Position Criteria:**
----------------------

* Strong ethics, values and the ability to influence others’ decision making.
* Ability to manage multiple projects/activities; results driven.
* Knowledge of product and manufacturing process.
* Process oriented and ability contribute to continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of Aerospace product and manufacturing processes and inspection techniques.
* Must exhibit a high level of motivation, sense of urgency, and energetic approach to job duties and requirements.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

description:
**Join The North Face Family**

The North Face was built on a love for the outdoors and the desire to enable all types of exploration, for all people, from their backyards to the Himalayas. Over the last 50 years we've lived by our “true north,” the belief that exploration has the power to change us, to challenge us and to help us see the world from new perspectives.

To help ignite a global movement of outdoor exploration, love for the natural world and an unwavering commitment to protect it, we welcome and encourage new participants to the outdoors. We extend our reach through support of non-profit organizations, establishing programs that connect participants with close-to-home recreation opportunities, and creating a connection with young leaders, inspiring them to explore and conserve. As we enter our sixth decade, we pledge to:

* Empower exploration and the thrill of the unknown for as many people as possible.
* Protect the places where we live, play, and operate.
* Evolve the way we make our products by improving our environmental performance and social responsibility in the supply chain.

**The North Face: Analyst, Loyalty & CRM - Americas**

The Analyst of Loyalty & CRM is a key member of The North Face Americas Loyalty & Lifecycle team, responsible for the strategy, measurement, and optimization of analytics across XPLR Pass and Lifecycle Marketing channels, including Email, SMS, and Push.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing, this role analyzes customer behavior across loyalty and lifecycle marketing, identifies growth opportunities, and leads measurement and reporting across the program and marketing channels.

Working cross-functionally across Loyalty & CRM, Marketing, Ecommerce, Retail, Finance, and Data & Analytics, this role helps improve how performance is measured, insights are communicated, and customer growth opportunities are prioritized.

You will play a critical role in driving optimization efforts that deliver real revenue impact across the business and improve member acquisition, engagement and retention.

**What you will do:**

**Loyalty & CRM Analytics Strategy & Execution:**

* Build and lead the analytics roadmap for Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, prioritizing initiatives based on business impact, customer value, feasibility, and strategic objectives.
* Serve as the primary analytics voice representing loyalty and lifecycle marketing analytics, shaping decisions with objective insights and clear recommendations.
* Support the execution of omnichannel customer journeys across email, SMS, push notifications, direct mail, and emerging channels through customer data and insights.
* Partner with CDP, Analytics, and Technology teams to leverage customer data for analysis, audience insights, measurement, and personalization opportunities.
* Analyze member acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value trends to identify opportunities for incremental growth.
* Develop forecasts, business cases, and opportunity sizing analyses to support investment decisions and prioritize growth initiatives.
* Evaluate audience strategies and customer segments to determine effectiveness and inform targeting approaches across lifecycle channels.

**Lifecycle Measurement & Experimentation**

* Own measurement and performance management across Loyalty and Lifecycle Marketing, including KPI frameworks, dashboards, recurring reporting, executive readouts, and business reviews.
* Monitor performance trends across loyalty and lifecycle channels, delivering actionable insights into what is happening, why it is happening, and where to act.
* Establish and maintain KPIs, metric definitions, and measurement standards to ensure consistent reporting across teams and platforms.
* Lead experimentation strategy, including test design, governance, incrementality, uplift measurement, attribution, and performance evaluation.
* Quantify incremental revenue impact from lifecycle marketing and loyalty initiatives through testing, attribution, and advanced measurement methodologies.
* Analyze customer behavior across retail, eCommerce, loyalty, and marketing touch points to deliver a unified view of customer engagement and value.
* Operating Model

* Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to validate data quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure accurate reporting.

* Improve analytics efficiency and quality through automation, modern tools, and AI-enabled capabilities.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. These Sellers offer hundreds of millions of unique products providing a broad and diverse inventory of products from Books, Electronics and Apparel to Consumables and beyond. Fulfillment By Amazon enables Sellers to provide fast and efficient delivery to their customers using Amazon fulfillment services. Sellers now make up the majority of the business on Amazon.com.

The FBA Inventory and Capacity Management team play a crucial rule in planning inventory volumes in the Amazon Fulfillment network (AFN) while facilitating sellers' desired growth. Our team specializes in forecasting short and long-term inbound volume based on historical data, trends, seller behaviors, and key signals. Accurate forecasting is essential for FC ops and FC capacity teams to plan operations effectively, ensuring optimal resource utilization and minimal operational costs.

AI-Driven Innovation: Our team is at the forefront of applying AI/ML technologies to transform supply chain forecasting. We leverage deep learning models (DeepAR, LSTMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI to build intelligent systems that predict, adapt, and optimize inbound operations in real time. This is a rare opportunity to work on AI solutions that directly impact Amazon's global supply chain at scale.

This role requires close collaboration with the science team to design and enhance Machine Learning (ML) models for improved forecasting accuracy and with our Sale and Operations Planning (S&OP) team integrate FBA forecasting into the broader network plan. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and results-oriented Senior Program Manager for our capacity and inventory planning space. In this role, you will collaborate with the science team to build advanced models for optimizing inbound forecasting, improve upon existing processes and collaboration, and work to build and enhance the forecasting toolset.

Key job responsibilities

* Manage new and existing products, successfully delivering difficult projects and goals across multiple organizations

Working with Science team to build ML models
Partner with other product and tech to secure resources, scope efforts, set project priorities and milestones and deliver on-time

As a Product Manager you will need to be an owner of your portfolio, making strategic product decisions grounded in data. You will work closely with business teams, leaders, engineering teams, economists/scientists and business intelligence analysts in an agile development environment to launch new features and experiences. Other key responsibilities include monitoring the execution of the project, providing project progress to stakeholders, and ensuring appropriate levels of product quality and performance

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

### **Job Title**

Director, Quality Programs-Integrated Supply Chain (ISC)

### **Job Description**

The **Director, Quality Programs-Integrated Supply Chain (ISC)** provides strategic leadership for enterprise and site-level quality programs within FDA regulated medical-device manufacturing environments. This role will lead large scale, global, cross-functional programs that strengthen the quality management system, improve compliance, reduce risk, and advance operational excellence.

**Your role:**

**Leadership and Team Management:**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Program Managers and data analyst responsible for quality programs.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture within the team.
* Provide guidance, support, and development opportunities to ensure team effectiveness and professional growth.

**Strategic Planning and Execution:**

* Develop and implement strategic plans for quality programs, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and completion of quality compliance projects to ensure they lead them in accordance with timelines, budgets, and objectives.
* Identify and address potential risks and issues that could impact project success.

**Product Quality, Quality Management System, Compliance and Standards:**

* Ensure adherence to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality policies.
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality programs, making adjustments as needed to maintain compliance and improve outcomes.
* Stay informed about industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance quality programs.
* Lead improvements in data and analytics by improvement current tools and practices

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Collaborate with other departments, including Operations Quality, Operations, Engineering, Business , and Supply Chain, on programs and outcomes.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for quality-related inquiries and concerns from internal stakeholders.

**Reporting and Documentation:**

* Prepare and present reports on project status, performance metrics, and compliance to senior management.
* Ensure accurate and timely documentation of quality program activities, including project plans, reports, and compliance records.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drive a culture of continuous improvement by implementing best practices and innovative solutions to enhance quality and efficiency.
Lead initiatives to identify opportunities for process improvements and implement corrective actions as needed

**You're the right fit if:**

* You have a minimum of 10+ years’ experience in FDA regulated medical device manufacturing/supply chain environments, providing strategic leadership for large scale, global, cross-functional quality programs/projects.
* You have a proven track record of successful program/project management, transformation, change management, continuous improvement and team leadership in a matrix environment
* You have proven experience in functional management of PMO/Quality teams, including budgeting, workforce planning, Performance Management, Employee Engagement/ Retention, Succession Planning, coaching, training, etc.
* You have strong understanding of Medical Device regulations/standards including ISO 13485/14971, 21CFR (803, 806, 820, etc.), MDD/ EU MDR, GMP, and GDP.
* You have proven expertise utilizing/improving data analytics- Quality KPI’s/Data Analysis to assess program/quality/team performance and identify process and continuous improvement opportunities.
* You’re able to effectively communicate, influence and build relationships with cross-functional team members at ALL levels.
* You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Engineering or a related Scientific discipline (required). Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., Six Sigma, PMP) preferred.
You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position .

**How we work together:**

We believe that we are better together than a part. For our ***Office-based*** teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations. **This is an Office role.**

**About Philips:**

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody, everywhere, has access to the quality of healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.
Learn more about our culture.

Imagine how your ideas and expertise can change a patient’s life. We generate extensive clinical evidence to demonstrate the effectiveness and safety of our innovations and how our products transform patients’ lives. As part of our Clinical Affairs team, you’ll hone your scientific curiosity and passion for evaluating data to increase access to pioneering technologies for patients in need. In close partnership with principal investigators, dedicated medical professionals, patient advocacy groups, and regulatory authorities, you will drive the evidence needed to optimize patient outcomes.

Patients with mitral and tricuspid heart valve disease often have complex conditions with limited treatment options. Our Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business unit is boldly pursuing an innovative portfolio of technologies to address a patient’s unmet clinical needs. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.

**You will make an impact by:**

* Perform analysis (e.g. enrollment, costing, resourcing) related to clinical trials to develop forecasting for key stakeholders (e.g. Clinical Affairs, Regulatory and Medical Affairs, Strategy, Global Supply Chain, Finance
* Investigate, assess and interpret clinical intel for strategic decision making to support business objectives, while proposing moderately complex solutions and recommendations
* Modify analysis tools by leveraging existing clinical models (e.g. inventory, case management, headcount trial enrollment and site activations/deactivations) while utilizing clinical trial knowledge
* Organize, analyze and create reports, and dashboards to summarize moderately complex challenges in clinical affairs projects, programs and/or initiatives
* Lead portions of clinical projects in collaboration with stakeholders (e.g. vendors, cross-functional teams)
* Identify and propose process improvements as it relates to clinical affairs (e.g. screening process, physician training)

**What you will need (Required):**

* Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 3 years related experience or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria
* Experience in quantitative or analytical field or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience working in clinical research in the medical device industry or equivalent work experience
* Experience with machine learning
* Proven expertise in Excel and PowerPoint and other MS Office Suite apps including Word and Access
* Good written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills
* Good problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills
* Moderate knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures and guidelines relevant to data analytics within clinical trials
* Solid understanding of quantitative methodologies, techniques and tools
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast paced environment
* Ability to work in a team environment, including inter-departmental teams and representing the organization on specific projects

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $74,000 to $104,000(highly experienced).

The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website.

description:
Join the IPG Team!

Are you ready to elevate your career? At IPG, we are more than just a global leader in packaging and protective solutions—we are a community that values safety, people, passion, integrity, performance, and teamwork. From tapes and films to packaging and protective products, as well as engineered coated materials and advanced packaging machinery, we develop innovative solutions that protect the world. Now, we are expanding our global team and looking for talented individuals like you!

Position Description

**Title:** Sr. Sales Strategy Analyst

**Department:** Sales

**Immediate Supervisor:** Dir, Business Perf & Sales Ops

**Status:** Exempt Salaried

**Position Purpose:** This role supports the Sales organization by transforming data into actionable insights that enhance commercial execution, CRM utilization, and strategic decision-making. This role is critical in developing consistent reporting, monitoring sales performance, and ensuring data accuracy across systems. Working cross-functionally with Finance, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Sales Leadership, the Analyst helps standardize processes, strengthen forecasting accuracy, and drive a culture of data-informed accountability.

Principle Accountabilities

1. CRM Reporting & Data Integrity

a. Develop and maintain CRM dashboards and performance reports for sales leadership and management

b. Monitor data accuracy, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and partner with the CRM admin to improve data quality and compliance with governance standards

c. Serve as a secondary system resource, capable of performing light admin tasks when needed

2. Sales Forecast & Business Analysis

a. Support monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles through data collection, pipeline validation, and variance analysis

b. Analyze sales performance by segment, region, or account to identify trends and opportunities

c. Contribute to financial modeling and performance projections that inform strategic decisions

3. Reporting & Performance Metrics

a. Build and maintain Power BI and Excel-based dashboards to measure KPIs across sales, pricing, and customer engagement

b. Deliver recurring and ad hoc reports to support leadership visibility and strategic reviews

c. Support quarterly business (QBR) preparation through data visualization and insight summaries

4. Process & System Optimization

a. Document and refine CRM-related workflows to enhance efficiency and consistency

b. Identify process bottlenecks or data gaps, proposing solutions to improve sales operations effectiveness

c. Collaborate on change management and training initiatives to drive system adoption and performance visibility

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

a. Partner with Finance, Product Management, and Supply Chain to ensure data alignment across business functions

b. Support integrated business planning to ensure consistent reporting and shared metrics

c. Contribute to strategic initiatives that improve commercial performance and organizational alignment

d. Related tasks as requested by supervisor

Essential Skills and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics or related field.
* 2-4 years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, or performance reporting
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics preferred)
* Demonstrated ability to translate data into insights that drive business outcomes
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication abilities to collaborate across departments

Why Choose IPG?

At IPG, you will find more than just a job—you will find a place where your success is our success. We pride ourselves on a culture built around strong relationships, where every team member plays a crucial role in our growth. Whether it is through cross-department collaboration, continuous training, or sustainability-driven initiatives, we create an environment where you can thrive.

Our commitment to sustainability influences everything we do, from designing eco-friendly products to minimizing waste in our production processes. We are dedicated to building a greener future while providing safe, supportive workplaces for our people.

With over 40 years of industry expertise and a proven track record of growth and innovation, IPG offers a stable, secure environment where you can flourish!

We offer competitive pay, extensive benefits that support you and your family, and exciting career development opportunities. Whether you are looking to enhance your skills or advance your career, we offer ongoing training and the support you need to succeed. Think big, dream bigger, and make an impact with IPG.

You belong here. Join us today!

Position Description

Responsible for managing all affairs between company and suppliers/subcontractors for various types of subcontracts/Purchase Orders including both fixed price and cost reimbursement.

About the role We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters. we build the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

We deliver the power to win. Every day, our global team looks beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges. Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Responsibilities Include: j

* Responsible for managing all affairs relative to the position of Procurement Buyer. - Analysis of Oracle system material needs. - Solicitation and preparation of Request for Quotes (RFQ's), Requests for Proposals (RFP's), and Request for Information (RFI's). j
* Cost analysis of proposals. - Price analysis of quotes. - Proposal fact finding. - Negotiate proposals and offers to meet program and cost targets. - Purchase Order preparation, placement and continued administration/monitoring to assure subcontractor compliance. j
* Administer subcontracts/purchase orders, control costs and assure on-time delivery to support program requirements. - Buying which includes analysis of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) needs. - Serve as the focal point between the suppliers and functional departments/program offices - Manage Quality, Design, Payment issues with subcontractors.
* Coordinate "Source Selection" process. - Ensure compliance with applicable procurement laws and regulations. - Administration of purchase orders via communication & onsite program reviews. - Review and access all planning to assure subcontracts/purchase orders are placed within Vendor lead-time. - Other duties as assigned

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in a business area of study. Supply Chain Management preferred. - Ability to use Oracle system & associated computer systems. - Experience in cost and price analysis and write-ups. - Ability to negotiate. - Occasional domestic travel. - Possible International travel. - Strong communication (oral & written) and problem-solving skills. - Strong problem solving and program management skills. - Excellent business acumen. - Work in a team environment to meet team objectives and performance metrics. - Perform under pressure to meet deadlines, provide timely updates, and communicate status with all parties involved. - Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel & the Internet business applications are desired but are not mandated. - Strong understanding of procurement processes, systems and MRP. - Ability to multi-task and proper management of workday and buying deck.

Pay: $48.00 - $50.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Labor Management System (LMS) Analyst is responsible for supporting, configuring, analyzing, and optimizing the organization's Labor Management System across distribution center operations.

The LMS Analyst leverages labor data, engineered labor standards, operational KPIs, and workforce analytics to improve distribution center productivity, reduce labor costs, and enhance employee performance. The position serves as the primary functional expert for the Labor Management System and provides both business and technical support for warehouse labor processes. Engineered labor standards, productivity tracking, labor forecasting, and shift planning are core LMS capabilities.

### **Required Skills and Responsibilities:**

* ### **Experience supporting, configuring, and troubleshooting Blue Yonder (JDA) Labor Management Systems.**
* Advanced SQL development and troubleshooting experience with Oracle SQL Server.
* Hands-on experience with MOCA commands, queries, and Blue Yonder application architecture.
* Experience supporting interfaces using APIs, web services, XML, JSON, flat files, and messaging queues.
* Understanding of distribution center processes including picking, packing, putaway, replenishment, and cycle counting.
* Knowledge of engineered labor standards, productivity calculations, indirect/direct labor tracking, and incentive programs.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications on Windows Server and/or Red Hat Linux environments.
* Strong experience analyzing logs, resolving interface issues, monitoring batch jobs, and supporting critical business operations.
* Experience managing user access, role-based security, workforce assignments, and system configuration within enterprise applications.
* Support LMS upgrades, patches, testing activities and system enhancements.

### **Preferred Tools**

* Blue Yonder LMS, MOCA, Integrator
* Oracle SQL Developer, Toad, SSMS
* Linux/Unix Shell Scripting, PowerShell

### **Additional Knowledge & Skills: Expertise in warehouse operations and supply chain processes. Familiarity with SQL, reporting tools, and data analysis. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams. Experience with Agile or hybrid project methodologies preferred.**

**About MMS**

McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers.

Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private-label medical-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID-19 tests.

### **Education: Bachelor’s degree and equivalent experience.**

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson,

**Our Base Pay Range for this position**

$105,800 - $176,300

description:
**Logistics at full potential.**

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

1st Shift, Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm

We’re constantly looking for ways to improve, enhance and adapt in an ever-changing marketplace. As the Analyst, Logistics, you will be responsible for developing actionable analyses to improve the productivity and efficiency of our operations. If you’re ready to embrace a new challenge with a dynamic global company, we have an opportunity for you to grow with GXO.

**Pay, benefits and more.**

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

**What you’ll do on a typical day:**

* Prepare operational analyses of services, projects or general business functions
* Maintain databases; extract information and develop metrics and scorecards to measure and improve overall performance
* Research operations, including performance and productivity data, error rates and root causes; review reports to identify operational issues across departments
* Prepare related reports, graphs, charts, presentations and other documents to support analyses
* Utilize systems and software to develop and maintain reporting tools to support business decisions
* Perform supplier and location waste walks to generate cost-saving ideas for the pipeline

**What you need to succeed at GXO:**

At a minimum, you’ll need:

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Business, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent related work or military experience
* 1 year of experience in comprehensive supply chain or logistics
* Expertise in preparing, importing and manipulating information in spreadsheets, databases and presentations; converting raw data into usable formats
* Experience with Microsoft Office (Access); ability to extract system data from SAP and utilize Excel/Access to develop reports
* Experience supporting Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), order management applications and database systems
* Advanced Excel skills, including the ability to perform macros

It’d be great if you also have:

* Experience with SAP
* Solid data mining and development skills; ability to perform statistical analysis and create queries
* Ability to create solutions-based reports to improve operational efficiency and increase customer satisfaction
* Fundamental comprehension of warehouse operations and the supply chain structure
* Solid verbal and written communication, organizational and time management skills

Senior Semantic Data Engineer

**Company:**

Prologis

**A day in the life**

Prologis is transforming how work gets done by bringing trusted data, automation, and AI into the core of its operations. As a Senior Semantic Data Engineer on the Data Solutions team, you will help create a shared enterprise understanding of business concepts, relationships, rules, and measures so people, applications, processes, and AI can interpret and use data consistently. This multidisciplinary role combines senior data engineering, business analysis, semantic modeling, AI evaluation, and enablement, with close partnership across business leaders, domain experts, and technical teams. You will carry solutions from discovery through production, helping Prologis improve decision confidence, accelerate solution delivery, and scale automation and AI without recreating business logic for each use case.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Design and deliver trusted, reusable Snowflake data products for business domains, translating source data into certified dimensional structures, reusable views, and data contracts while resolving identity and modeling historical change.
* Build and maintain the semantic layer by defining shared business concepts, terminology, relationships, rules, and measures that support consistent use of enterprise data across analytics, applications, business processes, automation, and AI.
* Implement semantic data products using Snowflake Cortex semantic views and analytical Cortex Agents, applying approved AI capabilities to improve delivery speed, quality, and consistency while remaining accountable for outputs.
* Validate semantic data products for business accuracy, data quality, usability, performance, security, and production readiness.
* Develop and maintain representative business questions, verified queries, expected results, and regression tests; investigate inaccurate or inconsistent AI-generated answers and improve the underlying data, semantic model, instructions, or examples.
* Capture definitions, mappings, ownership, lineage, and user guidance in version-controlled, machine-readable formats and publish this content to the enterprise data catalog through automated processes.
* Lead complex semantic-modeling initiatives from business and source discovery through technical design, implementation, production deployment, and continuous improvement, partnering with business owners and domain experts across business functions, processes, systems, and regional variations.

**Building blocks for success**

**Required:**

* Five or more years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, analytics engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience designing conceptual, logical, physical, and dimensional data models and translating business concepts into production data products, including grain, relationships, metrics, identity, and historical change.
* Advanced SQL skills.
* Experience designing and delivering production data products in Snowflake.
* Experience with semantic layers, reusable metric definitions, and business metadata that support natural-language data access, enterprise search, copilots, or AI agents.
* Experience managing technical assets through source control, code review, automated testing, deployment, and change-management practices.
* Practical experience using approved AI tools in analysis, engineering, documentation, testing, or problem-solving, with disciplined validation of AI-generated outputs.
* Communication and facilitation skills demonstrated through work with business stakeholders, translation between business and technical teams, ambiguity resolution, influence without direct authority, and leadership across collaborating teams.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience creating evaluation datasets, verified query libraries, or validation frameworks for analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or AI solutions.
* Experience with enterprise data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, and data-quality platforms.

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Specialist Production Planner**

**What you will do**

The Specialist Production Planner serves as a key member of the Supply Chain organization responsible for translating business demand into executable manufacturing plans while ensuring effective day-to-day execution within planning and manufacturing systems. This role combines production planning, manufacturing execution support, and data analytics to ensure production plans are accurately translated into SAP and other planning systems and effectively executed across Manufacturing. The position partners closely with Manufacturing, Finite Scheduling, Quality, Procurement, Warehouse, and Global Supply Chain to identify and resolve execution risks, maintain planning and master data integrity, and support supply continuity. The individual will leverage strong analytical and digital capabilities to develop reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and automation that improve planning visibility and decision-making, while supporting the continued digital transformation of Production Planning, including SAP S/4HANA and digital planning capabilities.

**Responsibilities:**

**Production Planning & Scenario Analysis**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain executable production plans for commercial and/or pipeline manufacturing platforms within SAP, RapidResponse, and other planning systems.

* Support production planning activities including campaign sequencing, capacity utilization, inventory requirements, changeovers, and supply commitments.

* Evaluate planning scenarios and provide data-driven recommendations balancing manufacturing capacity, inventory, customer demand, operational constraints, and business priorities.

* Support Monthly Planning Cycle (MPC), Long Range Strategy (LRS), Annual Operating Plan (AOP), and ad hoc scenario-planning activities.

* Identify production and supply risks and partner cross-functionally to develop mitigation strategies.

**Manufacturing Execution & SAP**
---------------------------------

* Translate approved production plans and finite schedules into accurate execution within SAP.

* Create, release, monitor, maintain, and close production/process orders in alignment with approved manufacturing schedules and execution priorities.

* Serve as a key point of coordination between Production Planning, Manufacturing, and Finite Scheduling to ensure plans are executable and accurately represented within planning and execution systems.

* Monitor production order status, confirmations, material consumption, inventory movements, and other execution data to proactively identify discrepancies and execution risks.

* Support short-term production schedule changes by ensuring SAP transactions, orders, and planning systems accurately reflect operational requirements.

* Support planning-related Master Data accuracy and partner with appropriate functions to resolve BOM, recipe, material, and system-data issues.

* Support planning and execution activities associated with SAP S/4HANA implementation and future system/process changes.

**Data Analytics, KPIs & Digital Enablement**
---------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain production planning and manufacturing execution KPIs, dashboards, and analytical tools that improve visibility and decision-making.

* Leverage advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities to analyze complex datasets, develop analytical tools, automate recurring activities, identify trends, and translate data into actionable insights.

* Utilize tools such as Power BI, Smartsheet, SAP analytics, and other digital platforms to improve reporting and visualization.

* Identify opportunities to automate transactional and reporting activities, reducing manual effort

The **Inventory Control Specialist II** operates within the Operations organization through the Operations Optimization department, reporting through Plant Logistics and Maintenance to the Inventory Control Supervisor.

+ Ensure inventory levels, bin locations, and material tracking are correctly maintained in SAP MM
+ Support accurate recordkeeping and reconciliation of all inventory levels across assigned sites
* **Inventory Optimization & Analysis**
+ Analyze product usage trends and adjust MRP settings (with Operations approval) to optimize stock levels
+ Proactively monitor and maintain inventory thresholds to ensure material availability
+ Track serialized components and ensure compliance with applicable standards
+ Provide inventory forecasting insights and recommend improvements to stocking strategies

+ Support multiple sites independently with minimal supervision
+ Perform quarterly inventory counts and maintain high accuracy levels
+ Conduct monthly site visits, inspections, and operational observations
+ Stay current on required parts, materials, and maintenance strategies for assigned sites
+ Act as the liaison between OEMs, vendors, and site operations
* **Procurement & Vendor Coordination**
+ Review vendor quotes, specifications, and technical cut sheets in coordination with Engineering and Procurement
+ Manage open supplier orders, track delivery timelines, and communicate risks to stakeholders (risk reporting)
+ Identify and evaluate alternative parts or solutions when applicable
+ Assist with resolving invoicing discrepancies and supplier issues
* **Warranty & Lifecycle Management**
+ Manage and track warranty claims for applicable sites
+ Support Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) processes and material obsolescence planning
+ Coordinate with OEMs to resolve warranty-related issues and part replacements
* **Process Improvement & Leadership (ICS II Focus)**
+ Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to inventory workflows and procedures
+ Assist in developing and refining inventory control standards and best practices
+ Serve as a subject matter resource for SAP and inventory processes within the team
+ Support training and onboarding of junior Inventory Control Specialists
+ Lead or assist with special projects related to inventory optimization, logistics, or system improvements
* **Safety & Compliance**
+ Demonstrate a strong safety-first mindset and promote a culture of safety
+ Maintain organized, clean, and compliant warehouse environments
+ Ensure proper material handling, labeling, and storage practices

The Global Technical Marketing Specialist partners closely with Portfolio Management, R&D, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Technical Services, Field Application Scientists, Sales, and Regional Marketing teams to ensure technical messaging is scientifically accurate, consistent, commercially relevant, and appropriate for global markets.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Content Strategy and Execution

* Serve as the primary technical content lead for assigned product portfolios.
* Plan, create, review, maintain, and update technical content throughout the product lifecycle.
* Translate complex scientific, technical, application, and product performance data into clear, customer-relevant materials for internal and external audiences.
* Partner with Portfolio Management, Field Application Scientists, R&D, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Technical Services, Sales, and Regional Marketing to develop technically accurate and commercially effective content.
* Develop technical materials that support commercialization, customer adoption, product positioning, differentiation, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure technical messaging is consistent across products, applications, markets, and customer-facing channels.

Documentation Ownership and Scientific Integrity

* Own and maintain core technical documentation for assigned products, including product instructions, equipment manuals, technical bulletins, application guides, training materials, validation reports, customer case studies, and scientific white papers.
* Ensure assigned technical documentation meets established standards for accuracy, scientific integrity, consistency, usability, and quality.
* Verify that technical materials align with approved product claims, validation data, intended use, workflow requirements, and product limitations.
* Support document review, revision control, and harmonization across global markets and functions.
* Establish and maintain consistent standards for technical writing, formatting, and content quality.
* Collaborate with Regulatory, Quality, Scientific Affairs, and other applicable functions to support appropriate review and approval of technical materials.

Technical Enablement, Product Positioning, and Launches

* Partner with Portfolio Managers to ensure scientific evidence and technical content support portfolio strategy, product positioning, differentiation, pricing, and growth initiatives.
* Provide technical marketing support for product launches, commercialization activities, and launch readiness.
* Develop launch-related technical materials, including training presentations, workflow diagrams, performance summaries, frequently asked questions, application guides, and technical comparison materials.
* Support training for Sales, Technical Services, distributors, and regional marketing teams to strengthen product knowledge and messaging consistency.
* Equip customer-facing teams with credible technical information regarding product performance, workflow advantages, applications, and differentiation.
* Contribute technical expertise to launch planning, launch reviews, and post-launch optimization activities.

Competitive Analysis and Performance Benchmarking

* Support technical competitive analysis and product benchmarking against competitive products, reference methods, emerging technologies, and alternative workflows.
* Develop technical comparison tools, performance summaries, and evidence-based differentiation materials.
* Monitor competitor claims, product updates, workflows, and supporting technical content to identify potential market risks and opportunities.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to translate competitive and benchmarking information into positioning, training, and sales enablement materials.

Additional Technical Marketing Responsibilities

* Develop and support application notes, troubleshooting guides, webinar content, technical FAQs, objection-handling tools, and other customer education materials.
* Contribute to customer evidence generation, case study development, and scientific storytelling for campaigns and strategic initiatives.
* Represent Technical Marketing on cross-functional product development, portfolio planning, commercialization, and launch teams as required.
* Support technical onboarding and training for distributors and channel partners.

* The ability to lift 50 lbs

Position is FT/non-exempt/hourly; responsible for providing exemplary service to import customers regarding the timely clearance of cargo through the appropriate government agencies & providing logistic/transportation services for inland freight moves. Candidate will demonstrate superior attention to detail, time management skills & professional communication skills. D. J. Powers is an established freight forwarder and customs brokerage firm, headquartered in Savannah, GA since 1930. D. J. Powers is an international Third Party Logistics Provider offering a full range of Global Supply Chain services. D. J. Powers operates eight U.S. offices and four overseas offices in Rotterdam, Ningbo, Shanghai and Shenzhen.

The company's strength, and value to its customers, is based on commitment and dedication to its employees. DJP's corporate philosophy includes "account ownership" by employees at the shipment execution level. Employees are supported with continuing education and training, as well as with world-class systems and experienced corporate officers. * Works effectively under pressure and with imperfect information

* Proficient with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook)

**Location:** Pittsburgh, PA

**Reports to:** Founder & CEO

**Employment:** 0.6 FTE to start, scaling to full-time employment as financing closes

**Career path:** Clear track to Chief Operating Officer
