* Associates Degree in Engineering OR
* Associates Degree in Project Management OR
* Associates Degree in Finance OR
* Associates Degree in Business AND
* 2 years minimum required related experience
* In Lieu of Degree, High School / GED AND 5 years minimum required related experience

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Software such as EcoSys, PowerPlan, Peoplesoft, Maximo, MS Project/MS Office Suite, Primavera, Business Objects.
* Experience with EcoSys preferred
* Risk management tools – SWORD / Monte Carlo analysis
* Budgeting and cost forecasting experience with Electric Transmission projects preferred
* schedule information for projects
* Demonstrated know

**Important Application Submission Information**

In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Friday, October 23, 2026

**More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

Senior PM position opened to backfill recent vacancy and support the expanding portfolio within PMC's Gas Development organization. Work is underway on development of various natural gas combined-cycle and simple-cycle facilities, an LNG storage evaluation and other existing facility modifications. Duke’s Integrated Resource Planning team continues to identify the need for new generation in all jurisdictions and additional sites must be evaluated and prepared for development. Development process covers everything from permitting, regulatory approvals, scope and pricing development and approvals, stakeholder engagement/coordination, bidding and selecting major equipment and contractors, and preparing the project for success as it transitions into the commit phase for execution. Depending on various factors, the development project manager may continue with the development team working on future sites or transition with a project into execution. The Gas Development team is also evaluating potential upfit and modifications to existing facilities, as well as other miscellaneous projects that may require similar development support and execution oversight.

Senior Project Manager (Sr PM) position has single point accountability or can be under general direction of a Sr. Project Director or Project Director. Sr PM position is responsible for management, or assisting management, of all phases of project planning and execution to ensure project success factors are met. These include but are not limited to scope, schedule, cost, quality, environmental, safety, communications, security, and integration. In addition, this position is highly involved in the funding management and budgeting for the project. This position may have direct reports consisting of Project Managers and Project Controls and/or other resources such as construction management, engineering, administrative support staff and contingent workers.

This position is typically assigned a portfolio of “Green” or “Brown” ranked projects per the Project Management Center of Excellence Risk-Informed Ranking Process. Higher ranked projects with greater risk may also be assigned when accompanied with an Enhanced Support and Oversight Plan (ESOP). The position is accountable for a portfolio of assigned projects with Moderate to High levels of risk and typically involve complex but mature technology and moderate complexity. Sr PM’s are accountable to various stakeholders that include facility and department level personnel in addition to Senior Management, and possibly the Board of Directors and External Agencies. Sr PM’s may be assigned to projects with specific risk-informed requirements based on specific experience and skill sets. Sr PM’s serve as unifying agent providing leadership, decision making, management, guidance, direction, coordination, and control of overall projects in accordance with established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements of the Company. This is a leadership position, and minimum qualifications must be met to be placed within this position. Progression to this level is based on experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, and restricted based on Business Unit needs to manage the portfolio.

**Responsibilities**

* **Create / Staff / Lead Project Team.** Sr PM's provide leadership, oversight, direction, management, delegation, and coordination with various internal and external organizations that are providing services to the project (Development, Engineering, Project Controls, Estimating, Construction Management, Supply Chain, Legal, EHS, QA/QC, Operations, Communications, Stakeholder Engagement, Regulatory, Security, Fuels, Transmission, etc.). Sr PMs manage matrixed members of the team daily. They interface with functional leaders of matrixed team members regarding placement, development and conflict resolution.
* **Establish and maintain communications among all project stakeholders**. Structure, lead, or assist in project related meetings to ensure open communication between team members, key stakeholders, and management. Prepare, communicate or report monthly project status, kickoff meetings, weekly and monthly required communication. Assure Project Plans, appropriate reporting means are developed and communicated according to PMCoE Standards and Business Unit implement

description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

**Ford Energy** is a newly formed, wholly-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). Ford Energy is uniquely positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable, US-built energy storage systems. We are not just building batteries; we are building the infrastructure for the next generation of the American grid.

Why Ford Energy?

At Ford Energy, you have the backing of an industrial manufacturing powerhouse with the agility of a dedicated energy startup offering industry leading technology. We offer a competitive compensation package including performance-based bonuses, Ford vehicle discounts, and the opportunity to shape the energy strategy of one of the world's most iconic brands. Learn more at https://fordenergy.com.

In this position...

Ford Energy is seeking a Technical Specialist to lead the technical integration of next-generation battery chemistry into Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

This role is responsible for translating BESS-level performance, life, safety, reliability, operational, and cost objectives into battery cell and battery subsystem requirements while leading the technical evaluation, selection, validation, and integration of next-generation battery technologies. The position serves as the primary technical bridge between cell suppliers and Ford Energy's battery, system, controls, and product engineering organizations.

The Technical Specialist will work closely with Cell Engineering, Module and Rack Engineering, Container Engineering, Battery Modeling, BMS, EMS, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), Electrical Systems, Validation, Safety, and Supplier Engineering teams to ensure successful integration of next-generation battery technologies into commercially viable energy storage products.

This role will also help shape Ford Energy's battery technology roadmap by assessing emerging next-generation battery technologies, identifying strategic opportunities and technical risks, and guiding future technology adoption decisions.

What you'll do...

* Lead Next-Generation Battery Technology Integration
* Serve as Ford Energy's technical subject matter expert for next-generation battery chemistry.
* Translate BESS application requirements into cell and battery subsystem technical requirements.
* Define cell-level targets for:
+ Energy capability
+ Power capability
+ Efficiency
+ Operating temperature range
+ Cycle life
+ Calendar life
+ Safety and reliability
+ Cost and total cost of ownership
* Establish operating windows, performance requirements, and integration criteria supporting grid-scale and commercial energy storage applications.
* Evaluate and Select Battery Cell Technologies
* Lead technical evaluation of next-generation battery cell technologies and work with cell suppliers.
* Assess supplier capability, technology maturity, performance, degradation behavior, safety, manufacturability, scalability, quality, and supply chain readiness.
* Support RFQ/RFI activities, supplier technical reviews, and sourcing decisions.
* Develop technical requirements, validation expectations, and success criteria for supplier programs.
* Lead Validation and Qualification Activities
* Define and execute cell characterization and validation strategies for next-generation battery technologies.
* Develop test plans covering:
+ Performance characterization
+ Rate capability
+ Efficiency
+ Thermal behavior
+ Cycle aging
+ Calendar aging
+ Safety and abuse testing
* Application-specific duty cycles
* Review supplier and laboratory data and provide technical assessments and recommendations.
* Establish qualification criteria supporting product release and supplier approval decisions.
* Drive Cross-Functional System Integration
* Work closely with:
+ Cell Engineering
+ Module and Rack Engineering
+ Container Engineering
+ Battery Modeling & CAE
+ BMS Engineering
+ EMS Engineering
+ Power Conversion Systems (PCS) Engineering
+ Electrical Systems Engineering
+ Validation and Safety Teams
+ Supplier Engineering
* Translate cell behavior, limitations, and degradation characteristics into module-, rack-, and container-level design requirements.
* Support development of operating limits, thermal requirements, control strategies, safety requirements, and life assumptions.
* Drive technical alignment across engineering organizations and suppliers to ensure successful product integration.
* Lead

=========================

**Thanks to our commitment to creating a supportive and engaged workplace culture, Gorilla Glue has been recognized as a top place to work for 16 years in a row. We offer competitive compensation packages, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and other perks and incentives to ensure our employees feel valued and supported.**


**Joining the Gorilla Glue family means being part of a team passionate about building strong brands and promoting a culture of excellence. As an employee, you'll be able to help create high-quality products and build brands that people love. Join us in an inspiring workplace where you can belong, grow, and make a difference!**


**Summary Description**
=======================

The Manager, Data Products & Governance leads the enterprise data product portfolio, the master data management program, and the data governance program that supports how data and artificial intelligence are used across the company. The role has three pillars, described below: data product management, master data management, and data governance and AI enablement. It also leads a team of three data governance and master data specialists, with responsibility for their priorities, development, and day-to-day execution.

Together these pillars set the standards, ownership model, and controls that make data trusted, well understood, and appropriately protected; keep master data accurate and consistent across the systems that depend on it; support the practical guardrails that let teams adopt AI capabilities safely and productively rather than informally and invisibly; and prioritize the data product work that turns standards into capabilities people actually use.

Beyond the team, the role leads through influence: holding governance forums, developing a federated network of data owners and stewards, and partnering across Information Technology, IT Security, Legal, Human Resources, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance to turn written policy into everyday practice. The division of responsibility between this role and the AI Center of Excellence is still being defined; this role brings the data expertise, standards, and controls that AI governance depends on, and partners with the COE on tool, model, and usage policy. Decisions to purchase third-party or syndicated data sets rest with the business functions that hold the business case and the budget. This role defines the standards those data sets must meet, evaluates fit and quality, and advises on selection; it does not decide what is bought.

**What will your day look like?**
=================================

**Pillar 1: Data Product Management**
-------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap for enterprise data products, aligned to business strategy and measurable value.
* Partner with business leaders and end users to understand the decisions, workflows, pain points, and opportunities that data products should support.
* Translate business needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear outcomes for data engineering, architecture, analytics, and application teams.
* Manage backlog prioritization and make tradeoff recommendations based on business impact, user value, risk, effort, dependencies, and data readiness.
* Guide data products through discovery, design, delivery, launch, adoption, enhancement, and retirement, including user validation and release readiness.
* Drive adoption through stakeholder communication, change planning, documentation, training coordination, and feedback loops.
* Identify opportunities to simplify fragmented reporting and data solutions, increase reuse, and reduce one-off or duplicative work.
* Partner with architecture and engineering to embed governance and product requirements into platform design, integration patterns, and semantic models rather than inspecting for them afterward.

**Pillar 2: Master Data Management**
------------------------------------

* Lead the master data management program across domains such as item, customer, and supplier, setting standards for record creation, enrichment, validation, and change so master data stays accurate and consistent across the ERP and the systems that consume it.

description:
The pay range per hour is $20.82 - $37.45. You may also earn additional compensation in the form of a shift differential, ranging from $2.00 to $3.50 per hour, based on eligibility.

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the right guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time.

A role in **Distribution and Receive Centers** means being on the very front lines of getting product to the guest as fast as possible—a critical differentiator and one of the most essential functions within Logistics. Whether it’s through focusing on regional or upstream distribution centers, target.com fulfillment centers, or import warehouses, you’ll have a chance to positively impact thousands of fellow team members and Target guests worldwide. There’s so much good work to be done, from Distribution Center Operations, where process and problem solving drive our results; Quality Management, which influences and maintains our good name in the retail marketplace, or overall Distribution Center Productivity, where we’re always analyzing and recalibrating how to best support our people, process and technology investments to support an ever evolving business

In support of Target’s Global Supply Chain and Logistics business, Human Resources is a critical partner in the ability to build the very best teams, and as HR we infuse our work with Target’s distinctive retail brand by continuously experimenting, evolving and innovating. With the chance to positively impact our teams in distribution centers across our Target network, you’ll be a strategic partner to both the leaders and the team members who elevate and nurture the Target experience. Our dynamic, passionate and responsive team comprises specialized people-professionals from several diverse disciplines. We operate behind the scenes to create a progressive culture of value, respect, reward and professional advancement.

As a **Senior Human Resource Specialist**, you enable the HR operating model by delivering consistent execution of HR processes, routines, and tools. You are a key partner and a reliable resource, helping ensure HR programs are delivered accurately, efficiently, and with a strong focus on the team member experience.

Through onboarding, workforce routines, and ensuring timely completion and accurate recordkeeping of required training, as well as day-to-day HR services, you provide guidance and operational support that helps leaders and team members navigate HR processes and organizational change. You apply established best practices and standard procedures to support staffing, retention, engagement, and compliance needs ultimately enabling teams to achieve business outcomes. You interact regularly with site leadership, HR partners, and cross-functional teams, and may engage with external candidates or vendors as part of staffing, onboarding, and HR process execution. You approach your work with a solutions-oriented mindset, delivering HR services with accuracy, consistency, and care for the team.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs*.*

**About you:**

* High school diploma or equivalent experience
* 1+ years of administrative experience

* Maintains positive and respectful attitude while working independently and in a team environment
* Proficient in word

description:
As an Infrastructure Support Specialist, you will deliver remote technical support and troubleshooting for customer hardware, peripherals, and network environments in automotive and retail operations. You will play a key role in diagnosing and resolving issues, supporting upgrades, and ensuring seamless operations across customer locations and hosted datacenter environments. We are seeking applicants with strong technical skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to communicate complex issues clearly.

**What you will be doing:**

* Provide high-quality remote technical support, focusing on customer service, technical expertise, and timely issue resolution.
* Troubleshoot, diagnose, and coordinate repairs for hardware, peripherals, and network connectivity across customer and hosted environments.
* Support and configure servers, PCs, scanners, printers, RF devices, POS equipment, and related peripherals.
* Perform software troubleshooting and repair activities related to supported hardware environments.
* Analyze and resolve connectivity failures across internal and external network routes, including ISP, VPN, firewall, routing, and endpoint communication.
* Communicate technical findings, routing paths, and root cause information clearly to customers in both business and technical terms.
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, telecommunications providers, datacenter teams, and internal support teams to resolve complex infrastructure and connectivity issues.
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, escalation details, and service actions accurately within support systems.
* Escalate unresolved problems within established service level expectations.
* Manage support requests in alignment with operational workflows, schedule adherence, and case activity expectations.
* Perform time-and-materials work, ensuring accurate documentation and billing for services not covered under support agreements.
Identify opportunities for additional support services, upgrades, or hardware-related consulting.

**What you will likely bring:**

* 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical or hardware support role, preferably in retail or technology environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for diagnosing complex hardware, software, and network issues.
* Experience supporting hardware environments, including servers, desktops, printers, scanners, RF devices, and POS systems.
* Working knowledge of Windows operating systems, Linux fundamentals, and basic client/server technologies.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, firewalls, remote access, ISP troubleshooting).
* Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and work across multiple time zones.

**What could set you apart:**

* Experience with Linux and POS or retail technology environments.
* Experience working within SLA-driven or ticket-based support environments.
Additional certifications or experience with advanced networking or security technologies.

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. **Job Designation**

* The Materials Manager oversees activities related to the purchase of materials, material control, inventory control, shipping/receiving and stores functions.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensures a steady flow of work is maintained through the manufacturing areas with proper routing, scheduling, dispatching and expediting of materials, including follow-up of work in process

* Identifies roadblocks and inefficiencies in business processes and make improvements to ensure requirements are met efficiently
* Maintain the lowest possible net inventories and assure economical make/buy decisions
* Ensures general safety, compliance with relevant legislation, regulations and company requirement
* Leads and directs work for team of employees as defined by business needs
* Manages staff selection, performance, development and training processes to ensure team competencies and capabilities to reach the business goals and expectations

* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance is required. May need to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and additional hours as necessary

**Job REQUIREMENTS**

* **Education requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in supply chain is preferred or operation management, business, or engineering. Advanced Degree such as Master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* **Years of experience:** min 5 years of professional experience in Purchasing and Planning roles

+ Ability to understand and follow specific instructions and procedures
+ Ability to research and analyze data effectively
+ Ability to gather data, to compile information, and prepare reports
+ Good/Strong/Excellence verbal and written communication skills
+ Presentation skills
+ Ability to influence stakeholders

+ Well-organized, detail-oriented, and ability to multi-task
+ Ability to work independently and prioritize duties with minimal supervision, in order to meet deadlines
+ Strong prioritization skills
+ Ability to visualize and plan objectives and goals strategically
+ Supervisory skills, including delegation, training and evaluating performance
+ Team building Skills
+ Conflict management skills
+ Decision making skills

**Fresh-Squeezed Legacy, Bold New Chapter**

Tropicana Brands Group is a $3B startup aiming to revolutionize the beverage category. Formed in 2022 as a joint venture between PAI Partners and PepsiCo, our portfolio includes iconic brands like Tropicana, Naked, KeVita, Izze, Copella, and Punica. With over 76 years of global leadership in the orange juice category, we’re committed to preserving this legacy while driving innovation in other areas. From reimagining orange juice to creating functional smoothies and driving afternoon refreshments, we are striving to become the undisputed global leader in fresh and chilled beverages.

The Supply Chain function is essential to Tropicana Brand Group’s success by enhancing operational efficiency, reducing costs, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality products. By improving warehouse operations, optimizing transportation routes, and refining inventory management practices, the team plays a critical role in streamlining processes. Collaborating with other departments to align strategies, the Supply Chain team ensures that Tropicana meets customer demands while maintaining a high standard of performance and cost-effectiveness. Through their efforts, they contribute to both short-term achievements and long-term growth.

**Your Next Pour: The Opportunity**

Tropicana Brands Group is looking for a highly qualified **Supply Chain Operations Manager** to join our team at our **Bradenton, Florida plant**. This role will be responsible for leading supply chain operations within the facility to ensure safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective execution of our manufacturing and distribution activities.

This individual will play a key role in driving operational excellence, continuous improvement, and supply chain performance while developing strong relationships across the organization. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can balance day-to-day operational execution with longer-term strategic planning in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Additional responsibilities include:**

* + Safety of our employees, OIR and LTCIR that is best in class for manufacturing plants

* + Drive overall supply chain capabilities by managing plant wide implementation of TWS (TPM), true efficiency, and team development. Forward progress on PM and AM goals as established in Chilled Strategic Plan, (Key is Planned Maintenance Activities and Zone Ownership )
+ Evaluate business unit capabilities, skills, and resource alignment to ensure performance against objectives. Lead realignment and work redesign efforts as necessary to provide executional excellence.
+ Lead the palletizing department in partnering with the warehouse to achieve safety, quality, productivity, and service goals while serving as an effective maintenance customer through clear communication, prioritized work requests, and coordinated planning
+ Continue positive progress on OHS results through building a team-based structure
+ Deliver Quality results that are best in all Chilled for Consumer and Manufacturing Complaints
+ Deliver Customer Service goals and Fill Rate targets
+ Responsible for Strategic Plan, Developing Budgets & CapEx

**The perfect Blend of Experience**

* + 5-7 years + experience as a people leader, preferably in a high-speed food and beverage industry
+ Ability to maintain world class Safety and Quality results
+ Strong Communication skills both written and verbal
+ Ability to develop and manage large budget
+ Strong knowledge of Chilled Beverage Supply Chain
+ Able to develop and implement Strategic Operation Plan that balances all objectives
+ Able to understand cross functional issues and lead a team that achieves defined goals
+ Working knowledge of quality systems, finance, capital planning, and project cost tracking and forecasting, economic justification analysis, statistical process control, and manufacturing management systems.
+ Actively coach Direct Reports and Team Members
+ Experience in implementing Continuous Improvement initiatives across multiple teams is preferred.
+ Strong innovative external focus with proven ability to affect sustainable change.
+ Must be very effective working in a volatile and complex environment and work with a sense of urgency that drives effective results
+ Strong influence management and communication skills, ability to gain organizational buy-in.
+ High levels of analytical and financial skills, ability to use data to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities and accurately assess financial impacts.
+ Ability to communicate and influence at all levels of an organization.
+ Ability to give and receive constructive feedback
+ Ability to lead a team-based approach to decision making
+ Demonstrated ability to work in a results-oriented, challenging environment
+ Strong leadership skills with the ability to get results through mentoring others

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, CAPITAL EQUIPMENT, WASTEWATER (STARLINK)**

At SpaceX we're leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink's utility for communities and businesses around the world.

This role will support the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of large-scale, state-of-the-art Ultrapure Water (UPW) and wastewater treatment plants that enable our high-volume manufacturing operations (including one of the largest PCB manufacturing lines in North America and major solar cell manufacturing facilities). You will work closely with the wastewater engineering team and construction/facilities stakeholders to drive capital equipment procurement and construction services for complex industrial water treatment systems, including Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) facilities.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Work directly with key internal stakeholders (wastewater engineering, construction, facilities, and operations) to develop and implement a comprehensive contract management process that ensures successful project execution for CAPEX and construction of wastewater and UPW systems
* Develop and execute equipment & services procurement strategies focused on wastewater treatment plants, ultrapure water systems, and associated construction projects
* Perform market analysis to determine should-costs and achieve the best purchasing deals for specialized equipment (e.g., membrane systems, RO, EDI/IX, evaporators, crystallizers, chemical systems, solids handling) and construction services
* Own end-to-end sourcing strategy and performance for major utility water systems, including:
* + Industrial water systems (raw water intake/treatment, process water, ultrapure/deionized water generation, cooling tower operations, and closed-loop hydronic systems)
+ Wastewater collection, treatment, and discharge (industrial wastewater, process effluent, deluge water treatment, stormwater management, and compliance with environmental permits)
* Define and implement long-term sourcing strategies to ensure reliable water supply, capacity, and cost-effective availability of raw water, process water, and treatment systems
* Create and negotiate contract documents in collaboration with the legal department for capital equipment, EPC contractors, and construction services
* Track and report projected and actual spend, assess budgetary risk, and provide clear budgetary analysis to enable timely management decision-making on multi-million dollar wastewater CAPEX projects
* Manage vendor and contractor relationships, ensuring clear communication, adherence to contracts, and resolution of performance or delivery issues
* Present value propositions to SpaceX management related to contract awards, cost reviews, cost reduction strategies, and critical supply issues for wastewater infrastructure
* Identify and execute cost reduction projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and providing project updates
* Perform advanced quantitative and business process analyses to identify financial impacts of decisions, cost improvement opportunities, and performance for assigned wastewater and construction categories
* Create and implement supplier management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage performance of, and monitor KPIs of the supply base supporting wastewater treatment and construction
* Lead and execute Requests for Proposals (RFPs) for capital equipment, construction packages, and specialized wastewater treatment systems
* Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories
* Develop and lead efforts to reduce the number of transactions while maintaining control and compliance

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; OR 9+ years of experience working in one or more of the following in lieu of a degree:
* + Purchasing/Procurement
+ Engineering (chemical, environmental, or mechanical)
+ Contract negotiation
+ Operations or supply chain management
+ Construction, facilities, or industrial plant management

description:
About the Role

The Procurement Manager is a strategic business partner responsible for developing and executing sourcing, supplier, and category strategies across a diverse portfolio of spend categories. This role requires a commercially minded individual who can balance governance, value creation, and speed of execution while supporting evolving business priorities.

The successful candidate will be highly adaptable, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in environments where priorities, requirements, and ways of working continue to evolve. They will use sound judgment to bring appropriate structure and discipline where needed, while maintaining a practical and flexible approach when partnering with stakeholders.

This role is responsible for leading procurement activities, supplier relationship management, and category strategy development across an assigned scope that includes marketing services, production-related support activities, travel and meetings services, menu printing, and other categories as business needs evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Category Management & Strategic Sourcing

* Independently manage procurement activities across assigned categories.
* Develop and execute category strategies that align with business objectives and deliver commercial value.
* Support ATL marketing execution through management of creative agencies and related marketing services providers.
* Support production planning and execution activities through supplier engagement, sourcing support, commercial evaluations, and risk management.
* Lead procurement activities across travel and meetings services, ensuring effective supplier governance and value delivery.
* Manage sourcing activities related to menu printing and other assigned categories.
* Identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes, supplier performance, operational effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Lead sourcing events, negotiations, contract discussions, renewals, and supplier selection activities as appropriate.
* Evaluate market dynamics, industry trends, supplier capabilities, and business requirements to inform decision-making.

Supplier Relationship Management

* Own supplier relationships and governance activities within assigned categories.
* Develop collaborative relationships with strategic and key suppliers to drive value, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor supplier performance expectations, service levels, and business outcomes.
* Lead supplier business reviews and performance discussions.
* Proactively identify and address supplier-related risks, issues, and opportunities.
* Partner with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve challenges and support business objectives.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels of the organization.
* Develop a strong understanding of business priorities and translate those needs into practical procurement solutions.
* Provide commercial guidance and procurement expertise to support informed business decisions.
* Balance stakeholder needs, governance requirements, risk considerations, and speed of execution.
* Influence decisions through strong communication, sound judgment, and data-driven recommendations.
* Act as a solutions-oriented partner who helps create clarity and direction in evolving business environments.

Continuous Improvement & Team Support

* Support broader Procurement initiatives at the local and global level.
* Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working and improve business processes where appropriate.
* Provide category, supplier, and market insights that support planning and decision-making.
* Collaborate with Procurement colleagues to leverage best practices, supplier insights, and category expertise.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and spend visibility activities in partnership with Finance and business stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 3+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, category management, supplier management, or a related commercial function.
* Demonstrated experience managing suppliers, commercial negotiations, and stakeholder relationships.
* Strong business acumen and commercial mindset.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and evolving environment.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and exercise sound judgment when requirements, priorities, or processes are still evolving.
* Demonstrated ability to create practical and scalable ways of working without relying on unnecessarily rigid processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and enterprise procurement systems.

Preferred

* Develop and implement procurement strategies for assigned indirect categories across North America.

**Supplier Relationship Management**

* Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers to improve performance, innovation, sustainability, and service delivery.
* Establish supplier performance scorecards and business review processes.
* Identify and develop alternative suppliers to improve competitive positioning and supply security.
* Drive supplier-led innovation opportunities that support business growth and operational excellence.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders and functional stakeholders.

Join us as a Supply Chain Planning Manager and lead a team that keeps our operations running smoothly. You'll develop strategies, optimize inventory and demand planning, and drive continuous improvement across the supply chain.

**What will you do?**

* Manage and develop a team responsible for daily supply chain planning operations and performance
* Create and execute supply chain strategies that align with business goals and maximize efficiency
* Analyze demand and inventory data to improve forecasting accuracy and resource utilization
* Partner with suppliers and cross-functional teams to enhance end-to-end supply chain effectiveness

**What are the key skills we are looking for?**

* **Change Management** — advanced level; leading teams through process improvements and operational transitions
* **People Management** — advanced level; coaching direct reports and conducting performance reviews to drive results
* **Strategic Thinking** — advanced level; aligning supply chain initiatives with broader business objectives
* **Demand Planning** — intermediate level; forecasting customer needs to optimize inventory and production schedules
* **Sales Inventory and Operations Planning** — intermediate level; coordinating cross-functional planning to balance supply and demand
* **Planning Tools** — intermediate level; leveraging systems to enhance forecasting and resource allocation
* **Inventory Management** — intermediate level; maintaining optimal stock levels to meet customer demand efficiently
* **Supplier Portal Tool** — intermediate level; managing supplier relationships and performance through digital platforms

* Proven leadership ability to inspire, coach, and develop high-performing teams

description:
At Insmed, every moment and every patient counts — and so does every person who joins in. As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition as *Science* magazine’s No. 1 Top Employer for five consecutive years, certification as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., and a place on *The Sunday Times* Best Places to Work list in the UK.

For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Clinical Supplier Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing supplier quality management activities supporting global clinical suppliers across development programs. You will serve as a key supplier quality partner to cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Bioanalytical, etc.) and external service providers to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and Insmed’s quality standards. You will administer the Supplier Management Program in partnership with DevQA, supporting supplier qualification, escalation management, quality data and performance trend monitoring, and quality agreement management for clinical suppliers supporting development programs.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to partner with DevQA to lead qualification, onboarding, risk assessment, and lifecycle management activities for clinical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and risk-based oversight principles, while assessing supplier capability, quality systems, and compliance against internal and external standards.

You’ll also:

* Collaborate and lead discussions with procurement, supply chain, DevQA and cross-functional SMEs to evaluate supplier performance history, support supplier selection, and execute qualification strategies for new and scope expansions of existing suppliers.
* Maintain and govern the approved supplier list and qualification records, ensuring appropriate risk-based controls are defined and applied throughout the supplier lifecycle in alignment with business and regulatory expectations.
* Maintain the supplier escalation programs to ensure that issues are getting elevated to the right levels at Insmed and within the Supplier’s organization to ensure we are addressing and solving issues effectively in a timely manner.
* Partner with DevQA to develop, manage, and continuously improve supplier performance monitoring frameworks for clinical suppliers in collaboration with the functional representatives, including KPIs, scorecards, and quality metrics, ensuring accurate risk-based scoring, timely completion, and appropriate control alignment.
* Support supplier quality event management and continuous improvement activities, including deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and development of supplier quality procedures, policies, templates, and governance frameworks.
* Analyze supplier quality data and performance trends, including deviations, CAPAs, audit findings, inspection outcomes, data integrity issues, and timeliness metrics, and facilitate, in collaboration with functional representative supplier governance forums and business reviews to drive remediation actions, corrective measures, and continuous improvement while maintaining accurate supplier records and approved supplier listings.
* Ensure supplier quality systems comply with global regulations, ICH guidelines, internal SOPs, and industry standards, while driving adherence to ALCOA+ data integrity principles and ICH Q9 risk management methodologies across outsourced activities.
* Provide support to inspection readiness activities for suppliers, and participating in Health Authority inspections (including FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and Health Canada).
* Support the audit program by conducting audits of suppliers and providing subject matter expertise through peer review, consultation on audit findings, and input on criticality assignment, ensuring that audit outputs remain objective, evidence based, and aligned with applicable regulatory standards.
* Own and manage the global clinical Quality Technical Agreement (QTA) program, including development, negotiation, execution, maintenance, periodic review, and renewal of Quality Agreements to ensure clear definition of GxP responsibilities, quality oversight, escalation pathways, data integrity expectations, inspection support obligations, and alignment with evolving regulatory and business requirements.

**Who You Are:**

You have a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Life Science or related discipline as well as a minimum of 12 years of direct experience supporting GCP regulated activities.

As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition as *Science* magazine’s No. 1 Top Employer for five consecutive years, certification as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., and a place on *The Sunday Times* Best Places to Work list in the UK.

For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Clinical Supplier Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing supplier quality management activities supporting global clinical suppliers across development programs. You will serve as a key supplier quality partner to cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Bioanalytical, etc.) and external service providers to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and Insmed’s quality standards. You will administer the Supplier Management Program in partnership with DevQA, supporting supplier qualification, escalation management, quality data and performance trend monitoring, and quality agreement management for clinical suppliers supporting development programs.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to partner with DevQA to lead qualification, onboarding, risk assessment, and lifecycle management activities for clinical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements and risk-based oversight principles, while assessing supplier capability, quality systems, and compliance against internal and external standards.

You’ll also:

  

* Collaborate and lead discussions with procurement, supply chain, DevQA and cross-functional SMEs to evaluate supplier performance history, support supplier selection, and execute qualification strategies for new and scope expansions of existing suppliers.
* Maintain and govern the approved supplier list and qualification records, ensuring appropriate risk-based controls are defined and applied throughout the supplier lifecycle in alignment with business and regulatory expectations.
* Maintain the supplier escalation programs to ensure that issues are getting elevated to the right levels at Insmed and within the Supplier’s organization to ensure we are addressing and solving issues effectively in a timely manner.
* Partner with DevQA to develop, manage, and continuously improve supplier performance monitoring frameworks for clinical suppliers in collaboration with the functional representatives, including KPIs, scorecards, and quality metrics, ensuring accurate risk-based scoring, timely completion, and appropriate control alignment.
* Support supplier quality event management and continuous improvement activities, including deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and development of supplier quality procedures, policies, templates, and governance frameworks.
* Analyze supplier quality data and performance trends, including deviations, CAPAs, audit findings, inspection outcomes, data integrity issues, and timeliness metrics, and facilitate, in collaboration with functional representative supplier governance forums and business reviews to drive remediation actions, corrective measures, and continuous improvement while maintaining accurate supplier records and approved supplier listings.
* Ensure supplier quality systems comply with global regulations, ICH guidelines, internal SOPs, and industry standards, while driving adherence to ALCOA+ data integrity principles and ICH Q9 risk management methodologies across outsourced activities.
* Provide support to inspection readiness activities for suppliers, and participating in Health Authority inspections (including FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and Health Canada).
* Support the audit program by conducting audits of suppliers and providing subject matter expertise through peer review, consultation on audit findings, and input on criticality assignment, ensuring that audit outputs remain objective, evidence based, and aligned with applicable regulatory standards.
* Own and manage the global clinical Quality Technical Agreement (QTA) program, including development, negotiation, execution, maintenance, periodic review, and renewal of Quality Agreements to ensure clear definition of GxP responsibilities, quality oversight, escalation pathways, data integrity expectations, inspection support obligations, and alignment with evolving regulatory and business requirements.

**Who You Are:**

You have a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Life Science or related discipline as well as a minimum of 12 years of direct experience supporting GCP regulated activities.

Introduction:

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT. Find out what **our people deliver.®** means when you come move the world with us!

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview:

The ***Terminal Manager*** is accountable for the P&L and operational oversight and management, leadership, and direction of the station to provide quality service, customer satisfaction and operational proficiency that ensures growth and profitability goals/objectives are met.

The ***Terminal Manager*** is responsible for implementation and compliance with company policies and procedures, quality standards, and other applicable regulatory guidelines, with respect to operational, administrative, customer service, marketing, and sales functions for the site. This position will develop and grow business in their dedicated region and will conduct business development activities.

Responsibilities:

* Lead, direct, and manage all station functions to ensure that all departments and staff execute service agreements.
* Overall profitability and service performance of the Station, with specific responsibility over customer service and operations for the Domestic, International, and Local Cartage product lines.
* Review, revise, and approve all customer and station operational SOP’s with the objective of improving quality and efficiencies, while decreasing costs in the day-to-day operation of Station.
* Review, revise, and approve all customer tariffs and requests for quote to ensure maximum profitability for the station while providing exceptional service for the customer.
* Manage Station customer service and operational personnel. Mentoring of staff, conduct regular performance reviews and general overall personnel development.
* Responsibility for recruitment, retention, and development of station customer service and operational staff.
* Service all existing customers, while marketing AIT’s full range of transportation services to new customers. Meet company service metric expectations.
* Utilize superior communication skills to motivate staff and develop effective working relationships with peers, executives, and clients. Ensure directives, rules, and procedures are communicated to all station personnel.
* Implement and direct quality control program for all operational areas while constantly striving for cost efficiencies and while providing best of class service for our customers.
* Ensure timely and accurate billing and posting of all transactions on a daily basis.
* Responsible for all relevant Station profits / losses.
* Support positive trending and obtainment of QMS (Quality Management System) objective goals.
* Encourage a growth mindset within the operational and customer service staff.
* Other duties and responsibilities will be assigned as business demands deem necessary.

Qualifications:

* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture

**Other Skills We Hope to See:**

* Bachelor's Degree strongly preferred / High School Diploma with equivalent combination of work experience may be considered.
* Minimum five (5) years industry experience required – logistics environment with International and Domestic experience.
* Minimum three (3) years supervisory or managerial experience required.
* Proven experience managing a full P & L, strongly preferred.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel).
* Able to perform all aspects of Domestic and International Operations including: customer service, dispatch, cargo and etc.
* Ability to organize and perform multiple assignments in a high-volume, fast-work environment.
* Ability to interact, communicate and maintain relationships with clients, vendors, customers in all levels of management.
* Proven ability to lead and manage the activities of a diverse workforce.
* Skilled problem solver

Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

The leader is accountable for building a best-in-class procurement operations model by leveraging SAP and Coupa ecosystems, advanced analytics, and process optimization to improve efficiency, decision-making, and business impact. The role also supports integration activities during mergers and acquisitions and acts as a subject matter expert for Procure-to-Pay processes, ensuring strong alignment between business operations and enterprise systems.

description:
**Drive the supply chain behind the world’s most advanced robots.**

At Boston Dynamics, we’re redefining what robots can do—and our supply chain is a critical enabler of that innovation. We are seeking a **Supply Chain Program Manager** to lead and drive end-to-end supply chain execution for new product introductions (NPI) and major program changes across our advanced robotics platforms.

Reporting to the **Director, Global Supply Chain** , this role serves as the central operational bridge between Engineering, Product Management, Global Supply Managers (GSMs), and suppliers. You will ensure that next-generation hardware platforms are launched on time, within budget, and built for scalable manufacturing.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Program & Sourcing Leadership:** Drive end-to-end supply chain readiness and NPI sourcing execution for key robotics programs from early development through production scale.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Operations to align supply chain capabilities with program milestones and product architecture.
* **GSM & Supplier Integration:** Work alongside Global Supply Managers (GSMs) to coordinate early supplier engagement, component selection, contract execution, and supplier readiness.
* **Risk & Schedule Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate supply chain risks—including lead time delays, technical readiness, capacity bottlenecks, and geopolitical factors—before they impact program schedules.
* **Cost Target Ownership:** Partner with GSMs and Product Cost Management (PCM) teams to manage BOM cost targets, review cost estimation models, and track total cost of ownership (TCO) across program lifecycles.
* **Design for Supply Chain:** Participate in engineering design reviews to provide guidance on supplier capabilities, component availability, manufacturability, and cost constraints.
* **Process Excellence:** Build, standardize, and refine NPI sourcing playbooks, program tracking templates, and milestone readiness frameworks across the supply chain org.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

You will serve as the connective tissue between cutting-edge engineering concepts and physical production execution. By ensuring program readiness for complex robotic systems, your leadership directly enables Boston Dynamics to move revolutionary hardware from R&D into commercial, logistics, and industrial deployment at scale.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Strong background in supply chain program management, NPI sourcing, or operations program management within hardware development.
* Experience operating in fast-paced environments with high-complexity, low-to-medium volume, or customized electromechanical/robotics platforms.
* Proven capability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage complex project schedules, and influence stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Deep familiarity with NPI product development lifecycles, BOM cost tracking, supplier readiness reviews, and risk mitigation strategies.
Exceptional organizational, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities independently.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain program management focused on new product development.
* Demonstrated success in manufacturing, hardware, or complex electromechanical engineering environments.
Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or modern project management methodologies preferred.

Aro Homes is a thriving, purpose-driven company on a mission to redefine residential construction. Aro Homes was founded to create well-designed, precision-engineered homes that are beautiful, livable, and durable, while being built multiple times faster and having a positive impact on the environment.

We are a diverse and experienced group of passionate and curious designers, builders, engineers, product developers, and businesspeople who are passionate about and committed to delivering on our mission. We've demonstrated that there is a massive opportunity to reduce waste and improve sustainability while building homes in a fraction of the time it traditionally takes. We utilize a repeatable, multi-disciplinary, and product-driven approach that is unique in the industry. We are funded by world-class investors who care about transforming industries for the better, including Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors. If you share the desire to leave a lasting positive impact on the world and to join a strong culture of intelligent, passionate people, then let's start a conversation.

**What you will be responsible for**

Aro Homes is seeking a Procurement Materials Manager who is a dynamic leader with a robust understanding of systems and procedures to support our procurement function. This role will be responsible for executing all Procurement activities at Aro Homes and building lasting, mutually beneficial partnerships with our external partners.

As part of our Procurement department, you will report to the Global Supply Chain Manager and will be responsible for executing the supply/demand planning and the accurate replenishment of mission-critical materials and services across all orgs - from procurement to customer success and everyone in between - in order to ensure seamless company-wide communication and top-notch performance as we scale nationwide.

In this important role, you will be the cross-functional partner supporting a broad range of critical business processes. You’ll lead an inventory replenishment roadmap focused on making us more efficient and effective in achieving current objectives and preparing for future initiatives. A successful candidate will be highly organized, technically nimble, and obsessed with automation and the customer experience.

**What You'll Do:**

* Develops appropriate supply chain strategies to maximize value.
* Forecast material requirements and optimize inventory management to prevent stockouts or overstock.
* Identifies opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and value engineering in the procurement process.
* Manage inventory levels, oversee reordering processes, and coordinate material delivery schedules with suppliers to meet project requirements.
* Build an open and trusting relationship with our external partners.
* Communicate regularly with stakeholders about procurement status, potential delays, or changes in material supply.
* Ensure that all procured materials meet project specifications, quality standards, and compliance regulations.
* Identifies and mitigates risks associated with material shortages, price fluctuations, and supplier reliability. Develop contingency plans to address potential disruptions in the supply chain.
* Work closely with quality control, inventory management, and design teams to address any material defects, discrepancies, or issues.
* Works cross-functionally with the Plant, Design, and Site Operations Teams on all inventory-related inquiries.
* Generate regular procurement reports on material costs, supplier performance, and inventory metrics for management review.
* Member of the operations staff, responsible for routinely reporting on department KPIs, including appropriate analysis and countermeasures as needed.
* Supports the implementation and proper utilization of the ERP system (NetSuite).

**What You'll Bring:**

* 3+ years’ experience in Procurement
* Innovative thinker willing to take smart risks and try new approaches,
* Strong analytical capabilities,
* Entrepreneurial experience
* Thinking outside the box, non-traditional
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills,
* Able to build motivated, capable, and engaged teams,
* Bias for action.

**What we offer:**

* Opportunity to join an outstanding early-stage team and grow a purpose-driven company from the ground up.
* Competitive salary package.
* Medical/dental/vision benefits.
* Equity in the company.
* Flexible Time Off.

Description:

**Be part of the operations team for our first US aircraft assembly line for Pilatus.**

Pilatus is hiring a Director Supply Chain to join our team in Sarasota, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and optimizing all end-to-end supply chain activities within an aircraft production environment. This includes strategic and operational oversight of procurement, logistics, warehouse operations, and material planning. This role ensures material availability, supplier performance, compliance with aviation standards, and efficient flow of components to support production schedules, cost targets, and quality requirements. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd!

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

Procurement & Supplier Management

* Develops and executes sourcing strategies for aircraft components and services
* Manages supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, and performance (delivery, quality, cost)
* Ensures compliance with corporate procurement standards and aviation regulations
* Mitigates supply risks through dual sourcing and supplier development

Logistics & Warehousing

* Oversees inbound/outbound logistics, international shipments, and customs compliance
* Manages warehouse operations (receiving, storage, kitting, material flow)
* Optimizes inventory accuracy, storage, and material handling processes

Material Planning & Production Support

* Ensures material availability in line with production schedules
* Balances inventory levels, lead times, and cost efficiency
* Collaborates cross-functionally with Production, Engineering, and Quality

Leadership & Performance Management

* Leads and develops the supply chain team
* Drives KPI-based performance and continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensures strong cross-functional alignment across the organization
* Ensures compliance with the guidelines and standards defined by the HQ Supply Chain Corporate functions

**Other Duties/Responsibilities**

* Defines and drives overall supply chain strategy and ramp-up readiness
* Leads supplier development and escalation management
* Ensures effective use of ERP systems and standardized processes
* Manages supply chain risks and compliance
* Drives cost control, budgeting, and performance reporting

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s or certifications like APICS/CIPS preferred)
* 7+ years of supply chain experience, ideally in aerospace or high-tech manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and end-to-end supply chain processes
* Proven leadership experience across procurement, logistics, and warehousing
* Familiar with aviation regulations, export controls, and global supply chains
* Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Analytical, data-driven, and able to perform in a fast-paced environment
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

**What We Offer:**

* Unique opportunity to be part of Pilatus’ first US PC-12 assembly line
* International training assignment, cultural exchange, language training at Pilatus headquarters in Stans, Switzerland (approx. 3 - 6 months)
* Long-term career growth opportunities
* 11 paid holidays a year, plus 15 days of paid vacation time, and 6 days of paid sick/personal time to start with an increase to 20 days of paid vacation time after 5 years with Pilatus
* 90% of medical, dental, and vision premiums paid for single coverage and 80% for family coverage, averaging $9,600 annually
* Monthly health savings account (HSA) contributions totaling $2,250 for single coverage and $3,000 for family coverage annually
* 401(k) retirement plan matching up to 6%
* Life and long-term disability insurance premiums paid in full

The hiring range is $120,000 - $156,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. Any bonus, incentive compensation, benefits, or other forms of compensation are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans, programs, and policies and may be modified in accordance with applicable law.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their application as soon as possible. Please note that this announcement may close at any time; early applications are encouraged.

* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, safety, inventory-control and traceability requirements throughout logistics operations.
* Analyze logistics master data and transactional data, develop meaningful KPIs, and prepare reports and briefings for management.
* Coordinate daily workload, staffing priorities and operational activities within the logistics area, and support employee onboarding, coaching and performance feedback.

* Maintain logistics master data, process documentation and SAP transactions accurately and in a timely manner.
* Support inventory counts, discrepancy resolution, missing-material meetings and corrective actions.
* Work with a high level of ownership, urgency and flexibility, particularly during assembly-line startup and ramp-up.
* Perform other duties and support cross-functional projects as assigned.

**A Place Where People Matter.**

Start your career journey with Univar Solutions! Here you can make an impact on the world around you and accelerate your career in areas that energize and excite you.

**Primary Purpose**

The **ChemCare District Supplier Manager** oversees supplier relationships, performance, and communication to support waste disposal operations. This role serves as the primary liaison between suppliers and internal teams, ensuring service excellence, cost management, regulatory compliance, and effective execution of supplier and supply chain optimization initiatives.

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage Supplier Relationships: Coordinate with suppliers to resolve service issues, billing discrepancies, cost inquiries, and operational concerns while communicating updates to internal stakeholders.

* Maintain Supplier Data: Manage supplier records, approvals, rate sheets, regulatory documentation, and system updates across SAP and SharePoint.

* Optimize Supply Chain: Lead supplier and disposal network optimization projects, including onboarding new TSDFs and implementing supply plan improvements.

* Support Strategic Projects: Assist with supplier transitions, facility moves, consolidations, and business integration activities.

* Analyze Performance: Track supplier performance, maintain KPIs and reporting, and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational improvements.

* Conduct Audits: Support low-risk supplier audits and periodic facility visits to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.

**What You'll Need:**

* 3+ years of SAP/ERP experience and reporting/analytics experience

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work cross-functionally

* Strong attention to detail and customer service mindset

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with all levels of the organization

* Willingness to travel up to 25% nationally

* Knowledge of RCRA, DOT, environmental services, or solid waste operations preferred

**Where You'll Work:**

* This is a hybrid-based role that will report out of our **Charlotte, NC** location

**Pay & Benefits:**

* The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate’s relevant experience, education, training, certifications, qualifications, and work location

* Available employee benefits include health, vision, dental coverage, along with industry-leading retirement and time off programs

**What You Can Expect:**

* Strong work/life flexibility

* To be surrounded by an inclusive team who is collaborative and committed to the achievement of the company

* To be rewarded for your contributions with a targeted annual company bonus (if applicable to your role) and annual salary reviews

* Competitive pay and benefits

Univar Solutions supports **sustainable solutions**for the world around us so that we can do our part to**help keep our communities healthy, fed, clean, and safe!**

**We are committed to a diverse workforce and a culture of inclusion.** Together, we are building a culture that acknowledges the unique experiences, perspectives and expertise of individuals and provides the development and growth opportunities to empower us to redefine our industry.

* Prior leadership experience with the ability to manage teams and coordinate cross-functional initiatives; supervisory experience preferred.
* Advanced SAP experience, including pricing configuration, master data management, workflows, and pricing-related tables.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, formulas, data analysis, and reporting.
* Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data management skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.

Job Description:

As a Sr. Buyer, you will be primarily accountable for overseeing the implementation of safety programs, manufacturing schedules, personnel, quality control, and production standards.

**What will you do?**

* Plan, manage, lead, and engage in daily production operations to achieve the key performance indicators (safety, on time delivery, quality, and productivity)
+ Promote and implement ergonomic principles, environmental responsibility and overall employee health and wellness
+ Provide world-class service to internal and external customers
+ Reports to Supply Chain Manager and directly leads a team of front-line supervisors with an indirect scope of hourly workforce across 3 shifts (Mon-Fri).
+ Lead efforts to attain internal certification goals, ISO requirements, and total customer satisfaction
+ Coach, mentor and develop all direct reports
+ Ensure compliance with all quality systems to achieve the required quality levels
+ Manage performance of assigned resources (material, methods, labor, machines)
+ Participate in the development of the Master Production Schedule
+ Champion Lean Manufacturing Initiatives (Schneider Performance System) to drive continuous improvement throughout the plant.
+ Be responsible for people management including goal setting, performance management, competency development, recognition, engagement, and well-being.
+ Define training goals according to competencies and targets
+ Lead change management in accordance with business and plant objectives
+ Promote collaboration, diversity and inclusion within the plant and the organization
+ Lead and coordinate the implementation of programs which support manufacturing strategies & goals

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering or related field is required
+ 5+ years of experience of management and leadership in a manufacturing environment
+ Ability to excel in fast paced, high performance environment
+ Previous experience with P&L responsibility
+ Solid understanding of OSHA guidelines and leading a strong safety culture
+ Experience in the application of Lean Manufacturing methodologies, certification a plus
+ Building a culture of responsiveness and continuous improvement
+ Ability to drive Employee Engagement through leadership, communication, and building the respect at all levels of the organization
+ ISO experience is a plus
+ Strong organizational and analytical skills, results driven, ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization
+ Flexible and available to work on off shifts
+ Excellent PC/Tablet and system knowledge, including the ability to analyze data within an MRP system, cloud based platforms (Tableau/AVEVA) and make effective assumptions to drive business results
+ Experience implementing or developing Smart Factory/Digital Factory initiatives
