**OTSL – Job Profile**

**Logistics Operations Manager**

**Forty Years Strong!** On-Target Supplies & Logistics, Ltd., is a regional supply chain logistics management firm with global customers and international responsibilities. For more than 40 years, we have worked with some of the largest companies in the world to design, implement, and manage customized logistics and transportation solutions that help them to gain a competitive advantage in today's global marketplace. We are committed to consistently delivering value-adding services, and we do this through our greatest asset: our employees.

**Hours:** Monday - Friday, 7 AM – 3:30 PM
**Pay:** $80,000 - $90,000 annually
**Health & Wellness:** Company-paid Life Insurance Policy and Employee Assistance Program; Medical, Dental, Vision; Supplemental Life Insurance; LTD/STD
**Retirement:** Company-sponsored 401K Retirement Plan with company match
**Other Benefits:** Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off
**Location:** Odessa, TX, On-site position
**Department:** Operations - Service Centers
**Reports To:** Executive Management

**OVERVIEW:**

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Logistics Operations Account Manager to lead high-performing teams and manage key customer relationships in the logistics industry. This role will oversee service delivery performance, ensure operational excellence, and drive customer satisfaction through strategic leadership and strong communication. The ideal candidate will possess robust knowledge of financial and operational logistics processes, excel in people management, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Supervise, mentor, and develop teams of logistics professional
* Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular reviews, and deliver ongoing coaching
* Drive accountability and foster a culture of safety, excellence, and continuous improvement
* Conduct interviews, coordinate onboarding and training, and ensure employee engagement

* Act as the primary point of contact for key customers, ensuring exceptional service and long-term partnership
* Quickly address and resolve customer concerns, offering proactive solutions
* Lead customer focused meetings and maintain open communication with customer and other stakeholders
* Identify and pursue growth opportunities within existing customer accounts

* Manage daily operations to ensure on-time deliveries, inventory control, and order accuracy using WMS and other reporting tools
* Monitor performance metrics such as inventory accuracy, quality, cost and safety

Build your career with Akralos

Akralos is where expertise meets opportunity. We’re a North American animal nutrition company built on the combined strengths of Alltech and ADM, two global leaders who’ve brought together their best people, proven products and shared commitment to excellence.

At Akralos, our team is at the heart of everything we do. From nutritionists and mill operators to sales professionals and support staff, every role contributes to our mission: partnering with customers to deliver results that matter. We serve livestock producers, equine owners and animal lovers across North America, providing the guidance, products and service they need to succeed — whether in the market or the show ring.

When you join Akralos, you’re joining a company that values your expertise and invests in your growth. With an extensive network of mills, leading-edge technology and R&D, and deep industry connections, we give you the tools to excel while building a career rooted in purpose and partnership.

Job Summary

To provide day-to-day leadership and management of production operations and supply chain activities for the facility. The Production Manager is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective production while maintaining product quality, customer service levels, inventory accuracy, and timely availability of raw materials and finished products.

The Production Manager will work closely with the Plant Manager, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Customer Service, Transportation, and other departments to ensure the facility meets production requirements and company objectives.

Key Responsibilities and Authority

1. Production Leadership

* Provide leadership and direction to production employees, ensuring policies, procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards are followed.
* Manage daily production activities to meet customer demand while maximizing labor, equipment, and plant efficiency.
* Develop and manage production schedules in coordination with customer requirements, inventory levels, raw material availability, and transportation needs.
* Monitor production performance, downtime, labor utilization, yields, and other key performance indicators.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency, reduce costs, minimize downtime, and improve overall plant performance.
* Ensure products are manufactured according to established formulas, specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.

2. Safety and Quality

* Serve as a safety leader and champion for the facility, ensuring World Class Safety standards are met.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate safety training and that safety procedures and policies are consistently followed.
* Identify safety concerns and work with the Plant Manager and appropriate departments to develop and implement corrective actions.
* Promote a strong safety culture and hold employees accountable for safe work practices.
* Support quality programs and ensure products meet company and customer quality standards.
* Assist in investigating and resolving customer complaints, non-conformances, and production-related quality issues.

3. Supply Chain Management

* Coordinate production requirements with raw material availability, inventory levels, customer demand, and transportation schedules.
* Monitor raw material and packaging inventories to ensure adequate supplies are available to support production.
* Work with Supply Chain and Purchasing to identify material needs and prevent production interruptions due to shortages.
* Assist with purchasing decisions and coordinate the timing of raw material deliveries based on production requirements and available storage capacity.
* Monitor inventory levels and support company inventory-turn and working-capital objectives.
* Help maintain accurate inventory records and investigate inventory variances.
* Coordinate finished-product inventory requirements to ensure products are available for customer orders and shipments.
* Work with Customer Service, Supply Chain, and Transportation to prioritize production and shipments based on customer needs.
* Assist with managing freight, transportation, and logistics issues that impact plant operations or customer service.
* Identify opportunities to improve supply chain efficiency, reduce freight costs, improve inventory utilization, and minimize obsolete or excess inventory.

4. Production Planning and Scheduling

* Manage the facility's daily and weekly production schedule in coordination with customer demand and supply chain requirements.
* Adjust production schedules as needed based on changing customer requirements, raw material availability, equipment downtime, staffing, and transportation needs.
* Ensure production priorities are clearly communicated to employees and supporting departments.
* Maintain appropriate finished-goods inventory levels while avoiding unnecessary production and excess inventory.

description:
Ecolab is seeking an **Associate Logistics Manager** to lead and coordinate material handling, shipping, receiving, warehousing, and inventory control activities at a site location. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient flow of materials and products through the facility while maintaining operational excellence, inventory accuracy, and compliance with company standards. You will work closely with plant leadership, supply chain partners, and cross-functional teams to optimize warehouse operations and support business objectives.

**What’s in it For You:**

* Opportunity to lead logistics and warehouse operations within a global organization committed to growth and innovation.
* Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with manufacturing, supply chain, customer service, and sales teams.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Career development opportunities within a world-class supply chain and logistics network.
* A culture focused on safety, sustainability, and operational excellence.

**What You Will Do:**

* Direct and coordinate material handling activities, including processing, packaging, storage, shipping, and receiving of supplies, materials, and equipment.
* Develop and manage schedules for shipping and receiving activities to optimize workflow, meet customer requirements, and effectively utilize warehouse space.
* Oversee warehouse operations, inventory control processes, and material management systems to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Monitor inventory levels and implement controls that support operational requirements and inventory integrity.
* Collaborate with plant operations, procurement, customer service, and transportation partners to ensure uninterrupted material flow.
* Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives focused on logistics performance, cost reduction, productivity, and service enhancement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Manage logistics activities for 80,000sqft divided across three local buildings.
* Track and analyze key performance indicators to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to logistics and warehouse personnel as applicable.
* Communicate regularly with management, local sales teams, and key stakeholders regarding operational performance and business needs.
* Support effective budget management and cost control efforts

**Position Details (Location & Work Schedule):**

* Location: Glenwood, IL
* M-F, 7am – 4pm
* May require occasional flexibility to support shipping, receiving, and operational demands.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Transportation, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
* 6 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, shipping, receiving, inventory control, manufacturing operations, or related supply chain functions.
* Experience working with inventory management systems and warehouse control processes.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Authorization to work in the country of employment without sponsorship now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience leading warehouse or logistics operations in a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of transportation, distribution, and supply chain best practices.
* Experience managing logistics budgets and operational performance metrics.
* Demonstrated success driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and supporting customer-focused operations.
* Proficiency with ERP, warehouse management, and inventory control systems. Preferably SAP
* Experience implementing new processes and procedures with associate training

**Annual or Hourly Compensation Range**

The base salary range for this position is $96,700.00 - $145,100.00. This position is eligible for annual bonus pay based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

**Benefits**

Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families.

*If you are viewing this posting on a site other than our Ecolab Career website, view our benefits at jobs.ecolab.com/working-here.*

**Potential Customer Requirements Notice**

To meet customer requirements and comply with local or state regulations, applicants for certain customer-facing roles may need to:

* Undergo additional background screens and/or drug/alcohol testing for customer credentialing.

Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense is dedicated to supporting those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager Supplier Quality Engineering leads the supplier quality engineering team to drive Supplier Performance improvement and foster a proactive, preventative culture of quality to ensure on-time delivery of quality parts. This role establishes, develops, and maintains strong partnerships with Key Suppliers and internal Twenty-Six Defense organizations to improve performance in both Supplier Delivery and Quality. The Sr. Manager provides resources and extensive expertise to the Supplier Quality Engineering department, maximizing Key Supplier strengths, building synergies, leveraging existing skill sets, and developing collaborative team environments to foster consistent world-class, high-performing suppliers. Sets departmental priorities and allocates resources to align with business objectives and annual plan.

Responsibilities and Tasks

* Provide leadership to Supplier Quality Engineers and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain and Program Managers to ensure supplier quality performance and continuous improvement.
* Monitor and evaluate Key Supplier Performance.
* Chair monthly Supplier Performance reviews with key internal stakeholders.
* Lead Supplier Performance Reviews with suppliers to review supplier scorecard performance.
* Work with new and existing suppliers, across the full product lifecycle, to develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance systems and activities.
* Collaborate with Corporate Quality team to develop and improve supplier performance procedures and initiatives.
* Collaborate on development of Supplier Statements of Work.
* Drive “Front End Processes” to ensure innovative, proven Supplier Performance Management techniques are incorporated early.
* Identify, develop, or maintain supplier quality KPIs supporting standard reporting business cadences, including comprehensive Return to Green plans.
* Initiate targeted Zero-Defect Plans with suppliers to improve overall quality.
* Participate on Supplier Corrective Action Review Boards to review SCAR progress and ensure consistency in handling corrective actions.
* Recommend approval of suppliers.
* Solve complex system-level issues through development and collaboration with multi-discipline teams.
* Analyze, evaluate, and recommend innovative approaches to Supplier Performance Management.
* Monitor and evaluate the receiving and source inspection processes for opportunities for improvement that will result in increased quality of material delivered to production.
* Assist Supplier Quality Engineers to resolve intricate technical issues.
* Complete projects as assigned by the Director of Quality.
* Plan and budget the resources required by the Supplier Quality Engineering Department.
* Recommend the suspension of the use of suppliers when there is evidence that products may not meet Twenty-Six Defense customer, statutory, regulatory, or other stakeholder requirements.

Consulting Relationships

* Supply Chain Organization
* Site Operations including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering
* Corporate Affiliates
* Business Units
* External Supplier Stakeholders

Informational Relationships

* Other functional staff as required

Knowledge (Education/License/Certification, Prior Experience)

* Bachelor's degree + 12 years experience required (or equivalent, related work experience and/or military service in lieu of degree)
* Degree Field Preferred: Engineering/Manufacturing or equivalent Technical degree
* 5+ years in project or team leadership required
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent
* Experience embedding advanced quality concepts into New Product Introduction (NPI)
* Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP planning software
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for supplier engagement
* Proven extensive background in Supplier Quality Management
* Experience with Process Improvement
* Ability to read and understand Blue Prints

* Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing
* Use of various measurement tools and methods
* Material special processes
* Surface finishing treatments

* Manufacturing techniques

Skills and Abilities

* Excellent interpersonal skills, including written and verbal communication

description:
KDC is a network of best-in-class custom formulators and manufacturers of color cosmetics, skincare, haircare, bath & body, fragrance, deodorant, home, health, industrial, and auto care products. KDC delivers high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and speed to market to well-known and emerging beauty, personal, and specialty companies from coast to coast. KDC has its head office in Longueuil, Québec. In addition, KDC has 10 operating facilities located throughout North America. Altogether, the company employs nearly 4,800 talented and dedicated employees in North America.

Purchasing Buyer-Supply Chain

kdc/one | Groveport, OH | Onsite

kdc/one is a global leader in custom formulation, package design, and manufacturing solutions for beauty, personal care, and home care brands. The company focuses on high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and rapid speed to market for many of the world’s most recognized brands. Supported by approximately 15,000 employees, kdc/one develops and launches thousands of products each year. The organization co-develops products for more than 1,000 brands, offering exposure to diverse projects and markets for team members.

Are you a purchasing professional who enjoys negotiating, solving problems, and making sure the right materials are available when they’re needed? kdc/one is looking for an experienced Buyer to join our Supply Chain team in Groveport, Ohio.

This is an onsite opportunity where you’ll play an important role in supporting production, managing supplier relationships, controlling costs, and keeping materials flowing efficiently.

Why Join kdc/one?

We believe great people deserve more than just a job. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both at work and beyond, including:

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* 5% annual bonus opportunity
* Medical, dental and vision benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Company-paid holidays
* Career growth and development opportunities
* And more!

What You'll Do

* Purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, supplies and services to support production needs
* Review material requirements and utilize MRP to plan purchasing activities
* Negotiate and manage vendor costs while meeting site requirements
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while monitoring cost, quality and service
* Place purchase orders and coordinate delivery schedules
* Monitor inventory levels, lead times and supplier capacity
* Expedite or delay deliveries as customer and production needs change
* Maintain accurate material information and purchasing data in SAP
* Partner with Quality, Production, Finance, Inventory Control and suppliers to resolve material and purchasing issues
* Review and approve purchasing documentation and invoices
* Help manage slow-moving and obsolete inventory
* Support continuous improvement of purchasing processes and workflows

What We're Looking For

* 3+ years of experience in a Buyer/Purchasing role
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing experience will be considered
* Manufacturing experience strongly preferred
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems and MRP
* Strong negotiation, problem-solving and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
* APICS or C.P.I.M. certification is a plus

The Environment

This is an onsite role based at our Groveport manufacturing facility. While you'll spend time in an office environment, you'll also regularly interact with our production floor and warehouse operations.

**Location:** Groveport, OH

If you're ready to take the next step in your purchasing career and make a direct impact on operations, we'd like to hear from you.

Seniority Level

Mid-Senior level

Industry

Industrial Machinery Manufacturing

Employment Type

Full-time

KDC-ONE is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, gender, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. I understand that employment with KDC-ONE Company is at-will, meaning that I or KDC-ONE Company may terminate my employment at any time, or for any reason consistent with applicable state or federal law. I understand that KDC-One requires the successful completion of a drug and/or alcohol test as a condition of employment.

description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

* Own the material function for advanced product-development programs, from early development through delivery.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program and technical leadership on all supply-chain matters.
* Translate program schedules into concrete sourcing and procurement plans that keep material moving on time.
* Identify and resolve material issues before they affect program cost, schedule, or quality.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment where priorities shift and requirements evolve.

**Responsibilities:**

**Planning & Strategy**

* Develop material program plans and supplier management plans for assigned programs.
* Translate engineering and program requirements into an actionable sourcing plan.
* Keep leadership informed on material risk, priority decisions, and recovery plans as issues arise.
* Maintain working knowledge of the policies and procedures governing material sourcing and movement.

**Sourcing & Order Execution**

* Develop RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, and evaluate supplier responses on pricing, lead time, and terms.
* Convert approved material needs into purchase requisitions and manage them through to a placed purchase order.
* Drive improvements in procurement cycle time by identifying and removing barriers to material availability.
* Support new-supplier onboarding, including confidentiality agreements and other required documentation.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Coordinate across procurement, planning, and production control to ensure clean handoffs and task ownership.
* Partner directly with engineering to define supply-chain requirements and delivery timing.
* Identify and escalate anything that puts program material at risk on cost, schedule, quality, or performance.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or an advanced degree with 3+ years of relevant experience (equivalent combinations of education and experience considered).
* Background in supply chain, production control, material planning, procurement, or a closely related discipline.
* Working proficiency with an ERP or MRP system.
* Solid understanding of how supply-and-demand planning connects to requisitions, purchase orders, and supplier management.
* Demonstrated ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast-moving product-development environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, and program teams.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain any security clearance required for the position.
* S. citizenship may be required, depending on program or clearance requirements.

Technical Buyer - Electric Motors

**Department:** Purchasing

**Location:** FEDCO Headquarters, Monroe, Michigan

**Employment Status:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Supply Chain Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Technical Buyer - Electric Motors sources and manages electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and related components for FEDCO products and customer projects. This purchasing role requires the technical knowledge to evaluate requirements, compare proposals, identify specification gaps, and coordinate questions with Engineering, Sales, Quality, and suppliers.

The position owns quotations, purchase orders, pricing, delivery performance, negotiations, and supplier relationships while balancing cost, quality, lead time, compliance, and customer requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

**Purchasing and Order Execution**
----------------------------------

* Request, evaluate, and compare supplier quotations for motors, VFDs, accessories, and related components.
* Create and manage purchase orders; verify pricing, quantities, specifications, documentation, and delivery dates.
* Resolve supplier acknowledgement discrepancies involving configuration, price, lead time, freight, warranty, or terms.
* Monitor open orders and delivery commitments; escalate risks and drive recovery actions.
* Maintain accurate ERP data and coordinate expedites, changes, cancellations, returns, warranty claims, and corrective actions.

**Technical Motor Purchasing**
------------------------------

* Review motor data sheets, drawings, customer specifications, and application requirements to confirm the required configuration.
* Compare ratings, voltage, frequency, speed, frame, enclosure, efficiency, mounting, duty, hazardous-area requirements, and accessories.
* Identify exceptions or missing information and coordinate approvals with Engineering, Sales, Quality, customers, and suppliers.
* Confirm NEMA or IEC construction, regional electrical requirements, and certifications; support motor and VFD sourcing without assuming final design authority.

**Supplier Sourcing and Commercial Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain qualified domestic and global sources for standard and engineered motor requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, freight, warranties, minimum quantities, stocking arrangements, and supply agreements.
* Evaluate total landed cost, including freight, tariffs, duties, quality risk, lead time, and inventory impact.
* Support supplier qualification and performance reviews; track quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, technical support, market conditions, and supply risks.

**Cross-Functional Support and Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Partner with Planning and Operations on forecasts, inventory, shortages, and project priorities.
* Support product development, engineering changes, value analysis, standardization, and cost reduction.
* Provide motor pricing, lead-time, sourcing, and technical information for quotations and customer orders.
* Maintain supplier records and reports, comply with purchasing, quality, and trade requirements, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Success in this role may be evaluated through:

* Supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost control, and technical support.
* Accuracy of sourcing decisions, purchase orders, documentation, and supplier commitments.
* Cost savings, risk avoidance, timely support, clear communication, organized records, and follow-through.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical training and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of purchasing, sourcing, or supplier-management experience involving electric motors, drives, rotating equipment, or industrial electrical components.
* Experience buying three-phase induction motors, working with manufacturers or distributors, developing requests for quotation, comparing proposals, negotiating terms, and managing orders through delivery.
* International sourcing, landed-cost analysis, and engineered-to-order manufacturing experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, purchasing controls, Microsoft Office, and relevant motor certifications.
* Professional purchasing certification is a plus; ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*FEDCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

**About Flexport:**
-------------------

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The Ocean team at Flexport works globally to make sure all business moves smoothly and our ocean product is the best it can be for our clients. Our Ocean Procurement Team is essential to winning new business, supporting all current business, and building out the future of Flexport's ocean services.

As a Procurement Manager, you'll be an integral part of helping achieve Flexport's growth goals. It's a face-paced and integral position for both winning new business, and supporting our current book of business. This role is focused on the Transpacific-Eastbound (TPEB) trade. A successful procurement manager will need to communicate market developments and strategy to a broad range of colleagues, negotiate freight rates, be willing and able to dig into the weeds of pricing / contract nuances, manage carrier relationships, and represent Flexport commercially.

**You Will**
------------

* Drive all things ocean carrier procurement for TPEB and take direct responsibility for carrier development and partnership on the respective trade, demonstrating Flexport's competitive advantages
* Coordinate and negotiate annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly procurement activities
* Build scalable procurement operating rhythms and tools, including working directly with internal contract tools for cost and pricing management
* Lead rate setting and strategy for RFP season on the trade
* Work closely with commercial Ocean and demand teams to win new business and execute for current book of business
* Educate and enable the broader Flexport organization with carrier and tradelane intelligence to foster better decision making, client engagement and growing the trade
* Lead regular cross team meetings
* Work collaboratively with colleagues in Asia to execute trade strategy and fulfillment
* Dive into escalations both in Asia and in the U.S. to keep our business moving

**You Should Have**
-------------------

* 7+ years of prior Ocean procurement experience at a top freight forwarder or trade experience at a carrier or 7+ years of supply chain experience and a BA/BS Degree;
* Strategic vision and continuous desire to improve–get into the weeds and build process from ground-up when needed
* Strong negotiation skills
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;
* Desire to build / scale ocean business
* Ability to travel regionally and internationally
* People management experience desired (but not required)
* A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

**Labcorp is seeking a Logistics Director to join our team in Raleigh, NC**

**Job Summary**

The Logistics Director provides strategic and operational leadership for the Atlantic Division's distribution, logistics, and warehousing infrastructure, translating the division's strategic and operating plans into efficient, compliant, and customer-focused day-to-day execution. The role develops and executes long-term logistics strategies that support growth, service excellence, operational efficiency and enterprise supply chain objectives while ensuring compliant and customer-focused execution. Owns the design and delivery of a centralized logistics dispatching model for customers requiring STAT and will-call specimen pickup, and drives operational excellence, margin improvement, and service quality across the specimen supply chain. Partnering across laboratory operations, patient services, and division leadership, the Director builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement, safety, and accountability.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Divisional leadership:** Lead the Atlantic division-wide distribution, logistics, and warehousing infrastructure, and execute the division's strategic and current-year business plans and budgets.
* **Centralized dispatch:** Develop and execute a plan for divisional centralized logistics dispatching to serve customers needing STAT and will-call specimen pickup, ensuring timely, reliable transport of patient specimens.
* **Strategy & process design: Create and drive** strategies for a highly functioning, efficient distribution/logistics/warehousing network; build and improve processes that deliver operational efficiency, drive margin improvement, and advance objectives set by senior leadership.
* **Route & network optimization:** Continuously review, optimize, and standardize courier routes, pickup service, new-account setup, and dispatch procedures, eliminating non-value-added activity.
* **Performance analytics:** Use Power BI to drive KPIs, performance metrics, and analytics; sustain and enhance existing dashboards to monitor performance and achieve divisional excellence across logistics and supply chain.
* **Financial ownership:** Develop and manage operating and capital budgets; partner with Finance on the logistics P&L to drive profitable growth, cost excellence, and accurate forecasting.
* **Policies & procedures:** Develop policies, SOPs, and procedures that support the operational infrastructure and ensure compliance with Labcorp standards.
* **Operational excellence:** Lead day-to-day operations to advance strategy, culture, talent development, and process excellence with an emphasis on productivity, efficiency, and quality.
* **Safety & compliance:** Establish, follow, and enforce safety standards and procedures in compliance with a healthy work environment, regulatory requirements, and applicable transportation and healthcare regulations.
* **Vendor & 3PL management:** Manage relationships and contracts with carriers and third-party logistics providers to meet service-level agreements and optimize cost and performance.
* **Technology enablement:** Support the selection and use of logistics technologies (e.g., routing/dispatch, transportation and warehouse management systems) to improve operational visibility.
* **Innovation & benchmarking:** Bring in new ideas and best practices from other industries that excel in distribution, logistics, and warehousing to enhance service and margin.
* **Talent development:** Build a strong leadership pipeline; mentor, develop, and set performance objectives for the logistics team, fostering a culture of coaching, trust, and continuous improvement.
* **Mergers & acquisitions:** Support M&A projects with oversight of logistics integration into Labcorp, including due-diligence analysis of the selling party's logistics infrastructure, route network, and logistics personnel; plan and execute the transition of acquired operations to ensure seamless, low-disruption integration into the division's distribution, dispatch, and warehousing model.

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**

In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

Location: USA - Miami, 12430 NW 25th St

Division: Air & Sea

Job Posting Title: Team Lead Air Export - 130411

Time Type: Full Time

**Team Lead, Air Export**

The Air Export Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the air export team, including coordinating with airlines, freight forwarders, and other service providers. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as a deep understanding of air freight logistics and regulations.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Supervise and coordinate daily activities of the air export team, ensuring efficient and timely delivery of cargo
* Coordinate with airlines, freight forwarders, and other service providers to ensure smooth and timely delivery of cargo
* Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and laws, including customs regulations and trade laws
* Develop and implement policies and procedures to improve efficiency and quality of service delivery
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce costs, improve service quality, and enhance customer satisfaction
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators, such as cargo delivery times, costs, and quality

**Educational background / Work experience**

* A bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field is required
* At least 5 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or a related field is required
* Prior experience in air exports and supervisory experience is highly desirable

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent leadership and communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Knowledge of logistics and supply chain management principles
* Ability to work well under pressure and in a fast-paced environment

***Supervisory Responsibilities (if any)***

* This role typically involves supervising a team of air export coordinators and other support staff

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience with leading air cargo logistics software and systems
* Familiarity with air freight regulations, customs requirements, and export controls
* Knowledge of airline routes and schedules

***Language skills***

* Fluency in English is required
* Knowledge of additional languages is a plus

***Computer Literacy***

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with logistics software and systems is required

***Schedule***

* Work schedule may include weekends and holidays

**At Will Employment**

DSV Air & Sea Inc. employees are hired for an undefined period of time as “at will” employees. This means that an employee may be terminated for any reason, or no reason at all, at any time, provided the discharge does not violate any law\\*. Additionally, each employee has the right to terminate his/her employment at any time. \\*Except if employed in Montana, where termination requires just cause.

For this position, the expected base pay range is $24.96 – $31.20 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

Information regarding DSV’s benefits offerings, including eligibility, coverage options, and plan

The Resource Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the material requirements plan with an accurate resource allocation for upcoming operational (PSD) and maintenance (TLM) activities that meet the planned and approved activities within the job horizon (0-30 days) and the short-term horizon (0-3 months) forecast. They provide M&S/Assets/Products to locations and wellsite as per requests in a timely and efficient manner. They act as a link between operations management and the planning & supply chain organization and build partnerships with delivery teams in OCC, Distribution hubs, EM centers to secure timely delivery of resources and services, monitor end-to-end visibility, and improve service level.

#### **Material & Inventory Management.**

* Consolidate, validate, and/or compute short-term resource forecasts by generating and maintaining material requirements planning (MRP) schedules; based on historical data, production forecasts, customer orders, and inventory levels.
* Analyze production and/or field requirements and material availability to ensure timely and accurate procurement of raw materials, components, and product supply.
* Evaluate and prioritize MRP action messages to initiate expediting or rescheduling as needed.
* Communicate and set BL expectations of escalated orders, updated lead times, and delivery status.
* Convert demand signals from PSD or TLM through Planned Orders into Purchase Requisitions.
* Conduct regular MRP system maintenance, including master data, lead times, reorder points, and safety stock review.
* Monitor and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to inventory management, such as stock turns, supply cost, fill rates, service delivery, and on-time delivery to optimize stock levels.
* Own Data Quality improvements in the S&OP process in the GU, such as, but not limited to: Supplier Lead Time, Open PO’s, GR/IR, MRP coverage, unassign fixed vendors.
* Lead IBP reviews at the GU when applicable and ensure the actions are followed and executed.

#### **Resource Management**

* Identify and address potential supply chain risks, such as shortages, delays, or quality issues, through proactive planning and communication.
* Monitor and maintain the required delivery dates (RDD) against purchase order (PO) delivery dates through the Material Availability Reports to ensure on-time delivery.
* Perform local netting within the country for all Assets, Products, and M&S categories and balance within shared zones.
* Collaborate with TLM and PSD teams to understand capacity constraints and maintain lead times for effective planning.
* Support fixed asset acquisition and/or disposal as required. Review PAC 2 reconciliation report and resolve non-conformances. \\* Request and approve or reject all field material/asset transfers (FMT/ FAT) in a timely manner.
* Participate in BL job planning or project readiness assessments (PRAs) to understand demand gaps and communicate priorities to supply functions, ensuring that constraints such as TCC, Import / Export regulations, lead times, and local logistics are accounted for.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including but not limited to procurement, logistics, and quality control, to ensure smooth material flow, minimizing disruptions while considering potential cost variations.
* Liaise with the respective function (TLM, Supply Chain, PSD) to analyze and consolidate the cost and cost variations associated with the fulfillment of the demand for products, materials & assets in the short-term horizon and propose improvement plans whenever applicable, such as, but not limited to material substitutions and localizations.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies related to procurement, inventory control, and supply chain management.
* Validate correct cost allocation by having service or rental POs correctly categorized by adding Cost center or WBS where applicable.
* Engage in tender process with S&C, Sourcing for Sales, PSD and validate tender assumptions including but not limited to equipment or rentals availability, financial assumptions.
* Own the process to update master data in the geography, such as Material master or FAL.
* At least 5 years of experience in Oil and Gas

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Description:

As the External Manufacturing Scheduler at Kite, you are responsible for building and maintaining executable production schedules across our external manufacturing (CDMO/CMO) network. You act as the primary planning conduit between Kite Network Planning, Site Supply Chain and our external partners, translating demand plans into contractually-aligned external forecasts, securing plasmid, vector and other critical material availability, managing purchase orders and invoicing, and governing schedule performance. This role ensures that external partner capacity, slot reservations, material readiness and release convert into stable, reliable supply across all external manufacturing nodes.

Responsibilities :

External Production and Release Scheduling

* + Own, build, and maintain the production schedule across all external manufacturing nodes, maintaining synchronized calendars with partners for end-to-end visibility.
+ Validate slot reservations, campaign timing, yield expectations, testing sequences, and release timelines with external partners.
+ Protect schedule stability within the frozen window while enabling agility in the longer horizon. Manage exceptions through established supply governance forums and provide partners with rolling 6–24 month visibility to enable proactive contracting, capacity planning, and risk mitigation.
+ Reconcile forecasted demand against contracted capacity, escalating gaps or over-commitments for resolution.

Plasmid & Critical Material Management

* + Own forward CMO planning for plasmid and Cell Banks confirming supplier feasibility and readiness ahead of scheduled campaigns.
+ Partner with Procurement, Materials, and External Quality to align material availability, safety stock, and procurement strategies with the schedule.
+ Proactively identify material constraints and drive mitigation to prevent disruption.

Purchase Order & Invoicing Management

* + Issue and manage POs to external partners in alignment with the schedule, forecast, and contract terms, tracking status through the full lifecycle to closure.
+ Manage invoicing with partners, including validation, reconciliation against POs/deliveries, and resolution of discrepancies.
+ Partner with Finance, Procurement, and Accounts Payable for timely financial processing, budgeting, accruals, and spend visibility.

Performance Management & Reporting

* + Track, analyze, and report KPIs across the external network: schedule adherence, capacity utilization, supply reliability/OTIF, forecast accuracy, inventory health, and PO/invoicing accuracy.
+ Partner with Quality to capture deviations, understand root-cause drivers, and drive corrective actions with partners.
+ Ensure adherence to plan stability metrics, managing exceptions through established governance processes.

External Tools & Maintenance to Support Daily Operations

* + Partner with system/IT teams to establish and maintain robust, efficient systems, tools, and data structures for managing external information.
+ Establish standardized reporting, dashboards, and data flows for accurate, timely visibility across the network.
+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen planning discipline, reduce cycle time, and improve integration.

Cross-Functional & Partner Coordination

* + Serve as the central scheduling interface between Kite and the External Manufacturing organization and external partners.
+ Coordinate shipments with internal sites, logistics and trade compliance to assure timely supply across Kite’s network.
+ Lead recurring scheduling forums with External Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain to align on feasibility, constraints, and assumptions.
+ Assure variation management is aligned with external manufacturing schedule including part number management

Qualifications

* + Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field with relevant experience; OR Master’s degree with correspondingly less experience; OR PhD with correspondingly less experience

Our function has been built in a non-traditional way for the legal sector, bringing together specialists from diverse backgrounds including BD, PR, communications, media, digital and operations.

This blend of expertise creates a dynamic, energetic team environment that nurtures fresh perspectives and gives the firm a genuine competitive advantage.

The will team comprise specialists from backgrounds including BD, PR, communications, media, digital and operations. The result will be a dynamic and energetic team environment which nurtures fresh perspectives and ultimately lends the firm a competitive advantage.

We take a holistic approach to marketing and business development, with the goal to help our lawyers win more work and make new connections. This important role exists to support the Business Development (BD) Directors and go-to-market teams in the delivery of high-level, quality and innovative business development, marketing and communication initiatives.

Working as a collaborative member of the firm’s shared support team in ‘The Hub’, this role will provide executive support across a broad range of exciting business development and marketing initiatives and projects.

**Why join the Hub?**

The Hub sits at the very heart of the BD, marketing and communications team at BCLP. Hub team members will have the opportunity to work across the full spectrum of BD, marketing and communications activities in all practice groups and sectors.

The Hub team will offer agile assistance, delivering valuable additional and flexible support to work on priority clients, practice/sector groups and markets, as the need arises.

This exciting role will enable Hub team members to learn a range of valuable skills, strengthening existing competencies and developing strong and lasting relationships across the firm, while gaining new insights and deepening knowledge. Full training will be provided.

**You’ll be responsible for:**

**Business development:** Supporting across the spectrum of BD to help in developing new business opportunities and deepen existing client relationships. This might include research, creating business development collateral, CRM assistance, involvement in pitches, press and social media searches, management of invitation lists and follow-ups

**Practice and sector groups:** Working flexibly across the different teams to provide hands-on executive support in the implementation of plans and projects

**Directories:** Supporting the team in the creation and submission of Directory entries in Chambers and Legal 500

**Marketing campaigns:** Working with the wider team to support with the implementation of campaigns. This might include working with brand and design, updating invitations, supporting events, mailshots, communications, website updates, social media posts and event follow-ups

**Communications:** Helping the team with internal communications, creating posts using standard templates, tracking activity and assisting with reporting, helping with client alerts

**Digital, social media and website:** Posting content onto website pages and social media, supporting with sourcing imagery, photography and infographics

**Operations support:** Ad hoc operations support as needed

**Presentations:** Updating and editing client and internal presentations

**Global support:** Acting as part of a wider global team who collaborate and support each other on a global basis

**Digital skills:** Keeping up-to-date with digital tools and applications to provide support with design, postings and formatting (training will be provided)

**Key relationships**

* Practice group BD teams
* Key Partners and fee-earners
* CMO
* Wider marketing team including CRM, campaigns, design, digital, events, international
* The Hub management and team
* Business Services teams as required (e.g. Practice Economics, Knowledge Management, Finance & Accounting)

**Skills and experience required**

* Degree educated, ideally with a Marketing (CIM) qualification
* Professional services background
* Marketing and/ or Business Development experience
* Self-motivated and proactive
* Happy to work flexibly with agility across the business
* Highly organised with impeccable attention to detail
* Excellent written communication and project management skills
* Able to manage competing priorities, requiring multi-tasking and working to tight deadlines
* Enthusiastic and eager to learn

description:
**Job Description**

**About the role**
------------------

General Motors is seeking a Technical Specialist to provide technical leadership for door modules, window regulator systems and door glass across vehicle programs. This role will guide the development, integration, validation and production readiness of these components, ensuring that designs meet functional, performance, quality, cost, timing and customer expectations.

The successful candidate will work across design, manufacturing, safety, quality, purchasing, suppliers and vehicle program teams. The role is ideal for an engineer who can combine deep component expertise with strong systems thinking, practical problem solving and the ability to influence decisions across a complex organization.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the technical subject-matter expert for door modules, window regulators, door glass and associated interfaces.
* Define component and system requirements, engineering specifications, design guidelines and acceptance criteria.
* Lead technical reviews of concepts, detailed designs, drawings, GD&T, materials, tolerances and interface definitions.
* Develop and manage strategic direction for door modules to enable factor of the future
* Ensure robust integration with door structures, hinges, latches, seals, weatherstrip, wiring, electrical controls, body systems and vehicle trim.
* Evaluate designs for fit, function, sealing, glass travel, run effort, noise, vibration, harshness, durability, environmental performance and customer usability.
* Guide supplier engineering activities, including sourcing assessments, design reviews, development timing, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Lead root-cause investigations for functional, dimensional, quality and field issues using structured problem-solving methods.
* Coordinate engineering validation plans, test requirements, test execution, data review and approval of results.
* Assess design risks and drive mitigation through DFMEA, tolerance analysis, design reviews and validation activities.
* Support manufacturing and assembly teams with process reviews, build events, launch activities and containment or corrective-action plans.
* Resolve cross-functional issues and communicate technical recommendations, risks, tradeoffs and decisions to program leadership.
* Maintain technical documentation, lessons learned, standards, change records and configuration integrity throughout the product lifecycle.
Mentor engineers and contribute to the development of best practices for closure-system components.

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Minimum 5 years experience
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or electrical engineering
* Significant experience in automotive body, closure, door system, window regulator, glass or related component development.
* Knowledge of power window, anti-pinch, express-up/down and related mechatronic control functions.
* Experience with vehicle door systems, frameless or framed door glass, window regulator mechanisms, door modules, glass run channels or related sealing systems.
* Demonstrated experience taking components from concept through design release, validation, launch and production support.
* Strong knowledge of mechanical design principles, materials, GD&T, tolerance stack-up and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Experience with engineering change management, supplier technical reviews and structured problem solving.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, CAD data, test results and manufacturing process information.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from working-level teams through senior leadership.
Ability to lead technical decisions in a cross-functional, fast-paced program environment.

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Experience dealing with electrical system validation requirements particularly for EMC and environmental durability
* Experience dealing with software changes and software validation process
* Experience with NVH, wind noise, water management, sealing, durability, corrosion or environmental validation of closure systems.
* Familiarity with DFMEA, PFMEA, design verification, production validation, APQP and supplier quality processes.
* Experience supporting vehicle build events, plant launches, warranty investigations or field technical actions.
* Automotive industry experience with global suppliers and vehicle development teams.

**About GM**

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

**BAIN CAPITAL SPECIALTY FINANCE OVERVIEW**

Bain Capital Specialty Finance (“BCSF”) is a business development company utilizing the significant experience and expertise of Bain Capital Credit’s Private Credit Group, which has over 20 dedicated professionals around the world who exclusively focus on middle-market investments. This scale enables the team to remain focused on sourcing and analyzing a large opportunity set, while remaining highly selective in approving credits. Our approach facilitates detailed focus on structuring, monitoring, and managing each of its current and prospective portfolio company investments.

**BAIN CAPITAL CREDIT OVERVIEW**

Bain Capital Credit is a leading global credit specialist with $58.2 billion in assets under management. We invest across the credit spectrum and in credit-related strategies, including leveraged loans, high-yield bonds, structured products, private middle market loans, bespoke capital solutions, distressed securities and assets, non-performing loans, hard assets, and equities. Since inception, we have made a cultural commitment to investor alignment. We are a private partnership and invest a significant amount of our own capital alongside our limited partners. We have approximately $956 million of employee co-investment committed across Bain Capital Credit funds as of June 30, 2025. Bain Capital Credit’s investment professionals are dedicated to sourcing, analyzing, documenting, and executing attractive credit opportunities across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific and are supported by robust operational and technical resources.

With approximately $225 billion of assets under management, Bain Capital is one of the world’s leading private investment firms. We create lasting impact for our investors, teams, businesses, and the communities in which we live.Over four decades we have strategically grown our platform to focus on Private Equity, Growth & Venture, Capital Solutions, Credit, and Real Assets. Today, our team includes 1,985+ employees in 24 offices on four continents.

**We partner differently to help people and companies embrace possibility and realize potential.**Founded as a private partnership in 1984, we have fostered a culture of innovation, entrepreneurialism, and agility, empowering our people to define and own their career trajectories. Today, our partnership approach enables us to pursue strategic growth, build enduring relationships with a robust external network, and collaborate across our integrated platform to connect the deep and diverse expertise that unlocks breakthrough insights.

**Our people are the heart of our advantage.** Colleagues at all levels have a seat at the table as they tackle business challenges with a principal investor mindset. By asking incisive questions, respectfully challenging one another, and remaining intellectually agile, we work together to achieve exceptional outcomes.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Work directly in the preparation and/or review of various Business Development Companies’ (“BDCs”) reporting requirements which include some or all of the following:

* 10-Q and 10-K SEC filings
* Weekly performance reporting including returns, positioning, and attribution analysis
* Weekly dividend estimate
* Review and reconciliation of outside Administrator’s NAV package
* Materials for BDC Board of Directors
* Work with Investor Relations to prepare investor decks and earnings release
* Analytical review of quarterly balance sheets and income statements
* Close interaction with outside accountants to assist in their audit work
* Close interaction with third party service provider to document evidence of internal controls operating effectively
* Close interaction with legal team to ensure BDC’s remain in compliance with regulatory requirements
* Capital reporting to investors of Joint Ventures
* Frequent /Challenging / Unique Ad hoc requests

* Application of provisions described in complex legal documents for Joint Ventures (e.g. PPMs/LPA/IMAs) including:
+ Capital Call Provisions
+ Capital Allocations
+ Carried Interest Allocations
+ Distribution Provisions
+ Management Fees
+ Expenses (ability to charge as well as expense cap provisions)
+ Investment Restrictions/Compliance

Overview:

**Employee Value Proposition**

The Talent Acquisition Specialist collaborates with key stakeholders to understand hiring needs across business units to meet immediate and future staffing plans. This critical role will ensure that we acquire the best talent possible to join our business as well as mentors other members of the recruiting team. They oversee the entire candidate experience from lead sourcing, interviewing and ultimately hiring candidates in concert with talent acquisition initiatives that support delivering the companys strategic priorities. This role supports the full life cycle recruitment across DBM Globals business units. From generating a pipeline to maintaining a successful offer acceptance rate, they are responsible for managing the entire candidate process, building scaled processes, analyzing data, and creating a deep partnership with the business.

Responsibilities:

**Key Performance Objectives**

* Provide talent acquisition solutions and market insight to meet business growth plans and drive key results
* Develop pipeline of talent for active and passive needs
* Own and lead sourcing strategies that increase the volume of potential qualified candidates
* Influence and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, such as effective job descriptions, candidate outreach, employer value propositions, and excellent interview and onboarding experiences, to drive positive candidate experiences.
* Work with department leadership to create plans and identify resources for staffing needs
* Partner with marketing and other departments to create compelling campaigns that enhance employer branding and visibility
* Provide exceptional candidate experience, while managing the full recruitment lifecycle
* Participate in key projects that enhance internal recruitment process, focusing on immediate and long-term needs
* Exercise a high level of professionalism and confidentiality when working with staff, projects, and proprietary information
* Develop and execute recruiting strategies for hard to fill and frequently filled positions
* Network through industry contacts, association memberships, trade groups, social media, and employees
* Collaborate with hiring managers and stakeholder employees regularly to keep parties informed, establish co-ownership, improve morale, and source new candidate leads
* Conduct regular follow-up with hiring managers to determine the effectiveness of recruiting plans and implementation
* Research and recommend new sources for active and passive candidate recruiting
* Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient, and positive for both hiring managers and candidates
* Own the full candidate lifecycle for a variety of positions
* Collaborate with internal clients to develop sourcing strategy for current and future needs
* Proactively source candidates using internet resources, social media, employee referrals, recruiting techniques and other creative methods
* Create and negotiate offers with candidates that may include complex compensation, incentive plans, relocation, or other hiring issues
* Ensure a smooth and positive candidate and hiring manager experience
* Liaise closely with internal functions such as HR, Talent Management, IT, and other business units as necessary to onboard candidates effectively
* Work with hiring managers to ensure job requirements and expectations are clearly understood and candidates are assessed against appropriate criteria
* Engage in recruiting projects; collaborate with multiple stakeholders and business units to improve candidate engagement
* Will work on other functions as needed

Qualifications:

**Core Competencies****:**

* In-depth knowledge of recruitment processes, with experience pipelining for future roles
* Exceptional prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once
* Strong understanding of latest recruitment trends, including the use of Social Media tools for recruitment
* Experience with Paycom Applicant Tracking, ADP Workforce Now, iCIMS, and/or Service Now is a plus
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office
* Construction industry experience is highly preferred
* Experience in a research capacity for candidate generation
* Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects, and relationships
* Experience sourcing through social media
* Strong attention to detail while operating with a high sense of urgency
* Strong sourcing, interviewing, and negotiation skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with a penchant towards metrics
* Experience recruiting talent in competitive markets
* Strong understanding and ability to recruit at all levels of the organization from entry level to executive

Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams between recruiting, human resources, shareholders and other teams and offices while delivering exceptional client service. * Source lateral associates and shareholder candidates for open and anticipated positions.
* Leverage sourcing platforms, such as Firm Prospects, Pirical, and LinkedIn Recruiter to develop target candidate lists across practice groups and markets.
* Conduct proactive outreach to prospective candidates and cultivate an excellent candidate experience.
* Assist with initial candidate screening and qualification discussions.
* Perform legal market research, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence reporting.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in Workday, including interview activity tracking and recruiting metrics.

description:
Expect more. Connect more. Be more at Diebold Nixdorf. Our teams automate, digitize, and transform the way more than 75 million people around the globe bank and shop in this hyper-connected, consumer-centric world. Join us in connecting people to commerce in this vital, rewarding role.

Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives on identifying specialized talent and advising business leaders on complex hiring needs? Join our team as a Senior Talent Acquisition Recruiter and play a key role in attracting and hiring experienced professionals for specialist-level positions across the organization. You will combine market insight, proactive sourcing, disciplined execution, and trusted stakeholder partnership to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes and an exceptional candidate experience.

In this role, you will focus on recruiting for specialized and hard-to-fill positions by:

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for specialist-level and hard-to-fill roles while balancing quality, pace, compliance, and candidate experience.
* Serve as a consultative partner to hiring managers and business leaders by translating business needs into effective talent strategies and realistic hiring plans.
* Develop targeted sourcing strategies using direct outreach, professional networks, referrals, talent communities, research, and role-specific channels.
* Assess candidates for technical expertise, functional capability, leadership behaviors, and alignment with role requirements.

Expect more. Connect more. Be more at Diebold Nixdorf. Our teams automate, digitize, and transform the way more than 75 million people around the globe bank and shop in this hyper-connected, consumer-centric world. Join us in connecting people to commerce in this vital, rewarding role.

Are you energized by fast-paced hiring environments and motivated by helping teams meet critical staffing needs at scale? Join our team as a Recruiter and play a key role in supporting high-volume recruitment efforts by building strong candidate pipelines, moving candidates efficiently through the process, and delivering a consistent, positive candidate experience.

In this role, you will focus on recruiting for recurring, high-demand roles by:

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for high-volume roles while maintaining speed, quality, and compliance.
* Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand staffing needs, hiring timelines, and role requirements.
* Build and maintain active candidate pipelines through job boards, referrals, direct sourcing, events, and other high-volume sourcing channels.
* Screen, assess, and advance candidates efficiently while ensuring a strong and consistent candidate experience.
* Track recruitment activity, funnel health, and key hiring metrics to identify risks and recommend process improvements.
* Support inclusive hiring practices by developing broad, diverse candidate pipelines for current and future openings.
* Contribute to scalable recruiting processes that improve speed, consistency, and hiring outcomes across high-volume requisitions.

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for high-volume positions, ensuring alignment with workforce plans, hiring targets, and business priorities.
* Partner with hiring managers to confirm hiring needs, intake expectations, selection criteria, and interview timelines.
* Source, engage, screen, and qualify a high volume of candidates using job boards, applicant tracking systems, referrals, social media, and other sourcing tools.
* Maintain a steady pipeline of qualified candidates and proactively address gaps in candidate flow or hiring progress.
* Coordinate interviews, communicate next steps, and keep candidates informed throughout the recruitment process.
* Support offer preparation and candidate closure in partnership with hiring managers, HR, and compensation teams.
* Ensure accurate documentation, requisition updates, and compliance throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Monitor recruiting metrics such as applicant flow, time-to-fill, interview volume, offer acceptance, and pipeline conversion to improve hiring outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to streamline recruiting workflows, improve candidate experience, and support scalable hiring processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent professional experience; post-secondary education in Human Resources or a related field is a plus.
* 2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Staffing, or a related HR discipline.
* Experience supporting high-volume recruitment, hourly hiring, field hiring, or recurring operational roles preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to build trust and influence hiring managers and candidates.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple requisitions, candidate pipelines, and competing priorities.
* Proactive, collaborative, and results-driven mindset.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with shifting priorities and time-sensitive hiring needs.

**Join us** and play a key role in shaping a world-class talent acquisition organization that supports the growth and success of our global workforce.
