The Talent Acquisition Specialist is a member of the ABS Global Talent Acquisition (TA) team. Our TA team is a Center of Excellence (COE) that supports the hiring efforts of three wholly owned ABS organizations. These organizations operate in 61 countries and have approximately 7,000 team members. This opportunity provides a professional work environment, work-life balance, and a competitive compensation and benefits package. The position also provides the recruiting professional with the tools, resources, and support needed to be successful in a collaborative and respectful environment.

**What You Will Do:**

* Primarily support hiring needs within the United States and occasionally Canada.
* Leverage recruiting experience to support hiring across Engineering, Information Technology (IT), Operations, Business Development (BD), Financial Services, and Cybersecurity.
* Proactively create staffing strategies and identify alternative methods for attracting candidates to assigned open positions.
* Work professionally with other HR team members, including Recruiters, Coordinators, HR Business Partners, Compensation, and various levels of HR management.
* Report weekly on assigned openings through standardized reporting and live sessions with members of management and Human Resources.
* Manage assigned openings from the requisition creation stage through offer creation and acceptance. All functions are performed digitally within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Operate as a talent acquisition partner to assigned departments and take the initiative to learn the business and how talent acquisition impacts operations.
* Partner, on occasion, with College Recruiting to help attract recent college graduates and interns.
* Travel, on occasion, to events including college recruiting and industry career fairs.

**What You Will Need:**

Education & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* At least four (4) years of recruiting experience is preferred.
* Solid experience using common tools to source passive candidates, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and similar platforms.
* Experience using an Applicant Tracking System (Oracle Recruiting Cloud - ORC preferred).
* Experience managing up to 25 requisitions simultaneously in a corporate environment is preferred.
* Experience sourcing passive candidates to fill difficult-to-fill roles.
* Comfortable utilizing AI tools to assist with sourcing and interviewing candidates.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

* Ability to work with team members in a respectful and professional manner.
* Ability to work in a diverse environment where respect for others is expected.
* Ability to travel, on occasion and with notice, in support of recruiting events.
* Skilled at engaging with all levels of management, including executive leadership, in a professional manner.
* Ability to provide feedback and direction tactfully and diplomatically to Hiring Managers when needed.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

* Knowledge of employment law related to recruiting and staffing.
* Exposure to recruiting metrics including Time to Fill, Time to Hire, and Days Open.
* Experience with government hiring requirements including ITAR and security clearances.

**Schedule and Location:**

* The position has a hybrid work schedule consisting of Tuesday through Thursday in the office. Monday and Friday provide the option to work remotely or from the office.
* This role is located at our modern ten-story corporate headquarters in Spring, Texas.

**Reporting Relationships:**

The professional will report to a senior-level member of management and will have no direct reports. The professional should be comfortable working in a collaborative environment where team members interact frequently in a constructive and respectful manner. It is common for the Talent Acquisition Specialist to represent the TA team in meetings with all levels of management and provide briefings to HR leadership when needed.

**Working Conditions:**

The work environment will be in an air-conditioned office setting requiring the employee to sit for prolonged periods while talking on the phone, reading from a computer monitor, and typing on a keyboard. In addition, the team member may occasionally lift items weighing up to 10 pounds. At times, the team member may be asked to travel by common transportation to recruiting or other work-related events. Some overnight travel may be required with advance notice.

description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world's largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Procurement Specialist has an important role in the Procurement Organization with the responsibility for the sourcing of equipment, goods, and services while reducing cost and ensuring on time delivery to meet organizations goals and objectives. This person will be responsible for managing and communicating the requirements of the organization to the supply base. This position will also facilitate the operations and implement procedures for effective stockroom management.

**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate approved requisitions for accuracy and potential cost savings.

* Execute approved purchase orders and distribute to approved vendors.

* Maintain vendor database utilizing current vendors and only adding vendors with added value to the organization.

* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery and compliance with the organizations terms and conditions.

* Focus on consolidating vendors by developing synergies with other sites within the organization to achieve optimum cost savings.

* Support and implement Procurement leadership cost saving initiatives.

* Measure and hold suppliers accountable for performance as measured in supplier scorecards.

* Manage on-site vendors to ensure all procedures are followed.

* Coordinate with accounting to ensure pricing/invoicing accuracy.

* Assists receiving with delivery discrepancies.

* Support continuous improvement throughout the organization.

* Establish and implement procedures to ensure organization and effectiveness of the stockroom.

* Evaluate and determine proper inventory levels for the stockroom.

* Effectively communicate potential supply disruptions throughout the organization.

* Promote safety initiatives and enforce the organization's safety policies.

* Execute Enviva's OEMS System, Gembas, Coaching, Visual Administration, 5's, Material Strategy, Root Cause Analysis, Material and information flow, 7 wastes, VA and NVA activities, Continuous Improvement, TPM, Communication.

**Qualifications**

* Professional career on engineering, business or related - Desirable

* Strong Background on Commercial Negotiations.

* Stockroom management experience required.

* Professional Level of experience in the manufacturing industry is required.

* Basic knowledge on MRP.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in Purchasing/Materials Management areas.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with periodic visits to manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
* Ability to travel occasionally to supplier locations and company facilities.
* Ability to safely enter industrial environments while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

This position is not eligible for visa support.

**EEO Statement**

Enviva is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition or privilege of employment. Enviva does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniform service member, genetic information or any other status protected by law. Enviva complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we operate.

**Top 5 Skills:**

1. Full life cycle recruitment, managing candidates through the entire life cycle of recruitment. Strong sense of urgency in recruiting

2. Knowledge of sourcing and technical/engineering skills

3. Strong interviewing skills

4. Deep knowledge of hiring manager engagement and management

5. Strong offer negotiation and closing skills

They must know how to use an ATS or CRM. Preferred: Workday, Eightfold, Greenhouse, or other internal ATS system.

**Required Education:** Bachelors or Masters degree

**Required Years of Experience:**

*5 – 10 years of experience in technical recruiting*

**Key Words:**

Sourcing, interviewing, scheduling, offer negotiation, technical recruiting, candidate management, hiring manager management

**Job Description:**

*As part of company's Talent Acquisition (TA) team, you will contribute to initiatives that will enhance the overall candidate experience and serve as a talent advisor to the business and our team. This role will focus on the end-to-end recruiting cycle and sourcing to identify, engage, and hire qualified candidates. The Talent Acquisition team incorporates industry best practices in recruiting that align with corporate objectives, workflows, and processes while considering business, industry, legal, and compliance factors to enable TA solutions.*

***Preferred Qualifications:***

***Bachelor's degree in Business, Humanities, Human Resources, Psychology, or related field.***

***5+ years of Talent Acquisition experience in the technology industry.***

***2+ years of work experience in one or more of the following areas: ATS (i.e., Workday), labor and employment relations, interviewing, compensation, benefits, sourcing, talent acquisition metrics, program management, designing and implementing process improvements, and strategic workforce planning.***

***1+ year of work experience in a global matrixed organization.***

***Principal Duties and Responsibilities:***

***Leverages knowledge and principles of TA programs, policies, processes, labor laws (where applicable), interviewing, compensation, negotiation, business, and industry factors to compliantly source, recruit, hire, onboard, transfer, and disposition candidates.***

***Pulls appropriate reports for data-based engagement discussions and proactively communicates requisition-level hiring status and updates to hiring mangers; reviews personal data metrics to evaluate own role within the department's performance metrics.***

***Collaborates and develops effective working relationships with partners within and outside team to accomplish mutual goals (e.g., attract top talent, ensure legal compliance, align with business objectives, etc.).***

***Applies understanding of tools (e.g., Sourcing Platforms, ATS, CRM) and strategies to build a small network in order to quickly identify and hire qualified candidates for multiple workstreams.***

***Level of Responsibility:***

***Works under supervision.***

***Decision-making affects direct area of work and/or work group.***

***Requires verbal and written communication skills to convey information. May require basic negotiation, influence, tact, etc.***

***Tasks require multiple steps which can be performed in various orders; some planning, problem-solving, and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively.***

Pay: $55.00 - $60.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

At DaVita, we find that our best leaders are those who create an inspiring vision for the future and empowers their team to achieve success. They take ownership of results and instill accountability in those they lead. They are driven, strong communicators, relationship builders, and find real fulfillment in challenging work.

Sound like you? Then you might be a great fit for the Senior Manager role on the Quality Talent Pipeline Team with DaVita.

**Here's what you can expect as a Quality Talent Pipeline - Sr Manager at DaVita:**

The Quality Talent Pipeline Team is helping deliver fully staffed and stable teams by making long-term investments on new pools clinical of talent. We do this by:

* Building long-term candidate sourcing pipelines with our Nursing partners
* Tapping into new pools of clinical talent including partnering with academic institutions and international recruiting agencies
* Crafting compelling offers, internship experiences, and 1st year programing

The scope of this role is to own accountability for multiple programs and the Program Specialist teammates (8) that support the placement of students for internships, observations, and clinical rotations in our Field. This Manager must be driven to deliver service excellence, support our team of Program Specialist and think outside the box to drive process improvement. This leader must be collaborative, strategic and have the ability to share the KPIs, results and performance of team with senior level audiences.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

**People Leadership:**

* Responsible for 5+ Program Specialist (PS teammates)
* Manage and prioritize Program Specialist workload to achieve program goals
* Develop and coach all Program Specialists in areas of opportunity and new skills
* Foster a team environment of trust and learning with multi-directional feedback

**Program Management:**

* Manage daily operations of RN/PCT Internship, Global RN and Referral hiring programs
* Support Program Specialists with coordinating placements for student internships
* Manage internal and external program communications and materials, from the initial placement requests through post-rotation
* Analyze program success metrics and report out monthly on progress against goals to Sr. Leadership and key stakeholders

**Partner Engagement and Relationships:**

* Serve as the liaison for school partners and external vendor relationships
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders on the Talent Acquisition Team, Nursing Team, and Field Leadership
* Independently resolve minor conflicts and escalate any issues to senior leadership as appropriate
* Cultivate a high level of collaboration, trust, and belonging within the team and with partners

**Continuous Improvement and Project Management:**

* Gather and analyze team and partner feedback on both program operations and engagement and develop a plan to address
* Identify process improvement opportunities across all Quality Talent Pipeline Team programs and drive towards execution
* Identify new opportunities for growth and articulate how our program can support Talent Acquisition's broader strategy to meet Village hiring demand
Partner with the Field and Nursing Team to identify and develop new relationships and engagement strategies

**Qualifications**

**Who you are**

* Passionate about our team’s mission of delivering fully staffed and stable teams to our field partners
* Energized by building new programs, enhancing existing programs, and partnering closely with other internal teams, school partners, and vendors to deliver results
* A self-starter with a high degree of initiative, urgency, and follow-through
A critical thinking that challenges the status quo to solve challenges strategically

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 4-6 years of total work experience
* Experience managing and coaching direct reports
* Experience in project management and process improvement
* Advanced computer skills and proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Exceptional client relationship management and people skills
* Experience managing internal programs and/or external (e.g., vendor or partner) relationships or programs
Strong analytical skills with ability to tell a story with data

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting school partnerships, recruiting, or human resources
* Experience with change management and deployment
* Experience in healthcare

**Interview process:** The interview process will consist of an initial phone screen, analytical assessment and behavioral based interview.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently hiring for a Principal Supply Chain Planning Specialist to join our Division’s Global Supply Chain team. This position is based onsite for a hybrid role in **Dulles, VA**.

* Support development and execution of material plans by aligning supply requirements with established product line priorities and overall business objectives under guidance from senior planners.

* Collaborate with sourcing, operations, and finance to support alignment on inventory targets, address non‑standard part requirements, and escalate critical‑path procurement issues for resolution.
* Contribute to long‑term capacity and resource planning by providing data, analyses, and recommendations that support new product introductions and efficient use of existing assets.
* Develop and present clear supply chain metrics and KPIs (e.g., inventory, on time delivery, material availability) to management, using tools such as Power BI and Tableau to support data driven decisions.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in supply chain, material planning, production planning, or related operations role. Or in lieu of a degree, 6 years of experience in supply chain, material planning, production planning, or related operations role.

**Job Description**

**Who will you be working with?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services. Our team is focused on continually improving our best-in-class production capabilities. We combine deep domain expertise and tenured experience to deliver unparalleled products for our customers. Here you’ll interact daily with team members during the problem resolution process and will partner with other key stakeholders to support our internal customers and their responsibilities.

**How will you make a difference?**

As a member of the Global Operations Equipment group, the Production Ops Specialist (Operations Coach) provides frontline leadership for a team of assemblers, welders and test technicians. In this role, you will utilize your experience and expertise to direct the daily work activities of operators using effective communication and coaching. You will handle day-to-day responsibilities including time approval, progressive discipline and work direction to meet site objectives. This role will continuously resolve issues through immediate action and have input on both short and long-term planning.

**What do we want to know about you?**

Are you an influential team player with strong attention to detail? Do you positively influence and elevate the performance of a team? Are you a collaborative and supportive problem solver with a constant focus on continuous improvement?

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or college OR a High School Diploma / GED with at least 2 years of supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.

* Previous experience in manufacturing, quality, sourcing or operations, management experience, priority given to applicants who have supervisory experience in a teaming environment.
* Ability to work effectively on a team and serve as a positive change agent.
* Demonstrated oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, able to provide feedback and address employee issues in a positive manner.
* Understanding of LEAN and Six Sigma concepts – quality mindset
* Strong analytical skills and willingness to learn and work as technical expert.
* Strong and effective problem identification and solution skills Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize aggressive deadlines.
* Willingness to take on tough challenges and grow professionally.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**What will your typical day look like?**

* Ensure that your production team operates with the highest environmental health & safety (EHS) standards to drive down environmental & safety incidents, first aids, & recordable injuries.
* Support and meet production schedules, drive productivity (time of product) and quality initiatives and manage the area within budget guidelines and controls; utilize data analysis to improve safety, decrease quality defects, and increase productivity.
* Manage production employees and production schedule requirements to include timekeeping, overtime, time off and discipline.
* Communicate and enforce handbook and other plant policies.
* Provide clear communication and operational guidance to management and other Wabtec employees daily.
* Interface with internal and external customers, define priorities for shift and work group leveraging morning production meetings (and shift change meetings, as needed)
* Actively participate in cross-functional teams, driving a "one team" focus, and demonstrate necessary leadership and coaching; facilitate operational star point projects and ensure High-Performance Work Team objectives.
* Help train and develop skills of production employees; educate production employees on business strategy and metrics.
* Work with various MRP, quality, and MES software systems to manage material and other systemic requirements.

**What about the physical demands of the job?**

* Exposure to shop floor requires wearing PPE
* Walking, climbing, stooping, bending, lifting is all part of the hands-on learning process
* This role will engage with direct staff on a day shift schedule, and you may be asked to work overtime as necessary; due to the supervisory nature of this position, it is not available for remote work.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

**Additional Information**

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $68900-98200 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com.

**Technical Specialist – HVAC Modules and Cabin Air Filters**

The Technical Specialist for HVAC Modules and Cabin Air Filters is the global technical authority and enterprise voice for front and rear HVAC modules and cabin air filters. The Technical Specialist leads the definition, integration, development, validation, release, and control of HVAC module systems. The role requires a high degree of independent judgment, creativity, initiative, and accountability in solving complex and ambiguous engineering problems. The Specialist influences vehicle architecture, program engineering, release engineering, suppliers, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, and global execution teams to ensure consistent implementation of robust solutions.

The Technical Specialist also provides technical leadership to component-level Technical Specialists, develops organizational knowledge, and operates with broad autonomy under the general direction of the Engineering Technical Leader.

* Set and communicate enterprise technical strategy for front and rear HVAC modules and cabin air filters.
* Make independent, data-driven decisions on complex technical issues with significant program, customer, cost, quality, or timing impact.
* Establish standards, best practices, specifications, inherent criteria, and reusable solutions across programs and vehicle segments.
* Lead alignment among architects, DREs, release engineers, suppliers, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, and other stakeholders.
* Influence senior leaders and executives by translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.
* Anticipate future technology, customer, regulatory, and business needs and convert them into actionable subsystem roadmaps.
* Coach and provide technical direction to component-level Technical Specialists and engineering teams.

Develop Industry Leading BOM and Subsystem Strategies

* Establish, maintain, and obtain approval for global BOM strategies that balance cost, mass, investment, quality, performance, timing, and customer expectations.
* Conduct performance, technology, and cost benchmarking to identify competitive opportunities and risks.
* Create family and variant maps, current-application assessments, and program rollout plans that maximize reuse and minimize complexity.
* Define best-fit subsystem and component solutions for vehicle segments, architectures, and program requirements.
* Develop sourcing strategies and support supplier development, technical capability assessment, and supplier qualification.
* Maintain global requirements, including SSTS and CTS templates, and ensure alignment across programs and regions.
* Create, govern, and continuously improve best practices, inherent criteria, specifications, typical sections, and technical standards.
Provide wants and needs that guide future technology, innovation, and subsystem roadmaps.

Provide Technical Governance and Decision Leadership

* Serve as the global technical authority for HVAC module and cabin air filter decisions.
* Provide vehicle architects, program DREs, and release engineers with approved best-fit BOM strategies, subsystems, components, specifications, and technical criteria.
* Approve BOM selections, peer reviews, program Statements of Requirements, and sourcing recommendations within the role’s delegated authority.
* Ensure the availability, accuracy, and traceability of engineering math, cost, quality, performance, and other imperative data.
* Review complex technical proposals, identify risks and tradeoffs, and provide clear corrective actions and decision recommendations.
* Lead HVAC module integration across component-level technical areas and ensure that subsystem requirements are complete, compatible, and robust.
* Guide requirements definition, design, analysis, development, validation, release, and engineering change control.

job_title: Customer Service and Supply Chain Specialist
description:
**Customer Service and Supply Chain Specialist**

**Sumida America Inc. | Searcy, Arkansas**

**Join Our Team**

Sumida America Inc. is seeking a highly motivated **Customer Service and Supply Chain Specialist** to join our team in Searcy, Arkansas. This salaried exempt position plays a key role in ensuring exceptional customer service while supporting purchasing, inventory management, production planning, and supply chain operations within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, analytical, organized, and capable of building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal teams.

**Position Summary**

The Customer Service and Supply Chain Specialist is responsible for managing customer relationships, coordinating order fulfillment, forecasting demand, and supporting purchasing activities for production components, magnet wire, MRO items, and services. This role serves as a critical link between customers, suppliers, manufacturing, sales, and operations to ensure timely delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service & Order Management**

* Analyze customer demand through customer portals and direct communications.
* Manage and coordinate the customer order fulfillment process.
* Develop manufacturing schedules based on customer requirements and forecasts.
* Communicate with customers regarding pricing, order acknowledgments, and shipment notifications.
* Ensure customer adherence to established business processes and agreements.
* Resolve customer concerns professionally and ethically.
* Process returns and coordinate replacement products or credit memos.

**Production Planning & Forecasting**

* Analyze sales trends and historical data to develop forecasts.
* Assist with production demand planning and scheduling.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and cost-saving opportunities.

**Purchasing & Supply Chain**

* Issue purchase orders for MRO goods and services.
* Monitor MRP requirements and forecasted component demand.
* Purchase production materials and components to support customer programs and manufacturing schedules.
* Assist with supplier negotiations and sourcing activities.
* Support supplier development and qualification efforts.
* Monitor supplier performance and help resolve shortages, quality concerns, and delivery issues.
* Track inbound materials and coordinate expedited freight when necessary.
* Assist in controlling purchased material costs.

**Inventory & Supplier Management**

* Oversee component inventory management.
* Support supplier scorecard and on-time delivery reporting.
* Maintain awareness of supplier operations and market conditions affecting supply.

**Team & Quality Systems Support**

* Cross-train with coworkers to provide backup coverage.
* Participate in ISO 14001 and IATF quality and environmental management activities.
* Perform additional customer service and purchasing duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* Strong computer proficiency and experience using business software systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization abilities.
* Outstanding customer service skills with a commitment to professionalism and teamwork.
* Ability to build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Manufacturing or automotive industry experience.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Knowledge of inventory management and demand planning processes.
* Purchasing or supply chain experience in a manufacturing environment.

**What We Are Looking For**

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative and customer-focused mindset.
* Professionalism, integrity, and respect for others.

**Work Environment**

* Primarily office-based environment.
* Limited exposure to manufacturing operations.
* Low noise level.
* Reasonable accommodations will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities.

**Physical Requirements**

* Regular sitting, speaking, hearing, and computer use.
* Occasional standing and walking.
* Occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds.
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Benefits**

Sumida America Inc. offers a competitive compensation package and benefits program, including opportunities for professional growth in a global manufacturing organization.

**Apply Today**

Interested candidates should submit a resume outlining their qualifications and relevant experience.

**Location:** Searcy, AR
**Job Type:** Full-Time
**FLSA Status:** Exempt
**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**Sumida America Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

**Job Description:**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Team Overview:**

Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) is a sub-line of business within Global Risk Management (GRM). EIT is responsible for developing consistent and coherent analytical tools and tests for effective risk and capital measurement, management, and reporting across Bank of America. EIT partners with the Lines of Business and Enterprise function to ensure the capabilities it builds address both internal and regulatory requirements and are responsive to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions, and emerging risks. In executing its activities, EIT drives innovation, process improvement, and automation.

EIT is transforming the way testing is built and executed through digital transformation, automation, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing technologies. EIT carries a portfolio of 8,000+ tests and has a global footprint of testing professionals across the United States, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, as well as Global Business Services (GBS) associates.

**Job Description:**

Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) has established itself as the enterprise utility for testing all end-to-end processes on behalf of the Second Line of Defense, Frontline Units (FLUs), and Control Functions (CFs), enabling more efficient and effective testing.

Production support specialist ensures the stability and continuous operation of live test production environment. Responsibilities include resolving incidents, monitoring system health, password management, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) to prevent repeat issues.

This role is responsible for developing capabilities such as models, analytical tools, and testing scripts that provide timely, actionable insights into the operational health of Bank of America’s processes. Key responsibilities include working with process owners to understand data, process flows, and controls; identifying risks; and designing effective testing and monitoring. Job expectations include creating methodologies to evaluate process and control effectiveness and compliance with laws, rules, and policies.

**Responsibilities:**

* Embodies EIT core skills: critical thinking, decisiveness, enterprise mindset, proactivity, project management, risk management, adaptability, collaboration, customer and client focus, effective written and verbal communication, and control rigor and discipline
* Partners effectively with process and data owners in the FLUs/CFs, risk managers, Global Compliance Operational Risk (GCOR), and various teams within EIT that provide operational, data sourcing, and technology infrastructure support. Methodology outputs are used to drive process improvements and timely detection and reporting of errors
* Uses methodology outputs, including analytical tools and testing scripts, to drive process improvements and timely detection of errors
* Communicates effectively to explain the rationale, methodology details, and results to a broad set of audiences, including key senior stakeholders across the Bank, auditors, and regulators
* Applies experience in process and operational excellence

**Required Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in fields including, but not limited to, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Process and Mechanical Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Accounting, or Business Administration, or equivalent work experience

**Position Overview:**

As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in identifying, pursuing, and securing new business opportunities within the engineering consulting sector. This position requires a strategic thinker with a proven track record of successfully managing and closing projects, coupled with a strong aptitude for cultivating and maintaining client relationships.

This is a full-time permanent position in our Philadelphia office.

Department

Project Delivery - Zone 5

Employment Type

Permanent - Full Time

Location

Philadelphia, PA

Workplace type

Onsite

Compensation

$86,000 - $110,000 / year

Reporting To

Greg Thompson

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Responsibilities:**

**Business Development:** Responsible for effectively sourcing, negotiating, and facilitating new business.

**Proposal and Contract Management:** Creating and delivering proposals inclusive of scope, fees, and qualifications for public and client RFPs.

**Client Relationship Management:** Responsible for developing strong working relationships with clients.

**Project Oversight:** Assembling and guiding a team of RWDI consultants toward meeting project objectives by overseeing the preparation of documentation developed by the technical team.

**Project Performance**: Accountable for project performance, on-time and quality delivery, and ensuring client expectations are met or exceeded.

**Financial Management:** Manage financial activities of the project including tracking revenue, issuing invoices, and recovering receivables.

**Quality Assurance:** Ensuring that Quality Assurances are completed, recorded, and meet company standards and project scope.

**Innovation:** Track industry developments and innovations to ensure that RWDI continuously delivers relevant services and new and innovative deliverables.

**Presentations and Conferences:** Regularly develop and deliver presentations at project meetings/workshops and industry events.

Learn about our **Projects****.**

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**
---------------------------------

**Qualifications** (*If you possess 80% of the qualifications listed, please apply since you may have additional skills that would align well with this role*)**:**

* Proven experience in business development and project management within the engineering consulting sector.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* Understanding of building design and construction process, codes, standards, and protocols.
* Strong understanding of engineering principles and the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to clients effectively.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
* Results-oriented with a demonstrated ability to meet and exceed targets.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Willingness to travel as needed.
* Ability to travel to the USA.

**Job Benefits**
----------------

**Compensation:**

* Salary Range: $86,000.00 -$110,000.00
* Annual Performance Bonus
* Paid Vacation
* Group Health Benefits
* RSP Matching
* Learning Spending Account
* Fitness Spending Account

Thank you in advance for your application. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

RWDI endorses and practices the principles of equal opportunity employment. We are committed to diversity and inclusion.

Accommodations are available during all stages of the recruitment process.

AI is not used in the recruitment process.

**About RWDI**
--------------

RWDI is a leading climate and performance engineering firm that has been helping clients tackle complex engineering challenges in the built environment for more than 50 years. With deep technical expertise, we drive success on ambitious building, industry, and infrastructure projects — enhancing performance, resiliency, and efficiency. Our extensive technical services span every project stage to help maximize performance while minimizing environmental impact. With a team of more than 800 engineers, scientists, and sustainability specialists in more than 30 offices across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region, we’re a truly global company.

Philadelphia, PA

**ABOUT SOTHEBY'S**

Established in 1744, Sotheby's promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby's and Concierge. Sotheby's Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby's new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

**THE ROLE**

Working as a Senior Specialist in the Books and Manuscripts department in New York, but focusing on all aspects of the business including sourcing, estimating, and cataloguing property for auction and private sales, and overseeing the coordination of sales in New York and London (and sale series that include London and Paris, as needed). In addition, this person will assist with aligning the global sale calendar with an emphasis on New York and London, developing key client relationships, and participating in business getting with oversight of major trade, private, and institutional consignments.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Sale Process

* Work with the Head of Americas, Business Managers, and colleagues in both London and Paris to meet the annual operating plan for the Americas
* Ensure property is added to the sale running list and consult with the Head of Department and Business Manager regarding any promises made to the clients
* Participate in proposal meetings and strategy for competitive business getting
* Interact with Press and Marketing departments on relevant properties as necessary, creating unified marketing campaigns for appropriate property
* Responsible for Books and Manuscripts sales in New York, working with other department members to ensure sales are properly researched, catalogued, and estimated. Duties include print and digital catalogue layout and design, drafting catalogue entries, and providing accurate condition reports
* Negotiate sale terms, explain processes and procedures, and provide service to clients throughout the sale process, both for auction and private sale
* Aid in ensuring adherence to compliance policies throughout sale processes
* Working with the Operations team to conceptualize and execute exhibitions and their installations
* Produce copy for, and coordinate the design, of proposals
* Engage in insurance and fair market value appraisals
* Assist in resolving post sale issues

Client Development

* Develop new and manage existing client contacts and strategic opportunities in the field of Books and Manuscripts with a focus on business getting as a part of a coordinated effort within an International Department
* Identify and maintain relationships with clients, dealers, and collectors
* Develop key consignors and buyer relationships

**IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES**

* Bachelor's degree required, with an advanced degree in a related field preferred
* At least five years of experience with an auction house or major dealer
* Experience and expertise in the field of Books and Manuscripts, with an emphasis on managing various and single owner sales
* Self-starter and proven ability to initiate business
* A team player with excellent communication skills
* Organized, thorough, focused, with a passion and commitment to the field
* Professional and discreet client service skills
* Excellent writing and organizational skills
* Ability to maintain composure in a stressful environment and meet constant deadlines
* Strong multi-tasker
* Knowledge of the auction business both in the US, UK, and Europe

Key Goals for This Position

* Build strong running lists for live sale series, while cultivating complementary running lists for parallel online sales without conflicting or competing property
* Adherence to sale cataloguing and sale deadlines, optimizing the effectiveness of Marketing (video, editorial, and social media) and Press campaigns
* Overseeing sale outreach, including liaising with Client Strategy, following up with existing clients, and engaging our new bidders

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $120,000-$170,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.

description:
This is the technical lead on go-to-market for AI Solutions, GLG's new human-data business. You build the researcher relationships, own every technical conversation, and design work we can deliver.

**The role**
------------

AI Solutions puts GLG's expert network to work on AI training data and expert evaluations for frontier labs. Our aim is to lead the top of the market: high-stakes professional domains.

You are the GM's partner in the market and share one revenue target. The GM runs the commercial side of each deal. You run the technical side: the relationship with the researcher, the quality and measurement discussion, and the design of the program. You are also a hunter, building pipeline through the research community.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Researcher relationships.** Build direct relationships with researchers, post-training teams and eval leads before there is an RFP. Bring back what labs are buying and where current vendors fall short.
* Source opportunities through those relationships and in the field: events, conferences and dinners where researchers spend time.
* **Technical discovery.** Find which capability a lab is trying to improve. Use GLG experts to surface where a model fails in a domain and turn that finding into a pilot.
* **Program design.** Define the task, rubric, output format and difficulty target so the work measures what the lab cares about.
* **Panel design.** Decide with the Strategic Project Lead who qualifies for the expert panel and how it is calibrated. You own it together and sign off with each other.
* **Quality methodology.** Own the QA conversation and the math behind it: gold sets, agreement metrics, sampling and acceptance thresholds. Go head-to-head with researchers on it.
* **Pilot to program.** Set the success criteria for each pilot and help convert it into a production contract.
* Write the technical sections of bids and build reusable materials so every sale is easier than the last.
* **Credibility strategy.** Decide with the GM and Delivery which benchmarks, evals and other proof GLG needs to win its domains.

**How you work with the team**
------------------------------

The GM owns pricing, terms and the close. You own the technical promise we make to the client. A Strategic Project Lead co-owns scoping with you, then sources the experts, staffs the panel, pressure-tests the collection approach, and owns delivery with the VP of Operations.

As we add sellers, you become their technical counterpart on every deal, or move into a selling role of your own.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

* Technical depth first. Credible with a frontier-lab researcher, well beyond "AI fluent" in the enterprise-sales sense.
* Has designed, scoped or delivered human-data, evaluation or benchmark work for AI labs.
* Knows the work: expert-authored evals, rubric design, preference data and post-training, in domains such as financial services, life sciences, trust & safety, etc.
* Strong on the statistics of quality: agreement metrics, gold sets, sampling and acceptance thresholds.
* Comfortable getting hands-on with model outputs and eval results.
* A hunter's instinct: you build your own relationships, want to share a revenue number, and like being in the field.
* Comfortable building in ambiguity on a founding team.

Likely backgrounds: a solutions engineer at a human-data vendor, a technical project lead who ran lab programs and wants to move to the front of the deal, or an evaluation specialist who wants to work with customers.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **The supply others lack.** Sourcing senior experts is the hard part of this market. GLG's expert network is the business we are built on.
* **A founding seat.** You write the playbook, shape the offering, and set the standard for who we hire next.
* **Direct access.** You work with lab researchers and with GLG leadership, with no layers in between.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**Compensation:** This role offers a competitive compensation package, consisting of base salary and a performance-based bonus.

The anticipated hiring base salary range for this role is: $150,000 - $200,000 USD

GLG is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation is based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. Certain roles may also be eligible for incentive compensation.

* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage effective on your first day of employment
* Flexible paid time off. No pre-determined limits on vacation time, plus 10 company holidays
* 401(k) and Roth 401(k) plans with an employer match (subject to annual limits & vesting)
* Tuition reimbursement program for eligible courses including language skills courses

description:
It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better.

We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing.

**Job Title**

Senior Indirect Category Specialist Technical MRO & Plant ServicesThe Senior Indirect Category Specialist, Technical MRO & Plant Services is responsible for developing and executing category strategies across technical MRO, maintenance services, production tooling, refractory products, engineered consumables, and other indirect categories, requiring cross-functional qualification and implementation. This role serves as the link between Procurement, Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, and Plant Leadership to identify sourcing opportunities, qualify supplier alternatives, and drive adoption of enterprise sourcing strategies.

The position is responsible for transforming fragmented plant-level spend into managed categories through supplier segmentation, category roadmaps, sourcing initiatives, qualification programs, and performance management. The role leads strategic sourcing projects focused on total cost of ownership, supply continuity, equipment reliability, and operational performance.

***\\* We are an ITAR Regulated Company and to be considered for Employment with us you must be either a US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident\\*\\****

***\\*\\*This role is Onsite at our Golden, CO Global Headquarters location\\*\\****

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Category Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute category strategies for technical MRO, maintenance services, production tooling, refractory products, engineered consumables, and other assigned indirect categories.

description:
HNI Corporation is a global family of brands for the workplace and home dedicated to enhancing the spaces where we live, work, and gather. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment where we make a positive impact on others, upholding our beliefs in integrity, inclusion and belonging.

**Your Impact Starts the Day You Do!**
--------------------------------------

### **What We Need:**

We are looking for a **Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our Corporate team as part of HNI’s Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence.

You will connect talented people with meaningful opportunities across HNI’s operating companies and partner with leaders to build teams that move our business forward. Through full-cycle recruiting, strategic advising, and continuous improvement, you will help deliver strong hiring outcomes and a welcoming experience for internal and external candidates.

### **What You Will Do:**

* **Own full-cycle recruitment** for professional, salaried positions, from intake and sourcing through screening, interviewing, selection debriefs, offer negotiation, and hiring completion.
* Lead complex searches, including leadership-level, niche, hard-to-fill, and multi-site roles, using tailored sourcing and assessment strategies.
* Partner with hiring managers, Member & Community Relations, and other stakeholders to understand current and anticipated workforce needs and recommend short- and long-term recruiting strategies.
* Share market intelligence on talent availability, competitor activity, and compensation trends to establish realistic expectations and inform hiring and offer decisions.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, job boards, social media, and other sourcing channels.
* Coach hiring managers on structured interviewing and consistent, equitable assessment practices while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and supported throughout the process.
* Own performance against recruiting metrics and service-level targets, including time to fill and requisition aging; proactively address risks, escalate barriers, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence initiatives, strengthen recruiting processes, and serve as a resource and mentor to other team members as needed.

### **What You Have:**

* **5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience** supporting professional, salaried positions across multiple functions and organizational levels.
* Proven success partnering with hiring managers and leadership to support organizational success through talent acquisition.
* Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, including advanced and Boolean searches, projects, pipeline management, and metrics.
* Expertise using a variety of sourcing methods and tools to identify, attract, and engage qualified talent.
* Strong negotiation and closing skills, including experience managing complex offers through acceptance.
* Working knowledge of employment laws and regulations affecting recruiting, including equal employment opportunity, pay transparency, and immigration and sponsorship requirements.
* **Preferred:** A blend of agency and in-house recruiting experience, along with experience recruiting for leadership-level or hard-to-fill technical roles.

### **What You’re Good At:**

* **Being a trusted advisor:** You work independently while consulting closely with hiring managers and leaders to translate business needs into effective hiring strategies.
* **Influencing thoughtfully:** You offer clear recommendations and constructively challenge assumptions to align on realistic candidate profiles, timelines, and compensation.
* **Engaging candidates:** You craft compelling outreach and use every conversation to help candidates understand the value of HNI career opportunities.
* **Managing competing priorities:** You efficiently handle a high volume of requisitions while maintaining attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
* **Adapting to change:** You adjust your approach as business priorities, hiring needs, and market conditions evolve.
* **Improving results:** You use recruiting data to identify barriers, take action, and strengthen hiring outcomes.
* **Collaborating and sharing expertise:** You build productive relationships, support teammates, and contribute to consistent practices across operating companies.

### **Working Conditions and Travel:**

This role primarily works in an office environment with ongoing low-level noise, significant computer use, and sitting or standing at a designated workspace for much of the scheduled workday. No special safety equipment is required. **Minimal travel, less than 10% annually, is expected.**

**Ready to make an impact? Join us in connecting great talent with opportunities across HNI.**

**About Us:**

Afinitas, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a global leader in equipment, forming systems, and essential accessory products that support transportation, water, and utility precast concrete infrastructure worldwide. We provide industry-leading production equipment; highly engineered formwork; and a broad portfolio of precast concrete, electrical, and construction accessories, along with structural products and systems designed for bridge, highway, and heavy construction applications. Afinitas is part of BW Forsyth Partners, LLC, the investment group of global manufacturing and engineering consulting firm Barry-Wehmiller, a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members, united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

**Job Description:**

Location: Remote (Midwest Preferred)

Employment Type: Contract

Afinitas is seeking a Contract Sourcing Specialist to help build candidate pipelines for frontline production and manufacturing positions across multiple locations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding talent, engaging candidates, and helping organizations fill critical manufacturing positions. You'll partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to identify and connect with production employees, skilled trades professionals, and other manufacturing talent needed to support our growing operations.

While this is a remote position, we are seeking candidates located in the Midwest who are familiar with regional labor markets and manufacturing talent pools.

What You'll Do

* Source candidates for production, assembly, machining, welding, maintenance, and other manufacturing roles.

* Build active talent pipelines across multiple sites and regions.

* Conduct candidate outreach through phone, email, text, social media, and recruiting platforms.

* Screen candidates and assess qualifications, availability, and interest.

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with recruiters and hiring managers.

* Maintain candidate records and sourcing activity within our ATS.

* Support hiring campaigns, workforce initiatives, and recruiting events as needed.

* Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill manufacturing positions.

What We're Looking For

* Experience sourcing or recruiting for manufacturing, production, warehouse, industrial, or skilled trades positions.

* Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

* Experience using recruiting technology, job boards, and sourcing platforms.

* Familiarity with Midwest labor markets and manufacturing talent communities strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations is a plus.

Why Join Us

* Flexible contract opportunity.

* Fully remote work environment.

* Opportunity to partner with multiple manufacturing locations and make an immediate impact.

* Collaborative team focused on solving hiring challenges and building strong workforce pipelines.

* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

The approximate pay range for this position is $35 - $50/hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

If you're passionate about finding talent and building pipelines that help manufacturing operations succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

**Sourcing Specialist I**

Corporate

Full-Time

Manufacturing Sourcing

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in procurement or sourcing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP systems.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment.

**Build A Better Career**

* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
* Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

**Build A Better Future**

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement savings plans with company match

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. **Sims Global Solutions | Lenexa, KS | Full-Time**

**Open Deck Freight Experience Strongly Preferred | Heavy Haul / Over-Dimensional Experience Preferred**

We are continuing to expand our specialized transportation capabilities and are looking for an experienced **Open Deck Logistics Specialist** to join our team.

Position Overview

The Open Deck Logistics Specialist will manage and coordinate specialized freight shipments from initial quoting and carrier procurement through final delivery.

This position requires hands-on experience with open deck transportation, including flatbed, step deck, and other specialized trailer configurations. Experience coordinating heavy haul and over-dimensional shipments is highly preferred.

The ideal candidate understands the complexities of open deck freight, has established relationships within the carrier community, and can effectively manage pricing, carrier sourcing, customer communication, and shipment execution.

This is an opportunity to join an established logistics organization and contribute to the continued growth of our open deck and specialized transportation business.

Key Responsibilities

**Freight Operations & Execution**

* Manage open deck and specialized freight shipments from initial quote through successful delivery.
* Coordinate transportation involving flatbed, step deck, RGN, and other specialized equipment.
* Evaluate shipment requirements, including commodity specifications, dimensions, weight, loading requirements, and equipment needs.
* Coordinate shipment scheduling, pickup and delivery appointments, and ongoing shipment tracking.
* Identify potential transportation challenges and proactively develop solutions.
* Maintain consistent communication with customers, carriers, and internal operations teams.

**Heavy Haul & Over-Dimensional Transportation**

* Support the planning and execution of heavy haul and over-dimensional shipments.
* Understand specialized equipment requirements, including RGN, stretch trailers, and other open deck configurations.
* Coordinate with carriers and appropriate partners regarding permits, escorts, route restrictions, and other specialized transportation requirements.
* Help ensure shipments are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable transportation regulations.

**Customer Service & Business Growth**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and carrier partners.
* Provide timely shipment updates and resolve operational issues.
* Collaborate with sales and operations teams to identify and develop additional open deck and specialized freight opportunities.
* Support the continued growth of Sims Global Solutions' heavy haul and specialized transportation capabilities.

Required Qualifications

* **Minimum of 2 years of recent experience in open deck freight brokerage, carrier procurement, or logistics operations.**
* Working knowledge of flatbed, step deck, and specialized open deck transportation.
* Experience sourcing carriers, negotiating freight rates, and coordinating shipments.
* Understanding of equipment selection, load dimensions, weight restrictions, and transportation requirements.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with transportation management systems, load boards, and standard business software.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience coordinating heavy haul and over-dimensional freight.
* Familiarity with RGN, stretch trailers, multi-axle configurations, and specialized equipment.
* Understanding of permitting, escort requirements, route surveys, and oversize/overweight transportation regulations.
* Established relationships with open deck and specialized transportation carriers.
* Experience supporting project-based freight, construction, industrial, energy, or infrastructure transportation.

Compensation & Benefits

Sims Global Solutions offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Multiple medical insurance plan options
* Dental and vision insurance
* Retirement plan with company match up to 3%
* Paid time off
* Modern, collaborative office environment
* On-site 3,000-square-foot fitness center
* On-site showers, laundry facilities, and kitchen

Join Our Team

If you have experience in open deck freight and enjoy the challenges of specialized transportation, we want to hear from you.

Join a growing logistics organization where your knowledge, relationships, and ability to execute complex shipments will make a direct impact.

**Sims Global Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight, and we use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Our customers around the globe rely on us for the information and tools they need to make critical investment decisions and remain connected across all sides of the financial community. And, to ensure the best experience for our 20,000+ employees across 176 offices globally, we provide the spaces and systems that allow our teams to work together with agility, productivity and collaboration, no matter where they are.

The Bloomberg Financial Solutions department of 5,000+ employees is at the forefront of ensuring success for our customers and employees alike. Our team comprises several key pillars: sales, service, operations, culture and brand. As a department, we are united by a common goal: We create meaningful relationships with clients by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support from sales and implementation, through their ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

**Our Team:**

Our Sales teams are industry renowned for their subject matter expertise and platinum service levels. You’ll benefit from exceptional training, not just when you join us, but continually throughout your career here. Just like we invest in our products, we invest in our people.

**What's the role?**

As a Senior Account Manager in Core Terminal Sales team, based in New York, you’ll cover leading financial markets institutions leveraging the product at the center of our business, the Bloomberg Terminal. You’ll develop a deep understanding of your clients’ workflows, technology, and data landscape, and use that context to deliver solutions that stick. You’ll build senior relationships that strengthen long-term partnerships and ensure Bloomberg remains embedded in how clients work.

You’ll be responsible for protecting and expanding existing client partnerships by defending renewals and competitive situations, while also building a healthy pipeline through disciplined lead sourcing. You will partner closely with Relationship Managers, Product Specialists, and Specialist Sales teams to execute account strategies and contribute to the broader success of our clients, team, and business.

**We’ll trust you to:**

- Develop deep, trusted relationships across your client base, from end users through desk heads and senior decision makers, to understand priorities, demonstrate Bloomberg’s value and protect existing revenue

- Build a strong understanding of your clients’ roles, workflows and business needs, using thoughtful questioning to identify gaps and position relevant Bloomberg functionality and solutions that deepen product adoption

- Take a strategic view across your account coverage to identify opportunities to expand Bloomberg’s footprint across Terminal, Enterprise products and data solutions

- Partner closely with Relationship Managers, product specialists and Enterprise teams to qualify opportunities, develop account strategies and progress revenue opportunities with key stakeholders and decision makers

- Develop deep expertise in Bloomberg’s solutions, financial markets and client segments, applying that knowledge to help clients optimize their workflows and identify opportunities where Bloomberg can provide additional value

- Proactively identify risks and opportunities across your accounts, including competitive threats, underutilized solutions and client needs that could inform product enhancements or create new commercial opportunities

- Contribute beyond your day-to-day account responsibilities by sharing successful strategies and best practices, supporting broader sales and departmental initiatives, mentoring colleagues, leading campaigns and contributing to product development

**You’ll need to have:**

- Experience in Account Management or a Sales-related role, supporting financial services clients

- Proven consultative sales skills, including competitive market research, lead generation, prospecting, business development and closing sales

- Experience in building and maintaining client relationships both externally and internally

- Strong presentation and communication skills

- Experience in one or more of the following asset classes: Fixed Income, Equities, FX, Futures, and other Derivatives

- The ability for regular travel

**We’d love to see:**

- Prior experience or knowledge of the Bloomberg product suite.

* Have a results-driven approach to recruiting, developing and improving our sourcing strategies for both active and passive candidates.
* Participate in special projects/recruiting initiatives as needed.
* Full-cycle candidate management.

* Minimum 2 years of manufacturing recruiting experience including full life cycle in an agency or corporate environment.
* Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches.
* Associate's Degree - HR or related field.
* Proficiency with ATS Systems and sourcing tools.

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Experience working in a high volume, multi-site environment.
* iCims Experience.

JC-534763

Vegetation Management Specialist

SENIOR ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST (SPECIALIST)

$7,820.00 - $10,732.00 per Month

New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.

**Final Filing Date:** **10/27/2026**

**Application Methods:**

Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account)

By Mail

Drop-off

Print Job

Save Job

### **Job Description and Duties**

Are you looking to be a part of a dynamic team of conservation-minded scientists working to protect fish and wildlife resources in the redwood and Douglas fir forests, oak woodlands, chaparral, and grasslands of the San Francisco Bay Area? The Department of Fish and Wildlife's Wildfire Resiliency Program is seeking a motivated professional to work as a Senior Environmental Scientist Specialist reviewing and evaluating vegetation management and fuel reduction projects, and Timber Emergencies and Exemptions by analyzing consequences of proposed activities, attending site visits and inspections, preparing written reports and recommendations for the conservation of fish and wildlife resources, assessing the application of law, regulation and policy, conducting listed and sensitive species consultations, and preparing any related Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreements and Incidental Take Permits.

The incumbent works in close collaboration with other Environmental Scientists and Senior Environmental Scientists, and with other state agencies. Under the direction of a Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisory) the incumbent represents the region and acts as the staff lead and provides consultative advice when working with applicants, local, state and federal agencies, stakeholders, and the general public. Public contacts made in the course of this work are sensitive and involve a wide variety of special interest groups.

Performance of specified activities will require an in-depth knowledge of administrative procedures, Department policies, applicable environmental laws and regulations, and ecological principles to protect fish and wildlife resources. Strong written and oral communication skills are necessary. Problem-solving, organizational skills and a positive attitude towards teamwork are essential. Fieldwork in rugged terrain is required.

**Personal Leave Program:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary salary reductions ranging from 2% to 4.62% in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) hours. Please note that the salary ranges listed in this Job Control may not reflect these reductions associated with the 2025 Personal Leave Program.

Please follow the link for more information regarding the 2025 Personal Leave program:

Personal Leave Program - Human Resources - CalHR.

This position may be eligible for a telework opportunity in accordance with departmental policies and operational needs. Beginning July 1, 2026, employees will be required to work in-person at least four (4) days per week in alignment with Executive Order N-22-25. Additional in-office days may be required based on operational needs.

**This position is a 12-month Limited Term (LT) and may be extended up to 24 months or become permanent.**

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Working Conditions**

The position requires the use of a computer for several hours each day, the completion of office tasks that require sitting, standing, and walking to other locations; attendance at meetings and participation in conference calls. The position may require frequent travel throughout the State including overnight travel, early mornings, and late nights (up to 20%). Must be able to work unusual and/or long hours; spend multiple days in the field assessing habitat conditions in inclement weather; walk in and through rough terrain; and hike over uneven, steep, wet, and rough terrain with no vehicle access. Must possess a valid driver’s license and be able to safely drive a motor vehicle (with and without four-wheel drive) off highway and over rough terrain. The position requires the use of personal protective equipment, including protective footwear, hardhat, gloves, helmet, and eye protection. The position may require the incumbent to wear a uniform identifying the employee as Department staff.

This position is located at the CDFW, Bay Delta Region field office in Santa Rosa, California. The position may be eligible
