This position is incentive eligible.

Do you want to join an organization that invests in you as a Senior Contracts Manager? At HealthTrust, you come first. HCA Healthcare has committed up to $300 million in programs to support our incredible team members over the course of three years.

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**

The Senior Contracts Manager is responsible for negotiating industry leading national agreements for HCA. Objective is to ensure best in class industry pricing and contract terms and conditions.
Position's key area of focus will be sourcing initiatives that are primarily categories with low to medium spend, complexity, risk and sensitivity. Position may have some responsibility for other types of categories for the purposes of development and workload allocation.
Individual must possess knowledge or prior experience in principles and concepts related to sourcing and contract management. Individual has knowledge of the industry or organization, processes, suppliers, customers, and contract terms/conditions. Individual will follow standard practices and policies in analyzing situations and data and solve a range of straightforward problems.

Individual demonstrates project leadership for back office team members (legal, contract administration, etc.).

What you will do in this role:

Project Management

* Ability to plan and execute project timelines for assigned categories, with guidance from manager.

Must have:

* Demonstrated level of organizational ability and attention to detail
* Ability to translate objectives into project planning priorities, create and manage work plans and timelines for multiple projects and priorities, and finalize negotiations in the time-frame designated for the project
* Ability to be highly efficient and productive without sacrificing quality

Category Knowledge

* Understanding or aptitude to learn the product categories assigned and how end-users’ interface with the products.
* Understanding or demonstrated ability to learn in-depth aspects of portfolio:
* Product features and benefits
* Product comparisons between supplier offerings
* Operational impact to provider
* Interpretation and use of market information provided by global sourcing team
* Future product pipe-line and impact on market
* Interpretation of current and new FDA 510k filings

Supplier Knowledge

* Individual must be able to develop and use knowledge about supplier to develop strategies, create leverage, mitigate risks, anticipate direction of the market and potential supplier direction. Includes, but not limited to:
* Discuss future product pipelines with suppliers
* Review current or future technology
* Investigate new supplier entrants to market
* Future product pipe-line and impact on market

Strategy Development, Validation, and Risk Mitigation

* The individual will develop the strategy with the guidance of their manager and in collaboration with HCA Service Lines and Supply Chain leadership.
* Individual will seek guidance of manager for risk issues and agreed upon risk mitigation strategies. For these categories, the individual will develop the strategy, identify risks, and develop a risk mitigation plan. Individual will present that information to their manager for discussion and approval

Sourcing Process

* Thorough understanding and accountability for the sourcing process for their assigned portfolio. Including market research, bid preparation, RFI, Strategy Development & Validation, RFP, Contract Negotiations, and contract launch.
* Supplier and Customer Relationship Management:
* Oversee supplier relationship during the sourcing process. Participate in supplier business reviews and review new products/technologies as they arise in assigned categories.
* Build strong relationships with senior level supplier contacts.

Customer

* Build strong customer relationships through frequent interaction (all levels, including executive).
* Effective and efficient communications with internal stakeholders and suppliers, with limited communication to customers. Includes:
* Facilitate conversations with internal functional team during project kick-off to gather feedback, opinions, and alignment of resource needs to meet contracting initiative timelines
* Communication of bid process, negotiation status, agreement on terms, financial proposal concerns and other matters with supplier and internal team
* Engaging customers through one-on-one conversations to articulate business strategy and resolve customer specific issues/concerns with contracting strategy or outcome

Collaboration

* Collaboration required with functional team throughout sourcing process:
* With HCA Service Line and Supply Chain and Clinical leadership
* With HealthTrust GPO counterparts on complementary strategy
* With legal staff on development and finalization of contract
* With financial analysts on assessing supplier proposals
* With contract analysts on product/price loading of awarded agreements

Ranked in the Top 20 of the Forbes Best-In-State Companies in 2026, Sun World International is a California-based agriculture and technology firm engaged in fruit variety development, technology, intellectual property, and licensing. Technology and IP pursuits include one of the world’s leading fruit breeding/genetics programs, a broad-based portfolio of plant patents and trademarks and investments in agriculture technology start-ups benefiting its global licensees. The Company prizes creativity, innovation, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Its people strive for excellence by demonstrating leadership, passion, kindness, authenticity, courage, initiative, and curiosity.

**About the Department:**

The Farming & Operations team provides the foundation for Sun World's global breeding and research programs. The team is responsible for creating and maintaining high-quality table grape and fruit tree crops that enable breeders and scientists to evaluate, select, and advance the next generation of proprietary fruit varieties. Through expert crop management, operational excellence, infrastructure development, and continuous innovation, the team ensures that Sun World's research farms consistently deliver reliable, high-quality results that support the company's long-term breeding objectives.

The **Senior Manager - California Farming & Operations** is responsible for leading farming & operations across Sun World's California research and trialing locations, including the company's flagship R&D headquarters in Wasco and additional research sites in Cutler and Coachella, California.

This role holds a critical leadership position within the R&D organization, leading through the Farm Manager, Specialists, and external farm-management partners to ensure research crops are managed to the highest standards in open-field and greenhouse environments, while maintaining facilities in excellent condition to provide a safe, functional, and professional work environment.

Success in this role requires strong technical expertise in crop production, exceptional leadership and communication skills, sound business judgment, experience in site operations activities, and the ability to solve complex agricultural and operations challenges in a dynamic research environment while delivering results against agreed goals and KPIs set by the team and leadership.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Senior Manager - California Farming & Operations is responsible for creating the growing environments and ensuring optimal facilities that enable Sun World's breeding programs to succeed. By leading people, optimizing operations, and ensuring exceptional crop performance, this role directly contributes to the development of future Sun World varieties and the long-term success of the company's global innovation pipeline.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Leadership & Team Development

* Provide leadership, direction, and coaching to farming teams across Sun World's California operations.
* Directly manage key personnel at the Wasco research site, including the Farm Manager, technical specialists, Facilities and Procurement Specialist and other operational staff.
* Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.
* Develop talent, succession plans, and professional growth opportunities for team members.
* Promote strong communication and alignment across Farming & Operations, Breeding, and Business functions.

2. California Farming & Operations Leadership

* Provide overall operational leadership for Sun World's California research and trialing locations in Wasco, Cutler, and Coachella.
* Oversee crop production plans, resource allocation, operational scheduling, and field execution.
* Responsible for maintaining our sites, including laboratory, offices, show rooms, at a high standard to allow researchers, employees and visitors to operate in safe, first-class facilities.
* Partner with breeding teams to ensure field operations support research objectives and breeding strategies.

3. Safety and Health

* Lead Safety and Health efforts in our California R&D facilities and fields.
* Identify risks, create contingency plans and procedures and all OSHA requirements that will keep our team members safe and healthy.
* Compliance with OSHA requirements.
* Implement a culture of safety
* Training related to safety, including vehicle safety
* Liaison with safety related vendors and service companies, such as fire and alarm systems
* Ensure compliance with pesticide regulations, re-entry intervals, storage requirements, and application protocols.

4. Research Crop Management

* Ensure crop management practices are tailored to the unique needs of breeding populations, trials, and advanced selections.
* Maintain healthy, uniform, and high-performing plant material that enables accurate evaluation and selection by breeders.

Oversee the implementation of best practices in irrigation, nutrition, pest management, pruning, canopy manage

**Job Description:**
The Sr. Strategic Sourcing Manager, Category Partnerships will lead regional Procurement engagement with the global Strategic Sourcing Categories across Direct and Indirect categories on behalf of Mars Snacking North America (MSNA). This Associate will own the Procurement relationship with assigned strategic sourcing categories, and act as the primary point of contact for related business partners. This role may also be responsible for the end-to-end sourcing of regional materials.

**Job Level Descriptor:**

* Strategic Category Management and Source-to-Contract Activities
* Supplier Relationship Management and Governance
* Regional Leadership and Stakeholder Management

Key Responsibilities

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* Regional Sourcing Commercial Leadership: Directs the end-to-end sourcing strategy and execution for all regionally segmented categories. Provides critical leadership in representation of the region to deliver on key business objectives.
* Global Partnership Performance Accountability: Acts as the primary strategic liaison between the region, center of excellence and Mars Global Services, championing regional needs and priorities. Ensures partners are held accountable for delivering against key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for Procurement related activities and objectives.

What are we looking for?

* 7-10 years of experience with strategic sourcing, supplier/customer management, innovation management and business partnering.
* Total Delivered Cost Reduction and Working Capital Improvements
* Supplier Performance Relationship Management
* Adapts and executes functional or departmental business plans and contributes to the development of functional strategy (3-5 years).
* Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional projects and leading team members in a matrixed or dotted-line reporting environment.
* Negotiation Influence: Exceptional negotiation, stakeholder management, and communication skills to influence both local teams and global corporate centers.
* A passion for driving value for our business by leveraging various sourcing channels.
* Bachelors degree required, Masters degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance preferred
* CPSM, CIPs or equivalent preferred

Job Specifications/Qualifications

Education Professional Qualifications

* Minimum requirement of Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain/Logistics/Materials Management or Finance and/or the equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* MBA or other Master’s degree preferred
* CPM/CPSM, CIPS or other analogous professional certification preferred

Knowledge / Experience

Minimum 7-10 years of Procurement and General Supply Chain experience in a progressive environment which includes strong working knowledge in the following: Strategic Sourcing, Negotiations and Contracting, SRM/SPM programs, continuous improvement programs, risk mitigation strategies. Breadth and depth in:

* Strong experiences in strategic sourcing methodology, e-sourcing, state-of-the-art risk management tools and supplier management programs. Experience in commodity markets and/or materials sourcing preferred
* Strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills enabling effective work within cross-functional teams. Excellent communication skills across all levels within the business
* Strong People Leadership experience in both linear and matrixed environments
* Strong project management experience with deep expertise in business financials, analytics problem-solving
* Strong crisis management and conflict resolution skills with demonstrated ability to identify “root causes” of issues and determine course of action to meet short- and long-term business needs.
* Experience in managing dynamic business environments, where price stability, supply availability, and potential business outcomes are under continuous pressure and change.
* Proven supply chain management skills
* Proficient in Power BI, SAP and MRP systems

What can you expect from Mars?

* Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
* Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
* A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

**About the Team**

The Supply Chain team turns design intent into executable reality, balancing lead time, cost, complexity, and manufacturability to ensure we can build and scale Terran R. On this team, you're not just placing orders; you're actively shaping the solution. With full ownership across raw materials, capital equipment, and services, the role requires both strategic thinking and day-to-day execution. As the company scales, supply chain becomes increasingly central, working closely with engineering, quality, manufacturing, and more to make decisions that work for today but also for tomorrow. This is a team for those who want to operate at the intersection of technical ambition and business execution, driving tangible progress to keep the Terran R program on track

**About the Role**

* As a Global Supply Manager, Machining, you'll work closely with stakeholders across Propulsion Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain Planning, and more to design and scale both existing and novel supply chains in the sourcing and development of complex machined components that create a competitive advantage for the enterprise
* Lead sourcing and supplier management for custom machined components and major vehicle structures ensuring cost, quality, and delivery targets are achieved
* Develop and execute supply chain strategies, including supplier selection, long-term agreements, and capacity planning to support Terran-R build schedules
* Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, and Planning to influence design for manufacturability and align procurement with program milestones
* Drive supplier performance through rigorous risk management, contract negotiations, and milestone-based tracking Mentor and support team members, building expertise in precision machining processes and supplier development
* Act as a thought leader for machining commodities, continuously improving sourcing processes, supplier health, and program readiness

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or related field 5+ years of professional experience in supply chain, sourcing, or procurement
* Demonstrated experience managing suppliers for complex aerospace or advanced manufacturing commodities
* Proven track record of negotiating contracts and managing milestone-based agreements
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (LN, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) Knowledge of aerospace manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 5-axis milling, turning, precision grinding, EDM, and tight-tolerance fabrication

**Nice to Have**

* MBA or advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business, or Engineering Direct experience managing machining commodities in aerospace (CNC machined components, castings, forgings, sheet metal fabrication, extrusions, etc.)
* Familiarity with AS9100 and NADCAP standards (specifically for machining processes), supplier qualifications, and audit processes
* Proven success driving supplier performance improvements through KPIs, recovery plans, and long-term agreements New Product Development (NPD) or Introduction (NPI) supply chain experience, preferably within aerospace or frontier technology industries
* Proficiency in supplier risk assessment, machining cost modeling, and capacity planning Understanding of material specifications, surface treatments, and inspection requirements for aerospace-grade machined parts

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Foundry Advanced Packaging Sourcing Manager**

**THE ROLE:**

* Coordinate the management and spend of AMD’s strategic foundry suppliers with specific focus on post fab / advanced packaging services reporting to the Director Foundry Procurement.
* Develop the global procurement strategy for foundry with specific focus on post fab and advanced packaging; implementing a supplier development program that has a coordinated long-term approach on cost, quality, and service.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships.
* Provide analytical support and recommendations regarding sourcing strategies, requirements planning, and cost improvement.

**THE PERSON:**

* Problem Solving Specialist
* Drives sophisticated solutions and recommendations for complex issues through the analysis of the situation and available data.
* Exercises judgment in selecting the methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for acquiring results.
* Networks with key contacts outside area of expertise.
* Excellent communication & people skills.
* Capable of initiating and leading new projects to enable procurement scalability in support of AMD growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with partners and foundry team members to understand and develop negotiation strategies to drive cost targets.
* Develop, implement, and lead critical foundry procurement management processes based on feedback from team members and partners. This may include (but not limited to): NPI/NRE procurement program management / order execution, Spend/Savings reporting, support emergency ordering process, tracking payables/receivables initiatives, ongoing critical action tracking/reporting and accountability.
* Own the overall driven bidding process including analysis, price negotiation, and driving business awards.
* Implement contracts to minimize AMD risk and enable supplier accountability for non-performance
* Lead Supplier Performance Management (SPM) and be responsible for the quarterly scorecard process to review service levels on cost, technology, quality, service, and flexibility.
* Develop and optimally communicate a foundry post fab / advanced packaging commodity strategy which fully reflects key partner inputs to AMD Senior Management Team. Provide updates on a regular basis to supervise progress against plan.
* Collaborate and formalize foundry post fab / advanced packaging market research and benchmarking processes.
* Collaborates with suppliers to communicate AMD requirements.
* Ownership of spend, savings and forecasting for Foundry post fab / advanced packaging supplier.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive Founry or Semiconductor experience (specific to post fab and advanced packaging service offerings is ideal)
* Strong Engineering background is a plus
* Stong Negotiation and Sourcing skills
* Supply Chain Management (SCM) familiarity
* Experience working in an engineering or semiconductor company
* Understanding of regional and global markets and cultures

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

BS/BA degree

MBA

**Location:**

Austin, TX

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda's designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

**About the Role**

We are seeking experienced Demand & Supply Planning Managers to help build a brand-new planning function for Lambda's data center hardware, as part of Lambda's Supply Chain team, which makes sure the right systems, racks, and networking equipment are in the right place at the right time to power our rapidly growing AI cloud footprint.

You will own the planning process that connects what our customers and data center deployments need with what our ODM/OEM partners and component suppliers can deliver: building and maintaining demand forecasts, translating them into supply and build plans, balancing capacity and inventory against deployment schedules, and surfacing constraints early enough for the business to act on them.

The ideal candidate has planned complex, long-lead-time hardware in a high-growth environment. You are comfortable pressure-testing a forecast, building a supply plan from the bill of materials up, running a rigorous S&OP cycle, and telling leadership clearly where the risks are and what trade-offs are on the table, while moving fluidly between strategic planning and the details that make or break a deployment.

Because this is a net-new team, you will have a real hand in defining how planning works at Lambda: the processes, the cadence, the metrics, and the tools. You will work closely with Sourcing (ODM/OEM), Commodity Management, Operations and Logistics, Data Center Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market to bring capacity online on schedule.

**What You'll Do**

**Demand Planning & Forecasting**

* Own the demand forecast for your assigned portfolio, translating data center deployment plans, customer commitments, and capacity roadmaps into a unit-level, time-phased view of what we need and when.
* Build and maintain forecast models, assumptions, and scenarios (base, upside, downside), and track forecast accuracy and bias over time.
* Partner with Go-to-Market, Project Management, Finance, and Data Center Engineering to keep the demand signal current as customer commitments, cluster designs, and site readiness change.
* Establish clear forecast input ownership, cadence, and change-control so that upstream changes are visible and acted on quickly.

**Supply Planning & Capacity Alignment**

* Convert demand into supply and build plans for finished systems, racks, and networking equipment, including ODM/OEM build slots, integration capacity, and delivery schedules.
* Align partner manufacturing capacity and lead times with the demand forecast, and drive resolution when supply and demand do not match.
* Work with Commodity Management to understand component availability and allocation (accelerators, memory, storage, optics, power, cooling) and reflect those constraints in the supply plan.
* Lead execution timing across the supply chain, setting and driving the schedule so that material procurement is placed and delivered on time to support build and deployment commitments.
* Plan for new platform introductions and transitions, coordinating build schedules, ramp timing, and cutover so that new and legacy platforms are supplied without gaps or excess.
* Coordinate with Operations and Logistics on inbound flow, staging, and delivery so that supply lands when data centers are ready to receive it, either through direct ship or hub-spoke delivery models.

**Integrated Planning (S&OP)**

* Run or contribute to the Sales & Operations Planning cycle for infrastructure: demand review, supply review, and executive alignment on trade-offs.
* Produce clear, decision-ready views of supply versus demand, gaps, risks, and recommended actions for leadership.
* Drive consensus across functions, and escalate constraints with options and a recommendation, not just a problem statement.
* Keep the plan of record accurate, and make plan changes and their downstream impacts transparent.

**Inventory & Working Capital**

* Leverage analytical models to define and manage inventory targets, buffer strategies, and safety stock for long-lead and critical items, balancing deployment risk against capital and obsolescence exposure.
* Monitor on-hand, in-transit, and committed inventory, and flag excess, shortage, and aging exposure early.

**Supply Risk & Resilience**

Identify, quantify, and help mitigate risks to deployment schedules, including:

* Lead-time changes and long-lead component exposure
* Manufacturing capacity constraints and build slot risk

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. At AWS Cloud Logistics, we support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for warehousing safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This position is located in Austin, TX.

AWS Infrastructure is looking for a talented, driven, and highly analytical, Contract Logistics Procurement Mgr with a hunger for driving change and impact at a global scale to join AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain (AIS) team. The successful candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for using data to drive business decisions. You are analytical and creative, and you don’t quit until you solve the problem. You thrive by providing data-driven decision support and business intelligence that is timely, accurate, and actionable.

Key job responsibilities

* Lead sourcing, procurement, and contract operations for global contract logistics and warehousing services.
* Establish annual financial plans and create operating rhythms to measure execution vs established targets.
* Build and manage operating rhythms to simplify and automate business processes to ensure compliance with agreed terms and reduce procurement lead times.
* Draft contractual requirements in cooperation with business partners which encourage continued customer focus deliver reduced service costs.
* Manage supplier relationships including contractual negotiations, service performance, capability development.
* Dive deep to uncover areas of opportunity, present written business recommendations, and lead global projects which deliver reduced service costs.

A day in the life

* Recommend, develop, and implement policies that guide the organization in accurately estimating service cost and delivering annual profit and loss (P&L).
* Develop new business relationships and competencies.
* Partner with supply and operations teams to develop capacity models, guide network strategy, and inform capital investment decisions.
* Own Controllership activities including invoice auditing to identify discrepancies.
* Partner with business partners to draft, maintain, and standardize contractual requirements.
* Design exception-based reporting highlighting and analyzing outliers.
* Lead weekly discussions reporting on financial performance to plan and areas of improvement.
* Manage and support finance and accounting activities globally with multiple currencies.

\\*Why AWS\\*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

\\*Diverse Experiences\\*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

\\*Work/Life Balance\\*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

\\*Inclusive Team Culture\\*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*First Solar reserves the right to offer you a role most applicable to your experience and skillset.*

**Basic Job Functions:**

Lead procurement cross-functional teams for Tier 2 categories resulting in procurement decisions delivering the highest quality, reliability, and value to meet First Solar requirements. Develop strong business relationships and strategic alliances supporting First Solar’s growth plan.

**Education/Experience:**

* BS/BA degree plus 5 or more years of experience in a related technical or business field or 8 years of experience in a related technical or business field
* Strong knowledge of operational purchasing processes & concepts
* Experience in the glass industry, glass manufacturing, or sourcing of glass and related materials is preferred, but not required.
* ISM and APICS Certification preferred.

**Required Skills/Competencies:**

* Decision Making:
+ Participates with executives to establish strategic plans and objectives.
+ Select, evaluate, and develop category plan objectives in areas of technology, quality, cost, flexibility, and service.
+ Execute projects consistent with achieving overall supply management organizational goals.
+ Implement sourcing decisions based on team consensus to weighted scorecard.
* Problem Solving:

+ Assess, define, and resolve complex supply chain and procurement issues without supervision.
+ Apply root cause analysis and derive corrective actions and assess adequacy of the analyses and plans proposed by suppliers managed.
+ Apply appropriate competitive cost benchmarks, financial analysis, and risk management techniques to solve issues.
+ Able to influence internal customers and executives to achieve mutually beneficial solutions.
* Project Management:

+ Understands and demonstrates advanced project management skills.
+ Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects at the same time, and to close projects on time.
+ Effectively manages relationships and peer deliverables to successful project completion.
* Interaction:

+ Highly effective communicator, including oral, written and presentation preparation
+ Interacts primarily with peers, senior managers, and executives within First Solar.
+ Interaction requires the ability to influence others, frequently associates with higher position, to achieve organizational goals.
+ Often acts as team leader of cross-functional group for ad-hoc or standing projects.
+ Routine interaction with directors, VPs or “C” level executives of suppliers managed.
+ Builds deep industry relationships and category subject matter expertise.
* Negotiation:

+ Performs market and cost analysis.
+ Issues RFIs/RFQs/RFPs.
+ Develops and executes negotiation plan.
+ Conducts negotiation within approved negotiation parameters and authority.
+ Documents commercial terms and drafts contract agreements and amendments.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead global commodity management activities for glass, including development of sourcing strategies that support competitive cost, supply assurance, capacity requirements, supplier development, and risk mitigation.
* Develop and implement a global sourcing with specific negotiation strategies to achieve cost, supply assurance and risk mitigation objectives.
* Lead commercial negotiations with managed supply partners.

**Company Description**

The Audio Business Division of Electro-Voice Dynacord LLC is headquartered in Burnsville, Minnesota. Our product segments include Critical Communications Systems, Pro Sound, and Public Address & Conferencing. With our premium brands: **Dynacord, Electro-Voice, RTS and Telex**, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of sound.

At KEENFINITY, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,200 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Next to our passion for technology we’re very passionate about our work environment. Based on values such as trust, appreciation, and accountability we all work together to shape the future – boldly, customer-focused and with a strong team spirit.

**Job Description**

The Senior Procurement Manager is responsible for managing the procurement buyers and strategic sourcing processes within the group. This includes:

* Responsible for overall within the BU segment for procurement activities including sourcing, supplier performance management, NPI’s, strategic suppliers development.
* Supplier strategy execution including strategic supplier framework, supplier base optimization, business and supplier roadmap alignment.
* Driving NPI and awarding management, ensuring awarding on-time and on cost target and strategic supplier utilization coverage.
* Driving team performance to reach to cost savings and cash flow targets.
* Process and productivity optimization, lead the team to improve working efficiency by process optimization and digital procurement solution towards benchmark level.
* Purchasing representative for the assigned respective Business Segment within Audio.
* Target and functional management of all procurement buyers under responsibility.
* Establish targets, priorities and deadlines for team members.
* Professional development of the team under responsibility.
* Ensures the procurement targets are defined and met for Business Segment under responsibility.
* Cross-project prioritization and coordination of procurement issues under responsibility.
* Approval of business awards for projects developed under the assigned Product Area.
* Alignment with other procurement leaders / supply chain leaders and BU stakeholders on prioritization and coordination of procurement issues.
* Ensures supplier selection is according to procurement supplier strategy.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field is required.
* Minimum of 5 years purchasing, strategic procurement/commodity management and/or materials management experience.
* Minimum of 5 years experience in sourcing in the areas of mechanical components, electronic and electro-mechanical components, contract manufacturing, loud speaker and various acoustic components, packaging and hardware along with some technical knowledge within a given spends category.
* Experience developing global supplier relationships and managing global supplier negotations.
* Experience utilizing procurement software tools such as SAP Ariba is preferred.
* Ability to solve problems and make decisions.
* Experience in leading a multicultural team.
* Experience in project management, negotiation, managerial and leadership skills.
* Ability to act independently on a strategic and operative level.
* Possesses knowledge of the product area.
* **International and domestic travel are required (10-15%).**

**Additional Information**

The U.S. based annual salary range for this role is between $135,000-$150,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

* *Reasonable accommodation may be provided, to the extent they do not pose an undue hardship, to enable qualified individuals with covered disabilities to perform essential functions.*
* *Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization is not available.*
* *All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

*At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology. We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.*

*Keenfinity Group is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.*

description:
**Job ID:** 41922 | **Location:** The Woodlands, Texas, USA | **Work Model:** Onsite

As **Senior Procurement Manager – Site & Maintenance**, you will drive end-to-end sourcing strategies across key indirect categories — including facilities management, MRO, utilities, energy, and fluids — ensuring Clariant's production sites and offices operate at peak efficiency. Working at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will deliver measurable P&L impact through savings initiatives, supplier development, and value transformation projects, while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and global procurement teams. This is a high-visibility role that offers the autonomy to shape category strategy, challenge the status quo, and elevate procurement as a true business partner — making it an ideal opportunity for an ambitious, agile procurement professional looking to make a tangible impact at a leading global specialty chemicals company.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and regularly review category strategies for Site & Maintenance (facilities management, MRO, utilities, energy, and fluids) in alignment with the regional Head of Indirect Spend, leveraging procurement analytics tools, commodity forecasts, and market intelligence
* Implement site & maintenance sourcing best practices using a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) approach to drive efficiency and cost optimization
* Deliver business objectives against clear financial and non-financial KPIs, ensuring measurable P&L impact across the organization
* Manage and optimize the existing supplier base while proactively identifying, developing, and onboarding new suppliers to challenge and improve current performance
* Drive supplier base simplification and tail spend management to reduce complexity and increase procurement efficiency
* Lead value transformation projects in close coordination with regional and global stakeholders, from ideation through to execution
* Build and manage strong relationships with strategic suppliers and key stakeholders across all business units and locations
* Actively participate in regional and global performance management forums, including the Indirect Spend SteerCo
* Simplify and automate non-value-added procurement activities to free up capacity for higher-impact initiatives
* Execute multiple sourcing initiatives simultaneously with an agile mindset, sense of urgency, and a results-driven approach
* Elevate the value perception of procurement within each business unit by consistently delivering tangible, quantifiable outcomes

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field with preferably 10+ years of proven procurement experience in a multinational organization; MBA is a plus
* Demonstrated track record in indirect categories such as facilities management, MRO, utilities, or energy
* In-depth category knowledge and ability to develop and execute strategic sourcing plans with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus
* Continuous Improvement certification (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma) is an advantage
* Willingness to travel up to 20%, primarily within the United States

**What´s in it for you?**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Insurances
* Paid Holidays
* PTO time with a carry-over benefit
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Wellness Program
* EAP Program
* Spending and Savings Accounts
* Life/AD&D Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Online discount Mall
* Auto/Home Insurance
* Identity Theft Protection
* Legal Services Plan

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. * Develop Sourcing Strategy for commodity detailing projects, sourcing levers, timing, resources, and expected benefits
* Accountable for execution of sourcing projects including RFx, continuous improvement, consolidation, etc.
* Responsible for defining negotiations strategy including supplier profiles, commercial negotiations targets, defining switching costs, and building Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
* Conduct or support negotiations and supplier selection - accountable for contract lifecycle management and compliance

* Support supplier segmentation, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and quarterly supplier reviews for all strategic suppliers within commodity. Scribe for all quarterly reviews and key supplier meetings. Ensure creation of supplier profiles for all SRM suppliers.
* Responsible for commodity continuity of supply - engage with plants to efficiently resolve escalated issues and formally manage and secure supplier capacity
* Support region/sector NPD Procurement teams through preferred supplier programs, RFQ's, and SRM to set and meet program QCD targets
* Actively monitor and mitigate supplier risk including financial, capacity, quality, and compliance
* Responsible for forecasting, reporting, mitigating, and recovery of commodity inflation
* Support Quarterly Commodity Reviews (QCR) including updated projects, metrics, strategy, and countermeasures

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* 3+ years’ experience with supply chain, strategic sourcing or mechanical, electrical, or VAVE engineering for a global industrial manufacturer
* 30% travel including some international trips

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and/or professional certifications (CPM, CPSM, CIRM, CPIM)
* Excellent negotiation skills & strategic mindset
* Experience with strategic sourcing and lean tools
* Digital dexterity and strong analytical ability to leverage data
* Strong knowledge of supply chain strategy (development and execution) and category specific experience
* Driven problem solver with appetite to independently address complex challenges in a fast-moving environment
* Proven track record of successful leadership, negotiation, and executive communication

* Participate in production / S&OP / planning meetings to communicate material risks, constraints, and recovery plans.

* Develop qualified supplier and contractor base to support customer demands.
* Coordinate with vendors on pricing, lead time and technical issues.
* Own parameter settings (lead times, lot sizes, safety stock, reorder points) in the ERP/MRP system for electronic materials.

* Work with engineering to qualify alternate parts and mitigate obsolescence and allocation risk.
* Review ECOs (Engineering Change Order).
* Generate pricing and formal quotes for customer RFQs.

**Education and/or Experience**

Required:

* Bachelor's Degree or minimum of five years procurement experience
* Minimum of five years experience with MRP or ERP systems

The company now employs over 300 employees and is a six-time recipient of Chicago's Best and Brightest Employers to Work For award.

***This position is designated as onsite. The selected candidate must be willing and able to report to the Waukegan, IL location during scheduled work hours***

**Summary**

Responsible for planning and managing daily procurement and materials management activities for the company's electronic line replaceable unit (LRU) product lines, including wireless access points, servers, and modems. This role leads the electronics procurement team, ensures material availability to support production and customer demand, and drives cost, quality, and delivery performance across the supply base.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Provide leadership for procurement related to our electronic product lines.
* Determine responsibilities of assigned organization and staff positions to accomplish the business objectives.
* Supervise human resource responsibilities, setting guidelines for personnel recruitment, evaluations and advancement.
* Trains and ensures that all assigned employees are aware of, understand, and comply with company and customer policies, procedures and regulations.
* Work with engineering on projects in development to identify potential procurement issues and opportunities.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for key electronic commodities (PCBAs, ICs, memory, harnesses, etc.).
* Identify potential new vendors. Interview and evaluate vendors based on pricing, lead time, and capability.
* Plan incoming materials according to production plan. Adjust delivery dates as customer requirements change. Balance cash flow with operational maximization.
* Analyze BOMs (Bills of Material) and identify materials with cost savings opportunities.
* Follow market trends and provide guidance and recommendation for long-term planning to senior management.
* Identify and assess supply risks (single-sourced items, geo-political risk, long lead items) and develop mitigation plans.
* Maintain safety stock, alternate suppliers, and contingency plans for critical components.
* Participate in production / S&OP / planning meetings to communicate material risks, constraints, and recovery plans.
* Submit RFQs (Requests for Quote) to vendors. Compare and review price to obtain best price and lead time.
* Issue Purchase Orders to vendors and follow up on material status.
* Develop qualified supplier and contractor base to support customer demands.
* Coordinate with vendors on pricing, lead time and technical issues.
* Own parameter settings (lead times, lot sizes, safety stock, reorder points) in the ERP/MRP system for electronic materials.
* Monitor component lifecycle status (e.g., EOL, NRND) and proactively manage substitutions and last-time buys.
* Work with engineering to qualify alternate parts and mitigate obsolescence and allocation risk.
* Review ECOs (Engineering Change Order).
* Generate pricing and formal quotes for customer RFQs.

**Education and/or Experience**

Required:

* Bachelor's Degree or minimum of five years procurement experience
* Minimum of five years experience with MRP or ERP systems

Preferred:

* Experience working in the aerospace industry and with electronic commodities such as PCBAs, ICs, Memory, and Cable Harnesses.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

As a member of Neogen’s Global Portfolio team, the Global Portfolio Associate - Food Safety supports portfolio management activities through data analysis, project coordination, lifecycle execution, market insight development, and commercial initiatives.

Working closely with Portfolio Managers and cross-functional partners, this role helps organize and analyze portfolio information, coordinate product and commercial activities, and support informed business decisions. The position provides an opportunity to build expertise in portfolio management, commercial strategy, product lifecycle management, and the Food Safety market while contributing to global portfolio growth and optimization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Portfolio Performance and Support

* Support Portfolio Managers in monitoring the performance of assigned product portfolios.
* Track and organize portfolio information including revenue, volume, pricing, product mix, supply performance, and customer trends.
* Prepare portfolio review materials, dashboards, reports, and performance analyses.
* Gather and organize data to support portfolio reviews, planning discussions, and business decisions.
* Participate in portfolio planning activities and contribute information and analysis to support recommendations and improvement opportunities.
* Develop knowledge of portfolio management principles, business drivers, and commercial performance metrics.

Lifecycle and Portfolio Optimization

* Support product lifecycle management activities across assigned portfolios.
* Coordinate product updates involving packaging, labeling, specifications, pricing, product information, and other portfolio changes.
* Maintain portfolio documentation, product hierarchies, lifecycle records, and supporting data.
* Support initiatives designed to improve portfolio effectiveness, simplify product offerings, and enhance customer value.
* Assist with portfolio rationalization, product enhancements, and product change initiatives.
* Partner with Portfolio Managers and cross-functional teams to support lifecycle execution and established portfolio management processes.

Market, Customer, and Competitive Insights

* Gather, organize, and summarize customer, market, competitor, and industry information.
* Support market research, competitive benchmarking, and opportunity assessments.
* Compile customer feedback, sales input, Technical Services observations, and regional market insights.
* Monitor relevant market developments and communicate findings to Portfolio Managers and other stakeholders.
* Assist with the development of presentations, analyses, and recommendations based on market and customer insights.
* Build knowledge of customer applications, purchasing drivers, competitive dynamics, and market trends across Neogen’s Food Safety portfolio.

Growth and Commercial Enablement

* Support Portfolio Managers with portfolio growth, pricing, retention, and product adoption initiatives.
* Assist with the development and coordination of commercial materials, product communications, presentations, and sales resources.
* Coordinate activities with Marketing, Sales, Technical Services, Regional teams, and other cross-functional partners.
* Collect and analyze data to help evaluate the effectiveness of commercial programs and portfolio initiatives.
* Support business case development, product positioning activities, and opportunity evaluations.
* Participate in portfolio growth initiatives while developing knowledge of commercial strategy and portfolio management.

Project Support and Coordination

* Support portfolio projects and initiatives led by Portfolio Managers and cross-functional teams.
* Coordinate meetings, agendas, action items, project documentation, and follow-up activities.
* Track project milestones, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
* Gather information and prepare updates for portfolio projects and strategic initiatives.
* Identify and communicate project risks, dependencies, delays, or issues requiring escalation.
* Support product launches, continuous improvement initiatives, and other cross-functional projects as assigned.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Chemistry, Food Science, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* Up to three years of professional experience in product management, portfolio management, marketing, commercial operations, project coordination, or a related field.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated ability to organize and analyze data or information.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and assignments.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with teams across multiple funct

Job Title: Project Manager (Entry-Level)

Location: Ann Arbor / Lansing, MI (Hybrid / On-site depending on project needs)

Job Type: Full-time

Base Salary: $75,000 / year (Commensurate with experience)

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level Project Manager to join our growing team in Michigan. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of engineering and operational projects—from initial procurement and vendor selection to final delivery and execution. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional looking to take ownership of project management operations in a dynamic, global business environment.

Key Responsibilities

Project Lifecycle Management: Assist in planning, executing, and tracking projects from inception through completion to ensure deliverables are met on time and within budget.

Procurement & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and select vendors, suppliers, and subcontractors. Manage purchasing processes and negotiate delivery timelines.

Supply Chain & Logistics Support: Coordinate equipment and material delivery schedules, ensuring seamless logistics between vendors, warehouses, and client sites.

Cross-Functional Communication: Serve as a point of contact between internal teams, clients, subcontractors, and overseas stakeholders.

Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate project documentation, cost tracking, purchase orders, and status reports for senior management.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Industrial Management, or a related field.

Experience: 0–2 years of experience in project coordination, procurement, engineering support, or related operations.

Language Skills: Bilingual in Korean and English (Required for daily communication with headquarters, vendors, and clients).

Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); familiarity with project management software or ERP systems is a plus.

Soft Skills: Strong organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills; ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Benefits

Competitive starting salary ($75,000/year)

Insurance and Health Benefits provided in accordance with company policy

Paid Time Off (PTO) & Paid Holidays

Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Pay: $75,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Language:

* Korean (Required)

Work Location: In person

OTS empowers the U.S. military and its allies with an extensive range of overarching product segments applied across all levels of strategic and tactical operations, providing a cutting-edge advantage to our warfighters. Our Ethos of Honesty, Trust, Transparency, and Alignment, are the guiding principles that form the foundation of everything we do. Integrity is paramount, innovation fuels our passion, customer satisfaction is at the core of our mission, and collaboration is key to our success - fostering a culture of teamwork and mutual respect among employees, partners, and stakeholders. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits that include career development and recognition programs. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team! Job Summary: We are seeking a highly motivated and dependable individual to fill a Supervisor position. As a Supervisor, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing daily operations, managing team performance, and ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and effectively. You will serve as a leader, mentor, and communicator for your team while ensuring compliance with organizational policies and standards. Success in this role requires strong leadership, problem-solving, and time-management skills, along with the ability to foster a positive and productive work environment. Position Location Detail: This position is located at our Main Plant facility. Impact of the Role:

### **General Profile**

* Working supervisor of a team (spends a portion of time performing the work supervised) or supervises the daily activities of production team members
* Must have one or more of any direct report type
* Analyses information to solve on-going problems and implements procedures and approaches to complete work
* Responsible for results of the team
* Provides direction to team using extensive knowledge of established precedents and practices
* Consistent exercise of discretion & judgment

Essential Functions:

* Supervises production operations for assigned units or during an assigned shift.

description:
Introduction: Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.

Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT. Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us! Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey. Overview: The Fulfillment Supervisor will supervise order entry, administration, and shipping processes of fulfillment team. This role will ensure all tasks are completed in accordance with AIT's policies and procedures. Additionally, the Fulfillment Supervisor will create shift schedule to include, workstation assignments/rotations, employee training, employee vacations, employee breaks, overtime assignment, back-up for absent employees, and shift rotations. Responsibilities:

* Supervise the process of fulfillment of orders by; managing the receipt, keying, and processing of orders or changes and determining departmental budgets and costs.
* Organize customer product labeling/fulfillment requests and create proper cost model.
* Work with other internal departments to make sure orders are filled according to agreed time lines
* Work with Operations Manager on coordinating customer roll outs
* Work closely with customers and internal team on 3PL Central WMS software & report development
* Assist in escalation request, research, and address issues with employees. Update process to fit resolutions and continue process improvement flow.
* Manage and assign work schedules, monitor overtime and time off request to assure department coverage based on business needs
* Assign quarterly and annually goals and monitor employee's goals progress
* Track product expiration dates with picture evidence to expand quality control capabilities
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

Qualifications: **Education**

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent (Required)

**Experience**

* 3+ years experience in fulfillment and warehouse operations (Required)
* 1+ years experience in domestic, international and cartage freight forwarding warehousing services (Required)

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Applies fundamental concepts High
* Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) Medium

**Licenses and Certifications**

* Forklift Certification - (Required)

What AIT Can Offer You:

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide:

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

*AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.*

**Job Description**

Join us as Project Manager Clinical Supplies - To manage the end-to-end supply chain for clinical trials, ensure timely and efficient distribution of trial materials, maintain optimal inventory levels, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the successful execution of clinical studies.

**This is a fully remote position for candidates located in the United States.**

**Prior clinical supplies experience in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry is a requirement.**

What You’ll Do:

* Develop study specific plans for each assigned project.
* Meet with internal teams to coordinate efforts, provide recommendations and risks, and update project reports/spreadsheets.
* Integrate all clinical supplies activities into the supply chain to support project logistic strategy and compliance with GxP requirements.
* Participate in ongoing training on new regulations.
* Representing the department internally and externally at meetings, strategic projects and initiatives as per the business requirements.
* Mentor and guide support junior team members.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives.
* Maintain and use existing tools while continuously looking for improvement opportunities.
* May participate in the bidding and/or bid defense opportunities client contact for their supply chain requests/questions/concerns.

Education and Experience:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).

* CRO industry experience is a requirement.

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

* Strong English and communication skills both written and verbal
* Strong interpersonal, planning, organizational, problem solving, sense of urgency and decision-making skills
* Effective leadership and team building skills
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
* Strong focus on customers and attention to detail
* Ability to work in team environment, as well as work independently with little guidance
* Good understanding of clinical supply operations
* Solid client building and 3rd party relationship management
* Ability to provide customer service with the highest standards of quality and excellence

Working Conditions and Environment:

* Work may be performed in a production, office or home-based environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Occasionally travels both domestic and international

Physical Requirements:

* Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
* Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
* Frequent mobility required.
* Occasional crouching, stooping, bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
* Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
* Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
* Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
* Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
* Works independently with little guidance or reliance on oral or written instructions and plans work schedules to meet goals. Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.
* Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
* Regular and consistent attendance.

Why Join Us?
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

As a Delivery Assurance Manager, you will be responsible for driving delivery performance and customer satisfaction across assigned programs. You will work closely with internal product teams, operations, supply chain, engineering, and other functional organizations to identify and resolve delivery risks, improve processes, and ensure customer requirements are met.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive delivery assurance objectives for assigned programs, proactively identifying risks and coordinating actions to support on-time delivery and customer requirements.
* Monitor program delivery performance, customer commitments, and critical hardware to identify potential delays and initiate appropriate recovery actions.
* Work cross-functionally with Collins Product Teams and other departments to resolve issues impacting customer delivery, including coordinating escalated actions when necessary.
* Interface regularly with internal and external customers to communicate delivery status, address concerns, and provide timely updates on recovery plans.
* Monitor the tracking, shipment, and delivery of critical customer hardware and coordinate with appropriate functions to resolve transportation or logistics issues.
* Perform escalated expediting activities when required to recover at-risk deliveries and minimize customer impact.
* Support customer delivery meetings by providing program status, identifying risks and constraints, and coordinating follow-up actions.
* Execute process improvements that strengthen delivery assurance, improve visibility to delivery risks, and enhance the customer experience.
* Utilize delivery assurance systems, SAP, and Microsoft Office tools to monitor performance, maintain accurate information, and communicate program status.
* Develop strong working relationships across functions to facilitate timely issue resolution and maintain alignment on customer commitments.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience
* Experience in customer service, customer support, program management, operations, supply chain, or delivery assurance.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with internal and external customers.
* Experience coordinating across multiple functions to resolve complex issues and meet customer commitments.
* Experience identifying delivery risks and developing or executing recovery plans.
* Experience with SAP and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.

**What We Offer**

Some of our competitive benefits package includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Position Location:** This role supports our Norcross, GA branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Atlanta, GA area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We're improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

**Transform the everyday with us!**

As an **Area Operations Manager, Solutions**, you will lead and direct operational execution across all customers within your assigned area. You will be accountable for profitable growth, operational excellence, and delivery performance, while ensuring alignment with Siemens SI B standards. This role works in close partnership with central Operations functions—including PMO, Operations Excellence, and the Large Project Organization (LPO)—to ensure consistent use of shared capabilities, best practices, and premium project delivery.

**As an Area Operations Manager, Solutions, you will:**

* Drive end-to-end operational performance across the assigned area, ensuring adherence to Siemens SI B standards, defined sales processes, and execution methodologies
* Meet and/or exceed quarterly and annual budget commitments, including revenue, gross margin, and operating margin targets
* Plan, direct, and oversee operational activities to support sustainable growth and consistent project execution excellence
* Monitor project performance to control job costs, manage risk, and ensure delivery within agreed scope, schedule, and cost parameters
* Partner closely with central Operations teams (PMO, Operations Excellence, and LPO) to leverage standard tools, resources, and best practices
* Provide operational and technical support to Sales teams, including pricing guidance, scope definition, and execution strategy for competitive bids
* Lead workforce planning by hiring, developing, allocating, and performance-managing resources to support current and future business needs
* Ensure balance sheet, cash flow, and working capital performance are in line with Siemens and SI B North Star expectations
* Maintain close alignment with Area General Management on market strategy, execution priorities, and growth initiatives

**You will make an impact with these qualifications:**

*Basic Qualifications:*

* 10+ years of experience leading operations in a project-based, solutions, or engineering environment
* Financial acumen, including responsibility for revenue, margin, cost control, and cash flow performance
* Experience partnering effectively with Sales, Project Management, and operations organizations
* High School diploma or state-recognized GED
* Travel as needed.
* Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens’ fleet vehicle program
* Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field
* Technical and operational expertise relevant to solutions-based delivery environments
* People leadership capability, including talent development and workforce planning
* Customer-focused mindset with strong relationship management and issue-resolution skills
