description:
**Logistics at full potential.**

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

We believe providing superior support and solutions for our customers drives our success, and we want to put you behind the wheel. As the Customer Service Representative, you will be responsible for maintaining workflow by assisting managers and supervisors with the coordination of warehouse duties, including inventory, creating packaging slips and reports, and fulfilling customer orders. If you’re excited about the challenge of working for a rapidly growing global company, we have an opportunity for you to grow with GXO.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

* Coordinate workload allocation among warehouse workers, material handlers and drivers

* Prepare work orders; troubleshoot orders and resolve discrepancies as needed

* Assign and release orders sent for loading and unloading

* Allocate and research inventory for orders

* Enter data for inbound and/or outbound freight into the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and create bills of lading (BOLs)

* Maintain and generate required reports

* Process, audit and file various documentation

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you'll need:

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office

* Ability to communicate effectively with carriers, customers, employees and management

* Proven ability to multitask and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment

It'd be great if you also have:

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Availability to work a flexible schedule when needed

1 year of customer service experience

+ 6 months of experience in a warehouse setting

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement here.

Description:

Pilatus is hiring a Procurement Manager to join our team in Sarasota, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining supplier performance in accordance with agreed contractual terms and real-time business needs. Pilatus is a global company based in Switzerland with a worldwide supplier base and this position is focused on the suppliers located in North America. The primary focus is resolution of issues that require face-to-face onsite presence, on short notice and over an extended period of time. The position is expected to be forward-thinking and to recommend and implement strategies for improving supplier performance and meeting production and customer support requirements. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.

* Assists with proactive and successful management of assigned suppliers within the North American supplier portfolio
* Hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations, commitments, and Key Performance Indicators
* Solves crisis and secures execution of recovery plans.
* Perform supplier risk analysis, develop and execute mitigation actions that protects Pilatus’s production plan
* Communicate proactively with all Pilatus supply chain stakeholders
* Escalate issues when needed according to roles and responsibilities
* Travel on short notice for in-person supplier visits as required
* Support ongoing supplier management tasks
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and the procurement team in Switzerland
* Collaborate with internal departments and stakeholders, including leading projects and meetings
* Support tracking of supply chain KPIs
* Participate actively in the improvement of procurement processes and management of cross-divisional projects
* Participate in special projects as required
* Act as liaison for procurement activities in European and North American Pilatus offices

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Minimum B.S. in Supply Chain Management or equivalent; graduate degree is an advantage
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a supply chain and/or procurement role in the aircraft industry
* Experience with business intelligence tools and supply chain analytics
* Willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally, sometimes on short notice
* Ability to develop relationships and interact effectively with both internal and external stakeholders across varied business areas
* Good knowledge in lean principles and tools
* Experience with ERP/MRP software
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities.

The hiring range is $68,000 - $94,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is **a place to do great work**, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also **a great place to work,** providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

**Job Responsibilities :**
--------------------------

The Supply Planner primary responsibilities include managing inventory positioning between manufacturing and distribution locations to support customer forecasts. Provides direction to expedite products to optimize order fulfillment, allocate and prioritize inventory between competing demands, work with all levels of the organization to ensure balanced and equitable distribution of products across the organization. Creates, manages, analyzes, and distributes daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual Operations and Sales reports using advanced-level Power BI and Excel.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Create and maintain an ongoing supply plan to ensure adequate warehouse inventory levels are maintained to fulfill customer demand from all Razer USA warehouses.
* Work with Sales, Sales Operations, Category Managers and/or Global Planning to prioritize and optimize inbound and outbound shipments to meet customer requirements.

* Manage and report finished goods stock levels, order fill rates, and other business management reports using advanced Power BI, Excel and SAP on a daily, weekly, monthly quarterly and annual basis.
* Manage and facilitate new product introductions to the region ensuring product is delivered on time and in full to support each product launch.
* Manage and facilitate End-of-Life planning and execution for all products and customers ensuring clean and smooth product transitions.
* Develop inventory and fulfillment modeling to ensure US and Global distribution methodologies are continually reviewed and optimized.
* Facilitate and conduct weekly supply planning meetings with Global Planning and Sales.
* Allocate and distribute daily supply to customer order release files to Business Operations
* Create and process daily air freight requests for approval.

* Create and distribute weekly 3PL inbound and outbound forecasts by warehouse
* Create, analyze and distribute Business Analysis reports using Power BI, Excel and SAP highlighting issues/concerns and developing and facilitating plans of action.
* Identify and execute cost savings opportunities and continuous improvement projects.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management undefined.

**Pre-Requisites :**
--------------------

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* 5+ years related work experience in Supply / Demand Planning is a must.
* 3+ years of advanced-level experience with Power BI and Excel is a must.
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills and the ability to effectively relate with multiple levels of management, both internally and externally.
* Ability to create and analyze data to solve problems or inefficiencies.
* Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines.
* Knowledge of supply planning tools.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent prioritization, follow-up and follow-through skills.

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Supply / Demand Planning.

**Travel Requirements**

May be required to travel up to 5%.

**Salary Ranges:**

$71,403.00 - $119,006.00 (per annum)

Disclaimer: Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Razer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diverse teams drive better ideas, better products, and a stronger culture. We are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and fair workplace for every employee across all the countries we operate in. Where needed, we provide reasonable accommodations - including for disability or religious practices - to ensure every team member can perform and contribute at their best.

**Are you game?**

description:
**Intro**
---------

Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off? Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop on board!

**Why you'll love this job**
----------------------------

* This job is a member of the Fleet PMO team within the Finance Organization.
* Responsible for managing projects, driving on time deliverables, and leading a group of cross-functional stakeholders to deliver each project on time and on budget.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Manages, plans, coordinates, and leads all aspects of interdisciplinary projects, including but not limited to, Technical Operations Engineering, Customer Experience, Supply Chain, Flight and Inflight
* Works independently as a Project Manager for the development, design, and implementation of major aircraft programs.
* Holds a crucial role in collaborating within Technical Operations, and across all departments to ensure the success of the project.
* Establishes project plans that consist of project goals, scope, timeline, risks, resources, budgets, milestones, tasks, communication strategies, and deliverable schedules.
* Monitors, tracks and facilitate all fleets projects to ensure production readiness.
* Prioritizes project planning work for effective risk and change management
* Interface with multiple systems to manage daily deliverables and task execution
* Acts as SME for any questions or issues in the project process
* Acts as a project leader, driving project progress, leading teamwork, and supporting the project team members to succeed in their roles and responsibilities
* Collaborate in a diversified and cross-functional team environment (Compliance, Finance, Engineering, AD/ECO planning, Material/Tooling Planning, AD/CFR, Stores, Records, other Tech Ops organizations, etc.)

**All you'll need for success**
-------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Aviation Management, Supply Chain, Finance, Project Management, or equivalent work experience/training
* 3+ years of experience as a Project Manager, or in management roles in aviation maintenance, engineering, or planning.
* *Basic understanding of aircraft engineering disciplines and the regulatory requirements impacting aircraft programs* Aviation experience is necessary

**Preferred Qualifications- Education & Prior Job Experience**

* Project Management certification
* Previous experience working with aircraft modifications and STCs
* Knowledge of AA policies and procedures

**Skills, Licenses & Certifications**

* Proven initiative-taker, with a positive attitude and a high learning capacity
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and written with all levels within the organization
* Ability to develop project plan quality control goals as well as lessons learning opportunities
* Problem resolution ability with a high degree of motivation, thoroughness, integrity, and reliability
* Proven reliable Project Management skills, experience managing scope, technical details, schedules, and budgets in a project environment
* Ability to think "outside the box" and leverage data responsibilities to help drive performance improvements
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office to include Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, MS Teams, etc.
* Experience with Smartsheet or similar project management tools is preferred
* Strong people management skills. Must have "can do" attitude in serving our team and the business mission with pride
* Capable to challenge the status quo and asking common sense questions
* Ability to manage multiple tasks while dealing with disruptions and change
* Ability to travel both domestic and international
* Ability to support aircraft modification projects on site during first aircraft installation

**What you'll get**
-------------------

Feel free to take advantage of all that American Airlines has to offer:

* Travel Perks: Ready to explore the world? You, your family and your friends can reach 365 destinations on more than 6,800 daily flights across our global network.
* Health Benefits: On day one, you’ll have access to your health, dental, prescription and vision benefits to help you stay well. And that’s just the start, we also offer virtual doctor visits, flexible spending accounts and more.
* Wellness Programs: We want you to be the best version of yourself – that’s why our wellness programs provide you with all the right tools, resources and support you need.
* 401(k) Program: Available upon hire and, depending on the workgroup, employer contributions to your 401(k) program are available after one year.

* Develop and manage annual budgets and rolling forecasts, monitoring performance to ensure established financial targets are met or exceeded.

Strategic Responsibility

* Drive organic growth within existing client accounts by identifying and implementing value-added opportunities, while supporting new business and new client acquisition.
* Develop and implement automation roadmaps for key clients and operations to improve efficiency, performance, and long-term business value.

**Parma, Idaho (Hybrid)**

We are looking for a Head of Commercial Operations, Americas to join our Agricultural Solutions team in Parma, Idaho leading the Americas country cluster.

The Head of Commercial Operations, Americas leads the Commercial and Supply Chain Operations for the Americas country cluster, ensuring that sales order handling / order-to-cash, logistics, local warehousing, delivery to customers, import and export of shipments, and product availability are executed well and continuously improved across the region, driving high customer satisfaction through strong leadership of local teams and close alignment with Sales in each country.

**Welcome to BASF**
-------------------

We are BASF in Agriculture and everything we do, we do for the love of farming, and the biggest job on Earth. We are an internationally successful company of the BASF Group. Our solutions are purpose-designed for different crop systems. Connecting seeds and traits, crop protection products, digital tools and sustainability approaches, to help deliver the best possible outcomes for farmers, growers and our other stakeholders along the value chain. With teams in the lab, field, office and in production, we do everything in our power to build a sustainable future for agriculture.

#ForTheLoveOfFarming #TheBiggestJobOnEarth #AgEmployerOfChoice

Here you can gain more insight into our Vision at BASF Agricultural Solutions!

**As a Head of Commercial Operations, Americas, you create chemistry by...**

* Managing the Commercial Operations organization for the Americas cluster, ensuring adequate staffing and capacity planning to meet local and corporate needs.
* Leading and developing the team to ensure skills and motivation are aligned with company strategy and agreed performance levels, including setting and following up on goals.
* Leading the execution of sales order handling / order-to-cash, logistics and local warehousing, delivery to customers, and import/export of shipments across the countries in the cluster.
* Connecting and aligning with key stakeholders in Marketing & Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure upstream and downstream processes, systems, and people are well connected to Commercial Operations.
* Ensuring Commercial Operations Managers in each country are well connected to product availability information and can translate it into an availability plan at area/customer level.
* Driving communication of product availability and reporting any foreseen hiccups against forecast to enable timely plan adjustments.
* Providing regular status updates on realized and open orders and related risks to support monthly and yearly business steering.
* Measuring and monitoring performance across Order-to-Cash, Supply Planning, Warehousing & Logistics, Transport Management, Foreign Trade, and Sales Planning processes to drive continuous improvement.
* Leading continuous improvement initiatives, promoting process standardization, automation, and data-driven decision-making in alignment with global practices.
* Collaborating with Global Key-Users, Business Process Experts, M&S Excellence, and Digital/IT to align system functionalities, data standards, and process enhancements.

**If you...**
-------------

* Hold a Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Supply Chain, Business Economics, or a related field.
* Bring 5+ years of experience in a multinational or global organization within Commercial Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related function.
* Have 2+ years of people management experience, managing remote and international people leadership preferred
* Possess solid expertise in Order-to-Cash processes and/or Logistics & Warehousing operations.
* Are proficient in ERP systems (such as SAP S/4HANA) and have experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and process automation technologies.
* Are passionate about leading operational excellence while fostering a high-performing, engaged team culture.
* Excel at building collaborative partnerships and communicating effectively across regions, cultures, and functions.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a continuous improvement mindset driven by data and insights.

* Embrace innovation and are enthusiastic about leveraging new technologies and digital solutions to enhance processes.

The Royal Caribbean Group’s **Supply Chain Team** has an exciting career opportunity for a full time **Associate Manager Hotel Procurement** reporting to the **Director Hotel Procurement**

**This position is onsite and based in Miami Florida**

**This position is also not eligible for work authorization sponsorship**

**Position Summary / Job Purpose:**

Subject matter procurement expert for the assigned goods and/or services Research suppliers from a variety of usual and unusual sources Confers with suppliers to obtain product or service information such as price availability and delivery schedule Responsible for short- and long-term planning and strategizing for assigned goods and/or services

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

Performs complex price analysis of multiple variables Expert use of analysis forecasting

* problem solving and quality improvement to develop strategies for dynamic market conditions

Communicates and presents clear strategies* plans and cost impacts to upper management
* Attends industry trade shows and conferences
* Measures and evaluates suppliers¿ on-time delivery performance
* Contributor to the company's delivery and invoicing policies
* Responsible for implementing and driving change

* 5+ years related procurement experience or specialized technical experience

Negotiation and analytical skills required* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate in a multicultural environment with all levels of employees and management
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products specifically Excel
Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts interest commissions proportions and percentages
Ability to write reports business correspondence and procedure manuals
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from suppliers and all levels of staff and management* both shipboard and shoreside

**Work Environment**

Up to 25% domestic and international travel

* as necessary

Project Management

United States of America, YORK

October 7 2026

Full time

Permanent

**Job benefits**
================

Competitive salary and bonus scheme

Continuous personnel development (e-learnings & projects)

Free day to volunteer

**About the position**
----------------------

GEA Group, founded in Germany in 1881, is a global leader in engineering solutions, serving industries such as food and beverage, pharma, dairy, and more. With over 18,000 employees worldwide and a strong U.S. presence since 1929, GEA combines the heritage of a well-established company with the innovation of a forward-thinking industry leader. At GEA, we’re not just building equipment, we’re building lasting careers with an average employee tenure range from 5 to over 11+ years, reflecting the strong culture, growth opportunities, and support we provide.

### **Your responsibilities and tasks**

* Start strong – Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on your first day
* Recharge and refresh – Enjoy 12 paid holidays, including a flexible floating holiday, and 136 hours of PTO to relax or explore
* Invest in your future – A 7% 401(k) employer match helps grow your retirement savings faster
* Keep learning – Take advantage of tuition reimbursement to further your education or skillset
* Live well – Our wellness incentive program rewards healthy habits
* Get support when you need it – Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program for personal or professional guidance
* Save smart – Flexible Health Savings and Spending Accounts to manage out-of-pocket expenses

At GEA in York, PA, we build processing equipment and integrated solutions to make a wide array of products for tomorrow’s consumers. You will be joining a fast-moving company that supplies into a market where new and better products are required.

We are looking to build out our Project Management Organization and hire a Project Manager for our team! Here, you will enjoy our structured training path for Project Managers, where we focus on developing and qualifying your project management skills. Depending on your results and interests, this will be a great opportunity to take the next step in your career and follow the career path for Project Managers. We have a project management network globally, which we all benefit from.

Responsibilities:

* Ensure the clarification, specification and execution of each project from the initial quotation phase to commissioning, handover, follow-up and project completion
* Generate buy-in among your stakeholders and motivate your team to ensure that all aspects of a project are moving in the same direction
* Make sure that your projects are delivered safely, within budget and according to scope, quality and schedule
* Oversee and ensure that customers are managed properly and that their satisfaction levels remain high during the execution of each project
* Collaborate with multiple stakeholders across departments and functions, ranging from Sales to Supply Chain, Finance (project budget and cost control) and Risk management of customer focused projects.
* Travel as needed to sites as projects are implemented and for customer meetings

### **Your profile and qualifications**

Profile And Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or related field highly preferred.
* 5+ years of Project Management experience in related projects, preferably in Industrial Heating and Refrigeration.
* Possess PMP License, or willing to obtain within 1 year of being in role.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Strong ability to navigate unforeseen challenges and deescalate situations.

The typical base pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year. GEA Group has different base pay ranges for different work locations within the United States.

The pay range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The estimated range is the budgeted amount for the position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications, and other job-related reasons. You may be eligible for additional rewards, such as discretionary bonus (based on eligibility) and/or equity awards.

Please note: This position is based in the United States and does not offer visa or work sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

GEA is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will therefore receive consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, race, color, religion, world view, national origin, genetics, disability, gender identity, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other protected characteristic required by applicable law. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and will be given special consideration if they are equally qualified.

Looking for work that matters? Join Viant and contribute to the design and manufacturing of medical technologies that improve patient outcomes. Guided by our promise—We’re In It For Life—you’ll build your career with a trusted industry innovator that invests in your growth, well-being, and ability to make a meaningful impact every day.

**About the company:**
Viant is a global medical device partner providing design, development, manufacturing, and assembly services through capabilities in materials, plastics, metals, extrusion, and automation. With nearly 6,000 employees across 24 locations worldwide, it delivers high-quality, life-enhancing products with the scale and expertise to bring devices to market efficiently. Learn more at Viant Medical’s website or in LinkedIn.

**About the role:**
The Senior Program Manager (SPM) is responsible for the management, implementation and strategy for a New Product Introduction, Transfer, Cost Reduction, Integrations, Insourcing, and Strategic Corporate Programs across all Viant Medical functional groups. The SPM will support, coach and mentor core sub-team members and functional leaders through issues associated with implementing new projects, customers and products. The SPM will follow and create processes for communicating and tracking all activities, commitments and metrics associated with a given project or program and will provide critical influence in ensuring that projects and products are implemented that meet Viant Medical’s cost, yield, quality supply chain and product release/support goals. The SPM will ensure the project review process has been implemented per Viant policy, and programs transition through the process as required. The SPM will be responsible for organizing weekly project review meetings, schedule and financial reviews for any programs under their leadership.

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for communicating the deliverables, requirements, and overall Customer needs to the cross-functional team. This requires an accurate assessment of the Project. These activities could include - understanding the requirements and deliverables of the customers, working with the plant leadership and Director of Operations to identify the required resources, and establishing ownership throughout the organization for the deliverables.

**Work Model:** Remote with 50% travel requirement as needed.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead cross-functional teams on key Strategic projects including but not limited to New Product Introduction, Transfer, Cost Reduction, Integrations, Insourcing, and Strategic Corporate Programs.
* Primary point of contact and communication between Viant and the Customer.
* Define the scope, budget, requirements, and deliverables of all assigned projects. Document and communicate internally and externally as needed.
* Ensuring the planning, coordination, execution, tracking, reporting and closure.
* Using Microsoft Project software tool, development of a fully Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) including all required tasks with key milestones identified and tracked.
* Obtain functional department commitment / buy-in to the schedule and budget
* Issue/Risk management to include development and tracking/reporting of mitigation plans.
* Program budget setting, financial analysis and reporting
* Assure activities will meet Viant requirements (SOP’s), FDA and ISO regulations.
* Goal setting and on-time delivery of Viant and customer milestone deliverables
* Project reporting requirements include but are not limited to:
* Provide Weekly Status Reporting for assigned Projects
* Provide Monthly Project Review status for assigned Projects as scheduled.
* Initiate corrective action review meetings when the project schedule is not being met.
* Working with the Project Team and Plant Management develop and document recovery plans and corrective actions into the IMS.
* Communicate the revised plans and schedule to the Customer.
* Utilize and steward Viant’s ViaLaunch program management process

Other projects and tasks as assigned.

**Job Requirements:****Education/ Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline or business management with at least 7 years of related work experience
* PMP Certification preferred

**Job Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years work experience (post-college)
* 5+ years project management experience
* Experience in medical device, contract manufacturing or related regulated industry preferred

**Skills/Competencies:**

* Project management skills; demonstrated use of PMI methodology.
* Strong analytical, planning, organization and time management skills
* Demonstrated track record of leading within complex organizations requiring strong influential management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a matrix organization, build teams and relationships.
* Experience leading projects with multiple cross-functional team members and functional management.
* Abilit

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

As our Maritime team continues to quickly grow, we are looking for motivated candidates that are inspired to work within an extremely energetic, creative, and innovative team that is passionate about subsea robotics and exploring the open ocean. We work in a highly dynamic environment where collaboration and idea sharing are a way of life.

We are looking for a Logistics Manager to join our rapidly growing team in Quincy, MA. In this role, you are responsible for overseeing all global logistics operations supporting Undersea Reconnaissance and Strike events and shipments. You will ensure the secure, compliant, and timely transport and storage of sensitive equipment, assets, and materials in alignment with U.S. government regulations and defense contracting standards. * Plan, manage, and execute logistics for all shipping to and from URS locations.
* Generate commercial invoices and packing lists for the export of items internationally.
* Work with international trade compliance to ensure proper jurisdiction classification on exports
* Oversee the secure transport and storage of sensitive equipment, prototypes, and display assets, ensuring compliance with defense sector requirements.
* Develop logistics playbooks and contingency strategies for mission-critical event timelines.
* Manage export/import documentation, ATA Carnets, customs declarations, and temporary imports.

**Transportation & Vendor Management**

* Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers and specialized logistics service providers.
* Select and oversee logistics service partners with proven defense industry and government clearance capabilities.
* Act as the primary logistics liaison with event organizers, internal stakeholder and external parties.

**Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Track and analyze costs related to freight, warehousing, customs, duties, and special handling.
* Drive cost optimization while ensuring compliance and operational excellence.

**Risk Management & Process Improvement**

* Anticipate and resolve potential delays due to customs, security, or geopolitical risks.
* Standardize logistics processes for repeatable success across shipments.
* Develop and implement KPIs for on-time delivery, compliance accuracy, and cost performance.

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, business, or related field (master's preferred).
* 7+ years of experience in global logistics or supply chain management, with defense sector exposure strongly preferred.
* Experience managing sensitive and oversized shipments via ocean and air freight.
* Knowledge of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, U.S. export/import controls and import/exports controls of various global markets.

* Develop material program plans and supplier management plans for assigned programs.
* Translate engineering and program requirements into an actionable sourcing plan.

* Partner directly with engineering to define supply-chain requirements and delivery timing.
* Identify and escalate anything that puts program material at risk on cost, schedule, quality, or performance.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* MBA or master's degree in finance, supply chain management, or a related field.
* Background in aerospace, defense, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

* Hands-on experience developing material program strategy from the ground up.
* Familiarity with supplier statements of work and associated contract requirements.
* Experience managing supplier selection, onboarding, and ongoing performance evaluation.
* Working knowledge of material requirements planning and logistics coordination.
* Demonstrated success operating within a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at the executive level.

As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

* **Grow with an Ownership Mindset**: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.
* **Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike:** At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.
* **Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose:** We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

**Location:** Remote in these states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KS, KY, IA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI

**Role Description:**

ShipBob is looking for a GTM Strategy and Programs Manager to sit at the intersection of Revenue Operations and field execution. In this role, you will own the design, operationalization, and continuous improvement of go-to-market programs that drive pipeline generation, sales productivity, and revenue growth. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Enablement, and RevOps stakeholders to translate strategy into structured programs—then measure and iterate on what works. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on a team that moves fast and holds itself to a high bar.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the GTM program calendar—design, launch, and manage cross-functional programs spanning pipeline generation, new logo acquisition, expansion, and partner motions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to define segment-level plays and operationalize them in Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Claude, or whatever cutting-edge idea you bring—ensuring reps have the right motion at the right stage.
* Build program measurement frameworks: define success metrics, instrument tracking in Salesforce and Databricks, and deliver recurring performance readouts to RevOps and GTM leadership.
* Oversee quarterly and annual GTM planning cycles in partnership with Revenue Operations, Finance, and go-to-market leaders, including headcount modeling, capacity planning, and segment-level goal setting.
* Run strategic projects including ICP refinement, territory design, and GTM model evolution.
* Serve as a connective layer between Marketing, Enablement, GTM Engineering, and Sales—ensuring programs are activated, tracked, and continuously improved across the full funnel.
* Support board- and exec-level reporting on GTM program ROI, pipeline health, and strategic initiative progress.
* Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* 3+ years of experience in GTM strategy, Revenue Operations, sales strategy, investment banking, or management consulting—B2B SaaS or logistics/supply chain exposure is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to take a strategic concept from whiteboard to operationalized program—you know how to build structure around ambiguous problems.
* Excellent analytical skills with hands-on experience in Salesforce reporting; familiarity with tools like Gong, Outreach, and BI platforms (Databricks, Tableau, or similar) is a plus.
* Exceptional cross-functional communicator—you can work with a VP on strategy in the morning and with a Salesforce admin on execution in the afternoon.
* High ownership mindset: you treat programs like a product manager treats a product—you define success, measure outcomes, and keep iterating until it works.
* Experience supporting or leading annual planning processes, including quota setting, territory design, or capacity modeling preferred.
* MBA required or strongly preferred; prior experience in consulting, finance, or a high-growth startup environment.

***ShipBob believes in transparency while providing a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance approach. We are targeting a salary range of $135,000 - $169,000 for this role. In addition to base salary, this role includes the opportunity to be eligible for participation in the Company's discretionary bonus plan based on Company's plans and in accordance with Company's policies.***

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance
* Paid Maternity/Parental Leave Program
* Paid Holidays & Flexible Time Off Program
* Paid Sick Leave
* Wellness Days (1 day/quarter)
* 401K Match

**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

**Role Overview:**
------------------

The Manager, Retail Development, Products & Experiences is in charge of executing retail and e-commerce strategies that drive sell-in of licensed merchandise across key retail partners. This role manages day-to-day relationships with Amazon, Costco and additionally coordinates all Canadian retailers.

This is an onsite position at our Los Angeles office.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage relationships with retail partners (Primarily Canadian retailers, Amazon and Costco) and licensees to drive sell-in and sell-through of licensed products across all major product categories including Toys, Sporting Goods, Apparel, Home, Accessories, Food & Beverage and Essentials & Beauty.
* Execute retail and e-commerce strategies across category responsibilities, including Amazon vendor/marketplace programs and Costco roadshow and club placements
* Be the account and retail expert across categories
* Contribute to overall account long term planning and strategy
* Monitor online detail-page content, search performance, and in-club retail performance to identify opportunities to increase sales and distribution
* Partner with licensing category teams to support product launches and retail activations in partnership with licensees
* Ensure brand consistency and compliance across all licensed products and retail placements, including digital shelf standards
* Conduct virtual and in-person retail audits to ensure merchandising standards are met and identify new opportunities
* Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitive activity across e-commerce and club channels
* Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, category, franchise) to support campaigns

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in retail, e-commerce, licensing, consumer products, or business development
* Bachelor's degree

**Additional Qualifications:**
------------------------------

* Solid written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work individually with solid organizational skills, attention to detail and follow-up
* Experience working with licensed brands or retail partnerships preferred
* Deep knowledge of e-commerce and club retail environments and merchandising strategies
* Exemplary relationship management and communication skills
* Analytical mindset with experience using sales data to drive decisions
* Working knowledge of entertainment, categories and/or retail industry ideally with in depth knowledge of Amazon, Costco or other major consumer products retailers

**About Skydance**
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Hiring Salary Range: $103,000.00 - 123,000.00.

Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.

This position is bonus eligible.

* Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
* Generous paid time off.
* Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.

------------

At Specsavers, our purpose is clear: to change lives through better sight and hearing. Behind that purpose sits a globally connected product and supply chain ecosystem responsible for shaping one of our most commercially significant categories.

The Ophthalmic Lens Category Development team shapes the future of Specsavers' global lens portfolio, combining customer insight, innovation and strategic partnerships to drive growth and customer outcomes.

We're looking for a Director of Category Development to lead one of Specsavers' most strategically important categories, shaping the future of the global ophthalmic lens portfolio and driving sustainable growth, customer outcomes and commercial success.

**The Role**

This is a senior leadership role responsible for defining the long-term vision for Specsavers' global ophthalmic lens category. You'll identify growth opportunities, shape the future portfolio and ensure customers continue to benefit from high-quality, market-leading lens solutions.

Leading a global network of suppliers, partners and stakeholders, you'll build strategic relationships that foster innovation, strengthen resilience and create long-term value. Working across the business, you'll connect customer needs, clinical insight and operational capability to bring new products and category initiatives successfully to market.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and deliver the global ophthalmic lens category strategy, shaping a long-term vision that drives growth, innovation and customer value.
* Develop and execute a multi-year category and portfolio roadmap aligned to business and regional priorities.
* Lead the evolution of the global lens portfolio, ensuring it remains relevant, competitive and aligned to customer and market needs.
* Drive innovation across lens technologies, materials, treatments, myopia management and emerging manufacturing solutions.
* Leverage customer, clinical and market insights to identify opportunities, inform investment decisions and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Develop and execute global supplier and sourcing strategies, balancing innovation, quality, resilience, value and security of supply.
* Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers and technology partners to drive innovation, performance and long-term value creation.
* Lead strategic commercial discussions, supplier reviews and business case development to support future growth.
* Identify and manage supplier, technology and production risks, ensuring effective mitigation and contingency planning.
* Partner across Product Operations, Manufacturing & Distribution, Fulfilment, Demand Planning, S&OP, Clinical, Marketing and regional teams to translate strategy into successful execution.
* Establish governance, performance frameworks and decision-making processes that support innovation, delivery and category growth.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, creating alignment and influencing strategic outcomes.
* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing global team, fostering a culture of curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Own the category budget, ensuring investments deliver sustainable growth, customer value and commercial returns.

**What We're Looking For**

* Senior leadership experience within ophthalmic lenses, optical products, healthcare products, category development or a similarly complex global product environment.
* Deep understanding of ophthalmic lens products, technologies, manufacturing, supplier networks and market dynamics.
* Experience developing and delivering global category, portfolio, innovation or sourcing strategies across multiple markets.
* Strong commercial acumen, including strategic supplier management, negotiations, business case development and value creation.
* A proven track record of turning customer, clinical and market insights into strategic decisions and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience leading complex transformation and cross-functional change programmes from strategy through to implementation.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align diverse global teams and functions.
* Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capability, balancing innovation, risk, quality, customer impact and commercial performance.
* An inclusive leadership style with experience building and developing high-performing, globally distributed teams.
* A curious, future-focused mindset with the resilience to thrive in a fast-moving, matrix organisation.

**Why This Role?**

This is an opportunity to lead one of Specsavers' most strategically important and commercially significant categories, shaping its future direction across a global business and influencing growth, innovation and customer outcomes at scale.

Ulta Beauty is expanding its digital capabilities, opening new stores on a continual basis and re-designing existing locations with the latest design and technological advancements for heightened guest experiences. We’re not just growing, we’re thriving through consistent innovation and a bold commitment to re-imagination. If you want the opportunity to build something strategic, to take ownership of your career trajectory, to apply your passion to operational excellence, Ulta Beauty provides the kind of stability and support few organizations can match. So be curious. Be flexible. Be more than you thought possible. The future is yours at Ulta Beauty.

:

**THE IMAPCT YOU CAN HAVE:**

As an Associate Planner, your financial and analytical aptitude will enable you to develop and execute comprehensive merchandise plans while maintaining strong partnerships with merchants, inventory analysts and external brands. You will oversee all aspects of planning and inventory management for all brands under your portfolio to achieve the strategic and financial objectives of the enterprise.

**YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:**

* Manage the development and execution of merchandise plans (weekly, monthly, annual) and inventory strategies for all brands under portfolio
* Establish and maintain credible partnerships with external brands, share monthly projections, advocate for what’s best for the business, and engage in critical negotiations while providing clear financial justifications for decisions
* Partner with internal merchants to grow and drive the business. Analyze market trends, historical data and customer/sales insights to drive the business
* Partner with FPA to provide insights into changes (margins, receipts) that impact overall financial performance and ensure decisions are made with a thorough understanding of the impact on the bottom line
* Collaborates with Inventory Analysts, communicates inventory strategies and direction to maintain healthy inventory levels and manage towards turn and EOH goals
* Develops and analyzes sales, inventory and ad-hoc reports
* Identifies and communicates opportunities and risks on overall business performance
* Participates and/or leads category, functional or enterprise initiatives

:

* Ability to make well-informed decisions through the evaluation of large quantities of data, discovery of trends and development of actionable insights

* Mindset that emphasizes teamwork
* Desire to continuously learn inventory best practices and activities

**About Us:** Uwajimaya, a family-owned business, and a cornerstone of Asian grocery retailing since 1928, is seeking dedicated individuals to join our dynamic team. With a legacy of excellence and a commitment to providing exceptional customer experiences, Uwajimaya has grown to become the premier destination for Asian food culture in the Pacific Northwest.

**Who We're Looking For:** We are seeking individuals who are passionate about delivering excellent customer service, driven to excel in their roles, and motivated to contribute to our vibrant team. Whether you're a seasoned professional or eager to start your career, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds who share our enthusiasm for food, customer service, and Asian culture.

**We offer:**

* A flexible, friendly, and diverse work environment
* Competitive starting wages
* Employee discounts on food and gift items
* Paid holidays from day one
* Excellent health benefits
* Retirement plan
* Paid time off
* Long term disability
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for growth and advancement
* Supplemental insurance options available

**Position Summary**:

The Senior Category Manager Deli & Bakery, under the guidance of the VP of Retail Sales, is responsible for developing and executing strategic plans to manage assortment, as well as to drive sales, profitability, and market share in Uwajimaya Deli & Bakery departments. The Senior Category Manager Deli & Bakery will create, curate, and own in-store and central kitchen scratch made assortments, as well as third party vendor made fresh and packaged assortments. This role requires an understanding of Japanese & Pan Asian foods, service deli operations, and recipe creation, as well as vendor and supply chain management. The Candidate should have experience in service deli or food service operations, supply chain, and retail category management. The Candidate should possess strong interpersonal communication skills. The Senior Category Manager Deli & Bakery directly oversees the Deli Category Assistant. Fluency in Japanese, Cantonese, or Mandarin is a plus, but not required.

**Position’s Key Responsibilities**:

* Develop and implement category strategies that align with overall business objectives and promote Japanese and Pan-Asian assortments. Conduct market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive insights. Optimize product assortment, pricing, and promotions to drive sales and profitability. Analyze sales performance and customer feedback to make data-driven decisions.
* Work with store Deli Managers to develop new Japanese and Pan Asian products for central kitchen and store production. Own and oversee ingredient statements, labeling, and packaging to complement assortment. Responsible for costs, pricing, margin of scratch made assortment in stores and central kitchen.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key food service and packaged goods suppliers and vendors. Negotiate contracts, terms, and conditions to ensure favorable pricing and supply chain efficiency. Shepherd and incubate new and local on trend vendors into Deli & Bakery assortment.
* Work closely with corporate marketing and merchandising teams to execute category plans. Ability to influence and collaborate with store deli department managers and teams to implement new changes and processes, ensuring smooth transitions and effective adoption of new initiatives. Coordinate with store operations to ensure effective in-store execution and presentation. Work closely with central kitchen to execute scratch made assortments.
* Monitor and report on category performance metrics, including sales, margins, and inventory turnover. Develop and implement action plans to address underperforming areas.
* Conduct consumer research and gather insights to understand shopping behaviors and preferences. Leverage insights to influence category strategy and drive customer satisfaction. Stay close to Asian restaurant and Asian retail grocery food trends.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Salary Range:** $91,468 - $135,689

Job Description:

**Our Opportunity**
Chewy is hiring Specialists for our Category Management team in our headquarters in Plantation, FL. These Specialists will support specific categories; Responsibilities include managing vendor ticket resolution, promotions setup, new vendor & new SKU onboarding and new assortment onboarding. The Category Specialist will often be the first point of contact for our vendors so it will be critical to deliver high-quality, thoughtful service to our valued partners. This role is uniquely positioned to directly craft our vendor and customer experiences, ultimately contributing to the Chewy brand!

In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and delivering priorities in an organized manner and according to service level agreements (SLAs). You will consistently deliver routine tasks that support broader category strategies and maintain vendor relationships through meaningful interactions. You will exercise your strong interpersonal skills, detailed attention, and the ability to absorb information and experiences quickly. Working well with both internal and external partners, you will thrive in our ambitious but flexible environment where approach-focused ideas and a customer-focused demeanor are highly valued.

**What You'll Do**

* Resolve vendor tickets on a daily/weekly basis in line with our SLAs
* Set up and implement promotions as per category manager direction
* Ensure new vendors and new SKUs are onboarded according to SLAs; troubleshoot issues and raise concerns when necessary
* Work cross-functionally with supply chain, private label, finance, catalog and promotion teams

**What You'll Need**

* Completion of a BS/BA degree desired
* 1+ years of experience with a preference in eCommerce, buying, account management, product management, category management, operations, analytics, finance or marketing
* Good analytical abilities and problem-solving skills (Excel, SQL is a plus)
* Strong verbal and written communication,
* Self-starter with a bias for action and attention to detail
* Proven time management, data analysis, and organizational management skills

The hourly range for this role is $25.00 - $37.50.

* The specific hourly range offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Non-exempt hourly team members accrue paid time off (PTO) and are eligible for additional unplanned unpaid time off (UTO)Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

**About Fort Lauderdale United FC**

Fort Lauderdale United FC is a growing professional sports organization based in South Florida, building a platform centered around professional teams, youth development, and community engagement.

The organization includes a women’s professional soccer team competing in the Gainbridge Super League and a men’s professional team joining USL League One in March. Fort Lauderdale United also operates soccer and volleyball academies, NFL FLAG football programming, and is developing additional sports programs including basketball and lacrosse.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Merchandise Manager will oversee the full merchandise operation across Fort Lauderdale United’s professional teams, academies, and sports programs.

This role owns the merchandise lifecycle—from product sourcing and vendor management to inventory, retail operations, e-commerce, marketing campaigns, collaborations, and new distribution opportunities.

The ideal candidate combines strong retail and operational skills with creativity and a commercial mindset. We are looking for someone who will not simply manage merchandise, but actively find new ways to grow revenue, expand distribution, create memorable products, and strengthen the Fort Lauderdale United brand.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

**Merchandise & Product Strategy**

* Lead merchandise and apparel strategy across Fort Lauderdale United.
* Source products and manage relationships with manufacturers, suppliers, and vendors.
* Identify new products, collections, trends, and limited-edition opportunities.
* Manage purchasing, pricing, inventory, product launches, and replenishment.
* Use sales and inventory data to guide future product decisions.

**Retail & Game Day Operations**

* Oversee merchandise retail locations at the stadium and training/operations facilities.
* Be present for applicable home matches and major events.
* Maintain organized, well-stocked, visually appealing retail environments.
* Coordinate merchandise needs for matches, tournaments, academy programs, community events, and other club activities.

**E-Commerce & Marketing**

* Manage the Fort Lauderdale United Shopify store, including products, inventory, promotions, and launches.
* Develop campaigns that drive merchandise awareness and sales.
* Partner with the marketing team on product storytelling, content, promotions, and launches.
* Create merchandise opportunities around matches, players, holidays, community initiatives, and special events.

**Collaborations & Distribution**

* Work with the Partnerships team on collaborations with corporate partners, local businesses, artists, and brands.
* Develop limited-edition products and collections inspired by Fort Lauderdale United and South Florida.
* Identify third-party retailers and community locations that can carry Fort Lauderdale United merchandise.
* Find creative ways to expand the brand beyond Fort Lauderdale United facilities.

**Revenue Growth & Reporting**

* Take ownership of merchandise revenue growth and new commercial opportunities.
* Track and report sales, inventory, campaign performance, and key merchandise KPIs.
* Analyze customer behavior, product performance, and inventory movement.
* Maintain merchandise budgets, purchasing records, and vendor information.
Proactively bring new concepts and business opportunities to leadership.

==========================

* Experience in merchandise, retail, apparel, e-commerce, brand management, or a related field.
* Experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform.
* Strong inventory, purchasing, and vendor-management skills.
* Ability to take merchandise campaigns from concept through launch.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Understanding of branding, consumer trends, retail presentation, and product storytelling.
* Ability to collaborate across marketing, partnerships, operations, and leadership.
* Willingness to work matches, events, evenings, and weekends as needed.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to identify opportunities and execute them.

This is an opportunity to build the merchandise business of a rapidly growing South Florida sports organization.

description:
**Job Description:**
Category Manager, Club All Other Value

Chicago, IL

The Category Manager is responsible for managing category leadership solutions for Club/AO Value. The position will focus on the Mars Snacking business including Chocolate Candy, Non-Chocolate Candy, Gum, Mints, Snacks and Seasonal. This role is expected to provide fact and insight-based solutions that drive growth for the category within the business. Utilizing shopper insight, opportunity identification and full understanding of products, assortment, pricing, placement, shelving, promotion, and merchandising, this role is the primary insight provider for our confectionery businesses across the marketplace. This role will work closely with internal and external partners.

What are we looking for?

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 3-5 years of experience in Sales or Category Management, within CPG and/or retail
* 1 year of business analytics experience
* Experience working with syndicated data software (i.e., 1010, IRI or Nielsen)
* Experience working in Assortment Planning or Space Management Software (i.e. Apollo, Intercept, etc)
* Experience with promotional / non promotional strategy development
* Strong problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Solid written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Ability to travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree
* 5 years of experience in Sales or Category Management
* 2 year of business analytics experience
* Previous experience in managing the Confectionery businesses
* Solid knowledge of Shopper Insights and Marketing Research and Strategy
* Experience in project development and partnering with large strategic retail customers
* Advanced data mining experience including shopper loyalty card and household panel data

What would be your key responsibilities?

* Create and plan category leadership solutions that deliver profitable sales growth for Club/AO Value across all business segments. These solutions should include shopper and category insights across: products/ assortment, placement, shelving, merchandising, pricing, and promotions.
* Where appropriate, manage and deliver against the responsibilities of the Category Captaincy/Advisory process in partnership with Club/AO Value.
* Influence Club/AO Value by identifying specific opportunities, assist with any research and lead projects to deliver category leadership solutions benefitting both retailers and MWC.
* Influence Annual Account Business Planning at Club/AO Value , through full partnering with sales team, by providing actionable category insights and solutions that support category leadership objectives for customer, company and category
* Identify specific research opportunities (shopper, consumer, etc.) to bring new learning to category leadership solutions.
* Execute all agreed to category leadership solutions with Club/AO Value to include success measures and detailed follow through
* Evaluate/ monitor all customer category leadership solutions, turn analysis into recommended action and continually improve to be more effective and efficient for category.
* Leverage insights and resources through the utilization of a broad range of data sources, market research findings, tools, analyses, and technology to continually bring new shopper ideas to selected retailers and Mars; incorporate in all category solutions for selected retailers.

What can you expect from Mars?

* Work with over 150,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.
* Join a purpose driven company, where we are striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
* Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
* An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

The pay range shown is applicable to all US locations listed within the job posting: USD 108,160.00 - USD 148,720.00

**Description**

Retail Category Analyst – Grocery & Dairy

Purpose and Scope/General Summary: We are looking for a Retail Category Analyst for Wild Fork Foods that reports onsite to the Wild Fork Food’s corporate office in Doral, FL.

The Retail Category Analyst supports the development, management, and growth of the Grocery, Dairy, and Refrigerated categories. Reporting directly to the Category Merchant, this role assists with product development, category management, replenishment, vendor coordination, and portfolio optimization to drive sales, contribution margin, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

* Support the end-to-end product lifecycle process from concept through launch.
* Coordinate new product development activities, including packaging creation, sensory evaluations, ingredient reviews, and commercialization timelines.
* Contribute to maintaining category and brand standards related to quality, ingredients, nutrition, and product attributes.
* Monitor consumer trends, competitive activity, and emerging products to identify opportunities for category growth and innovation.
* Analyze product and category performance to support assortment, pricing, promotional, and product development decisions.
* Maintain product master data and ensure a high level of accuracy across all item attributes and specifications.
* Assist in the development of product specifications, process requirements, and supplier documentation.
* Work closely with suppliers and co-packing partners to support product development, replenishment, and ongoing category needs.
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships through effective communication and collaboration.
* Create and manage purchase orders to support replenishment needs and ensure timely supplier execution.
* Partner with cross-functional teams including Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Operations, Marketing, and Finance to support category initiatives and product launches.
* Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree required; Business, Food Science, Marketing, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in retail merchandising, category management, product development, buying, or consumer packaged goods (CPG).
* Experience within Grocery, Dairy, Refrigerated, or related food categories preferred.
* Culinary or food industry experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and business acumen.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Solid understanding of food products, culinary fundamentals, and sensory evaluation.
* Working knowledge of HACCP and other food safety and quality processes.
* Strong organizational & project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Copilot, and related business applications.
* Passion for food, cooking, and product innovation.
* Can perform the functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation
* As a salaried position with the company, you may be required to travel at some point to other facilities, to attend Company events, or as a representative of the Company in other situations. Unless otherwise specified in this posting, the amount of travel may vary and the most qualified candidate must be willing and able to travel as business needs dictate.

The applicant who fills this position will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits:

* Benefits: Vision, Medical, and Dental coverage begin after 60 days of employment;
* Paid Time Off: sick leave, vacation, and 6 company observed holidays;
* 401(k): company match begins after the first year of service and follows the company vesting schedule;
* Base salary range of $70,000-$80,000;
* Incentive Pay: This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s annual bonus plan, the amount of bonus varies and is subject to the standard terms and conditions of the incentive program; and
* Career Development: Our company is dedicated to supporting professional growth by offering continuous learning opportunities and a focus on career growth through various learning and development programs.

The posted salary range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the compensation that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, tenure, internal equity, market data, and may vary accordingly.

This position does not have an application deadline. We will continue to recruit until the position has been filled.

description:
At Spoonflower (part of the Shutterfly family of brands) our mission is to empower your vision by helping you discover the perfect design for you and your print on wallpaper, fabric, or home decor. Spoonflower connects independent artists worldwide who create designs with consumers, makers, and interior designers looking for unique designs and products that are right for their projects.

The Merchandising Specialist II supports our Homeowner business and is responsible for defining and driving preseason merchandising and strategy, with a focus on optimizing product and design performance. This role leverages data and insights, deeply understands customer intent and preferences, quickly identifies trends, and determines what products and designs are featured where and why. This role leads pre-season planning and has accountability of in-season execution. Success is defined by proactive planning, analytical rigor, and measurable business impact. This role will support our homeowner customer, with a focus on Decor and Interiors FBTY assortment.

Pre-season Strategy & Merchandise Planning

* Lead design and product curation strategy; balancing trends, performance, and customer intent.
* Create, own, and develop the seasonal merchandising strategy and calendar. Determine when specific styles, collections, themes, and trends need to be surfaced. Align product and design priorities with marketing priorities to meet category plans while maximizing seasonal and consumer demand trends.
* Define product and design assortment and placement strategy across digital (site and channel feeds) utilizing data and insights from ecom and growth marketing teams.
* Take action on any high touch artist outreach needed; either directly with artists or with support from customer support.

Product / Design Performance – Analysis & Insights

* Analyze product and design performance across key KPI’s - customer count, engagement, conversion, AOV, ASP, unit demand, revenue, and gross margin.
* Establish and lead regular product and design performance reviews, elevating insights beyond reporting into strategic action on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Develop framework for design lifecycle management (launch, evaluate, scale, optimize, retire).

In-Season Execution and Oversight

* Execute promotion setup and governance, ensuring accuracy and consistency across systems (contentful, commerce tools, admin, etc)
* Maintain accountability for product data integrity and taxonomy across systems – both consumer facing and internal facing.
* Seek accountability for design data integrity and taxonomy – enabling effective filtering, search, and discoverability.
* Act as an owner- being the central point of connection between merchandising, growth marketing, ecom, creative, customer support and data teams.
* Provide input on priorities and workload, ensuring efficient focus, time, and execution is prioritized on defined business goals.
* Ability to win as a team – proactive outreach and support to high value customers as needed.

Qualifications

* Bachelors degree required
* 3-5+ years of experience in merchandising, business development, or buying
* Experience in Fabric and Textiles category preferred
* Strong analytical skills with experience translating data into business strategy
* Experience with CMS platforms, ecommerce tools, and data platforms
* Proven ability to develop merchandising and marketing strategies that drive measurable results
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce is important to Shutterfly not only because it directly reflects our value of Embracing our Differences, but also because it’s the right thing to do for our business and for our people. We welcome all applicants and evaluate them based on their qualifications. Learn more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion on our Career Site.

This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis until filled.
