* **Leverage consumer insights, analyze category data, and monitor the competitive landscape** to identify whitespace opportunities for your category, delivering innovation while capturing share
* **Lead portfolio reviews to optimize SKU productivity and portfolio rationalization decisions.**
* **Act as the P&L owner for your team’s businesses** — establishing forecasts, cost targets, and margin goal for new items while managing portfolio health of total category
* **Bring a global mindset** to ensure product market fits across regions.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:** **Brings strategy to life by influencing, aligning, and leading core teams toward a shared outcome.**

* **Lead and influence cross-functional teams** — drive clarity around decisions, changes, and shifting priorities.
* **Foster collaboration, trust, and accountability** by building strong working relationships across all functions.

The pay range is $73,000.00 - $132,000.00

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

A role in Buying means working with several diverse vendors to choose the best product mix, both in-store and online. We help determine where to localize, while calibrating market positioning and acting as brand managers. Here, you’ll own a wide SKU count so that your work is varied and challenging. Through cross-functional collaboration, instinct and creativity, you will be the expert on the guest, the market and the competition.

A **Buyer** helps create omni-channel growth by planning profitable and locally relevant assortments using your grasp of guest shopping behavior, assortment requirements and competitors. You will influence and negotiate with vendors to achieve results and identify gaps and opportunities. Your flexibility in reacting to business results and your ability to translate financial metrics and data into actionable strategies will be critical. You will lead cross-functional teams to drive category results while managing progress toward sales and margin goals. Your partnerships with product designers and/or category managers and vendors will help guide product development as you source appropriately for your category. You will interact with Associate Buyers, Senior Merchandise Specialists, the Pricing and Promotion Center of Excellence, Planning, Site Merchandising, the Item Center of Excellence and many other expert partners in support of your promotional planning work across channels.

Core responsibilities are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 1+ years of Merchandising experience
* Strong strategic and analytical skills to grow a business
* Strong collaboration skills to partner with Cross Functional Teams
* Flexibility, resilient and comfortable working in “grey areas” that are constantly changing

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target. Click here if you are curious to learn more about Minnesota.

**Benefits Eligibility**

Please paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou\\_D

**Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)**

In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to candidate.accommodations@HRHelp.Target.com. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.

Application deadline is : 10/18/2026

description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

The Associate Category Manager drives category performance through detailed analysis of product assortment, pricing change analysis, including historical changes and future forecasting, vendor proposals and agreements. The position is focused on optimization of category activities to include new product review, assortment review, vendor negotiations, including RFP and RFI activities, and pricing work related to the assigned category.

**New Ways of Work****: This position has been segmented as hybrid meaning the work is a combination of 3 days onsite In Rosemont, IL (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) and 2 days remotely (Monday and Friday) as defined by the role segmentation.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and provide detailed analysis of assigned category performance including growth objectives. Analysis will focus on the areas of product assortment, pricing, promotions, new product introductions, pricing changes, etc. Maintain regular reports to track performance and identify impact of variables on category performance against established metrics. Identify and report on trends, changes and opportunities. Provide suggestions aimed at increasing category performance.
* Develop RFPs and RFIs. Throughout the course of vendor negotiations and on-going management, review vendor proposals, agreements and contracts to support the category's success.
* Manage and maintain relationships with vendors leading product reviews, identification and assessment of opportunities and negotiating promotions for conferences. Additionally, the Associate Category Manager will negotiate with vendors who currently do not have in-place agreements with US Foods. Negotiate deals and Vendor Pricing Allowances (VPAs) with suppliers.
* Review and assess vendor performance reports, identify issues and provide recommendations to Category Manager.
* Conduct product assortment review and analysis, identifying top-performing SKUs by division and region. Identify areas for potential growth and analyze impact of proposed assortment changes. Recommend changes and actions to the Category Manager, aimed at enhancing category effectiveness and performance.
* Review category pricing reports on a regular basis, identifying potential pricing issues and opportunities. Conduct a detailed analysis on the impact of pricing and assortment changes and provide findings and recommendations to the Category Manager. Support the category by developing category specific communications, including product launch support materials.
* Maintain close relations with US Foods regions and divisions with the objective of understanding critical requirements and perspectives and ensuring that their needs are addressed in the overall category strategy. Liaise with divisions to resolve escalated merchandising issues.
* Other duties assigned by manager.

**Education/Training:**

* Four-year college degree in business or related field, or equivalent experience required.

**Related Experience:**

* Must possess a minimum 3 years experience in retail, food service or with a consumer goods company.
* Prior experience in vendor relations, pricing and management of product assortment required.
* Prior Category Management experience strongly desired.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Must possess the ability to operate successfully in a matrix environment and work effectively across multiple groups and levels.
* The successful candidate will have solid quantitative and analytical skills and the ability to work in a team setting. Must possess, or be able to rapidly develop, a strong knowledge of products within assigned category and division sales requirements.
* Must be able to provide fact-based recommendations across various levels of management.
* The ideal candidate will demonstrate a high degree of motivation, the ability to prioritize and self direct, strong business acumen and sound interpersonal skills.

description:
Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you will do::

The **Corporate Rotational Program** **on the Category Management track** is a 12-month, full-time development experience designed to build early-career professionals with a strong foundation in merchandise planning, private label, assortment planning, and category strategy.

Through three structured rotations, participants build foundational knowledge of item and supplier management while taking on increasing responsibility for category decisions. You’ll work closely with category managers and cross-functional partners, analyze performance data, and gain insight into how assortment and supplier strategies support QXO’s branches, customers, and broader business goals.

The program concludes with a four-week capstone focused on a category or assortment opportunity. Participants who successfully complete the program may be considered for a full-time role based on business needs, individual performance, and demonstrated career interests.

Each rotation is structured to build broad category management knowledge while giving you meaningful ownership of your work.

* Support category and assortment planning initiatives through product and supplier research, item-level analysis, competitive benchmarking, and performance reporting.
* Analyze SKU, supplier, regional, inventory, pricing, and promotional data to identify opportunities and help inform assortment and category decisions.
* Contribute to item and supplier setup and maintenance, private-label activities, line reviews, promotional planning, and other category management initiatives while ensuring assigned information and deliverables are accurate.
* Coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams, including operations, finance, supply chain, marketing, pricing, and commercial teams, to support category initiatives and broader business objectives.
* Manage assigned projects and workstreams, communicate findings and recommendations to business partners and category leaders, and monitor results to understand the impact of category decisions.

Across every rotation, you will receive defined objectives, regular feedback, and direct mentorship to support your growth and performance.

What you will bring::

* Bachelor's degree completed by the program start date in Merchandising, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Operations, or a related field; candidates with up to two years of relevant experience are welcome.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to interpret product, supplier, operational, and financial data.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes, maintain accurate information, manage competing priorities, and follow work through to completion.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders and present clear recommendations.
* Resourcefulness, resilience, ambition, and a results-oriented approach in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Genuine interest in building a long-term career in category management, merchandising, assortment planning, or a related commercial function.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Internship, co-op, or project experience in supply chain, operations, logistics, procurement, or manufacturing
* Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel) or exposure to supply chain systems (ERP, planning tools)
* Demonstrated business mindset with a focus on operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and customer outcomes

What you will earn::

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

***QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We value diversity and do not discriminate* *on the basis of* *race, color, religion,* *gender or sexual orientation**, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.*

**Company Overview**

Established in 1929, Heinen’sis a leading, family-owned grocery retailer known for its premium-quality products and outstanding customer service. Now in its fourth generation of family leadership, Heinen’s operates 23 locations – 18 in the Cleveland, Ohio area and 5 in the Chicago, Illinois market – supported by two distribution warehouses, a food production facility, and a corporate office located in Warrensville Heights, Ohio.

Our culture is rooted in an *associate-first philosophy*, placing a strong emphasis on the well-being, development, and quality of life of every team member. We offer competitive compensation, professional development and leadership training programs, paid time off, and flexible scheduling designed to promote a healthy work-life balance.

**Role Overview**

The Packaged Goods Director provides strategic leadership for the Grocery, Dairy, Frozen, and Wellness departments, developing and executing merchandising, pricing, assortment, promotional, and vendor partnership strategies that drive sales, profitability, and customer value.

As the primary business leader for center store packaged goods, this role leverages data analytics, market insights, customer trends, and supplier partnerships to optimize category performance, introduce innovative products, deliver competitive pricing, and enhance the overall customer shopping experience.

The Packaged Goods Director leads a team of Category Managers and Field Merchandisers and partners closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance to ensure effective execution and alignment with the company’s broader strategic objectives. This position is accountable for achieving sales and margin targets, strengthening strategic vendor relationships, supporting private brand growth, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across the business.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

*Category Leadership*

* Develop and execute strategies for the Grocery, Dairy, and Frozen departments to achieve sales, margin, and market share objectives. Lead and support the Director of Wellness, a direct report to this position, in achieving these same objectives for the Wellness Department.
* Analyze category performance, customer trends, competitive activity, and pricing to identify opportunities and recommend strategic actions.
* Develop annual business plans and monitor performance against established financial goals.

*Merchandising Leadership*

* Establish merchandising strategies, guidelines, and standards including seasonal, event, and promotional merchandising strategies that drive impactful, consistent, and customer-focused execution across stores.
* Provide strategic direction for space planning and analytics, ensuring space allocation and product placement support category and business objectives.
* Provide leadership and oversight for planogram (POG) development and execution, ensuring category strategies translate effectively to the shelf.

*Team Leadership*

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Category Managers, Field Merchandisers, and the Wellness Director to achieve business objectives and foster professional growth.
* Establish performance expectations and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

*Pricing, Promotions & Assortment*

* Oversee category pricing, promotional planning, and product assortment strategies.
* Lead the effective use of pricing and promotional analytics tools to optimize performance.
* Support personalized promotional initiatives and ensure alignment of vendor funding with merchandising programs.

*Supplier Management*

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with suppliers and negotiate product costs, promotional funding, and partnership agreements.
* Conduct regular business reviews to evaluate supplier performance and identify growth opportunities.

*Cross-Functional Partnership*

* Collaborate with Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance to support product availability, merchandising execution, and category initiatives.
* Champion the growth of the company's private label brands and support long-term merchandising strategies.

*Operational Excellence*

* Identify and implement process improvements that enhance merchandising effectiveness, promotional planning, and operational efficiency.
* Stay informed on industry trends, competitive developments, and product innovation to support future business growth.
* Drive product availability by establishing strategies, tools, and processes to improve in-stock conditions and ensure that customers can consistently find the products they expect

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field.
* Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive experience in category management, merchandising, or product management, including leadership experience.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.
* Strong analytical, financial, and strategic planning skill

**Summary**
-----------

**Category Analyst**

At our Company, we grow People, Brands, and Businesses! We are seeking a dynamic Category Analyst to provide our Sales Managers and Vendor Partners with comprehensive sales analysis and support. This person in this position will be responsible for running and compiling sales summaries, analyzing the data and providing actionable insights for retailer business. Will also support the sales team in completing forms needed for other internal departments.

Take this opportunity to join North America’s leading business solutions provider and build your career working with amazing people in a growing industry! Apply today!

**What we offer:**

* Full-Time Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life)
* 401(k) with company match
* Training and Career Development
* Generous Paid Time-Off

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide weekly sales summaries based on Syndicated Data, Nielsen, Circana
* Analyze data and translate it into actionable insights with the goal of driving sales.
* Run and publish ad hoc reports as needed/requested.
* Guide new vendors through the process of becoming a retailer vendor of record.
* Prepare presentations for buyer meetings/line reviews.

**Qualifications:**

* Sales and/or Replenishment Analytics or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience preferred
* Experience with the Syndicated Data, Nielsen, Circana
* Prior club or large retailer analytical experience preferred
* Strong computer skills including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, and web-browsers
* Ability to work independently and prioritize duties with minimal supervision, in order to meet deadlines
* Team/collaborative approach to decision making with excellent people skills and ability to build and maintain relationships

Job Will Remain Open Until Filled

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

The Company is one of North America’s leading sales and marketing agencies specializing in outsourced sales, merchandising, category management and marketing services to manufacturers, suppliers and producers of food products and consumer packaged goods. The company services a variety of trade channels including grocery, mass merchandise, specialty, convenience, drug, dollar, club, hardware, consumer electronics and home centers. We bridge the gap between manufacturers and retailers, providing consumers access to the best products available in the marketplace today.

**Job Duty**

System Reporting & Analysis

* Develop standard and ad hoc reports, templates, dashboards, scorecards and metrics.
* Research, analyze, and present data as assigned.
* Meet with management to discuss and clarify requests for projects, highlight issues, and make recommendations to address issues and priorities.
* Write detailed reports and make oral presentations to management.
* Troubleshoot data and reports.
* Assist in rollout and implementation programs
* Coach and assist in development of new team members.
* Identify and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with Data Privacy and Protection Guidelines.
* Evaluate, identify, and recommend solutions to automate processes.
* Partner with project team members for developing reports, interfaces, data conversion programs, and application extensions.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Direct Reports

* This position does not have supervisory responsibilities for direct reports

Indirect Reports

* This position does not have guidance or mentoring responsibilities for indirect reports

**Travel and/or Driving Requirements**

* Travel and Driving are not essential duties or functions of this job

**Minimum Qualifications**

The following are the minimum job-related qualifications which an individual needs in order to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job

Education Level: **(Required):** Associate's Degree or equivalent experience

**(Preferred):** Bachelor's Degree

Field of Study/Area of Experience: systems analytics, reporting

4-6 years of related experience.

**Knowledge and Abilities**

* Strong computer skills including proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Outlook, and web-browsers
* Strong written communication and verbal communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills
* Strong prioritization skills
* Ability to gather data, to compile information, and prepare reports
* Ability to work effectively with management
* Ability to research and analyze data effectively
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to handle a fast-paced work environment
* Flexible and adaptable, able to change and alter according to changes in projects or business environment
* Ability to work independently and prioritize duties with minimal supervision, in order to meet deadlines
* Ability to complete multiple duties with accuracy shifting from one to another with frequent interruptions

description:
The **Merchandise Specialist** at Staples Retail is transforming modern working and learning. Our Omni Merchandising organization offers entry-level opportunities with training, mentoring, and promotional opportunities to grow within the Merchandising team. Starting as a Merchandising Specialist, you will learn about competitive analysis, promotional planning, market research, identifying trends and new products, SKU set-up/maintenance, proofing marketing assets, website metrics, and more. Our people are the heart of our success, and we believe in collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning in all that we think, create, and do. You will gain exposure to a wide variety of cross-functional teams, including Merchandising, Marketing, Inventory Planning, Store Operations, eCommerce, and Stores, to name a few.

**Learn about and impact store merchandise and sales**:

* Attend vendor meetings to collaborate on business plans and gain exposure to new products
* Conduct market research, gather industry data, track trends, competitive shopping
* Work with vendors and internal teams to launch new to market products, vendor program agreements and price change worksheets
* Manage the approval process for all physical and digital marketing assets
* Proactively manage the SKU and Vendor set up and maintenance process
* Process product returns, price changes, price protection, coupons/rebates, and markdowns
* Source financial data and reports, to review sales performance with Buyer
* Answer communication from stores on products and vendors; other responsibilities as assigned

**Essential skills and experience:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed (within the last 1–2 years) a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Merchandising, Finance, or a related field; recent college grads welcome to apply
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, SUMIF, IFERROR)
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong math skills
* Interest in merchandising
* Enjoy working in teams and being highly communicative
* Ability to multi‑task and be flexible to new initiatives

**Get great perks.**

* Generous amount of paid time off, including one Floating Holiday each year
* Flexible work arrangements, including flexible work hours
* 401(k) plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance with many more optional benefits
* Associate store discount and more perks (discounts on mobile plans, movie tickets, etc.)

The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, business considerations, geography, and internal equity.

**WORK LOCATION DETAILS**

* **Work Location:** Home Office - Coppell, TX
* **Work Schedule:** Hybrid
* **Onsite:** Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays
* **Work from Home:** Mondays and Fridays

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Associate Buyer (Floral) is responsible for creating and executing merchandise strategies in partnership with the Buyer/Sr. Buyer to deliver Product Proud assortments to meet or exceed sales, margin and turn requirements. This Includes assortment selection & management, product development and go to market efforts (includes marketing, in store visual etc.). In addition, the Associate Buyer partners with key functional peers including Planner, Sourcing Managers and Visual Team to implement strategies maximizing business opportunities pre-season, during season and post-season.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Merchandising Strategy and Product Development**

* Develop and execute merchandise strategies in partnership with Buyer/Sr. Buyer; Includes assortment management and customer facing visual and storytelling ideas

* Responsible for supporting Buyer/ Sr. Buyer in Product Development vision in conjunction with a sourcing manager who administers the processes and timelines

* Travel and time in market for trend identification, category expertise and white space opportunities.

* **Vendor Relationships**

* Work with National Brand product partners to understand the market, the category, and to carefully curate assortments leveraging their expertise.

* In partnership with sourcing, who manages the vendor matrix, maintain relationships with key private label product partners to deliver product proud assortments, collaboratively drive business results and represent the At Home brand professionally in the market.

* **Financial Planning, Data Analysis, Inventory & Reporting**

* Provide insights and actively participate in the OTB process to drive category P&L in collaboration with the Sr. Buyer/ Buyer and the Sr. Planner/Planner

* Assist with analyzing purchasing trends, sales data, and supplier performance; Includes recommendations on action to take pre-season, during season and post-season

* Provide a point of view on assortment changes based on market assessment, prediction of purchasing needs, and productivity assessment of sales data

* **Cross-Department Collaboration:**

* Partner with Marketing, Digital and Packaging teams to achieve strategic business objectives and Go to Market vision

* Work closely with planning, sourcing, & visual teams to align Merchandising with company goals.

* Support Buyer/ Sr. Buyer with strategic initiatives and applicable milestone meetings

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is considered.

* 3-5 years’ experience in retail buying/ merchandising, planning, or related experience

* Merchandising or PD experience in (Decor) is a plus but not required.

* Product Development Ability; Creative and innovative skillset

* Ability to identify emerging trends and shops competition and market regularly

* Strong leadership and critical thinking skills

* Ability to develop and maintain strong cross-functional relationships

* Communicates and translates information in a well thought-out, concise, and easy to understand manner in both verbal and written form

* Demonstrates effective organizational skills and good time management

* Willing to travel for market and store trips

* Innate curiosity and passion for product and customer satisfaction

**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Role summary:**

As a Merchant, you will lead Apparel sub-category strategy development and execution for a moderately complex portfolio, driving financial performance and supplier management to meet business objectives. This role requires analyzing market trends, customer behavior, and competitive dynamics to inform pricing, assortment, and promotional decisions. You will collaborate cross-functionally to optimize omni-channel member experiences and guide team performance while supporting operational initiatives. Leveraging data insights and strategic planning, you will ensure alignment with company goals, fostering continuous improvement and delivering value through effective category and supplier management.

**About the team:**

The Merchant team leads strategy and execution for assigned Apparel subcategories, focusing on assortment planning, supplier collaboration, and financial management. This team drives business growth by analyzing market trends and customer insights to make informed decisions. Merchant will balance product expertise with data-driven approaches to identify opportunities and optimize performance. They foster strong partnerships across functions and suppliers, ensuring alignment with business goals. The team values curiosity, sound judgment, and effective communication, working with urgency and ownership to enhance the member experience and advance the category’s success within Sam's Club dynamic retail environment.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop and execute sub-category strategies aligned with long-term business objectives and market trends.
* Manage profit and loss responsibilities, analyzing daily business performance to meet financial targets.
* Lead supplier negotiations, and performance metrics to drive profitability.
* Oversee assortment planning, pricing decisions, and promotional strategies across store and online channels.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize channel strategies and inventory management.
* Guide and develop team members, setting performance expectations and fostering professional growth.
* Utilize data analysis tools to generate insights that inform strategic decisions and operational improvements.

**What you'll bring:**

* Proven experience in category strategy development and execution for moderately complex categories.
* Strong financial management skills, including profit and loss ownership and budget forecasting.
* Expertise in supplier management, negotiation, and performance tracking.
* Ability to analyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape to inform decisions.
* Demonstrated leadership in team management, including coaching, development, and performance evaluation.
* Proficiency in assortment planning, pricing strategy, and promotional execution across channels.
* Skilled in leveraging data analytics and digital tools to drive business insights and improvements.
* Commitment to operational excellence and delivering customer-centric solutions.

At Sam's Club, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet!

**-Health benefits** include medical, vision and dental coverage

**-Financial benefits** include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance

**-Paid time off benefits** include PTO, parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable.

For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices.

**- Other benefits** include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.

Live Better U is a company paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.

description:
**About us**
------------

KnitWell Group, a specialty retail operating company, comprises some of the most iconic brands in America – Ann Taylor, Chico's, Haven Well Within, Lane Bryant, LOFT, Soma, Talbots, White House Black Market. Individually, our brands are unique and strong. Together, we are powerful.
Our common thread is our commitment to create exceptional products, provide memorable experiences, and achieve superior results. Our associates are innovators who thrive through collaboration and are dedicated to excellence. At the heart of it all are the customers we serve. We are dedicated to creating fashion that not only looks good but also makes our customers feel good.

**About the role**

The Haven Well Within Merchant position is responsible for leading the strategy, development, and selection of merchandise to optimize sales growth and contribute to bottom line profit for their given department(s). This position executes quarterly buy strategies at the style/color level, exhibits a passion and eye for product, conducts in-depth analysis, both financial and trend, and leads collaborative cross-functional partnerships.

**The impact you can have**

* Directly responsible for the strategy, development, and collaborative execution of the product to optimize sales growth and contribute to bottom line profit.
* Analyze business performance on a weekly basis and present results to cross-functional and leadership teams.
* Hindsight prior seasons through extensive product, trend, and competitive analysis to plan for the next season.
* Build seasonal frameworks, work collaboratively to ensure strategies are in place to maximize business opportunities as well as seasonal trends.
* Drive partnership with Design team to evolve our proven core product and introduce merchandise that is new, trend right, works within our brand filter, and moves the business forward.
* Utilize both product strategies and analytical results to plan all merchant buys, in accordance to budget, for each quarter and present investments at product investment review.
* Utilize merchandizing buy tools to plan all merchandise buys to the style/color level.
* Drive partnership with Planning and Inventory Management on reviewing sales, receipt, and style/color counts; partner on managing in-season business sales results, promo and mark down cadence.
* Drive partnership with Sourcing to achieve target IMU plans, make seasonal fabric projections, participate in discussions on costs, deliveries, and other vendor related matters.
* Drive partnership with Visual and Marketing teams to ensure product placement, presentation and storytelling are all executed according to strategy or current business trend.
* Develop understanding of the Haven Well Within customer and where she shops.
* Curate product selections that are complimentary to the brand and to the customer’s preference.
* Responsible for developing strong, collaborative, partnerships with cross-functional teams across channels and other business areas; approach all working relationships in a tactful and effective way.
* Initiate and perform additional ad hoc analytical assignments as requested.
* Maintain knowledge of catalog and web industry trends, shop competition frequently.
* Analyze direct business metrics, evaluate customer demand performance in conjunction with sales.
* Oversee and attend catalog layout reviews and web thumbnail reviews, ensure accuracy and placement.
* Oversee review of all catalog and web content for department as released, work with teams to ensure accurate product representation.
* Maintain knowledge of retail industry trends, shop competition frequently.
* Work with Allocation partners to analyze performance in store volume group segmentations
* Oversee and attend store floor set layout reviews, ensure accuracy and placement.

**You'll bring to the role**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 5+ of experience in a buying, planning and/or inventory management role
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with intermediate level to advanced Microsoft Excel skills
* Innate sense of fashion and ability to analyze and translate trends
* Possess analytical skills, ability to draw smart conclusions and make thoughtful recommendations
* Strong organizational skills, ability to multitask, prioritize and complete tasks on tight deadlines
* Excellent attention to detail, understands importance of accuracy and thorough completion of tasks
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team
* Strong writing and presentation skills
* Must be able to thrive in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Must be a creative and critical thinker, with the ability to problem solve
* Must be self-motivated, driven to succeed and have a passion for learning

**Benefits**

* You will be eligible to receive a merchandise discount at select KnitWell Group brands, subject to each brand’s discount policies.
* Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility w

**Our Story**

J.Crew gets you dressed every day, for every occasion.

Since 1983, we’ve been creating classics that feel familiar and refreshingly new, crafted with unbeatable quality and distinctive point of view—it’s no wonder we’ve been in your closet for four decades and counting.

Today, we continue to do the classics our way, inspiring not only how you shop but how you define your personal style. Our commitment runs deeper than just making great clothes—we’re proud of our role in getting you dressed with confidence, character, and celebrating a distinctly American sensibility that makes us who we are.

Our dedication to Diversity, Equity, Belonging & Sustainability has been celebrated with industry recognition, reflecting our commitment to fostering an inclusive and sustainable workplace.

**The Role + Purpose** **:**

An Assistant Merchant is r esponsible for assisting with departmental execution of seasonal assortments, acting as point person for cross-functional business partners in production, marketing, design, allocation, and planning.

* Assist Merchants to organize assortments aligned to overall department strategy, resulting in increased earnings
* Identify product opportunities and become an expert in competitive landscape
* Partner with Design and Production on product strategies and requirements to ensure customer needs are met, AUC profitability, and speed to market
* Partner with Planning and Allocation on seasonal investment strategy by market to ensure big ideas and growth drivers are protected
* Communicate seasonal strategies in a collaborative way to key cross functional teams to ensure innovation and financial success
* Prepare and analyze selling recaps
* Sample management

**Qualifications:**

* 0-1 years’ Merchandising experience
* Strong excel skills
* Demonstrated analytical skills

We welcome you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes. Our passion is scouting life-long learners who are driven by curiosity, and who feel connected to our brands and share our desire to make an impact. We’re always seeking bright new talent who leverage their unique experiences to discover, grow and evolve with our teams.

**Benefits + Perks**

* **Health & Well-being -** Eligible associates and family members receive medical, dental, prescription and vision insurance, family planning (fertility, adoption & surrogacy support), fitness discounts, medical travel and more.
* **Associate Discount -** We love our products just as much as you do! That’s why we offer a great associate discount across all of our brands (J.Crew, J.Crew Factory, and Madewell).
* **Summer Fridays -** In addition to our hybrid work model, we also close our office at 1:00 PM every Friday during the Summer months.
* **Community Impact -** We support the communities where we live and work through our philanthropic efforts and the J.Crew Cares Program.
* **Winter Break -** In addition to our PTO package, J.Crew Group offers a winter break at the end of December to eligible full-time associates at the Home Office to provide time to refresh and recharge.

Note: Availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to work location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements.

Hourly Range: $25.48 - $29.74

At J.Crew Group (JCG) we aim to pay competitively for our company’s size and industry. The base salary offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region of work premises, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. The base salary is just one component of J.Crew Group’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes the opportunity for bonus, competitive benefits and perks.

One of our core focuses here at JCG is creating a community and culture that builds belonging. We are deeply committed to our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion efforts, and we warmly welcome job applicants of all backgrounds.

JCG is proud to affirmatively provide equal opportunity to all associates and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin or citizenship, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, legally protected physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected under applicable law.

WHO WE ARE:
Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

The Merchandise Planning Manager is accountable for the OTB process, entering orders on time, and the flow of inventory. You will be responsible for leading and managing the merchandise planning team, overseeing in-season forecasts and future merchandise plans to ensure they are aligned with company objectives. Guide the team in creating sales forecasts and inventory plans that optimize sales, margin, and turn. Must work effectively with cross-functional partners to execute buy and allocations strategies.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

* Lead the pre-season planning cycle, including the development and review of sales, stock, AUR, and margin plans; generate and review store clusters and SKU-level targets to support buying, allocation, and assortment strategies.
* Maintain and communicate the planning calendar, ensuring all key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables are met across cross-functional teams.
* Oversee OTBs at brand level and ensure merchandise targets are met on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis; communicate OTB plans to the merchandising team and assess inventory risks.
* Schedule and lead weekly/monthly in-season forecast and OTB meetings; ensure receipt plans are filled according to the write schedule.
* Review sales monthly and re-forecast quarterly; communicate results and critical issues to the Director of Planning and Buying; develop action plans to increase or decrease inventory as needed to reconcile the OTB.
* Drive sales by analyzing trends, forecasting demand, and reviewing inventory position; identify risks and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations on a weekly basis.
* Support and review SKU-level reorder ladders for core and carry-forward SKUs, ensuring replenishment strategies align with demand signals and inventory targets.
* Partner with planners and merchandisers to actively manage the lifecycle and flow of inventory, including exit strategies, transition strategies, cancellations, markdown needs, and in-store inventory plans; drive the buying calendar forward to ensure budgets are met and orders maintain ideal flow.
* Initiate analysis of business trends—including category performance, regional selling, and size selling—and translate findings into informative recommendations that influence organizational decisions.
* Prepare and present performance recaps to management at monthly, quarterly, and seasonal intervals, highlighting key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
* Partner with the Director of Planning in the review of financial analysis and team deliverables, providing direction and feedback as necessary.
* Develop and train new talent; mentor existing planners and guide review planners through monthly reforecasts to grow and strengthen the team.
* Lead cross-functional merchandise meetings, providing input on product performance, assortment strategies, and inventory positioning.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

* Strong aptitude for numbers and clear understanding of retail math.
* Experience in SKU level and category level planning, financial planning process and report/modeling building using excel and or planning software.
* Demonstrates the ability to quickly and proficiently understand and absorb new information
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to compile and analyze large sets of data using excel and BI tools.
* Strong organizational skills – ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize, and meet deadlines. Schedule and lead meetings in a timely manner.
* Proven track record of analyzing and delivering financial results.
* Highly motivated, have a professional demeanor, and be capable of working with and/or leading cross-functional teams in an effective and collaborative matter.
* Proficiency in using financial metrics and reports to measure the performance of the business. Understand how decisions impact financial results.
* Experience leading a team and having 4+ persons report into them.
* Ability to communicate persuasively, influentially, and responsibly across a cross-functional team.
* Excels in team environments and in building/developing strong interpersonal relationships, while maintaining an individual determination to accomplish goals.
* Passionate about customer service and the retail industry.
* Driven to excel and succeed, taking full ownership of his or her success.
* Ability to travel 0-10% of time.

REQUIREMENTS:

* Minimum of 6-8 years of merchandise planning, inventory management, buying or finance in a retail environment- preferably Footwear
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent expe

**Do your Best Work in Mooresville**

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

**Your Impact**

The role partners with the Merchants to ensure execution of omni product decisions and acts as an analytical and strategic resource in delivering against the product category strategy. This role will actively review categories, provide analytical support, and provide recommendations and ideas for sales and margin growth. This role will serve as the liaison with cross-functional support teams. As it relates to Merchandising, the role acts as the primary point of contact for the supplier, store, and all internal support communities and provides input based on knowledge of category. This role will assist with the onboarding of new suppliers/vendors/item set-up and ensuring the accuracy of cost and stocking information.

**What You Will Do**

* Drives the planning, preparations and execution of key business activities in partnership with the Merchant/Online Merchant; inclusive of developing & organizing product insights, performance metrics and presentations (i.e. Vendor Forum, Shark Tank, RVP Walks, Product Line Reviews)
* Proactively review and analyze store & online category performance and provide recommendations to improve product profitability & optimization.
* Creates and provides reporting based on data, metrics and analysis to make a recommendation as requested by the merchant to gain insights on product or category performance both in-store and online.
* Support Merchant in Product Line Reviews by compiling financial targets and partnering with internal teams in the successful execution of the line review.
* Provide reporting and recommendations on inventory by analyzing and identifying opportunities to drive the inventory health of the business.
* Supports the Merchant to prepare for vendor negotiations and partner in on-going support of the negotiation process.
* Develop and maintain a strong partnership and act as a point of contact for the merchants, vendors, stores, online business and all internal support communities.
* Collaborate with the internal teams on new item set-up and maintenance, assist with new vendor setup and maintenance.
* Maintain the integrity and accuracy of product data within Lowe’s designated software systems to ensure all product costs, vendor agreements and stocking information is accurate.
* Conduct content reviews to ensure new assortments, planograms, item descriptions and product specifications are correct for both in-store and online; partnering with appropriate support teams to ensure protocols & standards are followed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams in resolving vendor or product concerns communicated by stakeholders (ex - online purchase orders, Executive Customer Support issues or in-store product concerns).
* Ensure promotional activity for category is accurate and aligns to agreed upon strategy and timelines.
* Maintains a working knowledge of all Lowe’s policies and procedures as well as industry standards and compliance needs for assigned product areas.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2 Years experience in retail or merchandising
* Experience in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint)

**Preferred Skills/Education**
Bachelor’s degree In Business, Analytics or related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**About Lowe’s**

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. Lowe’s is a core value S&P 500 equity stock and a dividend aristocrat. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

*Lowe’s is an equal opportunity employer and administers all personnel practices without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, age, ancestry, national origin, mental or physical disability or medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law.*

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

VM's at Amazon are responsible for monitoring and reacting to industry trends and own the top and bottom lines of the P&L. They will develop selection and categories, deliver innovative growth solutions and work with internal teams to deliver the best customer experience. VMs work with vendors of all sizes • and possess leadership presence and communication skills to represent Amazon at all levels. VMs work across multiple internal teams, at high levels of leadership, to address customer experience issues within the category. We span a wide range of specialist skills, from data analytics and account management to brand development and ad sales. You'll be working with some of the smartest minds in e-commerce.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon retail teams work to help improve the selection and shopping experience for customers across our product categories, from books to fashion, electronics to grocery, movies and music to toys and health & beauty, and everything in between. As a retail VMVM's at Amazon are responsible for monitoring and reacting to industry trends and own the top and bottom lines of the P&L. They will develop selection and categories, deliver innovative growth solutions and work with internal teams to deliver the best customer experience. VMs work with vendors of all sizes • and possess leadership presence and communication skills to represent Amazon at all levels. VMs work across multiple internal teams, at high levels of leadership, to address customer experience issues within the category. We span a wide range of specialist skills, from data analytics and account management to brand development and ad sales. You'll be working with some of the smartest minds in e-commerce. in one of those categories, you will learn how Amazon handles its e-commerce retail business. Working alongside a vendor manager to help provide a suite of services designed to support Amazon's most strategic brands within one of our retail categories. Your priority will be to work backwards from the customer, identifying inputs to grow brands and improve their performance.
Job responsibilities include:

* Develop the analytical and problem-solving skills that our people are known for support vendor managers as well as Amazonians in other functions, such as in-stock and marketing

Amazon advertising sits at the intersection of advertising and e-commerce. Customers visit us every day to find, discover, and buy products, so we're obsessed with making the shopping experience the best it can be • and advertising is a part of that experience. As an intern, you'll gain a deep understanding of Amazon's display advertising products as well as our technical and operational capabilities. You'll learn when and how we can create custom opportunities, and you'll help our account managers create compelling presentations to delight our clients.
Amazon merchant services covers all third party merchants' activity related to selling on Amazon as well as the specific services and products we offer to help develop and grow these sellers. As an intern, you will be responsible for helping our account managers to deliver new business growth across Amazon's third party merchants.
Job Responsibilities Include:

* Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered by advertising or merchant services
* Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence
* Learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio and the Amazon culture
* Identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools
* Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including working with category teams, product teams, and technical support teams

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Access or SQL
* Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
* Experience using data to influence business decisions
* Experience with business analysis and P&L management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
* Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices
* Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding pro

We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page!

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

Watch Buyer I is responsible for the end-to-end management of the watch category, including assortment planning, product selection, vendor management, inventory maintenance, and promotional strategies. The Watch Buyer I operates with day-to-day ownership of the category while reporting to the Sr. Buyer and partnering closely to develop and execute overall category strategies.

**Category Management**

o Give input as requested to set Strategic Vision for Category

o Ability to adjust quickly, if needed, to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

o Analyze and React to Business on a weekly basis

o Participate in the development of financial plans and advertising/marketing plans for designated product categories.

o Assist in all business reviews for all designated product categories to Leadership.

o Oversee training and career development for Direct Reports / Team

**Assortment Management & Brand/Vendor Management.**

o Select watch merchandise from established brand partners, ensuring assortments align with consumer demand, brand positioning, and strategic department goals.

o Actively manage the watch assortment lifecycle from initial selection and seasonal assortment planning through inventory management, promotional activity, markdowns, and end of life.

o Partner with Senior Buyer to develop and maintain strategic brand assortments, identifying opportunities to expand key brands, styles, collections, and price points based on customer demand and category performance.

o Build and maintain strong relationships with watch brand partners, strategically managing the vendor base to optimize assortment, inventory, pricing, product availability, and overall category performance.

**Collaboration**

o Coordinate efforts with the marketing, visual display and advertising departments to promote and market key items, programs/brands and categories.

o Merchandise all marketing channel items for designated product categories. Present and justify all catalog/promotional items to merchandise directors and vice presidents.

o Participate in management of open-to-buy for assigned product categories with CMT and update as needed.

o When applicable; work directly with Signet’s accounting department to ensure credits/aging are applied correctly.

o Assist CMT with issues on vendor performance, including late orders and quality control issues.

o Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including emails, web site and store signage.

o Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

o Work cross-functionally with stores Ops team, VM, DC team and Planning on store test, Rollouts, RTV’s

**Additional Job Description**

Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Fashion Merchandising or related field preferred

Required or Acceptable Job-Related Experience: 2+ years’ experience prior buying experience

Years of Job-Related Experience Required: 2+ years

Technical/Other Skills Required:

o Computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office/Excel.

o Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), negotiation skills, attention to detail and accuracy, organizational skills, and math skills (ability to work with numbers and analyze data).

o Ability to be metal free and work in a metal free environment, when necessary, is based on security policy.

o Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

o Ability to work independently as well as a team.

o Ability to lead team if applicable.

o Ability to demonstrate leadership skills.

**YOU WILL BE:**

As Buyer, you will be responsible for the overall merchandising strategy and product direction within assigned categories or departments, aiming to meet or exceed sales, margin, and financial objectives. This role focuses on curating the most distinctive and high-quality merchandise that reflects Saks Global’s exceptional standards and aligns with customer needs and preferences. Leveraging competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business analysis, you will ensure a customer-centric assortment that drives performance. In addition to leading the purchasing and negotiation of merchandise, you will partner with Merchandise Planners to develop and execute strategies that maximize business opportunities. As the Buyer, you will also manage and mentor a team of Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment with business goals

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

Assortment Strategy

* Provide input on category and pre-season planning strategy in collaboration with Planners based on past performance and knowledge on trends/brand insights, and execute on the strategy throughout the season
* Build customer-centered assortment framework and allocation strategy based on customer and trend insights from Stores, Digital, CACI and Fashion and provide guidelines for allocation teams to follow
* Set strategies for product display and flow (e.g., launch dates, weeks of full-price selling, cross-sell opportunities, collection considerations) in alignment with guardrails from Planning and Marketing

Market Activities

* Lead market prep activities and attend market to select the best product in alignment with guardrails from Planning (e.g., Checkbook, OTB) and category direction from BP & Buying Leads (e.g., omni strategy, banner differentiation)
* Coordinate buys with brand partners, collaborate on exclusive merchandise, manage day-to-day communication around in-season brand performance, trending styles, chase opportunities and resolve escalated order management issues

In-Season Management

* Review daily performance reports and work closely with Planner counterparts to gather insights on trending products, categories, brands, etc., pull in-season levers to optimize performance and prepare for monthly OTB meetings to provide bottoms-up context and escalate opportunities and risks to Leads
* Serve as the owner of their business, constantly negotiating with Brand Partners throughout the season to improve performance (e.g., style swaps, capsules, RTVs, matrix expansion, markdowns)

Leadership Development

* Provide mentorship and hands-on training to Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, equipping them with the business acumen and practical skills needed to become successful future Buyers

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent retail experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a buying office with a strong understanding of buying operations and retail strategy.
* Proven business acumen with strong financial, analytical, and strategic planning skills.
* Expertise in retail math, including markup, margin planning, OTB, WOS, T/O, GMROI, and assortment planning.
* Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong internal and vendor relationships.
* Strong customer focus with a results-driven mindset and ability to manage ambiguity.
* Highly organized with strong planning, prioritization, and conflict management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the agility to adapt to changing business needs.
Willingness to travel, including internationally, as needed.

**YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT EXEMPLAR LUXURY GROUP:**

* Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
* Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate

* Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
* An amazing employee discount

Benefits: We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits (such as critical illness, hospital and accident insurance).

description:
**Your Opportunity as the Senior Analyst, Category Advisory - Walmart**

Key member of the Walmart Coffee Category Advisory Team, delivering actionable analytics, category insights, and operational excellence that strengthen Walmart’s category decisions and support category growth. Independently owns recurring category reporting and foundational advisory operations, including store lists, trait changes, and other store-level information affecting assortment and modular execution. Applies category knowledge, analytical rigor, and business acumen to identify business issues, diagnose performance, and develop fact-based recommendations. Contributes to category strategy development, modular design, and customer-facing advisory discussions while providing reporting, analytical, and execution support.

**Location:** Rogers, AR (JMS Walmart Office)

**Work Arrangements:** Hybrid - onsite a minimum of 2 days per week

**In this role you will:**

Category Reporting & Analytics

* Independently manage recurring Coffee category reporting, including data validation, performance analysis, insight generation, and timely distribution to Walmart and internal stakeholders; support reporting for Cones & Toppings, Milk Modifiers, and Hot Cocoa advisory.
* Analyze sales, market share, assortment, competitive activity and shopper behavior to explain category performance and identify growth opportunities across stores and digital.
* Track the performance of assortment and shelf resets, translating results into clear findings that inform future category decisions.
* Support store clustering, assortment, and space analyses in partnership with advisory team members.
Support the design, execution, and synthesis of in-store and digital shopper research, translating findings into actionable category opportunities.

Advisory Operations & Modular Execution

* Own the store list, maintaining accurate store traits, reconciling modular footage, and attributing information that determines store-level assortment and layout.
* Coordinate store and assortment updates with Walmart and advisory team members, proactively resolving discrepancies and identifying areas of opportunity.
* Participate in seasonal modular strategy development and execution, using automation and objective category-centric judgement to support category growth and customer needs.
Present analysis and findings in merchant engagements, helping ensure recommendations are grounded in data and shopper insights.

Advisory Capability & Continuous Improvement

* Champion automation, documentation, and process improvement that increase efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness across the Walmart Category Advisory organization
* Continuously develop expertise in category management, shopper behavior, modular development, assortment optimization, and advisory best practices.
* Share tools, learnings and best practices that strengthen team capabilities and improve organizational effectiveness.
Demonstrate increasing ownership and influence by connecting analytical findings to strategic category opportunities and customer-focused recommendations.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 2+ years of Consumer Packaged Goods, retail analytics, category management, or related field.
* Experience using customer POS and/or syndicated sales data to analyze business performance.
* Experience independently managing recurring reporting or operational deliverables.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to explain performance drivers and identify business applications.
* High attention to detail, including the ability to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and resolve issues.
* Ability to independently manage recurring processes and assigned projects while balancing changing priorities.
* Ability to translate data and analysis into clear, concise findings and communicate effectively with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency with spreadsheet and analytical tools, with the ability to learn and apply reporting, automation, and modular systems.
* Strong organizational and collaboration skills, including effective management of deadlines, dependencies, and handoffs.
* Sound judgement regarding when to act independently, seek alignment, or escalate an issue.
Ability to travel up to 15%

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role (not required):

* Walmart experience
Experience supporting assortment decision-making, modular development, or retail execution

**The Right Place for You**

We are bold, kind, strive to do the right thing, we play to win, and we believe in a strong community that thrives together. Our culture is rooted in our Basic Beliefs , and we believe in supporting every employee by meeting their physical, emotional, and financial needs.

**Company Description**

Pilot Company is an industry-leading network of travel centers with more than 30,000 team members and over 750 retail and fueling locations in 43 states and six Canadian provinces. Our energy and logistics division serves as a top supplier of fuel, employing one of the largest tanker fleets and providing critical services to oil operations in our nation's busiest basins. Pilot Company supports a growing portfolio of brands with expertise in supply chain and retail operations, logistics and transportation, technology and digital innovation, construction, maintenance, human resources, finance, sales and marketing.

Founded in 1958 by Jim A. Haslam II and currently led by CEO Adam Wright, our founding values, people-first culture and commitment to giving back remains true to us today. Whether we are serving guests, a fellow team member, or a trucking company, we are dedicated to fueling people and keeping North America moving.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Military encouraged to apply.

**Job Description**

The purpose of this job is to support the category team by tracking sales trends, reviewing margin, monitoring inventory turns, coordinating product distribution, and the preparation of category reviews.

* Provide detailed analysis of assigned category performance including areas of product assortment, pricing, promotions, and price changes
* Create and maintain reports to track performance and identify opportunities against established metrics
* Oversee a project from idea phase through in-store implementation, including execution of total merchandising, distribution, creative, suggested order set-up, etc.
* Manage the flow of vendor funding from planning through the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes
* Assist in the oversight of the category profit and loss
* Assist in developing annual category business plan
* Utilize company data and reporting systems to identify and create action plans for store level opportunities
* Participate in vendor negotiations; develop negotiation skills with supervision
* Deliver clear and concise communication to field teams relative to the category
* Maintain strong competitive awareness, including product offers, pricing, and proximity of competitors
* Model behaviors that support the company’s common purpose; ensure guests and team members are supported at the highest level
* Ensure all activities are in compliance with rules, regulations, policies, and procedures
* Complete other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent certification required
* Bachelor’s degree in retail or business preferred
* Minimum two years’ retail or similar experience preferred
* Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to analyze, think critically, and problem solve
* Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a group
* Ability to successfully manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to think creatively and identify new solutions
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Ability to communicate professionally with all corporate levels, vendors, and customers
* Comfortable with changing technology
* Travel required less than 25%, overnight may be required
* General office work requiring sitting or standing for long periods of time

**Additional Information**

* Nation-wide Medical Plan/Dental/Vision
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Weekly pay
* 401K match
* Tuition Assistance
* Adoption Assistance
* PTO
* Fuel Discount
