Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**

The North America Brand Merchandising team connects sport, consumer, product and marketplace strategies to deliver a cohesive Nike offense. This role reports to the Senior Director of North America Brand Merchandising, leads the Footwear Brand Merchandising team, and partners closely with Sport, Channel, Nike Direct, Planning, Finance, Brand and Global Merchandising teams.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strategic, consumer-obsessed footwear merchandising leader who can see across sports, franchises, price points and channels, then turn complexity into clear choices and action. The right candidate combines deep footwear and marketplace expertise with strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor and an instinct for product. They can move fluidly from long-range portfolio strategy to seasonal execution, using consumer, business and competitive insights to identify growth opportunities and sharpen the line. This leader must be comfortable influencing without direct authority, building alignment across diverse teams and constructively challenging the status quo. They communicate with clarity, make decisions with conviction and create the conditions for others to do their best work. They will bring a collaborative, team-first leadership style and a commitment to coaching and developing talent.

* Bachelor's degree in merchandising, business, marketing or a related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training.
* 8+ years of relevant merchandising, product, retail, buying, planning or related experience; footwear experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build consumer-led merchandising strategies and translate insights into portfolio, franchise, assortment and marketplace recommendations.
* Strong business acumen and analytical capability, with experience using financial, consumer and marketplace data to make decisions and influence senior stakeholders.
* Proven people leadership and cross-functional influence, with the ability to lead through ambiguity, manage multiple seasonal priorities and communicate a clear point of view.

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

You will lead the holistic North America footwear merchandising strategy across sport, channel and marketplace priorities. You will guide the team through long-range line planning and seasonal execution, shape critical portfolio and franchise choices, and build alignment around the footwear opportunities that matter most for consumers and the business.

* Lead the North America x-sport footwear strategy, connecting consumer, marketplace and business priorities across the total portfolio.
* Drive footwear portfolio and franchise excellence, including priority classifications, consumer choice zones, price-value opportunities, lifecycle decisions and marketplace distinction.
* Translate consumer, competitive, financial and marketplace insights into clear recommendations for line planning, assortment creation, seasonal readiness and go-to-market milestones.
* Lead x-sport footwear integration for key Brand and consumer moments, ensuring product priorities and stories come together as a cohesive Nike offense.
* Partner with Sport, Channel, Nike Direct, Sales, Planning, Finance, Brand, Global Merchandising and product creation teams to align strategy, resolve tradeoffs and enable execution.
* Own and evolve seasonal footwear tools and operating rhythms, bringing clarity to priorities, decision points, ownership and follow-through.
* Lead, coach and develop the Footwear Brand Merchandising team while strengthening merchandising excellence, accountability and an inclusive, high-performing team culture.

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form.

Job ID: R62783

widget: Full time

Brand: Calvin Klein

Non-Retail

**Be part of an iconic story.**

At Calvin Klein, we believe in fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture by celebrating different perspectives, backgrounds and beliefs to truly connect with our associates and consumers. Join us and have a meaningful impact on the world – and – endless opportunities to design your future. Immerse yourself in Calvin Klein here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)

**About the Role:**

The Assistant Merchandiser will have a diverse set of responsibilities supporting the Global Merchandising team to bring the line to life through the key categories, channel, and gender assigned. They will help support in the line planning, pricing and product creation processes to achieve or exceed annual financial goals; partnering closely with cross-functional teams such as design, supply, development and retail.

**What You'll Do:**

* Partner closely with the Merchant to support seasonal product vision and assist in building line plans that align with customer needs, business strategy, and financial targets.
* Develop a strong understanding of the customer through analysis of selling data, market insights, and consumer trends; apply learnings to support assortment decisions.
* Utilize sales performance, projections, bookings, and sell-through data to inform recommendations and support data-driven decision making.
* Assist in maintaining and managing merchandising calendars, ensuring adherence to key deliverables and cross-functional deadlines.
* Support sample management including tracking, proto reviews, and documenting feedback to facilitate timely product updates and changes.
* Create and maintain market tools, assortment guides, and internal presentations to support sales, retail, and cross-functional partners.
* Compile and analyze key merchandising reports (e.g., projections, booking recaps, sales performance, and post-season recaps) to identify risks, opportunities, and trends.
* Conduct ongoing brand, consumer, and competitive research to stay informed on market trends and evolving customer preferences.
* Apply critical thinking to interpret data and trends, connecting insights back to customer behavior and business performance.
* Support process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, clarity, and ways of working within the merchandising team.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners including Design, Product Development, Supply Chain, Raw Materials, Marketing, and Sales to support cohesive execution.
* Assist in supporting merchandising needs across international markets, gaining exposure to regional nuances and customer differences.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and a solution-oriented mindset.
* Support key seasonal milestones including line reviews, market preparation, hindsight analysis, and cross-functional presentations.
* Create and maintain global line matrices, assortment tools, and product databases to ensure accuracy throughout seasonal milestones.
* Support product lifecycle management including seasonal hindsight, line optimization, late adds, product exits, and continuous assortment refinement.
* Assist in building and maintaining global assortment architecture by category, franchise, end-use, price point, and consumer need.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 1-2 years experience in Merchandising, Buying, Planning, or Product Development (internship experience considered).
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) merchandising, business, or a related field
* Detail oriented
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and teamwork skills
* High level of analytical skills and conceptual creative ability
* Proficient in Microsoft (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)
* General understanding of retail math
* Customer-Focused Mindset: Demonstrated interest in understanding the consumer and how product decisions impact customer experience and performance.
* Growth mindset with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and adapting to changing business priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

**What to Expect:**

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Domestic None (0%) – No travel required.
* International None (0%) – No travel required.

**This position is not eligible for sponsorship.**

**About mSupply**

mSupply is a leading North American distributor of repair parts, equipment, and related products serving professionals across the appliance, HVAC, plumbing, commercial kitchen, and other essential service industries. Our business is built

around helping our customers get the right products, right when they need them.

As mSupply continues to evolve, we are building a centralized Merchandising organization designed to bring greater

consistency, scale, and commercial discipline to how we manage our categories. This is an opportunity to help shape that transformation and have a meaningful impact on how customers experience and purchase products across our digital and physical channels.

**The Opportunity**

The **Director, Category Merchandise – Appliance** is a strategic, commercially driven leader responsible for the overall strategy and performance of mSupply’s Appliance category. Reporting to the VP of Merchandising, this role will own assortment, pricing, vendor strategy, product experience, and category performance across MyMarcone, mSupply Partner Sites, branch locations, and counter sales channels.

This leader will bring Business Units together around a unified category strategy and connect supplier programs, customer needs, digital merchandising, and branch execution to drive revenue and margin growth.

This is an opportunity for a merchandising leader who enjoys building, influencing, and creating structure in a growing organization — and who wants to help shape the future of category management at mSupply.

**About Us**
We are a fast-growing online fashion wholesale company dedicated to delivering fashion apparel and accessories to our B2B buyers. We are seeking a detail-oriented, fashion-savvy E-Commerce Merchandising Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with team leaders to manage site updates, streamline inventory operations, support photoshoots, and build strong relationships with our wholesale customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and update product listings, ensuring accurate photos, descriptions, pricing, and stock details.
* Assist the team leader with daily website updates and ongoing improvements across our B2B online catalog.
* Support seasonal merchandising strategy and product assortment planning.
* Participate in and assist with product and model photoshoots, including styling, prepping samples, and organizing shoot items.
* Attend buying meetings and trade shows when needed.
* Conduct sales analysis to track item movement, identifying best sellers, slow sellers, and items to reorder.
* Follow up promptly with buyers and proactively reach out to drive recurring sales.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock availability with the team.
* Assist with order processing and work with the warehouse and shipping teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Work closely with the imaging team on item photoshoots to meet deadlines, including prepping samples, and organizing shoot items

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Education:** Degree in fashion or a related field required.
* **Experience:**
* At least 1 year of experience in e-commerce merchandising.
* Hands-on experience in fashion wholesale.
* **Fashion Knowledge:** Basic understanding of fashion terminology and seasonal/product cycles.
* **Platforms & Tools:**
* Required: Experience with Odoo, Shopify, or similar e-commerce platforms.
* Required: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Preferred: Basic skills in Canva and Adobe Photoshop.
* **Core Skills:** Quick learner, highly organized, proactive, with strong written and verbal communication.
* **Work Authorization & Availability:** Must be eligible to work in the U.S. and available full-time, on-site.
* **Passion:** Must have a genuine love for fashion. Interest in social media and marketing is a plus.

**Work Location:** In person

**\\*\\*Applicants with relevant work experience and a background in a related field of study will be given priority consideration.**

Pay: $17.00 - $18.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Buyer** **(Home Organization)** plays a critical role in shaping and executing the category strategy for a designated department. With a strong understanding of product development, pricing architecture, and customer behavior, the Buyer is responsible for building a compelling, brand-right assortment that drives both financial results and customer engagement. This role requires a blend of creativity, analytical skills, and market insight to deliver innovative product stories that differentiate the brand and meet evolving customer expectations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded merchant with a passion for products and a strong ability to translate insights into strategy. They will lead cross-functional teams, including Planning, Sourcing, and Go-to-Market partners, ensuring each category reflects a clear vision, a strong value proposition, and meaningful differentiation in the market.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Cross-Functional Team Leadership**
Demonstrates the ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams, including individuals who do not report directly. Success in this role requires strong influence, collaboration, and communication skills to foster alignment and drive high performance across diverse teams. The ability to build consensus and lead through influence is a crucial competency for an At-Home Buyer.
* **Category Strategy & Assortment Planning**
Develop and execute customer-focused merchandise strategies and seasonal assortment plans that support financial objectives and reflect brand values.
* Partner with Planning & Sourcing to build season assortment plans; Planning to own input & management of the tool, with support from Buyer on item intent & retail and sourcing for cost confirmation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Lead a team of Material Control Supervisors across all sites to deliver and control all material being utilized in the production and assembly of trailers and chassis products.

* Establish and implement plans for material presentation, delivery, and management of material from receipts to shipments.

* Work cross functionally with Supply Chain team and Suppliers to implement Kanbans and lean methods to manage material from supplier site to assembly.

* Establish and implement plans for storage of material within each site utilizing lean principles.

* Establish and implement methods and best practices related to the systems and process that support inventory forecasting, purchasing, and material control.

* Prepares customer delivery reports by collecting, analyzing and summarizing information and trends and uses information to proactively communicate potential late deliveries.

* Establishes and supervises production scheduling activities by monitoring material inventories, tracking progress of production and reviewing factors that affect schedules.

* Coordinate and work with quality, engineering, machining, and assembly operations to ensure 100% on-time delivery by establishing and monitoring schedule to proactively identify and address any issues.

* Responsible for accuracy of inventory counts by implementing and managing, in conjunction with Finance, an inventory control system, capable of identifying discrepancies in inventory counts and taking corrective action to guard against inconsistencies in the future.

* Achieves financial objectives by working with management group to prepare the materials budget, schedule expenditures, analyze variances and initiate corrective actions.

* Participates in MRB and CAR meetings to resolve quality issues working with both internal and external resources

* Collaborate with Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, Process Engineering, and Quality to achieve cost reduction targets

* Maintains a safe and healthy work environment by implementing, maintaining, and aligning company policies that adhere to local, state and federal environmental, health and safety regulations.

* Attend scheduled work hours on a regular and timely basis. Maintain good attendance.

* Comply with all company policies and procedures.

* Work and communicate as a team. Contribute to a team effort

* Other duties may be assigned as required by the Company.

Above is a list of the most important responsibilities and functions, which are essential to the position. Employees must be able to perform these essential functions satisfactorily with or without a reasonable accommodation. Accommodations will be evaluated and provided to eligible employees on a case by case basis, depending on the employee's medical restrictions, work availability, the nature of the position, the position's essential functions and other relevant factors.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, management, or other related discipline

* Licenses/Certifications:

* APICS certification a plus.

* Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

* At least 5 years progressive experience in management of materials and logistics within a design and manufacturing environment.

* Experience in Lean, total quality, six sigma, or other similar environments.

* Working knowledge and understanding of ERP/MRP systems and their use in a manufacturing environment, forecasting, order policy codes, etc.

* Working knowledge of line side inventory, pull systems (KanBan), and supplier managed inventory.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access.

* Ability to demonstrate solid written and oral communication skills.

* Maintain and provide current understanding of industry best practices and technology trends

* Identify tools, processes and metrics to optimize supplier value.

* Ability to contribute in a cross functional collaborative environment.

* Good technical writing, documentation, and record keeping skills.

* Financial skills including cost modeling, cost analysis, make vs. buy analysis.

* Ability to leverage metrics and other tools to drive supplier performance

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Procurement Manager, you'll be responsible for managing a team of employees responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and managing service provider for outsourced services. You will also assist a client or department with the development and execution of sourcing and procurement strategies.

This job is part of the Procurement function. They are responsible for sourcing and purchasing goods, services, or raw materials from vendors and suppliers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Work with business stakeholders, operational shared services team members, and sponsors to develop, coordinate, and execute strategy at local and regional levels.
* Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain contracts and other business documents in support of the purchase of goods and services.
* Review the process of contract terminations, expirations, extensions, and renewals. Inform peers and corporate management staff of changes or results.
* Manage supplier and contractor certification process. Conduct periodic visits to supplier work locations to review vendor performance.
* Mentor and educate on contemporary outsourcing practices and the value of applying them.
* Analyze account-wide facility management services spend, suppliers, operations, and statement of works to identify opportunities for value creation.
* Assist with creating RTFs, selecting solutions, and negotiating. Prepare and maintain contracts with national and regional service providers. Ensure contracts adhere to company standards.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement. Deal with sensitive issues.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. C.P.M., C.P.S.M. or N.A.C.M. certifications or eligibility preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

**REQUIRED: MUST APPLY IN PERSON !!!**

**BETWEEN THE HOURS OF 9AM - 3PM, MONDAY - FRIDAY**

**BRING RESUME**

**LOCATION: 103 Tower Drive Middletown NY 10941**

**Job Requirements and Skills Include:**

· Proficiency in all Microsoft Office Suite products, primarily Outlook and Excel is a must!

· Willing to learn and understand account-specific company regulations, key players, preferred component and methods of operation.

· Ability to communicate complications to operations and supporting internal departments.

· Willing to acquire a comprehension of construction documents such as floor plans/blueprints.

· A fast paced demeanor with strong attention to detail and ability to keep organized while multitasking.

· Willing to work overtime hours and answer calls outside of business hours when necessary.

**Summary of Position:**

· Provide targeted and personalized support to specific clients purchasing shelving, accessories, and other services (such as freight, inspections, permitting, and installation).

· Understanding clients business model to help adapt the size shelving that will accommodate to their products and goods.

· Assist in layout design and execution of shelving system in client's space.

· Confirmation of all materials, parts, and pieces being purchased via blueprint/floor plan understanding and reading.

· Processing of client purchase order through a series of programs and processes internally designed by MMI team.

· Work closely with engineer in establishing shop order and shelving pick list sent to our warehouses to be manufactured.

· Coordination with clients GC and site supervisors in meeting schedule delivery and install dates for new store and remodel build outs.

· Working in an energetic team environment, the candidate must be able to adapt to other team member's working and communication styles.

· Primarily, this role will involve assisting overall team in facilitating a close working relationship with GCs, architects, site supervisors, buyers & store planners on each and every project.

· Our entire staff is expected to keep our clients' needs fulfilled and should contribute to our success in being one of the top shelving suppliers across the nation.

MMI Storage Solutions is a busy shelving manufacturing company servicing primarily retail clients, as well as agriculture, golf, commercial, administrative, and additional market sectors. We pride ourselves on being one of the industry's leading back of house one-stop shop for shelving, high-density mobile systems, lockers, and other stockroom accessories. For the past 35+ years, we have been an influencer in the shelving/warehousing industry, and our account management team has ensured that we keep our clients returning.

Compensation includes a salary commensurate with experience, participation in group insurance plans upon eligibility, paid time off, sick leave, parental leave and more. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

Criminal background checks are part of the MMI hiring process.

MMI is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local law.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Title: VMO IT Sourcing Manager**

**Location: Onsite - Warwick, RI**

**Duration: 6 Months**

**Hours per Week: 35 Hours**

**Requirements**

· 3-5 years IT experience preferably 1-2 years in IT Vendor Management and/or IT Sourcing

· Understanding IT products & services from a contract and vendor management perspective

· Understanding commercial [pricing services] with contracting and negotiation aspect. Ability to determine contractual/financial exposure/ negotiate contracts.

· Knowledge of contracting trends, licensing models

· Deep market knowledge of IT vendor (Application Svcs, SaaS, Consulting)

· Strong project and process management skills, with the ability to handle multiple vendors and

· multiple contracts, as well as a wide range of tasks.

· Knowledge of best practices for IT contract negotiation tactics and strategies.

· Where applicable, understanding of government and industry regulations that will influence contracting approach and vendor behavior (for example, SOX, SECURITY).

· Experience drafting IT Statement of Work/SLA, change order or amendment

· Customer-focused approach to delivering contract management services to internal IT

· Supplier agreements: knowledge of legal terminology related to supplier agreements

· Proven negotiation and contracting skills

· Project management skills

· Ability to think strategically

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced complex environment

· Knowledge of Procurement Processes and Tools

· Proficient in the use of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, Sharepoint

· Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

**Education**

· Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree preferred.

· 10+ years relevant professional experience; 7-8 years’ experience in Indirect Sourcing categories required (Project Application Development, SaaS, Maintenance Support)

**Preferred**

· Familiarity with Public Sector Purchasing and Procurement is a plus.

· Familiarity with Tools such as Archer, a plus

· Strong analytical skills

· Strong IT background having managed vendor as Project Manager or IT Account Manager who has delivered services to client is a plus.

Pay: $45.00 - $50.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group > Sourcing

**General Summary:**

Develops, provides, and executes sourcing strategies, options, working with internal customers to conclude decisions based on technology, cost and schedule requirements, and then drives procurement to completion. Drives business aspects of complex, high impact supplier agreements in collaboration with suppliers and internal cross-functional organizations. Responsible for contract negotiations, cost, technology enablement, device development, and services to ensure capacity and supply assurance.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

OR

Associate's degree and 10+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

OR

High School Diploma or equivalent and 12+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.

* 4+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.

* 4+ years in a leadership role with or without direct reports (only applies to positions with direct reports).

* 3+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Sr. Director level and above).

* 2+ years of working with cost projection and management.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develops new processes and procedures and defines efficient methods for sourcing based on expertise in standard and Qualcomm's sourcing principles, theories, and concepts. Identifies opportunities for efficiency, aligns across teams to develop and implement efficient and effective solutions.
* Develops sourcing strategies and plans in accordance with supplier engagements or agreements that are aligned with business unit objectives for products or technology.
* Guides others to provide sourcing options and recommendations to internal customers based on technology, cost, risks, and schedule requirements. Uses strong understanding of competitive landscape and business needs to manage and serve as an escalation point for highly complex sourcing issues.
* Leads team to conduct and manage advanced data analysis to identify problems and develop solutions.
* Develops and communicates contract negotiation strategies, including licensing of IP for integration into end products, pricing, device development and/or supply assurance. Guides others during negotiations.
* Collaborates internally and externally to plan and execute work based on an understanding of factors such as design changes, cost targets, and changes to scheduled and quantities. Determines next steps and the associated risks.
* Makes decisions that have global implications. Decisions reflect broad knowledge of functional areas and strategies.
* Reviews assigned projects and determines the level of analyses and associated work that needs to be conducted in order to address these project deadlines and assigns projects throughout the team accordingly. Defines and improves processes for one's team.
* Re-scopes high-level team priorities based on discussions with other departments to determine what input is needed from the team, identify resources, and determines how to respond in the most productive manner based on own team's bandwidth.

**Level of Responsibility:**

* Works independently with little supervision.
* Provides supervision to direct reports.
* Decisions are more significant in their impact, influencing overall program or project success, finances, and/or the ability to meet objectives. Errors are not readily apparent due to the complexity of work process/product or time between decisions and results. Errors typically result in significant expenditure of time, resources, and funds to correct.
* Requires verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. Role may require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
* Works within the prescribed budgetary objectives of the department. Erroneous decisions, failure to achieve results may cause delays in schedules and result in the re-allocation of some resources.
* Has a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to make key decisions).
* Most tasks do not have defined steps; simultaneous use of multiple mental abilities is generally required to determine the best approach; mistakes may result in significant rework.
* Substantial creativity is needed to innovate new processes, procedures, or work products within guidelines or to achieve established objectives.
* Works on abstract problems in variable situa

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Procurement leads procurement strategy, sourcing, and supplier management at the enterprise level. This role works across the organization to align purchasing activities with business needs, strengthen supplier relationships, and secure favourable commercial terms. The position also drives cost savings and procurement efficiencies while establishing consistent standards, controls, and reporting to support informed decision-making.

**Position Details:**

* Full time, permanent position.
* 40 hours/week, Monday-Friday
* In office position, office location in Galleria, Houston Texas

Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute enterprise-wide procurement strategies and sourcing initiatives that align with organizational objectives. Ensure sourcing activities balance cost effectiveness, quality, service levels, and long-term supplier viability.
* Lead end-to-end commercial negotiations with suppliers covering master service agreements, pricing structures, statements of work, and contract terms. Collaborate closely with legal, finance, and operational teams to safeguard organizational interests.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement continuous cost-reduction initiatives and procurement efficiencies across business units. Streamline purchasing workflows to eliminate redundancies and enhance overall organizational agility.
* Manage supplier performance through formal reviews, service-level monitoring, and performance metrics. Address performance deficiencies, resolve escalations proactively, and build collaborative supplier relationships.
* Assess and mitigate supplier risk, supply chain vulnerabilities, and regulatory compliance exposures across the enterprise. Establish preventative controls and business continuity mechanisms to maintain supply security.
* Partner cross-functionally with senior business leaders to understand strategic plans and forecast purchasing demands. Integrate procurement roadmaps into broader business budgeting and operational planning cycles.
* Establish and govern enterprise procurement policies, internal controls, compliance procedures, and auditing frameworks. Build standardized reporting dashboards and analytics to provide transparent visibility into organizational spend and realized savings.
* Other work duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Deep knowledge of strategic sourcing methodologies, category management principles, and end-to-end procurement lifecycles.
* Thorough understanding of commercial contracting practices, standard legal protections, and total cost of ownership models.
* Comprehensive knowledge of supplier risk assessment, market intelligence tools, compliance frameworks, and procurement governance controls.
* Advanced contract negotiation and dispute resolution skills with a proven track record of securing favourable pricing and commercial terms.
* Strong financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills to evaluate complex supplier proposals and interpret organizational spend data.
* Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder communication skills to influence senior leadership, cross-functional partners, and external vendors.
* Demonstrated ability to translate organizational priorities into actionable purchasing forecasts and strategic sourcing roadmaps.
* Proven ability to design and implement enterprise procurement policies, operational controls, and reporting metrics across diverse departments.
* Ability to drive operational change, resolve vendor escalations, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced corporate environment.

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, business administration, finance, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Minimum 8 years of progressive experience leading enterprise procurement functions, strategic sourcing operations, and high-value contract negotiations. This background should include proven success managing vendor relationships and realizing measurable cost savings
* Demonstrated experience collaborating directly with senior business leaders to forecast organizational purchasing needs and implement governance frameworks.

Working Conditions:

* Work is primarily performed in an office or remote-office setting, with regular use of a computer and participation in meetings with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Prolonged periods of sitting or stationary standing at a desk or designated workstation. The role requires remaining focused and productive during extended desk-based working sessions.
* Continuous and extensive use of computer hardware, software applications, and peripherals such as monitors, keyboards, and mice. Frequent fine-motor dexterity is required for typing, data analysis, contract drafting, and general digital communication.
* Frequent verbal and auditory interaction during telephone calls, virtual video meetings, and in-person discussions. Mus

description:
**Summary**

A well-established industrial equipment manufacturer is seeking a Senior Subcontract Manager to oversee outside fabrication partners and suppliers supporting complex engineered equipment projects.

This position works closely with engineering, procurement, quality, manufacturing, and project teams to ensure subcontracted work is completed to specification, schedule, quality, and cost requirements.

This is a strong fit for someone with experience managing subcontractors or suppliers within heavy manufacturing, power generation, pressure vessels, boilers, heat exchangers, or similar industrial fabrication environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage subcontracted manufacturing and fabrication activities from award through final delivery
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned subcontractors and suppliers
* Track engineering, material procurement, fabrication, testing, inspections, and shipment milestones
* Review subcontractor schedules, costs, quality requirements, and project documentation
* Coordinate closely with engineering, procurement, quality, and project management teams
* Monitor vendor performance and address schedule, quality, or production issues
* Support supplier qualification and subcontractor development as needed
* Review technical drawings, specifications, and fabrication requirements
* Ensure subcontracted work meets applicable quality and industry standards
* Travel to domestic and international subcontractor facilities for project oversight, inspections, and coordination

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of subcontract management, supplier management, procurement, or project management experience
* Background in heavy industrial manufacturing or engineered equipment strongly preferred
* Experience with pressure vessels, boilers, heat exchangers, power generation equipment, or similar fabrication highly preferred
* Working knowledge of ASME codes and standards strongly preferred
* Ability to read and understand fabrication drawings, specifications, and technical documentation
* Strong vendor management, scheduling, and problem-solving skills
* Comfortable managing multiple subcontractors and projects simultaneously
* 50%+ travel
* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent relevant industry experience

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement plan
* Paid holidays and PTO
* Company-paid business travel / travel expenses
* Career growth within a larger family of energy and industrial companies

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

As a Sr Sourcing Deputy, you will play a crucial role in executing procurement processes, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.

Your Contribution:

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objective

* Gathering and analyzing information about the market, including competitors, customers, trends and products

* Manage sourcing and procurement for electronic components.
* Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.
* Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.
* Responsible for cost negotiations, drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis; provide supplier roadmap and market trend & analysis to internal customers on regular basis
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.
* Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place, work on long term component capacity planning and identifying sourcing bottlenecks

Your Qualifications and Skills:

* At least 6-8 years of sourcing experience, especially in electronic components.
* High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).
* Experience in strategic sourcing and international procurement.
* Ability to understand market drivers and cost structures.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
* Proven track record in supplier and cost management.
* Knowledge of financial analysis related to sourcing.

Work Location and Model:

At Logitech, we empower global collaboration by providing a flexible hybrid work model. Depending on the role and team needs, this may include working remotely, on-premises, or a blend of both.

This is a hybrid position. The successful candidate is expected to work onsite at our San Jose, CA office 2–3 days per week, with the remaining days remote. Specific onsite days will be coordinated with your manager and team.

Compensation:

This position offers an annual base salary typically between $ 116,000 and $ 152,000 . In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.

Benefits:

Logitech offers benefits such as Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, Traditional and Roth 401(k) Plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), Basic and Additional Life Insurance, Disability Coverage, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, Tuition Reimbursement Plans, Commuter Benefits, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Parental Leave.

Logitech also offers Wellness Programs, Health Savings Account Plans, access to Expert Medical Opinions, Identity Theft Protection, Breast Milk Delivery to Nursing Mothers on Business Travel, access to a Group Legal Plan, Donations Matching Programs, Employee Product Discounts, and access to Auto, Home, and Pet Insurance.

#LI-SN1

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants

description:
**Description**
---------------

**Overview of the Contracts and Procurement Program:**

SANDAG conducts more than 65 solicitations on an annual basis and engages with the community and suppliers to maintain a competitive business environment. The 25+ member Contracts and Procurement Services team provides procurement and contract management expertise in areas such as professional services, construction, operational supplies, Architecture & Engineering services, and technology equipment and services, and is responsible for executing approximately 800 contracts each year, with a total value of more than $275 million.

**Role:**

The Manager of Contracts & Procurement Services, Operations and Administration oversees the delivery of comprehensive, agency-wide procurement services while ensuring adherence to related agency, state, and federal regulations and laws. This position develops and administers contracts and procurement policies, programs, and activities, directly supervises Senior-level employees, and oversees a team of about 12 employees.

This role will be focused on procurement and programs that support SANDAG’s overall operations and administration. This includes oversight of contracts and procurements that fall into the areas of Professional Services (Non-A&E/CM), Facilities & Operations, Technology, Grants, and Revenue. In addition, this position will be responsible for critical program areas that are required to keep the agency and team operations strong and modernized including contract administration activities, Micro-purchase program oversight, insurance compliance, award reporting, audit and Public Records Act request support, and administration of the contract and purchasing modules within the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.

------------------------

* Oversee contracting and procurement activities such as the preparation of bid/proposal solicitations and related advertisements, bid/proposal openings and review, pre-award audits, contract/procurement awards and execution, and review of payment requests from contractors; ensure the agency’s procedures and records are accurate and comply with applicable agency, state, and federal rules and regulations.
* Oversee development and maintenance of contracting and procurement policies and procedures; streamline workflow to reduce the processing time of contracts and purchase orders; recommend and implement procedural improvements; ensure bid and proposal formats are compliant with SANDAG policy and appropriate laws and regulations.
* Plan, manage, and coordinate the development and implementation of the Contracts program goals, objectives, policies, and priorities.
* Develop strategic plans and budgets for Contracts and Procurement in coordination with Senior Analysts in the Department and the Director of Contracts and Procurement Services.
* Assist Director of Contracts and Procurement Services in establishing appropriate resource and staffing levels; monitor program activities and allocate resources accordingly.
* Supervise, mentor, train, and support career development opportunities for supervisory, professional, technical, and administrative level employees.
* Meet with staff to identify and resolve problems; assign projects and programmatic areas of responsibility; review and evaluate work methods and procedures; review staff work when issues or challenges arise.
* Identify, establish, and maintain best practices for SANDAG Contracts and Procurement services; develop and implement processes and procedures that are user-friendly for staff and vendors; ensure compliance with funding agencies and public sector contracting requirements; facilitate and assist with preparing materials for audits and compliance reviews.
* Ensure standard contract language reflects changes to laws, regulations, and ordinances; consult with legal counsel on complex contractual issues.
* Prepare, plan, and negotiate terms and conditions for complex multi-jurisdictional, multi-year, or diversely funded contracts and ensure they represent the best interests of the agency.

* Assist with monitoring the Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) and labor compliance and reporting functions.
* Participate in the review of plans, specifications, and related documents to be submitted to federal and state agencies for approval.

**Job Description**
This high-impact role supports the strategic sourcing, governance, and operational excellence of the company’s US based travel program. The travel category manager balances strategy creation, Request for Proposal (RFP) execution, and contract negotiations with a critical focus on the end-user experience, continuous process improvement and digital transformation. The ideal candidate will have well balanced travel category management experience with a focus on meetings & events.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Develop and execute category plans for travel-related services (e.g. travel management company, airline, ground transportation, hotel, meetings & events, corporate card programs) and other shared services agreements as applicable.
* Lead RFP process for all travel and meetings & events suppliers ensuring compliance with the Federal Acquisition Regualtion (FAR) and federal reimbursement structures (e.g., Government Services Administration (GSA) per diem rates).
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to develop requirements for RFP processes.
* Partner with Legal, Security, and Insurable Risk to navigate contract language redlines, limitation of liability clauses, and “Duty of Care” requirements.
* Conduct supplier rationalization exercises and manage supplier relationships, including quarterly business reviews, KPI creation, performance monitoring and digitization.
* Source, contract, organize, plan the logistics for and participate in the Travel Working Group meetings with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
* Create/present quarterly briefings to senior leadership.
* Act as the primary travel supplier liaison, resolving specific travel and/or meetings/events disruptions for travelers/planners with suppliers.
* Utilize quantitative and qualitative data to drive improvements in supplier performance and service quality.
* Analyze travel data into actionable insights and report on travel program spend, cost savings and avoidance.

**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**
**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of category management within the meetings & events and/or travel industry
* Deep understanding of meetings/events and travel pricing, revenue management, and current trends in travel and meetings industries.
* Strong category management, contract negotiation, and supplier relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to drive program adoption and influence spend decisions using data-driven insights.
* Exceptional communication skills across diverse, cross-functional teams and external suppliers
* Advanced Microsoft 365 skills for data analysis and forecasting.
* Project management and ability to manage multiple high visibility projects and deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Experience or strong aptitude for utilizing automation tools to modernize business processes.
* Ability to work with diverse, cross-functional, global teams.
* Experience with airline, hotel and meetings/events consulting and planning, data analysis, pricing and revenue management.
* Familiarity with industry-standard tools (e.g., Concur, iValua, Coupa, Lanyon, Cvent, ReadyBid, Groupize).
* Knowledge of current market trends, best practices, and contracting models

**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**

Experience in the Aerospace & Defense industry.

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $97157 - $165167

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

**About BAE Systems, Inc.**

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us

Texas Capital is built to help businesses and their leaders. Our depth of knowledge and expertise allows us to bring the best of the big firms at a scale that works for our clients, with highly experienced bankers who truly invest in people’s success — today and tomorrow.

While we are rooted in core financial products, we are differentiated by our approach. Our bankers are seasoned financial experts who possess deep experience across a multitude of industries. Equally important, they bring commitment — investing the time and resources to understand our clients’ immediate needs, identify market opportunities and meet long-term objectives. At Texas Capital, we do more than build business success. We build long-lasting relationships.

Texas Capital provides a variety of benefits to colleagues, including health insurance coverage, wellness program, fertility and family building aids, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans with a generous 401K match, paid leave programs, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

Headquartered in Dallas with offices in Austin, Fort Worth, Houston, Richardson, Plano and San Antonio, Texas Capital was recently named Best Regional Bank in 2024 by Bankrate and was named to *The Dallas Morning News*’ Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex Top Workplaces 2023 and GoBankingRate’s 2023 list of Best Regional Banks. For more information about joining our team, please visit us at www.texascapitalbank.com.

Key Responsibilities

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships within the business to manage all third-parties through regular performance reviews, goal-setting discussions, and expectation alignment sessions
* Analyze vendor performance metrics, platform reliability, and contractual compliance using data-driven methods; conduct periodic assessments and reviews to ensure adherence to established agreements.
* Assist in the negotiation of vendor contracts including licensing, pricing structures, implementation timelines, and service level agreements; ensure all terms align with company policies and data security standards.
* Monitor third-party technology and risk with the appropriate parties to ensure successful delivery against contractual obligations and implement remediation strategies for compliance gaps or performance deficiencies.
* Serve as a customer-focused point of contact to address vendor-related complaints, platform outages, delivery delays, and contractual disputes; develop solutions that maintain positive relationships while protecting Firm interests.
* Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives and value optimization opportunities across the vendor portfolio; maintain awareness of emerging fintech solutions and competitive alternatives.
* Partner with technology, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure vendor relationships support digital transformation goals and maintain compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
* Apply strong analytical skills to evaluate vendor performance data and market trends; develop technology sourcing strategies aligned with corporate innovation goals and provide recommendations for portfolio optimization
* Identify complex vendor-related challenges and implement data-driven solutions; provide proactive recommendations to enhance vendor capabilities and service delivery

Skills

* Demonstrated ability to drive cost optimization initiatives with measurable results
* Highly analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making
* Experience with third-party risk management frameworks, data security, and compliance frameworks
* Customer-oriented mindset with a track record of building strong stakeholder relationships
* Self-driven, results-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to provide clear guidance and mentor

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, supply chain management, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred)
* Banking or financial services industry experience
* 10+ years of IT vendor and relationship management experience, Strategic Sourcing and technology operations
* CPSM or Six Sigma certification preferred
* Vendor lifecycle management experience required

*The duties listed above are the essential functions, or fundamental duties within the job classification. The essential functions of individual positions within the classification may differ. Texas Capital Bank may assign reasonably related additional duties to individual employees consistent with standard departmental policy.Texas Capital is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Amrize is building North America. From bridges and railways to data centers, schools, offices and homes, our solutions are inside the buildings and infrastructure that connect people and advance how we live. And we invite you to come and build with us.

Description:

Join Amrize as a Project Procurement Manager, Construction and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Project Procurement Manager, Construction will oversee all aspects of procurement for the project including for all capital equipment, building materials, construction related services and raw materials. This position will manage supplier relationships, strategic sourcing and procurement processes and ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services essential for the project. The Procurement Manager must utilize a proactive approach to optimizing procurement strategies and place a strong focus on cost reduction, quality assurance and supply chain efficiency.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with the Project’s business goals and operational requirements.
* Lead cross-functional teams to manage procurement projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers, vendors, and service providers to secure advantageous terms.
* Conduct market research and supplier evaluations to identify and onboard reliable suppliers and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, production, logistics, quality assurance, and finance departments, to forecast demand and ensure an uninterrupted supply of materials.
* Monitor and manage supplier performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and performance metrics.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, reduce costs, and improve supplier performance.
* Ensure compliance with procurement activities' legal, regulatory, and environmental policies and standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Field of Study Preferred: Supply Chain Management, business administration, engineering or related field

**Required Work Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management, preferably within a construction manufacturing environment and/or a greenfield plant environment.
* Certification in supply chain management or procurement is a plus.
* 7+ years of managing suppier relationships, strategic soucing and handling negotiations

**Required Computer and Software Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience working with Procore or similar project management software Proficient in procurement software and systems

**Travel Requirements:**

* Occasional, but regular overnight travel to the project site and to suppliers for meetings and presentations

**Additional Requirements:**

* Demonstrate detailed and efficient organization skills
* Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills
* Work well under pressure to meet project deadlines
* Show high levels of commitment to detail
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, supply chain management, and strategic sourcing principles.
* Strong knowledge and project procurement experience with greenfield and brownfield expansions.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes and materials.
* Project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and managing budgets.
* Familiarity with capital projects including engineering and construction

We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don't miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026

**The team**

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

This role utilizes your deep understanding of end-to-end network transformation, with a specific emphasis on strategic sourcing and procurement impacts to broader supply chain design. While below is a sample of the role, each unique project will provide you the opportunity to develop and grow your supply chain transformation capabilities.

* Conduct discussions with senior leaders on functional solutions within sourcing and procurement and network visibility/resiliency
* Lead discussions with business to understand needs and requirements, translating requirements into technical platform functionality, and collaborate with technical architects ensuring technically feasible and scalable technology application solutions
* Perform high-level functional and technical architecture, analysis, research, and design for sourcing and procurement, `network visibility and resiliency/decision intelligence solutions
* Lead project delivery across process design, data analytics, solution configuration, deployment, testing, knowledge management, and performance metric development
* Advise clients on supply chain and operations strategy and translating findings into network design / sourcing strategies, total cost of ownership models, and recommendations for client executives
* Manage multiple workstreams and lead onshore and offshore teams in a client service environment
* Assess category cost drivers, supplier opportunities, and large datasets to identify trends, insights, and cost improvement opportunities
* Promote and participate in forums for sharing expertise, strengthening Deloitte's collective knowledge, and helping to resolve clients' challenges
Collaborate on innovative solutions to bolster the future of the practice

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 8+ years of experience in consulting, industry, or both
* 6+ years of experience leading network design, transformation and/or sourcing and procurement projects from strategy through implementation
* Experience with end-to-end supply chain assessments, spend analytics, network optimization, Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, strategic sourcing execution, category management, operational procurement, demand management, and supplier management
* Experience leading project teams or workstreams
* Experience utilizing and/or implementing relevant technology applications (e.g., Llamasoft, Coupa, Logility, iValua, etc)
* Experience using analytics, metrics and AI-centric tools/agents
* Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be authorized to work in the US without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Operations Research, Strategy, Finance, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields
* Prior Consulting experience
* Relevant software vendor Certifications
* Experience leading a project team in a project client environment.
* Experience developing total cost of ownership models
* Experience with Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis and spend analytics
* Experience with Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and supplier risk management

Overview:

This role is at Spirit AeroSystems, Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, supporting Spirit’s Commercial Business Units (“Spirit Commercial”). Spirit Commercial designs and builds commercial aerostructures, including for Boeing Commercial Airplanes, one of Boeing’s three business units and the premier manufacturer of commercial jetliners for decades. Spirit Commercial’s core products include fuselages, pylons, nacelles and wing components, with a focus on innovative composite and aluminium manufacturing solutions.

**The Role:** On a typical day, but not limited to, the Supplier Quality First Level Manager is responsible for a team of Supplier Quality Representatives (SQR) who oversee the performance and quality of Spirit Suppliers globally. This team is responsible for quality of product through the life cycle of the products which includes on-boarding, First Part Qualification, Sourcing of Product, First Article Inspection and Investigation of Discrepancies.

Responsibilities:

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Consistent discipline across suppliers, management and procurement job families and apply specialized technical expertise for problem resolution
* Meets deadlines of supplier audits, discrepancy resolution and Supplier Improvement Initiatives
* Works cross-functionally with internal and external customers and suppliers and all employee levels to carry out responsibilities
* Responsible for the day to day performance management baseline, including establishing the programs organization and work breakdown structures; reporting, visibility and communication of strategic and operational program activities necessary to achieve defined program objectives and business plans
* Reporting program performance and maintaining program communication plan

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Experience in Supplier Quality Management/Supply Chain Management
* Experience working with internal and external customers and suppliers
* Experience with customer flow down requirements

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* 3+ yrs experience in a quality or supply chain role
* Experience in a leadership/management position
* Knowledge of AS9100
* Knowledge of AS9102
* Knowledge of AS9145
* Experience in Aerospace
* Experience in manufacturing.
* Experience working with multiple cross functional teams.
* Experience with project management.
* Experience presenting to and interacting with all levels of the organization.
* Governance and Compliance background including experience with AS9100 or other external audits.
* APICS, CPIM, CSCP or other industry certification
* Experience in Microsoft Office Suite
* SAP experience
* Bachelor’s degree

**Drug Free Workplace:**

We are a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

**Pay & Benefits:**

We strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

We also provide eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary Pay Range: $100,750 - $154,500

**Kansas Tax Credit:** Join Spirit AeroSystems’ Kansas team and you may be eligible for a $5,000 state of Kansas Aviation tax credit for up to five years. Click here for more information on the tax credit.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Associate Manager, Direct Materials supports the strategic sourcing and management of primary packaging and other direct material categories, including but not limited to glass, cans, closures, wirehoods, and luxury packaging. In this role, the Associate Manager, Direct Materials collaborates with suppliers and cross-functional partners to advance sourcing and sustainability initiatives, negotiate and manage contracts, mitigate supply and packaging risks, and deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, service, innovation, and supply continuity. The successful candidate will apply strong project management, analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills to manage competing priorities, respond quickly to evolving business needs, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.

**Responsibilities**

* Own category strategy and execution for assigned direct materials, including but not limited to capsules, screwcaps, wirehoods, and luxury boxes, while supporting sourcing strategies for glass and cans.
* Develop and implement sourcing plans that improve cost, quality, service, supply continuity, innovation, and overall value across direct procurement categories.
* Own and advance assigned sustainability initiatives in partnership with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders, supporting broader company sustainability objectives
* Lead competitive sourcing activities, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and the drafting and execution of supply agreements.
* Proactively manage supplier contracts through renegotiation, extension, renewal, and performance-review cycles.
* Build and maintain productive supplier relationships and collaborate with internal partners across Brand, Buying Operations, Category Management, Graphics, Packaging Technology, Planning, Finance, and Operations.
* Identify procurement and packaging risks, recommend solutions, and coordinate cross-functional action to support new product development and ongoing business needs.
* Execute tactical and strategic initiatives that deliver sustainable savings, cost avoidance, risk reduction, and other measurable sources of value.
* Track category performance, market conditions, project milestones, risks, and savings, and communicate clear updates and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure compliance with procurement and finance policies, the company code of conduct, contractual requirements, and applicable external regulations.
Support continuous improvement and manage special projects or business priorities as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; MBA preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or formal training in project management beneficial
At least three years of progressively responsible experience in strategic sourcing, direct materials procurement, procurement consulting, supply chain, or a related discipline. Consumer packaged goods experience is preferred.

**Skills**

* Knowledge of strategic sourcing, category management, supplier management, and competitive bidding processes, including RFI, RFP, and RFQ activities.
* Strong supplier negotiation, contract drafting, contract management, and commercial decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated project management, problem-solving, analytical, and organizational capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships at all organizational levels.
* Experience supporting new product development, packaging commercialization, or related innovation initiatives.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with e-procurement, project management, and data-analysis tools.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to use data to develop recommendations and make decisions.
Fluent in English (bi-lingual Spanish, preferred)

**Minimum Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to sit and/or stand for long periods of time and work on a computer for extended periods. Lifting may be required. Must be at least 21 years of age. Must be able to sit and/or stand for long periods of time and work on a computer for extended periods. Lifting may be required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Travel 10%

* Own category strategy and execution for assigned direct materials, including but not limited to capsules, screwcaps, wirehoods, and luxury boxes, while supporting sourcing strategies for glass and cans.

* Own and advance assigned sustainability initiatives in partnership with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders, supporting broader company sustainability objectives
* Lead competitive sourcing activities, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and the drafting and execution of supply agreements.
* Proactively manage supplier contracts through renegotiation, extension, renewal, and performance-review cycles.

* Competitive pay and benefits, including Day 1 Health & Wellness Benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, 401K Employer Matching, Education Assistance, Paid Time Off, and much more.
* Growth opportunities performing essential work to support America’s food service and broadline distribution system.
* Safe and inclusive working environment, including culture of rewards, recognition, and respect.
