Our mission is to be the most valued marketer of food, fresh and broadline supply solutions to the convenience retail industry.
Core-Mark emphasizes personal growth and development for all associates. We believe that when you succeed, the company succeeds. We promote internally whenever possible and provide frequent training opportunities in several formats to help you meet your personal and career goals.

* **Location:** 2311 East 48th Street, Los Angeles, CA, 90058
* **Work Schedule:** This is an onsite role, Monday-Friday, normal business hours
+ Subject to change based on business needs
* **Travel:** N/A
* **Compensation:** $85k-$95k base salary, depending on experience

Reporting directly to the OpCo President, you will ensure your OpCo has the right products at the right time to meet customer needs by collaborating closely with a centralized purchasing team to execute purchasing strategies. In addition to this coordination, you will take direct ownership of managing local suppliers for fresh dairy, food items, produce and inventory. By optimizing inventory levels, analyzing demand forecasts, placing frequent purchase orders and working with cross-functional teams, you will drive improvements in fill rates and earned income and reduce aged inventory, playing a key role in the success of our organization.

Communication:

* Ensure OpCo specific needs (new customers, operational constraints, seasonality, etc.) are addressed.
* Communicate purchasing specific initiatives that would impact operational personnel.
* Establish solid relationships with corporate purchasing team.
* Meet with OpCo president monthly to review and discuss the “traffic report” from previous period.
* Address inventory concerns including aging, overstock, and spoils risk.
* Prepare and communicate customer specific scorecards as needed.
* Track spoils and spoils risk, partner with corporate buyers to reduce spoils risk.
* Monitor late PO reports and provide action steps to corporate purchasing team or OpCo receiving department.

Purchasing:

* Review and maintain forecasting and inventory levels to ensure achievement of targeted fill rate for assigned suppliers.
* Manage all aspects of the inner house and DCIS process between Core-Mark OpCos.
* Act as the buyer of record for all purchasing activity between assigned Core-Mark OpCo and PFG OpCos.
* Monitor and communicate all purchasing aspects of our PFG Food Service programs to OpCo and corporate associates.
* Review and execute Sku Rationalization process every quarter.
* Create RPO returns for regulated suppliers in SAP OpCos.

Income:

* Negotiate with suppliers to develop and execute OpCo specific income opportunities.
* Maintaining promotions and allowance with assigned vendors.
* Track and manage speed to market programs for regulated suppliers.
* Engage and facilitate marketing initiatives with customers such as flyers and ads.
* Assist with OpCo or regional Expo/Trade Shows as needed.
* Manage audit process to ensure all deductions are legitimate.

Miscellaneous:

* Travel when required for position (less than 10%).
* Understand and review OpCo P&L.
* Maintain safe work environment, adhere to safety procedures.

**The ideal candidate should possess the following:**

* Expert-level proficiency in Excel (must include advanced Pivot Tables) and PowerBI.
* Direct, hands-on experience utilizing AS400 and R6 systems (knowledge of SAP remains highly desired).
* Direct, hands-on experience placing purchase orders with vendors on a weekly basis.
* Experience negotiating merchandising income opportunities as a plus.
* Experience managing short shelf-life products (food, produce, dairy, etc.).
* Ability to analyze multiple forms of data as it relates to the decision-making process.
* Demonstrated professional leadership and negotiation abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and solve problems.
* Able to work independently and communicate effectively (written and verbal).
* Proficiency in Excel, other Microsoft Office products, and Windows-based programs.
* Familiarity or working knowledge of DCMS, R6, AS400 and SAP highly desired.
* Ability to interact effectively with a wide variety of vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of or ability to learn principles and practices of Purchasing, Sales, and Marketing.

**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role:**
-------------

As our Capex Supply Manager, you'll own the execution phase of Hadrian's capital equipment sourcing process. From the moment a machine or piece of equipment is purchased, you own getting it here and installed on time — driving the delivery schedule, managing third-party logistics, coordinating suppliers, and keeping leadership and cross-functional partners aligned. Capital equipment is the pacing item for standing up new factory capacity, so your work directly determines how fast Hadrian can bring new capabilities online.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the equipment delivery schedule across all active capital equipment purchases, from order to installation.
* Manage third-party logistics providers for equipment freight, shipping, and receiving.
* Communicate schedule status, risks, and changes clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define, align on, and lock schedule requirements.
* Work with suppliers to ensure they meet Hadrian's equipment delivery and installation requirements.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Proven project management experience owning schedules end to end, ideally for physical goods or equipment.
* Excellent communicator who keeps stakeholders and leadership informed and aligned.
* Highly detail-oriented, with strong accuracy in tracking dates, dependencies, and commitments.
* Structured problem solver who stays calm and drives resolution when plans slip.
* Ability to operate autonomously and coordinate suppliers and logistics without day-to-day oversight.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Experience with capital equipment or machine tools in aerospace, defense, or advanced manufacturing.
* Familiarity with ERP/MES and procurement/PO systems.
* Hands-on experience with international freight, customs, and equipment install/rigging coordination.
* Track record thriving in a fast-scaling, high-growth manufacturing environment.

**Compensation**
----------------

For this role, the target salary range is **$97,000 - $145,000** (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees

401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**
-----------------------

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions

description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

***KAYAK for Business*** (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners.

KAYAK is seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager to lead Supplier Relations for KAYAK for Business. This person will report to the Senior Director KAYAK for Business and oversee the portfolio of all global preferred supplier partners (TMC, airline, rail, lodging, car rental, ground, expense, payment, etc).

***This position is based in our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 times per week.***

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Drive global growth, engaging new partnerships as well as optimizing and retaining our existing partnerships, while expanding the value proposition and aligning the K4B strategy for suppliers and other partnerships
* Design and lead travel partner evaluations, communications, and contracting for the organization
* Collaborate with partners & internal teams on commercial opportunities, developing and strengthening strategic and mutually beneficial relationships for K4B and its partners
* Working closely with customers and internal collaborators to ensure current and future content & functionality needs are exceeded
* Collaborate with key internal teams like Business Development, Account Management, Product & Marketing to achieve target goals
* Contribute to determining and prioritizing new technology improvements to help drive additional sales to key partners
* Work closely with the Finance department for budgeting and forecasting and revenue reconciliation from suppliers

**Please apply if you have:**
-----------------------------

* 7+ years in travel agency, distribution, payment, air/lodging/car/rail supplier or related fields
* Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and externally
* Savvy and clear communicator, story teller and presenter to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Outstanding analytic skills to drive positive partnership results based on analysis
* Expert negotiator, developing creative solutions to problems or barriers
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced tech environment
* Recognized as a thought leader within the Travel Industry
* Experience in tech a major plus
* Strong business development and problem-solving skills coupled with a willingness to “roll up your sleeves”
* Experience working with global teams in multiple locations

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
* Focus on mental health and well-being:

+ Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
+ Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
+ Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
* No meeting Fridays
* Paid parental leave
* Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
* Paid volunteer time
* Focus on your career growth:

+ Development Dollars
+ Leadership development
+ Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
* Travel Discounts
* Employee Resource Groups
* Competitive retirement and health plans
* Free lunch 2 days per week
* Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is **$135,000-$155,000**.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

**Inclusion**
-------------

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

**Job Location:** Redmond, WA

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Supply Chain Leader to build, optimize, and scale a high-performing supply chain organization across a growing multi-site aerospace manufacturing enterprise. This role will lead end-to-end supply chain operations including sourcing, procurement, planning and supplier development.

At Dendreon, we're transforming the battle against cancer with personalized immunotherapy. Our flagship product, **PROVENGE® (sipuleucel-T)**, was the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer, utilizing a patient's own immune cells to fight the disease.

If you're driven by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on cancer patients' lives, we invite you to join our team. **CORE VALUES:**

* **Put Patients First:** Every day is an opportunity to improve the lives of those living with cancer.
* **Act with Integrity:** We commit to transparency, honesty, and always doing what's right.
* **Build Trust:** Trust is earned through candid, open communication and a collaborative approach.
* **Raise the Bar:** We embrace continuous improvement and innovation, always striving to elevate our people.
* **Drive Results:** We are accountable to each other and deliver success together.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Manager, Sourcing & Procurement is responsible for leading sourcing, procurement, supplier management, and contract negotiation activities that support Dendreon's manufacturing, commercial, clinical, and corporate operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced procurement professional to oversee the development of all Requests for Quotes and Proposals, Capital Projects, support award selection, lead purchase negotiations and complete contract commitments. The role drives process and budget improvements through continuous improvement incentives and enforces ethical and effective procurement practices within the buyer team. This position is ideal for a collaborative, business-focused procurement leader who thrives in a fast-paced biotechnology environment and enjoys rolling up their sleeves to solve problems, build supplier relationships, and drive results.

**NOTE:** **This role requires on-site presence at our Seal Beach, CA location 5 days per week.**

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Lead sourcing activities for goods and services that support manufacturing, laboratory, facilities, corporate, and commercial operations.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies that balance quality, service, risk, and cost considerations.
* Lead supplier selection initiatives, including RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and participate in supplier qualification activities.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier consolidation.

**Contract Negotiation**

* Lead negotiations of supplier agreements, service contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and other commercial contracts.
* Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Quality, Operations, and business stakeholders to negotiate favorable commercial terms while mitigating risk.
* Ensure contracts align with company policies and business objectives.
* Manage contract renewals, amendments, and supplier performance obligations.

**Hands-On Procurement Leadership**

* Personally perform sourcing and procurement activities when needed to support business priorities.
* Balance leadership responsibilities with direct execution of procurement initiatives.
* Support day-to-day purchasing operations and assist with escalations as necessary.
* Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop procurement personnel.
* Establish goals, priorities, and workload distribution across the procurement function.
* Provide guidance and support on sourcing strategies, supplier negotiations, and procurement best practices.
* Promote a collaborative and service-oriented team culture.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Technical Operations, Facilities, Finance, Clinical, and Commercial teams to understand business requirements.
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders regarding sourcing strategies, supplier performance, and project status.
* Support capital projects and strategic business initiatives through procurement expertise and supplier engagement.
* Works directly with VMI contact for ensuring adequate levels of inventory.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Finance, or a related field.
* 5+ years of progressive sourcing, procurement, or supply chain experience.
* 2+ years leadership experience with direct reports.
* Demonstrated experience negotiating supplier agreements, service contracts, and commercial terms within the United States.

Category Lead I

**Location:**
=============

Charlotte, NC, North Carolina Home Office

**Job Summary and Description:**
================================

**Key Responsibilities**

Acquisition Terms Negotiation:

* Under guidance, negotiates sourcing agreements and acquisition terms with an understanding of contract risk; drafts agreement terms that ensure business needs and compliance are met while accurately reflecting the arrangement between the parties
* Negotiates favorable economic value with a “total cost” perspective, and tracks and reports cost savings and avoidance; evaluates financial proposals, brings to manager’s attention sources with poor financial performance
* Supports in the development of a risk analysis matrix for moderate and high-risk arrangements and presents cases for, and documents business decisions

Vendor Management:

* Identifies strategic vendors, and assists in the development of a continuity-of-business plan with alternate sources of supply
* Identifies, and aids in the selection of, sources of supply
* Monitors vendor performance; engages with strategic vendors by developing collaborative relationships and under guidance works to align EPRI-vendor objectives; conducts routine review of the account/relationship
* With guidance, works to (1) identify opportunities for consolidation of supply base, and (2) identify RFX opportunities; with manager or designee support, (a) conducts RFX events and ensures objective, documented contract awards, and (b) formulates business cases with objective information/data
* Resolves vendor non-compliance, brings to manager’s attention cases requiring dispute resolution, and performs agreement cancellations and terminations unrelated to performance issues

Market Analysis:

* Keeps updated on trends in industries related to assigned category, remains informed about developments in other parts of the organization that have impact on acquisitions/procurement
* Surveys market conditions; identifies, makes recommendations and aids in the selection of, best sources of supply

Spend Category Strategy Development:

* With guidance, develops category acquisition strategies, monitors, and reports progress
* Helps manage organizational change that results from implementation of category-based acquisition strategies

Internal Dynamics, Collaboration and Communication:

* Develops and maintains collaborative relationships with internal clients and stakeholders, is aware of category budgets, client needs and departmental strategies, understands overall company objectives (raises conflicting objectives to the attention of manager); reviews acquisition scopes for value and compliance
* Develops ideas and strategies to improve operational efficiency to add value for stakeholders and the Sourcing Team
* Participates in special projects and assumes other duties which may be assigned to support the department as designated by the Manager of Sourcing and Procurement and/or the Director of the Sourcing Team

**Education and Experience**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in supply chain, vendor administration, 3rd party contract negotiations or supplier diversity
* Undergraduate degree or commensurate experience, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration Paralegal, or a related field. Certified Purchasing Professional Designation a plus
* Some understanding of, and experience negotiating commercial acquisition terms and conditions – with the ability to use/draft basic agreement prose
* Basic understanding of the generic procure-to-pay process
* Outstanding listening, and oral and written communication skills
* Familiar with applicable rules, regulations and norms as they apply to acquisitions (i.e., independent contractor status classifications, internal controls and fraud prevention, etc.)
* Knowledge of a category industry is a plus
* Experience working with an ERP system (SAP MM, SRM are desirable, but familiarity with other systems is also a plus)
* Ability to manage projects, prioritize and delegate work

**Skills and Attributes**

* Self-starter capable of working independently, managing deadlines and competing workloads, making informed decisions and seeking advice/decisions from others when needed
* Diplomatic, collaborative relationship builder
* Strong organizational, problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Experience working with data (analysis, clean-up, presentation)

The salary range for this position is $60,000 USD to $70,000 USD annually.This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.This role is eligible to participate in EPRI’s annual incentive program. The amount of incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the pl

* Monitor changes in industry standards, market availability, and catalog content that may impact material specifications or catalog accuracy.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We offer a competitive salary for this role, with an expected range of $83,000 - $105,000. The final offer will depend on your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. General Dynamics – Bath Iron Works also provides a variety of benefits including medical & dental insurance coverage, 401(k) retirement savings plan, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, life and disability insurance, company paid holidays, paid time off (PTO), health coaching, athletic trainers, employee assistance programs and onsite health services.

This position is responsible for supporting the sourcing, acquisition, and administration of very complex, high dollar equipment as a member of BIW’s Supply Chain Subcontracts team. This position is built for highly motivated individuals who have an eagerness to learn and the ability to rapidly and accurately perform supply chain tasks for a variety of contract types. Activities include issuing RFPs, evaluating proposals, performing price analyses and negotiating, managing suppliers and often expediting material deliveries, and resolving receiving and/or invoice issues. This role requires completion of appropriate documentation for compliance with federal contract regulations (FAR, DFARS) and to align with departmental and company procedures.

Operating under the BIW Business Operating System (BOS), the Subcontracts Specialist ensures compliance with safety, quality, and performance standards while maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

Safety Leadership:

* Actively participate in safety initiatives and lead by example.
* Prioritize safety, fostering a positive safety culture

Project Execution:

* Negotiate pricing and terms to reduce total costs and liability exposure consistent with company policies.
* Prepare standard contract documentation (e.g., casefile memo, price analysis, negotiation plan and results) i/a/w departmental procedures.
* Review supplier proposals and other documents for compliance with federal contract regulations (FAR, DFARS) and to align with departmental and company procedures.
* Develop/compile solicitation documents, including market research, proposal evaluation, source selection, and negotiations.

Training and Development:

* Be a continuous and active learner.
* Work to enhance current skills and take initiative to prepare yourself for future roles and career growth.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

* Assist and participate in cross departmental communications and information sharing to support organizational alignment.
* Create strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement:

* Monitor and assess supplier performance and initiate corrective action when supplier performance does not meet contractual obligations or company expectations.
* Evaluate effectiveness of existing department strategies and make recommendations for improvement as needed.

**Required/Preferred Education/Training**
-----------------------------------------

* 6-8 years' experience with BS / BA Degree preferably in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related degree preferred and comparable work experience.
* 4 years' experience with MBA or Certification, or direct work experience in Procurement or Strategic Sourcing.

**Required/Preferred Experience**
---------------------------------

* Ability to develop a command of complex contract terms in a short amount of time.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate technical decisions/strategies into business terms and implications. Ability to produce clear documentation geared to varied audiences.
* Ability to manage a high volume of work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven work environment.
* Solid project management and organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects.
* Positive and energetic with strong cross-functional team experience.
* Strong analytical problem-solving aptitude and financial acumen, including the ability to discuss and monitor associated budgets and expenditures.
* An excellent sense of humor and a high tolerance for uncertainty in the midst of shifting priorities.

* New River Community College

**Title:** Procurement and Asset Specialist

**Agency:** New River Community College

**Location:** Pulaski - 155

**FLSA:** Nonexempt

**Hiring Range:** $38,000 – 45,000

**Full Time or Part Time:** Full Time

Additional Detail

**Job Description:**

New River Community College is a two-year public institution of higher education operating under a state-wide system of 23 community colleges. The college is located on a one-hundred plus acre site at the intersection of U.S. Routes 11 and 100 in Dublin, Virginia with an instructional site in Christiansburg. The campus provides modern, well-equipped facilities for the career technical education programs as well as for the college transfer programs. Approximately 4,000 students comprise the student body.

The people employed by New River Community College embrace the philosophy that all individuals should have an opportunity to develop and extend their skills and knowledge to increase awareness of their roles and duties as citizens. The college serves the educational needs of the public and assumes a duty to help provide the requirements for trained workers in the region through a combined effort with local industry, business, professions, and government. The college promotes equal opportunity for prospective students and employees.

**Duties:**

Support employees in procuring goods and services for departments, prioritizing cost-effectiveness. Ensure negotiation for and compliance with college-wide contracts. Maintain partnerships with suppliers to ensure timely delivery and high-quality products. Maintain accurate records of all assets owned by the college, including their location, condition and value. Conduct an annual physical inventory to rectify any discrepancies. Provide training to employees on eVA and procurement card procedures. Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience with procurement processes, including obtaining quotes, working with vendors, processing purchases, and supporting contract administration.
* Demonstrated ability to use Microsoft Excel to enter, organize, track, and maintain accurate data and records.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a strong sense of accountability and attention to detail.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to interpret and follow established policies, procedures, and applicable regulations related to procurement, purchasing, and asset accountability.

**Additional Considerations:**

* Familiarity with data entry and inventory processes, including asset recognition, identification, tracking, and maintaining accurate records.
* Prior work experience involving familiarity with Virginia State procurement regulations, eVA, PeopleSoft and/or comparable systems.

**Position Role Type:**

Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Secret - Current

Active and existing security clearance required on day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Principal Supplier Assurance Specialist is a hands‑on contributor responsible for supporting end‑to‑end ownership of supplier manufacturing output and strengthening supplier performance through structured diagnostics, readiness assessments, and targeted corrective actions. This role focuses on manufacturing and quality issue identification, verifying process capability, supporting recovery activities, and reinforcing supplier process discipline. The position requires regular onsite presence at supplier facilities to perform assessments, validate processes, and help drive a performance‑oriented culture.

Supporting our international supply base requires Suppliers Assurance Team to demonstrate significant flexibility and adaptability. They are expected to adapt to unexpected changes in demand and shifting priorities, adjusting their areas of responsibility accordingly. This position involves support of suppliers outside the United States in the Arctic region (North America, South America, UK, Denmark, and Scandinavian region).

**What You Will Do**

* Support end‑to‑end evaluation of supplier manufacturing performance through onsite diagnostics of processes, equipment, tooling, flow, and quality systems.
* Execute readiness and capability assessments including FAI reviews, PFMEA audits, SPC capability checks, cycle‑time validation, bottleneck analysis, and Run‑at‑Rate support.
* Conduct technical troubleshooting to identify root causes of quality escapes, yield issues, and production instability.
* Maintain supplier readiness documentation, capability data, RCCA evidence, and capacity models.
* Assist with corrective and preventive action execution using structured problem‑solving tools such as 8D, 5‑Why, and fishbone analysis.
* Provide targeted coaching to supplier operators, technicians, and quality personnel to reinforce process discipline, standard work, and basic problem‑solving expectations.
* Participate in program and operations reviews by providing clear updates on yield, stability, bottlenecks, and schedule risk.
* Support the development of early performance plans and help suppliers adopt improved work practices and basic performance culture behaviors.
* Escalate technical issues, capacity constraints, and quality risks, integrating both
* operational and basic financial indicators (scrap trends, labor efficiency, overtime signals).
* Understand and follow all EXIM requirements by Command Media.
* Ability to travel 50 - 60% of time to supplier locations, as needed.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum five (5) years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum three (3) years' experience.
* Experience with either manufacturing engineering, supplier quality, or a related technical role.
* Experience working with PFMEA, SPC, capability analysis (Cpk/Ppk), GD&T, AS9100/ISO9001, FAI processes, APQP, statistical analysis, and or conduct source on Raytheon hardware at the supplier.
* U.S. Citizen - Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other precision manufacturing environments.
* Hands‑on experience with tooling assessments, gage R&R, or control‑plan auditing.
* Exposure to capacity analysis, OEE evaluation, or bottleneck mapping.
* Lean/Six Sigma training or certification (White/Yellow/Green Belt).
* Experience coaching entry‑level supplier engine

description:
**Purchasing Specialist**
=========================

**Industry:** Commercial Services | Doors, Gates, Access Control & Field Services
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented **Purchasing Specialist** to support our growing commercial service operations. This individual will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and coordinating the delivery of materials, equipment, parts, and supplies necessary to support installation, maintenance, repair, and service projects.

The ideal candidate will have purchasing or procurement experience within a **commercial service-based industry**, such as commercial doors, automatic gates, access control, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, construction, or other skilled trades.

Experience with **ServiceTitan or similar field service management software** is highly preferred. This position requires someone who can work effectively with service technicians, project managers, dispatchers, and vendors to ensure materials are available when needed while maintaining cost efficiency and accurate inventory records.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Purchasing & Procurement**

**Job Summary**

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer supports nursery operations by monitoring stock levels, sourcing plant material, and ordering replenishments for assigned departments. This role works closely with vendors, receiving staff, and internal teams to ensure plant material and related inventory are available to meet operational and sales needs while avoiding shortages, overstocks, or inactive inventory.

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer manages purchase orders, coordinates deliveries, resolves vendor issues, and maintains accurate vendor and inventory records. This role balances daily operational needs with efficient purchasing practices to support consistent product availability across the nursery.

**Essential Functions**

* Research and source plant material for special orders requested by the Sales Team.
* Maintain positive and effective relationships with plant vendors and suppliers.
* Maintain and update vendor information in company systems.
* Create and process purchase orders for plant material and related items.
* Verify receipt of purchased materials and work with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, shortages, or damages.
* Negotiate with vendors to obtain competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.
* Ensure purchase documentation and approvals are completed so vendor payments can be processed in a timely manner.
* Serve as a liaison between internal departments and vendors to coordinate purchasing and delivery needs.
* Work with vendors to schedule or expedite deliveries and resolve delivery issues such as shortages, late deliveries, or missed shipments.
* Coordinate logistics to ensure plant material arrives at the appropriate nursery location in a timely manner.
* Monitor changes in plant availability, vendor pricing, and purchasing terms.
* Participate in pricing updates, inventory projects, and other operational initiatives as needed.
* Support administrative tasks related to purchasing, inventory, and vendor coordination.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Assist with inventory-related projects and operational initiatives as needed.
* Support cross-departmental coordination related to purchasing and stocking activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Other Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience working in a nursery, horticulture, or related industry.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple purchasing and inventory activities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Associate degree (AA) or higher.
* Experience creating purchase orders within inventory or ERP systems.
* Familiarity with plant sourcing and vendor coordination within nursery operations.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This is an in-office position located at the nursery site. Remote work is not available except for short-term situations approved in advance by upper management.

The role requires regular movement between office and nursery yard environments.

Physical requirements include:

* Remaining in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for extended periods.
* Frequent typing and use of computer systems including data entry and 10-key functions.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, and operating office equipment.
* Gross grasping and manual handling of documents or office materials.
* Occasional walking through outdoor nursery areas which may involve uneven ground surfaces and exposure to varying weather conditions.
* Lifting up to 20 lbs. approximately 20% of the time.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

description:
**Nature of Work**
------------------

**\\*\\*Disclaimer-this position will be considered classified-exempt and “at will.”**

This position will report to the Ohio County Maintenance Headquarters and the Wetzel County Maintenance Headquarters. The Transportation County Supply Specialist performs duties in ordering, receiving, recording, storing materials and equipment. Locates and orders supplies and equipment as requested. Files, updates, and retrieves invoices, receipts, requisitions, transfers, and other information. Issues materials and/or equipment as needed. Responsible for making purchases using the State P-Card. Checks purchase orders for accuracy, completeness, and clarity. Performs analysis of computer inventory printouts with receipts, reports, and files. The work involves a certain degree of physical exertion. This could include long periods of walking or standing, recurring bending, crouching, stooping, stretching, reaching, or similar activities. Position could be required to lift up to 50 lbs. Performs related duties as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

**\\*\\*Preference may be given to Candidates with these qualifications\\*\\***

TRAINING/EDUCATION

High school diploma or the equivalent.

EXPERIENCE

* Four (4) years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid experience in a clerical capacity in connection with storeroom or warehouse operations, such as a stock clerk, inventory work, or handling materials; and/or experience in business operations such as bookkeeping, accounting, timekeeping, and purchasing.
* Substitution: Successful completion of coursework from a regionally accredited college or university, related business school, or vocational training may be substituted for four (4) years of the required experience through an established formula.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT

Travel may be required; therefore, a valid driver’s license is required.

PROMOTIONAL ONLY

Four (4) years as an hourly transportation worker with the Division of Highways.

**Other Information**
---------------------

* Candidate Contact Name: Sherry D Wade
* Phone Number: 304-221-2089
* Email Address: sherry.d.wade@wv.gov

description:
**Company Overview**

Specified Technologies Inc. (STI) is an industry leader in the development of firestopping systems, smoke and sound control products, and innovative construction solutions. For over 36 years, STI has partnered with contractors, engineers, and building owners to provide tested, trusted, and code‑compliant solutions worldwide.

Headquartered in Somerville, New Jersey, the company has grown to serve multiple markets and geographies and remains committed to innovation, safety, and performance in passive fire protection.

**Role Description**

We’re seeking an experienced **Procurement Specialist**. The ideal candidate will maximize ERP/MRP utilization (specifically within Acumatica or SAP), build strong vendor relationships, mitigate supply chain risks, streamline inventory and operational workflows, and establish a best-in-class supplier relationship management program.

This is a **hybrid** role based out of our Corporate Headquarters in **Somerville, New Jersey** with an expectation of **three days per week in the office.**

**Key areas of experience**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration (Manufacturing, NPI & Planning)
* Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
* Systems & Operational Integration
* Contract Negotiation & Supplier Management
* Supplier Performance Control
* Financial & Budgetary Oversight
* Leadership & Team Development
* Ability to meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs & Metrics)
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required or assigned.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).

**Experience**

* 5-10+ years of progressive procurement/sourcing experience in manufacturing environments, specializing in Chemical procurement.

**Skills**

* Proven track record supporting NPI processes, bill of materials (BOM) sourcing, and material planning integration.
* Hands-on experience with modern ERP systems (direct experience with Acumatica MRP/WMS is highly desirable).
* Strong contract negotiation, supplier performance management, financial acumen, and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Certifications (Preferred): CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management), CSCP (APICS/ASCM), or Lean Six Sigma certification

**Why You’ll Love Working Here (Benefits & Perks)**

At Specified Technologies Inc. (STI), you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, integrity, and individual growth. We’re committed to supporting your well-being, work-life balance, and financial future through a comprehensive benefits package, including:

**Healthcare Coverage** – Medical insurance options, plus dental and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy

**401(k) Retirement Plan** – Build your financial future with employer contributions

**Company-Paid Life Insurance** – Added peace of mind for you and your loved ones

**Generous Paid Time Off** – Company-paid holidays, vacation, floating, and sick time to support work-life balance

**Collaborative Team Environment** – Work with people who support you, value your contributions, and want to see you succeed

**Compensation** - **$90,000 - $115,000**

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Please note: This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or H-1B transfer. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and not require sponsorship now or in the future.

and inventory records, processing inventory submissions, assisting Staff with quotes and purchasing needs, monitoring

stock and pricing fluctuations, and ensuring timely, organized, and compliant procurement activities.

* Minimum: High School Diploma or Equivalency
* Valid Florida Driver's License
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Basic knowledge of general office equipment

* Maintain vendor records, insurance certificates, catalogs, and supplier performance data.
* Source and evaluate vendors, obtain quotes, and support purchasing decisions.
* Enter and process requisitions, procurement forms, and inventory submissions.
* Monitor stock levels, pricing, and reorder points; research pricing and bulk purchase options.
* Review purchase orders, confirm vendor receipt, and support PO processing as needed.
* Manage issued property records and coordinate returns or transfers for Staff members.
* Update inventory‑related spreadsheets and run reports as requested.
* Maintain accurate files in agency systems and support annual inventory activities.
* Handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and apply procurement best practices while adhering to Agency

policies and confidentiality requirements.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Adhere to laws/agency policy/rules/ regulations/SOP/ procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality/security of files and information obtained in the course of employment.

with lawful requirements.

co-workers.

description:
The Specialist, Procurement is responsible for executing procurement activities in support of defense and aerospace programs, including the acquisition of raw materials, components, assemblies, equipment, and services necessary to meet program, production, and customer requirements. This role applies professional procurement knowledge to support supplier selection, pricing analysis, purchase order administration, and supplier performance management while ensuring alignment with quality, cost, delivery, and compliance objectives. The position works under general supervision and contributes to operational and program success through effective sourcing, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team supporting complex programs in a highly regulated environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plans and executes procurement activities for raw materials, components, equipment, and services in support of defense and aerospace program requirements.
* Solicits, reviews, and analyzes supplier quotations, proposals, and bids to support sourcing decisions and cost objectives.
* Negotiates pricing, terms and conditions, and delivery commitments in accordance with company policies and program requirements.
* Issues and administers purchase orders through completion, including management of acknowledgements, deliveries, invoice discrepancies, and order closeout.
* Evaluates supplier capability, performance, and risk related to quality, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinates with internal stakeholders including engineering, manufacturing, quality, program management, and finance to ensure procurement actions support technical and contractual requirements.
* Resolves supplier-related issues involving shortages, damages, returns, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering or configuration changes.
* Maintains accurate procurement records and supports audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and reporting requirements.
* Reviews market conditions, supplier trends, and pricing data to recommend sourcing strategies and process improvements.
* Ensures procurement activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual requirements, anti-corruption standards, and ethical business practices.
* May provide guidance, coaching, or day-to-day support to less experienced employees within the job area
* Travel up to 20% may be required.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant procurement experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related procurement experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related procurement experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) requirements.
* Experience procuring electronic components, mechanical parts, complex assemblies, or specialized services.
* Familiarity with supplier performance management, cost analysis, and schedule risk mitigation.
* Experience supporting engineering change activity, configuration changes, and material returns.
* Working knowledge of export compliance considerations, including International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
* Experience using material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning tools in a production or program environment.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $79,000.00 - $147,000.00. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $69,500.00 - $128,500.00 This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

description:
Are you the detail-obsessed problem solver who catches the pricing error before it costs a dime and keeps every order on track from PO to warehouse? Do you believe a great bid starts with accurate takeoffs and clean data? ACS is looking for an organized, analytical Procurement Specialist to own material purchasing, bid estimating, and pricing accuracy for our Commercial division: protecting margin and keeping our projects moving.

Welcome to ACS: Commercial & Residential Flooring Specialists, where innovation meets a values-driven culture.

At ACS, we’re more than a flooring company. We’re a growing, collaborative community grounded in four core values: Say Yes, Own It, Do What You Say, and We Care. These principles shape how we work, solve problems, and support each other every day.

As the Procurement Specialist, you will own material ordering and tracking for ACS Commercial, working alongside the Project Coordinator to get material where it needs to be, when it needs to be there. You will build large and complex bid quotes, source product and vendor pricing for the sales team, audit cost and freight, and serve as the owner of our product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates.

Your work will directly impact margin, quote accuracy, and on-time material delivery; turning vendor pricing and project plans into bids that win and orders that arrive right the first time.

**Your objectives may be similar to:**

* Owning material ordering and tracking for sold jobs, ensuring every PO is accurate and every order is confirmed at the warehouse.
* Building accurate, competitive bid quotes and sourcing product and vendor pricing for commercial, multifamily, and property management projects.
* Protecting margin through disciplined cost, invoice, and freight auditing.
* Owning the product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates so the sales team can quote quickly and accurately.

**Essential Functions**

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

**Ordering & Material Tracking**

* Place material orders for sold jobs and confirm PO accuracy against the quote.
* Track every open order until material is confirmed at the servicing warehouse, working alongside the Project Coordinator.
* Flag delays, backorders, shortages, and substitutions to sales and the Project Coordinator the same day.

**Bid Estimating & Product Sourcing**

* Build large and complex bid quotes for property management, multifamily, and commercial projects.
* Source products and obtain vendor pricing for the sales team’s bid work, including special-order and non-catalog items.
* Read plans and measures to produce accurate takeoffs, scope, and material quantities.
* Review quotes built by sales and field teams for accuracy and margin before they go out.

**Cost & Freight Audit**

* Audit vendor invoices, material cost, and freight against quotes and POs.
* Identify overcharges, billing errors, and margin leaks, and work with vendors to resolve them.
* Report monthly on cost, freight, and margin trends to the VP of Sales and National Accounts.

**Product Library, Pricing & Templates**

* Lead the initial cleanup of the product library to align with the turnkey catalog, and finalize turnkey pricing in partnership with Finance and the VP.
* Build quote templates that enable sales reps and Field Support Managers to quote quickly and accurately.
* Build and maintain property key guides outlining approved products, specs, and pricing by property for managed accounts.
* Maintain pricing on an ongoing basis, updating for changes in vendor cost, SKUs, or freight, and retiring discontinued SKUs.

**To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in flooring, construction, or building-materials estimating, pricing, or purchasing.
* Ability to read plans and measures and produce accurate takeoffs.
* Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and maintaining clean price files.
* Experience with CRM or database systems such as QuickBase, vendor portals, and Outlook, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage many open orders, bids, and price changes at once and catch errors in quantities, SKUs, pricing, and freight before they cost money.
* Demonstrated ability to build and follow processes, including checklists, trackers, file structures, and standard steps that make work repeatable.
* Clear communicator with vendors, sales, and finance.
* Flooring product knowledge (LVP, hardwood, carpet, underlayment, transitions, prep) preferred.
* Experience with multifamily, property management, or commercial bids preferred.
* Experience with Home Depot Pro or a retail-installed program preferred.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Vacation (Planned Time Off)
* Sick/Personal (Unplanned Time Off)
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Health

+ Associate degree in business, accounting, finance, supply chain management, public administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience.

Job Title: Procurement SpecialistJob Role in TOPS: Procurement Specialist
How you will contribute

* Maintain thorough knowledge of launch categories assigned and functions as a

strong resource for internal customers.

* Support and enable regional strategies for specific categories where applicable,

participate and lead cross functional teams as appropriate to bring continuous
improvements to projects.

* Support annual cost reduction strategies, including but not limited to: negotiate

pricing ensuring the lowest price up-front, source new business per the regional
category strategy, identify potential category and/or supplier opportunity areas
(e.g. standardization, supplier consolidation, etc.), communicate potential
opportunities internally, and initiate activities to assemble appropriate resources
to pursue opportunity areas.

* Work on ERP utilization in the purchasing function, create and maintain all

material documents, info records, purchasing contracts and lease agreements in
ERP or risk database, and utilize ERP reports to track costs and monitor spending.

* Train and support Plant Lead Requisitioners on all purchasing processes,

procedures, and SAP in regard to all required transactions and reports.

* Perform site meetings that are assigned corporate procurement responsibilities

in coordination with site procurement, site controller and site manager.

* Travel to sites with concern status with regards to a purchasing related

issue/opportunity and/or the purchasing processes and resolve/stabilize.

* Lead on Non Compliance Research and Resolution
* Participation in Launch

**About the Role**
------------------

**How you will contribute**

* Purchase indirect materials and services, capital equipment, packaging, MRO, and other categories of items as assigned, ensuring lowest total cost is achieved.
* Maintain thorough knowledge of categories assigned, functions as an expert for internal customers.
* Support and enable regional strategies for specific categories where applicable, participate and lead cross functional teams as appropriate to bring continuous improvements to projects.
* Support annual cost reduction strategies, including but not limited to: negotiate pricing ensuring the lowest price up-front, source new business per the regional category strategy, identify potential category and/or supplier opportunity areas (e.g. standardization, supplier consolidation, etc.), communicate potential opportunities internally, and initiate activities to assemble appropriate resources to pursue opportunity areas.
* Work on ERP utilization in the purchasing function, create and maintain all material documents, info records, purchasing contracts and lease agreements in ERP or risk database, and utilize ERP reports to track costs and monitor spending.
* Train and support Plant Lead Requisitioners on all purchasing processes, procedures, and on SAP in regards to all required transactions and reports.
* Perform purchasing audits at plants to insure Plant Lead Requisitioners are following all processes and procedures.
* Travel to new business launch sites when required to support purchasing processes/functions until permanent position is filled, trained and functioning.
* Travel to sites with concern status with regards to a purchasing related issue/opportunity and/or the purchasing processes and resolve/stabilize.
* Other duties as assigned

**Your Key Qualifications**

* Bachelors Degree in Business, Supply Chain or similar field of study
* Knowledge of program and project management, experience within automotive or technology industries is desirable. Experience within SAP is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate as an agent on the company’s behalf, ensuring the company is represented in the best possible way.
* Ability to work well in cross-functional teams that include internal and external customers, and suppliers.
* Firm understanding of the Procure to Pay process, request for quotation (RFQ) process, as well as cost reduction and supply base rationalization.
* Able to complete strategic actions and initiatives in a timely manner while adhering to project budgets.
* Ability to travel to sites for startup initiatives and to train and work with site purchasing professionals.

**Compensation**

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

#### **What you'll do**

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Supplier Readiness & Development

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert in supplier readiness and industrialization, leading assessments of suppliers' manufacturing capabilities, tooling readiness, process maturity, and operational preparedness to support successful program launches.
* Drive supplier development initiatives across multiple programs, identifying opportunities to improve production readiness, manufacturing performance, and long-term scalability.

Program Launch & Readiness Leadership

* Lead complex supplier readiness activities from pre-production through mass production, ensuring alignment with key program milestones, launch timing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Evaluate supplier readiness risks and influence action plans to support successful vehicle launches and program execution.

Advanced Risk Management

* Identify and assess supplier, manufacturing, and supply chain risks through data analysis, supplier evaluations, and readiness reviews.
* Develop and drive mitigation strategies to address capacity constraints, quality concerns, operational challenges, logistics disruptions, and supply continuity risks.

Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Lead cross-functional supplier performance reviews focused on cost, quality, delivery, capacity, and operational excellence.
* Apply APQP, PPAP, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement methodologies to improve supplier performance and manufacturing readiness.
* Conduct advanced supplier assessments and audits to evaluate compliance with quality requirements, launch readiness expectations, and industry standards.

Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration

* Serve as a trusted advisor to Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Program Management teams on supplier readiness, launch risk, and manufacturing capability topics.
* Influence cross-functional decisions through deep expertise in supplier development, manufacturing operations, industrialization, and production readiness.
* Support resolution of complex supplier-related issues, including production constraints, launch challenges, quality concerns, and supply shortages.

Reporting & Analytics

* Develop and communicate supplier readiness metrics, performance trends, and risk assessments to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Utilize data-driven analysis to identify improvement opportunities and recommend actions that enhance supplier performance and launch readiness.

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

* This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC or Novi, Michigan**.
* This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
* Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.
* **Travel**: Domestic and international travel required, approximately **80**% of the time. Valid driver's license required. Passport required.

description:
We are seeking a Purchasing & Supply Chain Specialist to strengthen Purchasing capacity while working within established departmental responsibilities and management direction. This role supports REI's supply chain activities through supplier sourcing, purchasing coordination, inventory and material availability review, ERP data accuracy, and cross-functional support.

**Essential Functions:** include the following.

* Research and compares suppliers, goods, and services based on cost, quality, availability, reliability, and lead time
* Supports supplier sourcing, quotation analysis, supplier selection, and purchasing activities within established purchasing processes
* Assists with supplier pricing, terms, delivery commitments, returns/RMAs, and other supplier issues as assigned
* Identifies opportunities for cost savings, improved lead times, and more efficient purchasing practices

**Job Functions:** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Builds and maintains positive, professional supplier relationships
* Monitors assigned supplier performance and communicates material delivery, quality, or service concerns to appropriate stakeholders
* Coordinates with Purchasing, Production, Shipping/Receiving, Sales, and other departments to review material availability, inventory information, and purchasing needs. Provides information and support without assuming ownership of production scheduling or other departmental responsibilities
* Reviews and maintains applicable purchasing and supply-chain data within the ERP system, including supplier information, lead times, purchasing parameters, and other assigned data; supports data accuracy and cleanup efforts
* Prepares and maintains purchase orders, verifies specifications and pricing, and provides supporting information to Accounting and other departments as needed
* Tracks purchase deliveries and communicate supplier status, expected delivery dates, shortages, or other material-related issues to relevant stakeholders
* Supports purchasing and supply-chain process improvement, documentation, reporting, and special projects, including ERP-related initiatives, as assigned
* Responsible for seasonal reviews and forecasting beyond standard review
* Assists with development of an internal process for tracking actual customer business compared to customer projections
* Assists with development of an internal system for tracking purchase requests and results

**Supervisory Responsibility**
This position does not have supervisory responsibility.

**Required Education and Experience** to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required.

* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, procurement, or a related field highly preferred
* 3-5 years' experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory, or a related manufacturing/operations role
* Proficiency with ERP and inventory management systems; experience maintaining accurate purchasing, supplier, inventory, or material data
* Must possess excellent communication (both verbal and written), supplier-relations, and problem-solving skills
* Strong organization, documentation, and cross-functional coordination skills

description:
**QUOTING WAREHOUSE SPECIALIST**

**Are you organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy helping people find the right solution?**

We're looking for aQuoting Warehouse Specialistto join our team.

In this role, you'll support our sales and warehouse operations by preparing quotes, sourcing products, checking inventory, and helping move orders from quote to completion. You'll work closely with customers, vendors, sales, purchasing, and warehouse teams to provide an outstanding experience.

If you enjoy problem-solving, variety in your workday, and being part of a team that makes a difference, we'd love to meet you.

**WHAT WILL YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE?**

* Prepare accurate and timely customer quotes.
* Research products, pricing, lead times, and availability.
* Work with vendors and suppliers to obtain product information and pricing.
* Calculate costs, freight, discounts, and margins.
* Enter quotes and orders into the ERP system.
* Follow up on open quotes and support order conversion.
* Answer customer and team questions regarding products, pricing, inventory, and delivery.
* Coordinate with sales, purchasing, customer service, and warehouse teams.
* Maintain accurate customer, product, and pricing information.
* Recommend alternative products or cost-saving solutions when needed.
* Assist with inventory, pricing, and shipping inquiries.
* Deliver friendly and professional customer service.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIO**NS

* High school diploma or GED.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
* Basic math and computer skills.
* Ability to learn ERP and inventory management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid state-issued Real ID driver's license.
* Ability to perform warehouse duties, including lifting, bending, reaching, climbing, and standing for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 70 lbs.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Warehouse, inventory, logistics, parts, or purchasing operations.
* HVAC/R, mechanical service, or commercial equipment industries.
* Quoting or estimating.
* Customer service.
* Inside sales or sales support.
* Inventory management.
* ERP or inventory software systems.

*We're willing to train the right candidate with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn.*

**WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?**

We believe great people build great teams. This position offers an opportunity to learn our products and processes, develop valuable skills, and work alongside experienced professionals across multiple departments.

You'll gain hands-on experience in quoting, customer service, sales support, purchasing, and warehouse operations while making a meaningful contribution to the success of the team.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, enjoys continuous learning, and wants to grow with us.

If you're looking for a role where every day is different and your contributions matter, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

**About Smart Care**

Smart Care is a national repair and service provider for commercial foodservice, refrigeration, and cold storage equipment. Our offering of comprehensive mechanical services includes hot side cooking equipment, stand-alone refrigeration, specialty coffee and beverage, complex rack refrigeration and HVAC.

Smart Care is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected class status. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need a reasonable accommodation with respect to Smart Care’s application or hiring process due to a disability, please contact the Human Resources department at HR@smartcaresolutions.com.

USMCA & Trade Compliance Specialist (Freight Forwarding)

**Entry Level**

**Department:** Procurement / Trade Compliance

**Reports To:** Procurement Manager

**Level:** Entry Level

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Works across Procurement, Logistics/Supply Chain, and Finance/Accounting departments

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The USMCA & Freight Forwarding Specialist supports trade compliance and logistics coordination for imported and exported goods. This entry-level role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants to build expertise in international trade, customs compliance, and supply chain finance. The specialist will receive training and guidance while taking on real responsibility for SAP financial entries, carrier coordination, and export documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Financial & SAP Duties***

* Create and post ledger vouchers in SAP for customs entry payments (duties, taxes, broker fees)
* Reconcile entry payment records against carrier/broker invoices, with guidance from senior staff as needed
* Maintain accurate documentation for audit and compliance purposes

***Carrier & Logistics Coordination***

* Request and review quotes from carriers for freight and logistics services
* Assist in coordinating shipment scheduling and tracking for imported and exported goods
* Communicate with carriers, customs brokers, and internal teams to help resolve shipping issues

***Trade Documentation & Compliance***

* Prepare Commercial Invoices for exported goods
* Prepare and issue Certificates of Origin (USMCA) for qualifying exports
* Learn and apply USMCA rules of origin and customs documentation standards
* Support recordkeeping for import/export compliance

***Cross-Departmental Collaboration***

* Coordinate with Procurement on purchase orders and import-related needs
* Partner with Logistics/Operations on shipment timing and delivery requirements
* Work with Finance/Accounting on payment processing and cost allocation

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Logistics, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 0–1 years of professional experience; internships or coursework in trade, logistics, or finance a plus
* Basic understanding of import/export concepts (training provided)
* Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems preferred, not required
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Comfortable managing communication across multiple departments and external vendors
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook

**Preferred (Not Required)**
----------------------------

* Coursework or exposure to USMCA/NAFTA trade regulations
* Internship experience in freight forwarding, customs brokerage, or procurement

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Structured on-the-job training in trade compliance and logistics
* Mentorship from Procurement Manager and cross-functional teams
* Career growth path toward Trade Compliance Analyst or Logistics Coordinator roles
