**Job Requirements**

**Job Summary**

The Pharmacy Purchasing Specialist is responsible for procuring medications and pharmacy supplies by managing inventory levels, identifying and addressing medication recalls, placing purchase orders, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining compliance with all relevant regulations, while optimizing cost-effectiveness and minimizing waste within a pharmacy setting; carries out rules and regulations pertaining to the professional policies of the department and ensures compliance with state and federal regulations.

Specific responsibilities will be documented and retained internally by the Department of Pharmacy.

**Primary Responsibilities**

*The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job responsibilities performed.*

* Assesses medication levels and supplies, procures medications from approved vendors, verifies accuracy of shipments and processes payments. Contacts the appropriate party to review discrepancies and initiate resolution.
* Identifies medication shortages and provides prompt alternatives and communication in collaboration with the pharmacist to ensure minimal disruption in patient care.
* Manages medication recalls, expirations and properly rectifies issues. Communicates with the proper individual as appropriate.
* Uses general knowledge of medical informatics including order‐entry systems, automated dispensing devices, bar‐code packaging devices, bar‐code medication administration (BCMA) systems, clinical integrated systems and system/application maintenance in the performance of daily duties; is engaged in ensuring regulatory compliance related to purchasing and procurement.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**﻿Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Prioritizes work responsibilities and manages multiple demands.
* Demonstrates an awareness of self-responsibility and accountability for own professional practice.
* Adheres to all best practice standards and guidelines within scope of professional practice and follows all hospital policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Maintains competency in work- and pharmacy-related technology and applications and supports orientation and/or training of team members when appropriate.
* Seeks validation of knowledge base, skill level, and decision making as necessary and assertively seeks guidance in areas of question.
* Practices effective problem identification and resolution skills as a method of sound decision making. Accepts change as a part of the problem-solving process.
* Demonstrates effective communication methods and skills, using lines of authority appropriately.
* Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, current literature, workshops, in-service meetings, etc.
* Identifies the extent of the health system’s adherence to best practices and guidelines relevant to medication management.
* Attends hospital and departmental meetings as required.
* Utilizes appropriate customer relations skills when interacting with patients, their families, visitors, team members, and others, to ensure all customers are treated with respect and dignity.
* Represents the department on hospital committees, professional associates, and community organizations where appropriate.
* Participates in the development of policies, procedures, and guidelines pertaining to medication use and management.
* Maintains knowledgeability of the daily operations of UMMS, including the Pharmacy Department, through active engagement and awareness of departmental communications via mailbox, bulletin boards, and/or email.
* ﻿Maintains knowledgeability of the mission, vision, and values of UMMS.

**Work Experience**

**Education & Experience - Required**

* High School Graduate or equivalent.
* 2 years of purchasing experience.
* Maryland Technician Registration.

**Education & Experience - Preferred**

* Some college.
* Hospital experience.
* National Certification (CPhT).

description:
At UPMC, we’re all here for the same reason — to make Life Changing Medicine happen. Join our team and you will play a unique and important role in our mission to change healthcare for the better.

Why Join UPMC?

We don’t just take care of patients — we take care of our team, too. And we have the data to prove it. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from an industry leader you can expect:

* **AWARD-WINNING WORKPLACE:** Ranked #1 for Best Places to Work for Women & Diverse Managers by Diversity MBA
* A recent study showed that UPMC benefits are 20% higher in value than other healthcare providers in our market.
* Competitive pay
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities to grow in your career at UPMC

**UPMC is looking for a full-time Procure to Pay Specialist.**

**This position works standard daylight hours with no weekends required. This is a hybrid role with some remote flexibility.**

**Purpose:**
Corporate Supply Chain Management Procure to Pay provides services to all integrated facilities and supports the following purchase to pay functions: Purchasing/eProcurement, invoice management and invoice exception resolution, return product and credit memo validation, vendor and end user inquiries, and provides direction on the appropriate Procure to Pay pathways. The Procure to Pay Specialist position works under the direction of Supply Chain Management and supports the procurement or accounts payable pillars of Procure to Pay. The Procure to Pay Specialist is responsible for managing supplier documents as they move through defined Procure to Pay automation processes. The individual will support and assist with development of Supply Chain initiatives that reduce operational cost and improve service levels. They will focus on the remediation of operational procure to pay process gaps by assisting in determining root cause and solutions. The Procure to Pay Specialist must collaborate effectively while managing multiple tasks, tight deadlines, and high-pressure situations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Place purchase orders (PO) with approved suppliers, ensuring that all documentation is in order, terms and conditions are clear, line-item details are accurate, and pricing is aligned with client contracts or supplier quotation.
* Purchase power and final decision-making authority for purchases up to the client defined limit ($10,000 for UPMC).
* Perform purchase order confirmation activities for each order dispatched, which includes the review and action of all electronic order exceptions and unconfirmed electronic orders using the clients exchange or designated solution.
* Perform timely purchase order changes to ensure accuracy prior to receiving and/or invoice processing and provide timely notification to requestors of order delays or cancellations.
* Review and resolve invoice and credit memo exceptions according to client defined policies and procedures.
* Reconcile and support the resolution of transactions appearing on vendor statements/statement of account.
* Review and resolve invoices received with invalid or no PO number with an applied focus on root cause resolution and compliance to UPMC’s NO PO, NO PAY Policy.
* Process residual invoices and voucher corrections according to standard operating procedures.
* Support Procure to Pay Analysts in determining the cause and resolution of PO and invoice exceptions.
* Participate on cross functional teams (internal and external) to support business objectives and ensure delivery against department goals and objectives.
* Collaborate and communicate in an effective, professional manner with management, peers, general staff, physicians, and all personnel.
* Respect and maintain the confidentiality of all patients, physician, and hospital related information.
* Performs in accordance with system-wide competencies/behaviors.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management or related field required.
* Or Equivalent education and experience.

**Licensure, Certifications, and Clearances:**
* Act 34

**UPMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veteran**

* Ensures that appropriate documentation is provided to logistics/transportation & warehouse organization so that proper receipt is recorded
* Negotiates and coordinates additions, deletions, or modifications to subcontracts

* Manages performance of subcontracts, ensures compliance with all public law requirements as well as company (and business) policies and procedures including import/export regulations.

* Experience with procurement policies, procedures, and regulations

Northrop Grumman Space Sector is currently seeking a **Supply Chain Logistics Specialist - Level 2 or Level 3** to work onsite at our facility located in **Promontory, UT.**

Join the Space revolution and make the impossible, possible. **#definingpossible**

**Responsibilities to include, but not limited to the following:**

* Responsible for the receipt, delivery and inspection of incoming material, central stores/warehousing of program and/or company-acquired material and packaging and shipping services.
* Provides packaging engineering support, special container design, packaging estimates and format quotes.
* Ensures the retention of material and supplies for future use and in support of production and/or engineering.
* Responsible for the accountability and accuracy of physical records.
* Provides transportation of material and correspondence within the local Northrop Grumman business environment and primary or subsidiary contract partners.
* Maintains functional records in support of internal and external audits to ensure compliance with established policies and procedures.
* Manages, develops or carries out delivery in accordance with all established business policies, procedures and public law.
* Ensures accuracy of delivery information.
* Ensures: finished goods inventories, non-proprietary government property inventory, transportation, import/export requirements, and customer returns in conjunction with business area personnel.
* Understand and comply with all material requirements and specs; including but not limited to frozen, or otherwise temperature controlled and hazmat substances.

**The position can be filled with either a level 2 or level 3.**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* **Level 2:** Bachelor’s Degree with 2+ years of experience in supply chain management, project management, manufacturing, operations, logistics, procurement, or business management OR a Master’s Degree with 0 years of experience in supply chain management, project management, manufacturing, operations, or business management
* **Level 3:** Bachelor’s Degree with 5+ years of experience in supply chain management, project management, manufacturing, operations, logistics, procurement, or business management OR a Master’s Degree with 3+ years of experience in supply chain management, project management, manufacturing, operations, or business management
* In lieu of a degree, an additional 4 years of relatable business experience
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite with an emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with SAP and/or similar ERP systems
* Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in data analytics
* Ability to exercise excellent judgment and decision-making skills based on a clear understanding and application of government regulations to international trade activity
* Current/Active US Government security clearance

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
* 401k
* Educational Assistance
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

**This position is a standard 4-10 schedule. Example: Mon-Thursday 10hr days.**

description:
**SUMMARY**

Ajax Building Company, part of STO Building Group, is seeking a Director of MEP Operations to lead mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection delivery across its mission critical data center projects. This senior leader partners with Project Executives and field leadership to drive MEP financial performance, technical execution, and commissioning readiness from preconstruction through turnover.

The role builds and develops MEP project management and field teams, establishes consistent execution standards, and serves as a senior resource for clients, design teams, and trade partners on critical systems and delivery challenges.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Lead and mentor MEP Project Managers, MEP Superintendents, and related specialists; align staffing, resources, and performance expectations across projects.
* Direct MEP preconstruction strategy, including scope development, estimating reviews, constructability, value engineering, and trade partner selection.
* Oversee MEP budgets, buyout, forecasting, change orders, and cost controls; partner with Project Executives to protect margins and resolve commercial risks.
* Drive critical equipment procurement and vendor coordination, including owner-furnished contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment, factory testing, delivery, and installation readiness.
* Align MEP coordination, manpower, installation sequencing, utility energization, and commissioning milestones with overall project schedules.
* Provide senior technical oversight of critical power, cooling, controls, and life safety systems; resolve design, constructability, and system integration issues.
* Establish consistent MEP procedures for BIM/VDC coordination, submittals, RFIs, quality control, and progress reporting; hold teams and trade partners accountable.
* Oversee commissioning strategy with owners, commissioning agents, vendors, and project teams, including startup, functional testing, integrated systems testing, and phased turnover.
* Promote safe execution of MEP work, including energization and testing; identify delivery risks early and lead corrective action with project and safety leadership.
Build client and trade partner relationships, support pursuits and technical proposals, and apply lessons learned to strengthen Ajax’s mission critical operations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 15+ years of progressive MEP construction experience, including senior leadership of project teams, field operations, or a specialty contracting business.
* Proven leadership of large-scale data center MEP delivery from preconstruction through commissioning and turnover; hyperscale experience preferred.
* Deep expertise in electrical or mechanical construction, with the ability to oversee integrated MEP and fire protection scopes. Strong critical power experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing complex MEP budgets, procurement, forecasting, contract negotiations, and change management.

This position requires an active **TS/Sensitive Compartmental Information (SCI)** clearance.

The IT Systems Engineer is responsible for identifying strategic and tactical activities for IT enterprise enhancements and sustainment. This position assists the Government in information management (IM) analysis and prioritizing initiatives, development and integration efforts to eliminate redundancy and align capabilities for the client IT Enterprise. In addition, the IT Systems Engineer shall provide requirements analysis and management for the customer’s subordinate commands; and support the client in identifying, validating, coordinating and documenting IT requirements.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

Estimated Starting Salary Range for **IT Systems Engineer** : $105,000 to $115,000

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

**IT Systems Engineer Responsibilities Include:**

* Provide the customer with IT technical assistance and expertise related to IT requirements for various systems within the enterprise.
* Assist the customer’s subordinate commands with technical review of IT requirements to ensure they are aligned with the IT strategy for modernization and standardization.
* Review requirements submitted by the customer’s subordinate commands for accuracy, correctness, and completeness, and ensure that IT equipment procurements are aligned with the customer’s hardware standards.
* Work with ACC-INSCOM on the submissions of the customer’s subordinate commands IT acquisition requirements. Ensure completeness and accuracy of acquisition documents going to ACC-INSCOM.
* Recommendations on organizational manning and enterprise relationships; preparation of briefings and papers for INSCOM senior-leadership; providing technical expertise and recommendations at planning, implementation meetings; and providing recommendations on G6/GISA organization and TTPs.
* Attends INSCOM IT meetings, VTCs, and conferences as required and supports coordination with key military and civilian personnel at MSCs, HQDA, Army MACOMs, Services, and Intelligence Agencies
* Supports the development of Unfunded Requirement (UFR) and POM issue papers, organizational and functional lay-downs, POA&M MS Project schedules, facilities planning documents, security architecture planning documents, strategy and implementation documents and briefings
* Providing IT subject matter expertise on various topics in various forums.
Performs other job-related duties as assigned

**IT Systems Engineer Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities requested:**

* Prefer a minimum of a BA/BS in technology related field; ten years’ experience as an IT Systems Architect or Engineer can be substituted for the degree.
* Two years’ experience in Project Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering is required; 6 years’ experience is preferred.
* Knowledge of Federal government contracts and programs
* Must have good analytical skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, and highly effective organizational skills
* Must be able to adapt to a changing environment
* Must be proficient in all MS Office suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal

**VDC Coordinator - Design Intelligence**
=========================================

**Company**
-----------

Kunz is a model-based design and engineering firm focused on improving how complex, mission-critical facilities are designed and delivered. We work at the intersection of engineering, product development, digital design, and construction to create repeatable solutions for large-scale infrastructure programs.

Our teams work on complex technical challenges where design information must move reliably across disciplines and from engineering through construction. By combining deep technical expertise with model-based workflows, we help improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of project delivery.

**Location**
------------

San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado

**Job Description**
-------------------

Kunz is expanding its Design Intelligence team to support hyperscale data center programs. We are seeking architects, engineers, and BIM professionals with strong building knowledge and an interest in work breakdown structures, model metadata, and model-based analytics.

Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Senior Specialist, Production Planning, Material Planning Analyst***

***Job Code:*** ***45752***

***Job Location: John C Stennis Space Center, MS***

***Job Schedule:******4/10 - Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week***

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Technologies Inc. offers a complete line of propulsion products from launch vehicles to missile defense to advanced hypersonic propulsion. These have been used in a wide variety of government and commercial applications, including the main engines for the space shuttle, Atlas and Delta launch vehicles, missile defense systems, and Space Launch Systems. Join our team as a Senior Specialist, Production Planning in our Stennis Space Center Scheduling and Material Planning organization which plays a key role from proposal to product delivery company wide.

**Essential Functions:**

* Release Supplier Requisitions and Shop Orders for both Bill of Material (BOM) and independent demand requirements.
* Analyze program demand, create requisitions, maintain horizontal plan or line of balance, and initiate material transfers.
* Work collaboratively with Integrated Product Team (IPT) to address issues, problem solve and strategize to ensure we are meeting our customer commitments.
* Identify and initiate Program Inventory Surplus/Close Out.
* Perform miscellaneous tasks as assigned to support the specific program efforts.
* Up to 10% travel to other L3Harris facilities and suppliers across the country.
* Requires U.S. Citizenship. Must be able to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information and having dual citizenship may preclude you from being able to meet this requirement. Individual must be able to obtain and maintain NASA Personnel Reliability Program (PRP) and DOD Secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related planning experience. Graduate Degree or equivalent with 2 years of prior related planning experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related planning experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Prior Oracle/ERP/Delmia/Windchill Experience.
* American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) Certification.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office and other applicable software
* Demonstrated Lean Experience or Certification.
* Operations, Procurement, Scheduling and Engineering Value Stream experience, or demonstrated willingness to learn.

Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

* Lead or support the COE’s legal technology and process-transformation initiatives, including contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools, workflow automation, and legal AI solutions.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve cycle time, service quality, cost, and internal client experience.
* Assist in training business partners and internal clients on contracting processes, templates, risk allocation and self-service tools.

* Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, IT, and other business teams to translate legal considerations into clear, practical guidance that supports QXO’s commercial and operational objectives.
* Support M&A integration efforts as they relate to commercial contracts, vendor relationships, and enterprise services frameworks.
* Contribute to technology-enabled transformation initiatives, major operational projects, and other cross-functional initiatives led by the Vice President, Assistant General Counsel or Chief Legal Officer.

### **Required**

* Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school and active state-bar membership in good standing, or eligibility for admission in the jurisdiction of employment.

* Experience supporting a large, complex, multi-site organization is preferred. Experience in distribution, building products, industrial services, construction, or another operationally intensive environment is a plus.
* Strong command of commercial contracting principles and demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating a high volume and broad range of agreements with increasing complexity and independence.
* Experience drafting and negotiating a high volume and wide variety of commercial agreements.

Contracting Specialists at NSA award, administer, oversee, and monitor contracts. Responsibilities may include the following: - Conducting market research - Preparing and issuing Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Quote (RFQs) - Evaluating proposals from potential contractors/vendors - Negotiating contract terms with selected contractors/vendors - Evaluating procurements to ensure compliance with funding, legal, and program requirements. - Preparing and awarding contracts with supporting documentation in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and NSA policy. - Administering contracts to include issuing modifications and ensuring payment is issued. - Solving complex and unique challenges that arise throughout the life of a contract - Interfacing with various levels of personnel, management, and organizations throughout the Agency. - Meeting frequently with vendors and government technical experts to discuss contract cost, schedule, and performance. - Completing training in federal acquisition to become certified in Contracting under the Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) within 24 months of employment. - Utilizing Excel and Word at an advanced level on a daily basis to provide analytic support on assigned contracts. - Monitoring contractor performance and ensuring services are delivered in accordance with contract terms and identifying opportunities to improve contract performance and reduce contract cost. - Collaborating with technical experts to establish clearly defined contract tasks; validating those tasks are within the contract scope and cost parameters. - Generating cost estimates using historical data and future projections in an effort to build accurate and reliable spend plans. - Serving as part of a Source Selection Team and often times serving as the Source Selection evaluation lead or as an administrative lead/liaison with industry. - Presenting status updates on expenditures, delivery timelines, and contractor performance to senior executive leadership. - Partnering with finance and mission experts to ensure long-term contracts are properly funded and contract modifications are approved in a timely manner. - Forecasting requirements for future contracts and meeting with mission to draft pre-solicitation documents. - Reviewing contract invoices and collaborating with vendors to resolve any errors or issues prior to payment authorization. A training plan will be put in place to allow the required certification to be achieved within 36 months of employment.

Job ID: 2617726

**Location:** Lorton, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-08

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** TS.SCI

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\\_ON\\_SITE

**Description**

Join a mission driven satellite program at the forefront of national defense innovation. Our team is developing cutting edge technologies that directly support critical Department of War priorities, combining both proven and first-of-their-kind capabilities that have never been applied in space. Operating within a fast-paced acquisition environment, we benefit from streamlined authorities and direct access to senior Government decisionmakers, enabling us to move quickly and execute aggressive schedules using the most innovative contracting strategies available.

SAIC is seeking self-directed leaders who skillfully navigate ambiguity, solve complex challenges, and bring diverse expertise to a dynamic environment focused on delivering capability rapidly. Success here requires adaptability, initiative, and a willingness to wear multiple hats in support of a high impact mission. Candidates experienced as USAF/USSF acquisition officers (AFSC: 63A) or developmental engineers (AFSC: 62E) leading satellite programs in the USSF (SSC), NRO, or SDA, applying the full range of the systems engineering discipline (e.g., Requirements Development, Architecture, SE milestones: SRR, PDR, CDR, etc.), and/or DAWIA/PMI Program Management will be especially well-prepared to excel.

**Job Description:**

This position is for a Senior Contracts Support Specialist in **Lorton, VA** supporting cutting-edge and innovative space programs. The Senior Contracts Support Specialist serves as a key partner to Government program leadership providing acquisition, contract administration, and compliance support for the Inner Harbor contract. This role supports contract actions from planning through closeout and requires strong independent judgment and experience supporting complex federal acquisitions. The position is integrated into the Government-led Program Office team requiring full-time on-site work.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Function as a trusted acquisition advisor to Government and Program staff.
* Lead preparation of complete contract packages including requirements validation, funding documentation coordination, and acquisition strategy alignment.
* Develop, coordinate, and maintain pre-award documents such as Acquisition Plans, Justification & Approvals, Source Selection Plans, and RFP packages.
* Support execution of contract awards and modifications, ensuring accuracy of clauses, pricing structures, schedules, and deliverables.
* Conduct detailed cost/price analysis, evaluate proposals, support development of negotiation positions, and participate in negotiation discussions.
* Oversee post award contract administration including invoice review, discrepancy resolution, schedule monitoring, and performance compliance.
* Maintain comprehensive contract documentation, track contract actions, and ensure timely processing of contractual deliverables.
* Interface with program management, budget, technical teams, and legal to ensure aligned and compliant contract execution.
* Monitor changes in acquisition policy and ensure contract actions remain compliant with the FAR and DFARS.
* Develop, prepare, and present contract related reports, status briefings, and decision packages to senior leadership.
* Oversee project cost control activities, including actual cost analysis, variance reporting, trend identification, and performance assessments.

**Qualifications**

* TYPICAL EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelors and fifteen (15) years or more experience; Masters and thirteen (13) years or more experience.
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, team building and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to be effective in a government/contractor team environment.
* Experience with Intelligence Community or DoD contracting.
* Deep knowledge of FAR/DFARS, and EPX Studio.
* Experience with source selections and contract negotiations.
* Experience in Space Launch contracting, including mission unique requirements, launch services procurement, or support to launch enterprise acquisition activities.
* Ability to work in a very dynamic environment and effectively interact with numerous DOD, military/civilian personnel and industry partners.
* Ability to communicate with a diverse audience of senior decision makers with varying levels of programmatic and technical expertise.
* Effective communication, coordination, and customer engagement skills.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic, and team environment with no supervision.
* TS/SCI required.
* Previous SAP experience desired.

P2S|CMTA stands as a provider of professional engineering services to a broad range of markets, including higher education, healthcare, ports/harbors, industrial, entertainment, commercial, laboratories, municipal, and federal sectors. Our specialties include electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire protection, and technology integration. Our offered services range from engineering and commissioning to construction management. With over 400 dedicated employees on the West Coast, P2S|CMTA is an internationally recognized leader in many of the key markets we serve. We provide a blend of innovation and technical excellence in delivering green solutions that enhance and sustain the built, natural, and social environments. Currently, we have offices in Long Beach, Seattle, Irvine, San Diego, Los Angeles, and San Jose.

**Title:** Senior Marketing Manager

**Report to:** Director of Business Development

**Location:** Seattle, WA or Long Beach, CA or West Coast remote

**Salary Range:** $145,000 - $160,000 (depending on experience). This role is also eligible for an annual performance based bonus. Bonus eligibility and payout are determined by role, individual performance, and company performance, and are not guaranteed.

**Summary:**
The Senior Marketing Manager is responsible for leading the planning, management, and execution of strategic proposals, qualifications packages, interview presentations, and other business development collateral for a professional engineering, commissioning, and construction management services firm. This role serves as a key partner to firm leadership, market leaders, project managers, and technical staff, ensuring pursuit strategies are translated into compelling, compliant, and client-focused submissions that support the firm's growth objectives.

The Senior Marketing Manager provides both hands-on proposal leadership and team management, overseeing pursuit processes, quality standards, workload prioritization, and marketing resources while fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Proposal Leadership and Management

* Lead the pursuit process for high-priority RFQs, RFPs, SOQs, interviews, and presentations.
* Develop pursuit schedules, assignment matrices, compliance checklists, and production plans.
* Facilitate kickoff meetings, strategy sessions, and proposal reviews.
* Collaborate with technical teams to develop win themes, differentiators, and client-focused messaging.
* Manage proposal development from opportunity identification through final submittal.
* Review solicitation requirements and establish submission strategies that maximize compliance and competitiveness.
* Oversee final quality assurance and quality control reviews prior to submission.
* Ensure all submittals are completed accurately, professionally, and on schedule.

Strategic Pursuit Support

* Collaborate with market leaders and business developers on pursuit strategy and positioning.
* Participate in opportunity planning, go/no-go evaluations, and capture strategy development.
* Help identify competitive advantages, project experience, and staffing approaches that strengthen pursuits.
* Support interview preparation, presentation development, and coaching of presenters.
* Analyze client priorities and evaluation criteria to enhance proposal responsiveness.

Content Development and Knowledge Management

* Manage and maintain proposal resources, templates, resumes, project sheets, boilerplate content, and marketing collateral.
* Develop and improve standardized content while ensuring customization for each pursuit.
* Ensure project descriptions, staff qualifications, and firm narratives remain current and accurate.
* Establish best practices for proposal content management and documentation.

Team Leadership and Development

* Supervise and mentor proposal staff.
* Establish workload priorities and resource assignments.
* Provide coaching, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities.
* Promote collaboration across offices, markets, and disciplines.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, and training of marketing personnel.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

* Continuously evaluate and improve pursuit workflows, tools, and production processes.
* Track pursuit metrics, win rates, and proposal performance trends.
* Recommend process improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency.
* Lead implementation of marketing technologies and proposal management systems.

Collaboration and Relationship Management

* Build strong working relationships with technical leaders, project managers, and business development staff.
* Serve as a trusted advisor during pursuit planning and execution.
* Coordinate with external partners, subconsultants, and teaming organizations during proposal development.
* Support the firm's overall business development, brand, and clie

Our Clinical Pharmacists are responsible for providing general clinical and operational pharmacy services. This includes supervision of technical staff. * Effectively supervise pharmacy operation activities and provides support to the whole pharmacy team
* Compliant with facility pharmacy schedule to work physically at patient care areas to interact with medical staff, nurses and other members of the healthcare team.
* Effectively and proactively intervene in conflicts between pharmacy and medical staff regarding drug therapy issue resolutions.
* Comply with all regulatory standards
* Prioritize work and lead others to comply with facility medication turn-around time policy and procedure. Identify areas for improved efficiency
* Supervise and assist pharmacy technicians and other support staff effectively
* Act as supervisor in charge as assigned
* Participate in the continuous quality improvement of pharmacy operations (operational/clinical)
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Senior Contract Specialist**
==============================

**Item**

**Detail**

Location

On-site, Contracting and Logistics Department (Code 400), Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, Maine

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Hours are worked between 0600 and 1700 Eastern Time with a half-hour lunch; no more than 8 hours per day.

Telework

On-site position. Telework is not a right and is available only with Government concurrence.

Travel

None anticipated

Positions

Two (2) in the base period; three (3) in option period one

Salary range

$100,000 to $115,000

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Senior Contract Specialist is embedded with the Contracting and Logistics Department (Code 400) at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, which maintains, repairs, and modernizes LOS ANGELES and VIRGINIA Class submarines. The Senior Contract Specialist assists Government contracting officers with complex acquisitions across the full lifecycle and shares knowledge with, trains, and mentors Department and contractor staff.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Provide full acquisition lifecycle (cradle-to-grave) contracting support for complex equipment, supplies, services, and information technology, covering pre-award, award, and post-award contract administration.
* Provide critical analysis and pricing support using advanced Excel functions (HLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting with custom formulas, and complex nested functions) to arrive at fixed-price rates and cost-reimbursable projections from very large datasets.
* Assist program offices in preparing Independent Government Estimates (IGEs), including research on previous purchases, current market value, and other agency purchases.
* Provide advice and recommendations on acquisition strategy, including approaches, risks, contracting methods, competition, sources, cost, and milestone schedules; prepare Justifications and Approvals and market research memorandums.
* Prepare Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Combined Synopsis/Solicitations with all appropriate terms and conditions; verify funds availability and obtain legal concurrence where applicable before release.
* Assist in the evaluation process and document informal and formal source selections, including Source Selection Plans, evaluation sheets, Conflict of Interest/Nondisclosure Forms, and draft Source Selection Decision Memorandums.
* Work with evaluators and the Contracting Officer to identify pre-negotiation objectives; prepare contract award documents for task orders, delivery orders, and stand-alone contracts; prepare COR designation letters; distribute awards; and input award information into FPDS-NG.
* Prepare documentation for the exercise of options and post-award modifications (SF-30), and assist in resolving contractor performance issues.
* Provide on-the-job knowledge sharing, training, and mentorship, including PowerPoint presentations and job aids.
* Review work internally (contractor to contractor) for accuracy against regulations, policies, and standard procedures before submitting documentation to a Contracting Officer for review and signature.
* Perform to local Procurement Action Lead Time requirements, use the local contract management system in accordance with local policies, record hours daily by 8:00 a.m., and attend meetings as requested.
* Complete required Shipyard training, including the Acquisition Management System (AMS), Electronic Procurement System (ePS), DoD Cyber Security Awareness, and PNSY Contractor New Employee Orientation.

*This position supports Government contracting officers and does not perform inherently governmental functions or bind the Government.*

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Eight (8) years of Government contracting experience, including commercial and non-commercial supplies and services, IDIQs, and task and delivery orders.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* DAWIA Contracting Professional certification or equivalent (for example, FAC-C or FAC-C-DoD)..
* Expert knowledge of Federal contracting law, regulation, policies and precedents, and related principles and procedures sufficient to plan, lead, review, or audit the most complex procurement functions.
* Skill in promoting e-commerce and supporting the use of automated acquisition systems and other electronic systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including strong experience with advanced Excel functions (lookups, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting with custom formulas, nested functions).
* U.S. citizenship.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable NACI background investigation and installation access credentials (CAC/DBIDS). No security clearance is required.
* Clear and concise written and oral communication, problem solving, critical thinking, and the ability to function effectively during extended periods of high pressure.
* Experience training, mentor

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

You will be joining a newly formed Global AI & Knowledge Innovation Office (GAIKO) led by a Chief AI & Knowledge Officer who is moving fast. The team is global, still being staffed, and operating with urgency. This role sits alongside pillars covering Responsible AI & Governance, AI Portfolio Intelligence & Value, and Governed Innovation, as well as a separate product and technology organization.

**How you will contribute**

A&M's AI ambition depends on a growing set of strategic vendor and partner relationships — the AI model providers, platforms, and specialist firms the firm builds on and sells alongside. Right now, those relationships are managed informally and unevenly: some are deep and senior, others exist only at the account-management level, and there is no single place to see partner status, tier, or approval health across the portfolio.

This role owns that relationship layer end to end: the strategy for which partners matter and why, the senior-level engagement that makes A&M a partner of choice rather than just another logo, the operational tracking that keeps approvals and renewals from lapsing silently, and the coordination that gets priority partnerships through review faster. This is a relationship and coordination role, not a procurement, security, or product-build role. Those functions continue to own their own processes; this role removes friction and builds the case for investment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Partnership Strategy**

* Define the firm's overall AI partnership strategy: which categories of partner the firm needs (model providers, platforms, specialist firms), how many relationships to hold in each category, and what \\good\\ looks like at each tier
* Set the criteria for how partners are evaluated, tiered, and prioritized, and keep that framework current as the AI vendor landscape shifts
* Translate business unit and firm-wide growth priorities into a point of view on where new partnerships are worth pursuing versus where existing ones should be deepened, consolidated, or exited
* Present the strategy and its rationale to firm leadership, and own it as a living view that gets revisited as the market and the firm's needs change

**Partner Relationship Management**

* Enable and coordinate A&M's strategic AI partner relationships on behalf of the practitioners and BU leaders who own them day-to-day.
* Track and report on the health, scope, and terms of each partnership
* Own the go/no-go recommendation and business case for tier changes or new partner relationships

**Senior Stakeholder Engagement & Narrative Building**

* Build and maintain relationships with senior leaders — not just day-to-day account teams — at each key partner firm, so A&M is seen as a visible, credible, senior-level partner of choice
* Develop the narrative and supporting materials — pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, practitioner and client success stories — that make the case for why a partner should invest more deeply in A&M, and vice versa
* Represent A&M at partner-level executive briefings, quarterly business reviews, and strategic planning sessions

**Partner–BU Matching & Opportunity Surfacing**

* Proactively surface partnership opportunities in both directions: from business unit demand for a capability a partner offers, and from independent market scanning of capabilities BUs don't yet know exist
* Match the right partner to the right business unit use case, and broker the initial connection

**Partner Inventory & Relationship Intelligence**

* Create and maintain a living inventory of all strategic AI partners: relationship owner, tier/status, strength of relationship, key contacts, scope of the relationship, and vendor approval/expiration dates
* Be the single source of truth on whether the firm is current with each vendor, so approvals don't lapse silently
* Establish a regular cadence and format for communicating the state of these relationships across the firm — who our partners are, what each relationship covers, how to engage them, and what's changed — so business units and leadership aren't relying on word of mouth
* Make the inventory and relationship updates easily discoverable (e.g., a firm-wide partner directory or briefing) so any practitioner can quickly find the right partner and the right contact for a given need

**Fast-Lane Facilitation**

* Partner directly with the firm's procurement

**Job Title: Sr. Specialist, Supply Chain Management**

**Job Code:**

**Job Location: Redmond, WA**

**Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

**Job Description:**

This position provides Supply Chain/Material Management (SC/MM) support and leadership in support of Business Unit and Business Development activities. They are responsible for developing and documenting strategies, plans, and processes to manage the supply chain for integration into the Program Management plan. They work directly with Program Management and act as the primary customer contact for the Supply Chain portion of program activities. They represent procurement on the program integrated program teams (IPTs) and interface cross functionally in the resolution of material status, problems or issues.

**Essential Functions:**

The Material Management position is responsible for SC/MM execution of assigned program scope from time of customer request for proposal through contract closeout. To successfully complete these responsibilities, the MPM must:

* Manage program heath with Earned Value (EV) to manage program cost and schedule by using EV fundamentals and support Budget Change Requests (BCRs), Latest Revised Estimate (LRE), Status to report weekly performance to baseline plan
* Formulate quarterly Estimate at Complete (EAC) reports to communicate the program’s performance to budget
* Assist or lead SC/MM in the identification of risks and opportunities to executing the assigned program scope within cost, schedule and technical performance requirements
* Lead SC/MM in supporting program proposal activities to develop compliant labor and material estimates
* Assist or lead SC/MM in the management and execution of the assigned program scope within cost, schedule and technical performance requirements
* Support the program team in developing and baselining a program Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and budget for Supply Chain
* Coordinate with SC/MM management to establish work priorities for SC/MM personnel (e.g. buying and major subcontract personnel, etc.)
* Support supplier contract negotiations to meet program requirements
* Actively manage suppliers to level required (e.g. Supplier Mission Assurance Reviews (SMARs), Post Award Reviews (PARs), Program Management Reviews (PMRs) Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs), Critical Design Reviews (CDRs), Supplier Manufacturing Readiness Reviews (SMRRs), etc.) to achieve program requirements
* Use key metrics to drive performance that meets program requirements
* Monitor the program supply base to assess supplier performance and sustainability for early identification of issues and minimize expedite activities
* Ability to obtain a US LEVEL security clearance

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant Supply Chain experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related Supply Chain experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related Supply Chain experience.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C, Denver, or NYC areas is $82,500 - $153,000. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, and Vermont is $68,500 - $127,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location.

L3Harris announced on January 5th, that AE Industrial Partners (“AE Industrial”) has agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business. This position has been identified as one that will transition to the new standalone company upon closing of the transaction. Until that time, L3Harris will continue its hiring activity within this business.

**Job Title:** **Solutions Sales Executive, Payer**

**Job Summary:**

RevSpring is seeking a highly consultative, results-driven Solutions Sales Executive, Payer to join our health plan commercial team as a payments specialist. This individual will specialize in the U.S. Health Plan (Payer) market and own the sale of RevSpring's payments portfolio across the full payer payments lifecycle — member-to-plan, plan-to-member, plan-to-provider, and provider-to-plan. Rather than owning a fixed geographic territory, this role operates as a payments overlay specialist, partnering with named-account Account Executives across the payer sales team to identify, position, and close payments opportunities within their accounts and prospects.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across payer payments — including member/premium payments, member disbursements, provider disbursement (claims payments), and provider overpayment recovery — along with a track record of building executive relationships and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a specialist or overlay sales capacity.

**Essential Functions:**

* Serve as the payments subject-matter expert on the health plan sales team, partnering with named-account Account Executives to identify, position, and close payments opportunities within their territories.
* Own the sale of RevSpring's full payments portfolio for the payer market: member-to-plan (premium and consumer payments), plan-to-member (member disbursements/refunds), plan-to-provider (provider disbursement/claims payments), and provider-to-plan (overpayment and recovery collections).
* Lead discovery and solutioning for payments opportunities, translating a payer's current payment operations, vendor relationships, and pain points into a tailored RevSpring payments strategy.
* Develop and deliver consultative, executive-level presentations and ROI narratives that position RevSpring's payments capabilities against incumbent and competitive vendors (e.g., Zelis, ECHO Health/PNC, Optum Financial/VPay, InstaMed).
* Partner with named-account AEs to build and execute account-based plans that introduce payments into new-logo pursuits and expand payments adoption within existing RevSpring accounts.
* Lead the payments-specific sales cycle — from opportunity qualification through solution design, proposal, negotiation, and close — in close coordination with the account-owning AE.
* Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Business Development (BDR) to build and progress a qualified payments pipeline sufficient to meet or exceed quota.
* Maintain accurate, timely pipeline, forecast, and activity data in Salesforce for all payments opportunities to support territory planning and revenue forecasting.
* Stay current on payer payments industry trends, competitive dynamics, M&A activity, and regulatory changes (e.g., NACHA, CAQH CORE, HIPAA EFT/ERA mandates) to effectively position RevSpring in payments pursuits.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, and Product/Delivery to structure and close payments deals that set new and existing clients up for a smooth implementation and long-term partnership.
* Represent RevSpring at industry conferences and events to build brand awareness for RevSpring's payments capabilities and generate new payments opportunities.
* Provide accurate weekly/monthly pipeline updates and revenue forecasts for payments to sales leadership.

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Specific Job Skills:**

* Deep, demonstrated expertise in healthcare payments across some combination of: member/premium payments, member disbursements, provider disbursement (claims payments), and provider overpayment recovery.
* Working knowledge of payment rails and modalities used in the payer market — ACH/EFT, virtual card, digital wallets, check — and the operational and compliance considerations of each (NACHA, PCI, HITRUST, CAQH CORE).
* Track record of selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to health plans, TPAs, or payer-adjacent organizations, ideally in a specialist or overlay capacity alongside a broader account team.
* Skilled at building relationships and credibility with C-level and senior finance/operations stakeholders (e.g., CFO, VP of Claims Operations, VP of Provider Network) at health plan clients and prospects.
* Strong consultative and solution-selling skills; ability to align RevSpring's payments offerings to a payer's strategic priorities, cost-reduction goals, and provider/member experience objectives.
* Comfortable navigating long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles common to the payer market, and effective operating as a specialist inside a team-selling motion.
* Disciplined use of CRM (Salesforce) for pipeline management, forecasting, and account/territory collaboration with AEs.
* Understand the buying process, procurement dynamics, and vendor-consolidation considerations for health plan organizations evaluating payments vendors.
* Ability to clearly differentiate RevSpring

**About Carvana**

If you thrive on disrupting the status quo and want to join a company revolutionizing an industry, you'll love what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. We're reimagining the way people buy cars — and having a lot of fun doing it. Have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not taking our foot off the gas now.

**About the team and position**

Creating an extraordinary customer experience is at the heart of Carvana. Our goal is to place the customer in control of the car buying experience and infuse honesty and transparency back into the car buying process. The **Senior Buyer, Procurement** is a key sourcing position that will handle a variety of tactical and strategic tasks, including request for quotation (RFQ) and purchase order (PO) entry/submission and order tracking. This role will support procurement activity across the business. Additional duties of this position include data collection and analysis, assembling and publishing reports and providing support to Category Managers, Specialists and to Management.

**What you'll be doing**

* Leading the IT Procurement process. This position interfaces directly with Carvana Technology Services leadership on all contract renewals, net-new contracts, and identifying areas for supplier improvement through Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
* Negotiating favorable contract renewals and net-new contracts. You'll work closely with the Carvana Legal team in drafting and executing contracts.
* Collect, compile and analyze data and provide reports as needed, using MS SQL and Snowflake with a demonstrated ability with AI coding tools such as Claude or Codex.
* Ownership and accountability for the entire PO procurement process to include sending purchase orders, confirming order acknowledgement, expediting (as needed), and confirming Suppliers are paid.
* Communicate the status of current purchase orders with requesters and others as needed.
* Receive and execute ad-hoc requests that are external to the procurement system for any areas of the business the procurement platform has not yet been implemented.
* Maintain and adhere to procurement budgets, ensuring fiscal responsibility and cost efficiency.
* Follow up on invoice discrepancies as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What you should have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or relevant field and 5+ years experience OR
* 8+ years of experience in Procurement or Accounting.
* CPSM certification is a plus.
* Experience with Coupa or other leading Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or dedicated e-procurement platforms (preferred).
* Demonstrated accuracy, responsiveness, and follow-through; strong multitasking ability, close attention to detail, quantitative aptitude, and genuine curiosity about how things work.
* Ability to work collaboratively on a team as well as independently; actively engaged across the full procurement lifecycle and aligned with Carvana's core values.
* Ability to organize workload efficiently, meet tight deadlines, problem solve effectively, and perform duties of the job accurately and with input and follow-up from management.
* Proficient in the use of SQL, SnowFlake, MS Excel, and ERP systems.

**What we'll offer in return**

* Competitive full-time salary.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* 401K with company match.
* A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
* A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
* Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
* A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
* A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

**Other requirements**

In order to perform the essential functions of this role, candidates must meet the following baseline requirements:

* Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Carvana will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their role.

**Legal stuff**

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disa

**Location:** Amarillo, TX - Pantex Plant
**Job Title:** Project Quality Assurance Senior Associate

**Career Level From:** Senior Associate

**Career Level To:** Specialist

**Organization:** Projects & Infrastructure Qual (50654583)

**Job Specialty:** Quality Assurance

**What You'll Do**
------------------

Ensures use of principles and requirements required are implemented in all activities at Pantex. Support Product Realization Teams, Nuclear Enterprise Assurance, Pantex Operations, Pantex Process Engineering and Engineering, Procurement & Construction to achieve mission delivery. Identifies and communicates risks and opportunities to stakeholders concerning mission success. Provides technical assistance in the development/implementation of processes, procedures, and plans. Reviews work governing documents, routing changes or improvements, and procedures for technical and requirements accuracy. Coordinates with personnel and management from other organizations, and must interface with internal and external customers to assist in the implementation of customer defined requirements, schedules and expectations.

Contributes to the Quality organizational performance in achieving and exceeding established goals and expectations. Performs activities in support of the organizational priorities and missions. Assists in identifying scope of work, schedules, and estimates, and ensures the execution and completion of all deliverables are within budget and schedule.

Plans and directs activities concerned with the development, application, and maintenance of quality standards for processing materials or services into partially finished, finished material, or tangible products. May develop and implement methods and procedures for inspection, testing, and evaluation.

Leads or participates in Quality Assurance (QA) oversight, such as audits, assessments, inspections and surveillances. This may include internal project audits and vendor/supplier audits, as required. Work with personnel and management to communicate findings and issues. Identifies and recommends to management areas to be assessed based on risk analysis and performance indicators.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.
* Master's degree: Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
* OR Applicants without a bachelor's degree may be considered based on a combination of at least 10 years of completed education and/or relevant experience.

**Department of Energy (DOE) Order 426.2A Requirements**
--------------------------------------------------------

* In addition, the applicant must meet the requirements of DOE O 426.2A (i.e., Baccalaureate in engineering or related science, 2 years job-related and at least 1 year nuclear experience, or a DOE O 426.2A alternative). DOE O 426.2A experience requirements can be satisfied following employment. In the interim, newly hired personnel will not be assigned duties that could impact the safety basis of nuclear facilities. (Ref. DOE O 426.2A)

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

Preferred candidates have a bachelor's degree in an Engineering/Science discipline.

The following experience would be favorably considered:

* Construction and Maintenance activities

* Experience in quality/process improvements methods, statistical application/metrics methodology, engineering standards, measuring and test equipment, basic chemistry, and software QA programs.

* Formal training and/or experience in NQA-1, ISO-9000, or similar quality standards.

* Training and experience in performing assessments.

* Knowledge of Department of Energy (DOE) Orders and National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) quality requirements.

* Experience in, procurement document reviews, engineering design and design reviews.

* Experience in quality control engineering

description:
**Purpose & Overall Relevance for the Organization:**

Workplaces is responsible for the active management of the Global Real Estate Portfolio including leases and transactions of all the properties, all design, construction and operations for offices & showrooms for adidas. This supports revenue growth, portfolio optimization and creating great workplaces to attract and retain top talent across the globe. To ensure a successful and sustainable Portfolio, Workplaces collaborates within an extensive network of internal / external stakeholders and industry experts to provide value added service.

The Senior Specialist Commercial Management is responsible to support in the establishment and further development of the commercial facility management at adidas locations managed by Workplaces in North America. The main tasks are participation in projects and execution of commercial support in the entire department (e.g. investment and order processing, invoicing, cost tracking, project management & facility management financial data, etc.).

* Independent execution and support in handling of Purchase Orders inclusive GR booking and Invoice tracking and clarification.
* Independent solution of complex, commercial problems
* Commercial support of projects and ensuring that they are implemented on time and in the right quality incl. cost tracking
* Support in annual budget planning and monitoring of budget targets
* Support in cost tracking and creation of cost-relevant evaluations
* Execution of external settlements, invoicing

* Preparation and gathering of the necessary information in month-end and yearly account closeout and accruals

* Responsibility and timely execution of internal monthly allocations as well as process adjustments and support for system optimization
* Coordination of commercial issues with suppliers, external companies and adidas internal departments
* Support in the creation of documentation and presentations
* Ensure compliance with commercial processes and guidelines

* Support and optimize processes for the commercial management business of Workplaces
* Documentation of the processes and decisions
* Create transparency on costs and budgets

**Key Relationships:**

* Workplaces Regional Team
* Workplaces Regional Sr. Manager
* NAM Market Finance
* Group Procurement
* External suppliers

**Knowledge Skills and Abilities:**

* Good communication skills
* Knowledge of internal procedures and processes
* Advanced experience with budgeting, strategic planning, financial analysis

* Personal initiative and independent work while in a team environment
* High level customer service, internal and external
* Excellent knowledge in the use of MS-Office products
* Knowledge of SAP & ARIBA, advanced preferred
* Ability to create reports in a presentable manner to multiple different stakeholders
* At adidas we offer a Hybrid work policy which requires attendance in the office Monday through Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday each week. For work requiring a high degree of collaboration or an in-person presentation, in-office attendance is required even on Friday

**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred in Finance or Business Administration
* 3-5 years of professional experience in the field of Commercial Management or Finance
* Strong English Language required, both written and verbal

description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**

The Senior Specialist, Renovations & Facilities, plays a pivotal role on the Facilities & Renovations team by leading spatial design initiatives, capital improvement projects, and strategic maintenance across Success Academy's building portfolio. Reporting directly to the Team Lead of Renovations & Facilities, this position sits between tactical school-level facilities support and senior operational leadership, serving as the primary project manager driving long-term site viability. By ensuring adherence to best-in-class design and sustainability standards, the Senior Specialist directly supports instructional needs and enables the growth and operational excellence of SA's schools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and oversee multi-year facilities plans and needs assessments across the school portfolio to ensure alignment with organizational design and educational usage standards.
* Lead end-to-end capital improvement and renovation projects, managing scope, floor plan updates, enrollment adjustments, and full construction timelines.
* Coordinate with cross-functional internal teams (Executive, Schooling, Finance, Legal) and manage external service providers—including architects, engineers, expeditors, and contractors—to secure project alignment and sign-offs.
* Direct due diligence (zoning, code compliance, test-fits) for acquisitions and navigate approvals, submittals, and moves with key governmental bodies such as the NYC Department of Education (DOE) and Department of Buildings (DOB).
* Oversee routine and emergency maintenance operations while tracking project budgets, managing contracts, and maintaining COI documentation to mitigate institutional risk.

**Qualifications**

* 5 to 7+ years of experience managing service providers and complex initiatives in real estate, architecture, construction, facilities, or procurement.
* Direct experience working with NYC governmental agencies, including the Department of Education (Division of School Facilities), School Construction Authority (SCA), Department of Buildings (DOB), and Department of Transportation (DOT).
* Proven track record in end-to-end project management, including budgeting, contract negotiation, scheduling, zoning, and feasibility studies under strict deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or an equivalent combination of relevant field experience.

**Competencies**

* **Project Management Excellence:** Demonstrates exceptional organization and oversight to drive multiple complex capital initiatives from feasibility to closeout on strict timelines and within budget.
* **Stakeholder Management & Communication:** Articulates complex architectural and operational plans clearly to build alignment across internal executives, school leaders, and external agency partners.
* **Agility & Problem-Solving:** Swiftly adapts to ambiguous or changing environments, proactively forecasting risks and addressing emergency maintenance or regulatory roadblocks.
* **Strategic Vision & Advocacy:** Champion's high aesthetic, functional, and sustainable facility standards that reflect SA's mission and directly enhance the instructional environment.

**Compensation, Benefits, & Perks**

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

* **Day-One Health & Wellness:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.
* **Financial Security:** 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.
* **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* **Perks & Stipends:** A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Supplier Readiness & Development

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert in supplier readiness and industrialization, leading assessments of suppliers' manufacturing capabilities, tooling readiness, process maturity, and operational preparedness to support successful program launches.
* Drive supplier development initiatives across multiple programs, identifying opportunities to improve production readiness, manufacturing performance, and long-term scalability.

Program Launch & Readiness Leadership

* Lead complex supplier readiness activities from pre-production through mass production, ensuring alignment with key program milestones, launch timing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Evaluate supplier readiness risks and influence action plans to support successful vehicle launches and program execution.

Advanced Risk Management

* Identify and assess supplier, manufacturing, and supply chain risks through data analysis, supplier evaluations, and readiness reviews.
* Develop and drive mitigation strategies to address capacity constraints, quality concerns, operational challenges, logistics disruptions, and supply continuity risks.

Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Lead cross-functional supplier performance reviews focused on cost, quality, delivery, capacity, and operational excellence.
* Apply APQP, PPAP, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement methodologies to improve supplier performance and manufacturing readiness.
* Conduct advanced supplier assessments and audits to evaluate compliance with quality requirements, launch readiness expectations, and industry standards.

Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration

* Serve as a trusted advisor to Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Program Management teams on supplier readiness, launch risk, and manufacturing capability topics.
* Influence cross-functional decisions through deep expertise in supplier development, manufacturing operations, industrialization, and production readiness.
* Support resolution of complex supplier-related issues, including production constraints, launch challenges, quality concerns, and supply shortages.

Reporting & Analytics

* Develop and communicate supplier readiness metrics, performance trends, and risk assessments to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Utilize data-driven analysis to identify improvement opportunities and recommend actions that enhance supplier performance and launch readiness.

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

* This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC or Novi, Michigan**.
