**Senior Contract Specialist (15.49)**

OCT Consulting is a business management and technology consulting firm that supports Federal Government clients. We provide consulting services in the areas of Strategy, Process Improvement, Change Management, Program and Project Management, Acquisition/Procurement, and Information Technology.

Responsibilities and Duties

OCT currently has an opening for a Senior Contract Specialist to work with our federal client. The selected candidate will be embedded with the client's contracting department, which plans, awards, and administers fixed-price and cost-type contracts for supplies, services, and information technology. The Senior Contract Specialist will lead complex procurement actions, serve as a peer reviewer for the contractor team, and mentor both contractor and Government staff.

**This position is contingent upon contract award.**

**Day to day responsibilities include:**

* Support the full acquisition lifecycle (cradle-to-grave) for complex supplies, services, and information technology, including fixed-price and cost-type contracts, IDIQs, BOAs, BPAs, and task/delivery orders.
* Conduct market research and prepare market research memoranda, Justifications and Approvals (J&As), and related acquisition strategy documents; review requirements and sole-source justifications for accuracy.
* Prepare Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and combined synopsis/solicitations, ensuring all appropriate FAR/DFARS terms and conditions are included; verify funds availability and obtain legal concurrence as required.
* Support informal and formal source selections, including Source Selection Plans, evaluation worksheets, conflict-of-interest/non-disclosure documentation, and draft Source Selection Decision Memoranda.
* Perform cost and price analysis using advanced Excel (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP/HLOOKUP, pivot tables, nested functions, conditional formatting) on large pricing datasets; assist program offices with Independent Government Estimates (IGEs).
* Develop pre-negotiation objectives and support the Contracting Officer during negotiations; prepare award documents, COR designation letters, and FPDS-NG reporting.
* Prepare SF-30 modifications and option exercises, support contract administration, and assist in resolving contractor performance issues, claims, and closeout.
* Work in contract writing and acquisition systems including ePS, SPS/PD2, FPDS-NG, SAM, GSA eBuy/eLibrary/Advantage, and PIEE (CLS, EDA, SPRS, GFP).
* Perform to local Procurement Action Lead Time (PALT) standards and complete contractor-to-contractor peer review of all documents prior to Contracting Officer review and signature.
* Lead the most complex acquisitions, including source selections, IDIQ/BPA establishment, and complex pricing actions.
* Serve as a senior peer reviewer, checking team work products for regulatory accuracy and completeness before submission to the Contracting Officer.
* Provide on-the-job training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to Government and contractor staff, including PowerPoint training materials and job aids.

**Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Eight (8) or more years of Government contracting experience, including commercial and non-commercial supplies and services, IDIQs, and task/delivery orders.
* Bachelors degree required (Business degree preferred). Education and experience may not be substituted for one another.
* DAWIA Contracting Professional certification or equivalent (e.g., DAWIA Level III, FAC-C (new criteria)/FAC-C-DoD, or FAC-C Level III (legacy)).
* Demonstrated experience training, mentoring, or knowledge sharing with contracting staff.
* Expert knowledge of Federal contracting law, regulations, policies, and precedents sufficient to plan, lead, review, or audit the most complex procurement functions.
* Skill in promoting e-commerce and using automated acquisition systems; proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Adobe Acrobat.
* Strong advanced Excel skills for price analysis on large datasets.
* Preferred: ten (10) or more years of Government contracting experience; experience supporting Department of Defense contracting activities; hands-on experience with ePS.
* Must hold an active security clearance at the time of contract award; the investigation will involve a credit, fingerprint, and law enforcement agency check.
* Must be able to obtain client facility access credentials (CAC/badge) and wear required safety equipment (hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots) in industrial areas.
* Location: Full-time, on-site at the client facility. Work hours fall within 0600-1700 ET, Monday through Friday. Telework is permitted only with Government approval.

**Benefits**

Benefits

OCT offers competitive compensation packages and a full suite of benefits which includes:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Retirement savings 401K plan provided by an industry leading provider with 3% employer contributions of the employee

The Principal Category Specialist leads Procurement activities for strategic business transformation initiatives while providing ongoing category management in partnership with the assigned department. This position plays a critical role in driving sourcing, supplier negotiations, contract development, and business case analysis for high-impact projects with significant impact on the company's operational and financial performance.

**Day To Day Role**

* Lead procurement activities supporting strategic department projects from sourcing strategy through contract execution
* Partner with other internal departments such as Logistics, Operations, and/or Finance teams to address supplier issues, service escalations, pricing requests, contract amendments, and continuous improvement opportunities
* Serve as the primary Procurement business partner for the assigned function, supporting both strategic initiatives and ongoing operational requirements
* Develop and execute negotiation strategies with specialty providers, companies, partners, and/or related suppliers
* Drive supplier selection processes including RFIs, RFPs, bid evaluations, and commercial assessments
* Build comprehensive business cases, financial analyses, and total cost of ownership models to support executive decision-making
* Partner with cross-functional teams such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Finance, Engineering, Legal, and/or Executive Leadership
* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage commercial contracts and statements of work in collaboration with Legal
* Identify and quantify cost savings, operational improvements, risk mitigation opportunities, and service enhancements
* Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and recommendations for leadership reviews, steering committees, and board meetings
* Develop and execute category strategies for assigned department spend areas, including annual planning, market assessments, supplier performance reviews, and savings initiatives
* Provide procurement expertise and market intelligence regarding logistics industry trends, supplier capabilities, and commercial best practices
* Ensure procurement activities align with corporate governance, compliance, and risk management requirements
* Support implementation planning and supplier transition activities as needed

**Core Skills and Qualifications**

**The Ideal Candidate Must Possess the Following:**

* Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in business, supply chain management, logistics, finance, engineering, or a related field of study
* Advanced experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, and supply chain
* May require advanced knowledge of transportation networks, distribution operations, freight management, and logistics cost drivers
* Experience supporting large-scale supply chain transformation or network optimization projects
* Demonstrated success leading complex sourcing initiatives and supplier negotiations
* Strong knowledge of commercial contract structures, terms and conditions, and contract risk management
* Exceptional business case development and financial modeling capabilities
* Strong commercial acumen with experience developing and executing executive-level materials
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with senior executives, including C-suite leadership and Boards of Directors
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, highly visible project environment
* Familiar with change management best practices

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CSCP, CPIM, PMP, or equivalent

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

CPI is seeking a Manager to lead an organization of Project Managers and serve as a senior liaison between our internal operational, technical, and business partners. Ideal candidates are strategic leaders who set vision and direction, and possess the ability to develop and deploy innovative solutions to address organizational challenges. This role requires a leader who can operate at scale — setting mission and long-term strategy while empowering their managers to own execution. The candidate will have a high bar for quality, must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and must be able to leverage data to define metrics, drive improvements, and influence decisions across the organization. The scope of projects the team manages includes improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire systems, and building automation systems. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the leader will be expected to technically understand the work their teams execute.

You will set priorities and manage the workload and throughput of a team across multiple locations, prioritizing programs based on impact to the business (Safety, Capacity, Sustainability, and Availability). You will be responsible for developing the metrics and mechanisms that measure your organization's deliverables and results against established commitments. You will drive improvements by building collaborative relationships with senior leaders across partner organizations to eliminate waste and increase productivity, and you will develop your managers to do the same by delegating, coaching, and leveraging individual strengths. You will also look around corners to identify new opportunities across existing programs and to expand CPI services into new geographies without impacting existing commitments.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers, then this may be the challenge you have been looking for! Only those who have worked within a data center environment or similar mission critical space need apply.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Set vision and strategy — Develop short- and long-term goals for the CPI organization, aligned to the growth and scale of the data center infrastructure.

* Lead a team of project managers — Hire, develop, and coach; grow and retain top performers.
* Own organizational delivery — Prioritize workload across teams by business impact and manage results against Safety, Capacity, Sustainability, and Availability commitments.
* Define metrics and mechanisms — Establish the methodology to execute strategy, measure performance, and drive data-informed decisions.
* Influence across the organization — Build relationships with senior technical and engineering leaders across planning, design, engineering, construction, commissioning, procurement, operations, legal, security, and finance partners to deliver priorities as a global standard.
* Manage financials and headcount — Provide financial spend oversight and manage headcount scaling to match demand.
* Look around corners — Identify improvement opportunities and expand CPI services into new geographies without impacting commitments.
* Own organizational health — Maintain culture, operational management, learning and development, engagement, and career growth across the Americas region.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. OnTrac is hiring a Contracts Management Senior Specialist!

Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!

Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.

**Location:** Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.

**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $84.000 - $105,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $84,000 - $126,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

**Employment Logistics:**
The Contracts Management Senior Specialist oversees the drafting, review, negotiation, and administration of contracts to ensure compliance with legal requirements and alignment with business objectives. This role serves as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and external parties, mitigating contractual risk and supporting strategic initiatives through effective contract management, governance, and lifecycle oversight.

**Unpacking the Benefits:**
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\\*
* Six (6) paid company holidays
* Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.

**The Must-Haves:**

* 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Deep understanding of contract management and administration principles and terminology
* Knowledge of standard office software and contract management technologies
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to maintain professionalism
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

**Your Mission in Motion:**
A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.

* Contract drafting, review & negotiation: Draft, review, and negotiate vendor agreements, customer contracts, NDAs, service agreements, licensing arrangements, and other business contracts.
* Compliance & risk mitigation: Ensure contracts comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies; identify and mitigate contractual risks while providing clear guidance to stakeholders.
* Cross-functional contract alignment: Collaborate with Procurement, Sales, Finance, and Operations to align contract terms with business needs and objectives.
* Contract lifecycle & repository management: Maintain a centralized contract repository and manage contract lifecycle processes to ensure organization, accessibility, and visibility.
* Templates, playbooks & best practices: Develop and implement standardized templates, playbooks, and contract management best practices.
* Performance monitoring, audits & reporting: Monitor contract performance and compliance, proactively address issues, and support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal reporting related to contracts.

**Paving your way to your success:**

* You collaborate effectively within a team environment to align internal stakeholders and support business objectives.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing tasks effectively while maintaining accuracy.
* You analyze unusual situations using advanced analytical and problem-solving techniques to identify root causes.
* You creatively resolve a broad range of issues and recommend alternative approaches when appropriate.
* You adapt your communication style to diverse audiences and provide guidance on complex contract matters.

**Posting Timeline:**
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting

**Disclosures:**

* Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

### **About Us!**

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we're proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio's vision.

### **About Fivestone Studios!**

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

### **Your Mission**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior Immersive Producer** to join our team and take ownership of the delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects across immersive, experiential, digital and physical environments.

We are looking for a senior, hands-on producer who is commercially sharp, highly organised, calm under pressure, and comfortable working across creative, technology, content, fabrication, AV and live environments.

This is not simply a project management role. We need someone who can come into a project, quickly understand what needs to happen, create structure, identify gaps and risks, and drive the team and client towards delivery.

The Senior Producer owns delivery, not the creative or technical answer. The Creative Director owns creative quality. Technical/Technology Leads own technical architecture and specialist decisions. Discipline leads own their areas of execution.

The Senior Producer owns making sure the right people make the right decisions at the right time, with the right information, within the agreed scope, schedule and budget.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

### **Your Roles & Responsibilities**

#### **Project Delivery Ownership**

The Senior Producer will own the delivery mechanics across projects, including:

* **Scope** — ensuring everyone is clear on what we are and are not delivering.
* **Schedule** — building and managing realistic programmes, milestones and dependencies.
* **Budget** — managing project budgets, estimates, forecasts, vendor costs, invoices and margin.
* **Resourcing** — identifying the right internal and external talent and managing capacity.
* **Client & stakeholder management** — driving communication, decisions, approvals and expectations.
* **Risk, quality & change control** — identifying issues early, managing dependencies and protecting scope, quality and margin.
* **Documentation & handover** — ensuring requirements, decisions, approvals, deliverables and project information are properly documented.

#### **Project Management & Execution**

From pre-sales through to closeout, you should be able to independently:

* Turn a client brief/RFP into a clear scope, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, schedule and budget.
* Build and manage project plans, resource plans and budgets.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary internal teams and external freelancers/vendors.
* Work closely with Creative, Technology, Design and Production leads without trying to own their specialist decisions.
* Run client meetings, internal kickoffs, reviews and production cadences.
* Establish clear deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria and approval processes.
* Manage procurement, vendor quotes, contracts and change orders.
* Maintain RAID/risk, decision and change logs.
* Track project financials, resource utilisation, vendor spend and forecast-to-complete.
* Manage client feedback and prevent fragmented or uncontrolled scope expansion.
* Coordinate technical design, prototyping, integration, QA/UAT and installation where required.
* Be comfortable with the realities of physical production and live environments — site surveys, fabrication, AV, logistics, installation, commissioning and launch.
* Drive projects through to handover, warranty/support and financial closeout.

### **The Kind of Projects**

You should be comfortable managing projects where multiple disciplines come together, potentially including:

**Strategy UX/UI Creative Content 3D/Motion Software Hardware AV Fabrication Installation Launch**

Experience with immersive, experiential, digital experience, exhibition, entertainment, retail, cultural, branded or technology-led projects would be highly relevant.

### *

**Job Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator at The Fischer Group supports the Supply Chain Team by coordinating purchasing information and processes that help ensure materials and labor reach Fischer Homes job sites accurately and on time. In this role, you will help maintain purchase orders, vendor and pricing records, and trade partner capacity information for the divisions you support. Your attention to detail and follow-through will help keep purchasing activities organized and give internal teams and trade partners the information they need.

*You Will Thrive in This Role If You…*

* Take a detail-focused approach to maintaining purchasing, vendor, pricing, and payment information.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with trade partners and internal partners across field management, estimating, accounting, and purchasing.
* Investigate questions using available information and help identify practical, solution-focused next steps.
* Stay organized while managing recurring reports, administrative work, and requests that vary by task and timing.
* Use sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality when handling work-related information.
* Work comfortably with office productivity applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint or Google equivalents.

*These skills will be used to:*

* Support Senior and Lead Purchasing Coordinators with assigned tasks and provide administrative support to the Supply Chain Team.
* Coordinate communication among trade partners, field managers, estimating, and accounting for one or more supported divisions.
* Create purchase orders as requested by the Purchasing Manager and maintain standard vendor lists for supported communities.
* Enter and maintain vendor pricing, create relevant bid items, and complete other ERP-related tasks.
* Help Purchasing Managers keep trade partner capacity information accurate in relevant systems.
* Research purchase order and payment information and distribute reports on weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual schedules, as required.

*Required Qualifications:*

* High school diploma or equivalent.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Associate or bachelor's degree.
* Experience in the homebuilding industry.
* Experience in a role with purchasing- or procurement-related responsibilities.

*Physical demands and work environment:*

* Must be able to use sensory skills (i.e. verbal communication) to effectively communicate and interact with other Associates and customers.
* Must be able to perform repetitive motions and use fine motor skills (i.e. typing, writing) to operate office supplies (i.e. computer, calculator, copier).
* Must be able to lift and carry approximately 20-25lbs unassisted.
* Must be able to sit for long periods of time with low periods of reaching and standing.

**The Value of a career with Fischer Homes**

Fischer Homes is one of the largest and most reputable home builders in the Midwestern and Southeastern states. Founded in 1980, the company has grown to build over 40,000 homes and employs over 700 Associates. Fischer Homes' solid reputation has been built largely by the talent of our Associates as we have been recognized as the 32nd largest builder in the United States.

We value diversity within the Fischer Homes organization and see each Associate as a team member and valuable asset. We select highly competent individuals to join our team, provide them with the resources, training, and development possible to make significant contributions and drive their success while determining their career paths. The rewards for their efforts are:

* Professional Development Training programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Competitive Compensation
* 401(k) with Company matching contributions and profit-sharing
* Employee Life Insurance
* Personal time off
* Inclusive Leave

Fischer Homes holds the highest ethical standards of business. We are honest and straightforward and will stand by our word. Our actions demonstrate respect, courtesy, and above all, fairness.

In this role, you will help maintain purchase orders, vendor and pricing records, and trade partner capacity information for the divisions you support. Your attention to detail and follow-through will help keep purchasing activities organized and give internal teams and trade partners the information they need.

*You Will Thrive in This Role If You…*

* Take a detail-focused approach to maintaining purchasing, vendor, pricing, and payment information.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with trade partners and internal partners across field management, estimating, accounting, and purchasing.
* Investigate questions using available information and help identify practical, solution-focused next steps.
* Stay organized while managing recurring reports, administrative work, and requests that vary by task and timing.
* Use sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality when handling work-related information.
* Work comfortably with office productivity applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint or Google equivalents.

*These skills will be used to:*

* Support Senior and Lead Purchasing Coordinators with assigned tasks and provide administrative support to the Supply Chain Team.
* Coordinate communication among trade partners, field managers, estimating, and accounting for one or more supported divisions.
* Create purchase orders as requested by the Purchasing Manager and maintain standard vendor lists for supported communities.
* Enter and maintain vendor pricing, create relevant bid items, and complete other ERP-related tasks.
* Help Purchasing Managers keep trade partner capacity information accurate in relevant systems.
* Research purchase order and payment information and distribute reports on weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual schedules, as required.

*Required Qualifications:*

* High school diploma or equivalent.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Associate or bachelor's degree.
* Experience in the homebuilding industry.
* Experience in a role with purchasing- or procurement-related responsibilities.

*Physical demands and work environment:*

* Must be able to use sensory skills (i.e. verbal communication) to effectively communicate and interact with other Associates and customers.
* Must be able to perform repetitive motions and use fine motor skills (i.e. typing, writing) to operate office supplies (i.e. computer, calculator, copier).
* Must be able to lift and carry approximately 20-25lbs unassisted.
* Must be able to sit for long periods of time with low periods of reaching and standing.

**The Value of a career with Fischer Homes**

Fischer Homes is one of the largest and most reputable home builders in the Midwestern and Southeastern states. Founded in 1980, the company has grown to build over 40,000 homes and employs over 700 Associates. Fischer Homes' solid reputation has been built largely by the talent of our Associates as we have been recognized as the 32nd largest builder in the United States.

We value diversity within the Fischer Homes organization and see each Associate as a team member and valuable asset. We select highly competent individuals to join our team, provide them with the resources, training, and development possible to make significant contributions and drive their success while determining their career paths. The rewards for their efforts are:

* Professional Development Training programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Competitive Compensation
* 401(k) with Company matching contributions and profit-sharing
* Employee Life Insurance
* Personal time off
* Inclusive Leave

Fischer Homes holds the highest ethical standards of business. We are honest and straightforward and will stand by our word. Our actions demonstrate respect, courtesy, and above all, fairness.

**The Enterprise Civil Division under the Digital Sector at Leidos is seeking a Business Development (BD) Manager to drive growth across an assigned portfolio of Civilian accounts.**

* This individual will track agency budget, policy, and acquisition shifts, including GSA-centralized IT buying, shared-services vehicles, and assisted acquisitions, and translate them into positioning moves.

description:
**SUMMARY**

Ajax Building Company, part of STO Building Group, is seeking a Mission Critical Project Executive to lead large-scale data center projects from preconstruction through commissioning and turnover. This role is accountable for project profitability, client satisfaction, and team performance, providing executive oversight of safety, quality, schedule, and risk while building long-term client relationships.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Lead project managers, superintendents, and MEP leaders across assigned data center projects; establish priorities, staffing plans, and accountability.
* Serve as the primary executive contact for owners, design teams, and trade partners; resolve escalated issues and develop repeat business.
* Oversee preconstruction, budgeting, constructability, value engineering, subcontractor selection, and procurement strategy.
* Manage financial performance, including forecasts, cost controls, general conditions, billing, collections, and change orders; identify opportunities to improve profitability.
* Review contracts and scopes, manage commercial risk, and ensure compliance with project obligations and company procedures.
* Drive schedules and coordinate long-lead equipment, owner-furnished contractor-installed (OFCI) packages, utility readiness, and phased turnover milestones.
* Oversee integration of critical electrical and mechanical systems, including commissioning, integrated systems testing, and operational readiness.
* Hold teams accountable for safety and quality; monitor progress and promptly escalate significant budget, schedule, or delivery risks to leadership.
Ensure complete closeout, warranties, record documentation, and final financial reconciliation; capture lessons learned to improve future projects.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 15 years of commercial general contractor project management experience, including senior leadership of complex projects.
* Proven success delivering large-scale data center projects from preconstruction through commissioning and turnover; hyperscale experience preferred.
* Willingness to travel and stay near project sites for extended assignments (primarily across the Eastern region and Midwest).
* Strong understanding of critical power and cooling systems, MEP coordination, equipment procurement, commissioning, and phased delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multiple project teams, manage financial performance and contractual risk, and build lasting client relationships.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to visit and navigate active construction sites and perform essential job duties, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**ABOUT AJAX**

Founded in 1958, Ajax Building Company is a leading commercial contractor delivering complex, high-impact projects across the Southeast. Our work spans healthcare, K–12, higher education, justice, municipal, mission critical, and other institutional markets—giving our teams the opportunity to build projects that truly impact the communities they serve.

At Ajax, you’ll find a collaborative, team-oriented culture where your contributions are valued, backed by the strength and stability of STO Building Group’s $15B global platform. As we continue to grow, our employees take on meaningful responsibility, gain exposure to diverse and challenging work, and have clear paths for career advancement.

**BENEFITS**

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, Paid Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program

This role ensures project timelines are realistic, integrated, and executed efficiently within the plant environment. The Master Scheduler will work closely with the Business Unit, Project Management, Materials Management and Production teams to align internal construction activity with overall site priorities and customer delivery commitments with Pelzer's Factories. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining the master project schedule related to integration activities, identifying dependencies between disciplines, and ensuring that construction milestones and plant works are tracked and achieved according to scope. **Company Description**

SAP is the global market leader for business software and related services, and SAP National Security Services Inc.® (SAP NS2®) is an independent U.S. subsidiary, offering SAP solutions with specialized levels of security and support to meet the requirements of U.S. national security and critical infrastructure customers.

**This position requires access to customer data; candidates must be U.S. citizens and able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for customer access. SAP NS2 does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. All internal candidates must have manager approval to transfer.**

**Job Description**

**What You’ll Bring**

You bring deep expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Human Capital Management, enterprise solution architecture, and customer advisory services. You translate workforce strategy, business-process needs, and customer requirements into secure, scalable HCM solution recommendations. You engage confidently with senior business and technology stakeholders, shape solution approaches, lead discovery sessions and architecture reviews, and clearly communicate solution options, risks, and tradeoffs. You bring a collaborative mindset, strong written and verbal communication skills, and a commitment to mentoring colleagues and sharing HCM architecture expertise. Experience with SAP HCM on-premise, S/4HANA, or hybrid HCM landscapes is valued.

**What You’ll Build**

You will help shape and position SAP NS2 HCM solutions for U.S. national security, federal, and critical-infrastructure customers. As an HCM solution advisor, you will support customer discovery, solution strategy, architecture assessments, roadmap development, implementation planning, and optimization. You will partner with sales teams to develop proposals and request-for-proposal responses, present solution approaches, and help customers understand the value of SAP NS2 HCM services.

You will define and validate secure HCM application, data, integration, security, and access architectures across SAP and non-SAP systems. You will advise customers on practical approaches for SuccessFactors capabilities, including Employee Central, talent management, recruiting, learning, workforce analytics, and payroll, as applicable. In partnership with delivery, security, engineering, operations, product, and sales teams, you will support key design decisions, solution quality reviews, and critical customer situations. You will also contribute reusable architecture patterns, strengthen the HCM services portfolio, and mentor team members.

**Where You Belong**

You will join a collaborative SAP NS2 consulting community that delivers SAP solutions with specialized security and support for U.S. national security, federal, and critical-infrastructure customers. You will work alongside consultants, architects, engineers, security professionals, and customer-facing teams who value customer trust, practical innovation, continuous learning, and inclusive teamwork. Your expertise will help mission-focused customers modernize HR operations securely while shaping high-impact HCM transformation strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success serving as an SAP SuccessFactors HCM Solution Architect, Lead Consultant, or trusted advisor for complex customer transformation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in SuccessFactors Employee Central and multiple HCM domains, such as Recruiting, Learning, Performance and Goals, Succession, Workforce Analytics, or Employee Central Payroll.
* Ability to design and communicate end-to-end HCM application, data, integration, security, and access architectures across SAP and non-SAP systems.
* Experience supporting pre-sales activities, including customer discovery, solution strategy, proposal development, request-for-proposal responses, demonstrations, or solution presentations.
* Strong workshop facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to advise senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Knowledge of cloud security, data protection, and compliance considerations for regulated customer environments.
* U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for customer access.

**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.

**About Us**

For over 60 years, **M. J. Electric, LLC,** a Quanta Services company, has built-long standing working relationships and an industry-wide reputation as the single source solution to our customer’s electrical utility construction and maintenance needs.

MJE values integrity, is inspired by our work, and is invested in delivering quality projects for our customers. Our culture is a product of our core values and operating principles which unite our personnel. Their professional competence and intelligent innovation result in outstanding customer satisfaction. We stand by everything we do.

We are committed to investing in our employees and their growth through training, tools, equipment, industry-leading safety measures, advancement opportunities and more. At M. J. Electric, you aren’t just applying for job, you are building a career.

**About this Role – Senior Project Manager - Substation**

We are looking for a talented Senior Project Manager that has a passion for quality construction. This position is responsible for providing oversight, coordination, management support and technical expertise for all aspects of overhead substation construction, maintenance, modification and replacement.

**What You’ll Do**

* Work closely with Project Managers and customers to ensure crews and contractors are coordinated to work efficiently and meet contracting requirements, budgets, forecasts and schedules. Ensures that barriers to construction progress are removed in a timely manner
* Demonstrate safety leadership by supporting the implementation and management of the MJE Safety Management System. Promote proactive and preventive safety activities by observing, analyzing, encouraging safe work behaviors and correcting unsafe conditions. Integrate safety into project plans, establish safety goals, reinforce safety policies and procedures, support safety training, and monitor safety metrics. Support and coach supervisors and employees, provide feedback to encourage learning and create awareness, set priorities and focus on continuous improvement
* Coordinate the bidding of overhead transmission and distribution projects
* Assist Project Managers with project scope development and project authorization through completion
* Ensure that MJE Senior Management is kept current on the progress of construction projects, business opportunities and industry trends
* Systematically and regularly appraise and evaluate project progress against established goals, timelines and objectives. Provide assistance to Project Managers to correct deficiencies in these areas
* Consult with Utilities, Clients and Owners regarding design requirements, job specifications, bid requirements and offer technical expertise regarding construction solutions
* Understand critical design requirements of on-going projects and continuously monitor construction quality to ensure compliance within established tolerances
* Promote and develop common systems and processes to provide proper accounting, reporting of project costs, customer billing, scheduling, material procurement, record keeping, documentation and budgeting by Project Managers
* Interface with key customers to ensure that construction activities in affected areas are communicated and understood
* Act to ensure key project input including environmental, regulatory and governmental relations, public relations and landowner concerns are appropriately addressed on construction projects throughout the region
* Delegate activities, responsibilities, and authorities, ensuring appropriate levels and assignments of accountability are defined and understood
* Assist in the hiring, orientation and career development of Project Managers
* Assist with the development and tracking of key performance metrics
* Stay current on construction management trends and ensure Project Management personnel are informed of significant changes
* Monitor equipment type, purchases, usage, inspection, maintenance, and servicing throughout the region

**What You’ll Bring**

* Extensive (10+) years of Substation construction experience.
* Extensive project management skills with a track record of achievement of complex projects.
* Knowledge, interpretation and administration of collective bargaining agreements.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiations skills.
* Strong PC skills and software proficiency.
* Strong managerial/leadership skills.
* Ability to provide oversight to numerous projects throughout a large geographic area
* Customer service skills
* Supervisory Experience
* Ability to oversee large complex projects, portfolio of small projects or be a single point of contact for a large customer
* BS/BA in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related is preferred

**What You’ll Get**

* 401(k) with company match (Traditional & Roth)
* Paid Holidays and PTO
* Medical, Dental, and Vision

description:
**About Belite Bio**

Belite Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical drug development company focused on advancing novel therapeutics targeting retinal degenerative eye diseases with significant unmet medical needs. Built on our proprietary Retinol Binding Protein 4 (RBP4) IP portfolio, our clinical pipeline includes **Tinlarebant (LBS-008)**, an oral therapy currently in late-stage clinical trials (including the Phase 3 DRAGON and PHOENIX studies) for Stargardt disease (STGD1) and Geographic Atrophy (GA) in dry AMD.

At Belite Bio, we are dedicated to developing innovative solutions to treat untreatable conditions and prevent vision loss in patients worldwide. As an early-stage company, we value entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, accountability and the ability to thrive in fast moving environments.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Manager, Commercial Supply Operations, will support the establishment and management of a robust and effective global supply chain to support commercial supply of tinlarebant. This position will report to Director of Global Supply Chain and have a critical role in realizing the vision for Belite’s supply chain organization by supporting the development and maintenance of processes to ensure continuous commercial supply while maintaining regulatory and quality compliance. This is a remote position in United States; however, preference is for candidate to reside in San Diego county, California

**Key Responsibilities**

This role will support production planning, global logistics and warehousing, global supply chain procurement, planning and sourcing, demand management, end-to-end inventory strategy and materials management, global trade compliance, security and integrity and packaging. This role will also support the development and implementation of the standard business processes, including quality-related activities, to support the launch of new products; business integrations and subsequent supply operations of external partners.

**Competencies**

* Leadership and interpersonal skills, including a collaborative and team-oriented approach.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, detail-oriented personality, and ability to work and drive change across functions.
* Good organizational, time management and computer and software skills.
* Flexible, able to learn and implement new techniques, technologies, and novel approaches.
* Ability to quickly react to and mitigate unforeseen challenges.
* Ability to build strong relationships with co-workers, suppliers and external partners.
* Ability to function at a high level in a team setting whether leading the group or acting as an individual contributor.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree; focused on Supply Chain Management and/or APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional certification is a plus.
* Experience with Biotech startups and orphan disease space.
* 7 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry with at least 4 years’ work experience in a commercial supply setting, preferably in international markets.
* Demonstrated experience with oversight of secondary packaging and distribution partners.
* Demonstrated experience with pre-launch and commercial launch activities of a new ethical drug including production planning, system design and implementation.
* Proven record of accomplishment in GMP/GDP pharmaceutical or biotech organizations.
* New product launch and/or establishment of supply chain for new markets, including selection and integration of new external manufacturing and commercial partners.
* Knowledge of DSCSA requirements is a plus.
* Design and deployment of new business processes and supply change management systems (Supply Chain Quality, ERP, S&OP, demand management, etc.).
* Strong team leadership and change management experience for routine market supply and market expansion.
* Strong quality and compliance background
* Work history in a virtual or semi-virtual pharmaceutical company.

**Equal Employment Opportunity & Accommodations**

Belite Bio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Belite Bio is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interviewing process due to a medical condition or disability, please contact human resources to let us know the nature of your request.

**Salary Disclosure**

Pay Range: $145,000 to $170,000 USD (Salary offered will depend on candidate location, market rate adjustments, skills, and relevant experience).

* Assists in identifying and developing innovative methods for improving project management processes and techniques against current SOPs.
* Provides mentorship to all developing individuals within the project management group and the design disciplines.

* 10+ years of industry experience in Project Management.
* Project Management Institute (PMP certification preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, or planning.
* A minimum of 5 years of Pharmaceutical/GMP project experience.
* Skilled in the use of IT tools, including spreadsheets, word processing, planning, and scheduling software.
* Understanding of Earned Value and other project control methods.

* Travel duration, if any, is based on project complexity and location.

**GFT** is seeking a Senior Construction Manager/ Resident Engineer to support our growing construction management practice in California and the West Coast. This position will lead construction management teams from the field in the execution of CM projects and support our design teams with constructability reviews. Location flexible; office and project locations in the areas of Irvine, Los Angeles, Sacramento and Seattle to work on water resources projects in California or other West Coast agencies with large infrastructure, such as dams, spillways, levees, pipelines, pump stations, canals, wells, W/WW treatment facilities and/ or groundwater recharge facilities.

At **GFT**, we’re not just engineering the future; we’re meticulously building it. Our comprehensive suite of construction and program management services reflects our unwavering commitment to excellence, safety, innovation, and sustainability. Our construction management services are the cornerstone of our commitment to transforming communities and enhancing lives. We oversee every construction phase to help ensure projects are completed on schedule, within budget, and to the highest safety and quality standards.

**What you’ll be challenged to do:**

* Serve as Lead Construction Manager or Resident Engineer on large water-related construction projects with construction costs from up to $100M or more including, but not limited to, dams, spillways, levees, pipelines, pump stations, canals, wells, and groundwater recharge facilities.
* Lead and be responsible for project-specific CM teams including GFT staff and sub-consultants, with functions including, but not limited to, Resident Engineering, Office Engineering, Construction Quality Assurance, Construction Inspection, Surveying, Materials Testing, Contact Administration, Change Management, Cost and Schedule Analysis, Document Control, Environmental Compliance Monitoring and Public Outreach.
* Be based on-site full-time during project execution, or as appropriate for project and Client needs.
* Develop and implement Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and Health and Safety Plans as required by GFT and Client policies.
* Communicate and coordinate with other project participants including Client, Designer, Contractor and Regulators to expeditiously resolve construction-related issues including, but not limited to, cost overruns, schedule delays, procurement delays, quality deficiencies, regulatory non-compliance, environmental non-compliance, permit non-compliance, change orders, operational impacts and public complaints.
* Be Client-facing during project execution, reporting to the Client on progress and receiving feedback, and communicating and coordinating additional Client needs to appropriate GFT staff.
* Supervise and provide feedback on staff performance during project execution.
* Mentor and guide GFT staff to develop their CM skills during project execution.
* Lead additional CM services as needed including, but not limited to, Risk Management, Dispute Resolution and Claims Analysis.
* Support engineering and design teams as needed including, but not limited to, feasibility reviews of planning-level studies, constructability review of design plans and specifications, biddability review of contract documents, input to construction methods and sequencing, input to construction cost estimates and schedules, contractor prequalification and review of contractor bids.
* Support internal CM training programs.
* Support hiring efforts including review of candidate resumes and participation in candidate interviews.
* Support GFT administrative and operations teams with project and reporting and invoicing.

:

**What you will bring to our firm:**

* 15-25 years or more of previous related professional experience.
* Experience with Construction Management of water resources projects in California or other West Coast agencies with large infrastructure, such as dams, spillways, levees, pipelines, pump stations, canals, wells, W/WW treatment facilities and/ or groundwater recharge facilities.

**What we prefer you bring:**

* Excellent interpersonal, communication, writing, team leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong capability to work remotely and independently while maintaining productivity and motivation.
* Familiarity with MS Office, MS Project, Primavera P6, and other typical construction management related software.
* Ability to take and pass all GFT required construction safety related training courses.
* Willing to travel to jobsites.
* Valid U.S. driver’s license.

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.

**Featured Benefits:**

* Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
* Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
* Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.

description:
Position Summary:

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on *Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives*.

**Senior Project Manager – Utility Infrastructure & Technical Delivery**

**Position Summary**

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the engineering execution, turnkey procurement lifecycles, and delivery of complex utility infrastructure, capital expansion, and technical modernization projects. This role drives multi-site projects from initial feasibility through design, full-lifecycle material sourcing, remote logistics, and final delivery.

Serving as the primary client interface, the Senior Project Manager implements schedule and scope controls, manages complex supply chains for geographically diverse sites, and leads the development of engineering deliverables. The ideal candidate excels at managing full-lifecycle turnkey deployments, scaling standardized frameworks, driving procurement accountability, and translating highly complex technical processes into structured, field-ready deliverables.

Responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Team Leadership & Program Scaling**

* Lead engineering delivery for complex utility infrastructure programs, multi-site system expansions, and turnkey technical asset rollouts.
* Direct cross-functional design teams across various disciplines (electrical, civil, structural, environmental, land/real estate) to deliver complete, integrated packages.
* Provide direction, coaching, and leadership to project teams and technical coordinators across multiple office locations.
* Establish project frameworks for consistent, repeatable execution across multiple geographic locations while avoiding scope fragmentation.
* Direct design quality reviews and interdisciplinary coordination to ensure all engineering deliverables meet quality, accuracy, and consistency standards.

**Turnkey Procurement & Supply Chain Management**

* Oversee full procurement lifecycles for major utility assets, specialized hardware packages, and multi-site installation deployments.
* Manage comprehensive Bills of Materials (BOM), ensuring the strategic sourcing, packing, and validation of complete installation packages.
* Lead the development of technical and commercial documents, request-for-proposal (RFP) packages, equipment requisitions, and vendor scoring matrices.
* Drive contract negotiations and vendor selection, managing trade ally performance and holding suppliers contractually accountable to quality and deployment schedules.

**Client Interface & Public-Sector Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for investor-owned utilities, municipal utilities, and public-sector infrastructure clients (e.g., federal/state agencies).
* Build and maintain robust relationships with utility clients, executive leadership teams, and public decision-makers.
* Lead project status meetings, executive reviews, and formal stakeholder engagements to clearly communicate complex engineering recommendations, progress, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Manage client expectations while driving accountability to ensure, and project milestones are met within turnaround windows.

**Schedule, Scope, and Remote Logistics Management**

* Develop and manage detailed project scopes, schedules critical path, resource plans.
* Monitor project performance KPIs, engineering productivity, and schedule milestones across concurrent projects to ensure timely delivery.
* Mitigate environmental and seasonal risks by embedding contingency planning directly into the master program schedule.
* Implement change management processes, evaluating and managing impacts to engineering scope, procurement budgets, and project baselines.
* Coordinate turnkey logistical planning for shipping critical materials, tools, and consumables to domestic and remote locations, including oversight of customs clearances and final job-site transportation.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible engineering project management, program delivery, or owner's engineering experience overseeing Turnkey/EPC projects within the utility, energy infrastructure, or public infrastructure sect

description:
**What You Will Do**

The Program Office for LANL's Project Nexus is responsible for successful implementation of SAP/S4 HANA and SAP SuccessFactors, replacing Oracle EBS and Hitachi AssetSuite. The Program Office is responsible for coordinating all project activities, including planning, execution, and monitoring, ensuring alignment with business objectives. It also manages risk, budget, and timeline adherence. Working closely with stakeholders across the Laboratory, the Program Office provides governance, integration, and oversight to ensure successful delivery of modernized business processes and systems that support the Laboratory's mission. This position, in addition to the Program Office, will reside within ALDBUS-ERP and report to the Project Nexus Senior Director.

As the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Program Manager, you will provide leadership and overall management of the Project Nexus EAM portfolio, encompassing maintenance management, asset management, and property management. You will be accountable for leading this complex, cross-organizational scope from planning and design through implementation, deployment, and transition to operations.

The EAM Program Manager will serve as a primary interface among Laboratory business owners, Project Nexus leadership, implementation partners, and organizations whose missions and operations depend on effective management of Laboratory assets. You will exercise significant independent judgment in establishing priorities, integrating work across organizations, resolving issues, managing risk, and ensuring EAM capabilities are successfully delivered in alignment with Laboratory requirements and the broader Project Nexus transformation.

* Lead the SAP/S4 EAM portfolio, including maintenance management, asset management, and property management, from planning and design through deployment and operational transition.
* Develop and execute integrated work plans, establishing priorities, sequencing, resources, milestones, and performance expectations aligned with Project Nexus goals.
* Serve as the primary interface with business owners, Project Nexus leadership, and implementation partners to define requirements, resolve issues, and drive decisions.
* Direct implementation partners and subcontracted resources, ensuring deliverables meet scope, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.
* Provide programmatic leadership across business process design, configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, reporting, and operational readiness.
* Manage portfolio risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; develop mitigation strategies and escalate matters requiring broader program decisions.
* Accountable for scope, cost, schedule, milestones, and overall performance, implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Provide clear and timely status reporting to Project Nexus leadership, governance bodies, and Laboratory stakeholders.
* Integrate safety, security, quality, regulatory compliance, and other Laboratory requirements into EAM planning and execution.

**What You Need**

**This position is open for both internal and external candidates to apply.**

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

* **Program Management:** Expert-level knowledge and experience managing large, complex programs or portfolios, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, milestones, change control, risk, and performance.
* **Enterprise Transformation**: Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise system implementations, business transformations, or comparable cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation.
* **Leadership and Business Partnership:** Consultative experience working with senior business owners and stakeholders to establish priorities, negotiate commitments, resolve conflicts, and drive cross-organizational decisions.
* **Partner and Risk Management:** Experience directing implementation partners, consultants, or subcontractors and managing complex program risks, issues, and dependencies to achieve scope, quality, schedule, and budget commitments.
* **Communication:** Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels, facilitate executive decision-making, build consensus, and provide clear assessments of program performance and risk.

**Education/Experience at the Program Manager 4 Level:** Position requires a bachelor's degree in a related field from an accredited institution and 12 years of directly related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience directly related to the occupation.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of EAM and related business processes, such as maintenance/work management, asset lifecycle management, property management, and/or materials and inventory management.
* Experience with a full-lifecycle ERP implementation (e.g., Oracle Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, Workday), particularly in SAP/S4 EAM.

description:
#### **Role Definition**

The Project Manager is responsible for leading all aspects of project execution from inception through closeout, ensuring safe, high-quality, and efficient delivery of EPC projects. This role provides daily oversight of field operations, proactively manages project controls and reporting to maintain schedule, cost, and margin performance, and serves as the central coordinator among designers, subcontractors, vendors, and field teams. The Project Manager acts as the primary client interface, maintaining clear communication, transparency, and responsiveness to ensure client satisfaction. In addition, this role contributes to the company’s growth by building strong client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and representing the organization with professionalism and integrity to promote repeat and expanded work.

#### **PROTECT PEOPLE**

* Safety comes first in everything I do
* I protect our seat at the table by doing my best work
* I develop myself and others
* I put the needs of the Company and others above my own
* I represent myself and the Company professionally at all times

#### **BUILD RELATIONSHIPS**

* I respect people
* I have a positive attitude
* I collaborate and build healthy external relationships
* I collaborate and build healthy internal relationships
* I engage in healthy conflict
* I act with honesty, integrity, and ethics
* I avoid dramatic and toxic behavior

#### **FOCUS ON END GOALS**

* I focus my efforts on providing valueadded work to the customer; “work in the business”
* I start with the end in mind
* I honor our process
* I act with the greater good of the company and the team in mind
* I embrace the EOS process and take the appropriate amount of time to "work on the business"
* I respect Company resources

#### **DRIVE INNOVATION**

* I offer 2 Second Lean improvements
* I act with a continuous improvement mindset, low tech or high tech
* I think differently to create value and solve problems

#### **TOP 5 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

1. DAY-TO-DAY PROJECT OPERATIONS

* Overall accountability for safe and productive field execution.
* Lead weekly project coordination meetings with the team to ensure safety, quality, and productivity goals are met.
* Review, forecast, and schedule manpower needs and communicate to the appropriate individuals timely.
* Resolve fieldlevel issues quickly to maintain progress and minimize downtime.
* Ensure material procurement, information, and constraints are being managed by the team.
* Maintain compliance with all company and client safety and quality requirements.
* Accountable for the project team following the company’s Core Processes.

2. PROJECT CONTROLS AND REPORTING

* Develop and maintain project schedules, including milestones for engineering, procurement, and construction.
* Ensure timely billing to maximize earned value and cashflow on projects.
* Monitor selfperformed labor budget versus actual to ensure project success.
* Identify and document changes in scope or conditions and initiate change requests as appropriate.
* Forecast Estimated Cost at Completion and expected margins and communicate variances early.
* Conduct monthly project status reporting reviews with senior management.
* Monitor and report on KPI’s and measurable as assigned.

3. COORDINATE DESIGNERS, SUBCONTRACTORS, VENDORS, AND FIELD TEAMS

* Act as the central communication point between engineering, procurement, and construction functions.
* Review design deliverables to ensure design intent aligns with constructability and budget.
* Ensure subcontracts and purchase orders are executed timely to meet the schedule.
* Ensure information flow between the design team and the field is timely and complete.

4. CLIENT RELATIONS

* Serve as the primary client point of contact for all daytoday project matters.
* Lead regular client progress meetings and provide clear, accurate updates on status, issues, and next steps.
* Proactively communicate risks or changes and propose solutions before they escalate.
* Ensure project delivery aligns with client goals for schedule, quality, and cost.
* Maintain professionalism, responsiveness, and integrity in all client interactions.
* Gather client feedback throughout the project and adjust execution approach when needed.
* Support client satisfaction through transparency and problemsolving.

5. BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

* Build and maintain longterm client relationships based on performance and trust.
* Identify potential future projects, scope expansions, or service opportunities with existing clients.
* Support proposal development, estimating, and bid reviews for new work.
* Provide lessons learned and project insights to improve pursuit strategies.
* Represent the company professionally at client meetings, site visits, and industry events.
* Contribute to maintaining a positive reputation that leads to repeat business.

#### **EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon WWGS (Worldwide Grocery Stores) team is seeking an exceptionally motivated and talented Sr. Merchandising Manager with strong customer focus, analytical skills, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

The Sr. Merchandising Manager, Food, is the single-threaded leader for all food merchandising across Amazon Grocery stores. This role owns the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Food department, from space allocation through planogram execution on the shelf. You will drive how food products are presented, organized, and experienced by customers in our physical stores, directly impacting sales performance and the in-store customer experience.

This role reports to the Manager of Merchandising and partners cross-functionally with Category, Supply Chain, Store Operations, and Technology teams.

Key job responsibilities

* Space Strategy and Floor Planning You will own the space strategy for Food, determining how square footage is allocated across food categories to maximize sales and the customer experience. You will develop and maintain floor plans that reflect assortment priorities, seasonal shifts, and business objectives.
* Planogram Development and Execution You will build and maintain planograms that dictate product placement at the shelf level. You will ensure planograms are accurate, executable, and aligned to category strategy. You will own the feedback loop between what is planned and what is executed in-store.
* Fixture Management You will select, place, and manage all fixtures within the Food department, including shelving, endcaps, coolers, and promotional displays. You will partner with store design and operations to ensure fixtures support the merchandising strategy and are maintained to standard.
* Store Execution and Transition Management You will plan and lead all merchandising transitions and resets within Food, ensuring store teams have clear direction, accurate materials, and realistic timelines. You will monitor execution quality and address gaps in real time.
* Cross-Functional Partnership and Change Management You will serve as the Merchandising voice in cross-functional forums, including pre-launch reviews for technology and operational changes that affect the Food department. You will ask questions, raise concerns, and pressure-test changes before they reach the store floor. You will monitor impact post-launch and escalate disruption to store teams or customers.
* Performance Monitoring You will track how merchandising decisions impact sales, inventory, and the customer experience at the department and category level. You will use data to inform space allocation, product placement, and fixture decisions, and adjust plans based on what the data shows.

------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 5+ years of experience in merchandising, space planning, or category management in brick-and-mortar retail
* Experience building and managing planograms using space planning software
* Experience leading merchandising transitions and resets across a multi-store environment
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with buying, operations, and supply chain teams
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into merchandising decisions

* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes from scratch

job_title: Travel Senior Project Manager - Mission Critical
description:
**Summary**

The Senior Project Manager has the experience and expertise to assume a leadership role on individual projects of larger size or greater complexity. May supervise other Project Managers, accountable for their performance and project completion to ensure adherence to Contract Documents and to exceed Owner expectations. Also, provide guidance to assigned Project Teams, acting as the leader for these Project Teams in some instances.

**Duties**

* Champions “The Layton Way” by delivering predictable outcomes for internal teams, external teams, and customers.

* Ensures that “Constructing with Integrity” is delivered by working with honesty, unity, safety, and quality of work.

* Works well with Layton’s “Two in the Box” application working well with your counterpart (Senior Superintendent) to ensure successful project delivery and to strengthen client relationship.

* Supervises Project Teams, providing advice and counsel regarding project management techniques and adherence to plan specifications as well as company culture and procedure.

* Is directly responsible for projected costs and profits for each assigned project.

* Assists in the preparation of estimates for the project.

* Actively participates in negotiating a project’s prime contract; prepares project budget.

* Leads the project team in preparing the Project Management Plan (PMP).

* Participates in value engineering services as appropriate.

* Organizes and holds pre-construction planning and pre-mob meetings.

* Participates in the successful negotiation of all project subcontracts; in obtaining permits and resolving other regulatory requirements as necessary.

* Prepares a project schedule and develops milestones necessary to successfully complete the project in concert with the Project Superintendent.

* Obtains and reviews Contract Documents and determines their completeness and consistency.

* Plans the successful execution of the construction contract.

* Manages project materials and equipment procurement within the project budget and consistent with the project delivery schedule.

* Regularly visits the project site and monitors quantity, costs, safety, quality, and schedule performance with the Project Superintendent & Project Manager.

* Negotiates owner and subcontractor change orders and manages the resulting cost and profit impact.

* Controls the payment of job costs based on document review and approval and coordinates with the job cost accountant for payments and lien releases.

* Coordinates all final close out procedures for the project including as-built drawing, punch lists, final billing, occupancy permit, owner acceptance, project manuals, warranty letters, subcontractor close out, letter of substantial completion, and letter of recommendation.

* Holds post completion project review and provides Estimating & Marketing with information for their data base.

* Participates in the project’s 11-month warranty walk-through with the owner and maintains owner’s relations.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction management or related field.

**Preferred**

* Minimum of eight years project management experience in Mission Critical construction projects.

* Has experience in demonstrating strong ability to manage complex projects.

* Effective working as a team member and knows how to delegate to other team members to achieve organizational and customer goals.

* Skilled at making verbal and written presentations and communications with others.

* Understands estimating concepts to the level required to verify bids, understand market rates, and to process change orders, etc.

* Understands contractual language and concepts and how to protect the company while providing quality service to the client and has a working knowledge of construction laws and practices.

* Understands building codes and other design requirements as well as plans, blueprints, and specifications.

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, ability to resolve problems and issues with co-workers, owners, and subcontractors.

* Excellent negotiation skills and at least one year experience in negotiating contracts.

* Excellent understanding and ability to apply building codes and other design requirements.

* Has integrity: maintains normal standards of ethics, conduct, and organizational policies in job-related activities. Delivers predicable outcomes to internal and external customers.

**Benefits** : The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insuranc

* Prepares project budgets and unit cost reports.

* Coordinates all final close out procedures for the project including as-built drawings,
* close out, letter of substantial completion, and letter of recommendation.
