* Directs organization and preparation of all project documents for storage.
* Participates in PM training.
* Interacts with all company departments to ensure company policy and procedures are carried out and corporate objectives achieved.
* Uses tact to maintain relationships with vendors, owners, architects, community and state officials and the general public.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management or related field.

* Minimum of six or more years project management experience within **Data Center Construction.**
* Has a valid driver's license and a good driving record.
* Has an in-depth knowledge of commercial construction processes.
* Understands estimating concepts to the level required to verify bids, understand market rates, and to process change orders, etc.

Community service participation.

description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Operations Manager to lead and optimize our supply chain and distribution functions. This pivotal role involves overseeing end-to-end operations, driving process improvements, and ensuring seamless coordination across warehousing, transportation, and logistics teams. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in supply chain management, team leadership, and operational excellence, with a passion for continuous improvement and efficiency. Join us to shape innovative solutions that elevate our operational performance and customer satisfaction.

**Duties**

* Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of distribution operations, including warehouse management, transportation planning, and freight management to ensure timely delivery and cost efficiency.
* Develop and implement process improvement initiatives utilizing Lean methodologies to streamline workflows, reduce waste, and enhance productivity across all operational areas.
* Manage profit & loss statements by monitoring budgets, controlling costs, and optimizing resource allocation to meet financial targets.
* Oversee inventory management systems and inventory control procedures to maintain optimal stock levels while minimizing excess or obsolete inventory.
* Supervise warehouse operations including shipping & receiving, order fulfillment, dispatching, forklift operations, and warehouse safety protocols.
* Coordinate with third-party logistics providers (3PL), NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), procurement teams, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient supply chain flow.
* Utilize ERP systems such as AS400 or equivalent platforms for data analysis, reporting, demand planning, production planning, and supply chain analytics to support decision-making.
* Lead a team of supervisors and operational staff by providing managerial communication, fostering teamwork, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Implement transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS) to optimize logistics routes, freight costs, and warehouse distribution processes.
* Drive initiatives in procurement, purchasing, fleet management, materials management, and distribution management to enhance overall operational efficiency.

**Skills**

* Proven experience in supervising warehouse operations with a strong understanding of warehouse management systems (WMS) and inventory control techniques.
* Extensive knowledge of supply chain management principles including demand planning, production planning, procurement, freight forwarding (including NVOCC), and distribution operations.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Buyer is responsible for the timely, accurate, and cost-effective procurement of raw materials, tooling, manufacturing supplies, and assigned outside services required to support A1J Technologies’ precision manufacturing operations. As A1J advances from a traditional job-shop model toward a scalable Tier 1 supplier for commercial aerospace and defense customers, this position strengthens supplier reliability, material traceability, purchasing discipline, and delivery performance.

Reporting to the Supply Chain & Logistics Manager, the Senior Buyer executes sourcing and purchasing activities, negotiates with suppliers, expedites critical requirements, and works cross-functionally with Planning & Production Control, Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistics, and Finance. This is a senior individual-contributor role; purchasing strategy, staffing, and departmental leadership remain with the Supply Chain & Logistics Manager.

1. Procurement Execution & Material Availability

* Execute purchase requisitions and release accurate purchase orders for assigned raw materials, tooling, consumables, MRO items, and approved outside services within delegated authority.
* Review demand, lead times, specifications, inventory availability, and production priorities before placing orders.
* Proactively track open purchase orders, obtain supplier acknowledgments, and expedite shortages or delivery risks affecting production commitments.
* Coordinate substitutions, split deliveries, and alternate sourcing only through the required Engineering, Quality, and commercial approval processes.

2. Supplier Sourcing, Negotiation & Performance

* Identify and qualify prospective suppliers in coordination with Quality and the applicable supplier approval process.
* Solicit and evaluate quotations based on total value, lead time, technical requirements, quality, delivery, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and terms within delegated purchasing authority.
* Track supplier delivery and responsiveness; document recurring issues and support supplier improvement and corrective-action activities.

3. Aerospace, Defense & Purchasing Compliance

* Ensure purchase orders accurately communicate applicable drawings, specifications, revisions, certification requirements, and customer/quality flow downs as provided by authorized functions.
* Purchase from approved sources when required; verify required supplier approvals and coordinate with Quality on supplier status and special-process requirements.
* Support material traceability and required certifications, including mill test reports, certificates of conformity, and applicable lot/heat identification.
* Maintain purchasing records to support AS9100-aligned processes, audit readiness, product safety, configuration control, and prevention of suspect/counterfeit items.
* Escalate export-control, domestic sourcing, customer-approved-source, and other contract-specific requirements to designated compliance owners; do not independently interpret or waive requirements.

4. ERP, Data Accuracy & Purchasing Controls

* Maintain accurate supplier, purchase order, promised date, price, and delivery information in the ERP/MRP system.
* Ensure purchasing transactions, revisions, acknowledgments, and documentation are completed accurately and promptly.
* Partner with Receiving, Inventory/Material Control, and Finance to resolve receiving discrepancies, invoice mismatches, and open purchase order issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize purchasing workflows, reduce manual followup, and improve supplier and material visibility.

5. Cross-Functional Production Support

* Coordinate with Planning & Production Control on demand changes, critical shortages, and recovery schedules.
* Work with Manufacturing Engineering and CNC Programming to confirm purchasing requirements for raw material, tooling, and manufacturing support items.
* Partner with Quality and Receiving on rejected, damaged, incomplete, or uncertified incoming material; support supplier returns and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Logistics and outside-processing coordinators on material movements, subcontracted operations, and supplier commitments where assigned.
* Communicate procurement risks and mitigation actions clearly and promptly to stakeholders.

6. Cost Improvement & Continuous Improvement

* Identify documented savings through competitive sourcing, supplier consolidation, negotiated pricing, and process improvements without compromising product conformity or delivery.
* Analyze recurring expedite charges, lead-time variance, shortages, and purchasing inefficiencies; recommend sustainable corrective actions.
* Support standard work, supplier scorecards, purchasing KPIs, and disciplined continuous-improvement initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Supplier On-Time Delivery – delivery against confirmed suppli

**Senior Engagement Manager**

**Position Overview:**

With a healthy pipeline of new opportunities, Intapp continues to expand, and we have exciting plans for the next few years. We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to join our Professional Services team. As a Senior Engagement Manager, you will work within the Client Services division to ensure the successful delivery of client-facing projects — keeping engagements on schedule, within scope, and on budget from kickoff through close-out.

**What You Will Do:**

* Work with teams across the Client Services division to keep client-facing projects on track, delivering on schedule and within scope.
* Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.
* Track and analyze project budget performance, including expenditures and procurement, reporting on any current or potential blockers, risks, overflows, and deficits.
* Track and analyze project scope and schedule, reporting to management on any changes or risks, and recommending improvements and mitigations.
* Escalate projects to management and key internal stakeholders as needed, and maintain and report on the projects pipeline.
* Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, and close out projects at completion, passing project deliverables and documentation to operations.

**What You Will Need:**

* 8–12 years of experience in a Project Manager/Engagement Manager role, ideally working with enterprise software.
* A degree and a commitment to continued project management career growth.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking.
* Ability to work well with large and diverse virtual teams and to perform under pressure.
* Experience with task scheduling and with project management practices and tools to create, manage, and track project performance.
* Excellent client-facing, internal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Experienced user of the MS Office toolset.
* Experience in the legal, financial, or professional services sectors is a plus.

**What You Will Gain:**

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

* **Expand Your Skills:** Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
* **Enjoy Where You Work:** Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
* **Support What Matters Most:** Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

description:
### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We've proven we can build Nodes in small quantities. This role exists to make the path to repeatable production move faster. Manufacturing Technology defines the qualification requirements for each Node manufacturing process and owns delivery of the qualified process set. You will track readiness against those requirements — maintaining visibility into where each process stands, what evidence is still outstanding, and what is blocking it — and coordinate the cross-functional execution planning that closes the gaps. Your primary deliverable is velocity: sequencing process development work, surfacing constraints before they bite, and keeping engineering effort pointed at the qualification gates that matter most to the pilot program

This role is based at our new Pilot Manufacturing campus in Vancouver, Washington — the facility where Ocean-3 Nodes stop being drawings and start being steel. We're standing up heavy fabrication, blast and coatings, and full Node integration, which means the process development work happens feet away from the weld seams and the paint booth. You'll help build the line that builds the fleet.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage project milestone schedules for pilot manufacturing process development, ensuring clear communication of status, risks, and dependencies to internal stakeholders.
* Lead design and test sprint planning for the internal manufacturing team, balancing resource constraints and competing priorities across projects.
* Drive clear-to-build decisions, closing gaps across engineering release, material availability, tooling, and work instructions ahead of build start.
* Support the transition from development to pilot production by facilitating manufacturing readiness reviews and DFM feedback to engineering.
* Collaborate with the internal procurement team, external suppliers, and fabrication partners to ensure timely, high-quality delivery of components.
* Coordinate new equipment and tooling readiness from delivery through qualification.
* Monitor and escalate program risks, while proactively contributing to mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain documentation and tools that support production execution and scaling, in alignment with TPM best practices.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience managing technical programs in a manufacturing process development environment, including direct responsibility for coordinating materials, equipment availability, and teams to support learning plan execution in a pilot production environment.
* 5+ years working in hardware engineering or manufacturing engineering environments.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to meet aggressive program timelines.
* Direct experience working with change management systems, PLM/MES/ERP tools, and configuration control processes.
* Experience coordinating external suppliers and fabrication partners.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative environment.
* Ability to travel as needed for site visits and partner engagements.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* Experience across the full manufacturing lifecycle, from early development through pilot, ramp, and sustaining production.
* Experience standing up a new production line or manufacturing facility.
* Strong understanding of engineering f

**Description**

The Senior Project Manager independently manages strategic technology projects and may serve as a Project Manager within a broader program. Projects are typically high in complexity, risk, or visibility and may involve emerging or highly customized technologies, multiple solution areas, complex systems integration, and third-party vendors. The Senior Project Manager owns all aspects of project delivery, from initiation through closure, and works closely with sales, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional delivery teams. This role is accountable for project scope, schedule, financial performance, contractual commitments, risk management, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager may provide guidance and mentorship to other project team members. The role acts as a project advocate, driving results, making difficult decisions, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**What You Will Do**

* Successfully executes projects using CDW-G’s established delivery methodology, adapting the approach where appropriate to meet the needs of each engagement. Manages projects that may span multiple solution areas, service areas, workstreams, technologies, and third-party providers. Ensures the client’s business, technical, contractual, and operational requirements are understood and met.
* Evaluates the client’s project management methodology and incorporates appropriate CDW-G standards, controls, templates, and reporting requirements to create a comprehensive project delivery approach.
* Accountable for project financial performance and profitability. Develops, monitors, interprets, and communicates project budgets, forecasts, margins, and estimate-at-completion projections. Identifies budget-to-actual variances and recommends corrective actions.
* Ensures project time, expenses, invoices, and financial records are accurately tracked, reviewed, and approved in a timely manner. Identifies financial risks and works with project stakeholders to mitigate their impact.
* Understands the financial implications of project decisions and changes, including their potential effect on the client relationship, contractual commitments, and CDW-G profitability.
* Validates initial project scope, assumptions, estimates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Evaluates proposed changes for their impact on scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, contractual commitments, and client outcomes. Develops recommendations and initiates the appropriate change-control actions.
* Establishes strategies to minimize client and project impact resulting from approved or anticipated changes. Communicates impacts and recommendations to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensures all items defined in the CDW Statement of Work are delivered and performs quality assurance throughout the project life cycle.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, documents, and manages project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies. Develops mitigation and contingency plans and communicates exposure, ownership, and required decisions to stakeholders.
* Identifies risks and dependencies originating from related CDW-G initiatives, client environments, vendors, purchasing processes, and external stakeholders. Evaluates their potential effect on the project and coordinates appropriate response plans.
* Proactively conducts resource planning across project workstreams. Monitors and adjusts assignments, capacity, and billable schedules as necessary. Resolves resource and scheduling conflicts and escalates constraints that could affect project delivery.
* Develops, maintains, and communicates integrated project schedules in collaboration with engineering teams, client teams, subcontractors, and third-party vendors. Aligns project dependencies, milestones, contractual dates, and resource commitments.
* Ensures external resources are properly vetted and manages associated contracts through CDW-G or client contract administration and purchasing processes.
* Manages equipment, software, licensing, outside services procurement, and delivery schedules.
* Responsible for meeting contractual performance requirements, deliverables, acceptance criteria, milestones, and due dates throughout project delivery and completion.
* Ensures compliance with applicable corporate, client, and government policies and requirements.

description:
OCI Data Center Strategy is seeking an IC4 Program Manager to lead regional energy policy, regulatory strategy, and external engagement in support of strategic data center growth. This senior individual contributor will serve as OCI’s primary energy-policy and stakeholder-engagement lead in priority data center development regions, shaping how the organization navigates grid, regulatory, and energy-market issues.

This role is designed for someone located in or near a key development region, enabling consistent, in-person engagement with the stakeholders most relevant to OCI’s data center strategy.

**Why OCI / Data Center Strategy**

The role sits at the intersection of infrastructure growth, energy markets, public policy, and data center strategy. It offers broad ownership to develop regional engagement strategies, represent OCI externally, and influence decisions that affect market entry, project timing, grid access, and long-range infrastructure planning.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in energy policy, regulatory affairs, public policy, utility or grid strategy, energy economics, resource planning, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading external engagement with utilities, RTOs/ISOs, grid operators, state agencies, regulatory bodies, trade associations, or other energy-sector stakeholders.
* Experience developing and executing regional policy, regulatory, or stakeholder-engagement strategies that influence business outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of energy markets, grid planning and operating rules, utility regulation, resource planning, large-load interconnection, or related energy infrastructure topics.
* Proven ability to assess complex external developments and translate them into clear strategic recommendations for senior business leaders.
* Strong executive presence, communication skills, and ability to represent the organization credibly in high-stakes external settings.
* Ability to build consensus and influence across internal and external organizations without direct authority.
* Ability to travel periodically for regional external engagement, industry conferences, grid operator and trade association working groups, and internal meetings. Travel will be primarily focused on in-region stakeholder engagement.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead regional energy regulatory, policy, and stakeholder-engagement strategies for priority data center markets.
* Serve as a primary external representative for OCI with utilities, state agencies, grid operators, RTOs/ISOs, trade associations, and other regional stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain senior, productive relationships with external stakeholders that advance OCI’s strategic data center objectives.
* Represent OCI in regional and industry forums, trade association calls, grid operator working groups, regulatory proceedings, conferences, and stakeholder discussions.
* Proactively monitor and interpret rulemakings, policy developments, resource-planning activity, grid operating rules, and large-load integration processes.
* Translate external developments into clear strategic guidance for internal stakeholders, including timing, business impact, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Develop regional intelligence and engagement plans that inform market selection, site development, energy procurement, grid-access strategy, and long-range planning.
* Influence external policy and regulatory outcomes through direct engagement, coalition building, comments, working groups, and industry partnerships.
* Partner closely with Data Center Strategy, energy, real estate, construction, legal, government affairs, and other internal teams to align regional external engagement with business priorities.
Provide leadership, subject-matter guidance, and strategic direction to internal teams on regional energy and regulatory issues.

Overview:

Abacus Technology is seeking a Sr. Acquisition Manager to support the planning, development, implementation and management of a comprehensive, affordable and effective systems support strategy at Tinker AFB. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities:

* Apply knowledge and experience in acquisition program management philosophy, policies, and procedures to Air Force, Navy, and Army systems, subsystems, equipment procurement activities, post award project/program management tasks, and acquisition programs throughout their life cycles.
* Manage and organize resources and personnel needed to efficiently and effectively meet the objectives of each task, as well as explore new approaches as applicable within the performance of these tasks.
* Support the acquisition program management of full life cycle requirements, subsystems, and equipment.
* Assist with the development of documents, such as, but not limited to: Memorandum of Agreement/Memorandum of Understanding (MOA/MOU), PWS, SOW, RFP, Operational Requirements Documents (ORD), Initial Capabilities Documents (ICD), Capability Development Documents (CDD)/Capability Production Documents (CPD), and Analysis of Alternatives (AOA).
* Assist in: the coordination of documentation between functional resources (to include: financial, management, procurement, engineering, and logistics); the consolidation of their inputs into common documents; and in planning for the accomplishment of various program milestones.
* Provide assistance in risk management, project management, process improvement support, and logistics support.
* Participate in process improvement activities as members of, or advisors to, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) and Product/Process Improvement Working Groups (PIWGs).
* Assist in the collection of programmatic inputs from weapons systems program offices for defining, developing, and managing the acquisition and development/upgrades to the various Mobility Directorate aircraft configurations.
* Assist in determining program progress and effectively communicate recommendations to higher organizational management.

Qualifications:

15+ years experience in acquisitions including at least 5 years working in a DoD environment. Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Possess the knowledge, experience and recognized ability in the technical/professional field, possess the ability to perform tasks and oversee the efforts of junior personnel within the technical/professional discipline. Knowledge and previous experience with USAF acquisition and DoD 5000.2 Series. Understanding of current Department of Defense (DoD) and Air Force acquisition regulations, guidelines and processes. Demonstrate knowledge of technical/professional discipline as well as possess a comprehensive understanding and ability to apply associated standards, procedures and practices in their area of expertise. Demonstrate proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Applications, Adobe Acrobat, and applications for access to the world wide web including Microsoft Internet Explorer. Knowledge of logistics policy and guidance to include Title 10 United States Code Section 2466, Limitations on the Performance of Depot-Level Maintenance of Materiel (as amended by the National Defense Authorization Acts [NDAAs]), and all applicable AF systems. Understands the theories and principles of ILS planning, development, and execution sufficient to coordinate and integrate functions into a total, well structured, and viable program. Demonstrate a working knowledge of logistics and maintainability programs to include, but not be limited to, product support RAM-C program test and evaluation planning and execution, technical evaluation and identification of weapon systems logistics requirements and resources. Demonstrate an understanding of budgetary or financial analysis and control and life cycle cost analysis and control. Must be a US citizen and hold a current Secret clearance.

***Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.***

**EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled**

**About Us**

For over 60 years, **M. J. Electric, LLC,** a Quanta Services company, has built-long standing working relationships and an industry-wide reputation as the single source solution to our customer’s electrical utility construction and maintenance needs.

MJE values integrity, is inspired by our work, and is invested in delivering quality projects for our customers. Our culture is a product of our core values and operating principles which unite our personnel. Their professional competence and intelligent innovation result in outstanding customer satisfaction. We stand by everything we do.

We are committed to investing in our employees and their growth through training, tools, equipment, industry-leading safety measures, advancement opportunities and more. At M. J. Electric, you aren’t just applying for job, you are building a career.

**About this Role – Senior Project Manager**

We are looking for a talented Senior Project Manager that has a passion for quality construction. This position is responsible for providing oversight, coordination, management support, financial management and technical expertise for all aspects of power generation, heavy and light industrial, heavy and light commercial, refinery, mining, pulp and paper, and electrical construction projects.

**What You’ll Do**

* Work closely with Project Managers and customers to assure crews and contractors are coordinated to work efficiently and meet contracting requirements, design, budgets, forecasts and schedules. Ensures that barriers to construction progress are removed in a timely manner
* Accountable for overall performance (scope, safety, quality, schedule, reporting, customer relations subcontractors and cost) for a portfolio of projects
* Provided forecasts and cash flows for respective projects
* Prepares project plan according to MJE methodology
* Manages Project costs, including development of recovery plans to stay within budget limits
* Tracks the invoicing and receipt of all customer payments, forecasts and cash flow for projects
* Review and updates financial forecast monthly on a regular basis
* Report project performance data as required, to management and customers
* Organize project documentation
* Develop, optimize and update project schedules for multiple, simultaneous large projects using Primavera, P6
* Accept project assignments through the project's lifecycle
* Demonstrate safety leadership by supporting the implementation and management of the MJE Safety Management System. Promote proactive and preventive safety activities by observing, analyzing, encouraging safe work behaviors and correcting unsafe conditions. Integrate safety into project plans, establish safety goals, reinforce safety policies and procedures, support safety training, and monitor safety metrics. Support and coach supervisors and employees, provide feedback to encourage learning and create awareness, set priorities and focus on continuous improvement
* Participate in the bidding and development of a win strategy of power generation, heavy and light industrial, heavy and light commercial, refinery, mining, pulp and paper and process control instrumentation electrical construction projects
* Assist Project Managers with project scope development and project authorization through completion.
* Ensure that MJE Senior Management is kept current on the progress of construction projects, business opportunities and industry trends
* Systematically and regularly appraise and evaluate project progress against established goals, timelines and objectives. Provide assistance to Assistant Project Managers to correct deficiencies in these areas
* Understand critical design requirements of on-going projects and continuously monitor construction quality to ensure compliance within established tolerances
* Promote and develop common systems and processes to provide for proper accounting, reporting of project costs, customer billing, scheduling, material procurement, record keeping, documentation and budgeting by Project Managers
* Delegate activities, responsibilities, and authorities, ensuring appropriate levels and assignments of accountability are defined and understood
* Assist with the development and tracking of key performance metrics
* Stay current on construction management trends and ensure Project Management personnel are informed of significant changes
* Monitor equipment type, purchases, usage, inspection, maintenance, and servicing throughout the region

**What You’ll Bring**

* Extensive (10+) power generation, heavy and light industrial, heavy and light commercial, refinery, mining, pulp and paper and process control instrumentation electrical construction projects. Extensive project management skills with a track record of achievement of complex projects
* Knowledge, interpretation and administration of collective bargaining agreements
* Strong communication,

About Us:

When military bases, national security agencies, federal buildings, healthcare facilities, and leading commercial clients in Washington D.C and across the nation need superior facility support services, we answer the call. We offer a unique combination of government experience and facilities expertise that has helped us earn a position as one of the country’s leading integrated service providers.

Job Summary:

EMCOR Government Services has an immediate opening for an **Assistant Project Manager in Arlington, VA** supporting the FDIC facilities portfolio in Washington, DC and Arlington, VA, consisting of approximately 2.5 million square feet of office, support, and mission-critical facilities. Reporting directly to the Sr Project Manager, the Assistant Project Manager assists with the daily management of a comprehensive facilities management contract, including building operations, service contract administration, project coordination, work control management, financial oversight, and client engagement.

The Assistant Project Manager provides leadership and oversight to key operational functions, supports the execution of facility and construction-related projects, manages subcontractor performance, and helps ensure contract requirements are achieved safely, efficiently, and in accordance with client expectations. The position serves as a critical member of the contract leadership team and acts as a primary interface with client representatives, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

#EGS

#LI-JC1

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

* Provide direct oversight and supervision of the Work Control Business Manager, IDIQ Manager, and Dockmaster.
* Assist the Sr Project Manager in overseeing the daily operations of the FDIC Washington, DC facilities.
* Manage service contracts, including custodial, elevator, interior plant, landscaping, recycling, pest control, and waste management services, ensuring compliance with contract requirements and performance standards.
* Administer and oversee the Maximo work order system, ensuring proper staff training, data integrity, and effective utilization to support contract operations.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for operational inquiries and coordinate regularly with the client regarding facility operations, service delivery, and contract performance.
* Perform research, analysis, and special projects in support of contract operations and Sr Project Manager initiatives.
* Prepare and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, financial analyses, and other documentation required to support contract operations, client requirements, and company reporting.
* Schedule and participate in meetings and conferences; prepare agendas, meeting minutes, and action item tracking as required.
* Assist with budget development, cost tracking, invoice review, and financial reporting to ensure contract performance remains aligned with budget objectives.
* Coordinate with the Accounting Department to ensure accurate and timely client invoicing, vendor payments, and associated financial documentation.
* Coordinate with Human Resources on personnel matters, including documentation, onboarding, performance-related actions, attendance, leave administration, and timekeeping compliance.
* Create and manage work orders for client-funded projects and tasks, ensuring documentation, billing, performance tracking, and project closeout activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Conduct site walks with clients, develop project requirements, solicit contractor proposals, and evaluate submissions to ensure compliance with scope, budget, and contract requirements.
* Develop scopes of work and coordinate procurement activities for small projects and service requirements.
* Track project status, costs, schedules, and performance metrics, and provide regular updates through weekly and monthly reporting.
* Maintain SharePoint sites, contract files, and operational records to ensure information remains current, accurate, and accessible.
* Respond to safety incidents, conduct investigations, document findings, and prepare required reports and corrective action recommendations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

description:
At Mill Creek Residential we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where our associates can grow and bring their whole selves to work. This starts with our recruiting and hiring process. We want you to know that we encourage you to apply if this job excites you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. You may just be the right candidate for this role, or another role and make your mark at Mill Creek.

Mill Creek Residential is an industry leader in telecommunications, and the Telecommunications Manager will be responsible for leading and maintaining our top of class telecom strategy and continuing to guide us to expand revenue opportunities. The Telecommunications (Telecom) Manager will be responsible for coordinating, reviewing, and negotiating telecom contracts for Mill Creek Residential’s communities. They will need to keep up with new regulations, industry trends, and they will be expected to communicate and educate Mill Creek on their findings.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

* Work across departments to create project specific telecom strategies
* Serve as the main point of contact with our telecommunications lawyers for project kick off calls, proposal gathering, regular project updates, contract reviews, and contract negotiations
* Create revenue models and documentation of telecom summaries for each project
* Work with providers to stay up to date on regional standards and nuances such as revenue sharing, wiring standards, termination clauses, etc.
* Assist project teams with account setup and ordering when ready to turn up services to ensure negotiated contract requirements are met
* Coordinate with onsite teams for the installation of services and the commissioning of services with our infrastructure team
* Participate with NMHC telecom groups to follow updated FCC rulings and regulations
* Develop relationships with national providers, both bulk and retail
* Work across teams during contract renewals, renegotiations, and retrofit providers
* Serve as the main point of contact to our onsite teams for ISP issues
* Must be able to perform work from remote locations as needed

Education and/or Experience

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher or equivalent experience
* Proven experience in the areas of telecommunications as defined above
* Multifamily residential industry experience preferred
* Construction and Engineering industry experience preferred

Skills/Specialized Knowledge

* Knowledge of Real Estate, Multifamily, Telecommunications, and overall technology trends
* Exceptional interpersonal and relationship management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Detail oriented with strong analysis skills and problem-solving ability
* Ability to relate well to all kinds of people, both inside and outside the organization

About the Benefits of joining the Mill Creek Team

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Employer sponsored short and long term disability, Life and ADD insurance
* 401k with employer matching
* Paid time off benefits: Vacation, Sick, Holidays

Mill Creek is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Are you ready to contribute to the success of Mill Creek Residential? If so, apply today and become part of an organization that believes in uncompromising integrity, celebrating successes, continuous improvement, and working hard, smart and together!

**JOB INFORMATION:**

**Job Title:** Assistant Manager of Purchasing

**Department(s):** 5064 - Purchasing

**Location(s):** Hutchinson Island

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

Under the supervision of the Purchasing Manager, the Assistant Manager –Purchasing supervises the Purchasing team with direct reports being the Purchasing Specialist personnel. The Assistant Manager plans, organizes, and coordinates departmental functions. Manages the administrative processes in the procurement of contracts, materials, services, vendor management, and facilitates special projects. Provides support for other departments, often with a high degree of complexity, in obtaining and monitoring contracts for the organization.

Upholds the values of the GPA to promote Safety, Integrity, Respect, Community, Creativity and Opportunity. Promotes a safe work environment by participating in safety initiatives and reporting unsafe conditions and behaviors.

**JOB DUTIES:**

* Manage certain purchasing functions, including analyzing bids and making decisions, subject to review by the Manager, as to bids to accept and contracts to be awarded. The Assistant Manager will exercise discretion and independent judgment in making these determinations.
* Make decisions related to processes and problem-solving issues within the Purchasing Department, while supporting and assisting team members as needed.
* Ensure that prompt, efficient service is provided in procurement of materials, contracts, and special projects. Prepare purchasing requirements and general specifications for bids, RFQ's, and contracts.
* Facilitate soliciting, coordinating, evaluating, and awarding contracts and special projects, via the competitive bid process.
* Manages and conducts pre-bid conferences and facilitates contract resolution.
* Manage and monitor the Purchasing Department functions, workload and daily assignments while planning, scheduling, and monitoring employees' vacation, sick leave, and other absences.
* Provides guidance to internal department regarding purchasing procedures, contract requirements, vendor selection, competitive procurement, and documentation requirements.
* Manages the ERP Vendor Management portal and assists in vendor registration and vendor problem resolution.
* Participates in negotiating conflicting vendor and contract terms and conditions as needed.
* Coordinates with Legal, Risk Management, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering and other departments on procurement related matters.
* Prepare reports, summaries, presentations, procurement data, and correspondence information as requested.
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Good interpersonal skills with vendors and employees essential.
* Good oral and written communications skills required.
* Must have good organizational skills, be able to process a high volume of paperwork, be detail oriented, and have legible penmanship.
* The ability to interact and communicate effectively and professionally with the GPA staff on all levels of administration including immediate supervisor, management and co-workers.

**Experience**

* Five years or more of progressively responsible for governmental purchasing, contracting, or supply-chain experience Preferred
* SAP or Workday, and Maximo experience Preferred
* Experience with Microsoft Office and data entry Required

**Education**

* Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Business or related field

**Licenses & Certifications**

* TWIC - Transportation Worker Identification Credential Required
* Driver's License - Valid state driver's license Required
* Certified Professional Public Buyer Preferred
* Certified Public Procurement Officer Preferred

Note: This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, job requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. Management reserves the right to revise the job or to require the performance of different or additional tasks. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, an without direct threat to the health or safety of others.

Revised: 9/23/2026

***Mission: To empower entrepreneurs, strengthen industries, sustain communities, and fortify families by relentlessly striving to accelerate global commerce.***

Lincoln, Alabama, 35096

1st Shift

$84,200.00 - $126,300.00

**What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda**
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The SCM Site Delivery Frame Local Group Leader is responsible for coordinating daily activities with his/her respective buyers and technical lead support (EX1 – EX4 / Career Levels L3 – L5) to ensure Key Performance Indicators are met by mitigating risk of Downtime, GDP, and Cost from our North American supply base. The Group Leader is also responsible for implementing business plan themes/strategies developed by SC Delivery Department leadership and SCM Business Unit leadership as well as site Delivery budgets.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* Support Site Delivery Frame Unit Leaders/buyers in troubleshooting supplier and/or site-specific issues
* In supporting Local Unit Leader/Regional Unit Leader, lead the execution of Business Plan Themes/Strategies, Budget, Key Performance Indicators
* Lead/maintain critical projects, Business Plan Themes, and other initiatives, present/escalate when necessary
* Benchmark with other HDMA Frame Sites to identify and apply cost saving opportunities
* Engage associates w/in specific site or other HDMA Frame sites to develop & implement system enhancements (Commonization, OWBW, etc) and supplier improvement items
* Lead associate development activities (train, advise, mentor) of assigned buyers

**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills**
------------------------------------------

Minimum Educational Qualifications:

Bachelors’ degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Business Management

Minimum Experience:

8+ years relevant experience

Other Job-Specific Skills:

Provides necessary direction, support, and identifies/develops training for team members to perform their responsibilities
Accurately interprets direction from leadership; clearly communicates and conveys technical, business or policy information appropriately across multiple levels within a unit or group of operation
Takes action to build effective working relationships between individuals from different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints & experiences
Develops and uses benchmarks and performance measures to track progress or identify gaps
Continuously seeks opportunities to improve characteristics, conditions, processes, or products and directs improvement activity; has high sensitivity for loss or abnormal conditions
Understands the business, processes and technology employed across Honda's operational units; applies expertise to generate themes to improve characteristics
Develops solutions to highly complex, systemic problems that impact or involve multiple disciplines, departments, or products; takes initiative to develop and implement improvement themes that permanently countermeasure systemic root causes
Models' own behavior according to Honda Philosophy and can teach / mentor others to ensure company values are at forefront for all actions and decisions
effectively delegates responsibilities while providing support and structure
Creates a positive work environment that encourages high performance and pursuit of goals

**Job Dimensions**
------------------

**No. of Direct Reports**: 5 – 10 buyers

**No. of Indirect Reports**: 5 - 10 buyers on other Group Leader’s team (if applicable)

**Financial Dimensions:** Negotiate compensation requests and design changes between supplier and Honda to mitigate financial risk to Honda while ensuring the timely implementation of changepoint. Support the control of overtime and freight, and design change budgets to meet Ki targets.

**Decisions Expected**
----------------------

* Provide tactical and/or strategic guidance to buyers & leadership related to supplier issues, business plan items, and/or internal department issues
* Strategic direction related to Business Plan and One Way Best Way items
* Support Buyer performance ratings, succession planning, etc…through collaboration w/ Local Unit Leader
* Site Delivery Frame lo

Information Systems Technology Services is a unified organization comprised of various departments which collaborate effectively in order to deliver high quality technology solutions.

description:
Family-run and customer-focused since 1994, Automann has evolved into the leading distributor of HD truck and trailer parts. We sell to regional warehouse distributors, truck/ trailer dealers and specialty repair shops throughout the US, Canada and abroad. With more than 40,000 active parts across 17 categories from Body and Cabin components, Suspension, Steering and just about everything in between. To learn more please visit our website at www.automann.com.

Automann services its distributors out of (4) US Distribution centers; Monroe Township NJ (HQ), New Lennox IL, Duncanville TX and Ontario CA and (2) distribution centers in Canada: Brampton ON and Edmonton AB.

**Summary**

We have an immediate need for Purchasing Associate with the ability to establish and maintain a positive and professional relationship with suppliers and co-workers; cultural sensitivity and ability to relate well and effectively in a diverse workplace.

**Responsibilities**

· The Purchasing Associate is responsible for ensuring the satisfactory availability of goods to customers of the company by studying inventory levels and creating a forecast for expected usage

· Schedule deliveries. Communicate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of products to maintain required inventory levels by monitoring and expediting orders as needed.

· Communicate with suppliers to resolve shipment issues, including defective or unacceptable goods and determine corrective action.

· Negotiate best vendor terms, pricing and delivery based on budget and schedule requirements.

· Load and maintain supplier information in ERP database. Supplier information includes contact information, supplier product pricing, supplier part number, and payment terms. Verify order specifications/packaging and pricing for orders placed.

**Skills & Qualifications**

· 2 years experience / knowledge of supply management required

· 3+ years in sourcing, planning or purchasing roles

· Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and mange time effectively

· Strong attention to detail

· Strong written and verbal skills

· Detail oriented with good mathematical and analytical abilities is necessary

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Word required

. Bachelor’s Degree in a related discipline

· Work is generally routine; most tasks are well defined, but with considerable variation; some phases of the work are less well defined and may require independent action.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive.

Automann, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, sexual identity, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Supply chain management: 2 years (Required)
* Purchasing / Sourcing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:

We are establishing a dedicated Supplier Development capability within Supplier Quality Engineering focused on strategic supply chain initiatives, strengthening supplier capability, and improving long-term supply continuity and resiliency. The Associate Principal Supplier Quality Engineer (Supplier Development) will serve as a technical and program leader for high-priority supplier initiatives, partnering with Strategic Procurement and cross-functional stakeholders to define strategy, align resources, manage interdependent workstreams, and drive programs through execution. This is an opportunity to help shape and grow an emerging organization while leading initiatives with broad business visibility, cross-functional influence, and long-term impact.

This position is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional supplier development programs spanning supplier qualification, capability improvement, risk reduction, and supply continuity. The role will establish program plans, integrate technical and business requirements, manage risks and dependencies, and mobilize internal and external stakeholders to improve supplier quality, scalability, process robustness, and readiness to support business growth. * Drive supplier improvement activities including Kaizen events, process optimization projects, variation reduction efforts, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Perform supplier capability assessments, manufacturing evaluations, and technical due diligence activities
* Support make-versus-buy analyses by providing technical, quality, and manufacturing assessments
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve supplier performance, supply risk, and supplier controls

**Supplier Qualification & Enablement**

* Lead supplier qualification activities including process assessments, manufacturing readiness evaluations, and technical reviews.
* Support complex supplier programs including large qualifications, supplier expansion activities, and supplier capability growth efforts
* Lead supplier stabilization and monitoring activities for new suppliers, outsourced processes, or developing supply chains
* Support Strategic Procurement on:
* + Category strategy and diversification efforts
+ New supplier identification, qualification, and development initiatives
+ Supply risk reduction initiatives and inspection programs
+ Evaluation of outsource programs

**Supply Risk Reduction**

* Assess supplier capability, capacity, scalability, and operational risks that could impact supply continuity
* Support supplier segmentation and risk stratification activities
* Participate in subtier supplier assessments and mitigation efforts when appropriate
* Drive technical risk reduction activities for critical suppliers and supply chain initiatives
* Support development of long-term supply continuity and supplier resiliency strategies

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead complex, cross-functional supplier development programs from definition through implementation, including scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent supplier initiatives, establish integrated project plans and governance, track commitments and critical-path activities, proactively resolve barriers, and escalate decisions needed to maintain schedule and achieve program objectives.
* Apply engineering and quality tools to identify sources of process variation and opportunities for improvement such as supplier kaizens.
* Lead complex root cause investigations and corrective action efforts involving suppliers.
* Mentor Supplier Quality Engineers and cross-functional team members on supplier quality, process capability, and supplier development methodologies.

description:
**BASIC FUNCTION**

A Material Program Coordinator compiles, monitors, and reports material health and status for the purpose of achieving program milestones and objectives.

**MINIMUM SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Well-organized, with directly applicable experience in resource planning and scheduling.
* Capable of multi-tasking and handle large volumes of work.
* Basic knowledge of computer software such as Microsoft word, excel, power point, etc.)
* Good communication skills, including written and oral communication.
* Good Organizational skills.
* Must be able to read and understand purchase order requirements.
* Must be familiarized with materials, yard functions, and procedures.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Interfaces with Material Program Managers, Buyers, Accounting personnel, Production Control personnel, and suppliers as required.
* Verifies and distributes material in the yard as needed, including projected delivery and receipt dates to Material Program Manager.
* Able to read ad understand purchase order requirements.
* Communicates with production, purchasing, and engineering the utilization of excess material in lieu of ordering new and/or duplicate items already available.
* Interfaces with receiving warehouse to validate purchase order requirements vs receipt.
* Organizes and files documents as directed, in accordance with department requirements.
* Develops and publishes metrics assessing health of business systems requirements (i.e. time on shelf, order vs need date, etc).
* Coordinates with Parts Master, Planning and Engineering for new parts creation.
* Compiles weekly reports to include impacts and status of all material on the assigned program.
* Assists to ensure goals and objectives of the program are met regarding material health and support to production.
* Must follow the Company policies and procedures, including those relative to employee safety, environmental policy, and the principles of our quality system.
* Other duties assigned or requested by Management.
* Works overtime as required.
* Reports to work daily and on time.

*Bollinger is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to minorities, females, veterans and disabled individuals, and without regard to sexual orientation and gender identity.*

**Healthcare Purchasing Associate – Medical Supplies & Equipment**

**Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Day Shift | NO WEEKENDS!**

**Location: Howell Township, NJ**

**NOW HIRING – APPLY TODAY!**

US Healthcare is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Healthcare Purchasing Specialist to join our team!

In this role, you will coordinate the purchasing, ordering, and fulfillment of medical supplies and equipment for skilled nursing facilities. We're looking for someone with strong organizational skills, purchasing experience, and the ability to work effectively with vendors and healthcare teams.

**Why Join US Healthcare?**

* **Monday–Friday Day Shift – NO WEEKENDS!**
* Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Direct Deposit
* Paid Training & Orientation
* Opportunities for Career Advancement
* Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Purchase medical supplies and equipment for skilled nursing facilities.
* Source products, obtain competitive vendor quotes, and compare pricing.
* Prepare, place, and monitor purchase orders.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding product availability, deliveries, and backorders.
* Review order confirmations and invoices for pricing and quantity accuracy.
* Work with the accounting department to process invoices.
* Verify inventory and resolve shipment discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and vendor information.
* Help ensure facilities receive necessary supplies in a timely and cost-effective manner.
* Perform additional purchasing and administrative duties as needed.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Minimum 1–2 years of purchasing, procurement, or order fulfillment experience required.
* Healthcare or medical supply purchasing experience preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Experience with purchasing software preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

**Join Our Team!**

If you're looking for a stable, full-time opportunity with a Monday–Friday schedule, excellent benefits, and room to grow, we encourage you to apply!

APPLY TODAY AND JOIN THE US HEALTHCARE TEAM!

description:
Acordis provides infrastructure and technology services and solutions to clients throughout Florida and the United States. Through our partnership and certifications with leading technology providers including Cisco, HPE, Palo Alto, Juniper, Microsoft, Barracuda, VM Ware, Citrix, Xerox, Dell, and many others. Our customers receive the highest quality products and services the industry has to offer.

Acordis has an immediate opening for a purchasing agent/buyer. We are seeking an experienced candidate who will be responsible for the day-to-day processing of purchase orders for material/service requests; following up on these orders; confirming lead times and costs on these material and services. The right candidate will bid on new projects, maintain scopes of work, track any changes etc.

**Purchasing Agent/Buyer**

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Requesting cost proposals and negotiating contracts and prices.
* Preparing and processing purchase orders.
* Maintaining records of all transactions, purchase orders, receipts, and payments.
* Scheduling and verifying purchase deliveries.
* Researching and comparing suppliers, goods, and services.
* Selecting the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
* Monitoring inventory levels and determining purchase needs.
* Building and maintaining positive, long-term supplier relations.

**Purchasing Agent/Buyer**

**Experience/Education Requirements**

* Minimum of 3 years expereince required; at least 2 years of IT technology purchasing experience strongly preferred.
* Associates degree required; Bachelor’s Degree in Business or related field preferred,
* Purchasing or Supply Chain Management Certification preferred
* Experience with negotiating, contracting, analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to compile and present data in a format that facilitates information sharing and decision making
* Experience with Microsoft software such as Excel and Word; solid data entry
* Reliable and possess a high degree of work ethic
* Strong organizational ability
* Knowledge of industry suppliers preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadline

Company Profile

Acordis International Corp is leader in Technology & Solutions. Acordis works closely with clients to develop, implement, and support specific solutions to diverse network, communication, and information infrastructure needs. Acordis specializes in Data Management, Infrastructure Management, Storage Management, Systems Architecture, Managed IT services, IT Security, Cloud services, Digital Signage, Virtualization, Multifunctional Printers, Managed Print Services, Document Management Solutions, VOIP, and Wireless Networking solutions.

**Acordis is an official Partner of Miami Heat, Miami Dolphins, and Miami Open!**
**South Florida 2013, 2015 and 2016 Business of the year awards.**
**INC. 5000 list of fastest growing companies 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018**
**Fastest growing company in South Florida**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Purchasing/buying: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Sr Assoc, Procurement***

***Job Location:*** ***Anaheim, CA; Millersville, MD; Camden, NJ or Northampton, MA***

***Job Schedule: 9/80***

**Job Description:**

Maintain strategic alliances and partnerships that have already been established by the Purchasing organization. Perform supplier purchase order receipt follow-up, and ensure forecasted revenue dollars are met. Conduct conference calls and establish strong lines of communications with assigned vendors. Work with suppliers for decommits and determine appropriate course of action for recovery schedules. Immediately escalate any issues to management and recommend a proper course of action. Make sure all procurements meet and are in compliance with corporate and L3Harris policies and procedures including signature authority. Ensure that the supplier is competent to perform service or manufacture product by assisting in performing a capabilities and risk assessment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Daily management of incoming purchase orders to ensure PO delivery date fidelity and strong comunications with suppliers.
* Responsible to manage assigned commodities to enable L3 Harris production. This includes purchase order modification and maintenance and administration of engineering changes.
* Create PO package with all required documentation for PO changes; i.e., Price Analysis, Justification Worksheet, Order acknowledgement, PPV, Excess, etc.
* Manage supplier relationships of those suppliers assigned, and assist in the development and implementation of supplier base strategies
* Resolving supplier base problems, including negotiations on Non-Conformances, invoicing, receipt discrepancy, terms and conditions, and service levels
* Provide training, guidance and coaching Procurement Agents in non-supervisory role
* Provide guidance to the company on key events in the selected commodities that may effect the business plans of the company
* Maintain documentation control in compliance with FAR regulations and company procedures and policies
* Implement strategic goals as established by leadership and manage selected projects as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience, or Graduate Degree and of 0-2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.
* Contract experience, including knowledge of terms and conditions, and other agreement related experience
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Understanding and working knowledge of engineering documentation, product configurations, etc.
* Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively in a digital/remote environment

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience in government / FAR buying environment is strongly preferred
* Experience in SAP or CostPoint MRP systems preferred
* APICS CPIM or CSCP certification preferred

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $63,000-117,000. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Buyer (2NC)**
===============

### **Job Description**

The Buyers is responsible for the evaluation and intake of used product from customers into the store inventory. Additionally, they are responsible for providing exceptional customer service to all customers in a friendly and helpful manner. They should be knowledgeable about books and other merchandise in the store.

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provides the highest level of customer service to each customer including adjacent sales floor areas.
* Maintains merchandising standards in assigned area according to Company policies and procedures.
* Successfully promotes all Company initiatives when interacting with customers, including Sales Promotions, Text to Mobile etc.
* Ensures efficient evaluation, processing, and/or merchandising of product.
* Ensures customers receive a fast and friendly buyback experience.
* Researches and inputs product and customer information into the system according to Company procedure.
* Provides quotes to customers for purchase of product and authorizes the intake of product into store inventory.
* Monitors and maintain assigned area’s cleanliness, providing a clean workplace which includes dusting, vacuuming, cleaning restrooms, and assisting in the general maintenance of the building.
* Organizes received orders to facilitate speedy merchandising of traded product.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

### **Core Competencies**

* Interpersonal Skills
* Self-Management
* Action Orientation

### **Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* Customer service experience required, buying experience preferred
* 18 years of age or older
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Successful completion of all background screenings

### **Preferred Skills**

* Computer and cash register skills
* Knowledgeable about product, with the ability to research market trends

### **Physical and Environmental Requirements**

* Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods of time
* Must be able to use hands/arms to operate a keyboard and telephone for repetitive motion activities
* Must be able to lift or team lift objects up to 50 lbs., with or without assistance
* Must be able to communicate using speech, sight, and sound with or without an assistive device
* Must be able to stand, walk, climb, bend, stoop, or crouch while performing daily activities of the job

Associate, Supply Chain

The Supplier Enablement & Onboarding Specialist maintains vendor master data and drives supplier enablement processes within the **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Operations team**. In this role, the individual reviews requests to add and modify supplier profiles in the vendor master while ensuring team metrics are consistently met or exceeded. Additionally, the Specialist supports operational excellence by identifying and driving continuous process improvements.

ESM cultivates a supportive atmosphere where inclusion and belonging are central to our associate experience. By embracing a variety of perspectives and capitalizing on the unique talents of our team members, we strive to deliver outstanding results for our clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ***Supplier Onboarding & Maintenance****:* Review, validate, and process requests to add or modify supplier information in the vendor master database to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* ***Compliance & Research*****:** Perform required compliance vetting (e.g., tax, sanction, and risk checks) and conduct payables or vendor-related research.
* ***Supplier Enablement*****:** Provide high-touch support to enable suppliers on procurement platforms, specifically Coupa.
* ***Process Innovation:***Act as a change agent by challenging the status quo, disrupting inefficient processes, and leading process improvement initiatives within the ESM Ops value stream.
* ***Problem Solving:*** Identify innovative solutions to resolve complex system and operational challenges across multiple platforms.
* ***Stakeholder Engagement:***Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with internal customers, vendors, and cross-functional leadership to inform and influence positive outcomes.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of experience in Customer Service
* At least 1 year of experience with Google Suite

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ years of experience in Corporate Procurement or Supply Chain Ops
* 1+ years of experience with Enterprise Financial and Procurement systems (e.g., Coupa, PeopleSoft)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a track record of building positive vendor relationships
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate in a diverse, team-oriented environment

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Richmond, VA: $74,200 - $84,700 for Associate, Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace.
