description:
The Associate Purchasing and Contracts Specialist supports the end-to-end procurement and contract administration process.

*Procurement and Sourcing Operations*

* Supports Request for Proposal (RFP) and Request for Quote (RFQ) activities by coordinating bid documentation, schedules, and procurement timelines
* Independently evaluates procurement requests and determines the appropriate procurement method based on university policy, regulatory requirements, and institutional needs
* Assists in the evaluation of supplier proposals based on pricing, delivery requirements, service levels, and compliance with specifications
* Processes Purchase Orders (PO’s) and coordinates with vendors to ensure timely delivery, accurate invoicing, and resolution of order-related issues

*Supplier Relations and Communication*

* Serves as primary point of contact for routine supplier inquiries and communications
* Interprets procurement policies, procedures, and applicable regulations to provide guidance and recommendations to campus departments
* Serves as procurement resource for departments by advising on purchasing strategies, contract requirements, and compliance matters
* Assists with resolving shipping, quality, and invoice discrepancies while developing effective vendor resolution and problem-solving skills

*Contract Support and Administration*

* Manages procurement activities from initiation through award and subsequent contract administration with limited supervision and personal accountability for results
* Assists with preparation, review, and routing of standard vendor contracts, Statements of Work (SOW’s) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA’s)
* Supports contract administration activities by monitoring compliance requirements and tracking contract renewal and expiration dates
* Collaborates with Legal, Risk Management, and other stakeholders under supervision to gain an understanding of contract risk assessment and mitigation process

*Training and Professional Development*

* Actively participates in training and professional development opportunities related to organization fiscal policies, institutional purchasing regulations, and procurement systems
Demonstrates a commitment to learning and mastering complex procurement and contract administration processes, with the goal of assuming responsibility for larger accounts and more sophisticated contract negotiations

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Precision in administrative tasks, accurate data entry, and thorough record keeping for audit trails
* Clear written and verbal communication skills necessary to coordinate with internal departments and vendors
* Ability to absorb structured training regarding legal terminology, organizational policies, and procurement workflows
* Ability to proactively identify data discrepancies or shipping delays
* Strong aptitude for complex enterprise software and digital workflows and data tracking

**Application Review**

Review of applications will begin **October 20, 2026,** and will continue until the position is filled. Applications received by this date will receive priority consideration.

**Minimum:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, public administration or a closely related field
* 1 year of experience in administrative, procurement support, or financial role
An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

This position is open to recent graduate professionals transitioning into procurement.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, public administration or a closely related field
* 3-5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, or contract administration within an institutional, public sector, or higher education setting
* Hands on experience navigating Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) an procurement platforms (specifically Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications
Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) or Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM)

**Work Location:**

* University of Tennessee – Chattanooga, TN Campus
This is a fully on-site position

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* UT Market Range: MR10
* Anticipated hiring salary: $55,000 - $60,250

**ABOUT US**

The University of Tennessee at Chattanooga is in the heart of one of Tennessee’s largest and most dynamic cities. As a national model for metropolitan universities, UTC collaborates with its many regional partners to offer an experiential learning environment with outstanding teaching scholars in 128 undergraduate degree programs and 55 graduate programs—at both the master's and doctoral levels. UTC and Chattanooga—nationally recognized for its downtown redevelopment and wealth of outdoor recreation—are inextricably linked, and the University is central to the workforce and economic development efforts of the region and the state.

job_title: Associate Purchasing & Contracts Specialist, Procurement - UT Chattanooga
description:
The Associate Purchasing and Contracts Specialist supports the end-to-end procurement and contract administration process.

*Procurement and Sourcing Operations*

* Supports Request for Proposal (RFP) and Request for Quote (RFQ) activities by coordinating bid documentation, schedules, and procurement timelines
* Independently evaluates procurement requests and determines the appropriate procurement method based on university policy, regulatory requirements, and institutional needs
* Assists in the evaluation of supplier proposals based on pricing, delivery requirements, service levels, and compliance with specifications
* Processes Purchase Orders (PO’s) and coordinates with vendors to ensure timely delivery, accurate invoicing, and resolution of order-related issues

*Supplier Relations and Communication*

* Serves as primary point of contact for routine supplier inquiries and communications
* Interprets procurement policies, procedures, and applicable regulations to provide guidance and recommendations to campus departments
* Serves as procurement resource for departments by advising on purchasing strategies, contract requirements, and compliance matters
* Assists with resolving shipping, quality, and invoice discrepancies while developing effective vendor resolution and problem-solving skills

*Contract Support and Administration*

* Manages procurement activities from initiation through award and subsequent contract administration with limited supervision and personal accountability for results
* Assists with preparation, review, and routing of standard vendor contracts, Statements of Work (SOW’s) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA’s)
* Supports contract administration activities by monitoring compliance requirements and tracking contract renewal and expiration dates
* Collaborates with Legal, Risk Management, and other stakeholders under supervision to gain an understanding of contract risk assessment and mitigation process

*Training and Professional Development*

* Actively participates in training and professional development opportunities related to organization fiscal policies, institutional purchasing regulations, and procurement systems
Demonstrates a commitment to learning and mastering complex procurement and contract administration processes, with the goal of assuming responsibility for larger accounts and more sophisticated contract negotiations

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Precision in administrative tasks, accurate data entry, and thorough record keeping for audit trails
* Clear written and verbal communication skills necessary to coordinate with internal departments and vendors
* Ability to absorb structured training regarding legal terminology, organizational policies, and procurement workflows
* Ability to proactively identify data discrepancies or shipping delays
* Strong aptitude for complex enterprise software and digital workflows and data tracking

**Application Review**

Review of applications will begin **October 20, 2026,** and will continue until the position is filled. Applications received by this date will receive priority consideration.

**Minimum:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, public administration or a closely related field
* 1 year of experience in administrative, procurement support, or financial role
An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

This position is open to recent graduate professionals transitioning into procurement.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, public administration or a closely related field
* 3-5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, or contract administration within an institutional, public sector, or higher education setting
* Hands on experience navigating Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) an procurement platforms (specifically Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications
Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) or Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM)

**Work Location:**

* University of Tennessee – Chattanooga, TN Campus
This is a fully on-site position

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* UT Market Range: MR10
* Anticipated hiring salary: $55,000 - $60,250

**International****Purchasing****&****Inventory****Associate**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Reports****to:** R&D Purchasing
**Department:** Purchasing / Supply Chain

### **Position****summary**

The International Purchasing & Inventory Assistant supports purchasing, inventory control, and new-business coordination. The role helps ensure materials are ordered from international suppliers in line with MRP requirements, inventory records are accurate, and purchasing activities meet operational timelines.

### **Key****responsibilities**

* Review MRP requirements and prepare purchase orders for international suppliers.
* Track purchase orders and coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to support timely delivery and resolve routine order issues.
* Support inventory control by maintaining accurate records and investigating discrepancies.
* Assist with project coordination for new business, including tracking purchasing and material-related action items.
* Reconcile month-end inventory valuations and help research variances.
* Maintain purchasing and inventory data; prepare reports as needed.
* Organize and prioritize work to meet deadlines in a changing environment.
* Follow company policies, procedures, and applicable safety rules.
* Cross-train and provide support to other departments as requested.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong reading comprehension, written and verbal communication, and basic math skills.
* Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office, including strong Excel skills.
* Previous experience in manufacturing, inventory control, or purchasing—especially international purchasing—is preferred.
* Familiarity with MRP systems is an asset.

### **Physical****and****work****requirements**

* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Regular and punctual attendance is an expectation of the role.
* Safety glasses are required in designated areas.

**Job Summary:**

The Purchasing Associate is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders and related purchasing activities for an assigned region. This position is highly administrative and detail-oriented, with a strong focus on data accuracy, order processing, vendor communication, documentation, and follow-up.

The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable performing repetitive transactional work, able to manage a high volume of requests, and committed to accuracy and timely completion of tasks. This role supports the purchasing process rather than serving as a strategic sourcing or procurement position.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders accurately and within established timelines.
* Review purchasing requests for completeness and accuracy before processing.
* Enter and maintain purchasing, vendor, item, pricing, and order information within company systems.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with vendors regarding order status, availability, backorders, shipping, and expected delivery dates.
* Communicate order updates, delays, and purchasing issues to internal teams.
* Research and resolve discrepancies involving pricing, quantities, invoices, shipments, and purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and supporting documentation.
* Follow established purchasing procedures, approval requirements, and company policies.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal departments to ensure orders are processed and fulfilled correctly.
* Assist with vendor setup, documentation, pricing updates, and other administrative purchasing functions.
* Identify recurring order or vendor issues and escalate them appropriately.
* Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple requests and priorities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing support, order entry, administrative operations, logistics, inventory, customer service, accounts payable, or another high-volume transactional environment preferred.
* **Exceptional attention to detail and data-entry accuracy.**
* Ability to perform repetitive, process-driven work consistently and accurately.
* Ability to manage a high volume of transactions, requests, and follow-up items.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating with vendors and internal stakeholders regarding order status and discrepancies.
* Ability to follow established processes while recognizing when an issue requires escalation.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and able to quickly learn ERP, inventory, and purchasing systems.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, and talking on the phone, attending virtual online meetings, and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

*We are an equal opportunity employer that welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.*

**Position Summary**

This role is responsible for assisting the purchasing team with material orders, take offs, will call orders, data entry, expediting, invoicing errors and other duties that the purchasing manage determines needs support.

**Position Details**

* Assists Purchasing team with placing orders.
* Partners with suppliers to follow-up on delivery dates and back orders. Tracks the status of all back orders and informs appropriate team members and departments of any issues.
* Maintains current and accurate files of suppliers pricing within the ERP system and purchasing spreadsheets.
* Assists with processing material receivers. Coordinates bulk deliveries of rough products, to meet deadlines.
* Assists with processing material returns and credits.
* Supports the RFQ, RFP processes to obtain product information such as pricing, availability, and delivery schedule.

**Qualifications**

* High school degree or G.E.D
* Minimum 1 year experience in purchasing or customer service support
* Basic of purchasing practices and systems preferred
* Basic time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, while planning and executing timely, effectively, efficiently, and accurately
* Basic analytical and problem solving skills, quality oriented, and strong attention to detail required
* Ability to operate a personal computer using spreadsheet, word processing, data base software, and experience using ERP software. (COINS preferred)
* Ability to work in a continuous improvement environment
* Ability to work effectively with suppliers, customers, project management team, field staff, and accounting in a team environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.

**Benefits**

As a 100% employee-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family:

* 401(k) plan with 50% company match (no cap) and immediate 100% vesting
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (100% paid for employee)
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability
* Term life, AD&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance
* Disability income protection insurance
* Pre-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care)
* Paid parental leave
* Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time
* Training/professional development opportunities and company-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses
* Wellness benefits

* Purchase materials from supplies at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need
* Study market trends, interview vendors and recommends sources of supply
* Solicit and analyze quotations required to satisfy all the requirements of the authorizing source documentation
* Monitor outstanding orders to ensure timely deliveries of quality products to maintain production, following up on orders to expedite shipment and delivery as needed
* Negotiate for any adjustments resulting from price analysis, discrepant materials, surplus or obsolete materials, contract terminations or a purchase order cancellation
* Obtain certifications of delivery and conduct item delivery validation. Check and improve payment of invoices
* Develop and maintain necessary records and files for compliance purposes. Support preparation of proposal cost data
* Preferred candidate will be knowledgeable in weld process, mechanical and custom fab.

* Ability to plan, organize and manage multiple priorities efficiently
* Effective verbal and written communications skills
* Basic Microsoft Office application skills with emphasis in MS Excel

* Flexible Work Schedules

* Education Assistance

* Career Development & Training Opportunities

* Wellness Program (including Fitness Reimbursement)

* Medical, Dental, Vision & 401(K) with Company Funding

Textron's products and services are trusted everyday by those who protect our country. We are dedicated to hiring these Veterans and aim to translate their skills to make an impact on our Company.

**AI Readiness:** Textron expects employees to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively. Candidates should be comfortable learning and applying these tools, evaluating AI-generated output with sound judgment, and using AI in line with company policy and ethical standards. Prior experience with specific tools is not required — we value curiosity, adaptability, and good judgment.

Do you enjoy being involved in procurement for manufacturing and new product development? **Hypertherm Associates** is looking for an Associate Category Specialist with experience supporting procurement of industrial materials and equipment including electronics, tooling, and capital equipment to join our **Waterjet** team in **Kent, Washington** . In this role, your supply chain experience will be utilized to assess and mitigate risk, support new product introduction (NPI) activities, cultivate and execute cost savings initiatives, and execute projects.

Join our unique business where you'll find plenty of opportunities to showcase your strengths, learn new skills, and drive process and procurement improvements. If you're ready to make a real impact, we want you on our team!

Hypertherm Associates is the world leader in industrial cutting solutions. We are a 100% Associate-owned company with a no-layoff philosophy for over 55 years!

**As an Associate Category Specialist, you will:**

* Support the team in helping ensure materials are delivered on time, at the best available price, and meet quality requirements

* Work with guidance from experienced team members to communicate with suppliers about pricing, deliveries, inventory changes, and product updates

* Gather and share supplier performance information to support sourcing decisions, team discussions, and follow-up actions

* Assist with identifying, tracking, and documenting cost-saving opportunities for current manufacturing and future projects

* Create and update purchase orders and related documentation by following established processes and guidance

* Support contract compliance, invoicing questions, and Engineering Change Order activities by reviewing information and tracking details with guidance

Participate in cross-functional meetings and cost reduction projects by completing assigned tasks, gathering data, and supporting project follow-up

**Who you are and the experience you will bring:**

* A **Bachelor’s Degree** in a related discipline with **2** - **3 years** **supply chain experience**

* Proven analytical skills (cost/benefit analysis, make/buy decision-modeling, etc.)

* Strong written and verbal presentation and communication skills

* Proven experience in contract development and negotiation skills

Strong attention to detail

**Preferred experience to differentiate you:**

* ISM and/or APICS certification

* Green/Black Belt Certified

* Knowledge of Lean/JIT Methodology

Knowledge of Purchasing modules in Oracle or similar ERP system

**Location:** Kent, Washington or New Brighton, MN

**Travel:** Up to 10% domestic

**Why join Hypertherm Associates?**

* Global, 100% employee-owned company for over 55 years

* Profit-Sharing

* Employee Stock Ownership

* Five days/year Community Service Time

* Strong commitment to Environmental Stewardship

Stable, growing organization with a no-layoff philosophy

#LI-MJ1

Hypertherm Associates is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we welcome all applications. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At Hypertherm Associates, we are committed to building an inclusive diverse, flexible, and collaborative environment . If our mission resonates with you, but you don’t meet all posted requirements, we encourage you to still apply. We will evaluate your application materials and may suggest alternative roles that better leverage your strengths and talents. For positions with multiple levels, we will evaluate your prior experience to determine the level within our organization you are best aligned based upon the job applying.

$72,828.00-$121,377.00 Annual

description:
Since 1976, **Furniture Mart USA** has been more than just a furniture retailer, it’s a place where people come to build careers, not just jobs. We believe in hiring great people and giving them the tools to grow, thrive, and make a difference. If you're passionate about helping others transform their house into a home, you’ll feel right at home here too.

Join a team that’s built on trust, teamwork, and a shared commitment to excellence. Whether you're just starting out or looking to take your career to the next level, **Furniture Mart USA** is where your future begins.

**Our mission is simple: Transform houses into homes, employees into family, and customers into friends.** If you share our vision and values, we invite you to join our team.

**Starting Wage: $22-28/hour depending on experience**

**Summary:**

* **Full-Time (40 hrs/wk): Monday-Friday, 8:00AM-5:00PM**
* Monitor supply levels and make appropriate purchases as necessary
* Evaluate vendors to determine best price and quality of supplies purchased while negotiating prices accordingly
* Receive and process all requests for supplies made by various company departments and locations.
* Allocate appropriate cost to proper location
* Retains records on purchases/requests/filled orders
* Responsible for licensing and registration of all fleet vehicles
* Travel Arrangements-Flights, Hotels, Conference rooms
* Reviews, codes and approves all invoices related to items purchased
* Coordinates and purchases food needs for meetings and events
* Contacts suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries, to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other concerns
* Prepares, maintains, and reviews purchasing files, reports and price lists
* Tracks the status of requisitions, contracts, and orders
* Purchasing of Cell Phones and Managing of corporate account
* Purchasing of company uniforms
* Participates in department and company improvement activities, positively contributing to the team
* Proactively communicates issues and action taken or needed with Manager and/or Supervisor
* Maintains good attendance, punctuality and safe work practices
* Work in conjunction with Fleet Manager.
* Other duties as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* One-year certificate from college or technical school; or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Effective collaborator and communicator
* Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate well with external and internal customers and management.
* Self-motivated and absolute attention to detail

**Benefits: What’s in It for You?**
As a full-time member of our Furniture Mart USA family, you will enjoy:

* Paid training
* Full benefits package: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Paid Time Off, and more
* 401(k) with employer match
* Big employee & family discounts on furniture and mattresses

**Furniture Mart USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights
* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities
* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain
* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment
* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.
* Use procurement software tools
* Support the development and execution of category strategies
* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts
* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement
* At least 2 years of experience in risk management
* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement
* 4+ years of experience in risk management

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

description:
As part of our Mail Buying team, you’ll be involved in the entire mail-buying process—from receiving packages and communicating with customers to processing buys through the mail, Sell List Requests, and Ship + Sell program. You’ll also organize and prepare cards for their next stop: our inventory. If you like cards, staying busy, and seeing a project go from “just arrived” to “ready to sell,” there’s always something happening on the Mail Buying team.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Magic: The Gathering, Flesh and Blood, and Lorcana cards is helpful, but not required.
* Possess great attention to detail.
* Dependable, trustworthy, and punctual.
* Able to work well independently and as a part of a team.
* Remain flexible and accomplish tasks quickly in a fast-paced environment.
* Willing to learn and make good use of new programs and assets.
* Familiar with computer programs such as Word, Excel, and Outlook.

**Essential Duties:**

* Process mail-in sell requests using the Buyer Admin.
* Communicate with customers about their sell requests using the Buyer Admin and Gorgias.
* Answer phone calls and return voicemails.
* Schedule appointments in the Storefront for in-person purchases.
* Assist with processes as assigned by the Mail Buying Supervisor, such as facilitating customer returns.
* Assist with organizing cards for integration into inventory.
* Assist with processing collection purchases, such as organizing and pricing Ship + Sells.
* Assist with grading cards.

**Work Environment, Physical, and Mental Demands:**

*‘Regularly’ indicates this action would generally occur for over 5 hours each shift.*
*‘Frequently’ would generally occur for 2.5 to 5 hours each shift.*
*‘Occasionally’ would occur periodically but is necessary to complete essential duties.*

* Regularly required to sit for long periods.
* Regularly required to utilize finger and hand dexterity with repetitive motion tasks.
* Regularly operate a computer, utilizing a mouse and keyboard.
* Occasionally must be able to lift and carry up to 30 pounds for short distances.
* Occasionally must stoop, bend, kneel, and maintain full dexterity.
* Work environment often has airborne dust particles.

**Your Benefits at Star City Games**

As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a range of benefits designed to support your health, growth, and overall well-being.

**Health & Wellness:**

* Medical, dental & vision insurance
* Company contributions toward premiums
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with annual free sessions

**Financial & Retirement:**

* 401(k) with company match; eligible to enroll after 1 year of service
* Pre-tax health Flexible Spending Account
* Pre-tax Dependent Flexible Spending Account

**Time Off:**

* 10 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) to start, earned quarterly; increases based on length of service
* Option to sell up to 50 hours of PTO per quarter at 70% of daily rate
* 6 paid company holidays (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day, Christmas Day, Thanksgiving, New Year’s Day)
* 1 floating holiday
* Paid bereavement leave

**Other Perks:**

* Employee discount (10% off most items, 15% off supplies, $5 off in-store events or free entry if fee is under $5)
* Free tickets to Big Lick Comic Con twice per year

Benefits are subject to the terms of each plan and may change at the Company’s discretion. Full details will be provided during onboarding.

**Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws:**

* Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)
* Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)
* Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)
* E-Verify Participation Notice
* Right to Work

Star City Games is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Overview:

We are authentic, professional providers of fun, focused on building a Great Place To Work For All by staying true to our mission: “Life’s a Party, We’re Makin’ It Fun!” and “So Much Fun It’s Scary!”

At Spencer’s and Spirit, we do the right thing always-integrity, fairness, respect, and transparency are our foundation. You will find our culture to be inclusive, passionate, resilient, and one that values differences and embraces all.

**One Team / One Goal**

We are leaders and owners of our business success. Whether it’s developing new and exclusive costumes, quality testing products, or implementing technology solutions, our teams understand the value of working collaboratively to embrace change through innovation, curiosity, and thoughtfulness.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* *Flexible work environment*
* *Career advancement*
* *Competitive base salary*
* *Bonus opportunity*
* *Vacation, Personal, Sick and Holiday pay*
* *Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life and AD&D insurance*
* *401k with a company match*
* *30% merchandise discount*

Responsibilities:

The Associate Buyer manages purchasing and inventory for specific departments, driving sales and profitability through collaboration with internal teams and external partners. They assist in curating assortments, ensuring timely deliveries, and analyzing sales performance. The role also involves identifying new products and trends through research and competitive shopping. Additionally, the Associate Buyer helps guide and train Assistant Buyers and Senior Assistant Buyers.

* Responsible for building, creating & managing merchandise assortments that align with market and consumer trends, to be presented to the Buyer. Assortment creation includes selecting and developing merchandise by considering quality, sourcing, timing, delivery, mix, and price
* Analyze weekly sales and item performance to find opportunities and strategies to drive sales and margin
* Prepare merchandise and reports for weekly team meetings
* Manage entire product lifecycle from creation, tracking of the purchase orders, samples, merchandising in store, to markdowns and discards
* Responsible for making purchasing decisions independently that satisfy the customer demand and achieve sales, turn and margin plan
* Travel to store locations to review product mix, gather feedback, and share information with the merchant team
* Attend trade shows and travel to vendor locations to grow and maintain professional relationships with external partners, as well as gain insight on new trends and opportunities
* Maintain and grow professional relationships with external suppliers and internal partners via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings
* Partner with leadership and planning counterparts to manage the OTB and to identify opportunities in style count, sales goals, and inventory flow
* Manage markdowns and promotion strategies

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; and 5+ years experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proven ability to develop and implement strategies that drive business growth
* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, facilitating clear and effective dialogue with stakeholders
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative environments, taking initiative to drive projects forward
* Strong aptitude for partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals and enhance organizational effectiveness
* Skilled in developing, planning, presenting, and executing strategic initiatives that align with business objectives

*The pay range reflects the potential base salary range for this role. Individual base pay is determined by various factors such as relevant experience and skills, and the scope and responsibilities of the position.*

Pay Range: $70,000 - $80,000

Posted Date 10/06/2026

Description Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights

* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities

* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain

* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business

* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment

* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.

* Use procurement software tools

* Support the development and execution of category strategies

* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts

* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement

* At least 2 years of experience in risk management

* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement

* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Sales Territory: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

Responsibilities:

**Job Summary:** As an Associate Fresh Buyer, you'll train and work with a BDM to learn about product assortment, placement, purchase, price negotiation, distribution, cost negotiation, reacting to customer demand, and planning future category strategy. This position is an orientation job for Partners with limited experience in Business Development Management (BDM) or Buyer functions.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions:**

* Supply Chain & Inventory Management:
+ Associate Fresh Buyer is a developmental role for Fresh Buyer.
+ Works with set vendor base
+ Executes purchase orders for a pre-defined set of items.
+ Executes (buys to) pre-determined item level product specifications.
+ Somewhat seasonal with little market fluctuations
+ Executes the Supply Chain needs for determined ad/promo items
+ Executes pre-determined supply chain from Suppliers to warehouses then into stores¿
+ Purchase order replenishment
+ Days on hand Inventory levels and Freshness guarantees
+ Markdowns to move shorter dated items
+ Executes out of spec product /load rejections to ensure stores receive the highest quality products
+ Shrink management controls
+ Supplier service level targets
+ Executes the outbound product flow from the HEB warehouse network into the entire network of HEB banner stores (HEB/CM/MT/Joe V's).

* Supplier Cost & Pricing:
+ Supplier Cost Management:
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Minimal market price knowledge needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

* Strategic Planning:
+ Supplier Cost Management
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Basic understanding of market pricing is needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

*The responsibilities and essential functions outlined above describe the general nature and level of work assigned to this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time based on business needs. Employees may be required to perform other job-related tasks as requested by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodations.*

**Qualifications & Key Requirements:**

**Work Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in business, merchandising / retail, or Store Operations
* Category management, buying, supply chain, promotional planning, category analysis, merchandising, or other buying related experiences are a plus

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Ability to multi-task and perform under pressure
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills -
* Working knowledge of product information data flow (item, vendor, cost, price), category trends, promotional planning, category performance analysis, systems, process, and analysis
* Strong verbal / written communication and presentation skills
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Negotiating and influencing skills
* Organization and project management skills
* PC skills (MS Office and job-related software / programs)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities / deadlines and shift focus between tasks; attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively on cross-functional teams and company-wide initiatives
* Ability to navigate the organization and solve problems within / across departments
* Ability to recommend proactive solutions with limited direction and input
* Initiative: willingness to take risks

**Education:**

* Degree in business, economics, marketing, or related field preferred

**Licenses/Certifications:**

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

* Function in a fast-paced, retail, office environment
* Travel by car or plane with overnight stays
* Work extended hours; sit for extended periods

*The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Partner encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Last revised:** 08/01/2023

**Job Description** :

**MOVE YOUR CAREER FORWARD WITH RYDER!**

Be a vital player for one of the largest and most recognizable names in Logistics, Transportation, Fleet Maintenance and Supply Chain Services in the World!

**We are immediately hiring a 2nd shift Supply Chain Associate in Moraine, OH (Brookville) for our Supply Chain Solutions division. Manage day-to-day planning and scheduling inbound truck loads. Ability to work with all levels of the organization. The ability to work independently. Detail oriented with excellent follow up. Apply here today to speak with a Recruiter about the position and perks of joining our Ryder Ever Better Team.**

* **Pay Type: Exempt / Salary paid Twice Per Month**
* **Annual Salary Pay: $45,000 per year based on experience**
* **Schedule: 2nd shift: Monday-Friday 3:00 pm – 11:00 pm**
* **2 weeks training on 1st shift (6:00 am- 3:00 pm)**

**Summary**

The **2nd shift** **Supply Chain Operations Associate** will be responsible for operational functions, (General Motors LLP Account) independent decision making related to material availability and inventory control.

**Essential Functions**

* Follow-up all purchased parts to ensure shipment and on-time delivery performance to support production requirements

* Serve as main point of contact for all suppliers. Provide direction to suppliers regarding ship schedule requirements and containment plan when behind schedule. Includes decision making on timing for supplier ship schedules - allowing them to push material out, pull ahead and expedite material as needed based on inventory coverage at plant

* Track critical parts and develop/execute containment plan to ensure no interruptions or down time to manufacturing line, inclusive of decision making on mode and required delivery window to ensure continuity of production

* Coordinate and/or arrange for alternative sources of material, requests for spot buys, if necessary (SPO and other GM Plants)

* Independent monitoring, set-up, and cancellation of truck loads for material pick-up, as necessary to support schedule variations. Ensure proper material coverage at lowest possible cost for customer

* Review part buffers to determine that they cover build requirements. (Metal Centers and Powertrain). Document and manage S and AV code exceptions (Assembly Plants) including Alarm Interval maintenance. Determine root-cause and take appropriate action

* MGO Data Maintenance. Maintain accurate inventory levels in MGO, making appropriate adjustments where necessary. Make judgments on posting inventory adjustments based on investigation and analysis. Investigate and process any record adjustment requests from the previous shift

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties as assigned

**Skills and Abilities**

* Ability to create and maintain professional relationships within all levels of the organization (peers, work groups, customers, supervisors). , Required

* Ability to work independently and as a member of a team , Required

* Flexibility to operate and self-driven to excel in a fast-paced environment , Required

* Capable of multi-tasking, highly organized, with excellent time management skills , Required

* Strong organizational, problem solving and communication skills., Required

* Strong verbal and written communication skills , Required

* Flexible work schedule, Required

**Qualifications**

* H.S. Diploma/GED, Required

* Bachelor's Degree, Preferred

* 1 year or more in administrative experience, Preferred

* 1 year or more in relevant experience, Preferred

* Knowledge of MGO (GM's MRP system) Intermediate, Preferred

* Knowledge of transportation management Intermediate, Preferred

* Knowledge of material flow as it relates to manufacturing processes Intermediate, Preferred

**Travel**

* No

When Fortune 500 businesses and new startups need supply chain solutions, they look to our industry-leading logistics experts. At Ryder, there is more to being a supply chain professional than working on some of the nation’s biggest brands. We make sure you are also getting the diverse experience, advancement opportunities, all from an industry-leading Fortune 500 company.

Here are a few of the many benefits when working with us:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Benefits start at 30 Days
* 401 (K) Savings Plan with a company match
* Discounted employee stock purchase options
* Quality employee discounts that actually save you money on tools, cars, appliances, travel and more
* All major holidays paid and Paid time off within your first year
* Up to 12 weeks paid maternity leave

We want YOU to join our family made up of Proud Women and Men in Logistics who work alongside Military Reserve and Veterans we hire every day!

**Apply Here With Ryder Today**

Click here to see all Opportunities at Ryder: https://ryder.com/careers

**Sales & Operations Associate**

**Galot Buying Services | Hybrid/Remote | 30–40 Hours per Week**

**Help Us Serve Food Banks and Nonprofits Across the Country**

Since 2007, Galot Buying Services has partnered with food banks and nonprofit organizations to help them source quality, nutritious food for the communities they serve.

We are a small, established company looking for the right person to join our team and grow with us.

This is not a narrowly defined administrative position. You’ll work closely with our Operations Manager and learn multiple sides of the business, including customer relationships, sales, sourcing, purchasing, supplier communication, order management and day-to-day operations.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes initiative and wants the opportunity to gradually take ownership of customers, projects and business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with current and prospective food bank and nonprofit customers
* Reach out to organizations to learn about their current needs, upcoming programs and purchasing opportunities
* Follow up with customers on products, pricing, orders and new opportunities
* Assist with customer orders from initial inquiry through delivery and invoicing
* Help coordinate upcoming orders, bids and purchasing opportunities
* Source products based on customer needs and program requirements
* Communicate with food manufacturers and suppliers regarding products, pricing and availability
* Maintain accurate customer, supplier, product and pricing information
* Help manage customer relationships and opportunities through Salesforce
* Assist with purchasing, sales and general operational projects
* Attend occasional industry conferences and visit customers or nonprofit organizations

As you learn the business, we want you to take on greater responsibility and develop your own relationships with customers and suppliers.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Personable and comfortable talking with customers and prospective customers
* A strong communicator, both written and verbal
* Organized and detail-oriented
* Naturally proactive and willing to follow through without constant supervision
* Comfortable reaching out to new people and developing relationships
* Curious and interested in understanding how a business works
* Able to recognize opportunities and help move them forward
* Comfortable working independently in a hybrid/remote environment
* Interested in working for a small company where responsibilities and opportunities can grow over time

Experience in sales, customer service, food banking, nonprofit organizations, purchasing, sourcing, food distribution or operations is helpful, but not required.

Experience with Salesforce or another CRM system is also helpful, but not required.

More important than having experience in every area is being dependable, organized, personable and eager to learn.

A bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, operations, communications or a related field is preferred, but not required.

**Position Details**

**Schedule:** Approximately 30–40 hours per week

**Compensation:** $23–$27 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications

**Location:** Hybrid/remote. Candidates should be located in the Los Angeles, Orange County or San Diego area.

**Travel:** Occasional travel for industry conferences, customer meetings and nonprofit visits, approximately once per quarter.

**Growth Opportunity:** We are looking for someone interested in growing with Galot. For the right person, this position can develop into a full-time role with increasing responsibility for customer relationships, sourcing, purchasing and business development.

**About Galot**

Galot Buying Services works directly with food manufacturers and suppliers to provide food banks and nonprofit organizations with quality food products for their programs and the communities they serve.

We operate with a small team, which means everyone has an opportunity to contribute, learn the business and make a meaningful impact.

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

**About the Role**

Radiant is looking for a **Supply Chain Associate** to join the supply chain team supporting sourcing and acquisition of components, materials, and services for our micro-reactor systems. You'll work closely with Supplier Development Engineers (SDEs), Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Operations, developing hands-on experience in supplier evaluation and negotiation while contributing engineering judgment to sourcing decisions.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Manage day-to-day PO tracking and expediting for assigned commodities.
* Serve as a point of contact for lower-complexity supplier relationships; escalate higher-stakes commercial issues appropriately.
* Analyze supplier quotes and cost data to surface savings opportunities.
* Support risk assessments (supplier capacity, technical readiness) using your mechanical engineering background.
* Help track procurement metrics (on-time delivery, cost variance) and contribute to supplier scorecards alongside SDEs.
* Support supplier identification and evaluation on cost, quality, reliability, and capacity, working closely with SDE and Engineering teams.
* Assist with negotiation prep (pricing, lead times, terms) under the guidance of senior supply chain staff.
* Help draft and review MSAs, NDAs, and PO terms.
* Collaborate with SDEs, Engineering, and Quality to translate technical requirements into sourcing criteria.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related engineering field)
* 1–3 years of relevant experience; manufacturing, hardware, or hands-on engineering project experience is a strong plus.
* Strong technical aptitude with interest in developing commercial/negotiation skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable with ERP/MRP systems and standard office software (or willing to learn).
* Occasional travel to supplier locations (up to 30%).

**Desired Qualifications**

* Interest in nuclear energy or willingness to learn nuclear codes/standards (NQA-1, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR 21, ASME BPVC Section III & VIII).
* Exposure to supplier audits or inspections.
* Coursework or interest in quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100).

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
* Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.
* Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.
* One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.
* Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.
* Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.
* Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.
* 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.
* Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.
* Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.
* Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.
* Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

**Total Compensation and Benefits**
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment withou

description:
***International Shoppes*** has been delivering exceptional service and premium retail experiences to travelers since 1951. We proudly operate across some of the nation's busiest airports, including John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), Baltimore / Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Bradley International Airport (BDL), George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL), and Kahului Airport (OGG). We are committed to providing an outstanding shopping experience while representing many of the world's most recognized luxury, beauty, and lifestyle brands.

**Position Overview:**

The **Associate Buyer of Beauty** is responsible for providing market expertise, filtering the assortment, and establishing quantities that meet the Region's needs and financial goals within open to buy parameters. Demonstrates smart risk-taking in business and product decisions and clearly communicates and manages team to execute these decisions. Supports the Buyers by providing analysis and results for their category, recommends action against the results and follows through on executing this action. Coordinate daily activities across designated departments to facilitate responsibilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* PO Management and Execution
+ Review Brand Sell In and Write Monthly Orders with OTB
+ Review and introduce novelties for various in store activations
* Stock Maintenance- review WOS and opportunity for clean up
+ Duty Paid Allocation management and execution
- Splits/Duty Paid Transfers
- Work with store teams to determine needs of business
* Negotiate vendor returns and destructions
* Review and Implement Vendor Funded Promotions
* Quarterly Store Walkthrough /Attend Vendor Walkthroughs
* Various Ad – Hoc Reporting
* Identify product opportunities and trends which will impact the business and provide results
* Liaise with visual team to ensure that all products are properly on sales floor for optimization
* Manage product selection and assortment during market
* Analyze sales trends, key items, vendor profitability and aged inventory as well as making recommendations for driving improved performance
* Writing orders, changes, cancellations and necessary follow-up (both internally and externally) to ensure key shipments are delivered and processed.
* Monitoring of merchandise reports, Open-to-Buy monitoring, stock analysis and other ad hoc analyses.
* Manage product set up and maintenance.
* Ensure all markdowns and store promotions are entered and set up properly in system
* Establish and maintain relationships with outside vendors to stay abreast and informed of supply issues, new products, lead times and reliability
* Pull relevant sales, margin and price point reporting and make recommendations based on results to improve business portfolio.
* Performs other duties as determined by management but not limited to the above-mentioned responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.
* 4+ years of experience in Buying Role.
* Grasp and navigate a wide range of business relationships; negotiation skills.
* Creative product skills and comprehensive market knowledge.
* Ability to think conceptually and strategically regarding business; creative problem solver.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Demonstrates initiative, is conscientious and provides complete follow-through on all aspects of responsibility
* Ability to multitask and focus in a busy atmosphere
* Comfortable with team-based work structure, ability to demonstrate flexibility
* Excellent time management and communication skills
* High level of proficiency in Word and Excel.

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Full - Time 40 hours/week
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, 401K
* Merchandise Discounts
* Vacation / Personal / Sick time
* Traveling opportunities
* Great work environment

**To ensure that we continue to hire competent, ethical and trustworthy individuals, all candidates will be required to complete a thorough Port Authority Security background check prior to receiving any final offer of employment from International Shoppes.**

**JJob Summary:**

The Purchasing Associate is responsible for supporting the purchasing function through procurement, supplier management, inventory coordination, and ERP system maintenance. This role ensures timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials to support business operations.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

· Review the ERP system (SyteLine) to place and monitor purchase orders for sales samples, production, customer, and warehouse requirements.

· Review and resolve supplier invoices.

· Review and resolve goods receipts.

· Set-up logistics for purchase order arrival.

· Enter, update, and maintain supplier pricing.

· Assist with product sourcing and purchasing projects.

· Adjust planning/purchasing parameters based on analytical review.

· Monitor and track supplier non-conformance issues for supplier quality.

· Track the accuracy of purchase orders and monitor on-time delivery metrics to ensure supplier performance meets expectations.

· Monitor inventory including managing minimum and maximum stocking levels.

· Establish and manage stocking agreements using customer forecasts, supplier MOQs, and lead times, while monitoring performance and notifying Sales of over- or under-utilization

· Resolve supplier shipping issues or damage that occurred within transportation.

· Ability to identify seasonal trends in commodity purchasing and adjust accordingly.

· Cross-functional team player with Sales, Customer Service, Production, Accounting, and Warehouse.

· Assist the Production Coordinator in daily purchasing, scheduling, and logistics activities.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

· Proficiency in companies operating software, MS-Word and MS-Excel. ERP experience preferred.

· Strong analytical and mathematical skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills.

· Demonstrate sense of urgency, strong organizational skills, sense of ownership, and possess follow-up / follow through skills.

· Strong attention to detail and appropriate sense of urgency, when working both independently and as a team.

**Education and Experience:**

· High School diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred but not required.

· Prior purchasing experience in a distribution / manufacturing environment preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

· Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

· Working conditions are normal for an office environment.

· Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

· Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· Occasional travel to other Illing locations or supplier sites as required.

· Work location: In-office at Illing Headquarters, Richfield, WI.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Pay: $58,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

**Job Description**

**Position: Per Diem Purchasing Associate**

**Location: Barlow Respiratory Hospital, 2000 Stadium Way, Los Angeles**

**Job Summary:**

The Per Diem Purchasing Associate plays a crucial role in the operations of Barlow Respiratory Hospital's Materials Management Department. This position is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of all materials delivered by various vendors to the hospital. The ideal candidate will ensure that all materials are handled efficiently and stored properly, contributing to the smooth operation of hospital services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Receipt of Deliveries:** Accurately receive materials delivered to the Materials Management Department, ensuring all items are accounted for against delivery documents.
* **Storage:** Properly store all received materials in designated areas, maintaining an organized and efficient inventory system.
* **Distribution:** Timely distribute materials to various departments within the hospital, ensuring that all internal requests for materials are fulfilled accurately and promptly.
* **Inventory Management:** Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, participating in inventory counts and reconciliations as required.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Interact with vendors during the delivery process to resolve any discrepancies or issues that may arise.
* **Compliance:** Adhere to hospital policies and procedures related to materials handling, storage, and distribution.

**Requirements:**

* Computer literacy, with proficiency in inventory management software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid driver’s license, with a clean driving record.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to lift and move heavy items as needed.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexibility to work on a per diem basis, with varying hours according to departmental needs.
* **Per Diem position**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in materials management, inventory control, or a related field is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with purchasing software (e.g. MediTech) Preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

Barlow Respiratory Hospital is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals who are passionate about contributing to our team and supporting the health and well-being of our community.

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: From $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8.0 – 16.0 per week

Experience:

* Purchasing department : 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Olympic Steel**

Since 1954, Olympic Steel has been focused on safe, profitable, and sustainable growth through the direct sale of a wide range of processed metal products and several metal-intensive branded products. Guided by our Core Values, we put safety first – always, and we believe in cultivating an inclusive workplace where employee belonging, and empowerment are foundational to everything we do. Olympic Steel offers employees the best of both worlds: the culture and community of a closely connected team with the resources, opportunity and stability of a large, growing organization. Learn more about Olympic Steel at iamolympicsteel.com.

**Job Description**

This position is responsible for entering spot orders and stainless purchase orders and helping maintain and close purchase orders. The position handles the reconciling/matching of vendor invoices to purchase orders, material receipts and invoice/tag adjustments and may help to expedite orders. The position is also responsible for supporting the implementation and maintenance of the daily production schedule.

* Accurately and efficiently enters purchase orders based on approved PO requests
* Maintains records of all purchase orders, including closing them out
* Reviews vendor status reports and updates the inventory management system
* Working with vendors to expedite orders, and communicating with sales, quality, and accounts payable to resolve PO issues.
* Assists in implementing production schedule day-to-day
* Alerts Production Planning Specialist or management of any issues that may arise
* Assist with maintaining appropriate inventory levels to support the sales forecast, at lowest total cost, while meeting or exceeding required inventory turns
* Assists with physical inventory as needed

**Qualifications**

* High School Diploma, GED or commensurate experience
* 1+ year of experience in purchasing or inventory control, preferably within a manufacturing environment
* Highly skilled with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Outlook and Excel
* Ability to communicate effectively both written and verbally
* Skilled with multi-tasking and prioritizing

*Pay Range:* $25.00 - $28.00/hour

**Why Work for Olympic Steel**

Olympic Steel offers comprehensive benefits, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Paid holidays and vacation
* 401(k) with employer match
* Tuition reimbursement & Employee Discount Programs
* Referral program

We offer more than a competitive total compensation package. We provide our employees the ability to build a meaningful life-long career. When you work at Olympic Steel, you can make a significant impact – at our company, in the local community and in the world. For a comprehensive view of our benefits visit Steelperks.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Davenport, Iowa
Hempel Pipe & Supply, Inc.
Full-Time

**About Hempel Pipe & Supply**

Hempel Pipe & Supply is a trusted, family-owned distributor of pipe, valves, and fittings (PVF) serving contractors, industrial facilities, and commercial customers throughout the United States. Our team is committed to providing reliable products, strong vendor relationships, and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing Associate to support our purchasing and supply chain operations.

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Associate supports the purchasing team by helping manage inventory levels, processing purchase orders, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring products are available to meet customer demand. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, vendors, and internal teams to keep operations running smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Enter purchase orders for pipe, valves, fittings, and related PVF products
* Track order confirmations, delivery schedules, and backorders
* Maintain accurate inventory levels and product records
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, and lead times
* Coordinate with sales and warehouse teams to meet customer demand
* Monitor inventory reports and assist with stock replenishment
* Maintain vendor files and purchasing documentation
* Support cost control and purchasing efficiency initiatives

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
* 1–3 years of purchasing, inventory, or administrative experience preferred
* Strong organizational and analytical skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in industrial distribution, construction supply, or PVF industry
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP software
* Experience working with vendor relationships and supply chain coordination

**Benefits**

* Competitive wage based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth within the organization

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their resume to:

missy@hempelpipe.com

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
