**WHO WE ARE:** Broadview Product Development is seeking an **Experienced Product Development Engineer** to join our growing team. In this client-facing role, you will work directly with clients to deliver high-quality product development and engineering design services.

We also operate a full prototyping shop offering services for one-off prototypes as well as low-volume urethane casting production. We utilize a variety of urethane materials, SLA and FDM 3D printed parts, and custom CNC machined components.

Every project is unique. We are looking for a talented professional who thrives on variety, enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, and wants to be an integral part of a collaborative, small-company environment.

**POSITION SUMMARY & LOCATION:** This is an **onsite, client-facing role** located in the **Kalamazoo, MI area**. We are seeking a candidate based in or willing to relocate to the Kalamazoo region to help expand our local geographic footprint.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with clients’ design and engineering teams to translate conceptual ideas into production-ready CAD models.
* Gain a deep understanding of product functionality, aesthetic goals, and cost targets through iterative client consultations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and Broadview representative following project kickoff.
* Maintain regular communication with Broadview’s Lead Engineer and peer Product Development Engineers.
* Create comprehensive 2D drawings and 3D CAD data, managed across Broadview or customer databases.
* Coordinate with the internal Prototype Department to fulfill customer prototyping needs.
* Consult with clients on tooling design, material selection, and initial part evaluations.
* Assist with project scoping and quote generation as needed.

**Company Description**

The **Mechanical & Automation Engineer** is responsible for supporting the reliability, maintenance, and automation of manufacturing equipment and facility systems. This role works closely with the Maintenance Manager, Millwrights, Electricians, and Operations team to ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of plant equipment. The position combines mechanical engineering, maintenance, controls, and automation expertise to improve equipment performance, reduce downtime, and support continuous improvement initiatives throughout the facility.

**Job Description**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the Maintenance team to support daily maintenance operations and equipment reliability initiatives.
* Work closely with Millwrights and Electricians to troubleshoot, repair, and improve mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated systems.
* Partner with the Operations team to coordinate maintenance activities, minimize production disruptions, and support operational goals.
* Develop, implement, and maintain preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
* Troubleshoot and resolve automation, controls, instrumentation, and process-related issues.
* Support and maintain PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, sensors, instrumentation, and other automated control systems.
* Perform root cause analysis of equipment and process failures and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Design, recommend, and implement equipment modifications and process improvements that enhance safety, quality, productivity, and reliability.
* Assist with engineering and capital improvement projects, including equipment installations, upgrades, start-ups, and commissioning activities.
* Maintain and update electrical schematics, control drawings, technical documentation, and maintenance procedures.
* Analyze equipment performance data and identify opportunities for increased efficiency and cost reduction.
* Ensure compliance with company safety policies, environmental requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and support Lean Manufacturing and reliability-centered maintenance practices.
* Provide technical training and support for maintenance and operations personnel.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in maintenance, engineering, automation, or a related manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, industrial machinery, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and technical documentation.
* Experience supporting equipment installations, upgrades, and capital projects.
* Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
* Strong commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in paper manufacturing, pulp processing, or other heavy industrial environments.
* PLC programming experience using Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or similar platforms.
* Experience with SCADA systems and industrial automation networks.
* Knowledge of reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) principles.
* Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma experience.
* Experience with PLCs, HMIs, industrial controls, instrumentation, and automation systems.
* Knowledge of electrical systems, motor controls, VFDs, and industrial networking.

**Education/Certifications**

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Information**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

**About Us**
We are a Bay Area-based structural engineering firm specializing in residential and wood-frame structures. Our team is passionate about delivering innovative, practical, and code-compliant solutions for a wide range of projects, including new builds, remodels, and additions. We take pride in fostering a friendly, collaborative, and supportive work environment where team members grow together and make a real impact.

Get more info on our official company website: www.beam-able.com

* Perform structural analysis and design for residential and wood-frame buildings
* Prepare construction drawings and structural details
* Coordinate with architects, contractors, and other consultants
* Conduct site visits and provide construction-phase support
* [Senior Only] Mentor junior engineers and assist with technical reviews

* On-site work required at our Cupertino office
* Team-focused culture that values mentorship, mutual support, and continuous learning
* Regular project meetings and knowledge-sharing

* Junior Level: $70,000 – $90,000/year
* Senior Level: $90,000 – $120,000/year
* Benefits: health insurance, 401K, PTO, professional development support, and more

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering
* Proficiency in structural design software (e.g., AutoCAD, EnerCal, Bluebeam, Excel)
* Solid understanding of California Building Code (CBC), ASCE 7, and wood-frame construction
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* California PE license preferred (required for senior level)
* Junior: 0–3 years experience / Senior: 4+ years experience in structural engineering

* Experience working on Bay Area residential projects
* Familiarity with local permitting processes
* Interest in long-term career growth and leadership development

The Senior Project Engineer provides advanced project coordination, technical support, and administrative leadership for construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. This role is responsible for supporting the planning, documentation, communication, and control processes necessary for successful project delivery, while helping ensure that work is completed safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements and Skanska’s standards of quality and operational excellence.

- 2+ years preparing subcontract scopes and contracts.
- 2+ years experience with project close out.
- 1+ years working with cost control systems.

Overview:

Responsible to ensure that workmanship and materials meet the required specifications and standards. The Quality Engineer verifies that products and services meet customer expectations and achieve business goals. The Quality Engineer is the Subject Matter Expert (SME) in their area of expertise and is expected to leverage that knowledge to improve project performance, supplier management, and promote continual improvement.

**Location:** Open to remote but preference will go to someone who is able to be in an office location: Fargo, ND; Dallas, TX; Phx, AZ; Indy, IN

**Company Overview**

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.

The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Review test results of materials or products to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with specifications and standards
* Inspect workmanship, materials, components, and final products from pictures and on-site audits
* Develop and implement quality control procedures to reduce defects, rework, and prevent nonconformances
* Implement preventative actions to minimize the risk of future occurrences
* Review and approve Lessons Learned and Quality Alerts, in Zavanta as well as assist in standard operating procedure (SOP) updates and reviews
* Attend phase gate dry runs to provide insight and guidance and work with project team for quality portion of the final phase gate presentation
* Assist in developing inspection test plans for compliance with project specifications regarding incoming materials
* Analyze data collected from testing and inspections to identify trends, root causes of defects, areas of improvement
* Identify potential quality issues during the design, development, and construction
* Investigate corrective and preventative action (CAPA) to determine root causes of quality issues or problems and develop corrective actions to fix the existing issue and prevent reoccurrence
* Review and investigate ways to improve quality control processes and enhance overall quality
* Review new technologies for streamlining existing processes or procedures
* Review engineered drawings and specifications to understand the requirements for incoming materials
* May collaborate with project team on request for information (RFI’s) for defining tolerances, clarifying project specifications, and quality control procedures
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the lifecycle of the project
* Assist the Field Quality Manager in training project staff on quality expectations, project specifications, receiving materials, performing inspections, entering observations, tracking of quality metrics, quality assurance, and quality control
* Generate required reports to document quality issues, test reports, and corrective actions
* Review and maintain quality control documentation as needed
* Collaborate with suppliers to develop corrective action plans to address root causes and prevent re-occurrence
* Assist when needed to pre-qualify a supplier, observe factory acceptance testing, and determine if test results meet job specifications
* Conduct audits of supplier facilities and processes when warranted
* Maintain clear communication with internal teams and external suppliers regarding quality expectations and issues by kee

Overview:

Responsible to ensure that workmanship and materials meet the required specifications and standards. The Quality Engineer verifies that products and services meet customer expectations and achieve business goals. The Quality Engineer is the Subject Matter Expert (SME) in their area of expertise and is expected to leverage that knowledge to improve project performance, supplier management, and promote continual improvement.

**Location:** Open to remote but preference will go to someone who is able to be in an office location: Fargo, ND; Dallas, TX; Phx, AZ; Indy, IN

**Company Overview**

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).

We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.

The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.

MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Review test results of materials or products to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with specifications and standards
* Inspect workmanship, materials, components, and final products from pictures and on-site audits
* Develop and implement quality control procedures to reduce defects, rework, and prevent nonconformances
* Implement preventative actions to minimize the risk of future occurrences
* Review and approve Lessons Learned and Quality Alerts, in Zavanta as well as assist in standard operating procedure (SOP) updates and reviews
* Attend phase gate dry runs to provide insight and guidance and work with project team for quality portion of the final phase gate presentation
* Assist in developing inspection test plans for compliance with project specifications regarding incoming materials
* Analyze data collected from testing and inspections to identify trends, root causes of defects, areas of improvement
* Identify potential quality issues during the design, development, and construction
* Investigate corrective and preventative action (CAPA) to determine root causes of quality issues or problems and develop corrective actions to fix the existing issue and prevent reoccurrence
* Review and investigate ways to improve quality control processes and enhance overall quality
* Review new technologies for streamlining existing processes or procedures
* Review engineered drawings and specifications to understand the requirements for incoming materials
* May collaborate with project team on request for information (RFI’s) for defining tolerances, clarifying project specifications, and quality control procedures
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the lifecycle of the project
* Assist the Field Quality Manager in training project staff on quality expectations, project specifications, receiving materials, performing inspections, entering observations, tracking of quality metrics, quality assurance, and quality control
* Generate required reports to document quality issues, test reports, and corrective actions
* Review and maintain quality control documentation as needed
* Collaborate with suppliers to develop corrective action plans to address root causes and prevent re-occurrence
* Assist when needed to pre-qualify a supplier, observe factory acceptance testing, and determine if test results meet job specifications
* Conduct audits of supplier facilities and processes when warranted
* Maintain clear communication with internal teams and external suppliers regarding quality expectations and issues by kee

Overview:

**THE ROLE:**

This is a high visibility Quality Assurance Engineer I role that interacts with Operations Departments to create a relationship between the two groups. The Quality Assurance Engineer I will be part of the Quality Engineering team at Herbalife Innovation & Manufacturing, Winston- Salem, NC. This individual will be responsible for performing root cause analyses and leading CAPAs for Material Reviews, Product Complaints, and Non-conforming products. The incumbent should be well versed in data driven decision making for quality defects and developing quality related projects for drive down those defects.

**HOW YOU WOULD CONTRIBUTE:**

* Maintain a working knowledge of regulatory and Herbalife guideline requirements.
* Resolves day-to-day floor concerns and escalates to management as appropriate.
* Contributes and presents quality metrics and defines projects based on data.
* Report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and collate data for monitoring targets.
* Gather data on performance metrics to facilitate the review of program/ product effectiveness, efficacy, and actions for adherence to quality.
* Assign CAPAs to impacted departments. Follow-up on CAPA completion by assisting in implementing corrective or

preventative actions (CAPA) to ensure product quality and CAPA Effectiveness • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and
Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA) as a routine.

* Review and approve investigations for issues found CAPAs to effectively minimize or eliminate those defects.
* Complete preliminary review for Material Review Reports (MRR).
* Review and approve Rework Protocols for packaging operations.
* Lead/Facilitate Quality Events such as Root Causes Analyses or Kaizen Events.
* Support other departments with the completion of RCA and CAPA completion.
* Other duties as assigned.

**WHAT'S SPECIAL ABOUT THE TEAM:**

The Quality Engineering team is a self-directed and highly motivated group that requires minimal oversight and maintain a high level of productivity. They are results driven and proud of the work they accomplish to prevent quality defects yet humble that they tend to stay away from the spotlight. The Team has over 50 years of combined Herbalife knowledge

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* None

Job Qualifications:

**SKILLS AND BACKGROUND REQUIRED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**

**Skills:**

* Has strong knowledge of assessment tools and reporting
* Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills including Microsoft Excel skills /data analysis (statistics, pivot tables, etc.)

* Capable of organizing data from multiple sources, extracting key information and documenting investigation detail. Strong investigative skills.
* Excellent written and communication skills
* Ability to facilitate and lead group discussions
* Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations (FDA 21 CFR – Part 111/117) and documentation procedures.
* Proven ability to be self-motivated as well as to work collaboratively in a team-based environment is required.
* Must demonstrate initiative and a willingness to learn.
* Understands the importance of group thought, information sharing, collaboration and appropriate challenges to status quo
* Demonstrates a strong desire to be involved, maintain a positive attitude, and make a meaningful difference.

**Experience:**

* 3-5 years' experience in a quality/regulatory environment + 3 years' experience in Quality related field
* Knowledge of basic GMP and QA/QC in the food, nutraceutical or pharmaceutical industry

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Science, Engineering, or Physical Science

* In lieu of a degree, 7+ years of applicable experience will be considered

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ASQ Quality Engineer Certification
* Six Sigma Yellow and Green Belt
* BS or MS Degree in Quality Engineering
* Process Control Qualified Individual (PCQI)
* Better Process Control School (Acidified Foods)

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

In general, the following physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow otherwise qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the job.

Must be able to see, hear, speak and write clearly in order to communicate with employees and/or other customers.
Manual dexterity required.

Moderate: Mostly standing, walking, bending, frequent lifting

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

In general, the following conditions of the work environment are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow differently-abled individuals to perform the essential functions of the job within the environment.

The manufacturing facility is clean, orderly, properly lighted and ventilated
Noise levels are considered low to moderate, with some areas requiring hearing protection

Overview:

SSOE is looking for a Senior Process Engineer who would like to be part of our team. This person will support local clients, but also with expectation to virtually support project teams in other locations as well. This individual will work on and lead projects from inception through construction developing PFD’s, P&ID’s, process calculations, equipment selection and specifications in the early phases of our projects and continue to provide support through construction.

**What Makes SSOE a Great Place To Work**

You don't have to be an employee long before you understand the SSOE difference. It goes back to our history of reinventing ourselves for new markets, serious rates of growth year after year, and being ahead of the curve in technology. Those are the achievements of a company that rewards talent and effort in ways that mean the most to the individual.

When you work at SSOE, you work with the best and you're a part of something bigger than yourself. And providing the best possible workplace for our employees gives us a competitive advantage-helping us attract and retain top talent and drive better business results.

AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities:

* Explore the benefits that go hand-in-hand with a process engineering position at SSOE Group. Collaboration, accountability, and top-notch training are building blocks we use to set you up for success. Using sound engineering practices, this role will support clients in the chemical industry. The following duties are typical of the position but are not all encompassing.
* Leading engineering studies, write reports, develop and complete engineering calculations.
* Perform or assist with the development of PFDs and P&IDs, process calculations, equipment specifications, and procurement.
* Provide engineering oversite and checking of process deliverables.
* Coordinate with multi-discipline engineering and design teams to complete necessary project tasks.
* Assist in the creation of bid packages.
* Perform field work to support the above responsibilities.

.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor Degree in Mechanial Engineering, which qualifies for licensure in the state of practice.
* Professional Engineering Licensure (PE) or tracked to becoming PE.
* 10+ years of working experience required.
* Exposure to chemical plants, metals processing, food, beverage or consumer product plants, and/or other related industrial settings strongly preferred.
* Dust Collection or experience with Dust Hazard Analysis is a plus.
* Product Packaging experience is a plus.
* Experience with a chemical simulation program, such as ChemCAD or Aspen.
* Experience using Pipe Flo or AFT Fathom a plus.
* Ability to work in a client-facing role while partnering with contractors and vendors.
* Experience with building codes and chemical storage requirements.
* Experience with utility system equipment and distribution systems.
* Experience with industrial wastewater treatment a plus.
* Salary Range: **$120,000-140,000/year** depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position.
* Benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K, PTO & paid holidays.

description:
Overview:

There’s never been a better time to join the shipbuilding industry. As demand for cutting-edge naval technology grows, General Dynamics Electric Boat is at the forefront-designing, building, and maintaining the most advanced submarines in the world. Our work is mission-critical, supporting the U.S. Navy and strengthening national security.

We offer a workplace where integrity, innovation, and excellence drive everything we do. With competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and career growth opportunities, your future in shipbuilding starts here. Be part of history in the making – apply today.

Manufacturing Engineering develops, researches, designs, and procures special tools, fixtures, and other manufacturing aids required to facilitate submarine construction, maintenance, and overhaul on all classes

D467 Manufacturing Engineering is seeking highly motivated engineering technical assistants with prior experience in the submarine operation, design, construction, or maintenance industry that can join the team.

This position will involve supporting engineering personnel on the development and execution of fixtures as well as originating engineered procedures under engineering oversight and supporting their execution. This position may be located at Eagle Park or Groton based on department need.

Primary job responsibilities will include:

* Supporting Engineering in identifying and developing methods and tools for fabricating and assembling submarine components, structures, systems and modules.
* Developing efficient arrangements of existing production facilities, and layouts for new, expanded or upgraded facilities.
* Participating in Design/Build teams during new product design; review of Class drawings for manufacturing concerns; development of concepts for tools and fixtures; preparation of engineered sequence procedures for various activities; and preparation of lifting and handling procedures and drawings for rigging submarine components and modules.
* Providing pro-active construction support and maintaining consistent interface with the construction trades in support of the above Engineering areas of responsibility.
* Coaching and mentoring Manufacturing Engineers with the goal of developing the workforce’s ability to practically apply engineering skills to ships construction.

The successful candidate will:

* Have the ability to see an evolution practically from start to finish, understand the steps required to execute, and be able to articulate that process in written words as a procedure.
* Have prior submarine operational or new construction experience that will give insight in to the fixtures, tooling, or procedures needed to execute an evolution.
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work well in a team environment as well as independently.
* Have a strong mentoring capability to communicate practical application of products being produced

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* High School Diploma or GED
* 5+ years of experience in submarine construction, test, operation, or maintenance, or related naval construction

**Preferred:**

* Relevant Associates or Bachelor’s degree
* Experience with GD&T
* Experience with welding and structural fabrication

Skills:

* Structural fabrication
* Mechanical / machining
* Trouble shooting
* Procedure writing and execution
* Drawing review

description:
For more than 25 years, NVIDIA has driven innovation in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

DSX OS is NVIDIA's open source foundation for AI infrastructure. It is a growing portfolio of engineering teams building in the open. Every project in that portfolio needs to meet a shared bar for open-source readiness: code hygiene, governance, community health. Today, that's measured by hand, project by project. This role owns an internal product that changes that to a platform that scores, tracks, and reports on readiness across the DSX OS portfolio, and the roadmap that takes it from an internal utility to the definition of what "open source ready" means for DSX OS.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Lead the platform as production infrastructure. Maintain, harden, and evolve it from a measurement tool into the system every DSX OS project runs on — reliability and data quality matter because everything else in the program depends on it.
* Automate scoring. Replace manual review-fix-recheck loops with tooling, so the portfolio scales through automation instead of added effort. Self-serve integration.
* Build scoring into onboarding and workshop experiences. This lets participants get real-time feedback on their own project instead of waiting for manual review. It increases how many teams a single event can support.
* Engineering team feedback loop. Work directly with the project teams using the platform, capture friction signals, and feed them back into the product instead of letting issues pile up in a backlog.
* Readiness tracking and reporting. Automate the generation and tracking of per-project readiness plans so status, blockers, and progress are transparent to leadership without manual assembly.

**What we need to see:**

* 8+ years of relevant experience and a bachelors degree (or equivalent experience)
* Experience leading a software product or internal platform end-to-end and making the calls on what gets built, why, and in what order
* Strong software engineering skills, with a track record of turning manual, error-prone processes into reliable automation
* Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) as part of your actual engineering workflow, not just casual use
* Experience running a production system in the real world — on-call, incident response, or otherwise owning uptime and reliability for something people depend on daily
* Experience building reporting or dashboards that a non-engineering audience (leadership, partners) can trust as a source of truth
* Ownership mentality for production systems — system dependability and integrity of data fall under your responsibility, not someone else 's

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Built or operated a rubric-based scoring or compliance system — quality gates, readiness checks, policy-as-code — where the output has to be defensible enough for people to act on it
* Experience using LLMs within an evaluation pipeline (LLM-as-judge, qualitative signal assessment at scale) rather than only deterministic pass/fail checks
* Designed a metric or signal taxonomy from scratch — deciding what to measure, how to weight it, and how to keep a single score relevant as the system it measures evolves
* Built a tool that abstracts over multiple backends or platforms (e.g., supporting both GitHub and GitLab) so it isn't locked to one provider's API
* Experience with GitOps-style automation — automated checks that run against every repo or PR or equivalent experience without a human in the loop

Motor Components, LLC is a global leader in the electronic fuel pump industry, seeking an experienced **Quality Engineer** to provide support and improve product and process quality within the organization. Reporting to the Quality Manager, the ideal candidate will be responsible for: ensuring products meet specifications and customer requirements timely; analyzing quality data, perform root cause analysis, processing corrective actions and maintaining quality procedures, documentation and records within a manufacturing environment; support product testing, validation activities, along with both internal and external quality audits; improve product reliability and process consistency by working with Production and Engineering Departments to resolve quality issues. In addition, the ideal candidate will be able to perform these functions within a fast paced, results oriented organization that is ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 registered.

**Relevant Experience and Skills:**

* At a minimum, two-year degree in Quality, Mechanical Engineering, Electro-Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering Technology is required, although four-year Engineering degree is preferred. Certified Quality Engineer is a plus.
* 2-4 years of experience in a quality manufacturing environment preferred
* Proficient understanding in the design of processing of electro-mechanical devices
* Knowledge/experience related to the solenoid and motor driven fuel pumps is a plus
* Understanding/knowledge of inspection methods and product testing; experience with quality systems and documentation
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office
* Working knowledge of Lean and ISO
* Possesses “hand on” as well as theoretical approach to solving problems within a team atmosphere
* Knowledge of defect prevention and process improvement methods; Self-starter with high motivation in solving manufacturing problems
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional environment; Supervisory experience a plus
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications; Experience with data analysis and quality metrics
* Ability to manage own time, priorities, and resources to achieve company goals and objectives, both in manufacturing setting and office environment.

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Pay:** $55,000.00 – $75,000.00 per year

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

*People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply*

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s (Preferred)

**Experience:**

* Manufacturing: 2 years (Required)

**Work Location:** In person

description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Product Creation and Industrialization (PC&I) brings together Ford’s vehicle, electric, digital and design teams with our global manufacturing system. Working as one end-to-end organization, we turn ideas into high-quality vehicles, software and experiences across gas, hybrid and electric, designed around what customers need.

In this position...

Advanced EV’s Design Concept Engineering team is looking for a skilled Mechanical Engineer to join our fast-paced development, working on cutting-edge features with complex hardware, sensors and software. You will be responsible for developing product architectures and technology concepts, particularly in the areas of electronics systems. This includes development of early prototypes and new technologies leading into scalable mass production. This work focuses on product-differentiating, customer-facing designs for new products features and development. A good candidate would have a strong background in consumer electronics or user-focused automotive electronics. Experience with working with oversea CMs and production processes are preferred.

What you'll do...

* Concept Design – Work with design studio/product/marketing to create new products in our portfolio to bring new electromechanical/digital experiences to the automotive space.

* Product Development – Drive development from concept through prototyping, engineering development builds, validation, production release, and sustaining/field failure analysis.

* Bring up and validation – Bring up designs done in-house and at JDM/OEM. Test designs for reliability and validity. Implement changes to address issues found.

* Rapid Prototyping – Create quick, simple designs to execute design vision of the studio team using off the shelf parts or quick-fabricated parts. Understand tradeoffs being made for velocity and mitigate risks that impact team progress.

* System Integration – Work with other engineering teams to integrate designs into our vehicles.

You'll have...

* Bachelor of Science degree in ME or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

* 2+ years of hands-on relevant industry experience

Even better, you may have...

* Experience in design, characterization, and validation of consumer electronics, vehicle systems, input devices and/or HMI.

* Background in prototyping, full scale mockups and looks like/feels like demonstrations.

* Strong analytical skills regarding mechanical engineering theory.

* Relevant internship experience, school projects and passion projects that show a passion for product development

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resource groups
* Paid time off for individual and team community service
* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 8 and ranges from $138,800-$232,700.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR

Visa sponsorship is available for this position.

At Stantec, we know the work we do matters. From decarbonizing mines to modernizing electric grids and building the infrastructure that fuels communities, we’re powering the world. Our clients come to us with their biggest, most complex challenges because that’s where we thrive. And we’re looking for problem solvers, high achievers, and visionaries to help us.

Join us for a chance to grow professionally at one of the world’s top design firms while building our clean energy future.

Stantec is actively seeking Mechanical Engineers with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience in hydroelectric turbine and generator projects, dam outlet works, and other large water conveyance projects involving large-diameter valves. This opportunity is open to applicants who are eager to contribute to our dynamic team in the United States.

In this role, you will collaborate with diverse and multidisciplinary teams of engineers and technicians, delivering technical services to our esteemed clients across government, public, and private sectors. Your primary focus will be on mechanical engineering for rotating machines, specifically for water resource projects. This includes working on a variety of equipment such as conventional hydro Kaplan and Francis units, bulb units, reversible pump-turbines and motor-generators for pumped storage plants, and pumps and motors for power, water, wastewater, and light industrial projects. It also includes a variety of large valve types including isolation, discharge, and pressure relief for related hydropower, dams, and water conveyance projects.

Your Opportunity

We are currently engaged as the Owner’s Consulting Engineer in several hydro and valve projects that include complex scopes ranging from refurbishment, modernization, upgrades, to completely new plants. This offers a wide range of opportunities for a Mechanical Engineer with relevant experience. This is also an exceptional opportunity for a motivated and energetic individual seeking to challenge their abilities in a dynamic work environment. Join us and make a significant contribution to these exciting projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

* Collaborating with project engineers and project managers to assist in planning, design, CAD drafting/modeling, and preparation of manufacturing plans, bid documents, technical specifications, and capital cost estimates for various engineering projects.
* Working with clients to identify project goals and priorities and providing strategies and approaches to achieve those objectives.
* Determining criteria, loads, and boundary conditions for the mechanical design of turbines and/or generators including supporting calculations and design basis documents.
* Utilizing knowledge of appropriate and efficient manufacturing processes.
* Performing quality control and designing inspection & test plans throughout the manufacturing process of the equipment.
* Attending and witnessing installation and commissioning of equipment.
* Performing field measurements and condition assessment of equipment.
* Identifying deficiencies, performing root cause analyses, and developing options for the remediation of deficiencies.
* Managing interfaces with the client end users, suppliers of components, tradespeople, and industrial manufacturing engineers.
* Reviewing commercial contracts for equipment supply & installation.
* Communicating findings in report and drawing formats. Delivering client presentations.
* Communicating with other team members and becoming familiar with Stantec standards.

Your Capabilities

* Technical Expertise: The role requires a strong understanding of the mechanical design of hydro units, dam outlet works, and other water conveyance installations. This includes experience with analytical calculations, manufacturing processes, and commercial contracts.
* Software Proficiency: The candidate should be familiar with software used in turbine/generator design, including CAD and mechanical/structural FEA programs. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite is also required.
* Communication Skills: Effective written and verbal communication skills in English are essential. Knowledge of other languages is considered an asset to communicate with international clients and suppliers.
* Organizational Skills: The candidate should have strong organizational and workload management skills. They should be able to identify priorities between multiple tasks and demonstrate a flexible approach to work assignments to meet project due dates.

Job Requirements

* Physical Capabilities: The ability to perform physical tasks such as standing, walking, bending, climbing up ladders, and crawling in tight spaces. This includes performing site work, such as turbine and generator inspection, which may sometimes be identified as a confined space.
* Strength: The capacity to occasionally lift and/or move items up to 40 pounds, such as a man door.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

As a **Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer**, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of optical components, assemblies, and precision-machined parts used in aerospace and defense applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and maintain quality processes, drive continuous improvement, and support real-time manufacturing operations.

**This role is onsite in Carlsbad, California.**

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead quality engineering efforts for optical component production, assembly, and integration.
* Develop, implement, and maintain quality processes to meet engineering requirements, AS9100 standards, and customer specifications.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective/preventive actions using structured problem-solving tools (e.g., 5-Why, Fishbone, DMAIC).
* Collaborate with manufacturing, design engineering, and supply chain to address complex quality issues in optical assemblies, coatings, and precision-machined parts.
* Review and improve inspection criteria, sampling plans, and control documentation.
* Support supplier quality activities, including incoming material qualification, audits, and resolution of supplier nonconformances.
* Provide technical guidance to inspectors and technicians on optical and mechanical inspection methods.
* Analyze nonconformance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Author and maintain quality management system (QMS) documentation, including work instructions, process standards, and quality plans.
* Participate in internal audits, customer reviews, and production readiness activities.
* Read complex engineering drawings and interpret GD&T.
* Work onsite and support manufacturing operations in real time.
* Travel up to 10%.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience
* 5+ years of experience in quality engineering within an aerospace, defense, or precision manufacturing environment.
* Experience with quality tools, including FMEA, Control Plans, Root Cause & Corrective Action, and Statistical Process Control.
* Experience and familiarity with AS9100 or ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools and documentation processes.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Experience working directly with optical assemblies, coatings, or metrology equipment.
* Knowledge of Solumina, SAP, or similar MES/QMS systems.
* Experience in statistical analysis, capability studies, or Six Sigma methodologies.
* Familiarity with design-for-manufacture and design-for-quality concepts.
* Experience leading cross-functional problem-solving teams.
* Formal certifications such as CQE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, or similar.

The Quality Test Engineer plans, performs and leads lab validation activities that support the feasibility of new/improved lab concepts or technologies (equipment, software, test methods, etc.) required to support the development of new products and/or the robustness of commercial products. Other responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, supporting product release activities, including identification of product defects and potential issues, and the management of complaints for commercially released product from investigations through data analysis and trending. This position is also responsible for proactively managing complex issues with a high level of autonomy and is accountable for the success of all activities and deliverables while ensuring related operations comply with BD policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and standards.

* Serves as a technical expert on laboratory instrumentation, equipment and processes.
+ Plans and performs equipment qualifications, test method validations, fixture development, and computerized software validations, as needed.

* Independently plans and performs experiments that support new or commercial products or technology testing. Develops new methodologies or conducts routine procedures, as needed.
* Leads or contributes to nonconformance investigations, root cause analysis, corrective / preventive actions, etc.
* Performs applicable release testing or product testing, maintains documentation, and reviews inspection results.
* Leads or facilitates applicable complaint management process of commercial product, as needed, including sample management, activities performed by support team(s) or supplier(s), reporting and trending
* Supports equipment calibration / preventive maintenance / repair activities and investigations, as needed

* Independently identifies and creates/improves procedures to address gaps in laboratory processes.
* Identifies and supports qualifications of new lab suppliers, when needed. Supports Supplier Quality team with maintenance activities for existing suppliers.

* Maintains inventory of laboratory supplies, test samples, and drug/placebo.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional project teams, when needed. Assists Design Quality Engineers, Complaints team, and/or release teams.

* Supports audits, as needed

* Maintains good laboratory practices (GLP) consistent with BD and regulatory guidelines.

* Maintains good documentation practices (GDP) when generating test data and records in accordance to ISO, cGMP and other applicable regulations and standards.

* Working knowledge of the operation of mechanical measurement equipment (e.g. Instron) desirable
* Proficient communication (written and oral), organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize workload with minimum supervision
* Effective analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills
* Collaborative ability to work with diverse cross-functional teams
* Understanding of industry standards and regulations such as ISO, FDA, OSHA, ASTM desirable

**MWH** is a leading water and wastewater treatment-focused general contractor in the US with a rich history dating back to the 19th century. Fueled by the mission of **Building a Better World**, our teams are rapidly growing across the nation.

As a company committed to our team's well-being and growth, we offer a supportive work environment, opportunities for advancement, and the chance to contribute to a mission that shapes the future. Your expertise and ambition are valued here.

The work we do matters. The critical systems infrastructure we build changes lives, betters' communities, and improves ecosystems. If you're passionate about this, we want to hear from you!

About the Role

MWHis currently seeking a **Senior Project Engineer** to support both preconstruction and construction efforts on critical water, wastewater, and advanced water treatment plant projects for both municipal and industrial clients (including advanced technology sector clients) based out of ***Austin, Texas***.

Essential Functions

Selected individuals will provide technical support to project management and project supervision staff to ensure construction work is performed efficiently, on schedule and in accordance with company policy and engineering standards.

* Assist with subcontractor procurement and management, package development, construction layout, material and equipment procurement, submittal review, manpower scheduling, quantity takeoffs, labor productivity reporting, document controls, material purchases, deliveries and inventory, and project controls.
* Perform ongoing quality inspections; verify all completed work complies with applicable permits, codes, drawings, and specifications.
* Prepare and disseminate all required documentation records such as materials and equipment submittals, status reports, sketches of work already completed, material requirement calculations, to supervisor.
* Prepare drawings and sketches to support construction work, temporary works, work method statements, change orders, and estimates.
* Prepare/facilitate and submit work method statements, ensure requisite approvals and permits are obtained prior to work commencement.
* Research resolutions to drawing interpretation problems, conflicts, interferences, and errors. Initiate RFI’s and follow through to resolution.
* Layout and provide necessary building control lines and elevations for accurate measurement and correct installation of materials.
* Establish and implement office procedures as they relate to the administration of construction contracts.
* Implement project controls for distribution and record keeping of correspondence, technical records, and other project documents.
* Review all incoming correspondence and initiate action on it, record minutes of the weekly and monthly project site meeting, review and process the Contractor’s pay applications, review of the project schedule, process RFI’s and produce weekly and monthly construction progress reports.
* Ensure project management systems are maintained up-to-date and accurate.
* Assist with review and analyze Contractor claims, prepare change orders, and manage claims and change order records.
* Assist estimating staff with quantity takeoffs and solicitation of subcontractors and material vendors.
* Work in a manner to ensure your personal safety and that of fellow employees but following the company health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Perform additional assignments per supervisor’s direction.

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or related field; equivalent combination of experience, skills and training may be substituted.
* 5+ years of construction, design, and management experience/knowledge.
* Experience on heavy civil or industrial construction projects.
* Working knowledge of construction equipment techniques, drawings, specifications, building materials, and required standards applicable to discipline.
* Ability to assume responsibility and work within a larger team environment.
* Ability to interface and communicate effectively with others.
* Software familiarity with CMIC, ACC, Procore and Bluebeam.
* Familiarity with Project Management database systems such as Primavera Contract Manager, Expedition, SharePoint, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience with water/wastewater construction.

**Benefits**

* Group health & welfare benefits including options for medical, dental and vision
* 100% Company Paid Benefits: Employee Life Insurance & Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D), Spouse and Dependent Life & AD&D, Short Term Disability (STD), Long Term Disability (LTD), Employee Assistance Program and Health Advocate
* Voluntary benefits at discounted group rates for accidents, critical illness, and hospital indemnity
* Flexible Time Off Program (includes vacation and personal time)
* Paid Sick and Safe Leave
* Paid Parental Leave Program
* 10 Paid Holidays
* 401(k) Pla

**Job title:** Quality Assurance Validation Engineer

**Location:**Waltham, MA

**About the Job**

**In the race for the future of health – The Sanofi mRNA Center of Excellence (CoE)**

At Sanofi, we chase the miracles of science, and we know mRNA has a role to play in the future of health. And while the pandemic has shaken up our industry, creating new opportunities and risks, we believe the acceleration of innovation with mRNA technology means vaccines and treatments for more people faster than before.

That’s why we’re looking for bold, optimistic world-changers to join our mRNA Center of Excellence. We’re investing €400M a year into the new Center, hiring a team of 450 dedicated employees, and focusing on implementing an integrated end-to-end mRNA vaccine capabilities and research with R&D, digital and CMC teams.

Bring your ambition and optimism and join us on our journey to discover and deliver transformative medicine to patients through the advancement of our cutting-edge mRNA technology!

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.

**About the Opportunity**

The QAV Engineer will support both the Business System Owners and cross-functional technical departments (Validation, Metrology and Automation) at Sanofi’s mRNA Center of Excellent (CoE) and will report to the Deputy Director, Quality Assurance Validation. This individual will be responsible for supporting all field activities supporting internal and external QA Validation efforts as it pertains to Sanofi‘s mRNA Center of Excellence - at its various internal facilities and CMO’s. This individual will be responsible for supporting a team of FTE’s and consultants for Validation and Computer Systems Validation efforts at or on behalf of Sanofi’s mRNA CoE, for QAV related activities.

**About Sanofi**

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

**Main Responsibilities**

**Key responsibilities**

* Support and work in partnership with Validation, Automation, Metrology and Quality Control department personnel as well as cross-functionally with sub-QA departments to achieve deliverable and all routine Validation Lifecycle of the relevant Facilities, Utilities, Systems and Equipment and build strong working relationships.
* Provide QA oversight for GMP validation activities and apply risk-based methodology to validation efforts to help drive deliverables on time in a compliant manner, while serving as the QA Validation Subject Matter Expert and interacting with Business System Owners on their needs.
* QAV support on the necessary Project Plans, end to end Validation deliverables and supports any field activities performed in support of their execution.
* Help enforce compliance with senior leadership strategy and direction, as it pertains to the areas of equipment validation, computer systems validation, cleaning validation, Data Integrity initiatives and routine maintenance of validated systems.
* Help author and maintain Standard Operating Procedures incompliant with internal/global standards to support Equipment and Computer System validation for GMP.
* Support the phase appropriate strategy to the validation deliverables for new and existing facilities and labs.
* Provide QA assessment and approval of GMP validated systems related procedures, deviations, CAPAs and change controls with no supervision depending on complexity of system.
* Provide support for additional QAV-related activities during internal audits and self-inspections, supporting documentation, investigations and remediation activities as required.

**Support Sanofi’s mRNA CoE Metrology and Automation department:**

* Act as the QA contact and QA subject matter expert (SME) on the Metrology and Automation of all equipment/instruments partnering with technical departments and Business System Owners to ensure Data Integrity and cGMP compliance.
* Participate in the continuous improvement and development of Quality Systems to ensure quality and adherence to cGMPs.
* Help investigate and support management in all investigations stemming from Equipment/System failure and determines best course of action for resolution.

**Promote a Quality Culture**

* Support innovation, teamwork and a continuous improvement effort in the level of Quality in Sanofi’s mRNA CoE documentation.
* Ensure that Sanofi’s mRNA CoE Validation documentation meets standards expected by US and global regulatory authorities for research, development and ultimately commercial activities.

**Be accountable for:**

*

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

**What We Offer**

Salary:

$124,000.00 - $171,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop new procedures and Best Known Methods (BKMs) to service new products. Contribute to the FMECA process.

* Participate in or own first chamber Build & Test in Apps lab. Solve issues, or work with Engineering to address issues identified. Work with Manufacturing to develop procedures and participate (if required) on New Product final test

* Partner with Quality & Reliability (Q&R) group to review and address Top Field Issues. Participate in or own CAPA process. Conduct or facilitate Failure Analysis (FA) if needed

* Develop and document procedures to install (start-up), retrofit and maintain the product (Technical Product Manuals)

* Develop new procedures, Customer Engineering Notices (CENs), Internal Service Bulletins (ISBs) and troubleshooting guides as required

* Develop initial training package for new products and work with Global Technical Training (GTT) to develop training class. Train Customer Engineers (CEs), Process Engineers (PSEs) and Technical Product Support (TPS) assigned to customers who will receive ELS Shipments, prior to shipping

* Identify new parts that require to be stocked by AGS and work with them to ensure parts are stocked in correct locations

**Functional Knowledge**

* Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines

**Business Expertise**

* Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market

**Leadership**

* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

**Problem Solving**

* Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

**Impact**

* Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus

**New Product Release**

* New product first-in-fab startup support – technical training of TPS & account teams; Issue resolving

* Communicate with customer and field team for facility/ utility requirements

* Product manual release

* Work with DE to test new hardware/software in the lab

* Support TMC (Mfg. Eng.) to make final test procedure and provide support for final test

* Work with TPS and FSO to release wish list for new product development

* Responsible for PLC product support (Manual ,Field support plan, etc.)

* Set SPL and PLD (Spare Part List and & Part Lifetime Definition )

**Field Issue Support**

* Single point of contact to field team – manage weekly field issue meeting; issue summary/ tracking

* On-site support of TPS escalations and Identify & resolve top product issues

* PSER and JIRA issue timely closure

* Coordinate retrofit submission with TPS/eTPS

* Coordinate beta site testing and reporting

**AGS Support**

* Manage TSL (Target Spares List) and align with AGS to minimize overstock inventory

* SPS review related to legacy products and EOL parts and ECN generation as required

* Support AGS supply chain development

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular

**Travel:**

Yes, 10% of the Time

**Relocation Eligible:**

No

description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

We are looking for a **Mechanical Engineer** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to Director, Engineering and is based in San Jose, CA. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Advanced CAD proficiency: Mastery of CAD software SolidWorks
* 2D & 3D modeling: Ability to create detailed, accurate technical drawings and models for engineering projects.
* Industry standards & codes: Knowledge of engineering, or manufacturing standards.
Software tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and file management systems (Enterprise PDM)

**Experience & Education**

* Education: Associate’s or technical degree in drafting, engineering or equivalent experience
Experience: 5+ years in CAD design or related roles, with specialized experience in the target industry (energy, semiconductor, medical)

**Professional Skills**

* Analytical & problem-solving: Ability to interpret complex specifications and translate them into accurate designs
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams
* Project management: Experience managing design projects from concept to completion, and meeting deadlines
* Attention to detail: Precision in drafting to ensure compliance with project requirements

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee

with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

**Salary Ranges:**
==================

$98,400.00 - $141,600.00

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants, uncrewed platforms, and aircraft carriers—HII is able to ensure a high state of readiness driven by their technical and sustainment expertise.

**Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies**

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

* **Know & Grow Your People** – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
* **Build Relationships** – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
* **Take Ownership** – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
* **Customer First** – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
* **Shape the Future** – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* **Act with Urgency** – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

**Summary**
-----------

Join HII as we keep the world's most powerful Navy afloat! The Fleet Sustainment team is currently looking for a Senior Engineer. This position will provide technical support to engineering teams by collecting and analyzing technical data, producing engineering documentation and drawings, and performing calculations and preliminary analyses to support engineering decisions. The role also assists with testing and data recording, guides junior staff, coordinates with shipyards, OEMs, and subcontractors on ship alteration and overhaul activities, and supports configuration management for ships, systems, and equipment.

***\\*This role is contingent upon contract award.\\****

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

* Provide technical support to engineers on a variety of technical tasks.
* Gather, maintain, format, compile, and manipulate technical data, such as laboratory or material test results and engineering design changes.
* Produce engineering documentation, reports, and drawings, including flow charts, block diagrams, and schematics.
* Perform detailed mathematical calculations using established formulas and preliminary analyses of data where guidelines are provided, including quantitative judgments concerning technical data.
* Use personal computer applications in performance of analyses and development of documentation and reports; may conduct tests and record data to assist with engineering evaluation or analysis.
* Provide direction and guidance to lower-level non-exempt employees; often serve as lead worker on assigned tasks.
* Coordinate with shipyards, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and other subcontractors to support execution of ship alteration, repair, and overhaul work packages.
* Support configuration management activities documenting the current status of ships, systems, and equipment.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Eight (8) years of engineering experience, including at least five (5) years of specific naval engineering experience.
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or business-related field.
* Advanced knowledge in specialized engineering functions, with a wide and comprehensive acquaintance with both general and specific aspects of the job and their practical application to complex problems and situations ordinarily encountered.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance; must be a U.S. citizen eligible for such clearance.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including extended stays in support of overseas customer engagements.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain base access and CAC card.

--------------------------

* Foreign Military Sales (FMS) experience is highly desirable.
* Experience supporting multi-site or complex naval programs, including shipbuilding/overhaul environments.
* Experience supporting international customer engagements involving foreign government information and Controlled U

description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) team is seeking a **Associate****Mechanical Systems Design & Analysis Engineer** to join our team in **Saint Charles, MO**.

On the BT&E Test Operations & Engineering team, the design engineer has the primary responsibility for the synthesis of requirements, creation of engineering definition, 3D modeling, 2D drawing creation, and model-based definition development that defines the mechanical hardware required to install a flight test data system.

This position focuses on the design of flight test instrumentation hardware to meet the test requirements of Weapons program customers including Joint Direct Attack Munitions (JDAM), Small Diameter Bomb (SDB), Massive Ordinance Penetrator (MOP), and other derivative programs. The mechanical designers work the entire design cycle including support of requirement definition, layouts, coordination with electrical designers, preliminary design review, engineering release, coordination with manufacturing engineers and suppliers, occasional shipside support, and change incorporation.

**Position Responsibilities Include:**

* Lead the development and documentation of mechanical and fluid system and thermal environment
* Lead the development, maintenance or modification of system designs/proposals to provide design documentation and high-level requirements to downstream users/customers
* Perform detailed design development and modification of mechanical and fluid system installations
* Lead team in performing spatial integration at system or component level and modification of mechanisms/ordinance systems
* Prepare technical documents for mechanical components and systems
* Prepare proposal and new business development efforts
* Work with test program management for work estimation and intake process
* Delegate tasks to design team and provide supervision to junior engineers

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship
* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus on Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace Aeronautical or Material Sciences)
* 2+ years of experience in mechanical systems design
* Experience with and proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with engineering and design software (i.e. CAD/3D packages (UG/NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, CREO, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor degree or higher in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering
* Active U.S. Security Clearance in the past 24 months
* Experience in test and evaluation
* Knowledge/familiarity with additive manufacturing processes & tools
* Proficiency in Siemens NX

**Drug Free Workplace:**

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace (DFW) where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.
