At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary Pay Range: $85,000-$115,000

**Potential signing bonus for eligible/qualified external candidates.**

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Oct. 22, 2026**

**Export Control Requirements:**

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

**Export Control Details:**

US based job, US Person required

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

**Security Clearance**

**Mechanical Engineer**

The **Mechanical Engineer** is a key technical contributor driving G&G’s mechanical product development from concept through production. This is a hands-on opportunity to join a fast-growing, innovative team where your expertise in mechanical design, manufacturing processes, and product validation directly shapes G&G product design and reliability.

G&G products operate in some of the harshest environments in industry, including high-pressure washdown, chemical exposure, outdoor weather, and vibration. As a proactive problem solver, the Mechanical Engineer thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and decisions are made close to the product. Practical and execution oriented, you drive mechanical design from the first prototype through production release and into the field.

**Who will I report to?** ***VP of Engineering***

**What roles am I accountable for?**

***Mechanical Design & Product Development (45%)***

* Design mechanical components and products in SOLIDWORKS, including enclosures, heatsinks, housings, mounting hardware, wiring harnesses, and accessories; maintain all CAD data.
* Design for injection molding, polymer and metal extrusion, sheet metal, and 3D printing.
* Select and validate engineering plastics, seals, and fastening methods for harsh and chemically aggressive environments.
* Design thermal paths and heatsinks for high-power LED products.
* Build early-phase prototypes and proof-of-concept designs; iterate quickly based on test results.
* Create, execute, and document mechanical validation plans.
* Support UL certification and IP rating compliance on new product development.
* Apply GD&T and tolerance analysis to ensure designs are robust and production ready.

***Manufacturing Integration & Cross Functional Collaboration (25%)***

* Own BOM and drawing accuracy for assigned products.
* Work directly with molders, extruders, and fabrication vendors on tooling, first article inspection, and design changes.
* Validate incoming parts and assemblies against design specifications.
* Design assembly fixtures and jigs to support production at volume.
* Forensic analysis of mechanical field returns and internal defects; drive corrective actions.
* Partner with manufacturing on first-run production builds.
* Establish mechanical test methods and production acceptance criteria.
* Support Sales and Marketing with product drawings, renderings, and technical guidance as needed.

***Product Ownership & Project Management (20%)***

* Own assigned products from concept through production and into the field.
* Keep a clear view of where your projects stand, including work happening with vendors, procurement, and other teams.
* Look ahead for risks and delays and work with the team to find a path forward, whether that’s a second source, a revised plan, or escalating early.
* Make practical calls to keep projects moving, such as expediting parts or building extra prototypes when it saves time.
* Keep stakeholders informed as plans, dates, or results change.
* Follow through on requests from other teams and keep them updated on progress.
* Partner with the Engineering Program Manager on planning and tracking.

***Team G&G (10%)***

* Live and reinforce G&G core values.
* Contribute as a key member of the G&G Engineering team, fostering a culture of problem solving and continuous improvement.

**What does success look like?**

Success in this role means delivering durable, reliable mechanical designs that perform in the field and make it to production on schedule. You own your products from the first sketch through field performance, keep the team informed as work progresses, and drive problems to resolution.

**How do we show up every day?**

* **Positive Attitude** - We focus on solutions not obstacles. We show gratitude and appreciation. We create an environment that’s uplifting.
* **Above and Beyond** - We consistently exceed expectations. We care deeply for others. We choose what’s right over what’s easy.
* **Always Learning** - We constantly seek out knowledge and new ideas. We challenge the status quo with critical thinking. We solve problems through learning and innovation.
* **Gets It Done (GSD)** - We are fast, focused, and efficient. We stay nimble and adapt quickly. We take ownership to make things happen.
* **Detail Oriented** - We approach our work with intention. We take pride in doing things right the first time. We lead with quality in everything we do.

**What will I need to succeed?**

* Must align with our Core Values.
* A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering technology, or equivalent demonstrated experience in mechanical product design.
* 3 plus years of hands-on experience designing mechanical products and taking them through prototyping into production is essential.
* Experience working directly with manufacturing suppliers and vendors on tooling, DFM, first articles, design cha

**Position: Senior Electrical Engineer**

Salary $120K - $160K

**Above Group Overview**

We offer you the opportunity to put your passion and your God given talents and abilities to use. Our goal is to attract and develop skilled, called, and passionate people to impact our devoted customers and our team. We want to attract immensely creative employees with an ability to inspire, motivate, and challenge others.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that supports the well-being of our team. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; employer-funded HSA contributions; and an annual profit-sharing bonus that reflects our organization’s success as a result of our team’s collective achievements across projects.

**For more information, see www.abovegroupinc.com.**

**Our People Strategy**

We believe in a people strategy to be the fundamental driver of our organization. While we can never reach a perfect organizational model, we can certainly strive towards it in our daily efforts and mission. With that vision comes a focus of key initiatives we are working on, listed here, with the indicators of what it should look like as we approach:

* **Shared Direction:** A collective understanding of what the organization stands for, where it is going, and how we will get there. Indicators: a clear inspiring vision, well-executed strategies, clear aligned goals.

* **Authentic Values:** Deeply held principles guiding all decisions and relationships and reflected in the conduct of everyone at all times. Indicators: high levels of trust and communications, uncompromising integrity and ethics, socially responsible practices.

* **Productive Relationships:** Open, collaborative relationships that recognize and honor the commitments that people make to themselves, each other, their work, and the organization. Indicators: respect for all individuals, effective problem solving and decision-making, clear accountability, effective teamwork at all levels.

* **Liberating Processes:** Flexible structures, processes, and technologies that allow people to do their best work and to collaborate effectively across boundaries. Indicators: clear organizational design, collective knowledge, the right tools and technologies, the right people for the right jobs.

* **Outcome Learning:** Results-focused learning that strengthens individual and organizational capacity to cope with the present and define the future. Indicators: continuous teaching and learning, effective knowledge and skills development, leadership development at all levels.
* **Motivating Metrics:** Fair, meaningful performance requirements, measures and rewards that reinforce high performance and manage poor performance. Indicators: clear and energizing performance requirements, relevant work measures, differentiated rewards.

**Our Vision – What We Want to Do**

Continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God.

**Our Mission – Why We Exist**

Demonstrating the love of Jesus Christ through empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service.

**Our Values – How We Will Accomplish This Mission**

Our Core Values are the tools we use and the behaviors we exhibit as Employees of Above Group. They describe how we work together to achieve this special place we’re developing and how they make us uniquely successful.

* **Christian Values -** We demonstrate humility, honesty, integrity, respect, kindness, and a sense of social responsibility.
* **Uncompromising Quality –** We provide excellent results all the time, every time.
* **Buffalo –** We take initiative running toward and owning challenges.
* **Extreme Team –** We are accountable to each other to continuously grow and succeed.

Senior Electrical Engineer

**The Position**

The Senior Electrical Engineer for Above Group performs and provides engineering services for design and construction of projects along with delegating tasks to complete the designs of each project for the Firm. The Senior Electrical Engineer shall possess a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent, from an ABET accredited institution. This individual shall directly contribute to the Firm and its success through the application of knowledge and technical experience to effectively produce a quality design and ultimate product to the customer. The Senior Electrical Engineer is also responsible for contributing to the growth of the team by leading and mentoring subordinate staff in expanding their capabilities and contributions.

**General Duties**

* Responsible for the technical quality of the design of all projects to which they are assigned.
* Responsible for the on-time delivery of all deliverables, which meet AG submission requirements for all projects to which they are assigned. This includes completion of QA/QC process.
* Delegate task

Description:

Pilatus is hiring a Quality Compliance Engineer to join our team in Broomfield, CO. The Quality Compliance Engineer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory documentation framework for Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd. This role ensures company manuals, policies, processes, and procedures remain compliant with applicable FAA and EASA regulations and company requirements. The position serves as the primary focal point for regulatory compliance documentation, supports internal and external audits, interprets new regulatory requirements, and drives continuous improvement of the organization’s documented management system. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and revise Quality manuals, policies, processes, procedures, and work instructions supporting FAA Part 145, Part 21, Part 43, EASA Part 145, EASA Part 21, and other applicable regulations.
* Ensure the QMS documentation structure remains current, controlled, and aligned with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Monitor FAA, EASA, and other regulatory changes and assess impacts to company documentation and processes.
* Lead revisions to Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, Production manuals, and supporting procedures.
* Partner with operational departments to document compliant business processes and drive standardization.
* Support FAA, EASA, FOCA, and customer audits by preparing documentation and coordinating corrective actions.
* Conduct internal compliance audits and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Develop new procedures and process flows to improve operational efficiency while maintaining regulatory compliance.
* Manage document control activities, revision histories, approvals, and distribution.
* Support corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities related to compliance findings.
* Participate in strategic quality and compliance initiatives as assigned.

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aviation, Quality, or related technical field preferred.
* Minimum 3-5 years of aviation quality or regulatory compliance experience.
* Working knowledge of FAA 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145 and EASA Part 21 and Part 145 regulations.
* Experience developing controlled manuals, procedures, and quality documentation.
* Excellent technical writing, organizational, and analytical skills.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits and corrective action programs.
* Strong communication skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office and document management systems.
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

The hiring range is $80,000 - $86,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

**Where is the work:**
On-Site (5 days)

LiquidStack is a global leader in advanced liquid cooling solutions supporting high-performance computing and AI-driven data center environments. We are seeking a Quality Engineer – Manufacturing to support production quality systems, inspection processes, and continuous improvement initiatives. This hands-on role supports manufacturing quality, supplier defect tracking, and new product introduction activities. The ideal candidate brings 3–5 years of quality experience in a manufacturing or electro-mechanical assembly environment and demonstrates LiquidStack’s core behaviors: Flexible, Collaborative, Driven, Agile, Customer-Centric, and Attentive.

Key Responsibilities

Inspection & Manufacturing Quality Ownership

* Own and execute incoming, in-process, and final inspection processes.
* Maintain inspection checklists, documentation, and quality records.
* Support first-pass yield improvement initiatives.
* Ensure product labeling and release documentation meet quality standards.

Root Cause & Corrective Action Support

* Support root cause investigations using 5-Why, Fishbone, and 8D methodologies.
* Assist in documenting corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Verify effectiveness of implemented corrective actions.

Document Control and Continuous Improvement

* Own document control for quality-affecting documents
* Drive defect reduction and Kaizen initiatives, reduce rework hours and cost through root cause elimination, and improve yield through process optimization

Supplier Quality/Tracking

* Track and document incoming supplier defects.
* Communicate quality concerns with Supply Chain and Engineering.
* Support supplier corrective action follow-up.
* Track supplier performance (defect rate, and SCAR closure)
* Drive suppliers toward process control, validate special processes and reduce incoming inspection burden through supplier development and PPAP

New Product Introduction (NPI) Participation

* Participate in NPI builds and validation activities.
* Support development of inspection plans and documentation updates.
* Conduct First Article Inspection (FAI) on initial production units

Quality Systems & Compliance

* Maintain calibration tracking system.
* Support ISO 9001:2015 compliance.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering preferred. Will consider experience in lieu of a degree.
* 3–5 years of quality experience in manufacturing or electro-mechanical assembly.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015.
* Experience supporting root cause investigations.
* Ability to read mechanical drawings.
* Proficiency in Excel.

Key Competencies & Behaviors

* Hands-On & Practical: Comfortable working directly on the production floor and engaging operators, technicians, and engineers.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Looks for root causes, not symptoms; drives solutions, not just documentation.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains rigorous standards in review, documentation, and inspection.
* Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for assigned quality processes and follows through to closure.
* Work Environment
* Primarily based on manufacturing floor
* Must follow all plant safety requirements and use PPE where required.
* May require occasional lifting up to 50 lbs.
* May require standing/walking for extended periods
* Collaboration & Communication: Works well across teams with clarity, professionalism, and consistency.

**Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:**
$65,200.00 - $118,860.00

**Compensation Type:**
Salary

**Incentive Eligible:**
No

**Sales Commission Eligible:**
No

**Disclaimer:** We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status.

**Thrive at work and at home:**

*

**Job Description:**
--------------------

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will design, develop, and deliver mechanical assemblies, including full chassis design for ultra-high-performance and power electronic products. We are looking for candidates who thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment and take pride in delivering high-quality products within small, highly experienced teams.

Our cradle-to-grave lifecycle product development means ownership doesn't end at product shipment; you will also support customer trials, field issues, and product sustaining. You will collaborate closely with an interdisciplinary team of Hardware, ASIC, Signal, Mechanical, Thermal, Diagnostic, Packaging, and Manufacturing engineers, alongside partner engineering teams for joint development programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design rack-level and tray-level mechanical enclosures from concept to detailed design, encompassing look and feel, technology and component selection, tolerance and DFM analysis, documentation, and prototype builds.
* Ensure all designs comply with regulatory requirements and data center best practices.
* Partner with multidisciplinary teams to develop PCB designs, solve complex thermal and power delivery challenges, and incorporate advanced manufacturing technologies into cost-effective, production-level designs.
* Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and product qualification.
* Prepare engineering documentation, including drawings, BOMs, and change orders.

**Key Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5+ years of experience in electronics packaging.
* Proficiency in PTC Creo and Windchill for 3D modeling, design, and data management.
* Experience with sheet metal, machining, die-casting, and plastic manufacturing techniques.
* Experience with designs for high-powered enclosures and devices.
* Experience with liquid cooling requirements and challenges.
* Proven collaboration with production shops and manufacturing teams to streamline processes, enhance quality control, and ensure smooth transitions from design to implementation.
* Understanding of relevant US, European, and Asian regulations, standards, and best practices to ensure safety and environmental compliance.
* Demonstrated lifecycle product ownership of complex products from inception to volume production.
* Experience working with cross-functional support groups, including Sales, Marketing, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Compliance, Safety, and Sustainability.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 101,000.00 To USD 162,000.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

**Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law.**

**If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.**

**About Us**:

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

**About the Role**:

As a Senior Mechatronics Engineer, you will be responsible for keeping our fleet of inspection hardware, from aircraft-mounted infrared sensors to custom drone payloads and crawler robots, running reliably in the field and applying what we learn to the next generation of our systems.

Your time will be split between supporting deployed systems and leading new design efforts. Field support involves remotely diagnosing off-nominal behavior, tracing it to root causes across mechanical, electrical, and software domains, and designing the fixes. You will also lead the design of new systems, bringing lessons from the field into the next build. If you enjoy SSH-ing into a misbehaving unit, reading the logs, and working out whether the culprit is a physical connector, a firmware state, or a tolerance stack, we want to hear from you.

This role will be based out of our office and lab space in Mountain View. You'll be expected to spend at least 3 days a week in the office, given the hands-on nature of the role.

**Responsibilities**:

* Diagnose field deployed systems and drive root cause to resolution
* Lead mechanical and electrical design improvements that address field failures and improve reliability, from CAD changes to parts, assemblies, and drawings to updates in circuits, wiring, and harnesses
* Bring field experience and learnings into new sensor and payload designs, advocating for serviceability, diagnosability, and robustness from the start
* Work closely with data capture software engineers, hardware technicians, and operations personnel to ensure fixes and improvements are successfully deployed
* Guide junior engineers and technicians in debugging methods and root-cause thinking

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering (or a related field) and 5+ years of hands-on experience with complex electromechanical systems
* Fluency in a professional CAD package (we use the Autodesk suite for parts, assemblies, and production drawings)
* Comfort reading schematics and wiring diagrams covering sensors, compute, and power distribution
* Working command-line skills, including SSH, navigating the filesystem, and pulling and filtering logs (e.g., journalctl, grep, tail)
* A demonstrated, structured approach to diagnosing failures where the fault could be mechanical, electrical, or software, and the ability to explain your reasoning
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to translate technical findings into actionable updates for cross-functional stakeholders
* Ability to travel up to 5% of the time to support field deployments and operations at customer and partner sites
* A track record of using AI tools to speed up engineering work, such as triaging logs, drafting scripts, or working through design problems, along with the discernment to recognize their limitations and verify their output

**Day-to-Day Tools/Technical Environment**:

* Autodesk suite (Fusion 360, Fusion Electronics, Fusion Simulation)
* Replica testbed systems for hardware in the loop validation testing
* Scripting where helpful in Python and Bash
* Enterprise level AI tooling available and encouraged

**What’s Included**:

* Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission-driven intelligent aerial imaging company - our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen!
* Autonomy and upward mobility
* Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture: a place where your voice matters
* Competive salary with an annual 12% bonus and stock options
* Your choice of multiple medical insurance plans, including options with an HSA and 100% coverage of the premium for yourself and your dependents
* 100% paid dental and vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO: We mean it when we say we prioritize work-life balance and mental health

*This role has a base salary range of $150,000 - $180,000 USD, plus a target annual bonus and eligibility for stock options. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the USA.*

description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD)** is a leader in energetic system solutions offered to aerospace and defense customers for a wide array of applications. EBA&D products & capabilities set the U.S. standard and are highly sought after in the international community.

EBAD seeks an accomplished engineer for the position of **Supplier Quality Engineer** reporting to the Manager, Supplier Development in our Moorpark, CA office.

**Responsibilities:**

* Implement quality management plans.
* Tactical support with NCR (nonconformance report) closure, root cause and preventive actions.
* Supports Supplier selection.
* Perform Supplier Audits.
* ASL (Approved Supplier List) management.
* Utilize QA/QC tools for measuring supplier performance that affect our products and services.
* Measure and improve Supplier defect rates.
* Issue internal and external supplier Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA).
* Perform on-site source inspection.
* Pareto NCR data within the ERP to help determine systemic challenges.
* Work cross functionally within the Supply Chain, Engineering and Operations organizations to deliver conforming parts, on-time.
* Provides advice and guidance in interpreting and adapting quality standards and government regulations.
* Drive improvements utilizing Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing and Problem-solving tools.
* Analyze data effectively, summarize results, create reports, and use visual management tools effectively.
* Work with EBAD receiving inspection to identify and improve systemic supplier issues for acceptance of hardware.
* Track action plans from supplier audits and assessments and monitor their activity for completion and correctness on a daily basis.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field of study required.
* Supply Chain experience is preferred.
* Understanding of Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing practices, Problem Solving Skills and in-depth understanding ERP/MRP planning systems.
* Minimum of five (5) years of Quality Assurance experience.
* Experience with quality standards including AS9100, and NADCAP.
* Proficient interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T (ASME Y14.5).
* Minimum of five years’ experience Problem Solving, RCCA, five-why’s.
* Strong skills in MS Windows, including World, PPT, Excel and Project.
* The candidate must have excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* Excels in a dynamic work environment.
* Energetic, agile, and ability to work independently is a requirement.
* Must be willing to travel up to 50%.

**Compensation:**

Salary Range: $110,000 - $150,000 per year. Salary is determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

description:
The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring compliance with AS9100 and aerospace quality requirements through the maintenance of the Quality Management System, execution of audit programs, resolution of quality issues, implementation of corrective actions, supplier quality oversight, and continuous improvement activities that support manufacturing excellence and customer satisfaction.

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $93,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

* Maintain and enhance the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with aerospace industry standards and driving superior QA performance.
* Oversee internal and external audits to ensure strict adherence to quality requirements.
* Assist in the resolution of quality escapes, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and follow-up. Champion and train others for the Omni root cause corrective action process.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on data-driven analysis and industry’s best practices.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace and governmental regulations, including certifications.
* Develop and implement quality and inspection plans for manufactured parts and assemblies.
* Interface with internal and external customers and suppliers to investigate and resolve quality issues.
* Manage internal audit programs and train internal auditors.
* Report audit findings to management and develop corrective action plans.
* Evaluate suppliers in collaboration with Procurement to ensure adherence to quality standards through supplier audits.
* Implement quality tools and inspection processes on the shop floor to ensure process control.
* Prepare and deliver quarterly management reviews to the management team including audit and inspection performance data.
* Look for opportunities to streamline QMS processes by removing non value added steps or actions
* 4-5 years of current experience in a Machine Shop Quality Engineering role.
* Machining experience is a plus
* Electrical experience is a plus
* Experience managing or developing a QMS as a QE is mandatory
* Enovia or CATIA experience mandatory
* Multiple years of effective RCCA process management is a must.
* Familiarity with BAC5114 is a plus.
* Understanding of SPC and Sampling is a plus.
* History of working with operational employees on RCCA processes is a must.
* Experience preparing Management review presentations is a plus.

**The Opportunity**

PAE is seeking a visionary and highly technical Senior Lead Technology Engineer in our New York office to provide high-level project leadership and discipline management within our technology department. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of complex building projects, serving as a primary technical resource and mentor for the company. You will leverage your extensive knowledge of converged infrastructure; including telecom, audiovisual, security, and healthcare systems, to deliver innovative, code-compliant solutions while providing guidance to junior engineers and fostering strong, long-term relationships with clients and partners.

**Who We Are**

PAE is an engineering and design firm that turns complex challenges into reality. By leveraging the latest technologies, we solve problems in unique ways, and our designs enable buildings and communities to be more resilient and efficient. PAE is trusted by our clients in every aspect of a project's lifespan, from idea to occupancy. We set ambitious goals backed by analysis to significantly conserve water and energy while balancing costs and long-term operational needs. As a B Corp, we measure success by the benefits our projects provide to our clients, our communities, and our planet. We embrace innovation, transparency, sustainability, and lifelong curiosity.

**What You'll Do**

* Project team leadership and discipline management, responsible for completing the project on time and within budget
* Responsible for the preparation of deliverable documents including narratives, calculations, drawings and specifications
* Attend client meetings, lead the coordination effort between external and internal project teams
* Independently evaluate and apply design judgment, techniques, and procedures to complete a project from concepts through construction
* Extensive knowledge of converged infrastructure and ability to lead the design of telecom, audiovisual, security, healthcare and other technology system
* Assemble effective project teams
* Develop project workplans, tasks and assignments for the team
* Thorough understanding of interdisciplinary coordination
* Advanced understanding of the application of building codes and technology industry standards
* Oversee calculations and equipment selection
* Prepare and review opinions of probable construction costs
* Perform site visits and issues reports
* Provide training, guidance and mentorship for staff
* Provide updates to master specifications and standards, and improve company processes
* Develop client relationships
* Oversee the application of the project quality management plan (QMP)
* Perform other duties as assigned

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s Degree for discipline work or equivalent work experience
* Relevant professional credential (i.e. PE, CTS, RCDD, PSP)
* Requires a minimum of 2-4 years Technology design lead, or 5-10 years’ related work experience
* Inspire and motivate staff
* Serve as a technical resource for the company
* Advanced understanding of technology design concepts and ability to effectively communicate design options to a diverse stakeholder group
* Thorough understanding of project phases and their associated deliverables
* Strong delegation skills
* Proactive and effective communicator
* Attention to detail and advanced organizational skills
* Knowledge and application of NEC and relevant building and energy codes
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Revit/AutoCAD

**What We Offer**

* Hiring Base Salary Range: $113,500-$140,200annual
+ This position is eligible for time and a half overtime pay

The base salary is one component of PAE’s competitive compensation package for employees. We take into consideration a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, internal equity and geographic location in determining exact salary offered. At PAE, employees are eligible for annual compensation reviews based on performance and business needs. The above range represents PAE's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

**In addition, PAE offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:**

* Employer paid health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
* Annual 401k profit sharing based on company profit for the year and account contribution
* Professional development reimbursements including state registration and professional association dues
* Employer paid commuter/parking stipend
* Cell phone stipend
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Hybrid work schedule
* Employee Assistance Program
* 9 paid holidays including an additional employee-selected day
* Paid time off for sick leave, family leave, community service, holidays and vacation
* To learn more about our comprehensive benefits package, visit https://www.pae-engineers.com/careers/benefits. This information is provided per the Equal Pay Act

Looking for work that matters? Join Viant and contribute to the design and manufacturing of medical technologies that improve patient outcomes. Guided by our promise—We’re In It For Life—you’ll build your career with a trusted industry innovator that invests in your growth, well-being, and ability to make a meaningful impact every day.

Manufacturing Quality Engineer

**About the Site:**
Our Wheeling facility combines precision machining and assembly capabilities to deliver high-quality medical device components and finished products.

We offer market competitive compensation. Potential salary range for this role is $95k-$115k. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. Onsite daily.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits, effective date of hire
* 136 Hours PTO (prorated based on hire date) & 10 paid Holidays
* Company-paid life insurance
* 401k plan
* Pet Insurance
* Home Ownership
* Tuition Reimbursement

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated Senior Quality Engineer to join our team. This role is critical in ensuring product quality and regulatory compliance throughout the design and manufacturing process. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in quality systems, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration within a regulated industry, preferably medical devices.

**What you’ll do:** Key Responsibilities

* Adhere to company Core Beliefs and all safety and quality requirements, including, but not limited to company Quality Management System (QMS); Environmental, Health & Safety; company policies, procedures, and work instructions; and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Support regulatory and agency inspections, audits, investigations, and inquiries regarding the control and assessment of product design and manufacturing quality.
* Monitor manufacturing of assigned products, ensuring compliance with DMR and quality system requirements, and ensure complete and correct Device History Records are maintained.
* Identify, prioritize, and implement product and process improvement initiatives.
* Review the adequacy and correctness of changes to Bills of Material (BOM’s), Assembly Procedures, Drawings, Component Specification, FMEAs, Control Plans, etc.
* Generate and lead the completion of protocols and reports for product, process, and test method validations.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineers to review processes for new and existing products and coordinate process validations and capability studies. Recommend process monitoring devices where required and/or appropriate.
* Develop various inspection techniques and procedures to ensure product integrity to design specifications. Write and implement Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspection procedures.
* Ensure that the disposition of non-conforming materials comply with all relevant requirements and ensure that appropriate corrective actions are implemented to prevent recurrence.
* Lead complaint investigations and manage appropriate remediation activities.
* Review quality data for potential CAPA’s, including analyses of data and trends in complaints, supplier quality, nonconforming material, training effectiveness, and root cause analyses.
* Assist with product transfers.
* Work with suppliers, management, engineers, and manufacturing associates in the resolution of quality problems. Also, assist each of these groups with capability studies and the application of statistical quality control, including Cpk, DOE, Hypothesis Testing, etc.
* Provide technical support and direct the work of Quality Inspectors, Quality Technicians, Training Specialists, and/or other Quality Engineers as needed.

Qualifications

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical Engineering preferred) or a related discipline.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years of Quality Assurance experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, preferably medical devices or other regulated industry.

**Certifications (Preferred):**

* CQE, CRE, CQA, Six Sigma Green or Black Belt

Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of root cause analysis, DOE, statistics, lean manufacturing, risk management, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Minitab.
* Familiarity with metals processing and Toyota Production System is a plus.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated success in driving continuous improvement and leading cross-functional teams.

Overview:

**About M.C. Dean**

M.C. Dean is Building Intelligence. We design, build, operate, and maintain cyber-physical solutions for the nation’s most mission-critical facilities, secure environments, complex infrastructure, and global enterprises. With over 9,000 employees, our capabilities span electrical, electronic security, telecommunications, life safety, automation and controls, audiovisual, and IT systems. Headquarters in Tysons, Virginia, M.C. Dean delivers resilient, secure, and innovative power and technology solutions through engineering expertise and smart systems integration.

**Why Join Us?**

Our people are passionate about engineering innovation that improves lives and drives impactful change. Guided by our core values—agility, expertise, and trust—we foster a collaborative and forward-thinking work environment. At M.C. Dean, we are committed to building the next generation of technical leaders in electrical, engineering, and cybersecurity industries.

Responsibilities:

The Quality Engineer is responsible for following the M.C. Dean Quality Control (QA) Program to achieve and verify quality expectations for a durable and reliable installation. The Quality Engineer is responsible for overseeing field inspections to ensure work is in compliance with all safety policies and procedures. Job duties and responsibilities: Document, Implement and Manage Quality Control Plan on the project.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Gather customer specific quality requirements, review all relevant governing reference material for development and implementation of project specific quality plan.
* Create and maintain project specific quality plan and assure alignment between External and MMC Quality Plans.
* Conduct Mutual Understanding Meeting with subcontractors.
* Create and maintain Quality Control Tracking Log (QCTL) with planned and actual schedule for each of the three phases of quality control.
* Create and maintain necessary project specific QC checklists.
* Verify and status submittal approvals.
* Facilitate and participate in Design reviews.
* Maintain ongoing interface with client/client representative for issue resolution, reporting, improvements and audits.
* Maintain ongoing interface with subcontractor representative for issue resolution, reporting, improvements and audits.
* Facilitate and coordinate inspections and audits with 3rd party inspectors.
* Document tailored processes across the value stream using ISO, CMMI, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PMBOK, ITIL and other internationally recognized process frameworks.
* Identify technical and administrative controls and create rules, policies, and procedures for the implementation of controls.
* Lead all activities involving quality assurance, compliance, audits, deliverables, and process improvement.
* Conduct specific audits to measure the degree of adherence to documented policies and procedures.
* Prepare product and process quality reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
* Develop project scorecard on Quality Assurance and report to project and executive teams on the level of adherence.
* Work on special process improvement projects to identify root cause and put in place corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.

Qualifications:

**Education/Experience:**

* 2+ Years of experience with a Bachelors Science Degree in Engineering or Construction Management, with Industrial/Systems Engineering preferred.
* Must successfully pass a background check
* Working knowledge of USACE/NAVFAC 3-Phase Quality Control System.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Data Collection, Management and analysis knowledge.
* Planning and organizational
* Written and verbal communication
* Quick Decision-making abilities.
* Teamwork, Team building and collaboration
* Customer service orientation
* Sharp attention to detail
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Meticulous and diligent attributes
* Great team player with the ability to work with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence with no direct supervisory authority

**Abilities:**

* Exposure to computer screens for an extended period of time.
* Sitting for extended periods of time.
* Reach by extending hands or arms in any direction.
* Have finger dexterity in order to manipulate objects with fingers rather than whole hands or arms, for example, using a keyboard.
* Listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
* Communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.
* Read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.
* Apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.
* Identify and understand the speech of another person.

**Who We Are**

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes.

Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

**Total Rewards**

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

* Entry Level - $87,000
* Mid-Level - $92,700-114,000
* Sr Level - $122,400-154,000

* Provide in-depth technical expertise to develop, manage and implement engineering analysis, activities and programs.

* Provide complete task management of engineering issues.
* Perform engineering tasks as assigned by supervision applying engineering principles.
* Accountable for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of work ensuring proper configuration management and assuring that standard design criteria, practices, procedures and codes are used in preparation of plans and specifications.

* Recommend equipment, new concepts and techniques to improve performance, simplify construction, reduce costs, correct design or material flaws, or comply with changes in codes or regulations.

Overview:

Do you want to build an impactful career to change the world for the better?

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Government Project Accountant** in one of our offices such as; **Blue Bell, PA, Pittsburgh, PA, Asheville, NC, Atlanta, GA, Boca Raton, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Greenville, SC, Richmond, VA, or our Baton Rouge, LA** office. This position performs specialized accounting and contract administration for complex government projects, including project setup, client billing, revenue and cost analysis, financial reporting, and compliance with company policy, government cost accounting principles, and contractual requirements. The role partners closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, clients, subcontractors, and internal accounting teams to support accurate, timely financial administration and reporting.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit: http://www.geosyntec.com/careers/.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

**CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION**

* Perform contract administration for government projects of high complexity and advise Project Managers on contract financial matters and client negotiation factors.
* Interpret contract terms and establish accurate project and contract information in the accounting database in accordance with company policy, government cost accounting principles, and contractual obligations.
* Generate and review pre-billing reports for accuracy, including budget rates, markups, cost-recovery limitations, expense documentation requirements, and other contract-specific provisions.
* Coordinate Project Manager review of draft invoices; correlate, reference, and attach required supporting documentation; and prepare complete draft and final invoice packages, including revenue recognition support.
* Assess project revenue and cost calculations and record approved accounting adjustments resulting from Project Manager review comments.
* Perform cost analysis and distribute selected project management reports to Project Managers, managers, and Principals.
* Adjust annual overhead fluctuations for governmental or Cost Plus Fixed Fee projects, as applicable.
* Establish work breakdown structures, track actual hours, develop cost estimates, and prepare estimates at completion.
* Communicate with Project Managers and Project Directors regarding contract documents, change orders, contract modifications, approvals, additional services, and billing requirements.
* Research unbilled issues to optimize billing opportunities and support weekly and monthly budget and effort analysis for client reporting.

**PROJECT AND FINANCIAL ANALYSIS**

* Prepare proposal and project setups; follow up on client and subcontractor contracts; perform preliminary employee expense report reviews; and complete related administration.
* Prepare subcontractor bid and quote requests for Project Manager action and approval; maintain subcontractor files; and track invoices to support timely processing and payment.
* Monitor budgets with the Project Manager, prepare change orders, and track purchases through purchase orders and subcontracts for budget compliance and payment processing.
* Compile and distribute project financial data, including percent complete calculations and weekly or monthly reports; identify variances and elevate them to the Project Manager.
* Prepare detailed schedule and cost tracking to support timely senior review and client deliverables.
* Collect, prepare, and perform initial analysis of cost and schedule variances, performance trends, labor hours and labor cost versus budget, actual cost versus funding limitations, and project earned value.
* Track actual and potential scope changes and participate in change control management at the Project Manager’s discretion.
* Serve as liaison among departments, offices, subcontractors, agencies, staff, clients, and client accounts payable personnel to resolve project and invoicing issues and minimize payment delays.
* Participate in client meetings as requested and assist Project Managers by interpreting contractual requirements, Federal Acquisition Regulation provisions, and client-specific procurement regulations.
* Prepare project-specific health and safety plans and additional client reports when required.

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.

### **Working Conditions**

**Position located at 464 W Fourth St San Bernardino CA, San Bernardino County.**

**Multiple positions may be filled from this recruitment.**

Summary

Layton Construction is seeking an experienced
**Structural Project Manager with proven high-rise construction experience**
to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex structural scopes on large-scale vertical construction projects.

The Structural Project Manager will be responsible for the overall management of structural construction activities, with particular emphasis on
**concrete, reinforcing steel, post-tensioning, structural steel, vertical sequencing, schedule, cost, quality, and trade partner coordination**
.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience successfully managing structural scopes on
**high-rise buildings**
and understands the unique challenges associated with vertical construction, including structural sequencing, floor-cycle planning, crane and material logistics, temporary works, embeds, MEP coordination, and maintaining schedule performance through the structural phase.

This position partners closely with the Project Superintendent, design team, ownership, subcontractors, and internal project team to deliver predictable outcomes while maximizing project profitability and maintaining Layton’s standards for safety, quality, and client service. This position will report to an on-site Senior Project Manager.

Duties

* Champions
**“The Layton Way”**
by delivering predictable outcomes for internal teams, external teams, and customers.

* Ensures that
**“Constructing with Integrity”**
is delivered by working with honesty, unity, safety, and quality of work.

* Works collaboratively within Layton’s
**“Two in the Box”**
approach, partnering closely with the Superintendent to ensure successful project delivery and strengthen client relationships.

* Provides leadership and overall management of structural construction scopes on complex
**high-rise and vertical construction projects**
.

* Manages structural packages including
**cast-in-place concrete, reinforcing steel, post-tensioning, structural steel, embeds, miscellaneous metals, and related structural systems**
.

* Develops and manages structural sequencing and floor-cycle strategies in partnership with the Superintendent and trade partners to maintain critical project milestones.

* Coordinates structural activities with architectural, façade, vertical transportation, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other building systems to identify and resolve conflicts before they impact field production.

* Assists in the preparation of project estimates and develops and manages project budgets for assigned scopes.

* Manages procurement, negotiation, and administration of structural subcontractor and supplier agreements.

* Manages project schedule updates and key structural milestones in partnership with the Project Superintendent, including
**foundation activities, vertical structure, floor-cycle durations, topping out, dry-in, and turnover milestones**
.

* Evaluates structural drawings, specifications, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, and coordination documents for completeness, constructability, and consistency.

* Works closely with design teams and trade partners to resolve structural design conflicts, field conditions, embeds, penetrations, tolerances, and sequencing issues.

* Manages structural materials and equipment procurement in alignment with the project budget and overall construction schedule.

* Monitors project performance for quantity, cost, safety, quality, productivity, and schedule in partnership with the Superintendent.

* Develops and monitors project quality, safety, and risk management plans with particular attention to structural construction activities.

* Tracks structural production and proactively identifies potential schedule impacts, manpower concerns, procurement constraints, and trade coordination issues.

* Negotiates owner and subcontractor change orders and manages resulting cost, schedule, and profit impacts.

* Develops monthly client pay requests and follows up on collection.

* Controls payment of job costs based on document review and approval and coordinates with project accounting regarding payments, lien releases, forecasting, and monthly project reviews.

* Maintains strong working relationships with owners, architects, structural engineers, consultants, subcontractors, and trade partners.

* Leads structural scope meetings and communicates project status, risks, schedule impacts, and required decisions to project stakeholders.

* Supports final closeout procedures including as-built drawings, structural documentation, punch list completion, substantial completion, and turnover.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in
**Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management**
, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education a

**Position Type:**

Full time

**Overview:**

Vivmark Residential exists to set the mark for what home can be. Formed through the merger of AvalonBay Communities and Equity Residential, Vivmark brings together two industry leaders with a shared commitment to excellence, innovation, and delivering exceptional living experiences. Our vision is to be the most trusted and best-performing rental housing company in America - one that continues to get better as it grows. And we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

As an owner, developer, and manager of more than 180,000 apartment homes in major markets across the US, we have the scale to offer something most companies can't. At Vivmark, team members move up and across functions, markets, and disciplines, building lasting careers. We invest in team members growth, development, and capabilities that make them and us better, and we hold ourselves to the highest standard as an employer.

The best people want to work here. We hope you're one of them.

**The Role:**

This role has two salary ranges, depending on the level at which the candidate is hired:

* **Director Interior Design:** 101,200.00 - 168,700.00
* **Senior Director Interior Design:** $121,200 - $202,000

The final level will be determined based on each candidate's professional experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

The Director/Sr. Director of Interior Design will shape the vision and strategic direction of interior design across Vivmark's multifamily development and renovation projects for multiple regions. As a senior design leader, this role will provide creative leadership, guiding teams and cross-functional partners toward a shared vision while establishing a consistently high bar for design quality. The Director/Sr. Director will build and mentor a high performing design studio and will champion design quality, drive process improvements, and create a team culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design Leadership & Project Management**

* Lead design vision and execution for all interior-related projects, including new developments, capital improvement projects, and renovations.
* Oversee a portfolio of projects from concept through construction completion, ensuring design excellence and quality.
* Direct and perform all phases of interior design, including programming, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, FF&E selection, procurement coordination, and construction administration.
* Manage project pipelines, forecasting, staffing plans, and department priorities to meet business objectives.

**Team Leadership & Studio Development**

* Establish and grow a Dallas-based interior design studio, including recruitment, mentoring, performance management, and professional development of designers.
* Build a scalable team structure that supports current and future project volume.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture focused on creativity, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Manage workload planning, resource allocation, and team utilization to ensure effective project delivery and team development.
* Proactively collaborate with Arlington, VA based design studio for design quality, consistency and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related design discipline from an accredited institution.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in Interior Design, Architecture, or related fields, including leadership of multifamily residential, hospitality, mixed-use, or large-scale commercial projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, mentoring talent, and managing multiple concurrent projects.
* Expertise across all phases of the design process, including Programming, Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Documentation, Construction Administration, and FF&E procurement.
* Strong project management, budgeting, scheduling, and consultant management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on project execution.
* Proficiency in Revit, Adobe Creative Suite, AutoCAD, Enscape, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to travel periodically within the US.

**Preferred**

* NCIDQ Certification.
* LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) credential.

**How Vivmark Supports You:**

We know that our teams are the beating heart of our success and we re committed to showing our appreciation.

**Structural Project Manager with proven high-rise construction experience**

**Position Summary**

The Senior Electrical Estimator oversees the entire electrical estimating team and is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive estimates and proposals for large scale electrical construction projects. This position reviews project requirements, performs quantity takeoffs, develops labor and material costs, obtains subcontractor and supplier pricing, and identifies scope requirements, assumptions, exclusions, and potential risks.

The Senior Electrical Estimator manages and mentors electrical estimating team while also working closely with Sales, Project Management, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Contracts, vendors, and subcontractors to develop complete and competitive bids and support a smooth transition from estimating to project execution.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Team Leadership**

* Works with Electrical Director on WIP monthly targets to help prevent both lags and overloads in field workflow while also steadily increasing division revenue at a sustainable rate
* Assigns electrical estimates to members of electrical estimating team based on skillset, experience and current workload
* Oversees training of junior staff
* Assists in the selection and review of electrical estimator applicants
* Participates in Interviews for potential future ABLe Electrical Estimators
* Implementing company processes

**Estimating & Preconstruction**

* Coordinates with Electrical Director on financial evaluations of current and previous projects to ensure company profitability and success on future estimates
* Pipeline tracking and reports for electrical estimating team
* Review drawings, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and project requirements.
* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and other project costs.
* Develop estimates using estimating software, spreadsheets, historical cost data, and other resources.
* Determine labor hours, productivity assumptions, material quantities, equipment needs, and subcontractor requirements.
* Evaluate project scope, construction methods, schedules, and site conditions that may affect cost.
* Prepare accurate and complete estimates within established bid deadlines.

**Pricing & Bid Development**

* Obtain and evaluate quotes from suppliers, subcontractors, and vendors.
* Compare pricing and confirm proposals are aligned with project scope.
* Identify scope gaps, exclusions, assumptions, and potential cost risks.
* Coordinate with Procurement regarding material pricing, availability, substitutions, and lead times.
* Prepare bid summaries, pricing worksheets, proposals, and supporting documentation.
* Assist with value-engineering opportunities and alternative pricing options.

**Project & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with Sales to understand customer requirements, bid strategy, and proposal expectations.
* Coordinate with Engineering to confirm technical requirements and design assumptions.
* Work with Operations and Project Management to validate labor, productivity, scheduling, and constructability assumptions.
* Coordinate with Contracts regarding commercial requirements, exclusions, and contractual considerations.
* Participate in pre-bid meetings, site walks, scope reviews, and customer meetings as needed.

**Change Orders & Project Support**

* Assist Project Managers with pricing change orders, scope revisions, and additional work.
* Review project performance against estimating assumptions when requested.
* Provide estimating information and historical cost data to support project decisions.
* Assist with project handoff by communicating estimating assumptions, scope, exclusions, and other relevant information.

**Estimating Administration & Process Improvement**

* Maintain organized estimating files, bid documentation, pricing information, and historical cost data.
* Track bid status, results, and relevant market or pricing information.
* Maintain current knowledge of labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor pricing.
* Follow established estimating procedures, approval requirements, and quality standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve estimating processes, tools, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Manage multiple estimates and competing deadlines effectively.

**Education, Experience, and Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of estimating or related construction experience preferred, with proven track record on large scale projects.
* 3+ years in a management or leadership role
* Strong Leadership Skills
* Experience with large scale electrical project-based industries preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and technical documentation.
* Understanding of construction methods, labor productivity, material costs, and project pricing.
* Strong mathematical, analytical, organiz

**Job #**

042988

**Department Code**

31301-0097

**Department**

D'Aniello Institute for Veterans and Military Families (IVMF)

**Job Title**

Director of Entrepreneurship

**Location**

Syracuse, New York

**Campus**

Remote

**Commitment to On-Campus Experience**

Syracuse University is committed to delivering an exceptional student experience through vibrant, engaged campus communities. This position is based at the above campus location and requires regular in-person presence to support our students, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to our thriving academic environment. Syracuse University values the collaboration, mentorship, and spontaneous connections that happen when our community works together on campus. Remote work arrangements are limited in accordance with University policy.

**Pay Range**

$85,000 - $134,000

**Pay Determination**

Pay rates at Syracuse University are based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, the job responsibilities; the candidate’s education, training, work experience and key competencies; the university’s strategic priorities; internal peer equity; applicable federal, state, local laws, grant funding and contractual requisites; and external market analyses.

**Staff Level**

S6

**FLSA Status**

Exempt

**Hours**

Standard University business hours

8:30am – 5:00pm (academic year)

8:00am – 4:30pm (summer)

Hours may vary based on operational needs.

**Job Type**

Full-time

**Unionized Position Code**

Not Applicable

**Job Description**

Job Overview:

Skanska is searching for a dynamic Senior Project Manager. This is a great opportunity to start a career with a company that builds things that matter and values its team. We are proud to share our culture of diversity and inclusion.

Our work makes a clear contribution to society and the environment around us. We build in many different verticals. Whether we are building schools to provide inspiring spaces for learning, roads to connect communities or hospitals to care for patients, it all contributes to our purpose – we build for a better society.

Skanska's values —Be Better Together, Act Ethically and Transparently, Commit to Customer and Care for Life—are deeply engrained in how we work, which is why our values support and drive our D&I efforts.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing senior-level leadership, direction, and oversight for large, complex construction projects or multiple concurrent assignments within Skanska USA Building Inc. This role is accountable for managing the full lifecycle of project delivery, from preconstruction, planning, procurement, and contract administration through construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout. The Senior Project Manager helps ensure that projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations, contractual requirements, financial objectives, schedule milestones, quality standards, and Skanska’s operational practices.

Serving as a central leader on the project team, the Senior Project Manager works in close partnership with Project Executives, Superintendents, Project Managers, Project Engineers, clients, architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal support functions to establish project strategy, align key stakeholders, and maintain disciplined execution. This role is responsible for leading major project management functions, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, subcontract administration, procurement, document management, change management, risk identification, issue resolution, and performance reporting. The Senior Project Manager is expected to evaluate project conditions proactively, anticipate challenges, and make sound, timely decisions that support overall project success.

A key aspect of this position is financial and operational stewardship. The Senior Project Manager is responsible for monitoring the financial health of the project, managing forecasts and cost exposure, supporting fee protection, reviewing contract obligations, and helping ensure that commercial decisions are made with a clear understanding of project risk and business impact. This individual also plays an important role in maintaining schedule performance by collaborating with field leadership and trade partners to address procurement timelines, sequencing issues, labor coordination, design clarifications, and other factors that can influence progress and productivity.

The Senior Project Manager also serves as an important relationship leader, helping to build and maintain trust with clients and project partners through consistent communication, professionalism, transparency, and responsiveness. This role represents Skanska in meetings, negotiations, and high-level project discussions, and is expected to help resolve complex concerns while reinforcing confidence in the team’s ability to deliver. In addition, the Senior Project Manager supports a culture of collaboration and accountability across the project team, helping ensure that communication is clear, expectations are understood, and responsibilities are executed effectively.

Successful performance in this role requires deep construction knowledge, strong leadership ability, sound business judgment, and the capability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment. The Senior Project Manager is expected to model and reinforce Skanska’s values of safety, ethics, inclusion, sustainability, and continuous improvement while mentoring less experienced team members and strengthening overall team capability. Through disciplined project leadership, strong client service, and a commitment to operational excellence, the Senior Project Manager contributes directly to the successful delivery of projects and the long-term strength and reputation of Skanska USA Building Inc.

**Senior Project Manager** **Required Qualifications:**

* + - 6+ years proven track record of assuring client satisfaction.
- 6+ years track record of delivering on-time projects.
- 6+ years of experience maintaining or exceeding planned profit targets for projects.
- 6+ years creating and maintaining a culture of safety.
- 6+ years experience developing a culture of quality assurance and control.
- 6+ years managing and developing succesful teams.
- Bachelor’s Degree – Construction Management or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years.

-----------------------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

------------

You'll own the full implementation journey for Kaizen's federal customers: scoping the rollout, configuring the platform, training agency staff, and staying in the room until the deployment is actually adopted, not just launched. You'll work inside classified and accredited environments where every integration decision has to account for what data can move where, and you'll partner closely with the engineering team to make sure what gets shipped actually fits how the agency operates.
