**Procurement Coordinator**
===========================

Riddleberger Brothers, Inc. (RBI), a leading mechanical contractor in the Shenandoah Valley, is seeking a Procurement Coordinator to join our service team in Mount Crawford, VA. This full-time position will manage purchasing processes, vendor relationships, inventory, and material logistics to support efficient service operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and manage purchasing processes that promote value and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate equipment and material purchasing to support project schedules and minimize work in progress.
* Prioritize and process call-in material orders.
* Issue purchase orders with accurate vendor, part, pricing, and job or truck-stock information.
* Follow up with vendors, technicians, customers, and dispatchers regarding material availability and delivery schedules.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure the best overall value.
* Utilize vendors participating in the Comfort Systems USA National Purchasing Program.
* Process material returns, warranty claims, and RMA requests.
* Develop and maintain a preferred vendor list.
* Safely operate forklifts and vehicles to transport materials as needed.
* Manage main stock inventory, including quarterly checks, inventory counts, and auditor coordination.
* Manage small-tool procurement and tracking by technician and vehicle.
* Stock and prepare vehicles for new hires.
* Assist with purchase order entry and pricing.
* Provide backup support for quote processing, work order processing, invoicing, quoting, and accounts payable invoice processing.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of three years of experience in the commercial HVAC industry.
* Experience in materials purchasing preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
* Working knowledge of materials and systems related to the mechanical or HVAC industry.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and follow-up skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Professional, positive, cooperative, and teachable attitude.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to coordinate multiple activities and meet deadlines.
* Valid driver’s license required; ability to meet company driver qualification standards preferred.
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Ability to climb stairs and ladders as needed.
* Ability to stand, squat, bend, and stoop.

o Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

o Review and issue all purchase requests and SAP orders. Obtain necessary approval(s), review and analyze all reimbursements, requisitions, and Eastman Chemical Company credit card purchases. Review all Tool/Equipment and supplies purchases to ensure accuracy and completeness.

o Assist in managing Partner Tool Room inventory and ensuring proper stock levels.

o Assist in scheduling, transport, and payment for Partner equipment service and/or repair.

o Expedite, follow up, and ensure timely delivery of purchase order materials required by all departments. Just-In-Time (JIT) delivery.

o Select products for purchase by testing, observing, or examining items. Estimate value according to knowledge of market price.

o Interface with client and vendors to ensure all purchasing requirements, problems, etc. are addressed/resolved.

o Manage cost saving initiatives. Review and analyze all purchasing documents.

o Ensure all departmental procedures, policies, and work rules are complied with.

o Assist in management and scheduling service of Partner Industrial vehicle fleet.

o Assist in the Partner Cooler Room process as needed.

o Act as backup for the Tool Room Manager during absences to lead employees and maintain processes.

o Perform additional assignments per supervisor’s direction.

o Must be able to comply with all safety regulations and procedures applicable to a chemical plant environment.

o Regular reliable attendance and flexibility to work varied shifts and overtime as needed.

* Vision insurance

Overview:

Herzog Energy, Inc. is currently seeking a **Procurement Coordinator** in **St. Joseph, MO** to join our team and support the growing Procurement and Supply Chain function within Herzog Energy.

The Procurement Coordinator supports the day-to-day administrative, data management, vendor coordination, and purchasing activities necessary to support Herzog Energy's construction projects.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* This is a non-exhaustive overview of the job duties for this position.

* Procurement & Administrative Support: Support the Procurement and Supply Chain Manager with daily purchasing and procurement activities across active and upcoming renewable energy projects, including general administrative duties, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Records Management: Enter, maintain, and update procurement information within company systems, spreadsheets, and tracking tools.
* Vendor Records: Maintain current vendor contact information, capabilities, certifications, catalogs, and other supplier information.
* Contract Administration Support: Track contract and subcontract status, signatures, revisions, required documentation, and other administrative requirements.
* Invoice Support: Assist with matching invoices to purchase orders and supporting documentation and identify discrepancies for review.
* Reporting: Prepare routine procurement reports and provide accurate information regarding open purchase orders, pending approvals, upcoming deliveries, vendor documentation, and other procurement activities.
* Adhere to established company policies, procedures, terms and conditions, and legal matters that affect purchasing and procurement activities.
* Perform all duties in conformance with appropriate safety policies and procedures.
* Regular and consistent engagement, participation and promotion of Herzog’s Culture and its essential behaviors are a requirement for this position.
* Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are a must.
* Time-management skills are essential; must possess a natural sense of urgency and work well with pressure and deadlines.
* Must be a self-starter and able to excel in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and adaptive to change.
* Possess a high level of ingenuity.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of employees and prospects.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products and advanced computer literacy skills.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

* Subject to pre-employment background check and motor vehicle report review.
* Subject to pre-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen.
* Successfully complete and maintain any required safety certification and testing on an annual basis.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described below must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this role. This is a non-exhaustive overview of the physical requirements for this position.

* Work primarily in an office environment.
* Frequently sits for extended periods of time.
* Frequently use a computer keyboard and office related equipment.
* Requires occasional standing, walking, lifting, stooping or bending.

**Safety:**

* Herzog is nationally recognized for its excellent corporate safety record which results from all employees at all levels, in all positions adhering to established policies and procedures. Reporting any and all safety violations to your immediate supervisor is a prerequisite for continued employment. Safety diligence by all results in a safe work environment for all.

**Benefits:**

* Herzog offers a robust benefits package including medical and dental coverage. The plans are specific to projects and locations.

**Why Herzog:**

Founded in 1969, Herzog is headquartered in St. Joseph, Missouri, with a satellite office in Fort Worth, Texas.

Over the course of our 50+ year history, Herzog has become a national leader in the construction, operations and maintenance of commuter rail, light rail, streetcar, and freight rail projects.

We believe our culture is at the heart of our existence. It is that belief which empowers every member of our professional family to act with purpose and passion as they advance their career throughout their personal pursuit of excellence.

Backed by over five decades of experience, Herzog delivers exceptional customer service and elite results.

Our success is the outcome of our relentless pursuit of excellence, our passion for our customers, safety without compromise, and a deep-rooted belief in the power of team.

We invite you to join us on our journey to excellence as we work to be better today than yesterday and better tomorr

**Job Description**

**Title**: Procurement & Logistics Coordinator

**Supervisor**: Procurement & Warehouse Manager

**Department**: Procurement & Warehouse

**FLSA** **Status**: Non-exempt/hourly

**Summary/Objective**

The **Procurement and Logistics Specialist** is responsible for (a) sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing goods and services in alignment with the company’s quality, quantity, and cost expectations and (b) coordinating and optimizing the movement of goods, materials, and equipment to ensure timely, cost-effective, and efficient delivery. **Be part of an amazing story**

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

**Job Overview**

The Capital & Expense Control Coordinator is a member of the team responsible for managing collateral production for Macy’s Visual Merchandising, supporting various Macy’s businesses related to in-store marketing and promotions. This role requires building relationships, negotiating with an enterprise-minded focus, navigating reflows, adapting to evolving creative changes, and possessing strong problem-solving skills. The Capital & Expense Control Coordinator reports to the Manager of Capital & Expense Control and Beauty Print Production.

**What You Will Do**

* Control, process, and reconcile visual distributions and purchase orders for capital and expense purchases.
* Develop and maintain records, financial reports, and cost analyses for Visual budgets.
* Partner with Finance colleagues to coordinate fund transfers, reconcile final costs, and manage balance sheet functions.
* Serve as a liaison between vendors and the visual team regarding store deliverables.
* Negotiate pricing and organize warehouse and trucking for seasonal operational needs.
* Negotiate pricing and organize storage and trucking for office and special project needs.
* Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

**Skills You Will Need**

**Relationship Building:** Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.

**Negotiation:** Proficiency in negotiating with an enterprise-minded focus.

**Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving abilities.

**Expense Management and Financial Analysis:** Minimum of 2 years of experience in expense management and financial analysis.

**Collaboration:** Proven strength in collaborating with others.

**Excel Proficiency:** Advanced skills in Excel, including pivot tables, Vlookup, and filtering.

**Project Management:** Outstanding project management skills.

**Organization:** Excellent organizational skills.

**Communication:** Effective communication skills.

**Troubleshooting:** Ability to pivot, troubleshoot, and navigate reflows in a reactive business environment.

**Mathematical Skills:** Accelerated math skills and strategic thinking.

**Teamwork:** Solid ability to work both as part of a team and independently with minimal supervision.

**Interpersonal Skills:** Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to gain respect and cooperation from peers and high-level executives.

**Who You Are**

* Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 2+ years of experience in expense management, project management or financial analysis is preferred.
* This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
* Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

**What We Can Offer You**

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

*Some additional benefits we offer include:*

* Merchandise discounts
* Performance-based incentives
* Annual merit review
* Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
* Tuition reimbursement

*Access the full menu of benefits offerings* *here**.*

**About Us**

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

***Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!***

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator, based in Las Vegas, NV, plays a pivotal role in managing procurement operations, product research, and vendor negotiations under the direction of the Purchasing Manager. This role is responsible for executing the end-to-end purchasing workflow utilizing enterprise procurement software (SpendMap) to source goods, manage purchase orders, track inventory par levels, and reconcile invoices. By driving strong vendor relationships and aggressive cost negotiation, the Purchasing Coordinator ensures high-quality products and supplies are delivered efficiently to support the luxury operational standards of Paws Up Montana.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Procurement & Order Management:** Enter, process, expedite, and track purchase requests and purchase orders from initial order creation through final delivery using SpendMap.
* **Vendor Negotiations & Cost Control:** Actively research products, conduct three-bid competitive sourcing, and negotiate pricing with suppliers to secure the best possible quality and price for resort supplies.
* **Inventory & Par Level Support:** Assist in maintaining optimal inventory par levels across multiple operational areas, with dedicated focus on guest supplies, small tools, and operational equipment.
* **Vendor Relations & Invoice Reconciliation:** Establish and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and representatives while managing invoice reconciliation and order tracking.
* **Interdepartmental Support & Collaboration:** Partner closely with internal property departments and executive offices to resolve procurement inquiries, maintain delivery timelines, and fulfill supply needs.
* **Accountability & Workspace Maintenance:** Maintain meticulous organized records, purchase order files, and vendor databases to ensure total compliance and operational efficiency.
* **Ad-Hoc Duties:** Perform additional small projects and duties as assigned by the Purchasing Manager.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 2–3 years of purchasing experience handling a diverse range of product categories; familiarity with building materials or hospitality supplies is a plus.
* **Specialized Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the purchasing lifecycle, competitive three-bid processes, purchase order management, and contract negotiation.
* **Core Skills:** Superior negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills; high detail orientation with an energetic, adaptable, and "think outside the box" work approach.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong working knowledge of enterprise procurement systems (SpendMap experience preferred), advanced internet research skills, and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* **Work Style:** Ability to work effectively in an office setting, maintaining professionalism, discretion, and a neat presentation in all interdepartmental interactions.
* **Licensing/Certification:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

* **Mobility & Stamina:** Ability to sit constantly for extended periods of daily computer, system, and telephone work, with occasional standing and walking throughout the office.
* **Scheduling:** Ability to work full-time hours, with flexibility as needed to accommodate operational demands and supply chain priorities.
* **Lifting & Handling:** Ability to occasionally lift, carry, reach, or handle office files, packages, and procurement samples weighing up to 15–20 lbs.

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

Description:

**Position Summary**

The Corporate Materials Coordinator supports purchasing and supply operations across multiple facilities from a central location. Unlike a single facility-based role, this position focuses on system-wide ordering, vendor and contract support, data accuracy, and cost control. Management relies on this role to resolve supply issues, maintain item and pricing data, and keep purchasing consistent across sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing Support**:

* Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders for supplies, equipment, and services across sites
* Follow up on backorders, delays, and substitutions, and communicate updates to facilities
* Monitor orders for contract compliance and flag off-contract purchases
* Support emergency or urgent orders when sites have critical shortages

**Vendor and Contract Support**:

* Serve as a point of contact for vendor and distributor representatives on order status, pricing, and delivery issues
* Help maintain contract files, pricing schedules, and renewal calendars
* Assist with price comparisons, product trials, and standardization projects
* Track vendor performance (fill rates, on-time delivery, billing accuracy)

**Data and Systems:**

* Maintain item master and pricing data in the ERP or purchasing system; communicate savings opportunities with management
* Update catalogs, units of measure, and vendor information
* Run routine reports on spend, usage, and inventory levels, and identify trends or anomalies
* Reconcile purchase orders, receipts, and invoices, and help resolve payment discrepancies with Accounts Payable

**Inventory and Par Level Oversight:**

* Review facility par levels and usage data and recommend adjustments
* Support periodic inventory audits and reconcile variances
* Help monitor expiring or slow-moving stock across locations

**Compliance and Quality:**

* Support product recall and safety alert processes by identifying affected items and notifying sites
* Maintain documentation to support audits, surveys, and regulatory requirements
* Ensure purchasing follows organizational policy, approval limits, and ethical sourcing standards
* Serve as a resource for facility administrators, nursing leaders, and department managers on supply questions
* Coordinate with Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, and Clinical Operations on cross-functional issues
* Contribute to cost-savings initiatives and product standardization efforts
* Other Duties as Assigned

Requirements:

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing, supply chain, inventory, accounts payable, or administrative support (Healthcare Preferred)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to prioritize competing requests and meet deadlines

**Preferred:**

* Experience with an ERP or purchasing system (e.g., Oracle, Lawson/Infor, MediTech, SAP, or similar)
* Familiarity with healthcare products, group purchasing organizations (GPOs), or distributor catalogs
* Basic data analysis or reporting skills

**Core Competencies:**

* Accuracy and follow-through
* Analytical thinking
* Vendor and customer service orientation
* Time management
* Discretion with contract and pricing information

**Working Conditions:**

* Primarily office-based, with computer work for most of the day
* Occasional travel to facilities
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Standard business hours, with flexibility for urgent supply needs

**Portland, OR**

The Used Book Coordinator plays a central role in expanding Powell’s used book inventory by evaluating large-buy opportunities, negotiating purchases, and managing the logistics of bringing collections into the company. Book borrowing privileges

description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Under the supervision of the Urban Indian Center of Salt Lake (UICSL) Finance Director, the Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator is responsible for managing and controlling the organization’s inventory and related procurement processes. This self-starting role will involve tasks such as monitoring stock levels,
forecasting demand, placing purchase requests, and managing relationships with various suppliers and vendors. This role is critical to ensure a smooth supply chain and work with our Staff Accountant/ordering teams to ensure efficient operations. The Purchase and Inventory Coordinator will be the main individual responsible for managing procurement processes, overseeing stock levels, and creating supply vendor relationships. This position will be based out of the West Valley administrative office but will travel to additional UICSL facilities through UICSL-provided transportation to ensure accurate inventory counts and work with internal staff on items outside of their purview. The Purchasing and Inventory Coordinator will demonstrate specific and cultural sensitivity toward
UICSL and American Indian/Alaksa Native (AI/AN) clients. All duties will be done in accordance with federal and state regulations and will be sufficient in the needs of the organization. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational and time management abilities. Proactive attitude
with a willingness to learn and develop new skills.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Inventory management – tracks inventory levels, analyzes usage trends, sets order points, and conducts regular cycle counts

Procurement – purchases materials, equipment, and sometimes services – often negotiating prices and terms with suppliers and internal staff
Supplier relations – build and maintain positive relationships with suppliers as it’s crucial to ensuretimely delivery and overall quality of products
Cost Control – minimize inventory costs and optimizing purchasing
Interview potential vendors and select ones that best meet the needs of the organization under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) – appropriated funds following grant guidelines and following vendor selection policy
Evaluate the selection and shipping process and work to improve efficiency
Keep up to date with industry trends and update inventory on a regular basis
Negotiate vendor contracts and pricing agreements to achieve cost-effective purchasing
Conduct regular assessments of supplier performance and implement improvement plans as necessary
Work with Staff Accountant to coordinate purchasing slips, packing slips, and complete purchase order process

Create and maintain a purchasing/inventory system that is efficient with fewer out of stocks within the organization
Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier communications
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand purchasing needs and ensure timely delivery of goods

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
Education: High school diploma or GED
Experience: 5-6 years of experience in a purchasing or procurement role
Familiarity with vendor management and contract negotiation
Basic understanding of supply chain principles and inventory management
Other: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel

Job Overview
The Purchasing Coordinator will play a crucial role in supporting the purchasing process, ensuring that materials and supplies are acquired efficiently and effectively. This position is perfect for someone looking to grow their career in supply chain management and procurement.

Duties

* Work within our S4/Hana ERP system to produce, confirm, and maintain purchase requisitions and purchase orders, as well as purchasing and costing data.
* Work with vendors, freight companies, and internal operational groups to ensure that all goods and services purchased arrive in a timely manner at the proper cost to meet production schedules.
* Work with quality and production departments on quality issues with vendors, including vendor returns.
* Source vendors, obtain quotes, and negotiate costs/pricing on MRO and similar types of inventory items.
* Work with Purchasing Manager and other internal departments on product related projects and initiatives.
* Work with Purchasing Manager to monitor supplier performance to identify opportunities for cost savings and improved service.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Experience

* A background in purchasing or supply chain management is preferred but not required.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems such as SAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess pricing strategies and market conditions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with team members and suppliers.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, for data analysis and reporting.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving with a keen attention to detail.

**Position Summary:** The PD Coordinator is a critical member of the Product Development team responsible for sourcing, initiating, and engineering innovative product to market in a timely and cost-effective manner. The scope of the role consists of driving novelty component development for customer accounts and primary ownership of our main Spirit® seasonal lines. This individual excels in working cohesively with cross-functional partners in Design, Sales & Production to execute exceptional product within ambitious timelines.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Sourcing of new fabrics/yarns, trims, notions, packaging & technologies for Canvas Co.-driven development, as well as customer adopted active styles.
* Setup & documentation of the all the above in PLM; Thorough RM record completion: Material properties, FDS docs, unit cost, performance pre-testing, etc.
* Development of novelty embellishments – screen print innovations, embroidery applications, garment dye & wash techniques, AOP capabilities, etc. – w/ external supplier base.
* Complete, agile timeline ownership for all component sourcing.
* Close coordination with Canvas PD team for all development direction; Administer input on feasibility, optimal execution, technical parameters, and cost considerations.
* Collaborate with PD team to manage incoming and outgoing samples from factories to clients.
* Style development, setup and tech pack creation: Defining BOM items, garment decoration process, packing & trim requirements, and special handling instructions. Work with tech designer to ensure all technical elements are included and sample evaluations are completed.
* Oversee and maintain dept. libraries for embellishments, fabric & trim components, physical and digital.
* Organize incoming art from designers in presentation decks for clients
* Co-administration of development calendars; Drafting and implementation. Follow up w/ Design and hold upstream partners accountable for meeting key milestones/PD handoffs in timely manner.

**Critical Aspects:**

* Main functions predominantly consist of raw product development and R&D. This workflow will be very unstructured and freeform coming from Design. Less style numbers, more individual material items.

---------------

Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. **To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a/an** **Materials Coordinator in** **USA Fontana, Ca.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Report to the **Materials Manager, Materials Coordinator,** is responsible for coordinating and expediting the flow of materials among departments to ensure production schedules and deadlines are met.

**What a typical day looks like:**

* Pre-production planning and support: Review all materials to establish the project material status for Project readiness signoff on proposed production dates
* Follow up with vendors and buyers regarding lead times for materials and obtain tracking information; coordinate delivery dates, as needed.
* Follow up on any items showing short by working with Purchasing and engineering to get a resolution in place
* Update the status of the materials and ETAs in the ERP system to provide visibility to downstream processes
* Attend weekly production meetings and provide accurate information regarding material lead times and any issues that could potentially affect production
* Active Project production Support: Tracks material shortages and maintain a complete material shortage report along with resolution status on those items
* Interfaces and coordinates with various departments to resolve material and capacity constraints
* Attend daily production walk-through meetings to identify any material issues that could potentially affect production
* Notify appropriate internal teams (project managers, production managers, etc.) of any issues and material shortages that could potentially affect production
* Manage the log for material borrows between projects and get appropriate visibility
* Postproduction Support: Document and verify all ship lose material and items are accounted for prior to shipment of manufacturing projects
* Review all leftover items and establish a disposition plan for those items
* Review all open transactions and evaluate actions towards closing out all project transactions
* Root cause reasons for material shortages
* Research discrepancies associated with invoices
Perform other related duties as assigned

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* 4+ years’ experience in planning, production, inventory, or expeditin
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent organizational and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and an MRP/ERP System

**What the physical requirements are:**

* Periods of standing, walking, and sitting at a desk using a computer
* Must be able to lift up to 35 pounds at a time.
Must wear PPE, such as gloves, safety glasses, hard hat, and ear protection, while working on the production floor

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans

* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

description:
Come join a company that recognizes and rewards your abilities, provides opportunities to advance your career, and fosters an environment to learn and develop. Experitec is seeking high impact employees with focus and integrity to significantly improve the businesses of our customers and shape the future of Experitec’s business. Join a high-performance team and level up your customer service acumen while sharing your knowledge with other team members.

Come join a **100% employee-owned company** focused on customer outcomes and employee success! This position requires a hands-on approach, a strong work ethic, the ambition to interface with customers onsite, a troubleshooting mindset, and a commitment to excellence.

In this position, you may have the opportunity to work in different industries including power, chemical, renewable energy, food & beverage, refining, oil & gas, pharmaceutical, pulp & paper, water treatment, metals/mining and consumer goods. Experitec provides strong technical and customer service training throughout your career which will include:

* On-The-Job training to set you up for success.
* Ongoing customer service training.
* Technical training on key products and systems.
* Ongoing training on various company functions as an Employee-Owner to broaden business acumen.

The EPC Project Coordinator (PC) is responsible for end‑to‑end execution of EPC Projects from purchase order receipt through project closeout and warranty. EPC stands for Engineering Procurement & Construction. This role serves as the primary point of coordination and communication between customers, factories, and internal cross‑functional teams to ensure projects are executed accurately, on schedule, and in compliance with contractual and documentation requirements. Though not a technical expert, a project’s success is directly tied to how effective the PC is with coordinating all functions to complete deliverables; there is no Project Manager overseeing success on the Experitec side of the project. Our project partners will often have a Project Manager the PC will work closely with.

The Project Coordinator owns project execution processes, proactively manages risk (including liquidated damages), maintains financial and system accuracy, and ensures all commercial and technical documentation is delivered on time. This role is execution‑focused, not administrative, and plays a critical part in customer satisfaction, margin protection, and project success.

**Opportunities to make an Impact:**

* Owning the end‑to‑end EPC project execution lifecycle from purchase order receipt through project closeout, ensuring contractual, financial, schedule, and documentation obligations are met.
* Interpreting contracts, purchase orders, and the Schedule of Submittals (SOS) to confirm scope, inclusions, exclusions, documentation requirements, and delivery commitments.
* Establishing, maintaining, and ensuring accuracy of project data across IFS, SharePoint, DocBoss, and other supporting systems, maintaining audit‑ready and traceable records.
* Developing and managing the project execution plan, delivery schedule, and SOS, ensuring alignment across internal teams, suppliers, factories, and customers.
* Coordinating and leading internal and customer kickoff meetings, along with ongoing project‑specific meetings, to align responsibilities, execution strategy, and communication cadence.
* Collaborating closely with Program Managers, Application Engineers, Drafters, Shop Technicians, Suppliers, Emerson Project Management (external team), and other stakeholders to ensure timely, complete, and accurate deliverables.
* Proactively identifying execution, documentation, schedule, and liquidated damages risks; escalating issues with recommended mitigation actions to protect schedule, margin, and customer commitments.
* Coordinating procurement and manufacturing activities including order commitments, shop order creation and tracking, supplier communication, expediting, inspections, equipment releases, and delivery milestones.
* Tracking manufacturing progress, inspections, shipping releases, packing lists, milestone invoicing requirements, and customer delivery updates to ensure delivery schedules are met.
* Leading and supporting documentation execution by confirming requirements, managing revisions, tracking submittal approvals and returns, and ensuring all commercial, technical, and quality documentation is accurate, version‑controlled, and submitted on time.
* Ensuring documentation reports, expediting needs, and system data remain accurate and up to date throughout the project lifecycle.
* Serving as the primary owner of change order management, coordinating revised purchase orders, schedules, documentation, and financial impacts while clearly communicating changes to customers, factories, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensuring financial accuracy in IFS, including milestone invoicing coordination, revenue recognition support, and monitorin

description:
**About BLCCS**

BLCCS, LLC is a San Antonio-based commercial MEP service company providing HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Building Automation & Controls, Energy Services, and Preventive Maintenance.

Founded in 2017, BLCCS supports commercial and mission-critical facilities throughout the San Antonio area. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of our tools, inventory, purchasing, vehicle stock, refrigerant tracking, and warehouse operations.

**Position Summary**

The **Inventory, Warehouse & Procurement Coordinator** is responsible for maintaining accurate records of company tools, equipment, materials, vehicle inventory, refrigerant, purchasing, and purchase orders.

This is a hands-on position that combines warehouse responsibilities with administrative and technology-based work. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable working with technicians and vendors, strong with Excel and technology, and willing to take ownership of processes from start to finish.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate inventory of company tools, equipment, and materials.
* Track tools assigned to employees, vehicles, jobsites, and the warehouse.
* Maintain serial numbers, purchase dates, warranty information, and assignment records.
* Manage tool check-in/check-out and replacement requests.
* Verify warranty or repair options before approving replacement purchases.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory audits.
* Maintain standard vehicle inventory and perform vehicle inventory checks.
* Track refrigerant purchases, technician usage, vehicle stock, and refrigerant logs.
* Reconcile refrigerant inventory and identify discrepancies.
* Create and process purchase orders.
* Purchase approved tools, parts, materials, equipment, and supplies.
* Obtain vendor pricing and availability and follow up on outstanding orders.
* Receive deliveries and verify materials against purchase orders.
* Coordinate returns, damaged materials, and vendor discrepancies.
* Help prevent unnecessary or duplicate purchases.
* Organize warehouse inventory and maintain designated storage locations.
* Prepare materials and equipment for technicians and projects.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse.
* Safely operate a forklift and assist with loading, unloading, and material movement.

**Excel & Technology Requirements**

**\\*\\*Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required.\\*\\***

The successful candidate must be comfortable using Excel to track and manage:

* Tool inventory
* Vehicle inventory
* Refrigerant logs
* Purchase orders
* Warehouse inventory
* Warranty information

Candidates should be comfortable with sorting, filtering, formulas, data organization, and basic reporting.

The position also requires the ability to learn and use inventory systems, purchasing software, mobile apps, electronic forms, ticketing systems, QR/barcode systems, and other technology used by BLCCS.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and recordkeeping skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong Excel and overall technology skills.
* Ability to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies.
* Comfortable working with technicians, vendors, and management.
* Comfortable holding employees accountable for assigned company tools and equipment.
* Valid driver's license.
* Clean driving record required.
* Must meet company vehicle insurance requirements.
* Must successfully pass a background check.
* Ability to safely operate a forklift; certification preferred or ability to obtain certification required.
* Ability to perform normal warehouse and material-handling duties.
* Previous inventory, purchasing, warehouse, construction, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or facilities experience is preferred.

**Compensation**

**$18.00–$24.00 per hour, depending on experience.**

Compensation will be based on relevant experience, Excel and technology proficiency, purchasing or inventory experience, and the candidate's ability to independently manage the responsibilities of the position.

**What Success Looks Like**

The right person will help BLCCS maintain clear accountability for:

What we own, where it is, who has it, what was purchased, what is under warranty, what needs to be reordered, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, technology-capable, and willing to take ownership as BLCCS continues to grow.

Pay: $18.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Prescription drug insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for supporting purchasing activities and ensuring ingredients and products are ordered from approved suppliers to meet production needs. This role works closely with internal teams, vendors, and suppliers to support inventory flow, resolve issues, and contribute to cost-effective purchasing practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Purchase ingredients, raw materials, and products from approved suppliers to support scheduled production.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure materials arrive on time to prevent shortages, delays, or overstock.
* Maintain accurate purchase orders, including quantities, pricing, delivery dates, and supplier information.
* Monitor raw material inventory levels using ERP/MRP systems and purchasing tools.
* Maintain purchasing attributes such as safety stock, lead times, reorder points, and purchasing recommendations. Identify opportunities for adjustments and communicate those with the supervisor.
* Daily review for purchasing and inventory reports, including but not limited to the General Item Status Report, Reorder Report, Negative Item Report, and MRP outputs.
* Any discrepancies or issues should be independently researched and assessed prior to escalating to additional stakeholders.
* Communicate professionally with internal departments, vendors, suppliers, and other stakeholders regarding purchasing needs, order status, shortages, supply constraints, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with Customer Service, Inventory, Receiving, Strategic Procurement, Logistics, Planning, and other teams to support purchasing, inventory flow, and production requirements.
* Support company profitability through cost-effective purchasing, supplier collaboration, cost reduction, cost avoidance, and value-added procurement practices.
* Maintain a strong understanding of manufacturing capabilities, business processes, supply chain operations, and the raw materials used in production.
* Complete other duties and projects as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience in food, ingredient, manufacturing, or distribution purchasing preferred.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems or purchasing tools preferred.
* Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, suppliers, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Quality and Food Safety Requirements**

* Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* Follow all Safe Quality Food (SQF) guidelines.
* Maintain awareness of Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and its importance.
* Ensure all products and ingredients are purchased only from approved suppliers.

**Company Description**

Rexel USA is one of the largest distributors of electrical products, data communication, wireless communication and related supplies in the United States. Rexel USA operates its electrical distribution business in the United States through eight Regions that go to market under various banner and trade names, including Rexel, Rexel Automation, Gexpro, Mayer, Talley and Platt Electric Supply. In addition to an online store, Rexel USA has a distribution network of over 460 warehouse storefront locations throughout the U.S.

**Job Description**

**We are looking for a Procurement Coordinator to join our Rexel USA team in Mesquite, TX!**

**Summary:**
The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Procurement team on day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed. Will work with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure problems are resolved in a timely manner.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support Procurement team with day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed
* Daily review of critical items below minimum, allocations, or stock outs for regional Customer Solution Centers
* Meet or exceed defined fill rate/service level for regional branches and/or assigned supplier lines
* Work with suppliers when there are any shipping issues or discrepancies with product (e.g. non-conformity receipts issues including incorrect items, damaged boxes, quantity differences, poor quality, etc.)
* Assist payable variance resolution with Accounts Payable team when invoice matching issues arise
* Coordinate with warehouse on delivery status of purchase orders and communication to and from suppliers and freight forwarders on expedited shipment dates
* Monitor and push out communication on expedited shipments and updates from suppliers to sales teams and into ERP system
* Interface with multiple departments and resolve problems and issue as necessary
* Analyze and manage unhealthy inventory by updating stock flags, reviewing item minimums, and coordinating excess inventory transfers back to the Customer Solution Center
* Assist Inventory Planner with negotiations and execution of supplier returns
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Duties Disclaimer:**
The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Need**

* 2+ years of procurement experience preferred
* Prior experience in the electrical distribution industry preferred
* High School or GED - Required

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office products
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with partners at all levels
* Be a self-starter
* Attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to prioritize and organize

**Additional Information**

**Physical Demands:**

* Sit: Must be able to remain in a stationary position - Constantly – at least 51%
* Walk: Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location - Frequently – 21% to 50%
* Use hands to finger, handle, or feel: Operates a computer and other office machinery - Constantly – at least 51%
* Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl: Must be able to crouch down to stock shelves, pick up boxes, or position oneself to maintain computers in the lab/under desks/in server closet - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Climb or balance: Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder, forklift, pallet jack, or other warehouse equipment - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Talk, hear, taste, smell: Must be able to use senses to effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions - Constantly – at least 51%

**Weight and Force Demands:**

* Up to 10 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Up to 25 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%

**Working Environment:**

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environment such as high noise level and/or exposure to heat and cold - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Travels to offsite locations

* Maintain accurate purchasing and inventory information in SAP S/4HANA, including order and delivery records.

description:
Plantain Products Company - Chifles, the number one plantain chip brand in the U.S. by dollar sales, is hiring a Logistics and Procurement Coordinator in Miami-Dade. You will own daily freight quoting and booking, shipment coordination, purchase orders for packaging, racks and displays, and fleet compliance scheduling. Execution done well and done reliably, reporting to the Director of Operations and Logistics.

This role keeps product moving and orders flowing every day. This is an individual contributor role; it does not manage people.

**Full-time, on-site.** Pay is $60,000 to $75,000 per year. Benefits include health insurance, a 401(k) match and paid time off.

**First 90 days**

* Take over daily logistics and purchasing through a 90-day handover, working beside the people who run it today.
* Run the freight quoting cycle and the weekly delivery schedule without supervision.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current.

**How we evaluate**

A conversation, then a practical exercise based on real logistics and purchasing work. Details are shared with candidates who move forward.

Chifles is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.

**Compensation:**

$60,000 - $75,000 yearly

**Responsibilities:**

**Freight and daily logistics**

* Freight quoting and carrier booking, the largest single piece of the job. Solicit and compare FTL and LTL rates daily across our broker and carrier bench, hold a lane to a ceiling, and book.
* Live shipment coordination and exceptions: bills of lading and corrections, pickup confirmations and reschedules, trailer status, refused shipments, damage and shortage claims.
* Retailer purchase order cross-check, near daily, across our club and retail accounts: read each incoming PO against what was quoted and what will ship, and catch the leakage before it becomes a deduction. Order entry itself sits with the customer service team.
* Build and publish the weekly DSD delivery schedule to our independent distributor network and the internal sales and operations team.
* Purchase order reconciliation with brokers, mapping retailer PO lines and ship dates to SKUs.
* Packaging and inbound supplier documentation, including case and state-specific label specifications and inbound container paperwork.
* Share ship dates and order volumes with the warehouse team so it can plan the week.

**Purchase orders and follow-through**

* Place and manage purchase orders for film, packaging and other non-fruit inputs, tracking lead times and reorder points against the production plan.
* Own rack and display purchasing end to end: quantities against the program, lead times, delivery to the plant, and the paperwork behind each order.
* Approve packaging box purchase orders prepared by the warehouse team before they are sent.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current: on-time-in-full, fill rate, cost variance against quote.
* Check carrier invoices against the quoted rate and flag every variance.
* Work inside the freight and spend limits the Director sets, and escalate above them.
* Oversee the weekly inventory reconciliation in the ERP: check that each category owner completed their count, follow up on the ones that did not, and escalate variances.
* Handle day-to-day operational exceptions, including some outside normal hours.

**Fleet**

* DOT compliance for our trucks and drivers: files, inspections, renewals and the calendar behind them. Low frequency, zero tolerance for a lapse.
* Truck and trailer maintenance scheduling across owned and leased units, so a unit out of service never surprises the delivery schedule.

**Qualifications:**

* 2 to 4 years in logistics, freight, shipping or purchasing, in food, CPG, distribution or manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience booking FTL and LTL freight and working with brokers and carriers.
* Comfortable working inside an ERP rather than around it in spreadsheets. Acumatica experience is a plus.
* Solid Excel, and the care to keep a running scorecard accurate.
* Demonstrated AI proficiency. A requirement, not a preference. We use AI tools daily across the company, and you will be expected to do the same.
* Bilingual, Spanish and English. Much of the plant floor and warehouse work in Spanish.
* Organized under load, and willing to chase a carrier until you get an answer.

**About Company**

Plantain Products Company - Chifles is the number one plantain chip brand in the United States by dollar sales. We are family-owned, with about 65 employees. Our Miami operation bags cooked chips that arrive in bulk from our suppliers and builds the displays that ship to clubs and retailers. Our product moves through national retailers, warehouse clubs, a Florida DSD route network, and independent distributors.

**Purpose:**

This position provides essential inside support to the successful operations of the company. Responsible for equipment purchasing, fixed asset inventory management, long term rental contracts called monthlies and one-off event rentals. Responsible for equipment tracking and reservation system. Additionally, responsible for marketing projects and website maintenance.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Ensure order fulfillment of purchasing requests at the best possible value to the company.
* Manage and maintain good working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Work all issues (wrong product received, incorrect invoicing, and incorrect receipt of product, etc.) that occur to complete resolution.
* Routinely manage and mitigate supply chain risk.
* Manage long-term rental contracts called monthlies, including client invoicing and maintenance of equipment
* Obtain Order Acknowledgements from suppliers and update Promised Dates in the ERP.
* Communicate shipments delays to company personnel.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Position Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree is required.
* 1-3 years purchasing / buying experience preferred.
* Knowledge of broadcasting technology equipment
* Capable of working the entire MS Office suite, especially Excel. Crystal reporting system experience is a plus.
* Possess strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to organize vast amounts of data.
* Capable of learning new computer programs quickly.
* Demonstrated ability to multi-task several priorities and possess solid time management skills.
* Ability to be a self-starter and initiate projects.
* Must be able to work individually as well as in a team environment.
* Project management experience preferred.
* Ability to deliver superior service and build lasting relationships by demonstrating NEP’s Core Values: innovative, one team, passion and integrity.

description:
**Senior Procurement Coordinator**
==================================

**Location:** On Site at Salt Lake City, UT **Employment Type:** Full-Time **Pay Type:** Salary **Reports To:** Head of Group Procurement

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Procurement Coordinator to manage sourcing, purchasing, supplier relations, and inventory alignment across six store-front locations. This role will serve as the central point of coordination for purchasing operations and will utilize Odoo ERP to track demand, manage purchase orders, optimize inventory, and ensure cost-effective buying decisions. The ideal candidate has strong experience in multi-location procurement, vendor performance management, and data-driven purchasing using Odoo or similar ERP. Coatings and construction materials background is considered a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

PurchasingProcurement Execution

* Create, track, and manage purchase orders in Odoo ERP across six storefronts
* Consolidate purchasing needs across locations to leverage volume and pricing
* Ensure timely replenishment based on reorder points, safety stock, and demand forecasts
* Conduct competitive price reviews and cost benchmarking

ERPData Management

* Maintain accurate supplier catalogs, lead times, and pricing in Odoo
* Monitor product availability, landed cost, and purchase history
* Generate procurement and spend visibility reports in Odoo
* Support system improvements, workflow automation, and purchasing dashboards

VendorSupply Chain Management

* Build and maintain supplier relationships to ensure reliability and service quality
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules
* Resolve backorders, shortages, and quality issues
* Evaluate supplier performance using KPIs (on-time delivery, cost variance, defect rate)

Cross-Location Coordination

* Collaborate with store managers to validate demand planning and inventory needs
* Standardize SKUs and purchasing specifications to reduce complexity
* Participate in product substitutions and sourcing alternatives when needed
* Support logistics coordination and delivery routing for multiple locations

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3-5+ years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain coordination experience
* Experience working with ERPs (plus)
* Strong understanding of purchase planning, inventory controls, and vendor negotiations
* Excellent Excel or ERP-based reporting skills
* Strong communication skills and high attention to detail
* Multi-location procurement experience preferred

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* ERP-based decision making
* Negotiation and supplier management
* Time-sensitive problem solving
* Cost awareness and continuous improvement mindset
* Process documentation / standardization
* Ownership and accountability
* ISO
* LEAN

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelors in a Business, Engineering, or Economics concertation required
* Masters degree preferred

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation
* Growth opportunities in procurement / supply chain
* Exposure to multi-location operations and ERP optimization
* Matching 401K
* Full Insurance package available
* PTO

**\\*\\*Applicant must reside in Northeast Ohio**

Join the Cleveland Clinic team where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and make a lasting, meaningful impact on patient care. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

At Cleveland Clinic's Transplant Center, experts perform a variety of transplantation procedures. Each year, thousands of lives are saved and transformed because of our innovative expertise. As Donor Procurement Coordinator, you will coordinate all activities related to the receipt of organ offers for transplant, evaluation of organ offers for suitability, procurement of organs and transplant set-ups. Your position is essential to the organization and functioning of the Transplant Center, allowing caregivers to supply patients with the necessary treatment they need.

**This is a remote role. A caregiver in this position works varying 12hr shifts on a day/night rotation.**

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

* Comply with OPTN/UNOS requirements for post-transplant documentation of donor and transplant activities.

* Serve as the contact for all potential offers for transplant from local, regional and national organ procurement organizations.

* Organize the procurement team and dispatch team to the donor site within the required time frame.

* Coordinate air or ground transportation of organs.

* Serve as a resource for organ recovery and preservation.

* Assist in training organ preservation caregivers.

* Orient new residents and fellows to renal procurement, renal allocation and regulatory requirements.

* Develop and present professional education programs as needed.

* Obtain, analyze and report pertinent data regarding potential donors and accepted organs for transplants.

* Attend selection committee meetings.

* Abstract data and enter data into the transplant database.

* Maintain valid licensure and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Registered Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic).

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Bachelor’s Degree in a science-related field OR a degree/diploma from an accredited Nursing School, Respiratory Therapy Program or Paramedic Program

* One year of experience as an organ procurement coordinator OR clinical experience in critical care or in the field of organ procurement/transplant

* Maintain valid licenses and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic)

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Certified Procurement Transplant Coordinator (CPTC) by the American Board for Transplant Certification (ABTC)
* Previous transplant or organ procurement experience

* Related healthcare experience, UNOS/UNET experience and knowledge

**Physical Requirements:**

* Clinical, Exposure to Risk. Ability to be available 24 hours a day when assigned.

**Personal Protective Equipment:**

* Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

**Pay Range**

Minimum Annual Salary: $57,510.00

Maximum Annual Salary: $87,697.50

The pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the anticipated range for new hires. A successful candidate’s actual compensation will be determined after taking factors into consideration such as the candidate’s work history, experience, skill set and education. The pay range displayed does not include any applicable pay practices (e.g., shift differentials, overtime, etc.). The pay range does not include the value of Cleveland Clinic’s benefits package (e.g., healthcare, dental and vision benefits, retirement savings account contributions, etc.).

**Company Description**

Aspen One renews the mind, body, and spirit with a portfolio that redefines luxury, adventure, and leisure. With world-class and innovative brands and businesses, including Aspen Skiing Company, Aspen Hospitality, and Aspen Ventures, Aspen One propels the expansion of the Aspen ethos globally.

Whether it's Aspen Skiing Company providing unforgettable experiences at the confluence of nature, culture, and recreation across its four legendary mountains—Aspen Mountain, Snowmass, Aspen Highlands, and Buttermilk; or Aspen Hospitality elevating guest experiences in unforgettable ways by developing, owning, and operating a growing set of luxury and upper-scale hotels, private clubs, and branded residential properties in prime locations under The Nell and Limelight brands; Aspen One is deeply committed to providing unparalleled service, creative programming, community engagement, and unique opportunities for exploration. The company’s commitment to innovation is central to its evolution, including Aspen Ventures' amplification of the Aspen brand globally through new business lines that embody its values and heritage such as Aspen Collection.

For more than 75 years, the Aspen brand and community has pointed its compass toward new paths, people, and possibilities—and today, as Aspen One, the future is limitless. The company is a leader in sustainability and advocacy, with a legacy of modeling leading-edge solutions and changing policy locally and globally. As a collection of brands driven by tightly held core values, Aspen One aims to inspire a better world. For more information, visit www.aspen.com.

Please note that all official communications from the Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team are sent from email addresses within the notifications@smartrecruiters.com, aspen.com, aspensnowmass.com, aspenhospitality.co, limelighthotels.com & thelittlenell.com domains.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

description:
**Position Summary**

The Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Coordinator is responsible for supporting the centralization of purchasing across Trinity Basin Preparatory while identifying opportunities to reduce costs, improve vendor performance, strengthen purchasing controls.

This position combines procurement administration, strategic sourcing, spend analysis, competitive bidding support, vendor performance management, and purchase order processing. The successful candidate will work closely with district departments, campuses, and vendors to ensure that purchasing decisions are cost-effective, compliant, and aligned with the district's commitment to responsible stewardship of public funds.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategic Sourcing & Cost Optimization**

* Analyze district-wide spending patterns and identify opportunities for cost savings and procurement efficiencies.
* Conduct market research and pricing analysis to identify alternative vendors, products, and services that provide greater value to the district.
* Benchmark pricing against market rates, cooperative purchasing programs, and existing vendor agreements.
* Develop sourcing strategies for high-spend categories such as instructional supplies, technology, facilities, maintenance, transportation, child nutrition, furniture, and professional services.
* Support annual budget development by providing purchasing trend analysis and vendor cost projections.
* Receive and review purchase requisitions from campuses and departments and prepare, process, and track purchase orders through the district's purchasing system (Skyward Q).
* Serve as the primary liaison with Region 10, Region 11, and other approved cooperative purchasing organizations.

**Vendor Performance Management**

* Analyze spending by campus, department, category, and vendor and prepare procurement reports and dashboards to support management decision-making.
* Establish and maintain productive relationships with key vendors and suppliers across the district.
* Manage new vendor onboarding, including required documentation, approval, and Skyward setup.

* Coordinate quarterly vendor business reviews with district stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Technology, Child Nutrition, Human Resources, and Campus Leadership.
* Identify opportunities for cost reductions, service improvements, and operational efficiencies through vendor reviews.

**Competitive Procurement & Compliance**

* Support Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Qualifications (RFQs), and Requests for Quotes under the direction of the Chief Financial Officer.
* Assist with development of bid specifications, vendor communications, and proposal evaluations.
* Support compliance with district policies and applicable state and federal purchasing regulations.

**Education & Experience**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
* Minimum of three (3) years of experience in procurement, purchasing, finance, accounting, operations, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a public school district, charter school, municipality, healthcare organization, or other multi-location organization.
* Experience supporting RFPs, RFQs, vendor evaluations, and competitive procurement processes.
* Experience working with financial management, purchasing, or ERP systems.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of procurement principles, purchasing controls, and sourcing practices.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Experience with Power BI, reporting tools, or dashboard development preferred.

**Working Conditions**

Work is primarily performed in an office environment with periodic travel to district campuses, vendor locations, and meetings as required.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Trinity Basin Preparatory is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, religion, or any other protected status under applicable law.

**The Mission**
To communicate and assist with Procurement Director, Field Department, and outside growers/suppliers/drivers to deliver high quality raw materials to the Stahlbush processing plant. This role covers the documentation, planning, and coordination required to deliver materials in compliance with sustainable, organic, GAP, FSMA, SQF, DOT, and any other required 3rd party audit or process.
**Reporting Relationships**
This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement. The employee will work closely with multiple departments throughout the company along with outside growers/suppliers/contractors.
**Outcomes**

* Proactively resolve any issues related to raw product quality or delivery in a thorough and timely manner.
* Conduct internal audits of documentation to ensure compliance with third-party certification standards.
* Complete weight sheets for received products, ensuring all data aligns with traceability standards and providing accurate reports to Accounts Payable.
* Work with Procurement team to create and negotiate contracts with outside suppliers and growers to secure raw materials.
* Become an expert in our internal Transportation Management System (LOADS) to assist in transportation responsibilities, including creating, editing, and checking in shipments.
* Request freight quotes and issue Purchase Orders (POs) for inbound raw materials using the SIFI LOADS program and schedule shipments with vendors.
* Coordinate outside contract drivers and brokers to facilitate harvested crops for delivery to the processing plant.
* Assist the Field Department in pulling crop, soil, and moisture samples from the field.
* Assist in the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications for raw products.
* Assist in DMV and DOT related tasks, including vehicle registrations, insurance cards, and overweight/over-width permits.
* Support and optimize Stahlbush sustainability initiatives to align with company mission statement.
* This position has been identified as holding responsibility for food safety and quality of the company. This responsibility extends over all shifts.
* During the absence, the following position serves as coverage to this position: Director of Procurement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Agriculture, or related field preferred
* Passion to pursue a career in the agricultural, supply chain, or food production industry
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs including Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Ability and willingness to work independently and improve processes
* Proficiency in procurement processes, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Basic understanding of farming practices and the nature of the industry
* Willingness to learn current market pricing, food safety, and agriculture certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions**
General office environment with minimal physical effort. Requires sitting at a desk for majority of workday, but when needed, there will be periods of time work is performed outside.

The statements made in any and all of the position postings are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed, as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

description:
**Sourcing Coordinator**
========================

**Company:** Lopez Dorada Foods
**Department:** Supply Chain / Procurement
**Reports To:** Sourcing / Procurement Leadership

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The **Sourcing Coordinator** supports day-to-day purchasing and sourcing activities by processing purchase orders, monitoring inventory needs, coordinating with suppliers, and supporting plant and operational requirements. This role requires strong organization, follow-up, and the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Issue purchase orders and track orders through delivery.
* Expedite orders to support urgent operational needs.
* Follow up with suppliers on order status, lead times, and delivery dates.
* Resolve backorders, delivery issues, shortages, and order discrepancies.
* Monitor inventory levels for recurring non-stock and frequently purchased items.
* Review stockout reports and initiate reorders to help prevent shortages.
* Identify slow-moving or excess inventory to help reduce unnecessary carrying costs.
* Source products and supplies for routine and one-time purchasing requests.
* Obtain and compare supplier pricing, availability, and lead times.
* Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, FSQS, and other departments regarding purchasing needs.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records and communicate supply or delivery concerns.
* Support additional sourcing and procurement activities as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* Previous purchasing, sourcing, inventory, or supply chain experience preferred.
* Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple purchasing requests and changing priorities.
* Ability to work effectively with plant operations and cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable making timely sourcing decisions for routine and urgent requests.
* Strong communication and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; ability to learn purchasing and inventory systems.
