Last year our HCA Healthcare colleagues invested over 156,000 hours volunteering in our communities. As a Materials Management Coordinator with Blue River Surgery Center you can be a part of an organization that is devoted to giving back!

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**

The Materials Manager Coordinator contributes to the company’s mission, vision, and values by ensuring instruments, supplies, and equipment purchased are researched to maximize cost effectiveness; maintaining accurate and complete records concerning ordering, receiving, and payment for such in a timely and cost-effective manner; operating independently as well as cooperatively; maintaining professional and effective working relationships with teammates; and demonstrating knowledge and skills necessary to support superior patient care.

**What you will do in this role:**

* Works with the Regional Materials Manager or Market Materials Manager assigned to the market.
* Responsible for center supply expense management.
* Establishes and maintains levels and related controls of supplies and equipment for the Center.
* Responsible for purchases for the Center as necessary, utilizing purchase orders and checking orders received for accuracy and completeness.
* Prepares goods for return as appropriate and responsible for shipment of all goods from the Center.
* Restocks inventory as needed.
* Establishes and maintains PAR stock levels in all areas, with the cooperation of staff members.
* Maintains knowledge base and utilization of contract pricing, keeping current.
* Responsible for and oversees the biannual inventories, including accuracy of counts and their input into SMART.
* Processes accounts payable, matching billing to invoices, coding and processing in conjunction with the business office manager.
* Confers with physicians and nursing staff on special products or equipment needs and initiates trial use if indicated.

**Qualifications you will need:**

* Minimum (1) year of experience in a medical office setting highly preferred. (i.e. ambulatory surgery center, hospital, doctors office) preferred.
* Minimum (1) year of experience in materials management.
* Some accounting/bookkeeping experience helpful.

##### **Benefits**

Blue River Surgery Center, offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

* **Comprehensive benefits** for medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, behavioral health and telemedicine services
* **Wellbeing support,** including free counseling and referral services
* **Time away from work** programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long- and short-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
* **Savings and retirement resources**, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
* **Additional benefits** for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts

Learn more about Employee Benefits

***Note: Eligibility for benefits may vary by location.***

Blue River Surgery Center is the newest member of the Surgery Ventures Group powered by HCA Healthcare opening in early 2024. This state-of-the-art facility will include five operating rooms and two specialty procedures rooms. The center will be staffed by a skilled team of registered nurses and OR techs. Our specialties will include orthopedics, GI, podiatry, general and vascular surgery. The Center is located in South Kansas City near I-435 and Holmes.

HCA Healthcare has been recognized as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by the Ethisphere Institute more than ten times. In recent years, HCA Healthcare spent an estimated $3.7 billion in costs for the delivery of charitable care, uninsured discounts, and other uncompensated expenses.

description:
**Job Title:** Procurement Coordinator

**Location:** Richmond or Staunton, VA

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Travel:** 5%–25%, domestic and international

**Compensation:** $75,000–$90,000 annually

**Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA with employer contributions, employer-paid Life/AD&D, employer-paid Short-Term Disability, and voluntary supplemental insurance options

**Job Summary**

Our client is seeking an experienced Procurement Coordinator to support and manage purchasing, sourcing, logistics, inventory, and supplier performance. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining effective supply chain processes that improve operational efficiency, control costs, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and support reliable product availability.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in purchasing and supply chain operations, including international sourcing, importing, supplier management, contracting, lean processes, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and update supply chain policies and procedures to comply with new or changing environmental policies, standards, regulations, and laws, including Proposition 65 and other location-specific requirements.
* Maximize inventory and working capital turns by developing suppliers with shorter delivery cycles, improved reliability, and smaller order quantities while maintaining appropriate safety stock levels and avoiding stockouts.
* Manage supplier quality and performance issues through the Supplier Corrective Action process.
* Maintain documentation and records of supplier issues, resolutions, corrective actions, and related communications.
* Participate in the customer complaint review process and remain informed of relevant customer complaints.
* Develop procedures to effectively coordinate supply chain activities with sales, marketing, finance, production, quality assurance, and other functional areas.
* Design and implement supply chain strategies that support overall business objectives.
* Adapt supply chain strategies in response to changing market conditions, new business opportunities, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, operational efficiency, and overall supply chain effectiveness.
* Support company objectives and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.

Summary

As a Build to Rent (“BTR”) Purchasing Coordinator working for Taylor Morrison you will be responsible for generating purchase orders, job starts, administration of variance purchase orders, and various other administrative duties.

**Job Details**

**What You’ll Do**

We trust that as a BTR Purchasing Coordinator you will:

* Build purchasing data in Newstar Enterprise for all building plans
* Maintain takeoffs, costs, and budgets as needed for the Construction and Finance Departments
* Review takeoffs, costs, and budgets on every building prior to construction start to ensure accuracy and generate purchase orders for start package
* Review, process, and analyze variance purchase orders from Construction Managers and Purchasing Agents
* Analyze and reduce budget to actual costs on every building at time of service
* Assist agents with bidding and takeoffs when needed for special projects
* Coordinate with Homebuilding Divisions to confirm similar pricing structures
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Sound Like You?**

You might be just who we’re looking for if you have…

* 1-3 years’ experience in a similar position within a fast-paced office environment preferred
* Understanding of Multi-Family or Homebuilding process (parts, model subcontracts, etc.) preferred
* High School Diploma required
* Proficient in Excel required
* Must be highly organized and detail oriented
* Must be a team player with a strong sense of urgency and strong communication skills
* Must have the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
* Newstar experience is a plus

**FLSA Status: Non-Exempt**

This position is considered a non-exempt position for purposes of wage-hour law, which means that you will be required to keep a time record and will be eligible for overtime pay.

**Essential Functions:**

Successful job applicants will be able to perform these functions. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Report to Division/Corporate Office/Community daily and adhere to schedule
* Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer and/or electronic device
* Ability to have face to face conversations with customers, co-workers, and management
* Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time and move around work environment as needed
* Comply with company policies and procedure

**Physical Demands:**

* Must be able to able to remain in a stationary position up to 50% of the time
* The ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

* **Taylor Morrison experience and/or successful completion of training program may override required education and/or experience requirement.**

### **Job descriptions are not intended as, nor should be construed to be, exhaustive lists of all responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with a job. They are intended to be accurate reflections of those principal job duties and responsibilities essential for making fair pay decisions about the job.**

### **Taylor Morrison is an equal opportunity employer. Taylor Morrison does not discriminate against any candidate or employee based on race, national origin, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion or veteran status.**

**Benefits of Working With Taylor Morrison**

We are looking for dedicated professionals that share our values of putting the customer - and their needs - first. In addition to a great team atmosphere, career development and advancement opportunities, we offer full-time employees an extensive benefits package, to include:

* Competitive Compensation
* Health Care - Medical/Dental/Vision/Prescription Drug Coverage
* 401(k) with Company Matching Contributions
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Disability Programs
* Employee & Dependent Life Insurance
* Vacation & Company Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Home Purchase Rebate Program
* Home Mortgage Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

This role ensures that technicians and installers have the materials needed to complete jobs efficiently while maintaining inventory accuracy, controlling costs, and fostering strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.

* Track orders from placement through delivery and resolve any shipping or delivery issues.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct periodic inventory audits.
* Research alternative suppliers and products to improve quality, availability, and cost savings.
* Review vendor invoices and reconcile discrepancies with purchase orders and receipts.
* Monitor warranty claims and manufacturer credits to ensure reimbursement opportunities are captured.
* Assist with fleet, warehouse, and operational supply purchasing as needed.
* Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies and procedures.
* Generate and maintain purchasing, inventory, and vendor performance reports.
* Ensure warranty claims are submitted and processed within required deadlines to secure all available vendor credits and reimbursements for the company.
* Resolve escalated product order issues promptly.
* Ability to work interdepartmentally to achieve high customer and employee satisfaction.
* Achieve parts/equipment order time KPI of 24 hours or less.
* Identify price increases in parts/equipment and work diligently with vendors to obtain best pricing.
* Assist with monthly warehouse inventory counts.
* Verify all accounts payable are accurate and ensure the accounting department receives all payables in a timely manner.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or related coursework preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years of purchasing, inventory management, or administrative experience preferred.
* Experience in the HVAC, plumbing, construction, or home services industry preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent communication and vendor relationship management abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Experience with ServiceTitan, ERP systems, or inventory management software is preferred.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

* Understanding of HVAC and plumbing materials, equipment, and terminology.
* Ability to analyze inventory trends and purchasing needs.
* Strong negotiation and cost-control skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.
* Excellent recordkeeping and documentation skills.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move items up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work in a warehouse or office environment as needed.

**Performance Expectations**

* Maintain adequate inventory levels to support company operations.
* Minimize material shortages and job delays.
* Process purchase orders accurately and efficiently.
* Develop and maintain positive supplier relationships.

Location: Romeoville

Department: Administrative

Pay Type: Salaried, Non-Exempt

Reports to: Director of Purchasing

**Job Summary**

The Purchasing & Logistics Coordinator is responsible for supporting purchasing activities and coordinating inbound logistics for the Romeoville facility. This position serves as a primary point of coordination between Purchasing, Shipping & Receiving, Accounting, suppliers, carriers, and other internal departments to ensure materials are purchased, scheduled, received, documented, and processed accurately and on time.

The Purchasing & Logistics Coordinator manages purchase orders, inbound freight scheduling, purchasing and receiving documentation, supplier communications, material samples, inventory adjustments, and related reporting. The position is responsible for proactively following open orders, shipments, documentation issues, and discrepancies through resolution and communicating changes or potential problems to the appropriate departments.

* Maintain organized and accurate purchasing records and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate inbound material samples with suppliers and the Purchasing team.
* Organize, identify, track, and maintain facility and purchasing lab samples and associated documentation.
* File and maintain returned lab packets and related purchasing documentation.
* Maintain and distribute the weekly lab pass/fail report.
* Assist with researching purchasing discrepancies and obtaining information needed to resolve issues.
* Maintain and update the inbound cost-per-pound report and related purchasing information.
* Identify overdue, incomplete, or inaccurate purchasing documentation and follow through until resolved.

* Coordinate and maintain the inbound receiving schedule for the Romeoville facility and coordination with the Lawndale facility.
* Schedule inbound freight and receiving appointments using the company's transportation management system, including Argus TMS.
* Coordinate inbound truck schedules with Shipping & Receiving based on facility capacity and operational requirements.
* Communicate with suppliers, customers, carriers, brokers, and internal personnel regarding appointments, shipment status, delays, schedule changes, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor scheduled inbound shipments and proactively address late, missed, or changed deliveries.
* Attend scheduled logistics/operations meetings with transportation providers, including the weekly Argus LOP meeting.
* Maintain accurate receiving schedules, transportation records, logs, and related documentation.
* Communicate inbound material information and scheduling changes to Purchasing, Shipping & Receiving, Accounting, and other affected departments.
* Assist with resolving freight, delivery, receiving, and documentation discrepancies.

***Inventory & Accounting Coordination***

* Reconcile receiving reports against supplier invoices and purchasing documentation.
* Coordinate with Accounting, Purchasing, and Shipping & Receiving to resolve missing or incomplete invoice, PO, and receiving documentation.
* Research discrepancies involving quantities, pricing, purchase orders, receipts, freight, or supplier invoices and coordinate resolution with the appropriate department.
* Maintain the Inventory Adjustment Log and ensure adjustments are submitted and followed through to completion in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate records needed to support invoice processing and purchasing reconciliation.
* Provide Accounting with purchasing and receiving documentation as needed for invoice processing.

**About the Role:**

The Material Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the seamless flow of materials throughout the production process, directly impacting operational efficiency and product delivery timelines. This position is responsible for managing inventory levels, coordinating material orders, and maintaining accurate records to support production schedules. The Material Coordinator works closely with procurement, production, and warehouse teams to optimize material availability while minimizing excess stock and waste. By effectively controlling material flow and cycle counting, this role helps prevent production delays and supports cost-effective manufacturing operations. Ultimately, the Material Coordinator ensures that all materials are available when needed, contributing to the overall success and reliability of the supply chain within the organization.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher in supply chain management or related field preferred.
* Proven experience in materials management or inventory control within a manufacturing or production environment.
* Proficiency in using ERP systems for inventory and order management.
* Ability to perform physical tasks including lifting and carrying heavy materials safely.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with cycle counting and inventory reconciliation processes.
* Familiarity with production scheduling and its impact on material requirements.
* Knowledge of purchase order processing and vendor management.
* Certification in materials management or supply chain (e.g., APICS CPIM) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage and oversee the receipt, storage, and distribution of materials in alignment with production schedules.
* Coordinate and process work orders and purchase orders to ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and inventory audits to maintain accurate material records and identify discrepancies.
* Collaborate with production and warehouse teams to monitor material flow and resolve any supply chain issues promptly.
* Utilize ERP systems to track inventory levels, update material status, and generate reports for management review.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards when handling and lifting heavy materials.
* Communicate effectively with suppliers and internal departments to forecast material needs and adjust orders accordingly.

**Skills:**

The required skills such as materials management and material control are essential for maintaining accurate inventory levels and ensuring materials are available to meet production demands. Proficiency with ERP systems enables the Material Coordinator to efficiently track orders, update inventory data, and generate insightful reports that inform decision-making. Skills in cycle counting and purchase order processing help maintain inventory accuracy and streamline procurement activities. The ability to manage material flow and coordinate with production schedules ensures that materials are delivered just-in-time, reducing downtime and excess inventory. Additionally, physical capability to lift and carry heavy materials safely is necessary to support warehouse operations and maintain a safe working environment.

description:
Fisher Industries is a vertically integrated family of businesses that provides heavy civil construction and aggregate products across the United States. With over 70 years of experience, the company specializes in highways, bridges, aggregates, and large-scale infrastructure projects, supported by in-house capabilities in drilling, blasting, crushing, asphalt, and concrete production. Fisher is committed to delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions with an emphasis on safety and quality. As a proven industry leader, Fisher Industries continues to grow while maintaining the integrity and values of a family-owned company. For additional information about our company, visit our website at www.fisherind.com

**POSITION SCOPE**

The **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** serves as the central communication and coordination hub between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, vendors, and management. This role is responsible for managing procurement request intake, tracking request status, prioritizing operational needs, maintaining procurement records, and ensuring timely communication throughout the purchasing process. By centralizing request management and status reporting, this position allows Procurement Specialists to focus on sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and expediting activities that support critical construction, aggregate, and equipment operations.

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming parts, material, and procurement requests from field personnel, supervisors, project managers, mechanics, and operational teams.
* Manage a high volume of incoming communications and procurement-related requests daily.
* Create, document, and maintain procurement requests and work orders within department tracking systems and dashboards.
* Capture and verify required request details including equipment numbers, project information, quantities, priorities, delivery locations, and required completion dates.
* Review requests for accuracy and completeness and route them to the appropriate Procurement Specialist based on business segment, equipment type, or operational need.
* Prioritize requests based on equipment downtime, project schedules, operational urgency, and management direction.
* Maintain current status information for active procurement requests and provide updates to requesting departments.
* Communicate estimated delivery dates, shipment tracking information, backorders, delays, substitutions, and order status updates.
* Escalate urgent, delayed, or stalled requests to Procurement Specialists or department leadership as necessary.
* Track procurement requests from initial intake through completion and verify accurate closeout documentation.
* Coordinate parts and material pickups, transfers, and deliveries with warehouse personnel, drivers, and field teams.
* Maintain organized records including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, tracking information, vendor communications, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain current vendor and supplier contact information and identify potential duplicate requests or communication gaps.
* Document emergency purchases and after-hours procurement activity.
* Prepare and distribute procurement status reports for department leadership and operational stakeholders.
* Assist Procurement Specialists with administrative and reporting responsibilities during periods of high purchasing volume.
* Maintain effective communication between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, and delivery teams.
* Promote safety, efficiency, and teamwork across all business operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or related field preferred.
* Previous experience in procurement coordination, purchasing support, parts administration, inventory control, construction operations, fleet maintenance, or related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, ERP, fleet management, or work-order tracking systems preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, vendors, and external partners.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment, construction, aggregate production, trucking, or fleet operations preferred.

Fisher Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a drug-free work environment requiring pre-employment and random drug testing.

If you require an accommodation with applying, please email hrdept@fisherind.com or call the HR Department at (701) 456-9184 to request accommodations. This email is only to request accommodation for

**Purchasing Coordinator**

**Join Our Team:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchasing Coordinator** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
+ Product specifications and configurations
+ Quantity increases or decreases
+ Split shipments and multiple orders
+ Special customer requirements
+ Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred/Not Required:**

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Quosal, or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

About Golden Star Technology (GST)
Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

The hourly rate for this position is $20.80 - $31.20 per hour. This position is eligible for the variable incentive employee program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

In the Coordinator role, you will work with the Supervisor and Team Lead to drive results on key metrics including safety, quality, delivery, inventory, and productivity. You will provide leadership by promoting teamwork, delivery of materials, and providing proactive resolution to production needs.

**Essential Functions:**

* You will coordinate material for your designated area as well and between areas to meet scheduled ship dates.

• You will review and update the status of orders and materials with manufacturing supervisors, material control personnel, and people in work areas, customer service, and KanBan expeditors. Includes regularly scheduled multi-functional production meetings which vary from once a week to daily depending on area(s) of responsibility.

• You will review orders and associated documentation (drawings, travel documents, bills of material) as needed to ensure the team has the appropriate information to complete the job and to assist with troubleshooting problems with the order documentation.

• You will utilize the computer, including Microsoft Excel, DMM, AS400, and the Material Synchronization Spreadsheet, to maintain control of floor stock and floor records.

• You will promote a safe, engaged and inclusive work culture by proactively addressing and resolving concerns and escalating issues to your supervisor as appropriate.

• You will process surplus, rejected, and/or defective material according to procedures.

• You will problem solve manufacturing information by identifying missing and incorrect items.

• Attend the Tier meeting, check and update emails, and log into required systems (DMM, Enovia, AS400).

• Review production tasks, including checking turnbacks, the Kanban list, crane sheets, and SPCs on the brake and/or punches; also identify past-due parts and monitor the sidesheet list.

• You will act as a back-up Team Lead if needed, ensuring continuity in leadership and operations.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED from an accredited institution.

• Minimum of 3 years of manufacturing or materials processing experience required.

• Prior work experience using a computer, including competence in Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Word, and Excel) required.

• Must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship.

• No relocation benefit is being offered for this position. Only candidates within a 50-mile radius of (enter location) will be considered. Active-Duty Military Service member candidates are exempt from the geographical area limitation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s degree from an accredited institution.

• 1 year of leadership experience managing people, project teams, or previous coordinator experience is strongly preferred.

• 1 year experience in switchboard assembly.

• Experience with Eaton systems including order entry (Vista), material management (DMM), MRP/ERP (AS400)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, persuasive skills, and analytical problem-solving skills with individuals and groups to effectively participate within team environment.

**Skills:**
-----------

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, persuasive skills, and analytical problem-solving skills. Work with individuals and groups to effectively participate within team environment.

• Able to direct and influence others without formal leadership authority.

• Willing to work flexible hours and overtime in support of business needs.

• Proficient with computers and programs including Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and SharePoint

• Working knowledge of Lean concepts

• Must work somewhat independently and make decisions that affect the workgroup. Focus efforts on attaining assigned goals and objectives, which include meeting needs and expectations of internal and external customers.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless

description:
**Position Summary**

The Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Coordinator is responsible for supporting the centralization of purchasing across Trinity Basin Preparatory while identifying opportunities to reduce costs, improve vendor performance, strengthen purchasing controls.

This position combines procurement administration, strategic sourcing, spend analysis, competitive bidding support, vendor performance management, and purchase order processing. The successful candidate will work closely with district departments, campuses, and vendors to ensure that purchasing decisions are cost-effective, compliant, and aligned with the district's commitment to responsible stewardship of public funds.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategic Sourcing & Cost Optimization**

* Analyze district-wide spending patterns and identify opportunities for cost savings and procurement efficiencies.
* Conduct market research and pricing analysis to identify alternative vendors, products, and services that provide greater value to the district.
* Benchmark pricing against market rates, cooperative purchasing programs, and existing vendor agreements.
* Develop sourcing strategies for high-spend categories such as instructional supplies, technology, facilities, maintenance, transportation, child nutrition, furniture, and professional services.
* Support annual budget development by providing purchasing trend analysis and vendor cost projections.

* Receive and review purchase requisitions from campuses and departments and prepare, process, and track purchase orders through the district's purchasing system (Skyward Q).

* Serve as the primary liaison with Region 10, Region 11, and other approved cooperative purchasing organizations.

**Vendor Performance Management**

* Analyze spending by campus, department, category, and vendor and prepare procurement reports and dashboards to support management decision-making.
* Establish and maintain productive relationships with key vendors and suppliers across the district.

* Manage new vendor onboarding, including required documentation, approval, and Skyward setup.

* Coordinate quarterly vendor business reviews with district stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Technology, Child Nutrition, Human Resources, and Campus Leadership.
* Identify opportunities for cost reductions, service improvements, and operational efficiencies through vendor reviews.

**Competitive Procurement & Compliance**

* Support Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Qualifications (RFQs), and Requests for Quotes under the direction of the Chief Financial Officer.
* Assist with development of bid specifications, vendor communications, and proposal evaluations.
* Support compliance with district policies and applicable state and federal purchasing regulations.

**Education & Experience**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
* Minimum of three (3) years of experience in procurement, purchasing, finance, accounting, operations, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a public school district, charter school, municipality, healthcare organization, or other multi-location organization.
* Experience supporting RFPs, RFQs, vendor evaluations, and competitive procurement processes.
* Experience working with financial management, purchasing, or ERP systems.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of procurement principles, purchasing controls, and sourcing practices.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Experience with Power BI, reporting tools, or dashboard development preferred.

**Working Conditions**

Work is primarily performed in an office environment with periodic travel to district campuses, vendor locations, and meetings as required.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Trinity Basin Preparatory is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, religion, or any other protected status under applicable law.

* **Benefits:** Health and Dental (30+ hours/week), Paid Sick Leave, PTO

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented **Materials Coordinator** to manage hands-on inventory, purchasing, and build-support operations. In this role, you will be responsible for purchasing parts directly from Bills of Materials (BOMs), handling incoming shipments, prepping and kitting parts for production or engineering builds, and running shortage analyses to keep build schedules on track.

This is an early-career position ideal for someone with 3 - 5 years of experience in supply chain, inventory, or receiving who thrives in a fast-paced hardware or manufacturing environment and wants to grow their supply chain operations skill set.

**Key ResponsibilitiesPurchasing & Order Tracking**

* Purchase raw materials, electronic components, and off-the-shelf parts directly from release-ready BOMs and purchase requisitions.
* Issue Purchase Orders (POs), track vendor order confirmations, and ensure on-time delivery to support engineering and build schedules.
* Communicate with suppliers to obtain quotes, update lead times, and resolve shipping delays.

**Receiving & Inventory Control**

* Inspect, count, and receive all incoming deliveries against purchase orders and packing slips.
* Log received items into inventory software/ERP and properly route or store components in designated stockroom locations.
* Conduct regular cycle counts to ensure physical inventory matches system records.

**Kitting & Build Support**

* Pull, count, and package component kits per assembly BOMs for engineering prototypes, test builds, or production runs.
* Stage kits for the assembly/manufacturing team and issue parts out of inventory accurately.
* Manage line-side stock, replenishment, and consumable hardware supplies.

**BOM Shortage Analysis & Risk Mitigation**

* Run and evaluate shortage reports against scheduled builds to identify missing or long-lead items early.
* Flag component shortages, long lead times, or end-of-life (EOL) risks to engineering and procurement teams.
* Help track clear-to-build (CTB) status for upcoming builds.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Finance and Accounting to ensure that proper expense categorization, GL coding, and specific tax treatments are applied to all purchases.

**Office Management & Administrative Support**

* Serve as the central point of contact for day-today-day office operations such as managing lunch orders, front-office operations such as hosting visitors while ensuring facility security and managing all incoming/outgoing mail and courier services.
* Coordinate third-party office management vendors such as facility contractors, janitorial services, and others as needed.

**Key Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in purchasing, receiving, inventory management, or stockroom operations (hardware/electronics/manufacturing background preferred).
* **Technical Skills:**
* Basic understanding of Bills of Materials (BOMs), engineering drawings, and component part numbers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (vlookups, basic data filtering/reporting).
* Familiarity with inventory control systems, ERP, or MRP software (e.g., NetSuite, Arena, Odoo, SAP, or similar).
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational habits, and clear written/verbal communication.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift up to 40 lbs, walk/stand for extended periods in a stockroom/warehouse environment, and handle delicate components.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience in an electronics, electro-mechanical, or hardware startup environment.
* Basic understanding of ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) handling procedures.
* Familiarity with vendor management and lead time tracking.
* Experience communicating with international suppliers/vendors, including basic familiarity with international shipping procedures or customs documentation.

Pay: $27.00 - $34.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About Us: AAR Corp. (NYSE: AIR) is a global aerospace and defense aftermarket solutions company that employs more than 6,000 people across over 60 sites in over 20 countries. Headquartered in the Chicago, Illinois area, AAR supports commercial and government customers in more than 100 countries through four operating segments: Parts Supply, Integrated Solutions, Repair and Engineering and Expeditionary Services. AAR’s purpose is to empower people to build innovative aerospace solutions today so you can safely reach your destination tomorrow. The company’s mission is to go above and beyond to provide value-driven aerospace aftermarket solutions to meet the evolving needs of our customers worldwide. AAR constantly searches for the right thing to do for its customers, employees, partners and for society.**


Coordinator, Purchasing III - 18903

**Description**
---------------

Performs a variety of purchasing duties. Maintains records and files with pertinent purchasing information. Compiles, records, and tracks purchasing data, activities, and pricing. Checks deliveries of materials ordered, and shipments received. Within prescribed limits, takes actions to ensure on-time delivery of materials. Coordinates returns of rejected or unsuitable orders. Responds to requests for purchasing data and status of material activities.

§ Knows and understands company and department policies and safety procedures.

§ Works with vendors to obtain products or service information such as pricing, availability, and delivery schedules.

§ Prints reports to know what parts to purchase.

§ Locates parts with acceptable tracing, pricing, and lead times.

§ Prepares purchase orders (PO) and bid requests.

§ Sets up vendors for purchases.

§ Works with vendors to determine order statuses.

§ Interfaces with all departments to resolve problems and issues with purchased items.

§ Runs a purchase order status report, weekly.

§Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
------------------

§ Read, write, and understand English fluently.

§ Ability to learn and understand and communicate effectively in writing and verbally.

§ High school and two years of office/clerical related education and experience.

§ Associate of Arts degree in a related discipline and one year of related technician education/experience.

§ High school and 2 years of related production/maintenance education/experience with certification in assigned area preferred.

**Job**
-------

: Purchasing

**Primary Location**
--------------------

: United States-Arkansas-Hot Springs-Triumph Airborne Structures

**Schedule**
------------

: Full-time

**Overtime Status**
-------------------

: Non-exempt

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Job Code: 0001033

Department: MANUFACTURING ASSEMBLY AND PRODUCTION - OPERATIONS

Salary: $24 - $31 Per Hour

**Summary of Position:**

The Material Coordinator will oversee the timely and efficient flow of materials within the manufacturing facility. This role involves coordinating the timing, delivery, and presentation of material to each phase of the manufacturing process. The Material Coordinator will work closely with various departments, including supply chain, warehouse, production, quality, and engineering to improve material flow and availability. The ideal Materials Coordinator will be self-driven, organized, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Five years of inventory, purchasing, or administrative experience, preferably in Oilfield Services (Automotive / Mechanical also a plus).
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite Software (Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Desire to work within an ERP system to track materials and processes.
* Executes with great attention to detail.
* Self-motivated and eager to improve themselves and those around them.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Forklift Certified.
* High School Diploma.

**Indicators & Attributes for Success:**

* Attention to detail
* Ability to stay on task and follow through
* Safety conscious
* Customer/Client focus
* Positive attitude
* Prioritization & organizational skills
* Accountability
* Ethical practice
* Strong team-player

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Coordinates with the procurement team to ensure timely ordering of materials based on the materials procurement plan.
* Ensures that all materials meet quality standards and specifications given by the engineering department.
* Coordinates the internal distribution of materials to various production departments based on production schedules.
* Documents material and resources statuses as required through Fiix (ERP System) and related tools.
* Monitors inventory levels and optimizes inventory turnover to minimize stockouts and excess inventory costs.
* Works with vendors to obtain quotes for new orders and updates deliveries for existing orders.
* Collaborates with supply chain teams to source materials from reliable suppliers at competitive prices.
* Works closely with production, quality control, engineering, and logistics teams to ensure seamless material flow and address any issues that may arise.
* Participates manufacturing initiatives to reduce waste, improve processes, and enhance overall efficiency in material management.
* Ability to identify components by name and have a basic understating of its operation and purpose.
* Performs work tasks in a safe manner.
Other Duties: This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Working Conditions/Environment:**

* Regularly operates in a highly safety-conscious environment, outdoor and indoor.
* Regularly be exposed to cold, heat, dust, odors, oil, fumes, and noise.
* Requires frequent bending, stooping, kneeling crouching, crawling, climbing, balancing, lifting, carrying, reaching, etc. with arms, hands, and fingers.
* Visits to other Liberty Energy facilities and to vendors may be required.

Benefits

**Salary:**

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

**Benefits:**

At Liberty Energy, our total employee benefits include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug (Rx)
* Voluntary Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, & Child(ren)
* Employee Basic Life and AD&D Insurance – Company Paid
* Short Term & Long Term Disability – Company Paid
* 401(k) or Roth 401(k) Retirement Plan, plus a company match
* Parental Leave
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* And many other benefits not listed here

### **Position Summary**

Salary: $53,800 - $65,700 annually depending on experience. MSU Benefits - Free comprehensive health care for you and your family as well as a 10% contribution toward your retirement; Generous sick, vacation, personal and holiday time. This position is not eligible for remote work; Regular, in-person attendance is required to meet business and customer needs.

This position serves as administrative and operational support for IPF Custodial Support Services (CSS). CSS Operations includes IPF Custodial Logistics & Supplies, IPF Campus Custodial Events, Equipment, Equipment Maintenance, Hard Floor Care and Carpet Care Services. The position functions as an assistant to the CSS Manager and is responsible for purchasing supplies, managing service requests, maintaining operational data, and supporting campus-wide support services to the custodial department and custodial event operations. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Detailed breakdown of job responsibilities is as follows:

30%: Manage custodial supply procurement and related transactional processes in support of custodial operations. Process and monitor orders through Spartan Marketplace, review order details for accuracy and compliance, and communicate with custodial supervisors regarding discrepancies or product concerns. Coordinate exchanges, returns, and order receipt activities within Planon, track outstanding transactions through KFS (Kuali Financial System), and maintain organized electronic records of procurement documentation.

25%: Administer and reconcile work orders within the Planon/IWMS (Integrated Workplace Management System), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with University policies and procedures. Monitor and coordinate work order transactions across multiple business systems, resolve discrepancies, maintain data integrity, and support accurate service delivery and stewardship of University resources.

25%: Coordinate and administer multiple IWMS workbenches, including scheduling and tracking activities for carpet care, hard floor care, and Event Custodial operations. Prioritize and coordinate work based on operational needs, maintain accurate account and work order information, and communicate with stakeholders to support effective service delivery.

10%: Perform miscellaneous administrative and operational support assignments, including cleanliness audits utilizing Orange QC software, data entry, and purchase requisition processing. Assist with KPI tracking, internal process audits, dashboard monitoring, and the preparation of audit summaries and related reports for management.

10%: Correspondence through email, training, meetings and professional development. Assist with filing, making copies, and maintaining accurate calendars/schedules.

This position will engage in high performing, leading edge practices, valuing people, partners and stewardship.

### **Minimum Requirements**

Knowledge equivalent to that which normally would be acquired through the first two or three years of college, such as an Associate’s degree in a business-related field; one to three years of related and progressively more responsible or expansive work experience in performing tasks related to procurement, and scheduling; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **Desired Qualifications**

Two or more years working in an office type setting with customer service/administrative duties. Expert knowledge of computer software applications and data management systems. Demonstrated ability to learn and apply organizational policies, procedures, and operational processes. Experience working in Planon or an equivalent asset management software program. Experience working in KFS or similar financial software program. A highly motivated/self-starter who demonstrates the ability to work well with a team in a fast paced/quick decision environment. The ability to multi-task with accuracy, follow directions, communicate across various organizational levels, meet deadlines, and forecast the needs of department operations. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

A lifelong learner and problem solver with strong technical skills and communication skills, who focuses on innovative solutions aligned with University goals.

**CordenPharma** is a leading full-service Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, drug products (DPs), and packaging. With around 3,000 employees worldwide, we help pharmaceutical and biotech companies manufacture medicines with the ultimate goal of improving people’s lives.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our network, spanning Europe and the U.S., provides flexible and specialized solutions across six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules, and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to delivering the highest quality products for patient well-being.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our People Vision**
---------------------

We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients' lives.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Procurement Coordinator partners closely with Procurement to execute purchasing needs while maintaining strong visibility into departmental budgets and ensuring compliance with internal policies, MAS requirements, and audit controls. Serves as the primary point of contact for all procurement-related activities within an assigned department. Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of collaborating cross-functionally to support efficient and compliant procurement operations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Procurement Coordination**

* Serve as the central intake point for departmental purchasing requests
* Work with stakeholders to understand required goods/services, timing, and priorities
* Partner with Procurement to ensure sourcing and purchasing align with established processes

**Cost Center & Budget Support**

* Act as the Procurement Coordinator for the assigned department
* Maintain working knowledge of:
+ Budget structure and approved spending by G/L Account
+ Current commitments and anticipated purchasing needs
* Support alignment between purchasing activity and approved budgets

**SAP Requisitioning**

* Create and manage purchase requisitions in SAP
* Ensure accurate cost center and G/L coding, proper documentation, and MAS adherence

**Receipt & Acceptance**

* Acknowledge receipt and acceptance of goods and services
* Confirm deliveries align with purchase order requirements
* Complete receiving confirmations in SAP to support timely invoice processing
* Coordinate resolution of delivery or receiving discrepancies

**Policy & Compliance**

* Ensure all purchasing and receiving activities comply with procurement policies, MAS requirements, and audit standards
* Escalate exceptions or questions to Procurement as needed

**P-Card Management**

* Utilize a corporate P-Card for purchases not processed through SAP
* Ensure proper documentation, reconciliation, and compliance with P-Card policies

**LEADERSHIP & BUDGET RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------------------

None.

**SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------------------

Every individual is personally responsible for the safety and environmental aspects of their activities in the workplace. Each employee is expected to perform their job duties in a safe manner utilizing all their knowledge, training, ability, and experience.

**QUALITY RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------

Corden Pharma Colorado (CPC) is a manufacturer of a variety of pharmaceutical products. In following Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Corden Pharma Colorado manufactures in accordance with the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), International Council for Harmonisation Q7 (ICH), and other global regulations as applicable. This is critical as it is our mission to not place patients at risk due to inadequate safety, quality, or efficacy. CPC’s Quality Management System, which incorporates cGMP, is designed to deliver this quality objective. description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As a Procurement Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting procurement operations and cross-functional business activities to ensure materials, services, and resources are available when and where they are needed. This position provides administrative and operational support to the Procurement team while partnering with multiple departments to drive efficient purchasing processes, inventory accuracy, equipment maintenance coordination, facility initiatives, and operational continuity.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Support procurement activities by preparing and issuing Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and organizing supplier quotations for review and analysis.
* Assist procurement team members with purchasing activities to support customer sales, repair, and operational requirements.
* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders for direct materials, indirect materials, tooling, maintenance, repair services, and other business needs.
* Support Bill of Materials (BOM) purchasing activities to ensure timely availability of required components.
* Maintain inventory-related data and assist with inventory management initiatives to support operational objectives.
* Provide administrative and transactional support to Procurement Buyers, including data entry, supplier information maintenance, pricing updates, virtual inventory management, and system record accuracy.
* Coordinate equipment and machine maintenance service requests in partnership with production leadership and service providers.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across manufacturing, operations, facilities, shipping and receiving, and other functional teams to support business initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of company events and facility-related improvement activities.
* Provide backup support for shipping and receiving operations, as required.
* Gather and analyze information to support procurement decisions, recommendations, and special projects.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement procedures, quality standards, and applicable business requirements.
Participate in continuous improvement activities that enhance efficiency, service levels, and operational effectiveness.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to analyze information, exercise sound judgment, and make recommendations based on available data.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to provide responsive support to internal stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently while contributing as an engaged team member.
* Solutions-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing business needs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience with ERP systems and account management databases preferred; Epicor experience is a plus.

### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, inventory management, customer service, or administrative support preferred.
Manufacturing environment experience is a plus.

**BENEFITS WITH JABIL**
-----------------------

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
* 401(k) Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
* Commuter Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pet Insurance
* Adoption Assistance
* Annual Merit Increases
* Community Volunteer Opportunities

description:
Amarr, a part of ASSA ABLOY and one of North America’s leading garage door manufacturers, is seeking a Supplier Quality Engineer to join our Supply Chain organization in Lawrence, Kansas.

In this role, you will partner with Strategic Sourcing, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and our supply base to improve supplier quality, cost competitiveness, and overall performance. You will support new and existing products, develop supplier capabilities, lead structured problem-solving activities, and help identify and implement Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) opportunities.

This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working cross functionally, engaging directly with suppliers, and turning technical and manufacturing challenges into measurable business improvements.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Supplier Quality & Performance**
----------------------------------

* Monitor and improve supplier performance using key metrics including DPPM, Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ), supplier quality events, audit performance, and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Analyze supplier performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead supplier containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of long-term corrective actions.
* Partner with suppliers to improve manufacturing processes, process controls, quality systems, and overall capability.
* Support resolution of supplier-related issues identified through incoming inspection, manufacturing, assembly, testing, or field performance.
* Develop and manage Supplier Quality Improvement Plans for suppliers requiring focused improvement.

**Supplier Development**
------------------------

* Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Category Management teams to develop and strengthen preferred and partner suppliers.
* Conduct supplier capability assessments, technical reviews, process audits, quality-system audits, and sustainability audits.
* Develop supplier improvement roadmaps and drive actions to timely closure.
* Participate in supplier selection by evaluating manufacturing capability, quality systems, capacity, technical capability, risk, and continuous-improvement potential.
* Support supplier consolidation, resourcing, supplier transfers, and other strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Provide supplier coaching and training in areas such as APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, process capability, risk assessment, and structured problem solving.

**New Product Introduction / APQP / PPAP**
------------------------------------------

* Lead supplier quality activities supporting new product introductions, product revisions, supplier changes, and manufacturing process changes.
* Manage supplier APQP and PPAP activities for new and revised purchased components.
* Review supplier Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, capability studies, measurement-system analyses, and related quality documentation.
* Partner with Engineering and Strategic Sourcing to identify supplier and manufacturing risks early in the product-development process.
* Ensure suppliers demonstrate appropriate quality, capability, capacity, and production readiness prior to launch.

**Value Analysis / Value Engineering – VAVE**
=============================================

VAVE is an important component of this position. The Supplier Quality Engineer will work with suppliers and internal cross-functional teams to improve value while maintaining or improving product quality, reliability, safety, and customer performance.

* Proactively identify and develop VAVE opportunities within the supply base.
* Engage suppliers in generating improvement ideas involving materials, manufacturing processes, product design, specifications, packaging, standardization, part consolidation, and waste reduction.
* Facilitate supplier VAVE workshops and structured idea-generation activities.
* Partner with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Quality to evaluate VAVE concepts for technical feasibility, risk, cost impact, and implementation requirements.
* Support should-cost and cost-driver analysis to identify opportunities for product and process optimization.
* Develop VAVE business cases that consider potential savings, implementation costs, technical requirements, validation needs, risk, and timing.
* Coordinate testing, validation, PPAP, and implementation activities associated with approved VAVE changes.
* Maintain a pipeline of supplier VAVE opportunities from idea generation through validation and implementation.
* Encourage suppliers to proactively bring innovation, cost-reduction, and value-improvement ideas to Amarr.

**How Success Will Be Measured**
================================

* Supplier DPPM
* Supplier Cost of Poor Quality
* Supplier quality events
* Corrective action closure and effectiveness
* Supplier audit performance
* APQP / PPAP execution
* New product launch supplier performance
* Supplier improvement result

**Why Join Our Team?**

Do you want to be part of a team that is making a positive difference in lives all across the globe? Do you want to be part of a culture where you are recognized, respected, and rewarded for a job well done? U.S. Pipe has been providing quality water and wastewater products since 1899, and for the past 120 years we have proudly supported local governments, municipalities, water departments, and businesses all across the United States, and the world.

**What We Offer:**

* Team Collaboration: Join a team-oriented environment where collaboration is not just a buzzword but a priority.
* Career Growth: Be part of an industry leader renowned for world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution, and take your career to the next level.
* Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a comprehensive benefits package with options tailored to meet your needs and those of your family.

**About the Role:**

U.S. Pipe is seeking a **Project Mechanical Engineer** to support a large modernization project at our locations. The Project Mechanical Engineer will review project drawings, specifications and submittals for compliance with U.S. Pipe standards, codes and standards and contract requirements prior to the start of construction. During construction the Project Mechanical Engineer will verify that the installation conforms to the project requirements and ultimately support the successful commissioning of the new facility.

Upon completion of this project, this position will either transition into the plant or corporate engineering team.

The position will require travel (approximately 10% travel requirement)

**Specific Responsibilities:**

* Ensure contractors act safely by actively engaging with personnel to foster a culture where safety is openly discussed and continuously improved.
* As a member of the U.S. Pipe project team, coordinate with team members and plant personnel to ensure the design and construction support a fully functional facility.
* Review/comment/approve Mechanical drawings, submittals, specifications and other documents prepared by the General Contractor.
* Review General Contractor Requests for Information (RFI’s) and develop appropriate responses.
* Monitor multi-disciplinary construction and quality check General Contractor’s Mechanical construction.
* Coordinate with OEM vendors during installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Support commissioning activities to ensure proper and timely startup of the new facility.
* Prepare Mechanical punch list items and verify proper correction prior to final acceptance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field. Will consider combination of post-secondary education and experience in lieu of preferred degree.
* 3-5 years of experience in mechanical engineering or related role.
* Experience with installation of mechanical equipment including material handling equipment, hydraulic, pumping, cooling towers, compressed air and HVAC systems.
* Experience with mechanical alignments and lubrication.
* Experience with installation and testing of piping systems.
* Project Management experience.
* Experience working on construction sites, preferably heavy industrial construction facilities.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental regulations.
* Ability to think logically, strong decision-making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to present technical data.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, AutoCAD and Navisworks strongly preferred.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

U.S. Pipe is an equal opportunity employer committed to developing a workforce with well-qualified individuals without regard to their race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender, disability, veteran status or other protected characteristics. U.S. Pipe is a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact the U.S. Pipe Recruiting team at (866) 347-7473.

We need your talent, teamwork, and energy to help us achieve great things that inspire people all over the globe. We need you to bring creative ideas and diverse backgrounds to help us envision, shape, and deliver systems that will enable the exploration of space while benefiting people here on Earth. We are excited about what we do, and we need you on our team as we take on exciting challenges for NASA's pursuits in deep space exploration.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Cryogenics Mechanical Engineer** to join our JETS II contract team at **NASA Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX**.

**If selected you will:**

* Perform engineering design and analysis for cryogenic components, vacuum jacketed and warm piping systems, and associated mechanical systems.
* Develop procurement and fabrication documentation, including Statements of Work, specifications, and engineering drawings.
* Coordinate with vendors and fabricators, participate in design reviews, and witness key testing activities.
* Support facility operations for 20 K helium systems, 80 K liquid nitrogen storage, and distribution systems.
* Provide troubleshooting, maintenance guidance, and technical oversight during equipment assembly, installation, and commissioning.
* Prepare and participate in safety reviews, hazard analyses, operational procedures, and engineering review boards.
* Collaborate with multi-disciplined engineering teams and present design and technical findings.
* This is an on-site role.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

This position has been posted at multiple levels. Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.

* Typically requires a bachelor's degree in Engineering and a minimum of 2- 5 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience with mechanical stress analysis of pressure components, mechanical equipment design, and hands on system development.
* Knowledge of machining, welding, piping, and pipe fitting practices.
* Minimum two years of progressively responsible mechanical design experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; proficiency in MS Office tools.
* Ability to positively interact with and support contractors, vendors, and procurement professionals.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Cryogenic piping system design, fluid flow and heat transfer analysis, and cryogenic materials knowledge.
* Experience with cold boxes, phase separators, heat exchangers, pumps, compressors, valves, and other cryogenic plant equipment.
* Familiarity with ASME BPVC VIII, ASME B31.3, NFPA, and OSHA requirements.
* Proficiency with 3D CAD and analysis tools (Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD, ANSYS).
* Knowledge of high vacuum systems and helium mass spec leak detection.
* Experience with design and sizing of plant components, such as heat exchangers, pumps, compressors, piping, valves, relief devices
* Proficient with 3D modeling using Creo, Solid Works and/or AutoCAD Inventor.
* Familiarity with national building codes, NFPA and OSHA requirements.

**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Positive work-life balance
* 100% Employer paid insurance including: Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, short-term disability, and long-term disability
* 11 paid holidays annually
* Generous PTO
* 401k after 12 months of service with employer match
* Education assistance
* Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Mclaurin is a unique organization with a special focus on combining the best features of research and industry in order to foster innovation. Our organization strongly supports research, publication, and engagement with the academic community. We encourage our employees to remain on the cutting edge of new developments in their respective disciplines.

**US Citizenship and the ability to pass a comprehensive security background investigation is required.**

Mclaurin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
