**Position Overview**

The Mechanical Design Engineer's responsibilities include but are not limited to; review project design requirements, provide input for potential additional requirements, develop, and execute the design of ideas for the product, review and justify designs during preliminary and critical project design reviews. The Design Engineer will create CAD models using MSI's parametric skeleton strategy, fully defining the bill of materials of the system. The Design Engineer will also manage the development of the drawing package used to convey the system requirement to the production team. The Design Engineer will ensure designs meet the goals and requirements outlined for the project and will report the design's status to the Project Manager to ensure it remains in line with the master project schedule. The Design Engineer will work with the Engineering Team to continuously promote professional self-growth and design knowledge.

The Mechanical Design Engineers will report to the Lead SuspensionMobility Engineer. This position requires a full-time work week spent in the shop/office. Normal hours are Monday through Thursday 7:00am-4:30pm and Friday 7:00am-12:00pm. (Must be flexible to work additional hours as needed based on project requirements and deadlines).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Must demonstrate understanding of the function and purpose of vehicle sub-systems including, but not limited to chassis, suspension, drive train, brakes, exterior and interior systems, payload capacity, electrical, HVAC, fluid cooling systems. General hands-on experience with automotive or vehicle systems is a plus.
* Develop and manage vehicle components and assemblies in CAD. Use experience/knowledge to generate new design ideas. Work with Project Managers to provide continual schedule updates towards the progress of the overall project. MSI's design goals are to develop superior products by utilizing sound engineering principles and creative thinking. Our manufacturing goals are to minimize lead time and cost while building a high-quality component. The Design Engineer shall have experience with the application of GD&T techniques and ASME Y14.5 practices.
* Modeling at MSI is performed using PTC Creo 7.0. MSI has proven itself to be a leader with an "unmatched speed to market" approach by utilizing skeleton top-down parametric modeling. The Design Engineer shall understand the relationships that are built throughout the model using "external copy geometry" through assembly skeletons. A Senior Design Engineer will provide guidance of the model tree's parent and child structure relationships for each project. Design Engineers execute the design structure in the CAD system throughout the products developmental lifecycle process.
* The Design Engineer will perform structural FEA or mathematical analyses of a design within their capabilities. Experience with Ansys software is a plus. When necessary, the Design Engineer will work with outside FEA partners to manage and support the analysis effort by providing necessary information to these outside partners so they can provide MSI with a complete and through analysis summary that either confirms or directs modification of the design(s). The Design Engineer will also provide guidance to the Project Manager on when FEA should be used to validate a design. This will allow the Project Manager to plan and budget for the requested resources.
* The Design Engineer will work with the production team and vendor base to produce the prototypes. The Design Engineer will be expected to support manufacturing in the development of prototypes to ensure that the required changes for manufacturing are reported and implemented back to the CAD system. The Design Engineer is required to have a strong understanding of standard prototyping manufacturing methods.
* Contribute to developing and maintaining thorough and complete BOM's and production of accurate drawings for use in manufacturing processes and configuration management. Produce reports detailing analysis and design changes when necessary.
* Be able to develop a clear understanding of MSI's ERP system and how the other departments of the company function throughout the product life cycle.

**Skills and Qualifications Required**

* Minimum of a BS degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or similar
* Minimum 5 years in appropriate automotive, motorsports or defense vehicle related field
* Experience with sheet metal, weldments, and machined parts is a plus
* Minimum 3 years as high-level CAD user (CREO Preferred)
* Minimum of 1 year of PDM experience (Windchill Preferred)
* Experience in FEA (Ansys) is a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience designing and analyzing automotive components and systems
* Highly motivated, organized, and responsible.
* Leadership skills
* Ability to interact with all types of people under pressure
* Knowledge of machining practices, industry workings,

CMTA (formerly AMA Group), a Legence company

CMTA is one of the fastest-growing engineering firms in the U.S., known for sustainable, high-performance building systems and complex MEP/FP delivery. Through AMA’s design expertise in media, broadcast, and production facilities—and CMTA’s national portfolio in education, healthcare, and zero-energy projects—we pair deep technical craft with an innovative, collaborative culture that accelerates careers.

CMTA, formerly known as AMA Group, is seeking a Senior Project Engineer, Mechanical, who will be responsible for designing mechanical systems and ensuring projects are completed successfully on a range of both small and large projects. This is a hands-on role that will be given the opportunity to lead projects and represent AMA in all interactions with clients, contractors, architects, and other project team members.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Exercise judgment in evaluating, selecting, and applying standard design engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria on a variety of projects to include, but not limited to, buildings and facilities, including hospitals, laboratories, high-rise residential and high-rise offices, media, and other commercial and institutional projects, in compliance with state, National, and local municipality building codes
* Select and specify equipment, including pumps, heat exchangers, boilers, cooling towers, chillers, air handlers, and fans, for residential buildings with heat pumps, VRF/VRV, and PTAC systems
* Assist in the preparation of basis-of-design descriptions, responses to client comments, and other project-related documentation. Incorporate design changes using AutoCAD and Revit software
* Perform design load calculations, equipment selections, and mechanical system design
* Design energy-efficient systems that set the standards for building system design, perform COMCheck, and provide credit documentation for LEED and other building rating systems design and compliance
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s in Engineering required; PE highly preferred
* 5 - 9 years of experience in mechanical system design; field experience is required
* Working knowledge of building codes and standards, engineering drafting standards, mechanical engineering standards, and other trades
* Understanding of the construction process and ability to interpret construction drawings
* AutoCAD and REVIT proficiency

**Salary Range:** $85,000 - $110,000. This role is also eligible for an annual performance based bonus. Bonus eligibility and payout are determined by role, individual performance, and company performance, and are not guaranteed.

#LI-CM1 #LI-Onsite

The Employee Experience

People are at the heart of what we do. We’re committed to a diverse, inclusive culture where employees thrive—individually and as a team—with development, wellness, and day-to-day experience front and center. We offer competitive benefits and a collaborative, fun work environment. Our team was named “Best Engineering Firm to Work” for by Best Companies Group for 2024, 2025, and 2026—a people-first standard AMA continues as they integrate with CMTA.

About Legence

Description: NSI requires a Senior Logistics Engineer to support the PMA 265 Product Support Team (PST)/Integrated Product Team (IPT). The Senior Logistics Engineer serves as a vital senior-level asset within the PMA-265 Product Support Team (PST) Integrated Product Team (IPT). The primary objective of this position is to coordinate and optimize logistics engineering processes, execute complex data analyses, secure and track operational readiness funding, and integrate emerging material technologies into the F/A-18 and EA-18G fleet. The selected candidate will operate at a high level of independence, serving as a Deputy Assistant Program Manager for Systems Engineering (DAPMSE) equivalent in supporting cross-functional engineering, logistics, and program management domains. This role requires exceptional coordination capabilities to interface with internal NAVAIR competencies, external defense partners, and Congressional liaisons.

Data Analytics, Reporting, and Congressional Inquiries:

* Lead the generation, analysis, and synthesis of highly technical data requests, performance metrics, and fleet readiness reports.
* Serve as the primary coordinator for compiling, refining, and validating responses to high-profile inquiries, including official Congressional Inquiry packages and Senior Navy Leadership data calls.
* Ensure all technical and administrative responses for the Product Support Team are accurate, data-backed, and delivered within established tight deadlines.

Cross-Functional Integration & Data Call Coordination:

* Convene and facilitate cross-functional technical teams (consisting of logisticians, systems engineers, materials experts, and program analysts) to resolve complex operational and systemic fleet issues.
* Streamline tracking mechanisms and operational workflows to manage incoming action items and "data calls" across the PMA.
* Drive collaboration across departmental boundaries to ensure integrated, holistic engineering and program management solutions.

Funding Acquisition & Fleet Readiness Support:

* Support the generation of comprehensive technical justifications and business cases to secure critical funding (e.g., APN-5, OPN, O&MN) aimed at addressing urgent fleet equipment deficiencies and operational readiness requirements.
* Work collaboratively with financial and logistics teams to track funding execution, ensuring alignment with resource allocation rules and scheduling milestones.

Technical Writing, Policy, and Program Documentation:

* Author, review, and maintain critical program life-cycle documentation. This includes primary ownership of the program’s Corrosion Prevention Control Plan (CPCP) and Additive Manufacturing Plan.
* Lead inter-disciplinary reviews to incorporate updates reflecting the latest engineering practices, materials advancements, and environmental regulations into official program office documents.

Core Competencies & Technical Skills:

* Acquisition Certifications: Equivalency to DAWIA Level 3 in Systems Engineering or Program Management is highly preferred.
* Technical Writing & Communication: Proven history of drafting high-visibility technical papers, program plans, and executive briefings. Strong oral communication skills for facilitating multidisciplinary panels.
* Problem Solving & Process Improvement: Experience in developing process maps, workflow management tools, and efficiency trackers for complex engineering programs.

Location: Lexington Park, MD

Education: MS or MA Degree in Acquisition, Logistics Management, Business, Engineering, or Management.

Experience: At least 10 years’ FTE experience in acquisition related to in-service support of DOD weapons systems performing any of the following: LORA, maintenance planning, Logistics Support/Supportability Analysis, Operational Availability analysis, or resource requirements analysis. Twelve (12) to fifteen (15) years of progressive engineering experience within DoD Acquisition, Systems Engineering, or Sustainment environments and LCC experience desired. Four years’ experience supervising and directing in the performance of comprehensive analyses across the spectrum of IS elements, during a job assignment in an Acquisition command or supporting an acquisition command. Direct, extensive experience working within NAVAIR program offices (PMAs) and familiarity with NAVAIR-specific systems engineering practices.

Security Clearance: Secret Clearance is required. Must be a U.S. citizen.

Special Notes/Instructions: NSI is a privately held, small but quickly growing company with headquarters in Lexington Park, Maryland within 5 miles of the Patuxent River Naval Air Station. Established in 2004, we are now celebrating 22 years of excellence in providing quality products and services to the Department of Defense. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, paid time off, paid holidays,

Humanscale is the premier designer and manufacturer of ergonomic products that improve health and comfort at work. **We have a focus on sustainability with over 70% of our products currently certified as having a Net Positive impact on the environment. Overview:

The Product Engineer I supports the design, launch, and ongoing improvement of new and existing products in a manufacturing environment. This role manages engineering changes, contributes to early-stage product development to ensure manufacturability, creates and reviews assembly and specification drawings, maintains product data and bills of material, and determines the parts and tooling needed to meet production goals. * Identify opportunities for cost reductions and coordinate initiatives to achieve savings in a timely manner.
* Plan and accomplish projects & goals on time and within budget.
* Support the installation, qualification, verification, and validation of new and existing equipment and processes.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers regarding technical specifications and alternatives, including the procurement of material and components.
* Generate specification control drawings as a means of communication with vendors and suppliers.
* Resolve technical, procedural and logistical problems in manufacturing by using proper troubleshooting and failure analysis techniques.
* Design customized prototypes and final functional units to satisfy customer Special Order Requests (SOR).
* Any other duties as assigned.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar discipline.
* 0 to 2 years of engineering experience, including relevant internships, co-ops, or hands-on academic product development projects.
* Internship experience working in an Engineering capacity at a manufacturing facility.
* Knowledge of engineering principles, practices and techniques commonly employed in the design and production of products.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate engineering concepts to non-engineers.
* Understanding of Lean Manufacturing concepts, techniques and tools.
* Understanding of and experience working with machines & mechanical systems.
* Must be able to work in a team environment, helping others when necessary.
* Bilingual in Spanish and English preferred.

* Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.
* Must be able to do repetitive bending and stretching.
* Ability to lift 60 pounds.
* Ability to be onsite 5 days a week.
* Ability to move about the Production floor frequently and occasionally stoop, kneel, or crouch.
* Ability to use hands to operate tools, install, adjust and attach parts.

* A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
* Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

* Solid knowledge with manufacturing processes and electrical/mechanical components, systems and applications
* Solid understanding of lean techniques and statistical analysis

Overview:

As the ***Mechanical Engineer of Capital Projects*** at DBMG***,*** you’ll lead efforts in planning, executing, and overseeing capital expenditure projects related to steel fabrication and manufacturing. This role involves designing mechanical systems, managing automated machine installation project timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. The ideal candidate will have experience in heavy industrial environments and a strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles applied to manufacturing, automation and steel fabrication processes.

**Position Overview:**

* Project Planning & Execution: Lead the design, budgeting, and implementation of capital projects involving mechanical systems in steel fabrication plants.
* Equipment Specification & Procurement: Identify and specify mechanical equipment and systems required for fabrication and erection processes.
* Process Improvement: Analyze current operations and recommend changes to improve productivity, efficiency, safety, and quality. Mechanical design and overseeing the building of custom solutions is required.
* Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain engineering drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
* Vendor Coordination: Work with suppliers and contractors to ensure timely delivery and installation of mechanical components.
* Compliance & Safety: Ensure all mechanical designs and installations comply with industry standards, codes, and safety regulations.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with fabrication, erection, quality, and safety teams to align project goals and execution.
* Budget & Timeline Management: Monitor project costs and schedules to ensure alignment with capital expenditure plans.

Responsibilities:

**Work Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in a manufacturing or steel fabrication industrial environment.
* Shop floor and/or job site experience required.

**Education/Training:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, industrial, manufacturing, construction engineering, or a related field.

**Software & Technology:**

* Proficient in 2D & 3D CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) and project management tools.

Qualifications:

**Work Environment:**

* This position requires up to 30% of expected travel to work from various DBM Global offices and project sites as business needs require
* This position requires as many hours needed to fulfill the daily and weekly obligations required to carry out the functions and may require occasional evening and weekends.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made upon request for those who have disabilities that qualify under the American with Disabilities Act.

DBM Global, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ***Apply Directly. No Agencies.***

**The Opportunity:**

Join our dynamic engineering team in El Segundo, CA, where you'll design, prototype, and deliver innovative hardware solutions for real-world applications. As a Mechanical Engineer, you'll collaborate with experience d engineers and cross-functional teams to tackle complex hardware challenges—ruggedizing systems for extreme environments to integrating cutting-edge technologies into systems that will operate in space, on the ground, or underwater. Your work will directly impact mission-critical projects, supporting both defense and advanced technology initiatives. If you're passionate about turning ideas into tangible solutions and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced setting, this is the place to launch your engineering career.

Join us. The world can't wait.

**You Have:**

* Experience working in hardware design, prototyping, 3D modeling and computer-aided drafting ( CAD ) in an internship, school projects, or in a professional work environment
* Knowledge of basic engineering and physics principles as they apply to hardware design and product develop ment
* Knowledge of manufacturing technologies and approaches, including additive and subtractive manufacturing techniques
* Ability to develop technical documentation, including 2D technical drawings and written technical documentation
* Ability to collaborate with an integrated product team, including a variety of technical and non-technical teammates
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with prototyping and integration related to electromechanical or military systems
* Experience with finite element analysis ( FEA ) or modeling and simulation activities
* Experience with other engineering sof tware, including MATLAB, Mathcad, or multiphysics sof tware
* Experience with lab-based develop mental testing and test data acquisition
* Knowledge of product design for manufacturability, reliability, maintainability, injection molding, ruggedization, and extreme environments
* Secret clearance
* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information .

**Compensation**

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $55,200.00 to $126,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

**Identity Statement**

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on **your** own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly provided** .

**Work Model**
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

* **Remote** : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**
------------------------

The Senior Welding Engineer will serve as the technical owner for welding processes supporting production operations within the facility. This role will be responsible for developing, implementing, optimizing, and sustaining welding processes used to manufacture structural steel products. The position will focus primarily on structural steel GMAW-P pulse welding applications, while also supporting TIG welding processes used throughout the plant. The Senior Welding Engineer will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, and Safety teams to ensure weld quality, improve productivity, support new product launches, reduce manufacturing costs, and maintain compliance with applicable welding codes, customer requirements, and internal standards.

* Develop, qualify, and maintain welding procedures, work instructions, process standards, WPSs, PQRs, and supporting weld documentation as required.
* Lead weld process development, optimization, and troubleshooting for structural steel fabrication operations.
* Support robotic and manual GMAW-P pulse welding processes and provide technical support for TIG welding applications.
* Establish and maintain weld parameters, fixture requirements, consumable selection, shielding gases, preheat/interpass requirements, and process controls.
* Conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions for weld defects including porosity, lack of fusion, undercut, distortion, spatter, cracking, burn-through, and dimensional variation.
* Support new product launches by reviewing designs for weldability, manufacturability, quality, and production efficiency.
* Collaborate with Design Engineering and Quality to ensure welding requirements, welding symbols, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards are clearly defined.
* Evaluate and implement improvements to welding equipment, fixtures, tooling, automation, robotic welding cells, and welding consumables.
* Coordinate installation, startup, validation, and commissioning of welding equipment, tooling, and related process changes.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to improve safety, quality, throughput, labor efficiency, material usage, and overall welding line performance.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Welding Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or related technical discipline required. Bachelor’s degree specifically focused in Welding Engineering or Welding Engineering Technology preferred.
* 3+ years of welding engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Active Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification required.
* Strong experience developing, qualifying, and maintaining welding procedures and supporting weld quality programs.
* Experience with structural steel fabrication and welding processes.
* Demonstrated experience with GMAW-P pulse welding processes; experience supporting TIG welding processes preferred.
* Working knowledge of robotic welding systems, welding automation, welding power supplies, and associated process controls.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, GD&T, and applicable welding specifications.
* Experience with weld fixture design, process capability studies, weld quality validation, and weld inspection methods.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills related to welding defects and process variation.
* Experience supporting APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, and new product launch activities.
* Knowledge of AWS welding codes, welding metallurgy, filler metal selection, shielding gases, and weld testing methods.

----------------------------

description:
The ***Sr. Mechanical Engineer*** will contribute to the development of new products; work in a cross-functional development or advanced development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in this dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

Vertiv's Thermal Business Unit is a global leader in designing, manufacturing, and servicing mission-critical thermal management solutions for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities worldwide. The Thermal BU's portfolio spans the complete thermal chain from chip to atmosphere, including room cooling, in-row cooling, rack cooling, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution units (CDUs), rear-door heat exchangers, chillers, dry coolers, and trim coolers. Operating across all major regions (Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific), the Thermal BU serves hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and edge data center customers with solutions optimized for increasingly high-density AI and high-performance computing environments. Within this business unit, the Advanced Development group is responsible for incubating next-generation thermal technologies and proving their viability before transitioning them to NPDI teams for productization. This role sits at the forefront of that mission, driving innovation in emerging thermal architectures that will define Vertiv's competitive position in the rapidly evolving data center cooling market.

Roles and Responsibilties:

* Conduct advanced development tasks to inform NPDI teams designing new cooling systems for high density computer rooms.
* Collaborate across the disciplines of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, as well as production and offering teams. Work with these teams for design reviews, meeting cost metrics, and brainstorming around customer pain points.
* Perform a variety of engineering calculations using traditional engineering methods to verify design requirements, which may include stress calculations, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics.
* Perform CFD and/or 1D modeling and analysis to evaluate and optimize cooling system architectures, balancing thermal performance, energy efficiency, physical footprint, manufacturability, and total system cost.
* Develop solutions to complex problems where little or no precedence exists - the use of ingenuity and creativity is regularly required.
* Develop prototypes to support advanced product design.
* Plan and oversee proof-of-concept testing, then utilize the results to validate or modify designs, control methods, and analytical models.
* Compile reports and design guidelines.
* Scout technologies that could be implemented into Vertiv cooling systems. Sources could be suppliers, university researchers, startup companies, etc.
* Support Vertiv activities with University-Industry collaborations.
* Interact with employees, outside vendors and suppliers as needed.
Other Duties as assigned

Education and Requirements

* Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering (BSME) or directly related degree at minimum.
* Advanced Degree preferred.
* Min 7-10 years of experience.
* Demonstrated record of meeting deadlines and project goals
* Understanding of electrical schematic and pneumatic drawings (P&ID)
* Understanding of thermodynamics and fluid mechanics
* Ability to work and multi-task in a fast-paced environment independently and/or as a member of a dynamic team; offer and receive constructive criticism.
* Demonstrated history of delivering quality products to market with understanding and respect for phases of the product development process
* Excellent project management skills and communication skills
* Experience with 3D CAD software, preferred CREO 4.0 and greater
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to travel upto 10%
* ***Preferred:***
+ Experience in programming and/or creating thermal system energy models to compare new ideas to baseline systems
+ Experienced in the use of AI-powered engineering tools for increased efficiency
+ Experience with 2-Phase heat transfer fluids, including “natural” refrigerants
+ Experience with 1-phase and/or 2-phase Liquid Cooling technologies
+ Knowledge of psychometric chart and refrigeration cycles
+ Experience with CFD and/or FEA software, preferred Ansys
+ Understanding of manufacturing limitations, break sheet metal and formed copper tubes

ASI is seeking a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to support complex aircraft modification, prototyping, and integration projects within the Aircraft Prototype Systems Division (APSD). **This position is located onsite at NAS Patuxent River, MD and is not remote eligible.**

**Responsibilities**:

* Develop advanced 3D CAD models using PTC Creo, including complex geometries, large assemblies, skeleton-based architectures, surfaces, and shrink-wrap techniques
* Create, review, and manage Technical Data Packages (TDPs) compliant with MIL-STD-31000 and ASME drafting standards including ASME Y14.100, Y14.24, Y14.35, and Y14.5 GD&T requirements
* Perform classical mechanical and structural hand calculations for brackets, fasteners, margins of safety, and airworthiness substantiation to support flight clearance documentation
* Develop engineering drawings, analyses, and documentation in support of airworthiness, referencing Mil-HDBK-516, NAVAIRINST 13034.1, and NAWCADINST 13050.1
* Utilize PTC Windchill for configuration management, product structure control (WTParts), CAD data management, and change-control workflows including ECPs and ECNs
* Lead and mentor junior engineers and technicians, providing direction on CAD standards, GD&T, drafting practices, and workload prioritization
* Apply manufacturing knowledge related to sheet metal and machining processes, including CNC, lathes, mills, press brakes, and water jets, ensuring designs are optimized for fabrication and installation
* Work independently to execute complex, non-routine design tasks with minimal supervision, resolving technical issues and shaping engineering solutions on accelerated timelines

**Required Qualifications:**

**About Digital Dynamics Inc.**

Digital Dynamics Inc. (DDI) is a 100% employee-owned company specializing in high-performance control solutions for the semiconductor and display equipment industries. As owners, every team member contributes to our culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence. We are passionate about designing technologies that enable the future of advanced manufacturing.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Mechanical Engineer** to design and develop precision mechanical systems used in next-generation semiconductor and display equipment. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll contribute across the full product lifecycle—from concept design and prototyping through validation and production release—while collaborating with cross-functional teams and providing technical guidance to junior engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop mechanical assemblies, precision components, and enclosures that meet the high standards of semiconductor and display equipment.
* Support the development process across concept design, CAD modeling, prototyping, validation, and release to manufacturing.
* Apply best practices in GD&T, tolerance stack-up, materials selection, and thermal/structural analysis.
* Partner closely with electrical, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure seamless system integration.
* Participate in and contribute to design reviews, risk assessments, and DFM/DFT improvements to optimize reliability, cost, and manufacturability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering growth and collaboration.
* Collaborate with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure high-quality, cost-effective production.
* Investigate and resolve issues discovered in testing and production through structured root cause analysis.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* 8+ years of mechanical engineering experience with a focus on product design and high reliability safety systems (semiconductor or capital equipment experience strongly preferred).
* Advanced proficiency with CAD tools (SolidWorks or equivalent) and PDM systems.
* Strong expertise in thermal management, materials science, precision machining, and structural analysis.
* Demonstrated success taking products from concept through production in high-tech industries.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**

We believe rewarding employees extends beyond base compensation. Our total rewards approach is designed to recognize performance, support long-term growth, and create shared success through competitive pay, bonus program eligibility, participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), which provides employees the opportunity to share in the company’s long-term success, 401(k) match, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, paid time off, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a 100% employee-owned company.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Digital Dynamics Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Purpose of this Job:**

* This job is responsible for developing product in compliance with Sanden and customer requirements.
* This role will include compressor / system component (HVAC / HX / ITMS) development, design, testing, and reporting with engineering theory / logic.
* This role will also include training for other engineers and staff.
* Other responsibilities include technical support for projects related to manufacturing.

Requirements:

**Principle Duties/Essential Functions:**

* Execute product development by achieving technical goal.
* Achieve technical goals and task with PDCA for product development.
* Develop engineering solutions for suppliers, and cross functional members to meet required needs.
* Develop engineering laboratory testing methods and equipment.
* Coach / mentor engineers and other staff based on expertise.

**Other Tasks/Responsibilities:**

* Work with other Sanden locations to ensure product designs are consistent.
* Provide technical support to internal customers.
* Conduct technical feasibility study for new product configuration.
* Support project team(s).
* Other projects as assigned by management.
* Establish engineering report independently.
* Prepare technical data for presentation material for internal and external customers as needed.
* Responsible for awareness and compliance with company Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. Contributing to the effectiveness of the EHS policies and procedures by communicating and reporting unsafe conditions and/or non-compliances.

**Competencies:**

* The specific competencies and definitions required to do this job are listed on the Department Skills Matrix.

**Education:**

* Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering (BSME preferred)

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**

* 3+ years’ experience in automotive application design, compressor / system component (HVAC / HX / ITMS) development, FEA / CFD analysis knowledge, Vehicle & Compressor / System Testing knowledge / Skill, and HVAC / ITMS system knowledge.
* Working knowledge of current computer technology and applications such as CAD, CAE and MS Office applications.
* Good communication skills with internal customers.
* Knowledgeable of IATF-16949 and ISO-14001 procedures.
* Hands on with vehicle and test equipment.

**Licenses or Certifications:**

* EPA-608, EPA-609 are desired

**Physical Demands:**

* Routine lifting of 25 lb. loads (compressors) may be necessary
* Possible exposure to high noise levels
* Possible exposure to chemicals (oils, refrigerants, solvents).
* Exposure to environmental temperatures 30 - 110 degrees Fahrenheit
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and be able to prioritize workloads

**Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):**

* PPE may be required based on specific projects

**Work Environment/Hours:**

* Primary work area is in an office setting as well as lab environment.
* Must work normal office hours plus provide support on evenings and weekend (as needed)

**Primary Work Location:**

* Wylie, TX

**Travel Requirements:**

* 0 – 10% domestic
* 0 – 5% international to countries such as but not limited to Japan, Mexico

This position requires a strong technical understanding of mechanical systems, effective document control, and communication skills between internal teams, subcontractors, and clients.

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

**Where is the work:**
On-Site (5 days)

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Director of R&D of Trane Technologies, this role will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of thermal and cooling system development processes, from concept and testing to execution and maintenance of data centers. The successful individual will perform thermal analysis, test processes, monitor system performances and identify areas that can be improved for greater efficiency. The individual will learn about a variety of new technologies which can shape the data center industry for decades to come.

We are looking for a driven Senior Thermal Engineer that is passionate about this profession and wants to be a team leader on one of the world’s global leaders in liquid cooling solutions and services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Conduct conceptual designs of thermal solutions for data centers, specifically with water cooling.
* Collaborates with other engineers, vendors, partners to plan, design, and build test fixtures and prototypes.
* Designs and creates documentation such as PI&D.
* Designs testing procedures and controls equipment to accurately assess products and identify areas for modification.
* Conduct 1D Flow-Network-Modeling and 3D CFD simulations on heat transfer, energy balance, pressure drop and fluid dynamics for CDUs and cooling loops in data centers. Perform model verification tasks to ensure prediction accuracy.
* Responsible for subsystem-level and system-level thermal performance evaluations and optimizations.

Works with the engineering team and external consultants on manufacturing designs for data centers.

SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

* Master or PHD degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or related discipline.
* 5 plus years of experience with designing and calculating HVAC systems in industrial buildings and/or data centers.
* HVAC / Air Conditioning / Refrigeration certificate is considered an asset.
* Lead all the thermal performance, evaluation and testing.
* Understands thermal cycles including adiabatic process, isothermal process, evaporative cooling cycle and dehumidification cycle.
* Ability to perform air flow, thermal flow, and temperature calculations.
* Proficient with AUTOCAD 2D / 3D, SolidWorks and/or similar software.
* Experience with pressure drop simulation, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and thermal analysis software is required.
* Strong knowledge in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Attention to detail with the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Must have strong planning, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Able to prioritize competing tasks and keeping to critical deadlines.
* Self-starter that can be hands-on and able to work independently.
* Multicultural approach, comfortable working with diverse cultures and mind-sets.
* Appreciation to work in a global organization with teammates in different time zones/regions.
* Excellent English communication (verbal & written).

Conversational in Cantonese and/or Mandarin an asset.

About LiquidStack & the Team

LiquidStack is the established leader in liquid cooling for data center, HPC, and AI workloads, with manufacturing, R&D, and headquarters in Carrollton, Texas and a longstanding engineering presence in Hong Kong. As part of Trane Technologies, we are scaling our US-based engineering capability to augment our Hong Kong team. The new Texas engineering team will focus on the design, development, and delivery of large Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) and skidded direct-to-chip platforms — including our GigaModular™ CDU family — for hyperscale, colocation, and AI infrastructure customers. The team will own manufacturability, ETL / CSA / CE / NRTL compliance, and customer-facing engineering for these product families, working in close collaboration with the Hong Kong team on shared architecture and component engineering. The Mechanical Design team owns the physical architecture of CDU skids and enclosures — including the GigaModular™ platform — covering frame design, piping layout, component packaging, and design for manufacturability.

**Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range:**
$91,516.66 - $128,379.99

*

Description:

American Innovations helps customers keep their field operations running — our technology and support teams are the front line for the people who rely on our products and services every day. We're looking for people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and enjoy solving problems for others.

As Senior Mechanical Engineer, you'll be the mechanical owner of how our Bullhorn RMUs, MicroMax interrupters, and DVM instruments look, mount, seal, and last in the field. This is a senior individual-contributor role: you'll own new-product mechanical architecture and approve production tooling end-to-end, without a second mechanical engineer in the review. A cracked or leaking housing, a unit that won't fit a rectifier cabinet, or a battery door that fails outdoors is a gap in this role — so you'll balance industrial design, field installability, and long-term reliability so a customer's first physical impression of our hardware matches its quality.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Own mechanical architecture for next-generation IoT hardware across our Bullhorn rectifier RMUs, test-point/AC coupon RMUs, MicroMax interrupters, and field instruments (DVM)
* Design plastic housings, covers, adapters, battery compartments, antenna windows, and user-facing features that protect electronics in outdoor, rectifier-cabinet, and right-of-way environments (UV, dust, rain, heat, vibration, surge-adjacent installs)
* Create 3D concepts and production-intent models that package PCAs, cellular/satellite radios, GPS, batteries, shunts, relays, and connectors into compact, installable products, including pole/test-station mounts and in-rectifier installs
* Produce complete mechanical design records — CAD models, production prints, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, BOMs, and revision control — for new products and sustaining changes
* Lead design-for-injection-molding: draft, wall thickness, ribs/bosses, knit lines, gate/ejector strategy, inserts, seals/gaskets, and snap/latch features for industrial, outdoor-rated housings
* Drive tooling from DFM through first-article approval: review mold designs with toolmakers, close dimensional and cosmetic issues, and release production-capable tools as the final mechanical approver on new-product tooling
* Partner with Purchasing, contract manufacturers, and molders to hit cost, lead time, and quality targets, feeding DFM input in early so new products are manufacturable at scale
* Plan and execute mechanical verification and validation for harsh-environment IoT hardware: thermal, humidity, UV, ingress, shock/vibration, drop/abuse, and HALT as needed, including fit/function with PCA, antenna, and battery systems
* Design for measurement integrity and safety — surge-hardened installs, connector strain relief, creepage/clearance keep-outs, and service access that doesn't compromise the seal
* Support UL/TUV/FCC/safety documentation with mechanical evidence: materials, ratings, labels, and enclosure drawings
* Translate field and Technical Support feedback — install pain points, water ingress, cracked housings, battery door issues — into durable design changes, not one-off fixes
* Act as technical owner for new-product mechanical design: review and approve CAD, prints, test plans, and production Zeadiness
* Integrate closely with Electrical, Firmware, Product Management, Operations, and Purchasing so PCA outline, RF keep-outs, thermal paths, and assembly sequence are locked before tooling is cut
* Contribute mechanical deliverables — design records, DFMEA input, prototype plans, and phase-exit evidence — to formal new-product development gates
* Maintain mechanical BOMs, part numbers, and configuration under change control, coordinating with Operations so builds and production transfer aren't blocked by missing prints or tooling
* Use CAD automation, AI-assisted DFM and drawing checks, and reusable design libraries to speed up new-product mechanical work, while retaining ownership of stack-up, material selection, and tooling decisions
* Use simulation (FEA, mold-flow, thermal) to reduce prototype cycles, without substituting analysis for physical ingress, UV, and abuse testing

**What We Can Offer You:**

* Competitive Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
* Company Provided Life and Disability Insurance
* Paid Family Leave
* Matching 401k
* Supportive and collaborative work environment
* A rewarding culture with a focus on positive business practices and protecting the environment

Requirements:

**What You'll Need to Succeed:**

* A bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with 7+ years taking electronics-containing products from concept through production tooling
* Demonstrated mastery of plastic injection-molded enclosure design for outdoor or industrial electronics — draft, tooling, seals/gaskets, UV-stable resins — backed by a portfolio of shipped parts, not only prototypes
* Hands-on CAD experience (SolidWorks or equivalent) producing production drawings, GD&T

description:
The Manufacturing Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, direction and support to operations in the areas of process development, equipment optimization, tooling, plant layout, continuous improvement and automation. The Manufacturing Engineer supports production teams to ensure high standards for performance, quality, reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness, and also works collaboratively with Product Engineering in the design and development of both legacy and new products.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Functional**

* Establish and maintain optimum production methods, tooling and equipment to support efficient and reliable manufacturing.
+ Design, evaluate, and implement assembly fixtures, holding jigs, and specialized plant floor tooling using 3D CAD to improve repeatability and reduce operator fatigue.
* Demonstrate full “process ownership” for assigned areas including:
+ Technical documentation and on-floor support to meet safety, quality, productivity standards.
+ Equipment setup, operation and basic troubleshooting.
+ Monitoring and improving process performance using data analysis tools.
* Maintain and analyze process data to ensure process control.
* Lead and participate in special projects focused on improving process capability, reducing costs and improving equipment, with full accountability for project results.
* Apply structured problem-solving techniques to investigate process issues and implement sustainable corrective actions, integrating and streamlining processes throughout the supply chain to ensure maximum efficiency.
* Work with cross-functional teams including Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, and Operations to align manufacturing objectives.
* Support facility layout and equipment installation planning to improve material flow and optimize space utilization.

**Leadership**

* Take accountability for project execution, results, and impact to business goals.
* Demonstrate a sense of urgency in addressing operational needs and continuously driving improvements.
* Set clear goals and work proactively to overcome obstacles and ensure timely completion of assignments.

**Interpersonal**

* Promote collaboration and teamwork across departments to leverage knowledge, improve processes, and achieve common goals.
* Support a positive working environment by engaging with others respectfully and constructively.
* Work closely with team members and support staff to gain insight into process conditions and improvements.

**Business**

* Understand key business and financial metrics that impact manufacturing performance.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives by identifying opportunities for efficiency, quality, and cost improvements to meet the needs and requirements of customers or business partners in order to bring strategic value to them.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable government and regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, safety, environmental).

**EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

B.S. degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience may be considered.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

2 to 4 years experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering environment, preferably in electrical assembly or mechanical systems and test environment with knowledge of the manufacturing processes and process improvement techniques.

Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as be proficient in Microsoft applications. Additional required qualifications include:

* CAD software proficiency (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD).
* Experience with manufacturing process simulation and layout design.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and process improvement methodologies.
* Hands-on involvement with tooling, fixturing, and production equipment design.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**:

* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and move throughout an active manufacturing floor for extended periods (up to 75% of the shift).
* Ability to occasionally lift and manipulate up to 50 lbs with assistance.
* Ability to wear mandatory plant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) including safety glasses with side shields, steel-toe footwear, and hearing protection where required.

**Essential Functions of Position:**

* Provide technical support in the form of design calculations and adherence to project specifications, codes, and standards.
* Create and revise CAD drawings, and 3D models for project approval and in-house fabrication.
* Work with the project manager to maintain, document, and communicate project schedules.
* Communicate daily with internal and external customers.
* Create Bill of Materials
* Collaborate with multi-disciplinary engineering teams and work with vendors and contractors.
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation to track project development and design process.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* CAD and Inventor experience
* Associates degree in relevant field with related work experience.
* Knowledge of how mechanical systems and processes work.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills
* Excellence in verbal and written communication and ability to work as part of a team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelors in mechanical engineering
* 3-5 years in a manufacturing environment completing Engineering design work
* 3-5 years working in Inventor or SolidWorks
* Previous Epicor (ERP) Experience

* Required to sit, stand, and walk; for up to 8 hours per day.

* Ability to lift up to 20 pounds occasionally.
* Ability to communicate professionally, in written and oral communications.

**Mechanical Engineer**

At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

**About Us:**

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

**Job Summary:**

The **Mechanical Engineer/Designer** serves to design HVAC systems for buildings such as K-12 schools, retail/mixed-use spaces, and commercial spaces

**In this role, you will:**

* Design Heating, Ventilating & Air Conditioning Systems for various types of facilities
* Produce mechanical design drawings in AutoCAD and/or Revit software
* Perform field investigations
* Coordinate quality control, scheduling, and programming
* Coordinate and communicate information and progress with all three disciplines (mechanical, electrical and plumbing)

**You will be a great fit if:**

* You have demonstrated facilitation experience
* You have 2 to 5 years of experience in HVAC design and construction
* You have a solid understanding of duct design, piping design, air handlers, chiller, and boiler systems
* You have experience with performing load calculations, equipment selection and design, wet and dry side system design
* You have knowledge of CBC, CMC and CPC codes, DDC controls, Title 24, HAP or Energy Pro

**Skills/abilities:**

* Must have strong verbal and written communications skills in design and specifications

**Location**: Austin, TX
**Travel**: Less than 10%

description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

As a Product Engineer, you thrive in high-stakes, dynamic environment, driving product development at the forefront of the semiconductor equipment industry. Collaborating closely with customers and internal teams, you will provide real-time problem-solving to customer challenges and to enhance our products. Your passion for engaging with customers and innovative engineering drives progress in our industry, tackling the once unsolvable. You will be responsible for producing, implementing, and maintaining solutions as well as participating in troubleshooting and issue resolution working with field support teams. As an engineer, you will be in one of the fastest-growing businesses at Lam Research. Our products are scaling rapidly, and this is the team with the most to gain. This is a unique role in the company where the engineer will gain detailed knowledge on several cutting edge etch and dep hardware that Lam manufactures.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Manage timelines, priorities, milestones, and project logistics for WCO service products and customer deliverables.
* Perform technical scoping for new maintenance procedures and customer change requests.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts, field engineers, and product teams to clarify maintenance procedures and best practices when only sparse documentation is available.

Your Job

Molex is seeking a hands-on Mechanical Design Engineer to design, develop, build, and improve custom manufacturing equipment, tooling, and automation systems. This role will lead projects from concept through commissioning, including mechanical design, fabrication oversight, assembly support, troubleshooting, validation, and continuous improvement of existing equipment.

The ideal candidate has strong machine-building experience and is comfortable working in a manufacturing environment where practical problem-solving, equipment reliability, safety, and innovation are critical. This engineer will collaborate closely with Controls Engineers, Process Engineers, Maintenance, Production, Quality, and external vendors to deliver reliable and cost-effective equipment solutions.

Our Team

Molex leverages technology and innovation to provide advanced electronic solutions across the globe. With operations in over 40 countries, we serve a variety of industries including automotive, medical, data communications, and consumer electronics.

What you will do

* Design custom manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, guarding, and automation systems using 3D CAD software.
* Develop machine concepts, layouts, assemblies, detailed drawings, and bills of materials.
* Perform engineering calculations related to machine structures, mechanisms, motion systems, pneumatics, and power transmission.
* Evaluate design alternatives based on safety, performance, reliability, manufacturability, maintainability, cost, and schedule.
* Lead equipment projects from concept through fabrication, assembly, debugging, qualification, and production release.
* Work directly with internal resources, fabrication shops, machine builders, and suppliers to ensure equipment is built according to design requirements.
* Provide hands-on support during machine assembly, installation, setup, troubleshooting, and startup.
* Create and maintain equipment documentation, including drawings, bills of materials, spare-parts lists, risk assessments, and recommended maintenance information.
* Partner with Controls Engineers to integrate PLCs, HMIs, sensors, safety circuits, servos, robotics, and vision systems into new and existing equipment.
* Ensure mechanical designs support controls architecture, electrical requirements, machine safety, accessibility, and future scalability.
* Participate in commissioning and debugging to resolve mechanical, controls-interface, and process-performance issues.
* Support continuous-improvement , cost-reduction, and obsolescence-mitigation initiatives.
* Manage multiple engineering projects while maintaining scope, schedule, budget, technical documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Coordinate design reviews, build activities, acceptance testing, training, and handoff to Operations and Maintenance.
* Communicate project risks, progress, decisions, and resource needs clearly to cross-functional teams and leadership.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

Five or more years of experience designing and building manufacturing equipment, automation machinery, or custom industrial systems.

Proficiency with Siemens NX, SolidWorks, or comparable 3D CAD software.

Working knowledge of machine design, pneumatics, bearings, linear motion, servo-driven mechanisms, gearboxes, and mechanical power transmission.

Experience producing detailed manufacturing drawings, tolerance parts, assemblies, and bills of materials.

Knowledge of GD&T, design-for-manufacturing, machine guarding, and mechanical design best practices.

Strong hands-on troubleshooting, equipment installation, and machine startup capability.

Ability to work effectively in office, shop, and production-floor environments.

What Will Put You Ahead

Experience designing automated assembly, inspection, material-handling, or process equipment.

Experience with robotics, machine vision, motion control, and industrial automation.

Familiarity with PLCs, HMIs, industrial sensors, and controls-system integration.

Knowledge of machining, sheet-metal fabrication, welding, plastics, and machine assembly processes.

Experience with DFMEA, equipment risk assessments, validation, and project management.

Experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment or with custom machine builders.

Familiarity with SAP or manufacturing systems

Lean Six Sigma certification or experience driving CI projects

The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. * USD $78,400.00/Yr.
* USD $117,600.00/Yr.
* 59644

International Motors, LLC

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Position Overview**

International Manufacturing Engineering has an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Project Engineer – Manufacturing Engineering** at our San Antonio Assembly Plant.

This position will report to the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and will lead the planning and execution of manufacturing projects across the San Antonio campus, including Body, Paint, and General Assembly. The Project Engineer will be responsible for delivering projects ranging from capital equipment installations and process improvements to customer requests, corporate directives, and special engineering assignments.

In this position, you will work directly with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Safety, R&D, Purchasing, Finance, IT, MES, suppliers, and contractors to define project requirements and develop solutions that meet business objectives. The position will be responsible for managing project scope, schedule, cost, risk, and implementation while ensuring projects are safely commissioned and transitioned into production.

The ideal candidate will be a self-directed, hands-on project leader with proven experience delivering multi-million-dollar capital projects in a manufacturing environment. This individual will be expected to independently take assignments from concept through implementation, establish project direction, develop technical solutions, and lead cross-functional teams, suppliers, contractors, and engineering resources to successful completion.

The role also requires strong technical expertise in industrial torque tooling and automated systems. Experience deploying, integrating, commissioning, troubleshooting, and supporting Atlas Copco torque tooling and controls is highly valued. The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly on the production floor and getting into the technical details when needed, while also communicating project status, risks, and recommendations effectively with plant and engineering leadership.

The candidate will be expected to respond to production line calls, troubleshoot equipment and process issues during downtime events, and work directly with operations and maintenance teams to restore production. This includes assembling, modifying, testing, fabricating, and validating engineering solutions on the plant floor. Candidates should be comfortable using hand tools, working around manufacturing equipment, building prototypes, proving out concepts, and getting directly involved in implementation when required.

This role requires an engineer who can move seamlessly between the strategic and technical aspects of project execution from developing the business case, SOW, and project plan through equipment procurement, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and production handoff.

**San Antonio Manufacturing runs a 4x10 production schedule (Mon-Thurs, 5:30AM - 4:00PM).**

This role requires flexibility to support production and project activities outside of normal working hours, including evenings and weekends, particularly during equipment installations, commissioning, production launches, and other critical project activities.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead manufacturing engineering projects across the San Antonio campus, including Body, Paint, and General Assembly
* Lead multi-million-dollar capital projects from initial concept and business case through design, procurement, installation, commissioning, and production handoff
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, resources, and deliverables to ensure successful project execution
* Develop and contribute to internal Statements of Work (SOWs), equipment specifications, project plans, and capital requests
* Coordinate with internal engineering resources, contractors, suppliers, and equipment integrators throughout project execution
* Develop project concepts and evaluate alternative solutions based on safety, quality, capacity, cost, ergonomics, maintainability, and production requirements
* Serve as the technical project lead for manufacturing equipment, tooling, automation, and process-related projects
* Provide hands-on technical support during equipment installation, startup, commissioning, troubleshooting, and production launch
* Lead project readiness activities and ensure equipment and processes meet defined performance metrics prior to production handoff
* Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Safety, R&D, and other functional organizations to identify requirements and resolve project issues
* Respond to assignment directives, customer requests

**Company:** Corning

Requisition Number: 78514

**The company built on breakthroughs.**
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

At Corning, we strive to be the best — delivering innovative fiber optics, connectors and hardware solutions to high tech industries. Our people and our culture are the foundation for our success. In product development, you will join a collaborative, high performing team where technical excellence, analytical leadership, and continuous learning are celebrated. Every day, you will be empowered to own your work, drive breakthrough solutions, and help shape the future. We invest in our people, providing the resources, trust, and support needed to grow, learn, and make an impact.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Conceptualize innovative mechanical design solutions for new product development. Show deep understanding and technical evaluation behind the proposed solutions.
* Create mechanical designs of plastic injection molded and sheet metal components to meet a set of functional requirements.
* Provide high-level and detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings suitable for:
+ Concept presentation to customers.
+ Analytical evaluation (modeling).
+ Patent applications.
+ Technical reports or publications.
+ Cost or manufacturability analysis.

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Research externally published fundamentals, new designs (competitor products and patents), and manufacturing processes.
* Lead the projects from a technical standpoint – representing the design engineering perspective – which may include delegating tasks to other technical resources like CAD design, prototyping labs, and testing & qualification labs
* Ability to act as project lead in the aspects of defining project plan, budget, schedule, team, and completing reviews and documentation from kick-off to product release.
* Mentor junior engineers in best practices of engineering, product development, as well as Corning processes.
* Collaborate with project team members from multiple technical disciplines located in various domestic and global locations to translate design concepts into detailed designs that can be prototyped and manufactured.
* Work remotely with Manufacturing personnel to release new products at full-scale production.
* Provide documentation to communicate findings in technical reports, protect intellectual property in patent applications, order rapid prototypes, and/or support customer presentations and demonstrations.

**Experiences/Education - Required**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor of Science in Engineering. Major in Mechanical preferred. Electro-Mechanics, Mechatronics or Optical will be considered.

Work Experience.

* 4-7 years of Industry Related Experience (Product, Design, New Product Introduction).

• Product Development and/or NPI experience required.

• Experience designing injection molded and/or sheet metal parts highly desirable.

• Design of experiments experience is desirable.

• Demonstrated ability to understand and solve challenging technical problems.

• Demonstrated ability to take ownership and guide peers towards project goals.

• Sound understanding of material properties, manufacturing capabilities, and their application in product design.

Travel: 10% (Domestic and International)

Competencies

* Strength in the ability to generate, compile, and compare concepts and apply appropriate engineering analysis to validate them.

**Role Description**: Entry Level Purchasing Assistant

**Company Background**

Denier Electric is a family-owned business with a rich history that goes back over 8 decades. The business started as a small electrical contractor business in 1942 and has grown into a multi-division business capable of meeting the needs of just about any construction project. We are a regional leader amongst our peers specializing in commercial, mission critical, multi-family housing, healthcare, institutional and specialty electrical projects.

Denier is seeking eager, hardworking individuals to join our team. If you have a dedicated work ethic and enjoy working in a safety-focused, productive team environment this job is for you.

**Opportunity**

Denier is looking to expand our Purchasing team with an entry level Purchasing Agent. Experience in the electrical distribution or contracting business is preferred but not required.

**Job Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Solicit quotes for product/material needed
* Issue and process purchase orders for product/material
* Data entry, monitoring, and tracking of purchase orders, including back orders
* Inspect product/material in the warehouse
* Infrequent light warehouse duties
* Basic computer skills using Microsoft Word and Excel

**Skills**

* Ability to work well with others in a team oriented environment
* Self-motivated with a willingness to learn
* Punctual

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Pay
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401K with a Company match
* A fully paid medical plan.
* Dental and vision insurance available
* Provided Short-Term Disability
* Long-Term Disability available
* Provided Basic Life Insurance
* Supplemental Life Insurance available

Visit our website at www.denier.com to learn more about us and email your resume to our Human Resources Department at HR@denier.com.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
