description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The ideal assistant buyer is analytical, results-oriented and views the business through the lens of the customer.

**A day in the life…**

* Develop an understanding of the needs, wants and expectations of the customer
* Build an understanding of the market and competitors in their category
* Establish a clear understanding of the seasonal department merchandise strategy
* Partner with assistant buy planner on market preparation
* Contribute to negotiations of exclusive offerings, terms, pricing, vendor funded markdowns, return-to-vendor agreements, drop-ship programs, co-op, etc.
* Function as liaison to online and/or stores as assigned; including effective communication of the selling agenda
* Contribute to inventory management in season; including driving markdowns and exit strategy
* Be a student of the business regarding effective analysis and decision making to improve department performance
* Collaborate with, and respond with a sense of urgency to regional merchandisers regarding customer needs
* Partner with assistant buy planner to improve the depth and precision of location-level inventory content
* Participate in business reviews to develop greater understanding of how specific actions impact overall department results

**You own this if you have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Merchandising or equivalent work experience
* Experience in retail merchandising, planning or analysis required
* Experience supporting a high sales volume category (high SKU count, heavy seasonality, high revenue ($20M+) preferred
* Experience in a relevant merchandise category preferred
* Demonstrated understanding of retail and the service environment of Nordstrom required
* Proficiency in MS Office suite required
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication and strong interpersonal skills required

**Pay Range Details**

The pay range(s) below has been provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may be different for other locations.
Pay offers are dependent on the location, as well as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

$80,000.00 - $132,000.00 Annual

**We’ve got you covered…**

Our employees are our most important asset and that’s reflected in our benefits. Nordstrom is proud to offer a variety of benefits to support employees and their families, including:

* Medical/Vision, Dental, Retirement and Paid Time Away
* Life Insurance and Disability

description:
**General Summary**

Claire’s is being remade as a modern playground for girlhood, designed for Gen Alpha girls across the U.S. and Canada. While so many brands are trying to pull her toward what’s next, Claire’s is built around who she is right now—a place where she can explore, make choices, and build confidence. Claire’s has pierced more than 131 million customers, and for many girls, it is the first store where they spend their own money on something they chose for themselves. Our strategy is to build the products, experiences, and stores around those choices, giving her reasons to come back at every stage of girlhood. That work is happening now across piercing and jewelry, beauty, accessories, and toys. The Assistant Buyer is involved from the very beginning. You’ll follow product from first sample to store, sit in the room where the assortment is shaped, and look at the weekly data to understand what she picked up, what she passed on, and why. Your decisions reach 900 stores and you can walk into one and see your work come to life on the sales floor. In your first year, success means becoming the person in the room who knows your product area better than anyone else and turns weekly reads into actions the team can use. From there, your ownership grows—from the size of the business you manage to the decisions you make independently. Every merchant is reviewed twice a year on performance and potential, with development plans tied directly to what’s required for the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze and report on your area weekly and provide tactical in season trading actions to drive the business forward.
Build expertise in the customer and the competition for the assigned department, including other retailers' assortments, pricing and promotions against Claire's, and report back findings, white space opportunities and actions.
Track assigned tests cleanly: matched doors, matched weeks, and per-department reads, so scale, extend or exit decisions rest on actuals.
Use retail math to analyze the department weekly, monthly and seasonally, provide accurate investment inputs, and explain item level sales, margin and inventory variances, escalating errors and emerging risks.
Create and maintain style boards and line sheets with the product detail cross-functional partners need.
Manage the sample process: sort styles by category and season, track every sample against requirements, and communicate product changes before shipment.
Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Planning, Allocation, Marketing and In Store Presentation to learn the seasonal buying process.
Support the Buyer and the merchandising team on day-to-day functions for the assigned departments.
Own administrative deliverables: meeting reports and recaps, purchase orders, submits, sample tracking and seasonal buy recaps, keeping the critical path on time and the information accurate.
Manage email correspondence efficiently, escalate concerns to the merchandising team, and meet deadlines without a reminder.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in fashion merchandising, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Experience in retail or merchandise buying preferred
Curiosity about the customer we serve and what she is choosing right now
Comfort with numbers, including retail math, and the instinct to ask what a number means rather than only report it
Organized enough to hold a critical path on time without being chased
Clear written and verbal communication, including with partners outside merchandising
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint)

Claire’s is committed to adhering to all applicable company policies and federal, state, and local laws and regulations. All positions will be compensated at or above the legally mandated minimum wage for the location in which work is performed. The final compensation will be determined by various factors such as relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

Benefits for full-time employees included medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary welfare plans, bonus plan eligibility, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave.

Benefits for part-time employees included voluntary welfare plans, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave in required states.

* Sick Time: For the State of Washington, all employees will accrue paid sick time at the rate of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked.

Claire's is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and we encourage applications from members of all underrepresented groups, including those with disabilities. We will accommodate applicants' needs, upon request, throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Please inform us of the accommodation(s) that you may require.

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confide

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position provides administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Purchasing Department. The role coordinates daily office activities, maintains documentation and contract files, supports contract intake and routing, and ensures clear, timely communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors. As a backup Buyer, the position assists with purchasing tasks, including preparing requisitions and purchase orders, obtaining quotes per policy thresholds, following up with suppliers, and ensuring adherence to County procurement procedures and audit requirements.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Essential Functions***

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not necessarily limited to:

* Provide comprehensive administrative support, including scheduling, recordkeeping, mail processing, document preparation, and filing to ensure smooth department operations.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical files, and manage department logs, trackers, and routine reports.
* Assist with contract intake, tracking, routing for review and approval, and maintain complete and accurate contract files.
* Monitor workflow milestones and provide timely status updates to staff and stakeholders.

We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page!

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

The primary responsibility of the Assistant Buyer is to assist their Buyer on all aspects of the job or step in as needed to help with Merchandise Coordinator/Detail Assistant duties. They are responsible for sourcing and developing product, pricing product, determining assortment groups, forecasting order quantities, and participating in competitive shops. Weekly reporting and departmental reports.

**Product Development**

* Develop understanding/knowledge base of the Jewelry Category
* Work with the Buyer to learn the elements of merchandising as it applies to their position.
* Overall understanding and maintenance of their merchandise category, in conjunction with the Buyer
* Identify sales trends, develop new product designs for testing and assortment opportunities
* Attend vendor meetings and actively participate in selection and review of product. Be the point person for meeting notes and follow-up.
* Instrumental in determining various marketing vehicles, SKU selection, new merchandise programs, sales trends, and assortments which lead to sales growth and overall productivity in their area.
* Be jointly accountable for the success of their specific merchandise category with regards to sales, inventory levels & gross margin goals, which are established by Management.
* Participate in on-going Competitive Shopping from an omni-channel lens. Review our assortments as well as competitor to ascertain opportunities and advantages.
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

**Assortment / Inventory Management**

* Setup sku’s, descriptions, retails and packaging attributes.
* Assist Buyer with Assortment Development - Work with Planners and Inventory Analysts to set program parameters (i.e. product attributes, assortment size, targeted inventory and turn levels, open-to-buy requirements)
* Monitor and help develop forecasted sales quantities for marketing items and new programs in conjunction with the Inventory Analyst and Buyer
* Communicate and manage with vendors re: product qualities, costs, terms/ownership, delivery dates, return of merchandise requests.
* Establish retail prices in line with margin requirements
* Responsible for updating departmental category assortment sheets, reporting, and analysis

**Collaboration**

* Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including catalogs, emails, web site, customer mailings, and in store signage.
* Merchandise items for all marketing channels, which are innovative and competitive within the marketplace.
* Attend open-to-buy meetings and provide merchandise status updates as needed
* Complete and submit Project Request Forms and develop store communications.
* Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

**Office Assistant**

Citrus Hills Construction is a leading construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality new home construction projects. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Office Assistant to join our Purchasing Department and play a pivotal role in aligning our finding top-tier subcontractors who align with our commitment to excellence.

**Responsibilities:** The right candidate will support the purchasing department with a variety of clerical tasks. As the Office Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Maintain vendor packets and qualifications
* Requests for pricing, load price changes
* Revising/updating feature lists
* Updating project vendor lists
* Organizing and scheduling new vendor appointments
* Pricing and distributing design changes
* Keeping all plans updated and in stock
* New project product binders
* Keep the office organized
* Coordinate all paperwork for vendors
* Process purchase orders, change orders, and notices to proceed
* Create and maintain contract files
* Research invoice or purchase order issues as needed
* Prepare bid packages
* Managing all documentation and communication related to subcontractor selection, contracts, and project coordination.
* Maintain a clear and open line of communication with project managers, general contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Playing a key role in promoting the company's commitment to quality, safety, and on-time project delivery.

**Qualifications:** To be successful in this role, you should possess:

* Previous experience in purchasing or procurement within the construction industry.
* Strong knowledge of subcontractor sourcing and selection processes.
* Effective Time Management Skills
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Organization and documentation management.
* The ability to build and maintain professional relationships with subcontractors.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* Attention to detail and a results-driven approach.

**Education:** High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or six months to one year of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* Scheduling & Calendar Management: 1 year (Required)
* Independent Follow-Through & Problem Solving: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

**Job Description**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Data & Buying Assistant to support our Buying and Operations teams.

This role is responsible for maintaining accurate product and supplier information, assisting with purchase order management, monitoring stock availability, and ensuring product data is updated across internal systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with spreadsheets, handling repetitive tasks with accuracy, communicating with suppliers, and supporting fast-paced day-to-day operations.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Maintain and update product data, including pricing, street dates, supplier information, and inventory details.
* Import and manage new release and product information within internal systems.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure active products are correctly set up and maintained.
* Review and maintain weekly supplier stock feeds and availability updates.
* Assist Buyers by requesting and organizing supplier availability information.
* Close purchase orders and request open order reports from suppliers.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding inbound deliveries, delays, shortages, damages, and missing information.
* Provide updates to Warehouse and Buying teams regarding shipments and product availability.
* Adjust supplier assignments to improve stock availability and pricing when needed.
* Assist with rebate credit requests, shortage claims, and damage claims.
* Support general administrative and operational tasks for the Buying department.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Comfortable performing repetitive data-related tasks efficiently.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Willingness to learn and receive training.

Pay: From $17.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
**Description**

**Salaried Non Exempt**
**Position Title:** Purchasing Assistant Warehouse 12 hour Rotating from 6am to 6pm
**Department:** Purchasing Department

**Location:** Plainwell Plant

**Purchasing Assistant**—Serves under Purchasing Supervisor

The primary responsibilities of the Purchasing Assistant are turning purchase orders from released requisitions, confirm pricing and delivery dates on purchase orders with vendors, build relationships with vendors and assisting the Purchasing Supervisor with their duties.
**Responsibilities:**
Responsible for all aspects of the purchase order cycle to include:

* Checking requisitions for accurate information and internal releases.
* Acquiring pricing and delivery date confirmation from vendors.
* Contacting vendors when deliveries are late or incomplete. Will require coordination with Packaging and Stock Room Departments.
* Assisting vendors with any questions or problems they may have in regards to purchase orders
* Working with accounting to ensure that purchase orders have been received and invoices posted.
* Working with Accounts Payable to check payment status/problems for vendor invoices.
* All other duties as assigned by Purchasing Manager or Controller

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**
The Knowledge of overseeing all functions involved in incoming receiving inspection and accurately processing the inventory changes to Maintenance Parts, Operating Supplies, Ingredients, and Packaging supplies. This person will work closely with other departments within the Plainwell Complex to insure materials are received to the correct department and personnel.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Finding parts and materials in the computer data base for maintenance and other departments.
* + Checking on hand computer balances.
+ Finding locations and warehouses where parts are stored.
+ Researching Order histories including the following:
+ - On order quantities
- Requisitions and details including for whom the materials were ordered.
- Receiving histories.
- Issue histories.
- Return and repair histories.

* Two to five years purchasing/procurement experience.
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Good math skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Computer skills to include Microsoft Office Suite Programs (Outlook, Word, Excel and some knowledge of Access).
* SAP experience preferred
* Minimum one-year experience in procurement, inventory control, asset management, or incoming inspection and receiving.

**EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**:

High School Diploma/GED; College Degree in business related preferred

**EOE/INCLUDING DISABILITY/VETS**

Job Department/School **Biology**

FT/PT/Temp **Part time**

Location **Garden City, N.Y.**

**Biology**

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Administrative Assistant will handle procurement for largest department in the College of Arts and Sciences. Responsible for all ordering and balancing of the departmental budget. This is a part time, 25 hours a week position.

Pre-employment assessments on Microsoft Word and Excel will be conducted. Our union positions have excellent benefits including tuition remission for the employee, spouse and dependent children.

**SALARY INFORMATION:**

In compliance with New York’s Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary for this union position is $32,214. For a list of benefits provided to employees, please click here.

**REPORTS TO:** Department Chair

**RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES:**

* The pricing, ordering, and receiving of all supplies, equipment and other purchases for the Biology department. Includes receiving and distributing live animals such as mice and insects, and hazardous chemicals, as well as personal dealings with outside vendors and other departments.
* Maintenance and updating of all purchasing records.
* Monitor expenditures and budgets. Provide the Chair with detailed, itemized monthly reports on budget-line specific expenditures.
* Upon notification, calling and coordinating all services and repair calls and the processing of service contracts.
* Maintaining updated, detailed lists of all departmental equipment.
* Coordinating travel, lodging, and entertainment arrangements for the new faculty candidates and guest speakers.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS: (Knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Very good computer skills. The use of Adelphi administrative systems (e.g. eProcurement), Google Drive, Google Documents, Google Spreadsheets, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft Excel. Must pass Excel test given by Human Resources.
* Ability to prioritize workload according to volume, urgency, etc.
* Good organization skills and attention to detail.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively and accurately.
* Ability to be discrete and maintain high confidentiality on a wide range of issues.
* Good verbal and writing skills.
* Knowledge of University policies and procedures.
* Ability to work with students and colleagues in a diverse environment.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to sit at a desk for long periods of time.
* Ability to work on a computer for long periods of time.
* Ability to open drawers and file paperwork.

**EDUCATIONAL/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree is strongly preferred.
* Minimum of two years of administrative/clerical experience is required.

**HOURS:**

* Monday – Friday, 10am to 3pm, in office.

**ABOUT ADELPHI:**

Adelphi University, New York, is a highly awarded, nationally ranked, powerfully connected doctoral research university dedicated to transforming students’ lives through small classes with world-class faculty, hands-on learning and innovative ways to support academic and career success. Adelphi offers exceptional liberal arts and sciences programs and professional training, with particular strength in our Core Four—Arts and Humanities, STEM and Social Sciences, the Business and Education Professions, and Health and Wellness. Recognized as a Best College by U.S. News & World Report, Adelphi is Long Island’s oldest private coeducational university, serving more than 7,250 students at its beautiful main campus in Garden City, at learning hubs in Manhattan, the Hudson Valley and Suffolk County, and online. The University offers students 79 undergraduate programs, more than 84 master’s degree and doctoral programs, and 63 certificate programs in the liberal arts, the sciences and professional training. With powerful partnerships throughout the New York area, more than 119,000 graduates across the country, a growing enrollment of students from 43 states and 72 countries, and rising rankings from top publications and organizations, Adelphi is a dynamic community that plays a leadership role on Long Island and in the region.

* Maintains a supply chain that minimizes inventory while maintaining product availability.
* Maintains adequate inventories of purchased and manufactured material to satisfy the company.
* Collaborates with internal departments, receiving, and accounting on a regular basis.
* Contributes to process improvement within LogistiQ with strategic alignment with the overall business plan and focus of the company.

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Assistant Buyer, International, supports the International Buying team in executing and managing merchandising strategies across select international markets and brands. Reporting to the Buyer, this role is responsible for analyzing business performance, inventory trends, consumer behavior, and market data to inform assortment, pricing, and product decisions.
The ideal candidate is genuinely curious about all aspects of the merchandising process — from inventory planning and buying to product analysis and assortment development. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented individual with a passion for retail, consumer behavior, and data analysis.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

**Buying & Merchandising Strategy**

* Support the Buyer in developing and executing seasonal assortment strategies and merchandising plans for assigned international markets and brands
* Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, inventory levels, product performance, and Open-to-Buy (OTB) to identify opportunities and risks, and recommend actions to the Buyer
* Evaluate assortment performance and provide recommendations on product selection, depth, market allocation, replenishment, and inventory positioning
* Prepare for and participate in product meetings and assortment reviews (Style Out)
* Maintain assortment planning tools and business processes that support buying and merchandising decisions
* Recommend pricing adjustments, including markdowns, for stores and e-commerce based on market conditions, product performance, and inventory levels
* Work on ad hoc business analyses and special projects aligned with strategic merchandising objectives

**Business Analysis, Reporting & Communication**

* Compile, review, and interpret weekly and seasonal sales and inventory reports to identify trends, opportunities, and key performance indicators
* Prepare clear business analyses and presentations that summarize findings, highlight risks and opportunities, and support decision-making
* Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards used by the Buying team
* Prepare materials and provide support for business reviews, key initiatives, collaborations, and internal meetings
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, Allocation, Product, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, and other teams; contribute relevant analysis and recommendations in cross-functional discussion
* Partner with international and franchise partners to gather business information, understand market needs, and support execution of approved merchandising strategies

**Order Management, Systems & Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with the execution of purchase orders based on approved assortment and buying strategies, including style setup, product classification, and maintenance of accurate product data
* Generate, maintain, and monitor purchase orders from creation through delivery, flagging potential delays, discrepancies, or inventory risks
* Maintain organized and accurate records related to purchase orders, assortment decisions, business analyses, and key communications
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, workflows, and business practices within the Buying function
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned
* Stay current on retail industry trends, consumer behavior, competitive activity, and international market dynamics relevant to assigned brands and markets

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

* Ability to analyze information, identify trends and opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work with minimal supervision
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication, collaboration, and follow-through skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and international business partners

REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Buying & Merchandising, Retail Management, or a related field preferred
* 2+ years of relevant experience in buying, merchandising, or fashion retail
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid understanding of retail math

The pay range for this role is $72,000-$79,000/yr USD.

---------------

Under the direction of the assigned manager, perform complex analytical duties and leadership for the District related to procurement contracts, shipping, receiving, warehouse, disposal of surplus property, mailroom, inventory of fixed assets, records retention program and minority vendor program; Prepare specifications for both informal and formal bidding including all construction projects; assist with assigned risk/ liability programs and various supplies and services for the District; and assure compliance with legal codes, laws, and District policies.

**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:**

This is a management level class allocated only to the Department of Procurement, Risk Management, and Auxiliary Services. The Assistant Director is responsible for performing complex analytical work and supervising direct reports in the areas of procurement contracts, shipping, receiving, warehouse, disposal of surplus property, mailroom, inventory of fixed assets, records retention program and minority vendor program.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Assist with the development and preparation of the annual budget for the procurement and contract services department; analyze and review budget and projections, financial data; controls and authorizes expenditures in accordance with established guidelines.
* Manage and oversee the day-to-day operational functions of the procurement and contract services department.
* Oversee the preparation and staging of surplus items for auction, ensure the auction website is effectively maintained and updated, monitor buyer inquiries and correspondence during the auction, and supervise the accurate recording and reconciliation of surplus items and payments.
* Oversee staff in the receipt and distribution of daily incoming mail, assign and track college mailboxes and combinations, and ensure the consistent availability of necessary supplies.
* Oversee campus-wide records retention processing including categorizing, warehousing and proper disposal of records in compliance with California Community College Education Code.
* Interview, assign, coordinate, supervise, train, and evaluate the work performance of staff.
* Lead staff in the review of agreements, contracts, memorandums of understanding and other related documents to determine risk and liability exposure, ensuring compliance with all applicable federal and states rules and regulations, California general statutes, uniform guidance, and California Community College Chancellors Office.
* Lead assigned staff to obtain quotes, reviews and processes purchase orders, to ensure compliance.
* Recommend standard contract clauses for use in agreements, contracts, and memorandums of understanding, solicitations and purchase orders to minimize risk and liability exposure to the District.
* Contribute and present solutions for development and implementation of process improvement, cost efficiencies, policies and procedures within procurement and contract services. Including initiatives for improvements of training of District staff.
* Provide District staff with professional and technical expertise and advice on compliantly procuring goods and services including, request for proposals, bid strategy development, supplier negotiations, and contract development.
* Collaborate in the preparation of specifications, formal and informal bids, proposals and quotations, to include review and analysis of bids received.
* May coordinate and conduct the formal bid process for construction projects as needed.
* Oversee the preparation of advertisement to selected vendors, and the awarding of Requests for Proposal for services, materials and equipment; and review and assemble scopes of work as needed.
* Develop and oversee procurement and contract services training, and electronic procurement systems.
* Assist, as needed, with the selection process of design professional services and construction firms.
* Co-develop fiscal year timelines for purchases; and ensure that purchases are processed, received, and paid by the end of each fiscal year.
* Meet with the supplier community and representatives of vendor companies to identify new sources for services and supplies to support District initiatives.
* Assist in the preparation of procurement and contract services reports required to be submitted to the Board of Trustees for approval.
* Establish, implement, and maintain procedures regarding storage of new and surplus equipment, mail services, supplies, records and reports related to the procurement and contract services area.
* Attend and conduct a variety of meetings as needed; participate on assigned committees; attend workshops, conferences and training sessions as assigned.
* Perform related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

description:
**Take Ownership of Your Career and Shape Your Future!**

Are you ready to become an Employee Owner? At Suburban Enterprises, you not only work for the company you own the company! The ideal candidate is happy where he/she is currently employed but is interested in a more self-directed work environment, increased responsibility, and the opportunity to grow into additional roles. We would like to hire someone interested in a career, not a job, who wants to do the work and be recognized for a job well done!

**The Role – Purchasing Assistant**

The Purchasing Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the Purchasing team by maintaining accurate purchasing records, monitoring orders, coordinating inventory transactions, resolving supplier and invoice issues. This role plays a key part in ensuring timely procurement, accurate inventory management, and effective communication between suppliers, purchasing, accounts payable, and internal stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

* Enter and maintain accurate order, purchasing, and inventory data in company systems.
* Process order acknowledgements and review to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Process inventory requests related to field and machine moves.
* Monitor and maintain accurate inventory records.
* Track supplier shipments and follow up on purchase orders to ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate material returns and ensure timely pickup and credit processing.
* Partner with Accounts Payable to investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Assist with supplier performance evaluations.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for all quoting projects.
* Support Purchasing team as needed to ensure efficient operations.

**What You Bring (Required Experience)**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required
* 1-3 years of purchasing experience and/or training
* Familiarity with ERP and/or inventory software
* Experience in the use of a PC and Microsoft Word and Excel software, as well as the Internet

**Bonus Points For (Preferred Experience)**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain or related field preferred

**What We Offer – Why Choose Suburban Enterprises?**

* **Team Member Ownership**: Work for a company where your contributions directly impact your future

* **Commitment to Safety**: Safety isn’t just a priority; it’s our promise to you and your family

* **Career Growth**: This isn't just a job - it's a career path with opportunities for advancement
* **Continuous Learning**: Investment in your professional development
* **Collaborative Culture**: Work with a team that values respect, integrity, and excellence

description:
At Ben E. Keith Company, our legacy is strong—and our future is even stronger.

For more than a century, we’ve been leaders in fine food and premium beverage distribution, known for delivering excellence and building lasting partnerships. Today, our Food Division spans multiple states, and our Beverage Division brings top beverage brands to communities across Texas.

But what truly sets us apart is our commitment to people. We invest in our employees, empower growth, and create opportunities to make an impact—because when our people succeed, so do our customers and our business. Since 1906, that’s been our promise.

The Purchasing Assistant will compile information and records to draw up purchase orders for procurement of materials and services. The Purchasing Assistant will select, order and authorize payment for merchandise according to contractual agreements.

* Represent Ben E. Keith Company with professionalism, maintain a positive attitude and follow dress code
* Prepare purchase orders - send copies to suppliers and to departments originating requests.
* Determine if inventory quantities are sufficient for needs, ordering more materials when necessary.
* Respond to customer and supplier inquiries about order status, changes, or cancellations.
* Perform buying duties when necessary.
* Contact suppliers in order to schedule or expedite deliveries and to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other problems.
* Review requisition orders in order to verify accuracy, terminology and specifications.
* Prepare, maintain and review purchasing files, reports and price lists.
* Compare prices, specifications and delivery dates in order to determine the best bid among potential suppliers.
* Track the status of requisitions, contracts and orders.
* Calculate costs of orders and charge or forward invoices to appropriate accounts.
* Check shipments when they arrive to ensure that orders have been filled correctly and those goods meet specifications.
* Approve bills for payment.
* Locate suppliers using sources such as catalogs and the internet, interview supplier about products for ordering.
* Special projects as assigned.

**Job Qualifications:**

* 2 to 5 years Marketing or Purchasing experience preferred.
* Valid Driver’s license – Required to perform company business
* Knowledge and ability to competently us MS Office, internet and email – willingness to learn new software as needed.
* Associates or related degree /related experience resulting in equivalent level of knowledge and experience is required.

We offer employees the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in collaborative, results-driven environments supported by competitive benefits, including:

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match + 100% Company-Paid Profit Sharing
* Paid Time Off & Holidays
* Wellness, EAP & Educational Assistance

At Ben E. Keith, we value a diverse and inclusive workforce where different perspectives drive better decisions and innovation. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor, considering all qualified applicants, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

description:
Contech Engineered Solutions LLC provides site solutions for engineers, contractors, architects, and owners. The Contech portfolio includes bridges, drainage, erosion control, retaining wall, sanitary sewer, and stormwater management products. Through cost-effective engineered solutions, we help build, support, and sustain land development projects while protecting the environment.

**The Position**

Contech Engineered Solutions seeks a detail-oriented and dependable **Assistant Buyer** to join our team in West Chester, Ohio - **LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY**. In this role, you’ll provide essential administrative and clerical support to the Purchasing Department, helping keep day-to-day purchasing activities running smoothly. Working closely with Buyers and the Department Manager, you’ll maintain accurate purchasing records and data while supporting our plants and vendors with routine requests, information, and coordination.

**Why Should You Apply?**

At Contech Engineered Solutions, you’ll be part of a team-oriented environment where collaboration, innovation, and shared success are a priority. As an industry leader in world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution, we provide opportunities to work alongside talented professionals and contribute to meaningful work. We’re also committed to helping our employees achieve their professional goals while maintaining a healthy balance between work and life.

**About the Role**

* Request written bids and telephone quotes from approved vendors as directed, and record bid information including vendor price, payment terms, and delivery.
* Respond to and process system triggers for material and requests from plants for material or information; escalate issues to a Buyer as needed and communicate order status and delivery expectations to internal customers while coordinating with Contech Logistics.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders for raw material within established guidelines and as directed by a Buyer.
* Monitor on-hand inventory of stock at supplier, subcontractor and plant locations and report discrepancies and assist with physical inventory.
* Assist with tracking vendor quality and delivery issues and prepare supporting documentation for claims as directed.
* Support accounting and purchasing functions, including receiving products, virtually transferring inventory, reviewing invoices and obtaining proof of delivery documents from vendors.
* Communicate with vendors to obtain product, pricing and delivery information; refer vendor concerns and emergency purchase needs to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Maintain accurate purchasing files and records using proper record keeping methods and procedures.
* Follow departmental purchasing policies and procedures; refer questions on specifications, including AASHTO and ASTM requirements, and other regulations to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Assist with monitoring data integrity in the ERP system, incoming EDI data and Access databases; identify errors and assist with resolution.
* Assist with entering new items and new item/plant combinations into the ERP system in coordination with Cost Accounting, ensuring accurate descriptions are loaded.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Associate’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of six months to one year of office, clerical, or purchasing experience.
* Attention to detail in reviewing purchasing documents such as invoices, purchase orders, and requisitions to ensure conformance with policies and procedures.
* Basic knowledge of office procedures and general computer applications used in business, such as spreadsheet, database, and word processing software. Willingness to learn purchasing practices, including ethics, standards, bid preparation and competitive bidding procedures.
* Ability to: collect and enter data accurately; perform arithmetic calculations; use common units of measure; calculate discounts and shipping charges; prepare basic written reports; recognize responsibility and limits of assigned authority; maintain effective working relationships with vendors, management personnel, and co-workers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
* Familiarity with J.D. Edwards or another ERP system.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, transgender status, national origin, protected veteran status, or status as an individual with a disability. description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The incumbent will assist the Production Staff Manager in providing professional direction to the management group on purchasing strategies. The position will ensure that Corporate policies and procedures in the purchasing area are effectively implemented. The incumbent will assist in long range planning, value analysis and setting cost-saving goals, including supervises inventory levels. Buyer manages all vendor managed inventory in the warehouse, maintaining correct minimum/maximum levels.

**SCOPE AND IMPACT OF THE POSITION**

The success of the purchasing activity is directly related to the profitability of the Company. Because this position is called upon for advice, individual credibility is of the utmost importance. This position requires interfacing with Company employees’ company-wide, as well as outside vendors, thus necessitating effective communication capabilities both written and oral.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs all purchasing functions including evaluation per manager implemented procedures.
* Establishes and maintains effective relationships with Vendors as a primary Company representative.
* Purchases hardware, MRO, safety supplies, miscellaneous shop supplies, Exceedra materials, Costco/janitorial and kitchen needs, along with managing most company credit card purchases.
* Uses appropriate judgment and integrity in all purchasing decisions and establishes a high standard of conduct.
* Receives Purchase Requisitions from Project Managers, Plant Engineers, Foremen and other Company personnel. Obtains pricing and lead time information as necessary to make informed and cost-effective purchasing decisions. Issues Purchase Orders as necessary for securing requisitioned materials, equipment or services and inventory. Responsible for expediting all orders as required for timely delivery.
* Coordinates incoming traffic of major materials and adds big deliveries to delivery calendar.
* Maintains supplier/manufacturer library and updates as required. Maintains computer vendor database.
* Stamps, reviews, and processes all certification documents received from buyers, ensuring records are accurate and properly maintained.
* Tool Watch administrative help (Load Parts, Employee Information, ext.)
* Support the Warehouse by assisting in the write ups for BOL'S for shipping
* Process new SOS sheets for new product purchases.
* Assist in tracking Warehouse repair items.
* Assists Accounting in reconciling vendor invoices as required.

**SPECIAL NOTES AND CONDITIONS**

* (Outside work, travel, exceptional hours, etc.)
* Some work may require presence in the concrete manufacturing plant.
* Location is at CTC’s premises, except for local travel as required in support of customers. CTC does not offer telecommuting.

**COMPANY BENEFITS**

* Competitive salary: $26.78 - $28.50 per hour depending on experience
* Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental, and vision with family coverage included
* Retirement plan - 401(k) with generous company matching and an employer sponsored money purchase pension plan.
* Paid time off - Holidays, vacation and sick leave

**Education/Experience**

· One to two years of progressive experience in purchasing and inventory management (experience in Construction-related field preferred).

**Skills**

* Knowledge of Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook
* Knowledge of Sage computer software
* Ability to Multitask
* Good attention to detail
* Great Team Member
* Positive attitude & customer service skills
* Strength in Problem Solving
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to bridge communication gap between technical terms and general management knowledge.
* Strong mathematical skills.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life insurance
* State parental leave
* Employee assistant program
* Health savings account
* HSA online store with great prices
* 7 paid holidays
* Accrued paid time off
* State accrued sick pay
* 401(k) matching after 1 year of service
* Retirement plan
* Professional development assistance when job-related

description:
Big R is looking to hire an Assistant Buyer to provide support to our Sporting Goods/Automotive departments. An Assistant Buyer is responsible for providing operational support to the Buyer with a focus on business management and problem-solving. They are committed to executing responsibilities and managing functions for a product category. They will develop an understanding of the company’s business and position in the market, evolving into an expert in a business category, and working with vendors, agents, and other suppliers. **Responsibilities:**

* Perform operational functions supporting buyer to achieve sales, margin and inventory plans
* Write purchase orders and manage the purchase order process with suppliers ensuring on time and accurate delivery
* Demonstrate advanced product knowledge by sharing information with buyer through competitive shopping and market trend research
* Independently identify priorities and proactively work to achieve efficiency in purchase order writing, item maintenance and administrative tasks
* Establish and maintain a reputation of responsiveness in the marketplace
* Troubleshoot issues and negotiate with suppliers accordingly
* Utilize various software applications daily

* Professional attitude and appearance
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to maintain focus on goals and objectives that deliver results

* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Great communicator who works best in a collaborative environment and builds mutual trust and credibility at all levels of an organization

**ABOUT THIS POSITION**
-----------------------

In 2025, more than 52 million passengers traveled through Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX), making it one of the busiest airports in the United States and a key hub in the nation's fifth-largest city. PHX is the largest of three airports in the Phoenix Airport System, which also includes Deer Valley and Goodyear airports, operated by the City of Phoenix Aviation Department (AVN). Together, these airports generate an annual economic impact of over $44 billion.

The Aviation Department has a vacancy for an Administrative Aide position. This position is in the Procurement and Compliance Services (PCS) Division and will undertake a broad set of administrative tasks to support the functional areas of contract administration services, special services, and special projects. The Administrative Aide will provide professional-level administrative, operational and policy support to the C&S Division. Some work will include highly sensitive and/or confidential matters. This position will require the use independent judgment, tact, and discretion for successful performance.

The essential or major duties of this position are:

* Assists in the development of operational policies and procedures.
* Builds and sustains collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders including City executives. Professional diplomacy is a must.
* Identifies and demonstrates a continuous effort to improve division and administrative operations to increase efficiency, decrease turnaround times, and streamline work processes.
* Evaluates and responds to requests for information, meetings, and other materials in person, by telephone and in writing.
* Prioritizes and determines importance and appropriate action.
* Provides administrative support to contracting and procurement officers for bid openings, pre-offer meetings, and other solicitation activities including scheduling meetings, meeting room set-up, sending out notifications of meetings, and posting to the solicitation website.
* Provides administrative support to small business outreach events, business engagement meetings, and other division activities and events.
* Manages various workflow processes (e-CRF and Exigis), including maintaining tracking lists and databases.
* Tracks and maintains certificates of insurance for active contractors.
* Performs job duties in accordance with established policies and procedures.
* Processes various payment documents and enters into the City's financial system, such as department purchase orders, payment control documents, and contract order releases.
* Drafts written correspondence, emails, and other types of documents to internal and external customers.
* Processes response guarantee deposits and refunds.
* Maintains physical and electronic filing systems.
* Reviews, proofreads, and formats documents.
* Creates documents and spreadsheets and keep detailed records.
* Conducts research and assists with special projects as assigned.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

* Knowledge of procurement processes.
* Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Able to provide seamless customer service.
* Able to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

description:
**Base salary:** $45,000–$50,000 per year, depending on experience

**Position Summary**

We are a growing manufacturing company seeking an organized, proactive Buyer / Purchasing Coordinator to support daily purchasing and keep materials on schedule. This role focuses on purchasing specified parts from established or customer-designated suppliers, confirming pricing and availability, issuing purchase orders, and following up delivery.

You will work from provided part numbers, purchasing lists, and supplier information, including projects with approximately 200–300 BOM part numbers. Success requires accuracy, consistent follow-up, and clear communication with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Request supplier quotations and confirm part numbers, quantities, pricing, stock availability, lead times, and purchasing terms.
* Compare quotations for specified items and obtain internal approvals before ordering.
* Create and issue accurate purchase orders and obtain supplier order acknowledgments.
* Track open orders, promised ship dates, and expected arrival dates; follow up regularly until receipt.
* Identify shortages, missed commitments, and delivery risks early; coordinate expediting and escalate issues with clear status and proposed next steps.
* Communicate with customers to clarify designated suppliers, customer-allocated purchasing arrangements, and other purchasing instructions.
* Maintain an accurate Excel or purchasing-system tracker showing order status, quantities, supplier commitments, and outstanding issues.
* Coordinate with production, receiving, and accounting to resolve quantity, delivery, and invoice discrepancies.
* Keep supplier quotations, approvals, purchase orders, and correspondence organized and current.

**Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of experience in purchasing, order management, or supplier coordination; manufacturing or industrial experience preferred.
* Experience requesting quotations, processing purchase orders, and following up with suppliers.
* Working proficiency in Excel, including sorting, filtering, and maintaining detailed tracking sheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for supplier and customer correspondence.
* Strong attention to detail, especially with part numbers, quantities, prices, and dates.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders, follow up proactively, and communicate problems promptly.
* Comfortable working with project managers to support their purchasing needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience purchasing electrical or mechanical components.
* Familiarity with supplier lead times, minimum order quantities, and order acknowledgments.

**Role Scope**

Part specifications and approved supplier information are provided. Technical interpretation of BOMs, engineering design, and technical selection of substitute products are handled by the project managers or customer contact. The Buyer confirms purchasing details and routes technical questions for approval.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Purchase orders and tracking records are accurate and current.
* Supplier commitments are confirmed and followed up consistently.
* Delivery risks are reported early enough for the team to respond.
* Purchasing follows customer requirements and internal approvals.

Pay: $22.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

* Team player with a focus on collaboration

description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

**Role description:**

The Administrator, GWE PMO (Contracts & Procurement Operations), supports capital, facilities, and project-based initiatives through procurement coordination, contract administration, purchase order management, vendor engagement, project controls, financial tracking, and documentation management. This role serves as a key liaison between project teams, vendors, procurement, finance, consultants, and site stakeholders to ensure projects are executed efficiently, comply with internal procedures, and maintain accurate financial and project records.

This position is based in Groton, CT and follows a hybrid work arrangement, with employees expected to work on-site three days a week.

**Role accountabilities:**

* Coordinate purchase order requests, change orders, contract routing, requisition submissions, and procurement approvals for capital and operational projects.
* Support contract administration activities, including contract execution, vendor agreements, proposal reviews, DocuSign workflows, and contract documentation management.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for vendors and project teams regarding quotes, invoices, payment documentation, and procurement-related requests.
* Maintain capital requisition trackers and purchase order status reports to support governance reviews, project controls, and leadership reporting requirements.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously by coordinating requests and communications among project managers, consultants, procurement teams, finance teams, vendors, and site stakeholders.
* Monitor project financial information, budgets, commitments, and expenditures to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.
* Assist in the review and processing of invoices, contracts, purchase orders, and change orders while ensuring compliance with company procedures.
* Maintain SharePoint repositories, procurement records, contract files, project documentation, and audit-ready records in accordance with document retention and naming standards.
* Identify and resolve procurement, contract, and financial discrepancies in collaboration with project teams and stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and support to project coordinators and team members on procurement procedures, contract workflows, documentation requirements, and related processes.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in accounting, procurement, contract administration, purchase order management, invoice review, change order processing, or project controls within a construction, facilities, engineering, or project-based environment.
* Proficiency with accounting and procurement systems, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to review financial and project data, identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining financial records, contracts, procurement documentation, and project reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, vendors, finance, leadership, clients, and other stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven problem-solving abilities and experience supporting compliance, document control, audit readiness, and project record management.

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. * Ability to safely handle, transport, and distribute boxes, office supplies, equipment, and other materials.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and follow established purchasing, receiving, inventory, and safety procedures.
* Valid driver’s license required.

Description:

**Produce Assistant Buyer & Receiver**

**Part-time; benefits eligible**

**Friday - Saturday 6:00am - 2:00pm**

**16 Hours**

**Purpose: Support the Produce Buyer in meeting department goals by assisting with buying and receiving.**

**Status: Reports to Produce Manager**

**Pay Level 3**

**Responsibilities:**

**General:**

* Follow all department policies and procedures in order for Hunger Mountain Co-op to adhere to all applicable regulations.
* Be responsible for safety in the workplace by creating a safe work environment, reporting safety concerns to a manager, and adhering to all safety rules and regulations.
* Be a team player.
* Attend all required meetings, training, seminars and workshops.

**Buying:**

* Fill in and assist buyer and place day-to-day orders with established suppliers within guidelines set by Produce Manager.
* Inventory back stock to determine ordering needs and for periodic financial reporting.
* Communicate daily with Produce buyer regarding market choices and opportunities.
* Enter new products in the Point of Sale (POS) system, as needed.
* Assist in updating, organizing, and maintaining sales data in department spreadsheet.
* Assist in making and maintaining price signs and making price changes in POS system in consultation or at the direction of the Produce Buyer and/or Manager.
* Regularly double check floor pricing to assure consistency with the POS.
* Notify Produce buyer of inconsistencies in pricing and reports.
* Obtain credit from suppliers, as needed.

**Receiving:**

* Receive deliveries following established procedures, checking for quality and accuracy, while maintaining proper product rotation.
* Follow appropriate procedures for handling invoices.
* Maintain a clean and safe work environment, including mopping floors and cleaning cooler shelves.

**Merchandising:**

* Assist with displays following guidelines of Produce Manager. Replenish and rotate displays as needed; assure accuracy of signage; label items with PLU stickers and/or signs; correct pricing discrepancies and report to Produce Manager.
* Inform floor staff of new products when they arrive and facilitate the stocking and labelling of any new items.
* Assist floor staff with replenishing and maintaining displays, culling several times daily, and following stocking priorities set by Produce Manager.
* Assist customers with produce and special orders; offer samples and suggestions for purchases and preparations in friendly, courteous manner.
* Trim, wash, and prepare produce as needed. Pull damaged or spoiled items and dispose with appropriate notification to Produce Manager.
* Assist with general produce maintenance as needed. Remove trash, clean cases and mirrors, and keep prep and storage areas in clean, orderly condition.
* Use equipment safely. Monitor cooler and walk-in temperatures and follow procedures for handling breakdowns. Advise Produce Manager of equipment repair and replacement needs.

**Miscellaneous:**

* Provide produce information and education to Co-op staff members and customers.
* Participate in periodic inventory.
* Attend department and storewide meetings.
* Perform other tasks assigned by Produce Manager.

Requirements:

The responsibilities as listed in this job description are representative only and not exhaustive of the tasks that an employee may be required to perform. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Qualifications:**

* Prior retail produce experience required; experience with produce purchasing, merchandising, quality control, organic standards and especially ordering and working with multiple local organic farms is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to follow through on commitments under tight time pressures.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented with a strong numerical aptitude.
* Ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks.
* Familiarity with computers and Microsoft Office including use of Excel.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment involving frequently lifting 50 lbs., standing for long periods, and working in a cold environment.
* Manual dexterity with equipment used in moving, unpacking and preparing produce for display.
* Ability to follow all Safety policies and procedures of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to provide excellent service to customers, vendors and co-workers and abide by Hunger Mountain Co-op’s Service Policies.
* Ability to work well with others in a cooperative environment where teamwork and constant communication are essential.

**Desired:**

* Ability to have some scheduling flexibility with when business needs require it.
* Ability to follow attendance and punctuality policies of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to be physically present onsite at the Co-op to perform the requirements of this position.

Overview:

This role serves as a key liaison between Supply Chain, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Contracts, and suppliers to ensure material availability, regulatory compliance, cost control, schedule adherence, and long-term product supportability. The Project Coordinator leverages procurement analytics, supplier management practices, and lifecycle planning methodologies to proactively identify risks and develop solutions that support mission readiness and operational success.

**About Us**

Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors.

To accomplish our mission, we need a world-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face.

Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics.

Burros can be described as Disney's Wall-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have 700+ robots in our growing fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team.

**About you:**

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Supply Chain, our **Strategy & Operations Analyst** will be a core part of our growing commercial and operations teams, collaborating daily with customers, suppliers and manufacturing partners, accounting/finance, sales, robot support, field support, and our engineering team to drive top and bottom line growth. You have the resilience to defeat complex problems, and love to build, analyze, and improve products and processes alongside a highly-driven team.

The ideal candidate believes in our mission, and is passionate about autonomy in real-world-use. You are motivated by making a direct impact on the trajectory of the company you work for, and are intensely curious about the market, technology, and product.

### **Responsibilities:**

You'll report to the Senior Manager, Supply Chain and work closely with our COO and leadership team every day. This is a hands-on role with broad exposure across the business. You'll help keep Burro's operations running smoothly today while building the foundation we need to scale tomorrow.

* **Supply planning and demand fulfillment:** Help manage the robot configuration, build mix and spare parts fulfillment, source and plan incoming material so we're ready to meet customer demand.
* **Transportation and logistics:** Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments that support customer deliveries, internal sales needs, and R&D.
* **Supplier quality and outsourced assembly:** Support quality management across our supply chain and help oversee our contract assembly partners.
* **Data and analytics:** Analyze operational and robot utilization data to find insights that drive better decisions across the company.
* **Process improvement:** Spot gaps in how we work, recommend improvements, and help roll out the tools, systems, and processes that make us more efficient.
* **Building for scale:** Be our utility player. Bring the tools you know, pick up new ones quickly; build for scale and always ask how we can do it better next time.

### **Requirements:**

* 2-5 years of experience in an analytical role in consulting, startup operations, or with a manufacturing company
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, liberal arts, or a related field
* Fierce work ethic and self-motivation. You take ownership and see things through to completion.
* Ability to break complex, ambiguous problems down into clear, actionable plans
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort turning messy data into clear takeaways
* A collaborative communicator who builds strong working relationships with engineers, customers, sales and field support, suppliers, and manufacturing partners
* Exposure to some or all of the following: discrete manufacturing processes, supply chain sourcing and planning, design for manufacturability, Lean/6Sigma continuous improvement, new market entry and go-to-market strategy development, strategy deployment, new product introduction, business development, business process design, project management
* Deep passion for commercial robotics and excitement about the challenge of scaling a hardware business
* Willingness to travel up to 15%

### **Perks:**

* Competitive compensation and benefits package (medical/dental/vision)
* 401K Plan with up to a 4% match
* Early-stage equity
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid parental leave

$74,000 - $94,000 a year

**RECRUITERS:** We are **not** accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unso

*X-energy LLC conducts a thorough recruiting process and will never issue offers without interview to discuss qualifications and responsibilities. All applications will be submitted via our company career page,* *www.x-energy.com/careers/* *. We will never ask you to provide payment information as part of the recruiting process. If anyone claiming to represent X-energy directs you in a manner otherwise, please contact us at* *www.x-energy.com/contact-us* *.*

**Job Description**

This role is responsible for procurement of goods and services that will support X-energy's business effort. They will manage the entire life cycle of direct and indirect purchases. This includes working with customers and suppliers, identifying sources to meet X-energy's specific needs, negotiating terms and conditions, and purchase agreement administration.

The Administrator IV, Procurement is responsible for independently leading and executing complex procurement activities across materials, services, and hybrid contracts. This role owns the full procurement lifecycle for assigned categories and high-value contracts, from sourcing strategy through contract execution and supplier management. The Administrator IV ensures compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices while driving cost efficiency, quality, and timely delivery, and serves as a subject-matter expert and technical resource to the broader procurement team.

**Job Profile Tasks/Responsibilities**

* Prepare and issue request for proposals for purchases of goods and services, and conduct vendor selection in compliance with federal, customer, and company policies and procedures.
* Respond to purchase requisitions with identification of multiple vendors, and vendor selection analysis.
* Identify distinct requirements, provisions, and terms and conditions for vendor agreements.
* Generate and disseminate information to stakeholders throughout the company regarding purchasing status, compliance, modifications, negotiations, vendor availability, and vendor selection analysis.
* Review and track vendor performance and invoices for accuracy and facilitate the approval process.
* Resolve issues with customers and vendors.
* Generate and negotiate change orders and modifications as needed.
* Maintain approved vendor list through verification that they are not listed on the Excluded Parties List (EPL) or the Denied Parties List.
* Support company proposal efforts as necessary.
* Maintain procurement policies and procedures.
* Maintain all documents, reviews, and awards in an organized, detailed, and centralized filing system, and ensure all procurement files are compliant.
* Maintain professional demeanor and behavior at all times in all forms of communication.
* Lead the execution of the core tasks and responsibilities, listed in the Job Profile Task/Responsibilities section of this document, for direct and indirect purchases for all sizes, without close supervision and some latitude for independent judgment.
* Provide feedback and guidance to more junior team members with the execution of the core tasks and responsibilities listed in the Job Profile Task/Responsibilities section of this document.
* Shares knowledge related to industry best practices and standards with others across the team.
Perform other duties as assigned by manager.

**Job Profile Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field. Relevant years of experience may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
* Typically, ten years of experience in procurement/contracts administration is required.
* Experience conducting complex negotiations.
* Advanced experience with federal purchasing procedures, and/or knowledge of commercial procurements.
Extensive understanding of federal government regulatory guidelines, as appropriate.

**Desired Qualification:**

Experience working in the energy sector.

**Location:** 9801 Washingtonian Boulevard, Gaithersburg, Maryland

**Work Site Expectations:** 4 days a week in office, 1 day remote

**Travel Expectations:** Up to 10% as needed

**Hours:** 8:00am-5:00pm, Mon-Fri

**Compensation**

As required by Maryland and other applicable state law, X Energy, LLC (X-energy) lists the expected compensation range for a publicly advertised job opportunity based upon the job requirements (e.g. education/training, experience, skill sets, etc.). Individual candidates who meet the job requirements for the posted position will be offered a salary within this range based on their respective levels of education/training, experience, and other qualifications unique to them. Salary ranges may vary based on the specific office location and region referenced in the posting to take into consideration differences in cost of living and may not be reflective of all regions. Please note that compensation ranges listed for US job postings reflect base salary only and do not include benefits or other incentives.
