Boardwalk is a limited partnership operating in the midstream portion of the natural gas and natural gas liquids industry, providing transportation and storage services for our customers. Our 14,000 miles of pipeline and storage assets provide diverse market connectivity to producers and end-users who need reliable sources of natural gas for power generation, home heating or petrochemical feedstocks. We have the experience, knowledge, and flexibility to design service offerings and create system enhancements tailored to our customers’ needs throughout the 13 states in which we operate. As an organization focused on sustainability, we are committed to protecting the environment while delivering this energy source. This commitment is made to our customers, employees, and the communities in which we operate. We incorporate environmental stewardship, safety, and compliance into our day-to-day operations and seek to strengthen and support the communities we serve. Additional information about the company can be found online at www.bwpipelines.com.

We are currently looking for a Program Manager, University Relations & Early Career Program for our Houston, TX office.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Program Manager, University Relations & Early Career Programs is a key contributor within the Talent Management, L&D and OD/OE Center of Excellence. Reporting to the Manager, Talent Management, this role owns Boardwalk's early career talent lifecycle, from university engagement and candidate attraction through internships, conversion to full-time employment, and early career development.

The Program Manager partners closely with Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, and business leaders to translate workforce needs into sustainable talent pipelines, and leads the design, execution, and continuous improvement of university partnerships, campus recruiting, internship programming, and future rotational programs. The ideal candidate brings strong relationship-building skills, program management discipline, and a track record of creating high-quality candidate and participant experiences.

Key Responsibilities

University Relations & Early Career Pipeline Strategy

* Develop and execute the enterprise university relations and early career talent strategy, prioritizing schools and programs aligned to critical workforce and skill needs.
* Establish and manage relationships with priority universities, career centers, faculty, academic departments, and student organizations to build year-round visibility rather than event-driven engagement.
* Serve as Boardwalk's primary representative on campus and with university partners, supported by leader and employee ambassadors.
* Evaluate university partnerships based on talent quality, hiring outcomes, cost, and strategic value, and reallocate investment accordingly.

Campus Recruiting & Candidate Experience

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners and business leaders to forecast intern and entry-level hiring needs and build the annual recruiting plan.
* Lead sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, and offer coordination for designated early career roles.
* Deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across the recruiting lifecycle, including engagement between offer acceptance and start date.
* Build and maintain early career talent communities and pipelines for anticipated future hiring needs.

Internship Program Ownership

* Own the design, planning, and execution of the enterprise internship program, including assignment quality, project scoping, and intern placement.
* Equip intern managers and mentors with clear expectations, resources, and support to drive a strong intern experience.
* Coordinate intern onboarding, orientation, development activities, leadership exposure, networking, and end-of-program presentations.
* Facilitate intern evaluations and conversion recommendations, and maintain relationships with interns after they return to campus.
* Gather intern and manager feedback and translate it into measurable program improvements each cycle.

Early Career Development & Rotational Programs

* Assess and build the business case for rotational and early career development programs supporting critical talent pipelines.
* Partner with business and HR leaders to design rotation experiences, development plans, and learning milestones.
* Coordinate participant assignments, manager expectations, and program milestones, and monitor participant progression, mobility, and retention.

Employer Brand & Talent Engagement

* Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition to strengthen Boardwalk's employment brand with university and early career audiences.
* Develop consistent campus messaging, recruiting materials, and digital content that reflect Boardwalk's culture and career opportunities.
* Leverage employee, intern

description:
Founded in 2005, iam8bit is a creative production emporium that has quietly redefined the entertainment industry, time and time again. Collaborating with a plethora of partners and narrative-busting IPs, iam8bit punctuates the importance of engaging with fans directly. By creating the video game industry's very first community events, the company injected the idea of experiential immersion into game and film marketing. iam8bit also played a crucial role in the vinyl renaissance, minting its first record in 2010, and is the industry leader in premium physical editions of top-tier games. In 2020, iam8bit evolved into financing and publishing games, with several yet-to-be-announced PC, console and tabletop games on the horizon under its iam8bit Presents imprint.

As a **Senior Project Manager: Partner Accounts**, **you are responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and monitoring of all aspects of an XP project, including setting timelines, managing budgets and ensuring successful delivery of** **promotional product, swag, and related pop-up activations**. Attention to detail is critical to the success of the position accompanied by excellent communication and problem-solving skills. You enjoy owning projects and have a proven track record of delivering results in project management. You’ll be collaborating on impressive global IPs, communicating with and presenting to a variety of partners and personalities, and making unique and memorable swag objects that innovate. Sometimes you’ll even be traveling to cool locations to operate pop-ups for brands you’ve definitely heard of.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversee multiple and/or large, complex, highly sensitive projects including strategic partnerships and cross departmental initiatives; participating in contract negotiation, determining scope of work, and making decisions about the execution of the project within those parameters.

* Innovate based on partner’s goals and the philosophical DNA of iam8bit in order to produce and deliver creative products that exceed expectations at every turn.
* Be the primary liaison between the project team, leadership, and external stakeholders (i.e. clients and vendors) during the project(s); from project initiation through execution, building and maintaining high-level, strategic relationships with those parties.

* Report on portfolio performance to executives, to strategize and align on goals.
* Provide guidance, demonstrate, and help to build out best practices for project management within the department, as well as develop or influence training opportunities.
* Provide support to the larger XP team on events, mailers, and activations as needed.

**PROJECT-LEVEL MANAGEMENT:**

* Create and manage detailed project plans, outlining budgets, timelines, risks, and resources for successful execution, with minimal input from the executive team.
* Oversee the financial aspect of each project, ensuring that budgets are adhered to.
* Monitor progress to ensure client expectations and all deliverables and are met on time.
* Allocate and share resources across multiple department projects and/or teams.
* Manage vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to produce events and marketing assets.
* Collaborate with others for efficient execution, delegate tasks, and provide support as needed.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation, tracking all decisions, budgets, schedules, and communications for reference and reporting on specific project metrics, (i.e. timelines, budget adherence, and deliverable quality).

* Lead post-mortems for every project, identifying successes, challenges, and areas to improve.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Strong project management skills including planning, scheduling, and budgeting.
* Demonstrated ability with physical goods production including sourcing, sampling, shipping, etc.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
* Persistence and determination to complete projects, while being agile as changes arise.
* Ability to prioritize between different tasks and across different projects.
* Ability to work and make decisions under pressure to meet deadlines.
* Proficient in **Shopify,** Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator for file review).
* Understanding of customer service best-practices and demonstrated ability to make partners and clients feel cared for.
* PMP Certification Bachelor’s degree in business management, hospitality management, marketing or related areas OR 5 years of related, equivalent experience.
* Ability for travel nationally and internationally several times a year.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

The successful candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. This may require lifting, carrying, bending, standing for extended periods, climbing, walking, fine motor skills, and other physical activities associated with this role.

—-

Description:

Take-off with Pilatus! If you would like to join a strong and growing HR team, we invite you to explore our job opportunity in Broomfield, Colorado. The Recruiting Specialist supports hiring across Pilatus Aircraft USA, including aviation, technical, skilled, and professional positions. The role is responsible for full-cycle recruitment, from hiring intake through accepted offer, with a focus on proactive sourcing, effective hiring manager partnerships, and a positive candidate experience.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Independent management of full-cycle recruitment from hiring intake through accepted offer, including job postings, application review, interview coordination, candidate travel, and offer preparation
* Assessment of staffing needs and recruiting challenges with hiring managers across multiple locations and time zones; development and recommendation of effective sourcing and recruitment strategies
* Proactive identification and engagement of qualified candidates, including passive candidates for difficult-to-fill technical, skilled trades, and professional positions
* Independent candidate interviews and assessments, evaluation of qualifications against position requirements, and hiring recommendations
* Management of multiple open positions and competing hiring priorities, including talent pipelines and regular communication of recruiting progress and challenges
* Coordination of candidate communication, pre-employment screenings, reference checks, employment verifications, and transition of accepted candidates to onboarding
* Maintenance of accurate applicant and recruiting records in the applicant tracking system, including recruiting data and reporting
* Representation of Pilatus at career fairs and industry events, development of recruiting partnerships, and support of recruiting process improvements

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* Minimum of 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including independent responsibility from hiring intake through offer; experience in aviation, manufacturing, skilled trades, technical, corporate, or professional environments preferred
* Demonstrated success independently developing sourcing strategies and recruiting passive candidates for difficult-to-fill technical, skilled trades, or professional positions
* Experience independently conducting interviews, evaluating candidate qualifications, and providing hiring recommendations
* Experience managing multiple open positions and partnering directly with hiring managers across multiple locations and time zones
* Experience using applicant tracking systems and Microsoft Office; Paylocity and LinkedIn Recruiter experience preferred
* Strong judgment, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain effective relationships with hiring managers and candidates
* Primary work location in Broomfield, CO, with on-site work and travel to other Pilatus USA locations and recruiting events as required
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

**What We Offer**

* 11 paid holidays a year, plus 15 days of paid vacation time, and 6 days of paid sick/personal time to start with an increase to 20 days of paid vacation time after 5 years with Pilatus
* 90% of medical, dental, and vision premiums paid for single coverage and 80% for family coverage, averaging $9,600 annually
* Monthly health savings account (HSA) contributions totaling $2,250 for single coverage and $3,000 for family coverage annually
* 401(k) retirement plan matching up to 6%
* Life and long-term disability insurance premiums paid in full
* Tuition assistance available annually after the first year

The hiring range is $85,000 - $95,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. Any bonus, incentive compensation, benefits, or other forms of compensation are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans, programs, and policies and may be modified in accordance with applicable law.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their application as soon as possible. Please note that this announcement may close at any time; early applications are encouraged.

#### **Location:** **El Segundo, CA (Hybrid, 2-3 days on-site)** **Reports to:** **Head of Product Development** **Salary Range:** **$120,000 to $130,000 (DOE)**

### **About Us:**

NOYZ is a first-of it's-kind fine fragrance house born in LA. Fragrances fueled by feelings, not fantasies are made with unconventional, clean ingredients and innovative formats. Always rooted in real, raw and authentic storytelling. We're flipping the script on the category, replacing perfection with personality and industry rules with a bit of rebellion. Refinery 29 said it best, "NOYZ is the brand for the cool kids who don't want to smell like everyone else."

Backed by Beach House Group — the powerhouse behind BÉIS by Shay Mitchell, Pattern by Tracee Ellis Ross, and florence by mills — NOYZ is the next category-defining brand. Based in Los Angeles with offices in El Segundo, our team is built for impact, bringing together brilliant minds to push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

### **The 30,000 Foot View:**

At NOYZ, we move fast, think big and play where culture is created – not copied. This is a team that embraces creative freedom and storytelling, while having fun doing things differently.

We move at the speed of culture, obsess over the details, and bring standout products to market. Our Product Development team is small, close-knit, and high-impact. The Senior Manager, Product Development plays a critical role in driving NOYZ's fragrance innovation and new product pipeline from brief to launch. Working hand in hand with the Head of Product Development, this individual helps lead the development process end to end, briefing new formulas, managing cross-functional timelines, contract manufacturer and supplier relationships, and testing and regulatory processes. This role partners directly with leadership to execute NOYZ's three-year innovation pipeline, turning strategy into standout launches. It operates with a high degree of independence and leadership within a small, fast-moving team, and is well suited to an experienced developer who is confident taking the lead and bringing new products to life.

### **Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Product Development & Innovation**

* Work closely with leadership and the team to support new formula and packaging initiatives
* Drive fragrance innovation and new launches through every stage: brief, sourcing, formulation, testing, packaging, and commercialization
* Partner with the Head of Product Development on the innovation roadmap, category strategy, and launch calendar, helping keep priorities moving day to day
* Organize submissions, timelines, and feedback rounds
* Partner closely with Project Management on NPD meetings and pipeline reporting, including agenda setting, cross-functional alignment, and weekly progress recaps
* Track competitive launches, ingredient and scent trends, and bring new product and category opportunities to the table
* Spearhead in-office organization, building and maintaining a physical system for samples, components, and development materials

**Formulation, Testing & Regulatory**

* Lead contract manufacturers, labs, and component suppliers on formulation, stability, compatibility, and scale-up
* Manage safety, clinical, and consumer testing, flagging risks early to protect launch schedules
* Partner on claims substantiation, ingredient compliance, and regulatory submissions with third-party compliance partners

**Packaging Development**

* Lead packaging development from initial brief through final approval, partnering with the Head of Product Development on new packaging concepts and innovation
* Work with component suppliers on development, sampling, decoration, and production readiness, tracking every milestone
* Manage packaging compatibility and transit testing alongside formula testing to protect launch schedules
* Support the artwork and proofing process with Creative, ensuring final files meet spec, brand standards, and compliance requirements

**Timelines & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Help manage and maintain timelines across multiple concurrent projects, proactively problem-solving to keep launches on track
* Bring a no-job-too-big-or-too-small mentality, pitching in wherever needed
* Request, file, and maintain all supplier and component quotes, helping leadership build COGS and track pricing across projects

**The Uniquely Celebrated Skills As:**

* A confident leader who takes the lead on launches and holds partners accountable without being chased
* A curious innovator who stays ahead of ingredient, scent, and category trends
* An energized self-starter who gets excited by a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and loves seeing big ideas come to life quickly
* An adaptable sprinter who brings urgency, pace, and agility to a fast-moving, early-stage brand
* An end-to-end owner who sees the full picture, from first brief to shelf, and keeps every moving piece on track

**Description**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Recycling Operations Manager**

**Department**

EcoRecycle

**Primary Locations**

Cartersville (CTV) - Primary Work Location; travel to EcoRecycle and Dalton (DLT) facilities as needed

**Reports To**

EcoRecycle Team Lead

**Work Location / Travel Requirements**
=======================================

Based primarily at the Cartersville (CTV) facility, with travel to the EcoRecycle and Dalton (DLT) facilities as needed for operational support, site coordination, and improvement initiatives.

**1. Position Purpose**
=======================

The Recycling Operations Specialist supports and coordinates recycling and waste management activities across the Cartersville (CTV) and Dalton (DLT) facilities.

The position serves as a key liaison between the EcoRecycle Team Lead and the recycling personnel at each facility, coordinating common operational activities and driving improvement initiatives across both sites.

The role is responsible for identifying operational improvement opportunities, developing and implementing corrective or improvement actions, and monitoring their effectiveness. The position also supports waste cost reduction, expansion of recycling opportunities, improvement of revenue from recyclable and valuable materials, vendor management, shipment and export coordination, and management reporting.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**2.1 CTV / DLT Recycling Operations Support and Coordination**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor recycling operations and key issues at CTV and DLT.
* Coordinate activities between the EcoRecycle Team Lead and recycling personnel at each facility.
* Support operational and administrative activities of the recycling teams at each site.
* Track common action items, operational issues, and improvement initiatives across CTV and DLT.
* Support standardization of recycling processes and operating practices between the two facilities.

**2.2 Operational Improvement and Continuous Improvement Management**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Conduct regular reviews of CTV and DLT recycling operations and identify improvement opportunities.
* Identify and improve operational processes related to waste collection, storage, internal transportation, handling, and shipment.
* Analyze root causes of operational issues and develop practical improvement plans.
* Coordinate with site personnel and relevant departments to implement improvement initiatives.
* Manage owners, schedules, action items, and progress for improvement projects.
* Follow up after implementation to verify effectiveness and sustainable application in the field.
* Share best practices between CTV and DLT and support process standardization.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve safety, environmental performance, operational efficiency, and productivity.

**2.3 Cross-Functional Coordination**
-------------------------------------

* Coordinate with Production, EHS, Logistics, Equipment/Maintenance, Purchasing, Finance, and other relevant departments.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions and resolution of recycling and waste-related issues.
* Coordinate stakeholders when new processes are introduced or existing processes are changed.
* Track cross-functional action items and ensure timely follow-up and closure.

**2.4 Review of New Waste and Recycling Items**
-----------------------------------------------

* Review newly generated waste, by-products, and recyclable materials from production and plant operations.
* Coordinate with EHS and relevant departments to determine appropriate storage, handling, transportation, recycling, and disposal methods.
* Evaluate opportunities for recycling, reuse, or recovery of newly generated materials.
* Develop appropriate collection and handling processes for new waste and recyclable items.
* Monitor operational issues and performance after implementation.

**2.5 Waste and Recycling Vendor Sourcing and Management**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Identify and evaluate new waste disposal and recycling vendors.
* Compare vendor capabilities, pricing, service conditions, and operational requirements.
* Support bidding, vendor selection, contract coordination, and vendor onboarding.
* Monitor existing vendors for pricing, service quality, operational performance, and compliance.
* Diversify vendors where appropriate to reduce disposal costs and operational risk.

**2.6 Waste Cost Reduction and Revenue Improvement**
----------------------------------------------------

* Analyze waste disposal costs across CTV and DLT and identify cost-reduction opportunities.
* Reduce disposal volume and cost by expanding recycling and recovery opportunities.
* Identify new buyers and sales channels for recyclable and valuable materials.
* Compare market pricing and vendor offers to improve sales value.
* Support

***Company Overview***

Since its inception in 1995, FNS has been focused on providing the best total logistics services by implementing our core values: trust, communication, team play, challenge, and balance. Through trust, we can be a logistics partner that customers trust with a diverse group that works together based on a strong, unified belief. By communicating with and accommodating the voices of customers and co-workers we can deliver the best services. Our team play is enhanced by the appreciation and cooperation with each other with a focus on a singular goal. Challenging the status quo and innovating, FNS is unafraid of failure and strives to develop and improve our processes. Work-life balance strives to provide individuals with happiness to achieve and grow together.

For 2025, we have set out to become one of the nation's top 25 logistics companies with more than $1,500M in sales, with the best employee and customer satisfaction, and a network of over 100 different partners.

To achieve our goals, there is an emphasis on three traits of work. We promote a family-like working environments allow us to help promote every member's work-life balance, allowing us to develop cooperation and care for one another like family. We are nominated by our customers whom we can grow with based on a trusting relationship between our services and our customers. We specialize fields of work where professionals can nurture their talent, and we focus on every member's work-life balance so that members may cooperate and care for each other like family. Our core values are integral to the success and growth of FNS.

To Discover more, please visit our website at http://www.fnsusa.com

***Location:***La Palma, CA; Duluth, GA; Chicago, IL; or Dallas, TX
***Employment Type:***Full-Time
***Language:*** Korean / English Bilingual Preferred

***About the Job***

FNS, Inc. is seeking a proactive and highly motivated Talent Acquisition Specialist to support recruiting activities across our U.S. operations.

The primary focus of this position is to identify, screen, and engage qualified candidates for open positions, including positions that may require Korean-English bilingual candidates.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys actively searching for candidates, reviewing resumes, conducting initial candidate screenings, and building qualified talent pipelines rather than waiting for applicants to come in.

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will work closely with the Talent Acquisition Manager, Regional HR, and hiring managers to understand hiring priorities and provide qualified candidates in a timely manner.

The successful candidate should be organized, responsive, comfortable managing multiple open positions, and able to quickly understand different departments, organizational structures, and job requirements.

***Responsibilities***

**Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development**

* Proactively source qualified candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, Greenhouse database, professional networks, employee referrals, recruiting platforms, and other sourcing channels.
* Develop and maintain candidate pipelines for priority, recurring, and difficult-to-fill positions.
* Conduct targeted outreach to passive candidates rather than relying solely on incoming applications.
* Build and maintain candidate networks across various business functions and geographic markets, including Korean-English bilingual talent when needed.
* Research new sourcing channels and recruiting methods to expand candidate pools.
* Support sourcing for corporate, logistics, warehouse, transportation, operations, and other business functions.

**Resume Screening & Candidate Qualification**

* Review incoming applications and resumes in Greenhouse on a timely basis.
* Screen candidates based on job requirements, relevant experience, language ability when applicable, location, compensation expectations, and overall fit.
* Conduct initial phone or video screenings when needed to evaluate candidate qualifications and interest.
* Prepare clear and concise candidate summaries for Regional HR and hiring managers.
* Identify qualified candidates and move them forward to Regional HR or the appropriate hiring team for further evaluation.
* Maintain timely follow-up with candidates throughout the initial recruiting process.

**Recruiting Priority & Requisition Management**

* Manage multiple open requisitions based on recruiting priorities established by the Talent Acquisition Manager and business needs.
* Maintain active sourcing efforts for urgent and difficult-to-fill positions until qualified candidate pipelines are established.
* Monitor candidate pipelines and identify positions requiring additional sourcing efforts.
* Communicate recruiting progress, candidate availability, and sourcing challenges to the Talent Acquisition Manager and Regional HR.
* Support recruiting activities across multiple U.S. locations.

**Greenhouse / ATS

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter to help us hire exceptional engineers and technical talent. You’ll own searches end-to-end: developing the hiring strategy, sourcing candidates, running the process, partnering with hiring managers, and closing candidates.
This isn't a role where success is measured by sending large numbers of LinkedIn messages. We want someone who can understand what makes an exceptional technical candidate, develop creative ways to find them, and build the relationships necessary to bring them to Harper.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering and other technical roles.
* Partner with technical leaders to deeply understand roles, hiring profiles, and what distinguishes an exceptional candidate.
* Build sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill technical positions.
* Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn, GitHub, referrals, networks, events, and other creative channels.
* Conduct recruiter screens and assess candidates for motivation, experience, communication, and alignment with Harper.
* Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines.
* Manage candidates throughout the recruiting process and maintain high engagement.
* Partner with hiring managers to make fast, thoughtful hiring decisions.
* Drive offer strategy and help close competitive candidates.
* Maintain accurate pipeline information and use recruiting data to identify where searches are working or getting stuck.
* Develop a strong understanding of Harper's product, technology, team, and story so you can credibly represent the company to technical candidates.
* Help improve interview processes and hiring standards as the company scales.

The Gavial team draws upon decades of experience and knowledge to build high-quality, high-reliability parts and systems for some of the most demanding industries. We apply our Quality Assurance Program to strong processes, industry knowledge and dedicated people to deliver quality products on time.

Gavial is looking for a **Project Manager** to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. The Project Manager will manage projects of simple to above average scope and complexity, from planning through delivery. The person in this role will plan, direct, and coordinate activities of projects to ensure that goals or objectives of their assigned project(s) are accomplished within the prescribed time frame and funding parameters by performing the following duties.

* Evaluates requests for proposal/quote and provides necessary input for the development of the proposal/quote for future potential projects. Input includes determination of labor, staffing, timeframe, materials, equipment and other resource needs.
* Review customer contracts and purchase orders to evaluate technical, financial and schedule impact to projects.
* Determines time frame, funding limitations, procedures for accomplishing project, staffing requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of project.
* Generates the project roadmap (schedule, bills of material, work orders, etc.) and maintains that roadmap throughout the life of the project.
* Establishes work plan and staffing requirements for each phase of project and arranges for recruitment or assignment of project personnel in collaboration with internal department managers.
* Confers with project team to outline work plan and to assign duties, responsibilities, and scope of authority. Communicate changes to work plan schedule to all stakeholders.
* Collaborate with project team members to provide technical advice and to resolve problems.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining customer relationships on each project.
* Oversee management of supplier relationships to ensure performance, compliance, and alignment with company goals. Responsible for sourcing new suppliers to meet project requirements, leading negotiations, and ensuring alignment of the terms and conditions of both the supplier and the company.
* Directs and coordinates activities of project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within prescribed budget. Work with every department in the company to resolve project related issues.
* Monitors task completion status to identify at-risk project tasks and to develop mitigation plans.
* Prepares status reports for management and customer(s). Modifies schedules or plans as required.
* Coordinates project activities to meet requirements of governmental and regulatory agencies.

* Experience in manufacturing required; experience in electronic manufacturing a plus.
* Technical product experience and working knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, purchasing and cost estimating.
* Prior experience interfacing with a quality management system.
* Knowledge of Six Sigma and/or Lean manufacturing principles a plus.
* Familiarity with applicable health and safety regulations.

* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, suppliers, and employees.

description:
**Job Summary:**

In this role, you will participate in subcontract formation and/or administration. Subcontract formation includes leading preparation and review of bid request packages and developing project contracts operating procedures. Subcontract administration includes continual progress review, forecasting, and communication of difficulties. Your work will ensure subcontract compliance with project requirements. Performs all phases of tasks involved in the sourcing, formation, tendering, negotiation and award and administration of EPC subcontracts. Communicates with bidders and personnel within to establish clear definition of requirements and to assure proper performance to the stated project requirements. Maintains a continuing review of the progress of each subcontract and provides management with information regarding any scope budget, financial, legal or technical difficulties. Prepares change order and amendments, negotiates with subcontractors and customers to obtain settlement. Represents the company at all times with high moral standards and ethics.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Develop multiple contracts and/or services agreements simultaneously as assigned.
* Perform formation duties including but not limited to; source and prequalification of potential bidders, prepare and issue request for proposal packages, coordinate and resolve technical and commercial clarifications, receive bids, organize the evaluation process, prepare commercial bid summaries and recommendation documents, secure approvals in accordance with established procedures and prepare contract documents for execution.
* Implement the Division Responsibilities Matrix which records the Project’s agreed assignment of various subcontract management tasks and the Standard Work Process Procedures applicable to Subcontract Administration.
* Administer assigned subcontracts maintaining a continual review of progress and providing management with information regarding projected financial or technical difficulties.
* Prepare and maintain control and status reporting documents.
* Prepare and organize assigned contracts sponsored meetings, such as bid clarification and pre-award meetings, for the purpose of ensuring complete understanding and agreement between stakeholder parties on all contractual matters.
* Assist project Contracts team in solving and attending to administrative problems on planning, staffing, work-hour calculations, budgeting, procedures preparation, commitments involving monetary expenditure or risk, engineered technical specifications, or supplementary commercial conditions.
* Coordinate with Construction, Engineering and Support Services staff on operational activities affecting contractual rights and obligations, subcontract performance, subcontract administration and other major matters.
* Represent in contractual discussions of moderate complexity.
* Administer information programs to ensure mutual understanding of subcontract terms and conditions.
* Monitor cost vs scope progress and prepare periodic status reports for management.

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5-8 years of relevant experience or 9-12 years of relevant work experience.

**Required Knowledge and Skills:**

* Knowledge of service acquisition & procurement regulations, policies and practices.
* Demonstrated training or experience in pricing, contract law, negotiations and accounting.
* Working knowledge of engineering/construction industry contracting practices.
* Experience in developing contract types (including LSTK, T&M and UR), fee arrangements and contract terms.
* Experience in developing and recommending potential solutions to contractual problems to management.
* Broad knowledge and experience in subcontract administration required.
* Strong organizational and communication (oral and written) skills, professional and proactive approach to mitigation of contract administration challenges and inherent business risks.
* Knowledge of developing and implementing strategies for negotiations utilizing accounting or cost engineering methods gained through education or experience.
* Knowledge and understanding of the project functional groups and company policies, procedures and work practices, as well as associated software systems.
* Experience in field administration of EPC contracts is an asset.
* Minimum 5 years in (sub)contract administration.
* Proficiency in all phases of the formation and award of large, moderately complex contracts.

description:
**Position: Home Specialist**

**Join Our Mission: Supporting Seniors in Aging Safely**

At Charity Care Group, we are dedicated to improving the lives of low-income seniors by enabling them to age safely and independently in their homes. As a Home Specialist for the HomeSafe: Aging in Place Assistance Program, you will play a vital role in connecting seniors to life-changing resources, building a network of service providers, and ensuring the program’s success through outreach, registration, and education efforts.

**Job Description**: Empowering Seniors Through Personalized Support

The Home Specialist will assist with in-home visits, client registration, vendor recruitment, and community outreach, ensuring seniors beneﬁt from the HomeSafe program’s services. This role is essential in connecting underserved seniors to resources and supporting the program’s compliance with HUD guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**: Delivering Personalized Support

* Prospective Vendor Outreach and Network Building:

+ Conduct outreach to licensed Occupational Therapists (OTs) and contractors to build a database of professionals interested in contracting with the HomeSafe program.
+ Cold call, email, and engage potential service providers to gauge interest and qualiﬁcations.
* Maintain an organized database of interested vendors, ensuring all licensing and credential requirements are documented.
* In-Home Registration and Application Processing:

+ Conduct physical in-home visits to assist seniors with application completion and eligibility veriﬁcation for the HomeSafe program.
* Gather and organize required veriﬁcation documents, such as income and age qualiﬁcations, to ensure compliance with HUD guidelines.
* Provide clear guidance to seniors and their families throughout the application process.
* Door-to-Door Senior Outreach:

+ Conduct door-to-door outreach in targeted communities to identify and engage eligible seniors for program participation.
+ Educate seniors about the beneﬁts of the HomeSafe program and assist with initial registration steps.
* Community Event Outreach and Education:

+ Represent the HomeSafe program at community events, senior expos, and health fairs to promote awareness and participation.
+ Distribute HUD-compliant educational materials, including multilingual resources, to underserved populations and individuals with Limited English Proﬁciency (LEP).
* Collaborate with local organizations, such as Area Agencies on Aging, to maximize outreach and impact.
* Compliance and Reporting:

+ Ensure all activities adhere to HUD’s 24 CFR Part 58 requirements and other relevant regulations.
+ Contribute to biweekly progress reports detailing outreach efforts, client registrations, vendor recruitment, and program outcomes.

**Candidate Proﬁle**: A Compassionate and Organized Professional

**We’re looking for a Home Specialist who brings:**

* Qualiﬁcations:

+ High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
+ Experience in outreach, social work, customer service, or vendor sourcing is a plus.
* Skills:

+ Strong organizational and time management abilities.
+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, especially when engaging with seniors and underserved populations.
+ Proﬁciency in data entry, maintaining accurate records, and building professional networks.
* Attributes:

+ A compassionate and empathetic approach to working with seniors.
+ Patience, professionalism, and a commitment to improving lives. Why Join Charity Care Group’s HomeSafe Program?
* Purpose-Driven Work: Make a direct impact on the safety and independence of low-income seniors.
* Collaborative Environment: Join a passionate team dedicated to community service.
* Professional Growth: Gain valuable experience in outreach, vendor recruitment, and HUD compliance.

**Embark on a Rewarding Career Path**

We invite compassionate and detail-oriented professionals to join our mission of delivering impactful change through the HomeSafe: Aging in Place Assistance Program. Your dedication will play a critical role in helping seniors live safely and independently.

**Contact Information:**

Website: www.charitycaregroup.org Agency Phone: (757) 226-9916

Agency Fax: (757) 512-8802

Clean Start with Claire is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Professional Home Organizer to join our team in Chicago, IL. - Communicate clearly and kindly with clients throughout projects

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**

You’ll support full-cycle recruiting activities to include, but not limited to:

* Collaborate with and counsel recruiting stakeholders on recruiting/hiring process and procedures
* In conjunction with Recruiting Stakeholders, craft and edit job descriptions
* Create requisitions in the recruiting system/application tracking system (ATS)
* Assist in screening applications and resumes
* Pre-screen/conduct phone interviews with candidates and could also include assisting in sourcing activities
* Schedule phone screens, interviews, and host onsite interviews if needed
* Complete and/or coordinate hiring actions within HR Systems for new team members and update as needed
* Capture and edit offer details as needed
* Ensure all candidate application details are complete to proceed with hiring
* Provide support as needed for immigration and work visa legal program
* Respond to applicants’ inquiries during the scheduling and interview process and subsequent offer and hiring process
* Other duties as needed to ensure positive candidate and hiring manager experience
* Partner with HR Customer Service Center (HR CSC) and other Hiring Stakeholders to streamline, improve processes and increase efficiency
* Work with recruiting managers to on-board new Recruiting Team members
* Schedule meetings and training sessions and facilitate as needed

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Superb verbal and written communication
* Pro-active approach and a high level of ownership
* Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize
* Previous experience with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) required

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience working in a Talent Acquisition/Recruiting environment preferred
* Experience with Microsoft Teams, OneNote, SharePoint, Skype or other collaborative system
* Experience with enterprise level systems such as Systems, Applications & Products in Data Processing (SAP)

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree above, Human Resource Management or related field of study.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits.

Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. To learn more about Micron, please visit**micron.com/careers**

For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at hrsupport\\_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.

description:
About Us:

We are a multidisciplinary electrical firm with the in-house expertise to plan, construct, install, and fully integrate a full range of electrical, control, and telecom systems. We offer a comprehensive line of innovative electrical solutions, performing work collaboratively—under one roof—to help us lower costs, increase accuracy, and promote project efficiency.

Job Summary:

The Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) supports the human resources team by identifying, engaging, and attracting qualified talent to meet the organization’s workforce needs. This role leverages a variety of sourcing channels including job boards, social media, outreach programs, and strategic search methodologies to build and maintain robust talent pipelines.

#dynor

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

**Recruitment**

* Develop and execute strategies to identify and attract high-quality candidates.
* Review the company’s hiring and talent needs to anticipate future hiring needs.
* Create specific job position questions for phone screens and interviews.
* Maintain and update job descriptions as needed.
* Assist in the creation and maintenance of job postings.
* Establish expectations and goals with the hiring manager.
* Manage the candidate screening process, including candidate sourcing, reviewing resumes, initial phone screens, gathering hiring manager feedback, and interviews.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and sourcing activity within applicant tracking system.
* Maintain CPM Training Facilitator candidate notes and recommendations.
* Work with marketing on HR LinkedIn content planning, scheduling, and social media support.
* Coordinate and distribute internal recruitment campaigns to all employees via email.
* Create and maintain a candidate recruitment tracker.

**Events & Outreach Engagement**

* Manage, coordinate, and participate in job fairs, college career fairs, and school partnerships.
* Coordinate campus presentations, guest speaker panels, and events.
* Work with division managers to build and sustain a university internship program.
* Work with division managers to grow and develop mentorships with high school students in ACE type programs.
* Work with Department of Defense recruiters to engage with veterans transitioning to civilian life.
* Manage, maintain, and organize outreach pipeline.
* Explore and assist with other outreach initiatives.

**Success In This Role**

Success in this position is demonstrated through:

* Organized and accurate talent acquisition systems and records.
* Timely completion of assigned projects and requests.
* Professional and responsive communication with internal and external stakeholders.
* Well-executed outreach events and programs.
* Consistent follow-through on commitments and deadlines.

Qualifications:

* BSc/BA (HR Management or Business Degree) preferred but not required.
* Solid understanding of talent and acquisition principles.
* Good knowledge of MS Office 365 suite.
* Job fair experience preferred.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
* Must be a self-starter and able to work with different departments.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a TAS to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

The TAS is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 20 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

**Direct Reports**

None

Work Environment:

Office-based. Monday – Friday during normal business hours.

* Health & Welfare (medical, dental & vision)
* 401(k)
* 401(k) match
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
* Flexible spending accounts
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program

description:
Join Community Mainstreaming Associates (CMA) and help us build the team behind our mission.

At Community Mainstreaming Associates (CMA), our mission is to support individuals with developmental disabilities in living fulfilling, independent lives. Through comprehensive services, we promote inclusion and empower the people we support to thrive within their communities. Learn more about us by visiting www.communitymainstreaming.org

We are looking for an HR Recruiting Specialist who is passionate about connecting talented people with meaningful careers.

What You’ll Do

As our HR Recruiting Specialist, you will play an important role in attracting and hiring employees who will make CMA’s mission possible. You will manage the full recruitment activities from the initial requisition through candidate selection and offer, while partnering closely with hiring managers and the Human Resources team.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Managing full-cycle recruitment for assigned positions.
* Creating and maintaining accurate, engaging job postings.
* Sourcing qualified candidates through job boards, social media, community outreach, career fairs, colleges, and other recruitment channels.
* Reviewing resumes and applications and conducting initial candidate screenings.
* Coordinating interviews and ensuring candidates move through the hiring process in a timely manner.
* Partnering with hiring managers to identify strong candidates and support effective interviewing and selection.
* Ensuring required interviews, approvals, documentation, and hiring steps are completed before offers are extended.
* Maintaining clear and timely communication with candidates and hiring managers.
* Supporting recruitment events and employer-branding initiatives.
* Tracking recruitment activity and using data to identify opportunities to improve our hiring process.
* Helping create a positive, professional candidate experience from application through hire.

We are looking for someone who is:

* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* A strong communicator who builds positive relationships with candidates and hiring managers.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Confident conducting candidate screenings and interviews.
* Proactive about follow-up and keeping recruitment activities moving.
* Passionate about finding the right people for the right roles.
* Committed to confidentiality, professionalism, and fairness throughout the hiring process.
* Interested in using recruitment data and creative sourcing strategies to attract talent.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, human resources, or a related field.
* Experience managing multiple open positions and competing priorities.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to conduct effective candidate screening and interviews.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with hiring managers, candidates, and employees.
* Strong computer skills and experience using applicant tracking systems and HRIS platforms.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.

**Preferred:**

* Experience recruiting within healthcare, human services, nonprofit, or similarly environment.
* Experience with ADP Workforce Now or a comparable HRIS
* Experience with recruitment analytics and sourcing strategies.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Full-cycle recruiting and talent acquisition practices
* Candidate sourcing and screening
* Applicant tracking systems and HRIS technology
* Recruitment marketing and employer branding
* Strong verbal communication
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Organization, prioritization, and time management
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Relationship building and customer service
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Ability to manage confidential information

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment

Generous Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health and financial well-being.

Health & Wellness Benefits

* Medical
* Employer-paid Dental Benefits
* Vision Plan
* Accident Insurance
* Critical Illness Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Identity Theft & Fraud Protection
* Legal Services
* 403(b) Retirement Plan: Organization match of up to 5%.
* Life Insurance: Employer-sponsored coverage.
* Voluntary Life Insurance Options.
* Long-Term Disability Benefits.
* Section 125 Flexible Spending Program.
* Tuition Assistance.
* Paid Time Off

Join our team and make a difference with us

*Community Mainstreaming Associates is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

New Fresh Investments is a highly successful real estate investment firm focusing on residential fix-and-flip and rental properties in Southern California and has years of experience investing in SoCal Real Estate. We plan to increase our volume and are seeking an enthusiastic and driven **A Player** who wants to contribute and grow with a real estate investment company in San Diego. WE WANT TO WORK WITH CLOSERS!

**COMPENSATION:** $120,000+. This position includes a base rate plus profit share, so there is high earning potential

**Compensation:**

$120,000+

**Responsibilities:**

As a Real Estate Acquisitions Associate, you will:

* Source and acquire value-add properties for renovation - primarily in Coastal North County San Diego and South Orange County.
* Prospect and maintain new agent and seller relationships.
* Generate leads through multiple strategies, including inbound and outbound calling.
* Analyze properties accurately and responsibly.
* Formulate rough renovation budgets to make buying decisions.
* Make offers and negotiate with homeowners and Realtors.
* Procure contracts on high-margin deals.
* Assist in process improvements and innovation.
* Assist in formulating and implementing marketing and lead generation processes.

**Qualifications:**

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

* **Sales Experience:** Proven success in sales, with a passion for closing deals.
* **Cold-Calling Experience:** Essential experience in cold-calling to generate leads and build relationships.
* **Self-Motivated:** Able to work independently and stay driven to achieve targets.
* **Team Player:** Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
* **Attention to Detail:** Impeccable follow-up skills and acute attention to detail.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Efficient with Microsoft Office/Google Docs.
* **Location:** Must be local to Southern CA. Orange or San Diego counties are preferred.

**About Company**

We are a fast-growing real estate investment company focused on sourcing, renovating, and selling residential properties throughout Southern California and the surrounding area. Our team is driven, collaborative, and committed to delivering value through transparency, efficiency, and creative problem-solving.

=======================

**Item**

**Detail**

Location

On-site, Contracting and Logistics Department (Code 400), Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, Maine

Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Hours are worked between 0600 and 1700 Eastern Time with a half-hour lunch; no more than 8 hours per day.

Telework

On-site position. Telework is not a right and is available only with Government concurrence.

None anticipated

Five (5) in the base period; seven (7) in option period one

Salary range

$80,000 to $90,000

--------------------

The Contract Specialist is embedded with the Contracting and Logistics Department (Code 400) at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, which maintains, repairs, and modernizes LOS ANGELES and VIRGINIA Class submarines. The Contract Specialist assists Government contracting officers in planning, soliciting, awarding, and administering fixed-price and cost contracts for supplies, services, and information technology, in accordance with the FAR, DFARS, and local command policies.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Provide full acquisition lifecycle (cradle-to-grave) contracting support for complex equipment, supplies, services, and information technology, covering pre-award, award, and post-award contract administration.
* Provide critical analysis and pricing support using advanced Excel functions (HLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting with custom formulas, and complex nested functions) to arrive at fixed-price rates and cost-reimbursable projections from very large datasets.
* Assist program offices in preparing Independent Government Estimates (IGEs), including research on previous purchases, current market value, and other agency purchases.
* Provide advice and recommendations on acquisition strategy, including approaches, risks, contracting methods, competition, sources, cost, and milestone schedules; prepare Justifications and Approvals and market research memorandums.
* Prepare Requests for Quotes (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Combined Synopsis/Solicitations with all appropriate terms and conditions; verify funds availability and obtain legal concurrence where applicable before release.
* Assist in the evaluation process and document informal and formal source selections, including Source Selection Plans, evaluation sheets, Conflict of Interest/Nondisclosure Forms, and draft Source Selection Decision Memorandums.
* Work with evaluators and the Contracting Officer to identify pre-negotiation objectives; prepare contract award documents for task orders, delivery orders, and stand-alone contracts; prepare COR designation letters; distribute awards; and input award information into FPDS-NG.
* Prepare documentation for the exercise of options and post-award modifications (SF-30), and assist in resolving contractor performance issues.
* Provide on-the-job knowledge sharing, training, and mentorship, including PowerPoint presentations and job aids.
* Review work internally (contractor to contractor) for accuracy against regulations, policies, and standard procedures before submitting documentation to a Contracting Officer for review and signature.
* Perform to local Procurement Action Lead Time requirements, use the local contract management system in accordance with local policies, record hours daily by 8:00 a.m., and attend meetings as requested.
* Complete required Shipyard training, including the Acquisition Management System (AMS), Electronic Procurement System (ePS), DoD Cyber Security Awareness, and PNSY Contractor New Employee Orientation.

*This position supports Government contracting officers and does not perform inherently governmental functions or bind the Government.*

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Five (5) years of Government contracting experience, including commercial and non-commercial supplies and services, IDIQs, and task and delivery orders.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* DAWIA Contracting Professional certification or equivalent (for example, FAC-C or FAC-C-DoD)..
* Expert knowledge of Federal contracting law, regulation, policies and precedents, and related principles and procedures sufficient to plan, lead, review, or audit the most complex procurement functions.
* Skill in promoting e-commerce and supporting the use of automated acquisition systems and other electronic systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including strong experience with advanced Excel functions (lookups, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting with custom formulas, nested functions).
* U.S. citizenship.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable NACI background investigation and installation access credentials (CAC/DBIDS). No security clearance is required.

**Requirements**
----------------

**MOS Code: 001637 (Navy)**

Education and Experience: High School Diploma or GED or higher and three (3) years of experience in requisitioning, shipping, receiving, storing, and or transporting hazardous medical materials, supplies, or equipment.

Licenses and Certificates: Valid Texas Class "C" Driver's License or equivalent from another state by time of appointment.

**General Purpose**
-------------------

Under general supervision, maintain inventory of property, medical equipment, supplies, prepare requisitions, and purchase complex stock, equipment, and supplies. Inventory warehouses, stockrooms, and yards. Transport hazardous materials.

**Typical Duties**
------------------

Inventory management. Involves: Receiving shipments, verifying the contents of each shipment against purchase orders or bills of lading, checking for damage, and documenting any discrepancies. Tracking stock levels, conducting regular inventory counts, and updating inventory management systems. Picking, packing, and preparing items for shipment based on work orders. Entering data into inventory management systems and maintaining logs of incoming and outgoing shipments. Maintaining work areas organized and free of hazards, and ensuring a clean and safe working environment. Coordinating with shipping companies, preparing shipping labels, and ensuring all necessary documentation is completed for outgoing shipments. Working as part of a team to ensure efficient warehouse operations and support of the logistics team.

Provide service to customers by meeting their needs for supplies and resources. Involves: Receiving daily service requests from internal customers and providing supplies and resources. Review inventory records and ensure that stock levels are maintained. Order and reorder stock items to ensure inventories of minimum acceptable quantities are available to support the operating efficiency of departmental units. Prepare, update, and maintain stock records. Contact and work with approved vendors to identify price, quality, availability, and shipment date. Assist procurement professionals as directed with searches for possible supply or service vendors to be reviewed and approved by them for addition to the City's acceptable sources list. Deliver or direct issuance and delivery of stock items. Utilize and read technical manuals and access computer programs to identify supplies. Prepare, update, correct, and maintain files of the inventory database system to accurately reflect stock levels and maintain related transaction records.

**General Information**
-----------------------

Note: This is an unclassified contract position. Employment is predicated on continuation of state/federal funding.

**Note: Applicants are encouraged to apply immediately. This position will close when a preset number of qualified applications have been received.**

Note: Applicants with foreign diplomas, transcripts and degrees must have all documents translated and evaluated by an agency of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES)**prior**to submitting them to the Human Resources Department. Please visit www.naces.org/members for more information

A résumé and/or other documents will not be accepted in lieu of a completed application. Comments such as “See résumé” are not acceptable and will result in the application being considered incomplete.

To qualify for this position, required education, experience, knowledge and skills must be clearly stated on your application’s employment history. We do not use any information on your resume to review if you meet the minimum qualifications for this position.

Failure to fully detail all experience and job duties in the application, or copying/pasting directly from the job specification, or responses referring to your résumé will eliminate you from consideration for the position.

Description:

**Job Title:** Fleet Parts Specialist – Mechanic

**Job Type:** Full-Time (45+ hours/week), Monday–Friday
**Work Hours:** Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. preferred

**Pay Range:** $27-$30/hour

**Location:** 630 Proctor Ave NW, Elk River, MN 55330

**Position Summary**

The Fleet Parts Specialist is responsible for managing the company’s fleet-parts inventory and ensuring the parts, supplies, and equipment needed to maintain company vehicles are available when required. This role requires a strong understanding of OEM and aftermarket parts for trucks, light-duty vehicles, and related equipment.

This position works closely with the Fleet Department, maintenance technicians, drivers, operations staff, and vendors to identify parts needs, research and source products, place orders, maintain inventory accuracy, and control costs.

The Fleet Parts Specialist helps minimize vehicle and equipment downtime by ensuring parts are available for scheduled maintenance and emergency repairs while maintaining an organized and cost-effective inventory.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The essential functions include, but are not limited to:

**Parts Purchasing & Sourcing**

* Identify and source parts needed for fleet vehicles and maintenance.
* Research parts using manufacturer information, VINs, equipment numbers, parts catalogs, and vendor resources.
* Obtain pricing and availability from multiple vendors when appropriate.
* Place parts orders and monitor orders through delivery.
* Develop and maintain relationships with parts suppliers and vendors.
* Verify parts received against purchase orders and invoices.
* Process returns, cores, warranties, and incorrect or damaged parts.

**Inventory Management**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of fleet parts, supplies, and shop materials.
* Receive, label, organize, and properly store incoming parts.
* Maintain appropriate minimum and maximum inventory levels.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory counts and reconcile discrepancies.
* Identify slow-moving, obsolete, or excess inventory.
* Ensure commonly used parts are readily available to reduce fleet downtime.
* Maintain an organized and clean parts-storage area.

**Fleet & Maintenance Support**

* Work directly with Fleet Maintenance personnel to identify parts required for repairs and preventive maintenance.
* Assist technicians in locating parts and identifying appropriate replacements.
* Help research alternative or aftermarket parts when appropriate.
* Coordinate parts availability with scheduled maintenance and repair work.
* Assist with emergency parts sourcing when vehicles or equipment are down.
* Track parts used for individual vehicles and equipment as required.
* Help maintain vehicle and equipment maintenance records.

**Administrative & Cost Control**

* Enter purchase orders, receipts, and parts information into the company’s inventory or maintenance system.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, costs, vendors, warranties, and returns.
* Monitor parts spending and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Compare vendor pricing and negotiate pricing when appropriate.
* Ensure invoices and purchase orders are properly matched and coded.
* Provide reports regarding inventory levels, parts usage, and purchasing activity.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Follow all company safety policies and procedures.
* Maintain a clean and organized parts and storage area.
* Properly handle and store parts, fluids, chemicals, and other shop-related materials.
* Follow applicable DOT, OSHA, and company requirements as they relate to the position.

Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience with automotive, truck, fleet, or equipment parts, purchasing, or inventory management.
* Ability to identify and research vehicle and equipment parts.
* Strong organizational, recordkeeping, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn fleet and inventory management software.
* Effective communication skills when working with technicians, vendors, drivers, and management.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to safely operate a forklift. The company will provide required forklift training and safety testing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with heavy-duty trucks, diesel equipment, trailers, or commercial fleet maintenance.
* Previous parts department or fleet parts experience.
* Experience with inventory management or purchasing systems.
* Knowledge of automotive and heavy-duty truck parts.
* Experience using parts catalogs, VIN lookups, or manufacturer databases.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities

The Opportunity:

RS&H is seeking a Temporary Talent Acquisition Specialist to support our Information Technology recruiting efforts. This position may work remotely, in-office, or in a hybrid environment.

In this role, you will partner with hiring managers and HR stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top technology talent for a variety of IT-related positions. You will manage the full recruitment lifecycle, build candidate pipelines, provide market insights, and ensure an exceptional candidate experience while helping meet immediate business staffing needs.

**In this role you will:**

* Manage full-cycle recruitment for IT and technology-related positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruiting strategies.
* Source, screen, and evaluate candidates to assess qualifications and alignment with position requirements.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified technology professionals through networking, sourcing, and relationship management.
* Coordinate and facilitate interview processes, providing guidance to hiring teams throughout the selection process.
* Lead candidate communications and offer negotiations.
* Monitor recruiting activity and provide updates on hiring progress, market trends, and candidate availability.
* Support improvements to recruiting processes and identify opportunities to increase efficiency.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting data within the applicant tracking system.
* Ensure recruiting practices align with applicable employment regulations and company policies.

**To be successful in this role you will have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of five years of full-cycle recruiting or staffing experience.
* Experience recruiting for IT, technology, or related technical positions.
* Proven ability to source, qualify, and engage candidates in a competitive talent market.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and providing recruiting consultation throughout the hiring process.
* Knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and recruiting best practices, including OFCCP requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience using applicant tracking systems, preferably iCIMS.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and take initiative.

**Preferred qualifications and experience:**

* Human Resources certification.
* Experience recruiting within technology-focused organizations or technical environments.

**Why Join Us**

At RS&H, you'll be part of a collaborative team dedicated to connecting talented professionals with meaningful career opportunities. This temporary opportunity offers the chance to make an immediate impact by supporting critical IT hiring initiatives while partnering with leaders across the organization.

If you're an experienced recruiter with a passion for technology talent acquisition and building strong candidate relationships, we encourage you to apply.

***An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.***

Please view Equal Employment Opportunity Posters provided by OFCCP here.

***Please note: no agency representati******on or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy. Candidates should apply directly to this role to be considered.*** It is the responsibility of all third-party recruiting and employment agencies to know and adhere to our recruiting policy.

The Company:

Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together. We offer an exceptional journey from start to future. Our integrated teams translate experience into insight, turn challenges into opportunities, and build relationships that are as strong as the buildings and infrastructure we deliver together. We attribute our success to our unwavering commitment to our core values: integrity, accountability, curiosity, and teamwork.
